internal static class SR
{
	private static List<ResourceManager> _resourceManagers;

	private static int _customResourcesVersion;

	internal static int CustomResourcesVersion => _customResourcesVersion;

	static SR()
	{
		Assembly assembly = typeof(SR).Assembly;
		object[] customAttributes = assembly.GetCustomAttributes(typeof(StringResourceLocationAttribute), inherit: true);
		if (customAttributes == null || customAttributes.Length == 0)
		{
			throw new InvalidOperationException("Assembly is missing the StringResourceLocation attribute.");
		}
		string[] array = ((customAttributes[0] as StringResourceLocationAttribute) ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Error retrieving the StringResourceLocation attribute.")).Location.Split(';');
		int num = 0;
		string[] array2 = array;
		foreach (string text in array2)
		{
			if (text != null && text.Length > 0)
			{
				num++;
			}
		}
		_resourceManagers = new List<ResourceManager>();
		array2 = array;
		foreach (string text2 in array2)
		{
			if (text2 != null && text2.Length > 0)
			{
				_resourceManagers.Add(new ResourceManager(text2, assembly));
			}
		}
	}

	internal static string GetString(string resourceName)
	{
		foreach (ResourceManager resourceManager in _resourceManagers)
		{
			string text = resourceManager.GetString(resourceName, CultureInfo.CurrentUICulture);
			if (text != null)
			{
				return text;
			}
		}
		return null;
	}

	internal static void AddResource(string name, Assembly assembly)
	{
		ResourceManager resourceManager = new ResourceManager(name, assembly);
		resourceManager.GetString("DummyValue");
		_resourceManagers.Insert(0, resourceManager);
		_customResourcesVersion++;
	}

	internal static void RemoveResource(string name)
	{
		ResourceManager resourceManager = null;
		int num = 0;
		foreach (ResourceManager resourceManager2 in _resourceManagers)
		{
			if (resourceManager2.BaseName == name)
			{
				resourceManager = resourceManager2;
				break;
			}
			num++;
		}
		if (resourceManager != null)
		{
			_resourceManagers.Remove(resourceManager);
			_customResourcesVersion++;
		}
	}

	internal static string GetString(string resourceName, params object[] args)
	{
		string text = GetString(resourceName);
		if (text != null && args != null && args.Length != 0 && text.Length > 2)
		{
			try
			{
				text = string.Format(null, text, args);
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}
		return text;
	}
}
public class LRUCache<TKey, TValue>
{
	private int _maxItems;

	private LinkedList<LRUCacheItem<TKey, TValue>> _usedOrder;

	private FastIterationDictionary<TKey, LRUCacheItem<TKey, TValue>> _cache;

	public int MaxItems
	{
		get
		{
			return _maxItems;
		}
		set
		{
			_maxItems = value;
			while (_cache.Count > _maxItems)
			{
				Remove(_usedOrder.Last.Value.Key);
			}
		}
	}

	public FastIterationDictionary<TKey, LRUCacheItem<TKey, TValue>> InnerCache => _cache;

	public TValue this[TKey key]
	{
		get
		{
			if (!_cache.ContainsKey(key))
			{
				return default(TValue);
			}
			LRUCacheItem<TKey, TValue> lRUCacheItem = _cache[key];
			LinkedListNode<LRUCacheItem<TKey, TValue>> node = lRUCacheItem.Node;
			_usedOrder.Remove(node);
			_usedOrder.AddFirst(node.Value);
			lRUCacheItem.Node = _usedOrder.First;
			return lRUCacheItem.Value;
		}
		set
		{
			if (!_cache.ContainsKey(key))
			{
				LRUCacheItem<TKey, TValue> lRUCacheItem = new LRUCacheItem<TKey, TValue>();
				lRUCacheItem.Value = value;
				lRUCacheItem.Key = key;
				_usedOrder.AddFirst(lRUCacheItem);
				lRUCacheItem.Node = _usedOrder.First;
				_cache.Add(key, lRUCacheItem);
			}
			else
			{
				_ = this[key];
				_cache[key].Value = value;
			}
			while (_cache.Count > _maxItems)
			{
				Remove(_usedOrder.Last.Value.Key);
			}
		}
	}

	public int Count => _cache.Count;

	public LRUCache(int maxItems)
		: this(maxItems, (IEqualityComparer<TKey>)null)
	{
	}

	public LRUCache(int maxItems, IEqualityComparer<TKey> comparer)
	{
		_usedOrder = new LinkedList<LRUCacheItem<TKey, TValue>>();
		_cache = new FastIterationDictionary<TKey, LRUCacheItem<TKey, TValue>>(comparer);
		_maxItems = maxItems;
	}

	public bool ContainsKey(TKey key)
	{
		return _cache.ContainsKey(key);
	}

	public void Remove(TKey key)
	{
		if (_cache.ContainsKey(key))
		{
			LRUCacheItem<TKey, TValue> lRUCacheItem = _cache[key];
			_usedOrder.Remove(lRUCacheItem.Node);
			_cache.Remove(lRUCacheItem.Key);
		}
	}

	public void Clear()
	{
		_cache.Clear();
		_usedOrder = new LinkedList<LRUCacheItem<TKey, TValue>>();
	}
}
public class LRUCacheItem<TKey, TValue>
{
	public TKey Key { get; set; }

	public TValue Value { get; set; }

	public LinkedListNode<LRUCacheItem<TKey, TValue>> Node { get; set; }
}

namespace Infragistics
{
	public class AnimationManager
	{
		private ITickProvider _tickProvider;

		private Dictionary<string, AnimationState> _currentAnimations = new Dictionary<string, AnimationState>();

		private bool _isTicking;

		private int _tickID = -1;

		public AnimationManager(ITickProvider tickProvider)
		{
			_tickProvider = tickProvider;
		}

		private DateTime GetStartTime()
		{
			return DateTime.Now;
		}

		public void AddAnimation(string animationKey, object target, int duration, Action<double, AnimationState> tickAnimation, Func<double, double> easingFunction, double from, double to)
		{
			AnimationState animationState = new AnimationState();
			animationState.FromValue = from;
			animationState.ToValue = to;
			animationState.Target = target;
			animationState.Duration = duration;
			animationState.StartTime = GetStartTime();
			animationState.Tick = tickAnimation;
			animationState.Easing = easingFunction;
			AddAnimation(animationState);
		}

		public void AddAnimation(string animationKey, object target, int duration, Action<double, AnimationState> tickAnimation, Func<double, double> easingFunction)
		{
			AnimationState animationState = new AnimationState();
			animationState.Key = animationKey;
			animationState.Target = target;
			animationState.Duration = duration;
			animationState.StartTime = GetStartTime();
			animationState.Tick = tickAnimation;
			animationState.Easing = easingFunction;
			AddAnimation(animationState);
		}

		private void AddAnimation(AnimationState state)
		{
			if (_currentAnimations.ContainsKey(state.Key))
			{
				CancelAnimation(state.Key, CancelBehavior.KeepCurrent);
			}
			_currentAnimations.Add(state.Key, state);
			CheckTicking();
			_tickProvider.RequestFrame(_tickID);
		}

		public void CancelAnimation(string animationKey, CancelBehavior cancelBehavior)
		{
			if (_currentAnimations.ContainsKey(animationKey))
			{
				AnimationState animationState = _currentAnimations[animationKey];
				_ = animationState.Tick;
				if (cancelBehavior == CancelBehavior.ToBeginning)
				{
					animationState.Tick(animationState.Easing(0.0), animationState);
				}
				if (cancelBehavior == CancelBehavior.ToEnd)
				{
					animationState.Tick(animationState.Easing(1.0), animationState);
				}
				_currentAnimations.Remove(animationKey);
				CheckTicking();
			}
		}

		private void CheckTicking()
		{
			if (_currentAnimations.Count == 0)
			{
				TeardownTicking();
			}
			else
			{
				SetupTicking();
			}
		}

		private void SetupTicking()
		{
			if (!_isTicking)
			{
				_isTicking = true;
				_tickID = _tickProvider.SetupTicking(Tick);
			}
		}

		private void TeardownTicking()
		{
			if (_isTicking)
			{
				_tickProvider.TeardownTicking(_tickID);
				_tickID = -1;
			}
			_isTicking = false;
		}

		[Weak]
		private void Tick()
		{
			DateTime now = DateTime.Now;
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			foreach (AnimationState value in _currentAnimations.Values)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				int num = (int)(now - value.StartTime).TotalMilliseconds;
				if (num >= value.Duration)
				{
					num = value.Duration;
					flag = true;
				}
				if (num - value.LastRender >= 16 || num == value.Duration)
				{
					value.LastRender = num;
					value.IsCompleting = flag;
					double arg = (double)num / (double)value.Duration;
					arg = value.Easing(arg);
					value.Tick(arg, value);
					if (flag)
					{
						list.Add(value.Key);
					}
				}
			}
			foreach (string item in list)
			{
				_currentAnimations.Remove(item);
			}
			CheckTicking();
			if (_isTicking)
			{
				_tickProvider.RequestFrame(_tickID);
			}
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			_currentAnimations.Clear();
			TeardownTicking();
		}
	}
	public class AnimationState
	{
		public double ToValue { get; set; }

		public double FromValue { get; set; }

		public object Target { get; set; }

		public int Duration { get; set; }

		public DateTime StartTime { get; set; }

		public Action<double, AnimationState> Tick { get; set; }

		public Func<double, double> Easing { get; set; }

		public string Key { get; set; }

		public int LastRender { get; set; }

		public bool IsCompleting { get; set; }
	}
	public enum CancelBehavior
	{
		KeepCurrent,
		ToEnd,
		ToBeginning
	}
	public interface ITickProvider
	{
		int SetupTicking(Action callback);

		void RequestFrame(int id);

		void TeardownTicking(int id);
	}
	public abstract class AxisBase : Control, IDisposable
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty AutoRangeProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("AutoRange", typeof(bool), typeof(AxisBase), new PropertyMetadata(true, OnPropertyChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ScrollScaleProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ScrollScale", typeof(double), typeof(AxisBase), new PropertyMetadata(1.0, OnPropertyChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ScrollPositionProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ScrollPosition", typeof(double), typeof(AxisBase), new PropertyMetadata(0.0, OnPropertyChanged));

		private bool _disposed;

		public bool AutoRange

			get

			}
			set
			{
				_disposed = value;
			}
		}

		private static void OnPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			AxisBase axisBase = d as AxisBase;
			if (d != null)
			{
				axisBase.OnPropertyChanged(e);
			}
		}

		protected new virtual void OnPropertyChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
		}

		~AxisBase()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: false);
		}

		protected virtual void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			Disposed = true;
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: true);
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}
	}

			set

				SetValue(StyleProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public Brush Fill
		{
			get

				return (Brush)GetValue(FillProperty);

		protected StripeGroupBase()

		}

		private static bool AxisUnitValidateCallback(object value)
		{
			return (double)value >= 0.0;
		}

		protected internal static void OnPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)

			(d as StripeGroupBase).OnPropertyChanged(e);

		}

	public class GroupBy : DependencyObject, IEnumerable, INotifyCollectionChanged
	{
		private class Group
		{
			public object Key { get; set; }

			public IList<object> Items { get; set; }
		}

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ItemsSourceProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ItemsSource", typeof(IEnumerable), typeof(GroupBy), new PropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject o, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			(o as GroupBy).OnPropertyChanged("ItemsSource", e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
		}));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty KeyMemberPathProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("KeyMemberPath", typeof(string), typeof(GroupBy), new PropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject o, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			(o as GroupBy).OnPropertyChanged("KeyMemberPath", e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
		}));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ValueMemberPathProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ValueMemberPath", typeof(string), typeof(GroupBy), new PropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject o, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			(o as GroupBy).OnPropertyChanged("ValueMemberPath", e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
		}));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty GroupMemberPathProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("GroupMemberPath", typeof(string), typeof(GroupBy), new PropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject o, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			(o as GroupBy).OnPropertyChanged("GroupMemberPath", e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
		}));

		private FastReflectionHelper _frh = new FastReflectionHelper();

		private INotifyCollectionChanged _source;

		private List<string> _seriesKeys = new List<string>();

		private List<object> _output = new List<object>();

		public IEnumerable ItemsSource
		{
			get
			{
				return (IEnumerable)GetValue(ItemsSourceProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ItemsSourceProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public string KeyMemberPath
		{
			get
			{
				return (string)GetValue(KeyMemberPathProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(KeyMemberPathProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public string ValueMemberPath
		{
			get
			{
				return (string)GetValue(ValueMemberPathProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ValueMemberPathProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public string GroupMemberPath
		{
			get
			{
				return (string)GetValue(GroupMemberPathProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(GroupMemberPathProperty, value);
			}
		}

		internal int NumberOfSeries { get; set; }

		internal List<string> SeriesKeys
		{
			get
			{
				return _seriesKeys;
			}
			set
			{
				_seriesKeys = value;
			}
		}

		public event NotifyCollectionChangedEventHandler CollectionChanged;

		private void OnPropertyChanged(string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			RefreshOutput();
		}

		private void RefreshOutput()
		{
			if (Valid())
			{
				Listen();
				RefreshItems();
				RaiseCollectionChanged();
			}
		}

		private void RefreshItems()
		{
			_frh.PropertyName = GroupMemberPath;
			_output.Clear();
			List<Group> list = (from item in ItemsSource.OfType<object>()
				group item by _frh.GetPropertyValue(item) into gr
				select new Group
				{
					Key = gr.Key,
					Items = gr.ToList()
				}).ToList();
			_frh.PropertyName = KeyMemberPath;
			GroupingProxyHelper.CreateObject objectCreator = GetObjectCreator(list);
			Dictionary<string, bool> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, bool>();
			SeriesKeys.Clear();
			foreach (Group item in list)
			{
				GroupingBase groupingBase = objectCreator();
				groupingBase.Key = item.Key;
				foreach (object item2 in item.Items)
				{
					object propertyValue = _frh.GetPropertyValue(item2);
					string text = "Unkeyed";
					if (propertyValue != null)
					{
						text = Sanitize(propertyValue.ToString());
					}
					groupingBase.SetObjectForKey(text, item2);
					if (!dictionary.ContainsKey(text))
					{
						dictionary.Add(text, value: true);
						SeriesKeys.Add(text);
					}
				}
				_output.Add(groupingBase);
			}
			NumberOfSeries = SeriesKeys.Count;
		}

		private GroupingProxyHelper.CreateObject GetObjectCreator(List<Group> groups)
		{
			List<ConcretePropertyInfo> properties = GetProperties(groups);
			if (GroupingProxyHelper.DistinctKeysTypes(properties) == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			try
			{
				return GroupingProxyHelper.CreateObjectCreator(properties);
			}
			catch (MissingMethodException)
			{
				return () => new GroupingBase();
			}
		}

		private List<ConcretePropertyInfo> GetProperties(List<Group> groups)
		{
			var enumerable = from g in groups
				from item in g.Items
				group item by _frh.GetPropertyValue(item) into gr
				select new
				{
					Key = gr.Key,
					Types = from item in gr
						group item by item.GetType() into subGr
						select subGr.Key
				} into kt
				from t in kt.Types
				select new
				{
					Key = kt.Key,
					Type = t
				};
			List<ConcretePropertyInfo> list = new List<ConcretePropertyInfo>();
			foreach (var item in enumerable)
			{
				object key = item.Key;
				string text = "Unkeyed";
				if (key != null)
				{
					text = Sanitize(key.ToString());
				}
				foreach (PropertyInfo item2 in from p in item.Type.GetProperties(BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.FlattenHierarchy)
					select (p))
				{
					list.Add(new ConcretePropertyInfo
					{
						SourceType = item.Type,
						Key = text,
						Name = item2.Name,
						PropertyType = item2.PropertyType,
						PropertyName = text + "_" + item2.Name,
						PropertyInfo = item2
					});
				}
				if (ValueMemberPath != null && ValueMemberPath.StartsWith("[") && ValueMemberPath.EndsWith("]"))
				{
					PropertyInfo property = item.Type.GetProperty("Item", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.GetProperty);
					if (property != null)
					{
						string text2 = ValueMemberPath.Replace("[", "").Replace("]", "");
						list.Add(new ConcretePropertyInfo
						{
							SourceType = item.Type,
							Key = text,
							Name = text2,
							PropertyType = property.PropertyType,
							PropertyName = text + "_" + text2,
							PropertyInfo = property
						});
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private string Sanitize(string key)
		{
			return key.Replace(".", "__dot__");
		}

		private void Listen()
		{
			if (_source != null)
			{
				_source.CollectionChanged -= Source_CollectionChanged;
			}
			_source = ItemsSource as INotifyCollectionChanged;
			if (_source != null)
			{
				_source.CollectionChanged += Source_CollectionChanged;
			}
		}

		private void Source_CollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			RefreshOutput();
			RaiseCollectionChanged();
		}

		private bool Valid()
		{
			if (ItemsSource != null && GroupMemberPath != null)
			{
				return KeyMemberPath != null;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void RaiseCollectionChanged()
		{
			if (this.CollectionChanged != null)
			{
				this.CollectionChanged(this, new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset));
			}
		}

		public IEnumerator GetEnumerator()
		{
			if (_output == null)
			{
				return new List<object>().GetEnumerator();
			}
			return _output.GetEnumerator();
		}
	}
	internal class ConcretePropertyInfo
	{
		public string Key { get; set; }

		public string Name { get; set; }

		public string PropertyName { get; set; }

		public Type SourceType { get; set; }

		public Type PropertyType { get; set; }

		public PropertyInfo PropertyInfo { get; set; }
	}
	public class GroupingBase
	{
		public object Key { get; set; }

		public void SetObjectForKey(string key, object obj)
		{
			SetObjectForKeyOverride(key, obj);
		}

		protected virtual void SetObjectForKeyOverride(string key, object obj)
		{
		}

		public T GetDefaultValue<T>()
		{
			return default(T);
		}
	}
	internal static class GroupingProxyHelper
	{
		public delegate GroupingBase CreateObject();

		private static AssemblyBuilder _ab;

		private static ModuleBuilder _mb;

		private static Dictionary<string, CreateObject> _creatorCache;

		public static CreateObject CreateObjectCreator(List<ConcretePropertyInfo> props)
		{
			if (_creatorCache == null)
			{
				_creatorCache = new Dictionary<string, CreateObject>();
			}
			string cacheKey = GetCacheKey(props);
			if (_creatorCache.ContainsKey(cacheKey))
			{
				return _creatorCache[cacheKey];
			}
			new List<object>();
			ConstructorInfo constructor = CreateProxyType(props).GetConstructor(new Type[0]);
			DynamicMethod dynamicMethod = new DynamicMethod("Creator", typeof(GroupingBase), new Type[0]);
			ILGenerator iLGenerator = dynamicMethod.GetILGenerator();
			iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Newobj, constructor);
			iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Ret);
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(CreateObject);
			CreateObject createObject = (CreateObject)dynamicMethod.CreateDelegate(typeFromHandle);
			_creatorCache.Add(cacheKey, createObject);
			return createObject;
		}

		private static string GetCacheKey(List<ConcretePropertyInfo> props)
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			foreach (ConcretePropertyInfo item in props.OrderBy((ConcretePropertyInfo p) => p.PropertyName))
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(item.PropertyName);
				stringBuilder.Append("@@");
				stringBuilder.Append(item.PropertyType.FullName);
				stringBuilder.Append("@@");
				stringBuilder.Append(item.SourceType.FullName);
				stringBuilder.Append(";;");
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		public static List<Tuple<string, Type>> DistinctKeysTypes(List<ConcretePropertyInfo> props)
		{
			IEnumerable<Tuple<string, Type>> source = from prop in props
				group prop by new
				{
					Key = prop.Key,
					Type = prop.SourceType
				} into gr
				select new Tuple<string, Type>(gr.Key.Key, gr.Key.Type);
			IEnumerable<IGrouping<string, ConcretePropertyInfo>> source2 = from prop in props
				group prop by prop.Key into gr
				select (gr);
			if (source.Count() != source2.Count())
			{
				return null;
			}
			return source.ToList();
		}

		private static Type CreateProxyType(List<ConcretePropertyInfo> props)
		{
			if (_ab == null)
			{
				AssemblyName assemblyName = new AssemblyName("DynamicAssembly");
				_ab = AppDomain.CurrentDomain.DefineDynamicAssembly(assemblyName, AssemblyBuilderAccess.Run);
				_mb = _ab.DefineDynamicModule(assemblyName.Name);
			}
			TypeBuilder typeBuilder = _mb.DefineType(Guid.NewGuid().ToString() + "__proxy", TypeAttributes.Public, typeof(GroupingBase));
			Dictionary<string, FieldBuilder> fields = new Dictionary<string, FieldBuilder>();
			CreateFields(props, typeBuilder, fields);
			CreateProperties(props, typeBuilder, fields);
			CreateSetter(props, typeBuilder, fields);
			return typeBuilder.CreateType();
		}

		private static void CreateFields(List<ConcretePropertyInfo> props, TypeBuilder tb, Dictionary<string, FieldBuilder> fields)
		{
			foreach (Tuple<string, Type> item in DistinctKeysTypes(props))
			{
				FieldBuilder value = tb.DefineField("_" + item.Item1, item.Item2, FieldAttributes.Private);
				fields.Add(item.Item1, value);
			}
		}

		private static void CreateSetter(List<ConcretePropertyInfo> props, TypeBuilder tb, Dictionary<string, FieldBuilder> fields)
		{
			ILGenerator iLGenerator = tb.DefineMethod("SetObjectForKeyOverride", MethodAttributes.Public | MethodAttributes.Virtual, typeof(void), new Type[2]
			{
				typeof(string),
				typeof(object)
			}).GetILGenerator();
			MethodInfo method = typeof(string).GetMethod("op_Equality", BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.NonPublic, null, new Type[2]
			{
				typeof(string),
				typeof(string)
			}, null);
			iLGenerator.DeclareLocal(typeof(string));
			Dictionary<string, System.Reflection.Emit.Label> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, System.Reflection.Emit.Label>();
			iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Ldarg_1);
			iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Stloc_0);
			iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Ldloc_0);
			System.Reflection.Emit.Label label = iLGenerator.DefineLabel();
			iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Brfalse, label);
			foreach (Tuple<string, Type> item in DistinctKeysTypes(props))
			{
				System.Reflection.Emit.Label label2 = iLGenerator.DefineLabel();
				dictionary[item.Item1] = label2;
				iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Ldloc_0);
				iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Ldstr, item.Item1);
				iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Call, method);
				iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Brtrue, label2);
			}
			iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Br, label);
			foreach (Tuple<string, Type> item2 in DistinctKeysTypes(props))
			{
				System.Reflection.Emit.Label loc = dictionary[item2.Item1];
				iLGenerator.MarkLabel(loc);
				iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Ldarg_0);
				iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Ldarg_2);
				iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Isinst, item2.Item2);
				iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Stfld, fields[item2.Item1]);
				iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Br, label);
			}
			iLGenerator.MarkLabel(label);
			iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Ret);
		}

		private static void CreateProperties(List<ConcretePropertyInfo> props, TypeBuilder typeBuilder, Dictionary<string, FieldBuilder> fields)
		{
			foreach (ConcretePropertyInfo prop in props)
			{
				PropertyBuilder propertyBuilder = typeBuilder.DefineProperty(prop.PropertyName, PropertyAttributes.None, prop.PropertyType, null);
				MethodBuilder getMethod = CreateGetMethod(prop, typeBuilder, fields);
				propertyBuilder.SetGetMethod(getMethod);
				PropertyInfo propertyInfo = prop.SourceType.GetProperty(prop.Name);
				if (propertyInfo == null)
				{
					propertyInfo = prop.PropertyInfo;
				}
				if (propertyInfo.CanWrite)
				{
					MethodBuilder setMethod = CreateSetMethod(prop, typeBuilder, fields);
					propertyBuilder.SetSetMethod(setMethod);
				}
			}
		}

		private static MethodBuilder CreateSetMethod(ConcretePropertyInfo info, TypeBuilder typeBuilder, Dictionary<string, FieldBuilder> fields)
		{
			PropertyInfo propertyInfo = info.SourceType.GetProperty(info.Name);
			if (propertyInfo == null)
			{
				propertyInfo = info.PropertyInfo;
			}
			MethodInfo setMethod = propertyInfo.GetSetMethod();
			Type[] parameterTypes = (from p in setMethod.GetParameters()
				select p.ParameterType).ToArray();
			MethodBuilder methodBuilder = typeBuilder.DefineMethod("set_" + info.PropertyName, setMethod.Attributes, setMethod.CallingConvention, setMethod.ReturnType, parameterTypes);
			ILGenerator iLGenerator = methodBuilder.GetILGenerator();
			iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Ldarg_0);
			iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Ldfld, fields[info.Key]);
			iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Ldarg_1);
			iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Callvirt, setMethod);
			iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Ret);
			return methodBuilder;
		}

		private static MethodBuilder CreateGetMethod(ConcretePropertyInfo info, TypeBuilder typeBuilder, Dictionary<string, FieldBuilder> fields)
		{
			PropertyInfo propertyInfo = info.SourceType.GetProperty(info.Name);
			if (propertyInfo == null)
			{
				propertyInfo = info.PropertyInfo;
			}
			MethodInfo getMethod = propertyInfo.GetGetMethod();
			IEnumerable<Type> source = from p in getMethod.GetParameters()
				select p.ParameterType;
			MethodBuilder methodBuilder = typeBuilder.DefineMethod("get_" + info.PropertyName, getMethod.Attributes, getMethod.CallingConvention, getMethod.ReturnType, Type.EmptyTypes);
			MethodInfo method = typeof(GroupingBase).GetMethod("GetDefaultValue");
			ILGenerator iLGenerator = methodBuilder.GetILGenerator();
			System.Reflection.Emit.Label label = iLGenerator.DefineLabel();
			iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Ldarg_0);
			iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Ldfld, fields[info.Key]);
			iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Ldnull);
			iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Ceq);
			iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Brtrue, label);
			iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Ldarg_0);
			iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Ldfld, fields[info.Key]);
			if (source.Any())
			{
				iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Ldstr, info.Name);
			}
			iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Callvirt, getMethod);
			iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Ret);
			iLGenerator.MarkLabel(label);
			MethodInfo meth = method.MakeGenericMethod(getMethod.ReturnType);
			iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Ldarg_0);
			iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Call, meth);
			iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Ret);
			return methodBuilder;
		}
	}
	public class CursorTypeConverter : TypeConverter
	{
		public override bool CanConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type sourceType)
		{
			if (!(sourceType == typeof(string)))
			{
				return base.CanConvertFrom(context, sourceType);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
		{
			return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
		}

		public override object ConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value)
		{
			string text = value as string;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				return Cursors.Arrow;
			}
			return text switch
			{
				"Arrow" => Cursors.Arrow, 
				"Hand" => Cursors.Hand, 
				"IBeam" => Cursors.IBeam, 
				"None" => Cursors.None, 
				"SizeNS" => Cursors.SizeNS, 
				"SizeWE" => Cursors.SizeWE, 
				"Wait" => Cursors.Wait, 
				_ => Cursors.Arrow, 
			};
		}
	}
	public class DateTimeConverter : TypeConverter
	{
		public override bool CanConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type sourceType)
		{
			if (!(sourceType == typeof(string)))
			{
				return base.CanConvertFrom(context, sourceType);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
		{
			return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
		}

		public override object ConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value)
		{
			if (value is string text)
			{
				string text2 = text.Trim();
				if (text2.Length == 0)
				{
					return DateTime.MinValue;
				}
				culture = CultureInfo.InvariantCulture;
				DateTimeFormatInfo dateTimeFormatInfo = (DateTimeFormatInfo)culture.GetFormat(typeof(DateTimeFormatInfo));
				if (dateTimeFormatInfo != null)
				{
					return DateTime.Parse(text2, dateTimeFormatInfo);
				}
				return DateTime.Parse(text2, culture);
			}
			return base.ConvertFrom(context, culture, value);
		}

		public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (value is DateTime dateTime)
			{
				if (dateTime == DateTime.MinValue)
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				culture = CultureInfo.InvariantCulture;
				if (dateTime.TimeOfDay.TotalSeconds == 0.0)
				{
					return dateTime.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd", culture);
				}
				return dateTime.ToString(culture);
			}
			return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
		}
	}
	public class ObjectConverter : TypeConverter
	{
		public override bool CanConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type sourceType)
		{
			if (!(sourceType == typeof(string)))
			{
				return base.CanConvertFrom(context, sourceType);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
		{
			return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
		}

		public override object ConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			if (value is string result)
			{
				return result;
			}
			return base.ConvertFrom(context, culture, value);
		}
	}
	public class SolidBrushCollectionConverter : TypeConverter
	{
		public override bool CanConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type sourceType)
		{
			if (!(sourceType == typeof(string)))
			{
				return base.CanConvertFrom(context, sourceType);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override object ConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value)
		{
			if (!(value is string text))
			{
				return base.ConvertFrom(context, culture, value);
			}
			string text2 = text.Trim();
			string[] array = new string[0];
			if (text2.Contains(","))
			{
				array = text2.Split(',');
			}
			else if (text2.Contains(" "))
			{
				array = text2.Split(' ');
			}
			else if (text2.Length > 0)
			{
				array = new string[1] { text2 };
			}
			BrushCollection brushCollection = new BrushCollection();
			string[] array2 = array;
			for (int i = 0; i < array2.Length; i++)
			{
				Color color = ColorConverter.FromString(array2[i].Trim());
				brushCollection.Add(new SolidColorBrush(color));
			}
			return brushCollection;
		}

		public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (destinationType == typeof(string))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
		}
	}
	public class TimeSpanConverter : TypeConverter
	{
		public override bool CanConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type sourceType)
		{
			if (!(sourceType == typeof(string)))
			{
				return base.CanConvertFrom(context, sourceType);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
		{
			return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
		}

		public override object ConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value)
		{
			if (value is string text)
			{
				string text2 = text.Trim();
				if (text2.Length == 0)
				{
					return TimeSpan.Zero;
				}
				return TimeSpan.Parse(text2);
			}
			return base.ConvertFrom(context, culture, value);
		}

		public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (value is TimeSpan timeSpan)
			{
				if (timeSpan == TimeSpan.Zero)
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				return timeSpan.ToString();
			}
			return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
		}
	}
	public class FastIterationDictionary<TKey, TValue>
	{
		private Dictionary<TKey, TValue> _internalDictionary;

		private bool _suspendCleaning;

		public List<TKey> KeyList { get; set; }

		public List<TValue> ValueList { get; set; }

		public List<bool> RemovedList { get; set; }

		public Dictionary<TKey, int> ListMap { get; set; }

		public int Count => _internalDictionary.Count;

		public IEnumerable<TKey> Keys => _internalDictionary.Keys;

		public bool SuspendCleaning
		{
			get
			{
				return _suspendCleaning;
			}
			set
			{
				_suspendCleaning = value;
				if ((double)RemovedList.Count > (double)ListMap.Count * 3.0)
				{
					Clean();
				}
			}
		}

		public IEnumerable<TValue> Values => _internalDictionary.Values;

		public TValue this[TKey key]
		{
			get
			{
				return _internalDictionary[key];
			}
			set
			{
				if (!ContainsKey(key))
				{
					Add(key, value);
					return;
				}
				_internalDictionary[key] = value;
				int index = ListMap[key];
				ValueList[index] = value;
				RemovedList[index] = false;
			}
		}

		public FastIterationDictionary()
			: this((IEqualityComparer<TKey>)null)
		{
		}

		public FastIterationDictionary(IEqualityComparer<TKey> comparer)
		{
			_internalDictionary = new Dictionary<TKey, TValue>(comparer);
			KeyList = new List<TKey>();
			ValueList = new List<TValue>();
			ListMap = new Dictionary<TKey, int>();
			RemovedList = new List<bool>();
		}

		public void Add(TKey key, TValue value)
		{
			_internalDictionary.Add(key, value);
			KeyList.Add(key);
			ValueList.Add(value);
			ListMap.Add(key, KeyList.Count - 1);
			RemovedList.Add(item: false);
		}

		public bool Validate()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < KeyList.Count; i++)
			{
				if (!RemovedList[i] && (object)this[KeyList[i]] != (object)ValueList[i])
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public bool HasDuplicateValues()
		{
			HashSet<TValue> hashSet = new HashSet<TValue>();
			for (int i = 0; i < ValueList.Count; i++)
			{
				if (!RemovedList[i])
				{
					if (hashSet.Contains(ValueList[i]))
					{
						return true;
					}
					hashSet.Add(ValueList[i]);
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool ValidateValueKeys(Func<TValue, TKey> getKey)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < ValueList.Count; i++)
			{
				if (!RemovedList[i] && !getKey(ValueList[i]).Equals(KeyList[i]))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			_internalDictionary.Clear();
			KeyList.Clear();
			ValueList.Clear();
			ListMap.Clear();
			RemovedList.Clear();
		}

		public bool ContainsKey(TKey key)
		{
			return _internalDictionary.ContainsKey(key);
		}

		public bool Remove(TKey key)
		{
			bool flag = _internalDictionary.Remove(key);
			if (flag)
			{
				int index = ListMap[key];
				RemovedList[index] = true;
				ListMap.Remove(key);
				if ((double)RemovedList.Count > (double)ListMap.Count * 3.0)
				{
					Clean();
				}
				return flag;
			}
			return flag;
		}

		private void Clean()
		{
			if (SuspendCleaning)
			{
				return;
			}
			int count = RemovedList.Count;
			int num = 0;
			List<TKey> list = new List<TKey>();
			List<TValue> list2 = new List<TValue>();
			List<bool> list3 = new List<bool>();
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (!RemovedList[i])
				{
					ListMap.Remove(KeyList[i]);
					ListMap.Add(KeyList[i], num);
					list.Add(KeyList[i]);
					list2.Add(ValueList[i]);
					list3.Add(item: false);
					num++;
				}
			}
			KeyList = list;
			ValueList = list2;
			RemovedList = list3;
		}

		public bool TryGetValue(TKey key, out TValue value)
		{
			return _internalDictionary.TryGetValue(key, out value);
		}
	}
	internal abstract class KeyFrameAnimationFactory
	{
		private static KeyFrameAnimationFactory _instance;

		private AnimationKeyFrameEffect _effect;

		public static KeyFrameAnimationFactory Instance
		{
			get
			{
				if (_instance == null)
				{
					_instance = new PlatformKeyFrameAnimationFactory(Dispatcher);
					_instance.Timeline = new KeyFrameAnimationTimeline(_instance.TickProvider, _instance.ExecutionContext);
				}
				return _instance;
			}
		}

		public static Dispatcher Dispatcher { get; set; }

		public KeyFrameAnimationTimeline Timeline { get; private set; }

		public abstract ITickProvider TickProvider { get; }

		public abstract IExecutionContext ExecutionContext { get; }

		public virtual IKeyFrameAnimation CreateAnimation(AnimationKeyFrameEffect effect)
		{
			return new KeyFrameAnimationDirect(effect, Timeline);
		}
	}
	internal class KeyFrameAnimationTimeline
	{
		private ITickProvider _tickProvider;

		private IExecutionContext _executionContext;

		private DateTime _startTime;

		private LinkedList<IKeyFrameAnimation> _activeAnimations = new LinkedList<IKeyFrameAnimation>();

		private Dictionary<string, IKeyFrameAnimation> _activeAnimationsById = new Dictionary<string, IKeyFrameAnimation>();

		private Dictionary<IKeyFrameAnimation, LinkedListNode<IKeyFrameAnimation>> _activeAnimationNodes = new Dictionary<IKeyFrameAnimation, LinkedListNode<IKeyFrameAnimation>>();

		private int _animationCount;

		private bool _useFrameTime;

		private double _frameTime;

		private int _tickId = -1;

		internal IExecutionContext ExecutionContext => _executionContext;

		public double CurrentTime
		{
			get
			{
				if (_useFrameTime)
				{
					return _frameTime;
				}
				return (DateTime.Now - _startTime).TotalMilliseconds;
			}
		}

		public KeyFrameAnimationTimeline(ITickProvider tickProvider, IExecutionContext executionContext)
		{
			_tickProvider = tickProvider;
			_executionContext = executionContext;
			_startTime = DateTime.Now;
		}

		internal void Start(IKeyFrameAnimation animation)
		{
			if (!_activeAnimationsById.ContainsKey(animation.Id))
			{
				_activeAnimations.AddLast(animation);
				LinkedListNode<IKeyFrameAnimation> last = _activeAnimations.Last;
				_activeAnimationNodes.Add(animation, last);
				_activeAnimationsById.Add(animation.Id, animation);
				bool flag = false;
				if (_animationCount == 0)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				_animationCount++;
				if (flag)
				{
					StartTicking();
				}
			}
		}

		internal void Stop(IKeyFrameAnimation animation)
		{
			if (_activeAnimationNodes.ContainsKey(animation))
			{
				LinkedListNode<IKeyFrameAnimation> node = _activeAnimationNodes[animation];
				_activeAnimations.Remove(node);
				_activeAnimationsById.Remove(animation.Id);
				_activeAnimationNodes.Remove(animation);
				bool flag = false;
				_animationCount--;
				if (_animationCount == 0)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					StopTicking();
				}
			}
		}

		private void StopTicking()
		{
			if (_tickId >= 0)
			{
				_tickProvider.TeardownTicking(_tickId);
				_tickId = -1;
			}
		}

		private void StartTicking()
		{
			_tickId = _tickProvider.SetupTicking(Tick);
			_tickProvider.RequestFrame(_tickId);
		}

		private void Tick()
		{
			double currentTime = CurrentTime;
			_frameTime = currentTime;
			try
			{
				_useFrameTime = true;
				LinkedListNode<IKeyFrameAnimation> linkedListNode = _activeAnimations.First;
				if (linkedListNode == null)
				{
					StopTicking();
					_useFrameTime = false;
					return;
				}
				while (linkedListNode != null)
				{
					IKeyFrameAnimation value = linkedListNode.Value;
					if (value.PlayState == KeyFrameAnimationPlayState.Running)
					{
						((KeyFrameAnimationDirect)value).Tick();
					}
					else
					{
						((KeyFrameAnimationDirect)value).Tick();
						Stop(linkedListNode.Value);
					}
					linkedListNode = linkedListNode.Next;
				}
				_tickProvider.RequestFrame(_tickId);
			}
			finally
			{
				_useFrameTime = false;
			}
		}
	}
	internal interface IKeyFrameAnimation
	{
		double CurrentTime { get; set; }

		AnimationKeyFrameEffect Effect { get; set; }

		Task Finished { get; }

		Task Ready { get; }

		string Id { get; set; }

		KeyFrameAnimationPlayState PlayState { get; }

		double PlaybackRate { get; set; }

		double StartTime { get; set; }

		event Action OnFinished;

		event Action OnCanceled;

		void CommitStyles();

		void Cancel();

		void Finish();

		void Pause();

		void Play();

		void Reverse();

		void UpdatePlaybackRate(double newRate);
	}
	internal enum KeyFrameAnimationPlayState
	{
		Idle,
		Running,
		Paused,
		Finished
	}
	internal class AnimationKeyFrameEffectTiming
	{
		public double Delay { get; set; }

		public KeyFrameEffectTimingDirection Direction { get; set; }

		public double Duration { get; set; }

		public KeyFrameEffectEasing Easing { get; set; }

		public double EndDelay { get; set; }

		public KeyFrameAnimationFill Fill { get; set; }

		public double IterationStart { get; set; }

		public double Iterations { get; set; }

		public event Action OnFinished;

		public event Action OnCanceled;

		public AnimationKeyFrameEffectTiming()
		{
			Delay = 0.0;
			Direction = KeyFrameEffectTimingDirection.Normal;
			Easing = KeyFrameEffectEasing.Linear;
			EndDelay = 0.0;
			Fill = KeyFrameAnimationFill.Auto;
			IterationStart = 0.0;
			Iterations = 1.0;
		}
	}
	internal enum KeyFrameAnimationFill
	{
		Auto,
		None,
		Forwards,
		Backwards,
		Both
	}
	internal enum KeyFrameEffectEasing
	{
		CubicInOut,
		ExponentialInOut,
		CircleInOut,
		Linear
	}
	internal enum KeyFrameEffectTimingDirection
	{
		Normal,
		Reverse,
		Alternate,
		AlternateReverse
	}
	internal class KeyFrameAnimationDirect : IKeyFrameAnimation
	{
		private AnimationKeyFrameEffect _effect;

		private double _holdTime = double.NaN;

		private bool _hasHoldTime;

		private double _previousCurrentTime = double.NaN;

		private bool _hasPreviousCurrentTime;

		private string _id;

		private double _pendingPlaybackRate = double.NaN;

		private bool _hasPendingPlaybackRate;

		private double _playbackRate = 1.0;

		private double _startTime = double.NaN;

		private bool _hasStartTime;

		private KeyFrameAnimationTimeline _timeline;

		private static long _nextId;

		private bool _hasPendingPlayTask;

		private bool _hasPendingPauseTask;

		private bool _hasPendingFinishedNotification;

		private TaskCompletionSource<IKeyFrameAnimation> _currentReadyPromise;

		private TaskCompletionSource<IKeyFrameAnimation> _currentFinishedPromise;

		public AnimationKeyFrameEffect Effect
		{
			get
			{
				return _effect;
			}
			set
			{
				_effect = value;
			}
		}

		public bool HasCurrentTime
		{
			get
			{
				if (_hasHoldTime)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (_hasStartTime)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public double CurrentTime
		{
			get
			{
				if (_hasHoldTime)
				{
					return _holdTime;
				}
				return (Timeline.CurrentTime - StartTime) * PlaybackRate;
			}
			set
			{
				UpdateCurrentTime(value);
				UpdateFinishedState(didSeek: true, syncNotify: false);
			}
		}

		public Task Finished => _currentFinishedPromise.Task;

		public Task Ready => _currentReadyPromise.Task;

		public string Id
		{
			get
			{
				return _id;
			}
			set
			{
				_id = value;
			}
		}

		private double AssociatedEffectEnd
		{
			get
			{
				if (Effect == null)
				{
					return 0.0;
				}
				return Effect.EndTime;
			}
		}

		public KeyFrameAnimationPlayState PlayState
		{
			get
			{
				if (!HasCurrentTime && !_hasPendingPauseTask && !_hasPendingPlayTask)
				{
					return KeyFrameAnimationPlayState.Idle;
				}
				if (_hasPendingPauseTask || (!_hasStartTime && !_hasPendingPlayTask))
				{
					return KeyFrameAnimationPlayState.Paused;
				}
				if (HasCurrentTime && ((EffectivePlaybackRate > 0.0 && CurrentTime >= AssociatedEffectEnd) || (EffectivePlaybackRate < 0.0 && CurrentTime <= 0.0)))
				{
					return KeyFrameAnimationPlayState.Finished;
				}
				return KeyFrameAnimationPlayState.Running;
			}
		}

		public double EffectivePlaybackRate
		{
			get
			{
				if (_hasPendingPlaybackRate)
				{
					return _pendingPlaybackRate;
				}
				return _playbackRate;
			}
		}

		public double PlaybackRate
		{
			get
			{
				return _playbackRate;
			}
			set
			{
				_playbackRate = value;
			}
		}

		public double StartTime
		{
			get
			{
				return _startTime;
			}
			set
			{
				_ = Timeline.CurrentTime;
				_ = _previousCurrentTime;
				_startTime = value;
				_hasStartTime = true;
				if (PlaybackRate != 0.0)
				{
					_hasHoldTime = false;
				}
				UpdateFinishedState(didSeek: true, syncNotify: false);
			}
		}

		public KeyFrameAnimationTimeline Timeline => _timeline;

		public event Action OnFinished;

		public event Action OnCanceled;

		private void UpdateFinishedState(bool didSeek, bool syncNotify)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			double currentTime;
			if (!didSeek)
			{
				bool hasHoldTime = _hasHoldTime;
				_hasHoldTime = false;
				currentTime = CurrentTime;
				flag = HasCurrentTime;
				_hasHoldTime = hasHoldTime;
			}
			else
			{
				currentTime = CurrentTime;
				flag = HasCurrentTime;
			}
			if (flag && _hasStartTime && !_hasPendingPauseTask && !_hasPendingPlayTask)
			{
				if (PlaybackRate > 0.0 && currentTime >= AssociatedEffectEnd)
				{
					if (didSeek)
					{
						_holdTime = currentTime;
						_hasHoldTime = true;
					}
					else if (_hasPreviousCurrentTime)
					{
						_holdTime = Math.Max(_previousCurrentTime, AssociatedEffectEnd);
					}
					else
					{
						_holdTime = AssociatedEffectEnd;
					}
				}
				else if (PlaybackRate < 0.0 && currentTime <= 0.0)
				{
					if (didSeek)
					{
						_holdTime = currentTime;
					}
					else if (_hasPreviousCurrentTime)
					{
						_holdTime = Math.Min(_previousCurrentTime, 0.0);
					}
					else
					{
						_holdTime = 0.0;
					}
				}
				if (PlaybackRate != 0.0 && didSeek && _hasHoldTime)
				{
					_startTime = Timeline.CurrentTime - _holdTime / PlaybackRate;
					_hasStartTime = true;
					_hasHoldTime = false;
				}
			}
			_previousCurrentTime = CurrentTime;
			_hasPreviousCurrentTime = true;
			bool flag2 = PlayState == KeyFrameAnimationPlayState.Finished;
			if (!syncNotify && flag2 && !CurrentFinishIsResolved())
			{
				ScheduleFinishNotificationTask(delegate
				{
					FinishingTasks();
				});
			}
			if (flag2 && !CurrentFinishIsResolved() && syncNotify)
			{
				CancelFinishNotificationTask();
				FinishingTasks();
			}
			if (!flag2 && CurrentFinishIsResolved())
			{
				_currentFinishedPromise = CreateFinishPromise();
			}
		}

		private TaskCompletionSource<IKeyFrameAnimation> CreateFinishPromise()
		{
			return new TaskCompletionSource<IKeyFrameAnimation>();
		}

		private void CancelFinishNotificationTask()
		{
			_hasPendingFinishedNotification = false;
		}

		private void FinishingTasks()
		{
			if (_hasPendingFinishedNotification)
			{
				_hasPendingFinishedNotification = false;
				if (PlayState == KeyFrameAnimationPlayState.Finished)
				{
					ResolveFinishedPromise(this);
					RaiseOnFinished();
				}
			}
		}

		private void RaiseOnFinished()
		{
		}

		private void ResolveFinishedPromise(KeyFrameAnimationDirect animation)
		{
			_currentFinishedPromise.SetResult(animation);
		}

		private void ScheduleFinishNotificationTask(Action p)
		{
			if (!_hasPendingFinishedNotification)
			{
				_hasPendingFinishedNotification = true;
				Timeline.ExecutionContext.EnqueueAction(delegate
				{
					p();
				});
			}
		}

		private bool CurrentFinishIsResolved()
		{
			if (_currentFinishedPromise != null)
			{
				return _currentFinishedPromise.Task.IsCompleted;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void UpdateCurrentTime(double value)
		{
			if (_hasHoldTime || !_hasStartTime || PlaybackRate == 0.0)
			{
				_holdTime = value;
				_hasHoldTime = true;
			}
			else
			{
				_startTime = Timeline.CurrentTime - value / PlaybackRate;
			}
		}

		public KeyFrameAnimationDirect(AnimationKeyFrameEffect effect, KeyFrameAnimationTimeline timeline)
		{
			_id = "AUTO_ID_" + _nextId;
			_nextId++;
			Effect = effect;
			Effect.AssociatedAnimation = this;
			_timeline = timeline;
		}

		public void Cancel()
		{
			if (PlayState != KeyFrameAnimationPlayState.Idle)
			{
				ResetPendingTasks();
				RejectFinishedPromise("AbortError");
				_currentFinishedPromise = CreateFinishPromise();
				RaiseCancelEvent();
				_hasHoldTime = false;
				_hasStartTime = false;
			}
		}

		private void RejectFinishedPromise(string error)
		{
			if (_currentFinishedPromise != null)
			{
				_currentFinishedPromise.SetException(new Exception(error));
			}
		}

		private void RejectReadyPromise(string error)
		{
			if (_currentReadyPromise != null)
			{
				_currentReadyPromise.SetException(new Exception(error));
			}
		}

		private void RaiseCancelEvent()
		{
		}

		private void ResetPendingTasks()
		{
			if (_hasPendingPlayTask)
			{
				_hasPendingPlayTask = false;
			}
			if (_hasPendingPauseTask)
			{
				_hasPendingPauseTask = false;
			}
			ApplyPendingPlaybackRate();
			RejectReadyPromise("AbortError");
		}

		public void Finish()
		{
			if (EffectivePlaybackRate != 0.0 && (!(EffectivePlaybackRate > 0.0) || !double.IsInfinity(AssociatedEffectEnd)))
			{
				ApplyPendingPlaybackRate();
				double num = ((!(PlaybackRate > 0.0)) ? 0.0 : AssociatedEffectEnd);
				UpdateCurrentTime(num);
				if (!_hasStartTime)
				{
					_startTime = Timeline.CurrentTime - num / PlaybackRate;
					_hasStartTime = true;
				}
				if (_hasPendingPauseTask && _hasStartTime)
				{
					_hasHoldTime = false;
					CancelPauseTask();
					ResolveReadyPromise(this);
				}
				if (_hasPendingPlayTask && _hasStartTime)
				{
					CancelPlayTask();
					ResolveReadyPromise(this);
				}
				UpdateFinishedState(didSeek: true, syncNotify: true);
			}
		}

		public void Pause()
		{
			PauseHelper();
		}

		private void PauseHelper()
		{
			if (_hasPendingPauseTask || PlayState == KeyFrameAnimationPlayState.Paused)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!HasCurrentTime)
			{
				if (PlaybackRate >= 0.0)
				{
					_hasHoldTime = true;
					_holdTime = 0.0;
				}
				if (double.IsInfinity(AssociatedEffectEnd))
				{
					return;
				}
				_holdTime = AssociatedEffectEnd;
				_hasHoldTime = true;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			if (_hasPendingPlayTask)
			{
				flag = true;
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				_currentReadyPromise = GetReadyPromise();
			}
			SchedulePauseTask(delegate
			{
				if (_hasPendingPauseTask)
				{
					_hasPendingPauseTask = false;
					double currentTime = Timeline.CurrentTime;
					if (_hasStartTime && !_hasHoldTime)
					{
						_holdTime = (currentTime - _startTime) * PlaybackRate;
					}
					ApplyPendingPlaybackRate();
					_hasStartTime = false;
					ResolveReadyPromise(this);
					UpdateFinishedState(didSeek: false, syncNotify: false);
				}
			});
			UpdateFinishedState(didSeek: false, syncNotify: false);
		}

		private TaskCompletionSource<IKeyFrameAnimation> GetReadyPromise()
		{
			return new TaskCompletionSource<IKeyFrameAnimation>();
		}

		private void SchedulePauseTask(Action p)
		{
			if (!_hasPendingPauseTask)
			{
				_hasPendingPauseTask = true;
				Timeline.ExecutionContext.EnqueueAction(delegate
				{
					p();
				});
			}
		}

		public void Play()
		{
			PlayHelper(autoRewind: true);
		}

		private void PlayHelper(bool autoRewind)
		{
			bool hasPendingPauseTask = _hasPendingPauseTask;
			if (EffectivePlaybackRate > 0.0 && autoRewind && (!HasCurrentTime || CurrentTime < 0.0 || CurrentTime >= AssociatedEffectEnd))
			{
				_holdTime = 0.0;
				_hasHoldTime = true;
			}
			else if (EffectivePlaybackRate < 0.0 && autoRewind && (!HasCurrentTime || CurrentTime <= 0.0 || CurrentTime > AssociatedEffectEnd))
			{
				if (double.IsInfinity(AssociatedEffectEnd))
				{
					return;
				}
				_holdTime = AssociatedEffectEnd;
				_hasHoldTime = true;
			}
			else if (EffectivePlaybackRate == 0.0 && !HasCurrentTime)
			{
				_holdTime = 0.0;
				_hasHoldTime = true;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			if (_hasPendingPauseTask)
			{
				CancelPauseTask();
				flag = true;
			}
			if (_hasPendingPlayTask)
			{
				CancelPlayTask();
				flag = true;
			}
			if (!_hasHoldTime && !hasPendingPauseTask && !_hasPendingPlaybackRate)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (_hasHoldTime)
			{
				_hasStartTime = false;
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				_currentReadyPromise = GetReadyPromise();
			}
			SchedulePlayTask(delegate
			{
				if (_hasPendingPlayTask)
				{
					_hasPendingPlayTask = false;
					if (_hasStartTime || _hasHoldTime)
					{
						double currentTime = Timeline.CurrentTime;
						if (_hasHoldTime)
						{
							ApplyPendingPlaybackRate();
							double startTime = currentTime;
							if (PlaybackRate != 0.0)
							{
								startTime = currentTime - _holdTime / PlaybackRate;
							}
							_startTime = startTime;
							_hasStartTime = true;
							if (PlaybackRate != 0.0)
							{
								_hasHoldTime = false;
							}
						}
						else if (_hasStartTime && _hasPendingPlaybackRate)
						{
							double num = (currentTime - _startTime) * PlaybackRate;
							ApplyPendingPlaybackRate();
							if (PlaybackRate == 0.0)
							{
								_holdTime = num;
								_hasHoldTime = true;
							}
							double startTime2 = currentTime;
							if (PlaybackRate != 0.0)
							{
								startTime2 = currentTime - num / PlaybackRate;
							}
							_startTime = startTime2;
							_hasStartTime = true;
						}
						ResolveReadyPromise(this);
						UpdateFinishedState(didSeek: false, syncNotify: false);
						Timeline.Start(this);
					}
				}
			});
			UpdateFinishedState(didSeek: false, syncNotify: false);
		}

		private void ResolveReadyPromise(KeyFrameAnimationDirect animation)
		{
			if (_currentReadyPromise != null)
			{
				_currentReadyPromise.SetResult(animation);
			}
		}

		private void CancelPauseTask()
		{
			_hasPendingPauseTask = false;
		}

		private void CancelPlayTask()
		{
			_hasPendingPlayTask = false;
		}

		private void SchedulePlayTask(Action p)
		{
			if (!_hasPendingPlayTask)
			{
				_hasPendingPlayTask = true;
				Timeline.ExecutionContext.EnqueueAction(delegate
				{
					p();
				});
			}
		}

		public void Reverse()
		{
			_ = _pendingPlaybackRate;
			_pendingPlaybackRate = 0.0 - EffectivePlaybackRate;
			_hasPendingPlaybackRate = true;
			PlayHelper(autoRewind: true);
		}

		public void UpdatePlaybackRate(double newRate)
		{
			KeyFrameAnimationPlayState playState = PlayState;
			_pendingPlaybackRate = newRate;
			_hasPendingPlaybackRate = true;
			switch (playState)
			{
			case KeyFrameAnimationPlayState.Idle:
			case KeyFrameAnimationPlayState.Paused:
				ApplyPendingPlaybackRate();
				break;
			case KeyFrameAnimationPlayState.Finished:
			{
				bool hasHoldTime = _hasHoldTime;
				_hasHoldTime = false;
				double currentTime = CurrentTime;
				_hasHoldTime = hasHoldTime;
				if (_pendingPlaybackRate == 0.0)
				{
					_startTime = Timeline.CurrentTime;
				}
				else
				{
					_startTime = Timeline.CurrentTime - currentTime / _pendingPlaybackRate;
				}
				ApplyPendingPlaybackRate();
				break;
			}
			default:
				PlayHelper(autoRewind: false);
				break;
			}
		}

		private void ApplyPendingPlaybackRate()
		{
			if (_hasPendingPlaybackRate)
			{
				_playbackRate = _pendingPlaybackRate;
				_hasPendingPlaybackRate = false;
			}
		}

		public void CommitStyles()
		{
			Effect.CommitStyles();
		}

		internal void Tick()
		{
			Effect.Tick();
			UpdateFinishedState(didSeek: false, syncNotify: false);
		}
	}
	internal enum AnimationKeyFrameEffectTargetType
	{
		NativeView,
		FrameworkElement
	}
	internal interface IDependentRenderer
	{
		bool IsDirty { get; }

		void MarkDirty();
	}
	internal class AnimationKeyFrameEffect
	{
		private List<AnimationKeyFrame> _frames = new List<AnimationKeyFrame>();

		private AnimationKeyFrame[] _framesCache;

		private double _startDelay;

		private double _endDelay;

		private Func<double, double> _easingFunction;

		private KeyFrameAnimationFill _fillMode;

		private double _iterationCount;

		private double _iterationDuration;

		private KeyFrameEffectTimingDirection _playbackDirection;

		private double _iterationStart;

		private KeyFrameEffectEasing _easing;

		private double[] _resolvedOffsets;

		private UIElementPropertyId[] _effectPropertiesCache;

		private UIElementPropertyAccessor[] _effectPropertyAccessors;

		[Weak]
		internal KeyFrameAnimationDirect AssociatedAnimation { get; set; }

		private double ActiveDuration => _iterationDuration * _iterationCount;

		internal double EndTime => Math.Max(_startDelay + ActiveDuration + _endDelay, 0.0);

		protected double[] ResolvedOffsets
		{
			get
			{
				if (_resolvedOffsets == null)
				{
					_resolvedOffsets = ComputeResolvedOffsets();
				}
				return _resolvedOffsets;
			}
		}

		private double LocalTime
		{
			get
			{
				if (AssociatedAnimation != null)
				{
					return AssociatedAnimation.CurrentTime;
				}
				return double.NaN;
			}
		}

		private bool HasLocalTime
		{
			get
			{
				if (AssociatedAnimation != null)
				{
					return AssociatedAnimation.HasCurrentTime;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private double BeforeActiveBoundaryTime => Math.Max(Math.Min(_startDelay, EndTime), 0.0);

		private double ActiveAfterBoundaryTime => Math.Max(Math.Min(_startDelay + ActiveDuration, EndTime), 0.0);

		private bool AnimationIsForwards
		{
			get
			{
				if (AssociatedAnimation != null && AssociatedAnimation.PlaybackRate < 0.0)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		private KeyFrameAnimationEffectPhase CurrentPhase
		{
			get
			{
				if (HasLocalTime && (LocalTime < BeforeActiveBoundaryTime || (!AnimationIsForwards && LocalTime == BeforeActiveBoundaryTime)))
				{
					return KeyFrameAnimationEffectPhase.Before;
				}
				if (HasLocalTime && (LocalTime > ActiveAfterBoundaryTime || (AnimationIsForwards && LocalTime == ActiveAfterBoundaryTime)))
				{
					return KeyFrameAnimationEffectPhase.After;
				}
				if (HasLocalTime)
				{
					return KeyFrameAnimationEffectPhase.Active;
				}
				return KeyFrameAnimationEffectPhase.Idle;
			}
		}

		private double ActiveTime
		{
			get
			{
				switch (CurrentPhase)
				{
				case KeyFrameAnimationEffectPhase.Before:
					if (_fillMode == KeyFrameAnimationFill.Backwards || _fillMode == KeyFrameAnimationFill.Both)
					{
						return Math.Max(LocalTime - _startDelay, 0.0);
					}
					return double.NaN;
				case KeyFrameAnimationEffectPhase.Active:
					return LocalTime - _startDelay;
				case KeyFrameAnimationEffectPhase.After:
					if (_fillMode == KeyFrameAnimationFill.Forwards || _fillMode == KeyFrameAnimationFill.Both)
					{
						return Math.Max(Math.Min(LocalTime - _startDelay, ActiveDuration), 0.0);
					}
					return double.NaN;
				default:
					return double.NaN;
				}
			}
		}

		private bool HasActiveTime
		{
			get
			{
				if (!HasLocalTime)
				{
					return false;
				}
				switch (CurrentPhase)
				{
				case KeyFrameAnimationEffectPhase.Before:
					if (_fillMode == KeyFrameAnimationFill.Backwards || _fillMode == KeyFrameAnimationFill.Both)
					{
						return true;
					}
					return false;
				case KeyFrameAnimationEffectPhase.Active:
					return true;
				case KeyFrameAnimationEffectPhase.After:
					if (_fillMode == KeyFrameAnimationFill.Forwards || _fillMode == KeyFrameAnimationFill.Both)
					{
						return true;
					}
					return false;
				default:
					return false;
				}
			}
		}

		private bool HasOverallProgress
		{
			get
			{
				if (!HasActiveTime)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		private double OverallProgress
		{
			get
			{
				if (!HasActiveTime)
				{
					return double.NaN;
				}
				double num = 0.0;
				num = ((_iterationDuration != 0.0) ? (ActiveTime / _iterationDuration) : ((CurrentPhase != KeyFrameAnimationEffectPhase.Before) ? _iterationCount : 0.0));
				return num + _iterationStart;
			}
		}

		private bool HasSimpleIterationProgress
		{
			get
			{
				if (!HasOverallProgress)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		private double SimpleIterationProgress
		{
			get
			{
				if (!HasOverallProgress)
				{
					return double.NaN;
				}
				double num = 1.0;
				num = ((!double.IsInfinity(OverallProgress)) ? (OverallProgress % 1.0) : (_iterationStart % 1.0));
				if (num == 0.0 && (CurrentPhase == KeyFrameAnimationEffectPhase.Active || CurrentPhase == KeyFrameAnimationEffectPhase.After) && ActiveTime == ActiveDuration && _iterationCount != 0.0)
				{
					num = 1.0;
				}
				return num;
			}
		}

		private bool HasCurrentIteration
		{
			get
			{
				if (!HasActiveTime)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		private double CurrentIteration
		{
			get
			{
				if (!HasActiveTime)
				{
					return double.NaN;
				}
				if (CurrentPhase == KeyFrameAnimationEffectPhase.After && double.IsInfinity(_iterationCount))
				{
					return double.PositiveInfinity;
				}
				if (SimpleIterationProgress == 1.0)
				{
					return Math.Floor(OverallProgress) - 1.0;
				}
				return Math.Floor(OverallProgress);
			}
		}

		private bool HasDirectedProgress => HasSimpleIterationProgress;

		private double DirectedProgress
		{
			get
			{
				if (!HasSimpleIterationProgress)
				{
					return double.NaN;
				}
				if (GetCurrentDirection())
				{
					return SimpleIterationProgress;
				}
				return 1.0 - SimpleIterationProgress;
			}
		}

		private bool HasTransformedProgress => HasDirectedProgress;

		private double TransformedProgress
		{
			get
			{
				if (!HasDirectedProgress)
				{
					return double.NaN;
				}
				bool beforeFlag = false;
				bool currentDirection = GetCurrentDirection();
				if (currentDirection && CurrentPhase == KeyFrameAnimationEffectPhase.Before)
				{
					beforeFlag = true;
				}
				if (!currentDirection && CurrentPhase == KeyFrameAnimationEffectPhase.After)
				{
					beforeFlag = true;
				}
				return TimingFunction(DirectedProgress, beforeFlag);
			}
		}

		private double IterationProgress => TransformedProgress;

		private bool HasIterationProgress => HasTransformedProgress;

		public object Target { get; private set; }

		public AnimationKeyFrameEffectTargetType TargetType { get; private set; }

		public IDependentRenderer DependentRenderer { get; private set; }

		public AnimationKeyFrame[] Frames
		{
			get
			{
				if (_framesCache == null)
				{
					_framesCache = _frames.ToArray();
					_effectPropertiesCache = GetEffectProperties();
					_effectPropertyAccessors = GetEffectPropertyAccessors();
				}
				return _framesCache;
			}
		}

		public UIElementPropertyId[] EffectProperties
		{
			get
			{
				if (_framesCache == null)
				{
					_framesCache = _frames.ToArray();
					_effectPropertiesCache = GetEffectProperties();
					_effectPropertyAccessors = GetEffectPropertyAccessors();
				}
				return _effectPropertiesCache;
			}
		}

		internal UIElementPropertyAccessor[] EffectPropertyAccessors
		{
			get
			{
				if (_framesCache == null)
				{
					_framesCache = _frames.ToArray();
					_effectPropertiesCache = GetEffectProperties();
					_effectPropertyAccessors = GetEffectPropertyAccessors();
				}
				return _effectPropertyAccessors;
			}
		}

		public AnimationKeyFrameEffectTiming Timing { get; private set; }

		private void UpdateTimingCalculations()
		{
			_startDelay = Timing.Delay;
			_endDelay = Timing.EndDelay;
			_fillMode = Timing.Fill;
			_iterationCount = Timing.Iterations;
			_iterationDuration = Timing.Duration;
			_playbackDirection = Timing.Direction;
			_iterationStart = Timing.IterationStart;
			_easing = Timing.Easing;
			_easingFunction = ResolveEasingFunction(_easing);
		}

		private Func<double, double> ResolveEasingFunction(KeyFrameEffectEasing easing)
		{
			return easing switch
			{
				KeyFrameEffectEasing.Linear => (double p) => p, 
				KeyFrameEffectEasing.ExponentialInOut => new ExponentialEase().Ease, 
				KeyFrameEffectEasing.CircleInOut => new CircleEase().Ease, 
				KeyFrameEffectEasing.CubicInOut => new CubicEase().Ease, 
				_ => (double p) => p, 
			};
		}

		public AnimationKeyFrameEffect(object target, AnimationKeyFrameEffectTargetType targetType, IDependentRenderer dependentRenderer, AnimationKeyFrameEffectTiming timing)
		{
			Target = target;
			TargetType = targetType;
			Timing = timing;
			UpdateTimingCalculations();
			DependentRenderer = dependentRenderer;
		}

		public AnimationKeyFrameEffect(object target, AnimationKeyFrameEffectTargetType targetType, IDependentRenderer dependentRenderer, AnimationKeyFrameEffectTiming timing, AnimationKeyFrame[] frames)
		{
			Target = target;
			TargetType = targetType;
			DependentRenderer = dependentRenderer;
			Timing = timing;
			UpdateTimingCalculations();
			_frames.AddRange(frames);
		}

		private double[] ComputeResolvedOffsets()
		{
			AnimationKeyFrame[] frames = Frames;
			if (frames.Length <= 1)
			{
				return new double[1];
			}
			double[] array = new double[frames.Length];
			double num = 1.0 / (double)(frames.Length - 1);
			double num2 = 0.0;
			for (int i = 0; i < frames.Length; i++)
			{
				if (double.IsNaN(frames[i].Offset))
				{
					array[i] = num2;
				}
				else
				{
					array[i] = frames[i].Offset;
					num2 = frames[i].Offset;
					if (frames.Length - 1 - i > 0)
					{
						num = (1.0 - num2) / (double)(frames.Length - 1 - i);
					}
				}
				num2 += num;
			}
			return array;
		}

		public AnimationKeyFrameEffect Add(AnimationKeyFrame frame)
		{
			_frames.Add(frame);
			_framesCache = null;
			_effectPropertiesCache = null;
			return this;
		}

		public AnimationKeyFrameEffect AddFrame(params AnimationKeyFrameProperty[] props)
		{
			AnimationKeyFrame animationKeyFrame = new AnimationKeyFrame();
			if (props != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < props.Length; i++)
				{
					animationKeyFrame.Add(props[i]);
				}
			}
			Add(animationKeyFrame);
			return this;
		}

		public AnimationKeyFrameEffect AddFrameWithOffset(double offset, params AnimationKeyFrameProperty[] props)
		{
			AnimationKeyFrame animationKeyFrame = new AnimationKeyFrame(offset);
			if (props != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < props.Length; i++)
				{
					animationKeyFrame.Add(props[i]);
				}
			}
			Add(animationKeyFrame);
			return this;
		}

		private bool GetCurrentDirection()
		{
			bool flag = true;
			if (_playbackDirection == KeyFrameEffectTimingDirection.Normal)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (_playbackDirection == KeyFrameEffectTimingDirection.Reverse)
			{
				return false;
			}
			double num = CurrentIteration;
			if (_playbackDirection == KeyFrameEffectTimingDirection.AlternateReverse)
			{
				num += 1.0;
			}
			if (double.IsInfinity(num))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (num % 2.0 == 0.0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private double TimingFunction(double directedProgress, bool beforeFlag)
		{
			return _easingFunction(directedProgress);
		}

		internal void Tick()
		{
			if (HasTransformedProgress)
			{
				_ = TransformedProgress;
				for (int i = 0; i < EffectProperties.Length; i++)
				{
					object effectValue = GetEffectValue(EffectProperties[i], EffectPropertyAccessors[i]);
					ApplyEffectValue(EffectProperties[i], EffectPropertyAccessors[i], effectValue);
				}
			}
		}

		private void ApplyEffectValue(UIElementPropertyId animationKeyFramePropertyId, UIElementPropertyAccessor accessor, object value)
		{
			accessor.SetValue(Target, value);
		}

		private object GetEffectValue(UIElementPropertyId animationKeyFramePropertyId, UIElementPropertyAccessor accessor)
		{
			if (!HasIterationProgress)
			{
				return null;
			}
			double iterationProgress = IterationProgress;
			if (Target == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			object underlyingValue = GetUnderlyingValue(animationKeyFramePropertyId, accessor);
			List<AnimationKeyFrame> list = new List<AnimationKeyFrame>();
			List<double> list2 = new List<double>();
			for (int i = 0; i < Frames.Length; i++)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < Frames[i].Properties.Length; j++)
				{
					if (Frames[i].Properties[j].PropertyId == animationKeyFramePropertyId)
					{
						list.Add(Frames[i]);
						list2.Add(ResolvedOffsets[i]);
					}
				}
			}
			if (list.Count == 0)
			{
				return underlyingValue;
			}
			if (list2[0] != 0.0)
			{
				list.Insert(0, new AnimationKeyFrame(0.0).Add(new AnimationKeyFrameProperty(animationKeyFramePropertyId, underlyingValue)));
				list2.Insert(0, 0.0);
			}
			if (list2[list.Count - 1] != 1.0)
			{
				list.Add(new AnimationKeyFrame(1.0).Add(new AnimationKeyFrameProperty(animationKeyFramePropertyId, underlyingValue)));
				list2.Add(1.0);
			}
			bool flag = false;
			List<AnimationKeyFrame> list3 = new List<AnimationKeyFrame>();
			List<double> list4 = new List<double>();
			if (iterationProgress < 0.0)
			{
				int num = 0;
				for (int k = 0; k < list.Count && list2[k] == 0.0; k++)
				{
					num++;
				}
				if (num > 1)
				{
					flag = true;
					list3.Add(list[0]);
					list4.Add(list2[0]);
				}
			}
			if (iterationProgress >= 1.0)
			{
				int num2 = 0;
				int num3 = list.Count - 1;
				while (num3 >= 0 && list2[num3] == 1.0)
				{
					num2++;
					num3--;
				}
				if (num2 > 1)
				{
					flag = true;
					list3.Add(list[list.Count - 1]);
					list4.Add(list2[list.Count - 1]);
				}
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				AnimationKeyFrame item = null;
				int num4 = -1;
				for (int l = 0; l < list.Count && list2[l] <= iterationProgress; l++)
				{
					item = list[l];
					num4 = l;
				}
				if (num4 == -1)
				{
					for (int m = 0; m < list.Count && list2[m] == 0.0; m++)
					{
						item = list[m];
						num4 = m;
					}
				}
				list3.Add(item);
				list4.Add(list2[num4]);
				if (num4 < list2.Count - 1)
				{
					list3.Add(list[num4 + 1]);
					list4.Add(list2[num4 + 1]);
				}
			}
			if (list3.Count == 1)
			{
				for (int n = 0; n < list3[0].Properties.Length; n++)
				{
					if (list3[0].Properties[n].PropertyId == animationKeyFramePropertyId)
					{
						return list3[0].Properties[n].Value;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
			double num5 = list4[0];
			double num6 = list4[list3.Count - 1];
			object value = list3[0].GetProperty(animationKeyFramePropertyId).Value;
			object value2 = list3[1].GetProperty(animationKeyFramePropertyId).Value;
			double p = (iterationProgress - num5) / (num6 - num5);
			return InterpolateValue(animationKeyFramePropertyId, p, value, value2);
		}

		private object InterpolateValue(UIElementPropertyId targetProperty, double p, object startValue, object endValue)
		{
			switch (targetProperty)
			{
			case UIElementPropertyId.BackgroundColor:
			case UIElementPropertyId.BorderColor:
			case UIElementPropertyId.Color:
			case UIElementPropertyId.Stroke:
			case UIElementPropertyId.Fill:
				return ((Brush)startValue).GetInterpolation(p, (Brush)endValue, InterpolationMode.RGB);
			case UIElementPropertyId.BorderWidth:
			case UIElementPropertyId.Padding:
			case UIElementPropertyId.Margin:
				return InterpolationUtil.InterpolateThickness(p, (Thickness)startValue, (Thickness)endValue);
			case UIElementPropertyId.FontSize:
			case UIElementPropertyId.Width:
			case UIElementPropertyId.Height:
			case UIElementPropertyId.Left:
			case UIElementPropertyId.Top:
			case UIElementPropertyId.StrokeWidth:
			case UIElementPropertyId.StrokeDashOffset:
				return (double)startValue + p * ((double)endValue - (double)startValue);
			case UIElementPropertyId.Opacity:
				return (double)startValue + p * ((double)endValue - (double)startValue);
			case UIElementPropertyId.BorderRadius:
				return InterpolationUtil.InterpolateCornerRadius(p, (CornerRadius)startValue, (CornerRadius)endValue);
			case UIElementPropertyId.Transform:
				return InterpolateMatrixTransforms(p, (MatrixTransform)startValue, (MatrixTransform)endValue);
			case UIElementPropertyId.StrokeDashArray:
				return InterpolationUtil.InterpolateDashArrays(p, (double[])startValue, (double[])endValue);
			default:
				if (p < 0.5)
				{
					return startValue;
				}
				return endValue;
			}
		}

		private MatrixTransform InterpolateMatrixTransforms(double p, MatrixTransform startValue, MatrixTransform endValue)
		{
			Matrix matrix = TransformMatrixHelpler.AffineInterpolate(p, startValue.Matrix, endValue.Matrix);
			return new MatrixTransform
			{
				Matrix = matrix
			};
		}

		private object GetUnderlyingValue(UIElementPropertyId targetProperty, UIElementPropertyAccessor accessor)
		{
			return accessor.GetValue(Target);
		}

		private UIElementPropertyAccessor[] GetEffectPropertyAccessors()
		{
			List<UIElementPropertyAccessor> list = new List<UIElementPropertyAccessor>();
			for (int i = 0; i < EffectProperties.Length; i++)
			{
				list.Add(UIElementPropertyAccessorFactory.Instance.GetPropertyAccessor(EffectProperties[i]));
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		private UIElementPropertyId[] GetEffectProperties()
		{
			List<UIElementPropertyId> list = new List<UIElementPropertyId>();
			HashSet<UIElementPropertyId> hashSet = new HashSet<UIElementPropertyId>();
			for (int i = 0; i < Frames.Length; i++)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < Frames[i].Properties.Length; j++)
				{
					if (!hashSet.Contains(Frames[i].Properties[j].PropertyId))
					{
						hashSet.Add(Frames[i].Properties[j].PropertyId);
						list.Add(Frames[i].Properties[j].PropertyId);
					}
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		internal void CommitStyles()
		{
			KeyFrameAnimationFill fillMode = _fillMode;
			_fillMode = KeyFrameAnimationFill.Both;
			Tick();
			_fillMode = fillMode;
		}
	}
	internal enum KeyFrameAnimationEffectPhase

	internal class AnimationKeyFrame
	{
		private List<AnimationKeyFrameProperty> _properties = new List<AnimationKeyFrameProperty>();

		private AnimationKeyFrameProperty[] _propertiesCache;

		private Dictionary<UIElementPropertyId, AnimationKeyFrameProperty> _propertiesMap;

		public double Offset { get; set; }

		public AnimationKeyFrameProperty[] Properties
		{
			get
			{
				if (_propertiesCache == null)
				{
					_propertiesCache = _properties.ToArray();
				}
				return _propertiesCache;
			}
		}

		public AnimationKeyFrame()
		{
			Offset = double.NaN;
		}

		public AnimationKeyFrame(double offset)
		{
			Offset = offset;
		}

		public AnimationKeyFrameProperty GetProperty(UIElementPropertyId id)
		{
			if (_propertiesMap == null)
			{
				_propertiesMap = new Dictionary<UIElementPropertyId, AnimationKeyFrameProperty>();
				for (int i = 0; i < Properties.Length; i++)
				{
					_propertiesMap[Properties[i].PropertyId] = Properties[i];
				}
			}
			if (_propertiesMap.ContainsKey(id))
			{
				return _propertiesMap[id];
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static AnimationKeyFrame Create()
		{
			return new AnimationKeyFrame();
		}

		public static AnimationKeyFrame CreateWithOffset(double offset)
		{
			return new AnimationKeyFrame
			{
				Offset = offset
			};
		}

		public static AnimationKeyFrame CreateWithOffsetAndProperties(double offset, AnimationKeyFrameProperty[] properties)
		{
			AnimationKeyFrame animationKeyFrame = new AnimationKeyFrame();
			animationKeyFrame.Offset = offset;
			animationKeyFrame._properties.AddRange(properties);
			return animationKeyFrame;
		}

		public AnimationKeyFrame Add(AnimationKeyFrameProperty property)
		{
			_properties.Add(property);
			_propertiesCache = null;
			_propertiesMap = null;
			return this;
		}
	}
	internal class AnimationKeyFrameProperty
	{
		private object _value;

		public UIElementPropertyId PropertyId { get; private set; }

		public object Value
		{
			get
			{
				return _value;
			}
			set
			{
				object value2 = CheckCoercions(value);
				_value = value2;
			}
		}

		public AnimationKeyFrameProperty(UIElementPropertyId id, object value)
		{
			PropertyId = id;
			Value = value;
		}

		private object CheckCoercions(object value)
		{
			if (PropertyId == UIElementPropertyId.Unset)
			{
				return value;
			}
			UIElementPropertyId propertyId = PropertyId;
			if (propertyId == UIElementPropertyId.Transform)
			{
				Matrix matrix = TransformMatrixHelpler.CoerceToMatrix(value);
				return new MatrixTransform
				{
					Matrix = matrix
				};
			}
			return value;
		}
	}

	[TypeConverter(typeof(SolidBrushCollectionConverter))]
	public class BrushCollection : ObservableCollection<Brush>
	{
		private static Random random = new Random();

		private InterpolationMode _interpolationMode;

		public InterpolationMode InterpolationMode
		{
			get
			{
				return _interpolationMode;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_interpolationMode != value)
				{
					_interpolationMode = value;
					OnCollectionChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset));
				}
			}
		}

		public Brush this[double index] => BrushCollectionUtil.GetInterpolatedBrush(this, index);

		public new Brush this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				if (index < 0 || index >= base.Count)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return base[index];
			}
			set
			{
				base[index] = value;
			}
		}

		protected override void InsertItem(int index, Brush item)
		{
			if (item.CanFreeze)
			{
				item.Freeze();
			}
			base.InsertItem(index, item);
		}

		protected override void SetItem(int index, Brush item)
		{
			if (item.CanFreeze)
			{
				item.Freeze();
			}
			base.SetItem(index, item);
		}

		public Brush SelectRandom()
		{
			return this[random.Next(base.Count)];
		}

		public override bool Equals([SwiftParameterLabel("other")] object obj)
		{
			if (obj == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			BrushCollection brushCollection = (BrushCollection)obj;
			if (brushCollection.Count != base.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < brushCollection.Count; i++)
			{
				if (!brushCollection[i].Equals(this[i]))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static BrushCollection From(IList<string> colorStrings)
		{
			BrushCollection brushCollection = new BrushCollection();
			foreach (string colorString in colorStrings)
			{
				Brush brush = ColorUtil.FromString(colorString).ToBrush();
				if (brush != null)
				{
					brushCollection.Add(brush);
				}
			}
			return brushCollection;
		}
	}
	public class BrushCollectionUtil
	{
		public static Brush GetInterpolatedBrush(BrushCollection target, [SwiftMutableParameter] double index)
		{
			if (double.IsNaN(index))
			{
				return null;
			}
			index = MathUtil.Clamp(index, 0.0, (double)target.Count - 1.0);
			int num = (int)Math.Floor(index);
			if ((double)num == index)
			{
				return target[num];
			}
			return target[num].GetInterpolation(index - (double)num, target[num + 1], target.InterpolationMode);
		}

		internal static BrushCollection From(IList<Color> colors)
		{
			BrushCollection brushCollection = new BrushCollection();
			foreach (Color color in colors)
			{
				Brush brush = color.ToBrush();
				if (brush != null)
				{
					brushCollection.Add(brush);
				}
			}
			return brushCollection;
		}
	}
