	internal class TransformMatrixHelpler
	{
		public static Matrix CoerceToMatrix(object value)
		{
			if (value is MatrixTransform)
			{
				return ((MatrixTransform)value).Matrix;
			}
			if (value is ScaleTransform)
			{
				ScaleTransform scaleTransform = (ScaleTransform)value;
				return GetAffineTransformation(0.0, scaleTransform.ScaleX, scaleTransform.ScaleY, new Point(0.0, 0.0));
			}
			if (value is RotateTransform)
			{
				return GetAffineTransformation(((RotateTransform)value).Angle, 1.0, 1.0, new Point(0.0, 0.0));
			}
			if (value is TranslateTransform)
			{
				TranslateTransform translateTransform = (TranslateTransform)value;
				return GetAffineTransformation(0.0, 1.0, 1.0, new Point(translateTransform.X, translateTransform.Y));
			}
			if (value is TransformGroup)
			{
				TransformGroup transformGroup = (TransformGroup)value;
				Matrix matrix = new Matrix
				{
					M11 = 1.0,
					M22 = 1.0
				};
				for (int num = transformGroup.Children.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					Matrix m = CoerceToMatrix(transformGroup.Children[num]);
					matrix = AffineMultiply(matrix, m);
				}
				return matrix;
			}
			if (value == null)
			{
				return Matrix.Identity;
			}
			return (Matrix)value;
		}

		public static double AffineExtractRotation(Matrix m)
		{
			return Math.Atan2(m.M12, m.M11) * 180.0 / Math.PI;
		}

		public static double AffineExtractScaleX(Matrix m)
		{
			return Math.Sqrt(m.M11 * m.M11 + m.M12 * m.M12);
		}

		public static double AffineExtractScaleY(Matrix m)
		{
			return Math.Sqrt(m.M21 * m.M21 + m.M22 * m.M22);
		}

		public static Point AffineExtractTranslation(Matrix m)
		{
			return new Point(m.OffsetX, m.OffsetY);
		}

		public static Matrix AffineMultiply(Matrix m1, Matrix m2)
		{
			return new Matrix
			{
				M11 = m1.M11 * m2.M11 + m1.M12 * m2.M21,
				M12 = m1.M11 * m2.M12 + m1.M12 * m2.M22,
				OffsetX = m1.OffsetX * m2.M11 + m1.OffsetY * m2.M21 + m2.OffsetX,
				M21 = m1.M21 * m2.M11 + m1.M22 * m2.M21,
				M22 = m1.M21 * m2.M12 + m1.M22 * m2.M22,
				OffsetY = m1.OffsetX * m2.M12 + m1.OffsetY * m2.M22 + m2.OffsetY
			};
		}

		public static Matrix AffineInterpolate(double p, Matrix m1, Matrix m2)
		{
			double num = AffineExtractRotation(m1);
			double num2 = AffineExtractRotation(m2);
			double num3 = AffineExtractScaleX(m1);
			double num4 = AffineExtractScaleX(m2);
			double num5 = AffineExtractScaleY(m1);
			double num6 = AffineExtractScaleY(m2);
			Point point = AffineExtractTranslation(m1);
			Point point2 = AffineExtractTranslation(m2);
			double angle = num + (num2 - num) * p;
			double scaleX = num3 + (num4 - num3) * p;
			double scaleY = num5 + (num6 - num5) * p;
			Point translation = new Point(point.X + (point2.X - point.X) * p, point.Y + (point2.Y - point.Y) * p);
			return GetAffineTransformation(angle, scaleX, scaleY, translation);
		}

		public static Matrix GetAffineTransformation([SwiftMutableParameter] double angle, double scaleX, double scaleY, Point translation)
		{
			angle %= 360.0;
			double num = angle * Math.PI / 180.0;
			Matrix result = default(Matrix);
			double num2 = Math.Cos(num);
			double num3 = Math.Sin(num);
			result.M11 = scaleX * num2;
			result.M12 = scaleX * num3;
			result.M21 = (0.0 - scaleY) * num3;
			result.M22 = scaleY * num2;
			result.OffsetX = translation.X;
			result.OffsetY = translation.Y;
			return result;
		}
	}

	[TSClientName("ArrayExtension")]
	public static class ArrayUtil
	{
		public static void Shuffle<T>(this IList<T> list)
		{
			if (list != null)
			{
				Random random = new Random();
				for (int num = list.Count - 1; num > 0; num--)
				{
					int index = random.Next(num);
					T value = list[num];
					list[num] = list[index];
					list[index] = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public static int InsertionIndex<T>(this IList<T> collection, T value) where T : IComparable
		{
			int num = -1;
			int num2 = 0;
			int num3 = collection.Count;
			while (num == -1)
			{
				if (num3 <= num2)
				{
					num = num2;
					continue;
				}
				int num4 = (num2 + num3) / 2;
				switch (Math.Sign(((IComparable)value).CompareTo(collection[num4])))
				{
				case -1:
					num3 = num4;
					break;
				case 0:
					num = num4;
					break;
				case 1:
					num2 = num4 + 1;
					break;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		public static int InsertionIndex<T>(this IList<T> collection, Comparison<T> comparison, T value)
		{
			int num = -1;
			int num2 = 0;
			int num3 = collection.Count;
			while (num == -1)
			{
				if (num3 <= num2)
				{
					num = num2;
					continue;
				}
				int num4 = (num2 + num3) / 2;
				switch (Math.Sign(comparison(value, collection[num4])))
				{
				case -1:
					num3 = num4;
					break;
				case 0:
					num = num4;
					break;
				case 1:
					num2 = num4 + 1;
					break;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		public static IEnumerable<IEnumerable<T>> Permute<T>(this IEnumerable<T> list, int count)
		{
			if (count == 0)
			{
				yield return new T[0];
				yield break;
			}
			foreach (T startingElement in list)
			{
				IEnumerable<T> list2 = list.Except(new T[1] { startingElement });
				foreach (IEnumerable<T> item in list2.Permute(count - 1))
				{
					yield return new T[1] { startingElement }.Concat(item);
				}
			}
		}

		public static int BinarySearch<T>(this IList<T> list, Func<T, int> comparisonFunction)
		{
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = list.Count - 1;
			while (num <= num2)
			{
				int num3 = num + (num2 - num >> 1);
				int num4 = comparisonFunction(list[num3]);
				if (num4 < 0)
				{
					num2 = num3 - 1;
					continue;
				}
				if (num4 > 0)
				{
					num = num3 + 1;
					continue;
				}
				return num3;
			}
			return ~num;
		}

		public static int BinarySearch<T>(this IIndexedPool<T> list, Func<T, int> comparisonFunction)
		{
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = list.Count - 1;
			while (num <= num2)
			{
				int num3 = num + (num2 - num >> 1);
				int num4 = comparisonFunction(list[num3]);
				if (num4 < 0)
				{
					num2 = num3 - 1;
					continue;
				}
				if (num4 > 0)
				{
					num = num3 + 1;
					continue;
				}
				return num3;
			}
			return ~num;
		}

		public static T GetModulus<T>(this IList<T> list, int index)
		{
			if (list == null)
			{
				return default(T);
			}
			if (list.Count == 0)
			{
				return default(T);
			}
			return list[index % list.Count];
		}

		public static object GetModulusObject(this IList list, int index)
		{
			if (list == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (list.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return list[index % list.Count];
		}
	}
	public static class CoreGeometryUtil
	{
		public static double SimplifyAngle([SwiftMutableParameter] double angle)
		{
			if (double.IsNaN(angle) || double.IsInfinity(angle))
			{
				return angle;
			}
			while (angle > 360.0)
			{
				angle -= 360.0;
			}
			while (angle < 0.0)
			{
				angle += 360.0;
			}
			return angle;
		}

		public static Point GetCenterFromArcSegment(Point startPoint, Point endPoint, double radius, bool isCounter, bool isLargeArc)
		{
			Point point = new Point((startPoint.X + endPoint.X) / 2.0, (startPoint.Y + endPoint.Y) / 2.0);
			double num = endPoint.X - startPoint.X;
			double num2 = endPoint.Y - startPoint.Y;
			double num3 = Math.Sqrt(num * num + num2 * num2);
			double num4 = num2;
			double num5 = num * -1.0;
			if (isLargeArc == isCounter)
			{
				num4 = num2 * -1.0;
				num5 = num;
			}
			double num6 = Math.Max(Math.Abs(num4), Math.Abs(num5));
			num4 /= num6;
			num5 /= num6;
			double num7 = Math.Sqrt(num4 * num4 + num5 * num5);
			double num8 = num4 / num7;
			double num9 = num5 / num7;
			double num10 = num3 / 2.0;
			double num11 = Math.Sqrt(radius * radius - num10 * num10);
			if (double.IsNaN(num11))
			{
				num11 = 0.0;
			}
			double num12 = num11 * num8;
			double num13 = num11 * num9;
			return new Point(point.X + num12, point.Y + num13);
		}
	}

		private static int ParseInvariantInt(string str)
		{
			int result = 0;
			int.TryParse(str, NumberStyles.Integer, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out result);
			return result;
		}

		private static double ParseInvariantDouble(string str)
		{
			double result = 0.0;
			double.TryParse(str, NumberStyles.Float, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out result);
			return result;
		}

		internal static byte[] IntToArgb(int value)
		{
			byte b = (byte)(value & 0xFF000000u);
			byte b2 = (byte)(value & 0xFF0000);
			byte b3 = (byte)(value & 0xFF00);
			byte b4 = (byte)(value & 0xFF);
			return new byte[4] { b, b2, b3, b4 };
		}

		internal static Color StringToColor(string str)
		{
			byte[] array = StringToRGBA(str);
			return Color.FromArgb(array[3], array[0], array[1], array[2]);
		}

		internal static byte[] StringToRGBA(string str)
		{
			byte b = 0;
			byte b2 = 0;
			byte b3 = 0;
			byte b4 = byte.MaxValue;
			string text = str.Replace(" ", "").ToLower();
			if (text == "transparent")
			{
				return new byte[4];
			}
			if (_wellKnownColors.ContainsKey(text))
			{
				str = _wellKnownColors[text];
			}
			if (str.StartsWith("rgba"))
			{
				str = str.Replace("rgba", "").Replace(" ", "").Replace("(", "")
					.Replace(")", "");
				string[] array = str.Split(',');
				if (array.Length == 4)
				{
					b = (byte)ParseInvariantInt(array[0]);
					b2 = (byte)ParseInvariantInt(array[1]);
					b3 = (byte)ParseInvariantInt(array[2]);
					b4 = (byte)(ParseInvariantDouble(array[3]) * 255.0);
				}
			}
			else if (str.StartsWith("rgb"))
			{
				str = str.Replace("rgb", "").Replace(" ", "").Replace("(", "")
					.Replace(")", "");
				string[] array2 = str.Split(',');
				if (array2.Length == 3)
				{
					b = (byte)ParseInvariantInt(array2[0]);
					b2 = (byte)ParseInvariantInt(array2[1]);
					b3 = (byte)ParseInvariantInt(array2[2]);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				str = str.Replace("#", "").Replace(" ", "");
				if (str.Length == 8)
				{
					b4 = (byte)HexToInt(str.Substring(0, 2));
					b = (byte)HexToInt(str.Substring(2, 2));
					b2 = (byte)HexToInt(str.Substring(4, 2));
					b3 = (byte)HexToInt(str.Substring(6, 2));
				}
				if (str.Length == 6)
				{
					b = (byte)HexToInt(str.Substring(0, 2));
					b2 = (byte)HexToInt(str.Substring(2, 2));
					b3 = (byte)HexToInt(str.Substring(4, 2));
				}
				else if (str.Length == 3)
				{
					b = (byte)HexToInt(str.Substring(0, 1) + str.Substring(0, 1));
					b2 = (byte)HexToInt(str.Substring(1, 1) + str.Substring(1, 1));
					b3 = (byte)HexToInt(str.Substring(2, 1) + str.Substring(2, 1));
				}
			}
			return new byte[4] { b, b2, b3, b4 };
		}

		private static int HexToInt(string val)
		{
			if (int.TryParse(val, NumberStyles.HexNumber, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var result))
			{
				return result;
			}
			return 0;
		}

		public static Brush StringToBrush(string str)
		{
			if (IsGradient(str))
			{
				return BrushFromGradientString(str);
			}
			return new SolidColorBrush(StringToColor(str));
		}

		public static bool IsGradient(string value)
		{
			if (!value.Contains("linear-gradient"))
			{
				return value.Contains("radial-gradient");
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static Brush BrushFromGradientString(string value)
		{
			Regex regex = new Regex("hsl\\([\\s\\S]+?\\)[\\s\\S]*?[,\\)]|rgba?\\([\\s\\S]+?\\)[\\s\\S]*?[,\\)]|[^\\(\\)]*?[,\\)]", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase | RegexOptions.Multiline);
			Regex regex2 = new Regex("\\s*\\d*%\\s*$");
			Regex regex3 = new Regex("^\\s\\s*");
			Regex regex4 = new Regex("\\s\\s*$");
			Regex regex5 = new Regex("[,\\)]?$");
			int i = 1;
			int num = 0;
			bool flag = false;
			MatchCollection matchCollection = regex.Matches(value);
			if (matchCollection == null || matchCollection.Count < 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			LinearGradientBrush linearGradientBrush = new LinearGradientBrush();
			int count = matchCollection.Count;
			string value2 = matchCollection[0].Groups[0].Value;
			GradientStop[] array2;
			if (value2.Contains("to") || value2.Contains("deg"))
			{
				Point[] array = CalculatePointsFromAngle(AngleFromString(value2));
				linearGradientBrush.StartPoint = new Point(array[0].X, array[0].Y);
				linearGradientBrush.EndPoint = new Point(array[1].X, array[1].Y);
				array2 = new GradientStop[count - 1];
			}
			else
			{
				array2 = new GradientStop[count];
				i = 0;
			}
			for (; i < count; i++)
			{
				GradientStop gradientStop = new GradientStop();
				value2 = matchCollection[i].Groups[0].Value;
				value2 = regex3.Replace(value2, "");
				value2 = regex4.Replace(value2, "");
				value2 = regex5.Replace(value2, "");
				Match match = regex2.Match(value2);
				int num2 = (match.Success ? match.Index : (-1));
				if (num2 != -1)
				{
					gradientStop.Color = StringToColor(value2.Substring(0, num2));
					gradientStop.Offset = double.Parse(value2.Substring(num2 + 1).Replace("%", "")) / 100.0;
				}
				else
				{
					gradientStop.Color = StringToColor(value2);
					gradientStop.Offset = -1.0;
					flag = true;
				}
				array2[num] = gradientStop;
				num++;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				if (array2[0].Offset == -1.0)
				{
					array2[0].Offset = 0.0;
				}
				if (array2[array2.Length - 1].Offset == -1.0)
				{
					array2[array2.Length - 1].Offset = 1.0;
				}
				FixUnsetOffsets(array2);
				linearGradientBrush.GradientStops = new GradientStopCollection(array2);
			}
			return linearGradientBrush;
		}

		private static void FixUnsetOffsets(GradientStop[] stops)
		{
			int num = -1;
			double num2 = -1.0;
			double num3 = 0.0;
			bool flag = false;
			for (int i = num + 1; i < stops.Length; i++)
			{
				GradientStop gradientStop = stops[i];
				if (gradientStop.Offset != -1.0)
				{
					num2 = (gradientStop.Offset = Math.Max(num2, gradientStop.Offset));
					if (flag)
					{
						int num5 = 1;
						double num6 = (num2 - num3) / (double)(i - num);
						for (int j = num + 1; j < i; j++)
						{
							stops[j].Offset = num3 + num6 * (double)num5;
							num5++;
						}
						flag = false;
					}
					num = i;
					num3 = num2;
				}
				else
				{
					flag = true;
				}
			}
		}

		private static double AngleFromString(string value)
		{
			Regex regex = new Regex("to\\s*top\\s*", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase);
			Regex regex2 = new Regex("to\\s*right\\s*top\\s*", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase);
			Regex regex3 = new Regex("to\\s*right\\s*", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase);
			Regex regex4 = new Regex("to\\s*right\\s*bottom\\s*", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase);
			Regex regex5 = new Regex("to\\s*bottom\\s*", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase);
			Regex regex6 = new Regex("to\\s*left\\s*bottom\\s*", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase);
			Regex regex7 = new Regex("to\\s*left\\s*", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase);
			Regex regex8 = new Regex("to\\s*left\\s*top\\s*", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase);
			if (value.Contains("deg"))
			{
				return double.Parse(value.Replace("deg", ""));
			}
			if (regex.IsMatch(value))
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			if (regex2.IsMatch(value))
			{
				return 45.0;
			}
			if (regex3.IsMatch(value))
			{
				return 90.0;
			}
			if (regex4.IsMatch(value))
			{
				return 135.0;
			}
			if (regex5.IsMatch(value))
			{
				return 180.0;
			}
			if (regex6.IsMatch(value))
			{
				return 225.0;
			}
			if (regex7.IsMatch(value))
			{
				return 270.0;
			}
			return regex8.IsMatch(value) ? 315 : 180;
		}

		private static double Radians(double degrees)
		{
			return Math.PI * degrees / 180.0;
		}

		private static double SimplifyAngle(double angle)
		{
			if (double.IsNaN(angle) || double.IsInfinity(angle))
			{
				return angle;
			}
			while (angle > 360.0)
			{
				angle -= 360.0;
			}
			while (angle < 0.0)
			{
				angle += 360.0;
			}
			return angle;
		}

		private static Point[] CalculatePointsFromAngle(double inputAngle)
		{
			Point[] array = new Point[2];
			Point point = default(Point);
			Point point2 = default(Point);
			double num = SimplifyAngle(inputAngle);
			if (num >= 0.0 && num <= 45.0)
			{
				double num2 = Math.Tan(Radians(num));
				point.X = 0.5 - 0.5 * num2;
				point.Y = 1.0;
				point2.X = 0.5 + 0.5 * num2;
				point2.Y = 0.0;
			}
			else if (num > 180.0 && num <= 225.0)
			{
				double num3 = Math.Tan(Radians(num - 180.0));
				point.X = 0.5 + 0.5 * num3;
				point.Y = 0.0;
				point2.X = 0.5 - 0.5 * num3;
				point2.Y = 1.0;
			}
			else if (num > 135.0 && num <= 180.0)
			{
				double num4 = Math.Tan(Radians(180.0 - num));
				point.X = 0.5 - 0.5 * num4;
				point.Y = 0.0;
				point2.X = 0.5 + 0.5 * num4;
				point2.Y = 1.0;
			}
			else if (num > 315.0 && num < 360.0)
			{
				double num5 = Math.Tan(Radians(360.0 - num));
				point.X = 0.5 + 0.5 * num5;
				point.Y = 1.0;
				point2.X = 0.5 - 0.5 * num5;
				point2.Y = 0.0;
			}
			else if (num > 45.0 && num <= 90.0)
			{
				double num6 = Math.Tan(Radians(90.0 - num));
				point2.Y = 0.5 - 0.5 * num6;
				point2.X = 1.0;
				point.Y = 0.5 + 0.5 * num6;
				point.X = 0.0;
			}
			else if (num > 90.0 && num <= 135.0)
			{
				double num7 = Math.Tan(Radians(num - 90.0));
				point2.Y = 0.5 + 0.5 * num7;
				point2.X = 1.0;
				point.Y = 0.5 - 0.5 * num7;
				point.X = 0.0;
			}
			else if (num > 225.0 && num <= 270.0)
			{
				double num8 = Math.Tan(Radians(270.0 - num));
				point.Y = 0.5 - 0.5 * num8;
				point.X = 1.0;
				point2.Y = 0.5 + 0.5 * num8;
				point2.X = 0.0;
			}
			else if (num > 270.0 && num <= 315.0)
			{
				double num9 = Math.Tan(Radians(num - 270.0));
				point.Y = 0.5 + 0.5 * num9;
				point.X = 1.0;
				point2.Y = 0.5 - 0.5 * num9;
				point2.X = 0.0;
			}
			array[0] = point;
			array[1] = point2;
			return array;
		}
	}
	public static class DeviceUtils
	{
		public static double ToPixelUnits(double value)
		{
			return value;
		}

		public static double ToFontPixelUnits(double value)
		{
			return value;
		}

		public static double ClampPixelScalingRatio(double value)
		{
			if (double.IsNaN(value))
			{
				return double.NaN;
			}
			if (value <= 0.0)
			{
				return double.NaN;
			}
			return value;
		}

		public static double FromPixelUnits(double value)
		{
			return value * GetDIPScalingRatio();
		}

		public static double FromFontPixelUnits(double value)
		{
			return value * GetFontDIPScalingRatio();
		}

		public static double GetDIPScalingRatio()
		{
			double num = ToPixelUnits(2.0);
			return 2.0 / num;
		}

		public static double GetFontDIPScalingRatio()
		{
			double num = ToFontPixelUnits(2.0);
			return 2.0 / num;
		}
	}
	public static class Extensions
	{
		public static void Reset(this PathGeometry geom)
		{
			geom.Figures.Clear();
			geom.Figures.Add(new PathFigure());
			geom.Figures.RemoveAt(0);
		}

		public static void Reset(this GeometryGroup geom)
		{
			geom.Children.Clear();
			geom.Children.Add(new PathGeometry());
			geom.Children.RemoveAt(0);
		}

		public static void Detach(this FrameworkElement child)
		{
			if (child != null)
			{
				if (child.Parent is Panel panel)
				{
					panel.Children.Remove(child);
				}
				else if (child.Parent is ContentControl contentControl)
				{
					contentControl.Content = null;
				}
				else if (child.Parent is ContentPresenter contentPresenter)
				{
					contentPresenter.Content = null;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void TransferChildrenTo(this Panel from, Panel to)
		{
			List<UIElement> list = new List<UIElement>();
			foreach (object child in from.Children)
			{
				if (child is UIElement)
				{
					list.Add((UIElement)child);
				}
			}
			foreach (UIElement item in list)
			{
				from.Children.Remove(item);
				to.Children.Add(item);
			}
		}

		public static bool IsPlottable(this double num)
		{
			if (!double.IsNaN(num))
			{
				return !double.IsInfinity(num);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool IsPlottable(this Point point)
		{
			if (point.X.IsPlottable())
			{
				return point.Y.IsPlottable();
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool IsPlottable(this Rect rect)
		{
			if (!double.IsNaN(rect.Left) && !double.IsNaN(rect.Right) && !double.IsNaN(rect.Top) && !double.IsNaN(rect.Bottom) && !double.IsInfinity(rect.Left) && !double.IsInfinity(rect.Right) && !double.IsInfinity(rect.Top))
			{
				return !double.IsInfinity(rect.Bottom);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static IEnumerable<T> LogicalDescendantsOfType<T>(this FrameworkElement ele) where T : FrameworkElement
		{
			foreach (FrameworkElement child in LogicalTreeHelper.GetChildren(ele).OfType<FrameworkElement>())
			{
				if (child is T)
				{
					yield return (T)child;
				}
				foreach (T item in child.LogicalDescendantsOfType<T>())
				{
					yield return item;
				}
			}
		}

		public static IEnumerable<T> VisualDescendantsOfType<T>(this FrameworkElement ele) where T : FrameworkElement
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < VisualTreeHelper.GetChildrenCount(ele); i++)
			{
				if (!(VisualTreeHelper.GetChild(ele, i) is FrameworkElement child))
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (child is T)
				{
					yield return (T)child;
				}
				foreach (T item in child.VisualDescendantsOfType<T>())
				{
					yield return item;
				}
			}
		}

		public static bool IsInVisualTree(this DependencyObject element)
		{
			return element.IsInVisualTree(PlatformProxy.GetRootVisual(element));
		}

		public static bool IsInVisualTree(this DependencyObject element, DependencyObject ancestor)
		{
			for (DependencyObject dependencyObject = element; dependencyObject != null; dependencyObject = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(dependencyObject))
			{
				if (dependencyObject == ancestor)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool IsVisibleInVisualTree(this FrameworkElement ele, FrameworkElement topParent = null)
		{
			if (!ele.IsInVisualTree())
			{
				return false;
			}
			while (ele != topParent && ele != null)
			{
				if (ele.Visibility == Visibility.Collapsed)
				{
					return false;
				}
				ele = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(ele) as FrameworkElement;
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	internal static class FrameworkElementExtensions
	{
		public static bool HasParent(this FrameworkElement frameworkElement, Panel collection)
		{
			return frameworkElement.Parent != null;
		}
	}

	{
		public static readonly double PHI = (1.0 + Math.Sqrt(5.0)) / 2.0;

		public const double DegreeAsRadian = Math.PI / 180.0;

		public static double Asinh(double angle)
		{
			return Math.Log(angle + Math.Sqrt(angle * angle + 1.0));
		}

		public static string NumberToMinDecimalsString(double number_)
		{
			return number_.ToString();
		}

		public static double Hypot(double x, double y)
		{
			return Math.Sqrt(x * x + y * y);
		}

		public static double Sqr(double x)
		{
			return x * x;
		}

		public static double Clamp(double value, double minimum, double maximum)
		{
			return Math.Min(maximum, Math.Max(minimum, value));
		}

		public static double Radians(double degrees)
		{
			return Math.PI * degrees / 180.0;
		}

		public static double Degrees(double radians)
		{
			return 180.0 * radians / Math.PI;
		}

		public static double Min3(double v1, double v2, double v3)
		{
			return Math.Min(v1, Math.Min(v2, v3));
		}

		public static double Max3(double v1, double v2, double v3)
		{
			return Math.Max(v1, Math.Max(v2, v3));
		}

		public static double Min(params double[] a)
		{
			double num = a[0];
			for (int i = 1; i < a.Length; i++)
			{
				num = Math.Min(num, a[i]);
			}
			return num;
		}

		public static double Max(params double[] a)
		{
			double num = a[0];
			for (int i = 1; i < a.Length; i++)
			{
				num = Math.Max(num, a[i]);
			}
			return num;
		}
	}

		public static double GammaLn(double x)
		{
			if (x <= 0.0)
			{
				return double.NaN;
			}
			double[] array = new double[14]
			{
				57.15623566586292, -59.59796035547549, 14.136097974741746, -0.4919138160976202, 3.399464998481189E-05, 4.652362892704858E-05, -9.837447530487956E-05, 0.0001580887032249125, -0.00021026444172410488, 0.00021743961811521265,
				-0.0001643181065367639, 8.441822398385275E-05, -2.6190838401581408E-05, 3.6899182659531625E-06
			};
			double num = x;
			double num2 = (x + 0.5) * Math.Log(x + 5.2421875) - (x + 5.2421875);
			double num3 = 0.9999999999999971;
			for (int i = 0; i < 14; i++)
			{
				num3 += array[i] / (num += 1.0);
			}
			return num2 + Math.Log(2.5066282746310007 * num3 / x);
		}

		public static double Noise([SwiftMutableParameter] double x, [SwiftMutableParameter] double y, [SwiftMutableParameter] double z)
		{
			int num = (int)Math.Floor(x) & 0xFF;
			int num2 = (int)Math.Floor(y) & 0xFF;
			int num3 = (int)Math.Floor(z) & 0xFF;
			x -= Math.Floor(x);
			y -= Math.Floor(y);
			z -= Math.Floor(z);
			double t = fade(x);
			double t2 = fade(y);
			double t3 = fade(z);
			int num4 = basis[num] + num2;
			int num5 = basis[num4] + num3;
			int num6 = basis[num4 + 1] + num3;
			int num7 = basis[num + 1] + num2;
			int num8 = basis[num7] + num3;
			int num9 = basis[num7 + 1] + num3;
			return lerp(t3, lerp(t2, lerp(t, grad(basis[num5], x, y, z), grad(basis[num8], x - 1.0, y, z)), lerp(t, grad(basis[num6], x, y - 1.0, z), grad(basis[num9], x - 1.0, y - 1.0, z))), lerp(t2, lerp(t, grad(basis[num5 + 1], x, y, z - 1.0), grad(basis[num8 + 1], x - 1.0, y, z - 1.0)), lerp(t, grad(basis[num6 + 1], x, y - 1.0, z - 1.0), grad(basis[num9 + 1], x - 1.0, y - 1.0, z - 1.0))));
		}

		private static double fade(double t)
		{
			return t * t * t * (t * (t * 6.0 - 15.0) + 10.0);
		}

		private static double lerp(double t, double a, double b)
		{
			return a + t * (b - a);
		}

		private static double grad(int hash, double x, double y, double z)
		{
			int num = hash & 0xF;
			double num2 = ((num < 8) ? x : y);
			double num3 = ((num < 4) ? y : ((num == 12 || num == 14) ? x : z));
			return (((num & 1) == 0) ? num2 : (0.0 - num2)) + (((num & 2) == 0) ? num3 : (0.0 - num3));
		}

		public static double NiceFloor(double value)
		{
			if (value == 0.0)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			if (value < 0.0)
			{
				return 0.0 - NiceCeiling(0.0 - value);
			}
			int n = (int)Math.Floor(Math.Log10(value));
			double num = value / expt(10.0, n);
			return ((num < 2.0) ? 1.0 : ((num < 5.0) ? 2.0 : ((num < 10.0) ? 5.0 : 10.0))) * expt(10.0, n);
		}

		public static double NiceRound(double value)
		{
			if (value == 0.0)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			if (value < 0.0)
			{
				return 0.0 - NiceRound(0.0 - value);
			}
			int n = (int)Math.Floor(Math.Log10(value));
			double num = value / expt(10.0, n);
			return ((num < 1.0) ? 1.0 : ((num < 3.0) ? 2.0 : ((num < 7.0) ? 5.0 : 10.0))) * expt(10.0, n);
		}

		public static double NiceCeiling(double value)
		{
			if (value == 0.0)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			if (value < 0.0)
			{
				return 0.0 - NiceFloor(0.0 - value);
			}
			int n = (int)Math.Floor(Math.Log10(value));
			double num = value / expt(10.0, n);
			return ((num <= 1.0) ? 1.0 : ((num <= 2.0) ? 2.0 : ((num <= 5.0) ? 5.0 : 10.0))) * expt(10.0, n);
		}

		private static double expt(double a, [SwiftMutableParameter] int n)
		{
			double num = 1.0;
			while (n > 0)
			{
				num *= a;
				n--;
			}
			while (n < 0)
			{
				num /= a;
				n++;
			}
			return num;
		}
	}
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	public class Pool<T> : IIndexedPool<T>, IPool<T>
	{
		public Func<T> Create { get; set; }

		public Action<T> Disactivate { get; set; }

		public Action<T> Activate { get; set; }

		public Action<T> Destroy { get; set; }

		public T this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				if (index >= Count)
				{
					Count = index + 1;
				}
				return Active[index];
			}
		}

		public int Count
		{
			get
			{
				return Active.Count;
			}
			set
			{
				int num = Active.Count;
				while (value > Active.Count && Inactive.Count > 0)
				{
					T val = Inactive[Inactive.Count - 1];
					Active.Add(val);
					Inactive.RemoveAt(Inactive.Count - 1);
					if (Activate != null)
					{
						Activate(val);
					}
				}
				while (value > Active.Count && Inactive.Count == 0)
				{
					T val2 = Create();
					Active.Add(val2);
					if (Activate != null)
					{
						Activate(val2);
					}
				}
				int num2 = 2;
				while (num != 0)
				{
					num >>= 1;
					num2 <<= 1;
				}
				while (value < Active.Count)
				{
					T val3 = Active[Active.Count - 1];
					Active.RemoveAt(Active.Count - 1);
					if (Disactivate != null)
					{
						Disactivate(val3);
					}
					if (Inactive.Count < num2)
					{
						Inactive.Add(val3);
					}
					else if (Destroy != null)
					{
						Destroy(val3);
					}
				}
				if (num2 < Inactive.Count)
				{
					for (int i = num2; i < Inactive.Count; i++)
					{
						Destroy(Inactive[i]);
					}
					Inactive.RemoveRange(num2, Inactive.Count - num2);
				}
			}
		}

		public List<T> Active { get; set; }

		public List<T> Inactive { get; set; }

		public Pool()
		{
			Active = new List<T>();
			Inactive = new List<T>();
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			Count = 0;
		}

		public void DoToAll(Action<T> action)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < Inactive.Count; i++)
			{
				action(Inactive[i]);
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < Active.Count; j++)
			{
				action(Active[j]);
			}
		}
	}
	public interface IPool<T>
	{
		Func<T> Create { get; set; }

		Action<T> Disactivate { get; set; }

		Action<T> Activate { get; set; }

		Action<T> Destroy { get; set; }

		void Clear();
	}
	public interface IIndexedPool<T> : IPool<T>
	{
		T this[int index] { get; }

		int Count { get; }
	}
	public interface IHashPool<TKey, TValue> : IPool<TValue>
	{
		TValue this[TKey key] { get; }
	}
	public class HashPool<TKey, TValue> : IHashPool<TKey, TValue>, IPool<TValue>
	{
		protected List<TValue> Inactive { get; set; }

		protected Dictionary<TKey, TValue> Active { get; set; }

		public Func<TValue> Create { get; set; }

		public Action<TValue> Disactivate { get; set; }

		public Action<TValue> Activate { get; set; }

		public Action<TValue> Destroy { get; set; }

		public TValue this[TKey key]
		{
			get
			{
				if (!Active.TryGetValue(key, out var value))
				{
					if (Inactive.Count > 0)
					{
						value = Inactive[Inactive.Count - 1];
						Inactive.RemoveAt(Inactive.Count - 1);
					}
					else
					{
						value = Create();
					}
					if (Activate != null)
					{
						Activate(value);
					}
					Active[key] = value;
				}
				return value;
			}
		}

		public IEnumerable<TKey> ActiveKeys => Active.Keys;

		public int ActiveCount => Active.Count;

		public HashPool()
		{
			Inactive = new List<TValue>();
			Active = new Dictionary<TKey, TValue>();
		}

		public bool IsActiveKey(TKey key)
		{
			return Active.ContainsKey(key);
		}

		public void Remove(TKey key)
		{
			if (!Active.TryGetValue(key, out var value))
			{
				return;
			}
			Active.Remove(key);
			if (Disactivate != null)
			{
				Disactivate(value);
			}
			Inactive.Add(value);
			int num = Active.Count;
			int num2 = 2;
			while (num != 0)
			{
				num >>= 1;
				num2 <<= 1;
			}
			if (num2 < Inactive.Count)
			{
				for (int i = num2; i < Inactive.Count; i++)
				{
					Destroy(Inactive[i]);
				}
				Inactive.RemoveRange(num2, Inactive.Count - num2);
			}
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			List<TKey> list = new List<TKey>();
			foreach (TKey key in Active.Keys)
			{
				list.Add(key);
			}
			foreach (TKey item in list)
			{
				Remove(item);
			}
		}

		public void DoToAll(Action<TValue> action)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < Inactive.Count; i++)
			{
				action(Inactive[i]);
			}
			foreach (TValue value in Active.Values)
			{
				action(value);
			}
		}

		public void DoToAllActive(Action<TValue> action)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < Inactive.Count; i++)
			{
				action(Inactive[i]);
			}
			foreach (TValue value in Active.Values)
			{
				action(value);
			}
		}
	}

	public static class RectUtil
	{
		public static Point GetCenter(this Rect rect)
		{
			if (rect.IsEmpty)
			{
				return new Point(double.NaN, double.NaN);
			}
			return new Point(0.5 * (rect.Left + rect.Right), 0.5 * (rect.Bottom + rect.Top));
		}

		public static double GetArea(this Rect rect)
		{
			if (rect.IsEmpty)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			return rect.Width * rect.Height;
		}

		public static Rect Duplicate(this Rect rect)
		{
			if (rect.IsEmpty)
			{
				return rect;
			}
			return new Rect(rect.Left, rect.Top, rect.Width, rect.Height);
		}

		public static Point GetLeader(this Rect rect, Point anchor)
		{
			if (rect.Contains(anchor))
			{
				return anchor;
			}
			Point point = new Point(rect.Left + 0.5 * rect.Width, rect.Top + 0.5 * rect.Height);
			Point point2 = new Point(anchor.X - point.X, anchor.Y - point.Y);
			double num;
			if (point2.X != 0.0)
			{
				num = (rect.Left - point.X) / point2.X;
				double num2 = point.Y + num * point2.Y;
				if (num2 > rect.Top && num2 < rect.Bottom)
				{
					if (!(num > 0.0))
					{
						return new Point(rect.Right, point.Y - num * point2.Y);
					}
					return new Point(rect.Left, num2);
				}
			}
			num = (rect.Top - point.Y) / point2.Y;
			double x = point.X + num * point2.X;
			if (!(num > 0.0))
			{
				return new Point(point.X - num * point2.X, rect.Bottom);
			}
			return new Point(x, rect.Top);
		}

		public static double GetDistanceSquared(this Rect rect, Point pt)
		{
			if (rect.IsEmpty)
			{
				return double.NaN;
			}
			return rect.GetDistanceSquared(pt.X, pt.Y);
		}

		public static double GetDistanceSquared(this Rect rect, Rect rc)
		{
			if (rect.IsEmpty)
			{
				return double.PositiveInfinity;
			}
			double num = rect.GetDistanceSquared(rc.Left, rc.Top);
			if (num > 0.0)
			{
				num = Math.Min(num, rect.GetDistanceSquared(rc.Left, rc.Bottom));
			}
			if (num > 0.0)
			{
				num = Math.Min(num, rect.GetDistanceSquared(rc.Right, rc.Bottom));
			}
			if (num > 0.0)
			{
				num = Math.Min(num, rect.GetDistanceSquared(rc.Right, rc.Top));
			}
			if (num > 0.0)
			{
				num = Math.Min(num, rc.GetDistanceSquared(rect.Left, rect.Top));
			}
			if (num > 0.0)
			{
				num = Math.Min(num, rc.GetDistanceSquared(rect.Left, rect.Bottom));
			}
			if (num > 0.0)
			{
				num = Math.Min(num, rc.GetDistanceSquared(rect.Right, rect.Bottom));
			}
			if (num > 0.0)
			{
				num = Math.Min(num, rc.GetDistanceSquared(rect.Right, rect.Top));
			}
			return num;
		}

		private static double GetDistanceSquared(this Rect rc, double X, double Y)
		{
			double num = X - rc.Left;
			double num2 = Y - rc.Top;
			double num3 = rc.Width * num;
			double num4 = rc.Height * num2;
			if (num3 > 0.0)
			{
				double num5 = rc.Width * rc.Width;
				num = ((!(num3 < num5)) ? (num - rc.Width) : (num - num3 / num5 * rc.Width));
			}
			if (num4 > 0.0)
			{
				double num6 = rc.Height * rc.Height;
				num2 = ((!(num4 < num6)) ? (num2 - rc.Height) : (num2 - num4 / num6 * rc.Height));
			}
			return num * num + num2 * num2;
		}

		public static bool Contains(this Rect rect, Rect rc)
		{
			if (rect.IsEmpty || rc.IsEmpty)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (rect.Left > rc.Left)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (rect.Right < rc.Right)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (rect.Top > rc.Top)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (rect.Bottom < rc.Bottom)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static bool IntersectsWith(this Rect rect, Rect rc)
		{
			if (rect.IsEmpty || rc.IsEmpty)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (rect.Right < rc.Left)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (rect.Left > rc.Right)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (rect.Top > rc.Bottom)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (rect.Bottom < rc.Top)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static double IntersectionArea(this Rect rect, Rect rc)
		{
			if (rect.IsEmpty || rc.IsEmpty)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			double num = Math.Min(rect.Right, rc.Right) - Math.Max(rect.Left, rc.Left);
			if (num <= 0.0)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			double num2 = Math.Min(rect.Bottom, rc.Bottom) - Math.Max(rect.Top, rc.Top);
			if (num2 <= 0.0)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			return num * num2;
		}

		public static Rect GetInflated(this Rect rect, double width, double height)
		{
			if (rect.IsEmpty)
			{
				return rect;
			}
			return new Rect(rect.X - width, rect.Y - height, Math.Max(0.0, rect.Width + 2.0 * width), Math.Max(0.0, rect.Height + 2.0 * height));
		}

		public static Rect InflateBy(Rect rect, double dx, double dy)
		{
			rect.X -= dx;
			rect.Y -= dy;
			double num = rect.Width + 2.0 * dx;
			double num2 = rect.Height + 2.0 * dy;
			rect.Width = ((num > 1.0) ? num : 1.0);
			rect.Height = ((num2 > 1.0) ? num2 : 1.0);
			return rect;
		}

		public static Rect Inflate(this Rect rect, double dx, double dy)
		{
			rect.X -= dx;
			rect.Y -= dy;
			double num = rect.Width + 2.0 * dx;
			double num2 = rect.Height + 2.0 * dy;
			rect.Width = ((num > 1.0) ? num : 1.0);
			rect.Height = ((num2 > 1.0) ? num2 : 1.0);
			return rect;
		}

		public static Rect Inflate(this Rect rect, double thickness)
		{
			double x = rect.X - thickness;
			double y = rect.Y - thickness;
			double num = rect.Width + thickness + thickness;
			double num2 = rect.Height + thickness + thickness;
			double width = ((num > 0.0) ? num : 0.0);
			double height = ((num2 > 0.0) ? num2 : 0.0);
			return new Rect(x, y, width, height);
		}

		public static Rect Inflate(this Rect rect, Thickness thickness)
		{
			rect.X -= thickness.Left;
			rect.Y -= thickness.Top;
			double num = rect.Width + thickness.Left + thickness.Right;
			double num2 = rect.Height + thickness.Top + thickness.Bottom;
			rect.Width = ((num > 0.0) ? num : 0.0);
			rect.Height = ((num2 > 0.0) ? num2 : 0.0);
			return rect;
		}

		public static Rect InflateBy(Rect rect, Thickness thickness)
		{
			rect.X -= thickness.Left;
			rect.Y -= thickness.Top;
			double num = rect.Width + thickness.Left + thickness.Right;
			double num2 = rect.Height + thickness.Top + thickness.Bottom;
			rect.Width = ((num > 0.0) ? num : 0.0);
			rect.Height = ((num2 > 0.0) ? num2 : 0.0);
			return rect;
		}

		public static Rect Deflate(this Rect rect, Thickness thickness)
		{
			rect.X += thickness.Left;
			rect.Y += thickness.Top;
			double num = rect.Width - thickness.Left - thickness.Right;
			double num2 = rect.Height - thickness.Top - thickness.Bottom;
			rect.Width = ((num > 0.0) ? num : 0.0);
			rect.Height = ((num2 > 0.0) ? num2 : 0.0);
			return rect;
		}

		public static Rect Round(this Rect rect)
		{
			rect.X = Math.Round(rect.X);
			rect.Y = Math.Round(rect.Y);
			rect.Width = Math.Round(rect.Width);
			rect.Height = Math.Round(rect.Height);
			return rect;
		}

		public static bool IsNull(this Rect rect)
		{
			if (rect.X == 0.0 && rect.Y == 0.0 && rect.Width == 0.0)
			{
				return rect.Height == 0.0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static Size Size(this Rect rect)
		{
			return new Size(rect.Width, rect.Height);
		}

		public static Rect Normalize(this Rect current, Rect rect)
		{
			return current.Normalize(rect.Size());
		}

		public static Rect Normalize(this Rect current, Size size)
		{
			Rect result = current;
			result.X = current.X / size.Width;
			result.Y = current.Y / size.Height;
			result.Width = current.Width / size.Width;
			result.Height = current.Height / size.Height;
			return result;
		}

		public static Point GetTopLeft(this Rect rect)
		{
			return new Point(rect.X, rect.Y);
		}

		public static Point GetTopRight(this Rect rect)
		{
			return new Point(rect.X + rect.Width, rect.Y);
		}

		public static Point GetBottomLeft(this Rect rect)
		{
			return new Point(rect.X, rect.Y + rect.Height);
		}

		public static Point GetBottomRight(this Rect rect)
		{
			return new Point(rect.X + rect.Width, rect.Y + rect.Height);
		}

		public static List<Point> GetCorners(this Rect rect)
		{
			return new List<Point>
			{
				rect.GetTopLeft(),
				rect.GetTopRight(),
				rect.GetBottomRight(),
				rect.GetBottomLeft()
			};
		}

		public static Rect RotateAboutCenter(this Rect rect, [SwiftMutableParameter] double angle)
		{
			angle = CoreGeometryUtil.SimplifyAngle(angle);
			if (angle == 0.0 || angle == 180.0)
			{
				return new Rect(rect.Left, rect.Top, rect.Width, rect.Height);
			}
			Point center = rect.GetCenter();
			if (angle == 90.0 || angle == 270.0)
			{
				double num = rect.Height / 2.0;
				double num2 = rect.Width / 2.0;
				return new Rect(center.X - num, center.Y - num2, rect.Height, rect.Width);
			}
			return rect.RotateAboutPoint(center.X, center.Y, angle);
		}

		public static Rect RotateAboutPoint(this Rect rect, double x, double y, double angle)
		{
			List<Point> corners = rect.GetCorners();
			double num = MathUtil.Radians(angle);
			double num2 = Math.Cos(num);
			double num3 = Math.Sin(num);
			double num4 = double.MaxValue;
			double num5 = double.MaxValue;
			double num6 = double.MinValue;
			double num7 = double.MinValue;
			for (int i = 0; i < corners.Count; i++)
			{
				Point point = corners[i];
				double val = num2 * (point.X - x) - num3 * (point.Y - y) + x;
				double val2 = num3 * (point.X - x) + num2 * (point.Y - y) + y;
				num4 = Math.Min(num4, val2);
				num5 = Math.Min(num5, val);
				num6 = Math.Max(num6, val);
				num7 = Math.Max(num7, val2);
			}
			return new Rect(num5, num4, num6 - num5, num7 - num4);
		}
	}
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	public class StackPool<T>
	{
		private bool _deferDisactivate;

		private Dictionary<T, object> active;

		private Stack<T> limbo;

		private Stack<T> inactive;

		public bool DeferDisactivate
		{
			get
			{
				return _deferDisactivate;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_deferDisactivate == value)
				{
					return;
				}
				_deferDisactivate = value;
				if (!_deferDisactivate)
				{
					int num = RoundUp(active.Count);
					while (limbo.Count > 0 && inactive.Count <= num)
					{
						T val = limbo.Pop();
						Deactivate(val);
						inactive.Push(val);
					}
					while (limbo.Count > 0)
					{
						T obj = limbo.Pop();
						Deactivate(obj);
						Destroy(obj);
					}
					while (inactive.Count > num)
					{
						Destroy(inactive.Pop());
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public int ActiveCount => active.Count;

		public int InactiveCount => inactive.Count;

		public Func<T> Create { get; set; }

		public Action<T> Deactivate { get; set; }

		public Action<T> Activate { get; set; }

		public Action<T> Destroy { get; set; }

		public StackPool()
		{
			active = new Dictionary<T, object>();
			limbo = new Stack<T>();
			inactive = new Stack<T>();
		}

		public T Pop()
		{
			T val;
			if (limbo.Count != 0)
			{
				val = limbo.Pop();
			}
			else
			{
				val = ((inactive.Count != 0) ? inactive.Pop() : Create());
				Activate(val);
			}
			active.Add(val, null);
			return val;
		}

		public void Push(T t)
		{
			active.Remove(t);
			if (DeferDisactivate)
			{
				limbo.Push(t);
				return;
			}
			Deactivate(t);
			int num = RoundUp(active.Count);
			if (inactive.Count < num)
			{
				Destroy(t);
			}
			else
			{
				inactive.Push(t);
			}
		}

		private static int RoundUp(int a)
		{
			int num = 2;
			while (a > num)
			{
				num <<= 1;
			}
			return num;
		}
	}
	internal class PlatformKeyFrameAnimationFactory : KeyFrameAnimationFactory
	{
		private ITickProvider _tickProvider;

		private IExecutionContext _executionContext;

		public override ITickProvider TickProvider => _tickProvider;

		public override IExecutionContext ExecutionContext => _executionContext;

		public PlatformKeyFrameAnimationFactory(Dispatcher dispatcher)
		{
			_tickProvider = new AnimationXamlTickProvider();
			_executionContext = new WPFExecutionContext(dispatcher);
		}
	}
	internal class AnimationXamlTickProvider : ITickProvider
	{
		private Dictionary<int, Action> _tickingCallbacks = new Dictionary<int, Action>();

		private bool _ticking;

		private int _currentID;

		private List<Action> _toCall = new List<Action>();

		public int SetupTicking(Action callback)
		{
			int currentID = _currentID;
			_currentID++;
			_tickingCallbacks[currentID] = callback;
			if (!_ticking)
			{
				CompositionTarget.Rendering += CompositionTarget_Rendering;
				_ticking = true;
			}
			return currentID;
		}

		private void CompositionTarget_Rendering(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			_toCall.Clear();
			foreach (Action value in _tickingCallbacks.Values)
			{
				_toCall.Add(value);
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < _toCall.Count; i++)
			{
				_toCall[i]();
			}
			_toCall.Clear();
		}

		public void RequestFrame(int id)
		{
		}

		public void TeardownTicking(int id)
		{
			_tickingCallbacks.Remove(id);
			if (_tickingCallbacks.Count == 0 && _ticking)
			{
				_ticking = false;
				CompositionTarget.Rendering -= CompositionTarget_Rendering;
			}
		}
	}
	[ContentProperty("Children")]
	internal class Group : Groupable
	{
		private bool _addingItem;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ChildrenProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Children", typeof(ObservableCollection<Groupable>), typeof(Group), new PropertyMetadata(null, OnChildrenChanged));

		private bool AddingItem
		{
			get
			{
				return _addingItem;
			}
			set
			{
				_addingItem = value;
			}
		}

		public ObservableCollection<Groupable> Children
		{
			get
			{
				return (ObservableCollection<Groupable>)GetValue(ChildrenProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ChildrenProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public Group()
		{
			Children = new ObservableCollection<Groupable>();
		}

		private static void OnChildrenChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((Group)d).OnChildrenChanged((ObservableCollection<Groupable>)e.OldValue, (ObservableCollection<Groupable>)e.NewValue);
		}

		private void OnChildrenChanged(ObservableCollection<Groupable> oldValue, ObservableCollection<Groupable> newValue)
		{
			if (oldValue != null)
			{
				oldValue.CollectionChanged -= Children_CollectionChanged;
				RemoveItems(oldValue);
			}
			if (newValue != null)
			{
				AddItems(newValue);
				newValue.CollectionChanged += Children_CollectionChanged;
			}
		}

		private void Children_CollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			switch (e.Action)
			{
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add:
				AddItems(e.NewItems);
				break;
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove:
				RemoveItems(e.OldItems);
				break;
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace:
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Move:
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset:
				break;
			}
		}

		public void AddItems(IList items)
		{
			if (items == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (Groupable item in items)
			{
				item.SetView(View);
				item.Parent = this;
				AddingItem = true;
				AccumulateBounds(item);
				AddingItem = false;
				AddItem(item);
			}
		}

		public void RemoveItems(IList items)
		{
			if (items == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (Groupable item in items)
			{
				item.Parent = base.Parent;
				RemoveItem(item);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void AddItem(Groupable item)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void RemoveItem(Groupable item)
		{
		}

		protected override void OnBoundsChanged(Rect oldValue, Rect newValue)
		{
			base.OnBoundsChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			if (!base.Initializing && !AddingItem)
			{
				ArrangeChildren(oldValue, newValue);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnVisibilityChanged(Visibility oldValue, Visibility newValue)
		{
			base.OnVisibilityChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			foreach (Groupable child in Children)
			{
				child.Visibility = newValue;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnZIndexChanged(int oldValue, int newValue)
		{
			base.OnZIndexChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			foreach (Groupable child in Children)
			{
				child.ZIndex = newValue;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnCursorChanged(Cursor oldValue, Cursor newValue)
		{
			base.OnCursorChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			foreach (Groupable child in Children)
			{
				child.Cursor = newValue;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnFillChanged(Brush oldValue, Brush newValue)
		{
			base.OnFillChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			foreach (Groupable child in Children)
			{
				child.Fill = newValue;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnStrokeChanged(Brush oldValue, Brush newValue)
		{
			base.OnStrokeChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			foreach (Groupable child in Children)
			{
				child.Stroke = newValue;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnStrokeThicknessChanged(double oldValue, double newValue)
		{
			base.OnStrokeThicknessChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			foreach (Groupable child in Children)
			{
				child.StrokeThickness = newValue;
			}
		}

		public override void Render()
		{
			foreach (Groupable child in Children)
			{
				if (child.View == null)
				{
					child.SetView(View);
				}
				child.Render();
			}
		}

		public override void Remove()
		{
			foreach (Groupable child in Children)
			{
				if (child.View != null)
				{
					child.Remove();
				}
			}
		}

		public override bool HitTest(Point point)
		{
			if (base.Visibility == Visibility.Collapsed)
			{
				return false;
			}
			foreach (Groupable child in Children)
			{
				if (child.HitTest(point))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool HitTest(Rect rect)
		{
			if (base.Visibility == Visibility.Collapsed)
			{
				return false;
			}
			foreach (Groupable child in Children)
			{
				if (child.HitTest(rect))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override void OnMouseLeave(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseLeave(e);
			foreach (Groupable child in Children)
			{
				if (child.IsMouseOver)
				{
					child.OnMouseLeave(e);
				}
			}
		}

		public override void OnMouseMove(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseMove(e);
			Point docMousePosition = View.LastInput.DocMousePosition;
			foreach (Groupable child in Children)
			{
				if (child.HitTest(docMousePosition))
				{
					if (child.IsMouseOver)
					{
						child.OnMouseMove(e);
					}
					else
					{
						child.OnMouseEnter(e);
					}
				}
				else if (child.IsMouseOver)
				{
					child.OnMouseLeave(e);
				}
			}
		}

		public override void OnMouseLeftButtonDown(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseLeftButtonDown(e);
			Point docMousePosition = View.LastInput.DocMousePosition;
			foreach (Groupable child in Children)
			{
				if (child.HitTest(docMousePosition))
				{
					child.OnMouseLeftButtonDown(e);
				}
			}
		}

		public override void OnMouseLeftButtonUp(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseLeftButtonUp(e);
			Point docMousePosition = View.LastInput.DocMousePosition;
			foreach (Groupable child in Children)
			{
				if (child.HitTest(docMousePosition))
				{
					child.OnMouseLeftButtonUp(e);
				}
			}
		}

		public override void OnMouseLeftButtonDoubleClick(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseLeftButtonDoubleClick(e);
			Point docMousePosition = View.LastInput.DocMousePosition;
			for (int i = 0; i < Children.Count; i++)
			{
				InteractiveElement interactiveElement = Children[i];
				if (interactiveElement.HitTest(docMousePosition))
				{
					interactiveElement.OnMouseLeftButtonDoubleClick(e);
				}
			}
		}

		public override void OnKeyDown(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			Point docMousePosition = View.LastInput.DocMousePosition;
			foreach (Groupable child in Children)
			{
				if (child.HitTest(docMousePosition))
				{
					child.OnKeyDown(e);
				}
			}
		}

		public override void OnKeyUp(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			Point docMousePosition = View.LastInput.DocMousePosition;
			foreach (Groupable child in Children)
			{
				if (child.HitTest(docMousePosition))
				{
					child.OnKeyUp(e);
				}
			}
		}

		public override void TransformBounds(Transform transform)
		{
			AddingItem = true;
			Rect newBounds = Groupable.TransformRect(transform, base.Bounds);
			ArrangeChildren(base.Bounds, newBounds);
			base.TransformBounds(transform);
			AddingItem = false;
		}

		public virtual void ArrangeChildren(Rect oldBounds, Rect newBounds)
		{
			Transform groupTransform = Groupable.CalculateTransform(newBounds, oldBounds);
			foreach (Groupable child in Children)
			{
				child.ArrangeInGroup(oldBounds, newBounds, groupTransform);
			}
		}

		protected static Rect CalculateBounds(Groupable[] items)
		{
			Rect result = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
			foreach (VisualElement visualElement in items)
			{
				bool flag = result.X == 0.0 && result.Y == 0.0 && result.Width == 0.0 && result.Height == 0.0;
				if (result.IsEmpty || flag)
				{
					result = visualElement.Bounds;
				}
				else
				{
					result.Union(visualElement.Bounds);
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected void AccumulateBounds(VisualElement item)
		{
			Rect bounds = base.Bounds;
			bool flag = bounds.X == 0.0 && bounds.Y == 0.0 && bounds.Width == 0.0 && bounds.Height == 0.0;
			if (bounds.IsEmpty || flag)
			{
				bounds = item.Bounds;
			}
			else
			{
				bounds.Union(item.Bounds);
			}
			base.Bounds = bounds;
		}
	}
	internal abstract class Groupable : InteractiveElement
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty AutoRescalesProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("AutoRescales", typeof(bool), typeof(Groupable), new PropertyMetadata(true, OnAutoRescalesChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty HorizontalAlignmentProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("HorizontalAlignment", typeof(HorizontalAlignment), typeof(Groupable), new PropertyMetadata(HorizontalAlignment.Left, OnHorizontalAlignmentChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty VerticalAlignmentProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("VerticalAlignment", typeof(VerticalAlignment), typeof(Groupable), new PropertyMetadata(VerticalAlignment.Top, OnVerticalAlignmentChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty MarginProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Margin", typeof(Thickness), typeof(Groupable), new PropertyMetadata(default(Thickness), OnMarginChanged));

		private Group _parent;

		public bool AutoRescales
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(AutoRescalesProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(AutoRescalesProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public HorizontalAlignment HorizontalAlignment
		{
			get
			{
				return (HorizontalAlignment)GetValue(HorizontalAlignmentProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(HorizontalAlignmentProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public VerticalAlignment VerticalAlignment
		{
			get
			{
				return (VerticalAlignment)GetValue(VerticalAlignmentProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(VerticalAlignmentProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public Thickness Margin
		{
			get
			{
				return (Thickness)GetValue(MarginProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(MarginProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public Group Parent
		{
			get
			{
				return _parent;
			}
			internal set
			{
				_parent = value;
			}
		}

		private static void OnAutoRescalesChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((Groupable)d).OnAutoRescalesChanged((bool)e.OldValue, (bool)e.NewValue);
		}

		protected virtual void OnAutoRescalesChanged(bool oldValue, bool newValue)
		{
		}

		private static void OnHorizontalAlignmentChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((Groupable)d).OnHorizontalAlignmentChanged((HorizontalAlignment)e.OldValue, (HorizontalAlignment)e.NewValue);
		}

		protected virtual void OnHorizontalAlignmentChanged(HorizontalAlignment oldValue, HorizontalAlignment newValue)
		{
		}

		private static void OnVerticalAlignmentChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((Groupable)d).OnVerticalAlignmentChanged((VerticalAlignment)e.OldValue, (VerticalAlignment)e.NewValue);
		}

		protected virtual void OnVerticalAlignmentChanged(VerticalAlignment oldValue, VerticalAlignment newValue)
		{
		}

		private static void OnMarginChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((Groupable)d).OnMarginChanged((Thickness)e.OldValue, (Thickness)e.NewValue);
		}

		protected virtual void OnMarginChanged(Thickness oldValue, Thickness newValue)
		{
		}

		public virtual void ArrangeInGroup(Rect oldGroupBounds, Rect newGroupBounds, Transform groupTransform)
		{
			if (AutoRescales)
			{
				TransformBounds(groupTransform);
			}
			else
			{
				ArrangeRelative(oldGroupBounds, newGroupBounds);
			}
		}

		protected static Rect TransformRect(GeneralTransform transform, Rect rect)
		{
			Point point = transform.Transform(new Point(rect.X, rect.Y));
			Point point2 = transform.Transform(new Point(rect.Right, rect.Bottom));
			return new Rect(point, point2);
		}

		protected static TranslateTransform CalculateTranslateTransform(Rect newBounds, Rect oldBounds)
		{
			TranslateTransform translateTransform = new TranslateTransform();
			if (newBounds.IsEmpty || oldBounds.IsEmpty)
			{
				return translateTransform;
			}
			double x = newBounds.X - oldBounds.X;
			double y = newBounds.Y - oldBounds.Y;
			translateTransform.X = x;
			translateTransform.Y = y;
			return translateTransform;
		}

		protected static ScaleTransform CalculateScaleTransform(Rect newBounds, Rect oldBounds)
		{
			ScaleTransform scaleTransform = new ScaleTransform();
			if (oldBounds.Width == 0.0 || oldBounds.Height == 0.0 || newBounds.Width == 0.0 || newBounds.Height == 0.0 || oldBounds.IsEmpty || newBounds.IsEmpty)
			{
				return scaleTransform;
			}
			scaleTransform.CenterX = oldBounds.X;
			scaleTransform.CenterY = oldBounds.Y;
			double scaleX = newBounds.Width / oldBounds.Width;
			double scaleY = newBounds.Height / oldBounds.Height;
			scaleTransform.ScaleX = scaleX;
			scaleTransform.ScaleY = scaleY;
			return scaleTransform;
		}

		protected static TransformGroup CalculateTransform(Rect newBounds, Rect oldBounds)
		{
			TransformGroup transformGroup = new TransformGroup();
			ScaleTransform value = CalculateScaleTransform(newBounds, oldBounds);
			transformGroup.Children.Add(value);
			TranslateTransform value2 = CalculateTranslateTransform(newBounds, oldBounds);
			transformGroup.Children.Add(value2);
			return transformGroup;
		}

		public virtual void TransformBounds(Transform transform)
		{
			base.Bounds = TransformRect(transform, base.Bounds);
		}

		public virtual void ArrangeRelative(Rect oldGroupBounds, Rect newGroupBounds)
		{
			Rect bounds = base.Bounds;
			Thickness margin = Margin;
			switch (HorizontalAlignment)
			{
			case HorizontalAlignment.Left:
				bounds.X = newGroupBounds.X + margin.Left;
				break;
			case HorizontalAlignment.Center:
				bounds.X = newGroupBounds.X + (newGroupBounds.Width - bounds.Width) / 2.0;
				break;
			case HorizontalAlignment.Right:
				bounds.X = newGroupBounds.Right - bounds.Width - margin.Right;
				break;
			case HorizontalAlignment.Stretch:
				bounds.X = newGroupBounds.X + margin.Left;
				bounds.Width = newGroupBounds.Width - margin.Left - margin.Left;
				break;
			}
			switch (VerticalAlignment)
			{
			case VerticalAlignment.Top:
				bounds.Y = newGroupBounds.Y + margin.Top;
				break;
			case VerticalAlignment.Center:
				bounds.Y = newGroupBounds.Y + (newGroupBounds.Height - bounds.Height) / 2.0;
				break;
			case VerticalAlignment.Bottom:
				bounds.Y = newGroupBounds.Bottom - bounds.Height - margin.Bottom;
				break;
			case VerticalAlignment.Stretch:
				bounds.Y = newGroupBounds.Y + margin.Top;
				bounds.Height = newGroupBounds.Height - margin.Top - margin.Bottom;
				break;
			}
			base.Bounds = bounds;
		}
	}

	internal class ShapeElement : Groupable
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty FrameworkElementsProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("FrameworkElements", typeof(ObservableCollection<FrameworkElement>), typeof(ShapeElement), new PropertyMetadata(null, OnFrameworkElementsChanged));

		private FrameworkElement _activeFrameworkElement;

		private bool _isMouseEntered;

		public ObservableCollection<FrameworkElement> FrameworkElements
		{
			get
			{
				return (ObservableCollection<FrameworkElement>)GetValue(FrameworkElementsProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(FrameworkElementsProperty, value);
			}
		}

		internal FrameworkElement ActiveFrameworkElement
		{
			get
			{
				return _activeFrameworkElement;
			}
			set
			{
				_activeFrameworkElement = value;
			}
		}

		private bool IsMouseEntered
		{
			get
			{
				return _isMouseEntered;
			}
			set
			{
				_isMouseEntered = value;
			}
		}

		public ShapeElement()
		{
			FrameworkElements = new ObservableCollection<FrameworkElement>();
		}

		private static void OnFrameworkElementsChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((ShapeElement)d).OnFrameworkElementsChanged((ObservableCollection<FrameworkElement>)e.OldValue, (ObservableCollection<FrameworkElement>)e.NewValue);
		}

		protected virtual void OnFrameworkElementsChanged(ObservableCollection<FrameworkElement> oldValue, ObservableCollection<FrameworkElement> newValue)
		{
			if (oldValue != null)
			{
				oldValue.CollectionChanged -= FrameworkElements_CollectionChanged;
				RemoveFrameworkElementsSettings(oldValue);
			}
			if (newValue != null)
			{
				newValue.CollectionChanged += FrameworkElements_CollectionChanged;
				SetFrameworkElementsSettings(newValue);
			}
		}

		private void FrameworkElements_CollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			NotifyCollectionChangedAction action = e.Action;
			if (action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add || action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace)
			{
				SetFrameworkElementsSettings(e.NewItems);
			}
			action = e.Action;
			if (action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove || action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace)
			{
				RemoveFrameworkElementsSettings(e.OldItems);
			}
		}

		private void SetFrameworkElementsSettings(IList items)
		{
			if (items == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (FrameworkElement item in items)
			{
				item.MouseEnter += FrameworkElement_MouseEnter;
				item.MouseLeave += FrameworkElement_MouseLeave;
				if (View != null && base.Canvas != null)
				{
					base.Canvas.Children.Add(item);
				}
				ChangeFrameworkElementSettings(item);
			}
		}

		private void RemoveFrameworkElementsSettings(IList items)
		{
			if (items == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (FrameworkElement item in items)
			{
				item.MouseEnter -= FrameworkElement_MouseEnter;
				item.MouseLeave -= FrameworkElement_MouseLeave;
				if (View != null && base.Canvas != null)
				{
					base.Canvas.Children.Remove(item);
				}
			}
		}

		private void FrameworkElement_MouseEnter(object sender, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!base.IsMouseCaptured)
			{
				ActiveFrameworkElement = sender as FrameworkElement;
			}
			IsMouseEntered = true;
		}

		private void FrameworkElement_MouseLeave(object sender, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!base.IsMouseCaptured)
			{
				ActiveFrameworkElement = null;
			}
			IsMouseEntered = false;
		}

		protected override void OnBoundsChanged(Rect oldValue, Rect newValue)
		{
			base.OnBoundsChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			SetFrameworkElementsBounds();
		}

		protected override void OnVisibilityChanged(Visibility oldValue, Visibility newValue)
		{
			base.OnVisibilityChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			foreach (FrameworkElement frameworkElement in FrameworkElements)
			{
				frameworkElement.Visibility = newValue;
			}
			if (newValue == Visibility.Collapsed)
			{
				IsMouseEntered = false;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnZIndexChanged(int oldValue, int newValue)
		{
			base.OnZIndexChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			foreach (FrameworkElement frameworkElement in FrameworkElements)
			{
				Panel.SetZIndex(frameworkElement, newValue);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnCursorChanged(Cursor oldValue, Cursor newValue)
		{
			base.OnCursorChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			foreach (FrameworkElement frameworkElement in FrameworkElements)
			{
				frameworkElement.Cursor = newValue;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnFillChanged(Brush oldValue, Brush newValue)
		{
			base.OnFillChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			foreach (FrameworkElement frameworkElement in FrameworkElements)
			{
				if (frameworkElement is Shape shape)
				{
					shape.Fill = newValue;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnStrokeChanged(Brush oldValue, Brush newValue)
		{
			base.OnStrokeChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			foreach (FrameworkElement frameworkElement in FrameworkElements)
			{
				if (frameworkElement is Shape shape)
				{
					shape.Stroke = newValue;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnStrokeThicknessChanged(double oldValue, double newValue)
		{
			base.OnStrokeThicknessChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			foreach (FrameworkElement frameworkElement in FrameworkElements)
			{
				if (frameworkElement is Shape shape)
				{
					shape.StrokeThickness = newValue;
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Render()
		{
			if (View == null || base.Canvas == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (FrameworkElement frameworkElement in FrameworkElements)
			{
				if (!base.Canvas.Children.Contains(frameworkElement))
				{
					base.Canvas.Children.Add(frameworkElement);
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Remove()
		{
			foreach (FrameworkElement frameworkElement in FrameworkElements)
			{
				base.Canvas.Children.Remove(frameworkElement);
			}
		}

		public override bool HitTest(Point point)
		{
			return IsMouseEntered;
		}

		public override void OnMouseLeftButtonDown(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseLeftButtonDown(e);
			if (ActiveFrameworkElement.Visibility == Visibility.Visible)
			{
				ActiveFrameworkElement.CaptureMouse();
				View.CapturedElement = this;
			}
		}

		public override void OnMouseLeftButtonUp(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseLeftButtonUp(e);
			if (ActiveFrameworkElement.Visibility == Visibility.Visible)
			{
				View.IsManuallyReleasingMouseCapture = true;
				ActiveFrameworkElement.ReleaseMouseCapture();
			}
			View.CapturedElement = null;
		}

		protected virtual void ChangeFrameworkElementSettings(FrameworkElement frameworkElement)
		{
			base.Initializing = true;
			base.Bounds = GetBounds(frameworkElement);
			SetFrameworkElementBounds(frameworkElement);
			base.Initializing = false;
		}

		private void SetFrameworkElementsBounds()
		{
			foreach (FrameworkElement frameworkElement in FrameworkElements)
			{
				SetFrameworkElementBounds(frameworkElement);
			}
		}

		private void SetFrameworkElementBounds(FrameworkElement frameworkElement)
		{
			Thickness margin = frameworkElement.Margin;
			double num = margin.Left + margin.Right;
			double num2 = margin.Top + margin.Bottom;
			double num3 = base.Bounds.Width - num;
			double num4 = base.Bounds.Height - num2;
			if (num3 < 0.0)
			{
				num3 = 0.0;
			}
			if (num4 < 0.0)
			{
				num4 = 0.0;
			}
			frameworkElement.Width = Math.Round(num3);
			frameworkElement.Height = Math.Round(num4);
			Canvas.SetLeft(frameworkElement, Math.Round(base.Bounds.X));
			Canvas.SetTop(frameworkElement, Math.Round(base.Bounds.Y));
		}

		private Rect GetBounds(FrameworkElement frameworkElement)
		{
			Rect bounds = base.Bounds;
			if (ReadLocalValue(VisualElement.XProperty) == DependencyProperty.UnsetValue)
			{
				double left = Canvas.GetLeft(frameworkElement);
				if (!double.IsNaN(left))
				{
					bounds.X = left;
				}
			}
			if (ReadLocalValue(VisualElement.YProperty) == DependencyProperty.UnsetValue)
			{
				double top = Canvas.GetTop(frameworkElement);
				if (!double.IsNaN(top))
				{
					bounds.Y = top;
				}
			}
			if (ReadLocalValue(VisualElement.WidthProperty) == DependencyProperty.UnsetValue)
			{
				double width = frameworkElement.Width;
				if (!double.IsNaN(width))
				{
					bounds.Width = width;
				}
			}
			if (ReadLocalValue(VisualElement.HeightProperty) == DependencyProperty.UnsetValue)
			{
				double height = frameworkElement.Height;
				if (!double.IsNaN(height))
				{
					bounds.Height = height;
				}
			}
			return bounds;
		}
	}

		public static readonly DependencyProperty StrokeDashArrayProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("StrokeDashArray", typeof(DoubleCollection), typeof(VisualElement), new PropertyMetadata(null, OnStrokeDashArrayChanged));
