		private static void OnBoundsChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((VisualElement)d).OnBoundsChanged((Rect)e.OldValue, (Rect)e.NewValue);
		}

		protected virtual void OnBoundsChanged(Rect oldValue, Rect newValue)
		{
			ChangingBounds = true;
			if (X != newValue.X)
			{
				X = newValue.X;
			}
			if (Y != newValue.Y)
			{
				Y = newValue.Y;
			}
			if (Width != newValue.Width)
			{
				Width = newValue.Width;
			}
			if (Height != newValue.Height)
			{
				Height = newValue.Height;
			}
			ChangingBounds = false;
		}

		private static void OnZIndexChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((VisualElement)d).OnZIndexChanged((int)e.OldValue, (int)e.NewValue);
		}

		protected virtual void OnZIndexChanged(int oldValue, int newValue)
		{
		}

		private static void OnVisibilityChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((VisualElement)d).OnVisibilityChanged((Visibility)e.OldValue, (Visibility)e.NewValue);
		}

		protected virtual void OnVisibilityChanged(Visibility oldValue, Visibility newValue)
		{
		}

		private static void OnXChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((VisualElement)d).OnXChanged((double)e.OldValue, (double)e.NewValue);
		}

		protected virtual void OnXChanged(double oldValue, double newValue)
		{
			if (!ChangingBounds)
			{
				Bounds = new Rect(newValue, Bounds.Y, Bounds.Width, Bounds.Height);
			}
		}

		private static void OnYChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((VisualElement)d).OnYChanged((double)e.OldValue, (double)e.NewValue);
		}

		protected virtual void OnYChanged(double oldValue, double newValue)
		{
			if (!ChangingBounds)
			{
				Bounds = new Rect(Bounds.X, newValue, Bounds.Width, Bounds.Height);
			}
		}

		private static void OnWidthChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((VisualElement)d).OnWidthChanged((double)e.OldValue, (double)e.NewValue);
		}

		protected virtual void OnWidthChanged(double oldValue, double newValue)
		{
			if (!ChangingBounds)
			{
				Bounds = new Rect(Bounds.X, Bounds.Y, newValue, Bounds.Height);
			}
		}

		private static void OnHeightChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((VisualElement)d).OnHeightChanged((double)e.OldValue, (double)e.NewValue);
		}

		protected virtual void OnHeightChanged(double oldValue, double newValue)
		{
			if (!ChangingBounds)
			{
				Bounds = new Rect(Bounds.X, Bounds.Y, Bounds.Width, newValue);
			}
		}

		private static void OnFillChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((VisualElement)d).OnFillChanged((Brush)e.OldValue, (Brush)e.NewValue);
		}

		protected virtual void OnFillChanged(Brush oldValue, Brush newValue)
		{
		}

		private static void OnStrokeChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((VisualElement)d).OnStrokeChanged((Brush)e.OldValue, (Brush)e.NewValue);
		}

		protected virtual void OnStrokeChanged(Brush oldValue, Brush newValue)
		{
		}

		private static void OnStrokeThicknessChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((VisualElement)d).OnStrokeThicknessChanged((double)e.OldValue, (double)e.NewValue);
		}

		protected virtual void OnStrokeThicknessChanged(double oldValue, double newValue)
		{
		}

		private static void OnStrokeDashArrayChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((VisualElement)d).OnStrokeDashArrayChanged((DoubleCollection)e.OldValue, (DoubleCollection)e.NewValue);
		}

		private void OnStrokeDashArrayChanged(DoubleCollection oldValue, DoubleCollection newValue)
		{
		}

		internal virtual void SetView(InteractiveControl view)
		{
			View = view;
		}

		public virtual bool HitTest(Point point)
		{
			return Bounds.Contains(point);
		}

		public virtual bool HitTest(Rect rect)
		{
			if (rect.X <= Bounds.X && rect.Y <= Bounds.Y && rect.Right >= Bounds.Right && rect.Bottom >= Bounds.Bottom)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public abstract void Render();

		public abstract void Remove();
	}
	public class InputContext
	{
		private Point _viewMousePosition;

		private Point _docMousePosition;

		private Key _key;

		public Point ViewMousePosition
		{
			get
			{
				return _viewMousePosition;
			}
			set
			{
				_viewMousePosition = value;
			}
		}

		public Point DocMousePosition
		{
			get
			{
				return _docMousePosition;
			}
			set
			{
				_docMousePosition = value;
			}
		}

		public Key Key
		{
			get
			{
				return _key;
			}
			set
			{
				_key = value;
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class InteractiveControl : Control
	{
		private const int DoubleClickInterval = 300;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty LastInputProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("LastInput", typeof(InputContext), typeof(InteractiveControl), new PropertyMetadata(null));

		private ITool _defaultTool;

		private Canvas _canvas;

		private ITool _currentTool;

		private Collection<ITool> _mouseDownTools;

		private Collection<ITool> _mouseMoveTools;

		private ShapeElement _capturedElement;

		private Point _clickPoint;

		private DispatcherTimer _doubleClickTimer;

		private ObservableCollection<VisualElement> _visualElements;

		public InputContext LastInput
		{
			get
			{
				return (InputContext)GetValue(LastInputProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(LastInputProperty, value);
			}
		}

		internal List<ResizePoint> ResizePoints { get; set; }

		private ITool DefaultTool
		{
			get
			{
				return _defaultTool;
			}
			set
			{
				_defaultTool = value;
			}
		}

		public virtual Canvas Canvas
		{
			get
			{
				return _canvas;
			}
			protected set
			{
				_canvas = value;
			}
		}

		public ITool CurrentTool
		{
			get
			{
				return _currentTool;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_currentTool != value)
				{
					if (_currentTool != null)
					{
						_currentTool.Stop();
					}
					if (value == null)
					{
						_currentTool = DefaultTool;
					}
					else
					{
						_currentTool = value;
					}
					if (_currentTool != null)
					{
						_currentTool.Start();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public Collection<ITool> MouseDownTools
		{
			get
			{
				return _mouseDownTools;
			}
			private set
			{
				_mouseDownTools = value;
			}
		}

		public Collection<ITool> MouseMoveTools
		{
			get
			{
				return _mouseMoveTools;
			}
			private set
			{
				_mouseMoveTools = value;
			}
		}

		internal ShapeElement CapturedElement
		{
			get
			{
				return _capturedElement;
			}
			set
			{
				_capturedElement = value;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsManuallyReleasingMouseCapture { get; set; }

		private Point ClickPoint
		{
			get
			{
				return _clickPoint;
			}
			set
			{
				_clickPoint = value;
			}
		}

		private DispatcherTimer DoubleClickTimer
		{
			get
			{
				return _doubleClickTimer;
			}
			set
			{
				_doubleClickTimer = value;
			}
		}

		internal ObservableCollection<VisualElement> VisualElements
		{
			get
			{
				return _visualElements;
			}
			private set
			{
				_visualElements = value;
			}
		}

		internal Collection<InteractiveElement> InteractiveElements
		{
			get
			{
				Collection<InteractiveElement> collection = new Collection<InteractiveElement>();
				foreach (VisualElement visualElement in VisualElements)
				{
					if (visualElement is InteractiveElement item)
					{
						collection.Add(item);
					}
				}
				return collection;
			}
		}

		protected InteractiveControl()
		{
			base.DefaultStyleKey = typeof(InteractiveControl);
			VisualElements = new ObservableCollection<VisualElement>();
			VisualElements.CollectionChanged += VisualElements_CollectionChanged;
			LastInput = new InputContext();
			MouseDownTools = new Collection<ITool>();
			MouseMoveTools = new Collection<ITool>();
			DefaultTool = new DefaultTool(this);
			CurrentTool = DefaultTool;
			DoubleClickTimer = new DispatcherTimer();
			DoubleClickTimer.Interval = new TimeSpan(0, 0, 0, 0, 300);
			DoubleClickTimer.Tick += DoubleClickTimer_Tick;
			ResizePoints = new List<ResizePoint>();
		}

		internal virtual InteractiveElement HitTest(Point point)
		{
			Collection<InteractiveElement> interactiveElements = InteractiveElements;
			for (int num = interactiveElements.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				InteractiveElement interactiveElement = interactiveElements[num];
				if (interactiveElement.HitTest(point))
				{
					return interactiveElement;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal void ReleaseMouseCaptures()
		{
			if (CapturedElement != null && CapturedElement.ActiveFrameworkElement != null)
			{
				IsManuallyReleasingMouseCapture = true;
				CapturedElement.ActiveFrameworkElement.ReleaseMouseCapture();
			}
		}

		private bool IsCanvasValid()
		{
			if (Canvas == null || Canvas.ActualHeight == 0.0 || Canvas.ActualWidth == 0.0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override void OnMouseMove(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseMove(e);
			if (!IsCanvasValid())
			{
				return;
			}
			LastInput.ViewMousePosition = e.GetPosition(null);
			Point position = e.GetPosition(Canvas);
			LastInput.DocMousePosition = position;
			foreach (InteractiveElement item in (IEnumerable<InteractiveElement>)InteractiveElements)
			{
				if (item.HitTest(position))
				{
					if (item.IsMouseOver)
					{
						item.OnMouseMove(e);
					}
					else
					{
						item.OnMouseEnter(e);
					}
				}
				else if (item.IsMouseOver)
				{
					item.OnMouseLeave(e);
				}
			}
			CurrentTool.MouseMove();
		}

		protected override void OnMouseEnter(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseEnter(e);
			LastInput.ViewMousePosition = e.GetPosition(null);
			LastInput.DocMousePosition = e.GetPosition(Canvas);
			if (IsCanvasValid())
			{
				CurrentTool.Start();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeave(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseLeave(e);
			foreach (InteractiveElement item in (IEnumerable<InteractiveElement>)InteractiveElements)
			{
				if (item.IsMouseOver)
				{
					item.OnMouseLeave(e);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnLostMouseCapture(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnLostMouseCapture(e);
			if (IsManuallyReleasingMouseCapture)
			{
				IsManuallyReleasingMouseCapture = false;
				return;
			}
			foreach (InteractiveElement item in (IEnumerable<InteractiveElement>)InteractiveElements)
			{
				if (item.IsMouseOver)
				{
					item.OnMouseLeave(e);
				}
			}
			CurrentTool = null;
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeftButtonDown(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseLeftButtonDown(e);
			if (!IsCanvasValid())
			{
				return;
			}
			LastInput.ViewMousePosition = e.GetPosition(null);
			LastInput.DocMousePosition = e.GetPosition(Canvas);
			Collection<InteractiveElement> interactiveElements = InteractiveElements;
			Point docMousePosition = LastInput.DocMousePosition;
			foreach (InteractiveElement item in (IEnumerable<InteractiveElement>)interactiveElements)
			{
				if (item.HitTest(docMousePosition))
				{
					item.OnMouseLeftButtonDown(e);
				}
			}
			CurrentTool = null;
			CurrentTool.MouseLeftButtonDown(e);
			CheckMouseDoubleClick(e);
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeftButtonUp(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseLeftButtonUp(e);
			if (!IsCanvasValid())
			{
				return;
			}
			LastInput.ViewMousePosition = e.GetPosition(null);
			LastInput.DocMousePosition = e.GetPosition(Canvas);
			foreach (InteractiveElement item in (IEnumerable<InteractiveElement>)InteractiveElements)
			{
				if (item.IsMouseCaptured)
				{
					item.OnMouseLeftButtonUp(e);
				}
			}
			CurrentTool.MouseLeftButtonUp(e);
		}

		protected virtual void OnMouseLeftButtonDoubleClick(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			foreach (InteractiveElement item in (IEnumerable<InteractiveElement>)InteractiveElements)
			{
				if (item.IsMouseCaptured)
				{
					item.OnMouseLeftButtonDoubleClick(e);
				}
			}
			CurrentTool.OnMouseLeftButtonDoubleClick();
		}

		protected override void OnKeyDown(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnKeyDown(e);
			LastInput.Key = e.Key;
			Collection<InteractiveElement> interactiveElements = InteractiveElements;
			Point docMousePosition = LastInput.DocMousePosition;
			foreach (InteractiveElement item in (IEnumerable<InteractiveElement>)interactiveElements)
			{
				if (item.HitTest(docMousePosition))
				{
					item.OnKeyDown(e);
				}
			}
			CurrentTool.KeyDown();
		}

		protected override void OnKeyUp(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnKeyUp(e);
			LastInput.Key = e.Key;
			Collection<InteractiveElement> interactiveElements = InteractiveElements;
			Point docMousePosition = LastInput.DocMousePosition;
			foreach (InteractiveElement item in (IEnumerable<InteractiveElement>)interactiveElements)
			{
				if (item.HitTest(docMousePosition))
				{
					item.OnKeyUp(e);
				}
			}
			CurrentTool.KeyUp();
		}

		private void VisualElements_CollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			switch (e.Action)
			{
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add:
			{
				foreach (VisualElement newItem in e.NewItems)
				{
					newItem.SetView(this);
					newItem.Render();
				}
				break;
			}
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove:
			{
				foreach (VisualElement oldItem in e.OldItems)
				{
					oldItem.Remove();
				}
				break;
			}
			}
		}

		private void CheckMouseDoubleClick(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			Point docMousePosition = LastInput.DocMousePosition;
			if (DoubleClickTimer.IsEnabled && !IsMouseMoved(ClickPoint, docMousePosition))
			{
				DoubleClickTimer.Stop();
				OnMouseLeftButtonDoubleClick(e);
			}
			else
			{
				DoubleClickTimer.Start();
				ClickPoint = docMousePosition;
			}
		}

		private static bool IsMouseMoved(Point pt1, Point pt2)
		{
			if (!(Math.Abs(pt1.X - pt2.X) > 3.0))
			{
				return Math.Abs(pt1.Y - pt2.Y) > 3.0;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void DoubleClickTimer_Tick(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			DoubleClickTimer.Stop();
		}
	}
	public class DefaultTool : Tool
	{
		public DefaultTool(InteractiveControl view)
			: base(view)
		{
		}

		public override void MouseLeftButtonDown(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			foreach (ITool mouseDownTool in base.View.MouseDownTools)
			{
				if (mouseDownTool != null && mouseDownTool.CanStart(e))
				{
					base.View.CurrentTool = mouseDownTool;
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public override void MouseMove()
		{
			foreach (ITool mouseMoveTool in base.View.MouseMoveTools)
			{
				if (mouseMoveTool != null && mouseMoveTool.CanStart())
				{
					base.View.CurrentTool = mouseMoveTool;
					break;
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public interface ITool

		bool CanStart(MouseButtonEventArgs e);

		void Start();

		void KeyDown();

		void KeyUp();

		void MouseMove();

		void MouseLeftButtonDown(MouseButtonEventArgs e);

		void Stop();
	}

		protected Tool(InteractiveControl view)

			View = view;
		}

		public virtual bool CanStart()
		{
			return false;
		}

		public virtual bool CanStart(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			return false;
		}

		{
		}

		public virtual void KeyDown()

		}

		}

		}

		}

		public void StopTool()
		{
			if (View.CurrentTool == this && View.ResizePoints.Count == 0)

				View.ReleaseMouseCaptures();
				View.CurrentTool = null;
			}
		}
	}
	public static class CultureInfoHelper
	{
		public static CultureInfo CultureToUse
		{
			get
			{
				if (CultureInfo.CurrentCulture == null || CultureInfo.CurrentCulture.IsNeutralCulture)
				{
					return CultureInfo.InvariantCulture;
				}
				return CultureInfo.CurrentCulture;
			}
		}

	public enum SurfaceGridDataInterpolation
	{
		AverageLocalNeighbors,
		MaxClosestNeighbors,
		InverseDistanceWeight
	}
	internal class DataInterpolator
	{
		public SurfaceGrid Grid { get; private set; }

		public SurfaceGridDataInterpolation Interpolation => Grid.DataInterpolation;

		public DataInterpolator(SurfaceGrid grid)
		{
			Grid = grid;
		}

		internal void Update(IList<GridPoint> gridPoints)
		{
			foreach (GridPoint gridPoint in gridPoints)
			{
				Update(gridPoint);
			}
		}

		internal void Update(GridPoint point)
		{
			List<XYZ> neighbors = Grid.GetNeighbors(point);
			double num = double.MinValue;
			if (Interpolation == SurfaceGridDataInterpolation.MaxClosestNeighbors)
			{
				List<GridDistance> list = new List<GridDistance>();
				double distanceMin = double.MaxValue;
				foreach (XYZ item in neighbors)
				{
					GridDistance distance = Grid.GetDistance(point, item);
					list.Add(distance);
					distanceMin = Math.Min(distanceMin, distance.Length);
				}
				foreach (GridDistance item2 in list.Where((GridDistance d) => Grid.IsEqual(d.Length, distanceMin)).ToList())
				{
					num = Math.Max(num, item2.DataPoint.Z);
				}
			}
			else if (Interpolation == SurfaceGridDataInterpolation.InverseDistanceWeight)
			{
				double num2 = 0.0;
				foreach (XYZ item3 in neighbors)
				{
					GridWeight weight = Grid.GetWeight(point, item3);
					num2 += weight.Value * item3.Z;
				}
				num = num2 / (double)neighbors.Count;
			}
			else if (Interpolation == SurfaceGridDataInterpolation.AverageLocalNeighbors)
			{
				if (neighbors.Count == 0)
				{
					num = 0.0;
				}
				else
				{
					double num3 = 0.0;
					foreach (XYZ item4 in neighbors)
					{
						num3 += item4.Z;
					}
					num = num3 / (double)neighbors.Count;
				}
			}
			point.Z = num;
		}
	}
	internal enum DataSplitMode
	{
		FullSplit,
		EvenSplit,
		NoSplit
	}
	public enum SurfaceGridDistanceMeasure
	{
		CityBlock,
		Pythagorean
	}
	internal class GridDistance
	{
		internal XYZ GridPoint { get; set; }

		internal XYZ DataPoint { get; set; }

		public double Length => Calculate();

		public SurfaceGridDistanceMeasure Measure { get; set; }

		public GridDistance()
			: this(SurfaceGridDistanceMeasure.CityBlock)
		{
		}

		public GridDistance(SurfaceGridDistanceMeasure measure)
		{
			Measure = measure;
		}

		protected double Calculate()
		{
			double result = double.NaN;
			if (GridPoint == null || DataPoint == null)
			{
				return result;
			}
			double num = Math.Abs(GridPoint.X - DataPoint.X);
			double num2 = Math.Abs(GridPoint.Y - DataPoint.Y);
			if (Measure == SurfaceGridDistanceMeasure.CityBlock)
			{
				result = num + num2;
			}
			else if (Measure == SurfaceGridDistanceMeasure.Pythagorean)
			{
				result = Math.Sqrt(num * num + num2 * num2);
			}
			return result;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return Length.ToString("N4") + " distance to data " + DataPoint;
		}
	}
	internal class GridLocation
	{
		public double X { get; internal set; }

		public double Y { get; internal set; }

		public int Row { get; internal set; }

		public int Col { get; internal set; }

		public List<GridLocation> Split { get; protected set; }

		public GridLocation()
		{
			Split = new List<GridLocation>();
		}

		public GridLocation(int row, int col)
		{
			Split = new List<GridLocation>();
			Row = row;
			Col = col;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return $"C {Col:##0}, R {Row:##0}";
		}

		public GridLocation Left()
		{
			return new GridLocation(Row, Col - 1);
		}

		public GridLocation Right()
		{
			return new GridLocation(Row, Col + 1);
		}

		public GridLocation Above()
		{
			return new GridLocation(Row + 1, Col);
		}

		public GridLocation Below()
		{
			return new GridLocation(Row - 1, Col);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return Col.GetHashCode() ^ Row.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!(obj is GridLocation gridLocation))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Row == gridLocation.Row)
			{
				return Col == gridLocation.Col;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool Equals(GridLocation cell)
		{
			if (cell == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Row == cell.Row)
			{
				return Col == cell.Col;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	internal class GridPoint : XYZ
	{
		public GridLocation Location { get; private set; }

		public List<XYZ> Neighbors { get; private set; }

		public GridPoint(GridLocation location, double sizeX, double sizeY)
			: base(location.X, location.Y, double.NaN)
		{
			Neighbors = new List<XYZ>();
			Location = location;
		}
	}
	internal class GridDictionary : Dictionary<GridLocation, GridPoint>
	{
		public bool Contains(GridLocation location)
		{
			return ContainsKey(location);
		}

		public bool Contains(int row, int col)
		{
			GridLocation gridLocation = new GridLocation();
			gridLocation.Row = row;
			gridLocation.Col = col;
			return Contains(gridLocation);
		}
	}
	internal class GridWeight
	{
		public GridDistance Distance { get; set; }

		public double Value { get; set; }

		public GridWeight(double value, GridDistance distance)
		{
			Distance = distance;
			Value = value;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return Value.ToString("N4") + " weight, " + Distance;
		}
	}
	public class RectangularSurfaceGridDataSampler : SurfaceGridDataSamplerBase
	{
		private const string MaximumPointsXPropertyName = "MaximumPointsX";

		private int _MaximumPointsX = 100;

		private const string MaximumPointsYPropertyName = "MaximumPointsY";

		private int _MaximumPointsY = 100;

		public int MaximumPointsX
		{
			get
			{
				return _MaximumPointsX;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != MaximumPointsX)
				{
					int maximumPointsX = MaximumPointsX;
					_MaximumPointsX = value;
					OnPropertyUpdated(new PropertyChangedEventArgs<int>("MaximumPointsX", maximumPointsX, MaximumPointsX));
				}
			}
		}

		public int MaximumPointsY
		{
			get
			{
				return _MaximumPointsY;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != MaximumPointsY)
				{
					int maximumPointsY = MaximumPointsY;
					_MaximumPointsY = value;
					OnPropertyUpdated(new PropertyChangedEventArgs<int>("MaximumPointsY", maximumPointsY, MaximumPointsY));
				}
			}
		}

		public RectangularSurfaceGridDataSampler()
		{
			base.SurfaceGrid.MaximumPointsX = MaximumPointsX;
			base.SurfaceGrid.MaximumPointsY = MaximumPointsY;
		}

		protected override void OnPropertyUpdated(PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnPropertyUpdated(e);
			string propertyName = e.PropertyName;
			if (!(propertyName == "MaximumPointsX"))
			{
				if (propertyName == "MaximumPointsY")
				{
					base.SurfaceGrid.MaximumPointsY = MaximumPointsY;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				base.SurfaceGrid.MaximumPointsX = MaximumPointsX;
			}
		}
	}
	internal class SurfaceGrid : IEnumerable<GridPoint>, IEnumerable, INotifyCollectionChanged
	{
		protected const double SpaceTolerance = 0.0001;

		protected const int MinimumPointsInSpace = 2;

		protected const int MinimumPointsTotal = 4;

		private int _maximumPointsX = -1;

		private int _maximumPointsY = -1;

		private double _intervalX = double.NaN;

		private double _intervalY = double.NaN;

		private IFastItemColumn<double> _XColumn;

		private IFastItemColumn<double> _YColumn;

		private IFastItemColumn<double> _ZColumn;

		private FastItemsSource _FastItemsSource;

		private DataInterpolator _dataInterpolator;

		private SurfaceGridDataInterpolation _dataInterpolation;

		private DataSplitMode _dataSplitMode;

		private SurfaceGridDistanceMeasure _distanceMeasure;

		public int MaximumPointsX
		{
			get
			{
				return _maximumPointsX;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != _maximumPointsX && value >= 2)
				{
					_maximumPointsX = value;
					UpdateIntervals();
					OnPropertyChanged("MaximumPointsX");
				}
			}
		}

		public int MaximumPointsY
		{
			get
			{
				return _maximumPointsY;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != _maximumPointsY && value >= 2)
				{
					_maximumPointsY = value;
					UpdateIntervals();
					OnPropertyChanged("MaximumPointsY");
				}
			}
		}

		public double GridIntervalX
		{
			get
			{
				return _intervalX;
			}
			private set
			{
				if (!IsEqual(value, _intervalX))
				{
					_intervalX = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("GridIntervalX");
				}
			}
		}

		public double GridIntervalY
		{
			get
			{
				return _intervalY;
			}
			private set
			{
				if (!IsEqual(value, _intervalY))
				{
					_intervalY = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("GridIntervalY");
				}
			}
		}

		public double DistanceMax { get; private set; }

		public IFastItemColumn<double> XColumn
		{
			get
			{
				return _XColumn;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != XColumn)
				{
					_XColumn = value;
					UpdateIntervals();
					DispatcherUtil.QueueSingleInvoke(GenerateGrid);
				}
			}
		}

		public IFastItemColumn<double> YColumn
		{
			get
			{
				return _YColumn;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != YColumn)
				{
					_YColumn = value;
					UpdateIntervals();
					DispatcherUtil.QueueSingleInvoke(GenerateGrid);
				}
			}
		}

		public IFastItemColumn<double> ZColumn
		{
			get
			{
				return _ZColumn;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != ZColumn)
				{
					_ZColumn = value;
					UpdateIntervals();
					DispatcherUtil.QueueSingleInvoke(GenerateGrid);
				}
			}
		}

		public FastItemsSource FastItemsSource
		{
			get
			{
				return _FastItemsSource;
			}
			set
			{
				if (FastItemsSource != value)
				{
					FastItemsSource fastItemsSource = FastItemsSource;
					if (fastItemsSource != null)
					{
						fastItemsSource.Event -= OnDataSourceChanged;
					}
					_FastItemsSource = value;
					if (FastItemsSource != null)
					{
						FastItemsSource.Event += OnDataSourceChanged;
					}
				}
				_FastItemsSource = value;
			}
		}

		internal GridDictionary GridCells { get; set; }

		internal List<GridPoint> GridPoints => GridCells.Values.ToList();

		internal DataInterpolator DataInterpolator
		{
			get
			{
				return _dataInterpolator;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_dataInterpolator != value)
				{
					_dataInterpolator = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("DataInterpolator");
				}
			}
		}

		public SurfaceGridDataInterpolation DataInterpolation
		{
			get
			{
				return _dataInterpolation;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_dataInterpolation != value)
				{
					_dataInterpolation = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("DataInterpolation");
				}
			}
		}

		public DataSplitMode DataSplitMode
		{
			get
			{
				return _dataSplitMode;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_dataSplitMode != value)
				{
					_dataSplitMode = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("DataSplitMode");
				}
			}
		}

		public SurfaceGridDistanceMeasure DistanceMeasure
		{
			get
			{
				return _distanceMeasure;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_distanceMeasure != value)
				{
					_distanceMeasure = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("DistanceMeasure");
				}
			}
		}

		public event NotifyCollectionChangedEventHandler CollectionChanged;

		public SurfaceGrid()
		{
			GridCells = new GridDictionary();
			MaximumPointsX = 2;
			MaximumPointsY = 2;
			DataInterpolation = SurfaceGridDataInterpolation.MaxClosestNeighbors;
			DistanceMeasure = SurfaceGridDistanceMeasure.Pythagorean;
			DataSplitMode = DataSplitMode.FullSplit;
			DataInterpolator = new DataInterpolator(this);
		}

		private void NotifyCollectionChanged()
		{
			if (this.CollectionChanged != null)
			{
				this.CollectionChanged(this, new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset));
			}
		}

		private double ColumnRange(IFastItemColumn<double> column)
		{
			return column.Maximum - column.Minimum;
		}

		protected void UpdateIntervals()
		{
			if (XColumn != null && YColumn != null)
			{
				GridIntervalX = ColumnRange(XColumn) / (double)(MaximumPointsX - 1);
				GridIntervalY = ColumnRange(YColumn) / (double)(MaximumPointsY - 1);
				GridDistance distance = GetDistance(new XYZ(0.0, 0.0, double.NaN), new XYZ(GridIntervalX, GridIntervalY, double.NaN));
				DistanceMax = distance.Length;
			}
		}

		public bool IsReady()
		{
			if (FastItemsSource != null && FastItemsSource.Count != 0 && XColumn != null && YColumn != null && ZColumn != null && DataInterpolator != null && MaximumPointsX >= 2 && MaximumPointsY >= 2 && GridIntervalX >= 0.0001)
			{
				return GridIntervalY >= 0.0001;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool IsEqual(double value1, double value2)
		{
			return Math.Abs(value1 - value2) < 0.0001;
		}

		protected void GenerateGrid()
		{
			if (!IsReady())
			{
				return;
			}
			UpdateIntervals();
			GridCells.Clear();
			double minimum = XColumn.Minimum;
			double minimum2 = YColumn.Minimum;
			double maximum = XColumn.Maximum;
			double maximum2 = YColumn.Maximum;
			double gridIntervalX = GridIntervalX;
			double gridIntervalY = GridIntervalY;
			for (double num = minimum; num < maximum + gridIntervalX; num += gridIntervalX)
			{
				for (double num2 = minimum2; num2 < maximum2 + gridIntervalY; num2 += gridIntervalY)
				{
					double num3 = num;
					double num4 = num2;
					if (num3 > maximum)
					{
						num3 = maximum;
					}
					if (num4 > maximum2)
					{
						num4 = maximum2;
					}
					GridLocation location = GetLocation(num3, num4);
					if (!GridCells.Contains(location))
					{
						GridPoint value = new GridPoint(location, gridIntervalX, gridIntervalY);
						GridCells.Add(location, value);
					}
				}
			}
			DistributeData();
			UpdateGrid();
		}

		internal void Add(GridLocation location, XYZ dataPoint)
		{
			if (GridCells.Contains(location))
			{
				GridCells[location].Neighbors.Add(dataPoint);
			}
		}

		public GridLocation GetLocation(double dataX, double dataY)
		{
			double num = (dataX - XColumn.Minimum) / GridIntervalX;
			double num2 = (dataY - YColumn.Minimum) / GridIntervalY;
			double num3 = Math.Round(num, 0, MidpointRounding.ToEven);
			double num4 = Math.Round(num2, 0, MidpointRounding.ToEven);
			GridLocation gridLocation = new GridLocation
			{
				Col = (int)num3,
				Row = (int)num4,
				X = dataX,
				Y = dataY
			};
			bool flag = num % 1.0 == 0.5;
			bool flag2 = num2 % 1.0 == 0.5;
			bool flag3 = (double)gridLocation.Row * GridIntervalY > dataY;
			bool flag4 = (double)gridLocation.Col * GridIntervalX < dataX;
			if (flag2 && flag)
			{
				gridLocation.Split.Add(gridLocation);
				gridLocation.Split.Add(flag3 ? gridLocation.Below() : gridLocation.Above());
				gridLocation.Split.Add(flag4 ? gridLocation.Right() : gridLocation.Left());
				GridLocation gridLocation2 = (flag3 ? gridLocation.Below() : gridLocation.Above());
				gridLocation2 = (flag4 ? gridLocation2.Right() : gridLocation2.Left());
				gridLocation.Split.Add(gridLocation2);
			}
			else if (flag2)
			{
				gridLocation.Split.Add(gridLocation);
				gridLocation.Split.Add(flag3 ? gridLocation.Below() : gridLocation.Above());
			}
			else if (flag)
			{
				gridLocation.Split.Add(gridLocation);
				gridLocation.Split.Add(flag4 ? gridLocation.Right() : gridLocation.Left());
			}
			return gridLocation;
		}

		public GridDistance GetDistance(XYZ gridPoint, XYZ dataPoint)
		{
			return new GridDistance(DistanceMeasure)
			{
				GridPoint = gridPoint,
				DataPoint = dataPoint
			};
		}

		public GridWeight GetWeight(XYZ gridPoint, XYZ dataPoint)
		{
			GridDistance distance = GetDistance(gridPoint, dataPoint);
			double val = 1.0 / (distance.Length / DistanceMax);
			val = Math.Min(val, 1.0);
			if (double.IsNaN(val) || double.IsInfinity(val))
			{
				val = 1.0;
			}
			return new GridWeight(val, distance);
		}

		internal List<XYZ> GetNeighbors(GridPoint point, int xStep, int yStep)
		{
			int col = point.Location.Col;
			int row = point.Location.Row;
			List<XYZ> list = new List<XYZ>();
			GridLocation gridLocation = new GridLocation();
			for (int i = row - yStep; i <= row + yStep; i++)
			{
				gridLocation.Col = col - xStep;
				gridLocation.Row = i;
				if (GridCells.ContainsKey(gridLocation))
				{
					list.AddRange(GridCells[gridLocation].Neighbors);
				}
				gridLocation.Col = col + xStep;
				gridLocation.Row = i;
				if (GridCells.ContainsKey(gridLocation))
				{
					list.AddRange(GridCells[gridLocation].Neighbors);
				}
			}
			for (int j = col - xStep; j <= col + xStep; j++)
			{
				gridLocation.Col = j;
				gridLocation.Row = row - yStep;
				if (GridCells.ContainsKey(gridLocation))
				{
					list.AddRange(GridCells[gridLocation].Neighbors);
				}
				gridLocation.Col = j;
				gridLocation.Row = row + yStep;
				if (GridCells.ContainsKey(gridLocation))
				{
					list.AddRange(GridCells[gridLocation].Neighbors);
				}
			}
			if (list.Count == 0)
			{
				list = GetNeighbors(point, xStep + 1, yStep + 1);
			}
			return list;
		}

		internal List<XYZ> GetNeighbors(GridPoint point)
		{
			List<XYZ> list = new List<XYZ>();
			GridLocation location = point.Location;
			list.AddRange(GridCells[location].Neighbors);
			if (list.Count == 0 && (DataInterpolation == SurfaceGridDataInterpolation.MaxClosestNeighbors || DataInterpolation == SurfaceGridDataInterpolation.InverseDistanceWeight))
			{
				list = GetNeighbors(point, 1, 1);
			}
			return list;
		}

		public void DistributeData()
		{
			if (!IsReady())
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (GridPoint value in GridCells.Values)
			{
				value.Neighbors.Clear();
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < FastItemsSource.Count; i++)
			{
				GridLocation location = GetLocation(XColumn[i], YColumn[i]);
				XYZ xYZ = new XYZ(XColumn[i], YColumn[i], ZColumn[i]);
				if (location.Split.Count == 0)
				{
					Add(location, xYZ);
					continue;
				}
				foreach (GridLocation item in location.Split)
				{
					XYZ xYZ2 = new XYZ(xYZ.X, xYZ.Y, xYZ.Z);
					if (DataSplitMode == DataSplitMode.EvenSplit)
					{
						xYZ2.Z = xYZ.Z / (double)location.Split.Count;
					}
					else if (DataSplitMode == DataSplitMode.FullSplit)
					{
						xYZ2.Z = xYZ.Z;
					}
					if (DataSplitMode != DataSplitMode.NoSplit)
					{
						Add(item, xYZ2);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateGrid()
		{
			if (IsReady())
			{
				DataInterpolator.Update(GridPoints);
				NotifyCollectionChanged();
			}
		}

		protected void OnPropertyChanged(string propertyName)
		{
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "MaximumPointsX":
			case "MaximumPointsY":
				GenerateGrid();
				break;
			case "DataSplitMode":
				DistributeData();
				UpdateGrid();
				break;
			case "DistanceMeasure":
				UpdateIntervals();
				UpdateGrid();
				break;
			case "DataInterpolator":
			case "DataInterpolation":
				UpdateGrid();
				break;
			}
		}

		private void OnDataSourceChanged(object sender, FastItemsSourceEventArgs e)
		{
			GenerateGrid();
		}

		public IEnumerator<GridPoint> GetEnumerator()
		{
			return ((IEnumerable<GridPoint>)GridPoints).GetEnumerator();
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return ((IEnumerable<GridPoint>)GridPoints).GetEnumerator();
		}
	}
	public class SurfaceGridDataSampler : SurfaceGridDataSamplerBase
	{
		private const string SamplingThresholdPropertyName = "SamplingThreshold";

		private int _SamplingThreshold = 10000;

		public int SamplingThreshold
		{
			get
			{
				return _SamplingThreshold;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != SamplingThreshold)
				{
					int samplingThreshold = SamplingThreshold;
					_SamplingThreshold = value;
					OnPropertyUpdated(new PropertyChangedEventArgs<int>("SamplingThreshold", samplingThreshold, SamplingThreshold));
				}
			}
		}

		public SurfaceGridDataSampler()
		{
			base.SurfaceGrid.MaximumPointsX = (base.SurfaceGrid.MaximumPointsY = (int)Math.Floor(Math.Sqrt(SamplingThreshold)));
		}

		protected override void OnPropertyUpdated(PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnPropertyUpdated(e);
			string propertyName = e.PropertyName;
			if (propertyName == "SamplingThreshold")
			{
				SurfaceGrid surfaceGrid = base.SurfaceGrid;
				int maximumPointsX = (base.SurfaceGrid.MaximumPointsY = (int)Math.Floor(Math.Sqrt(SamplingThreshold)));
				surfaceGrid.MaximumPointsX = maximumPointsX;
			}
		}
	}

		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		public event NotifyCollectionChangedEventHandler CollectionChanged;

		public SurfaceGridDataSamplerBase()
		{
			SurfaceGrid = new SurfaceGrid();
			SurfaceGrid.CollectionChanged += HandleSurfaceGridCollectionChanged;
			FastItemsSource = new FastItemsSource();
		}

		protected virtual void OnPropertyUpdated(PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			switch (e.PropertyName)
			{
			case "ItemsSource":
				FastItemsSource.DeregisterColumn(XColumn);
				FastItemsSource.DeregisterColumn(YColumn);
				FastItemsSource.DeregisterColumn(ZColumn);
				FastItemsSource.ItemsSource = ItemsSource;
				XColumn = FastItemsSource.RegisterColumn(XMemberPath);
				YColumn = FastItemsSource.RegisterColumn(YMemberPath);
				ZColumn = FastItemsSource.RegisterColumn(ZMemberPath);
				break;
			case "XMemberPath":
				FastItemsSource.DeregisterColumn(XColumn);
				XColumn = FastItemsSource.RegisterColumn(XMemberPath);
				break;
			case "YMemberPath":
				FastItemsSource.DeregisterColumn(XColumn);
				YColumn = FastItemsSource.RegisterColumn(YMemberPath);
				break;
			case "ZMemberPath":
				FastItemsSource.DeregisterColumn(XColumn);
				ZColumn = FastItemsSource.RegisterColumn(ZMemberPath);
				break;
			case "FastItemsSource":
				SurfaceGrid.FastItemsSource = FastItemsSource;
				break;
			case "XColumn":
				SurfaceGrid.XColumn = XColumn;
				break;
			case "YColumn":
				SurfaceGrid.YColumn = YColumn;
				break;
			case "ZColumn":
				SurfaceGrid.ZColumn = ZColumn;
				break;
			case "DataInterpolation":
				SurfaceGrid.DataInterpolation = DataInterpolation;
				break;
			case "DistanceMeasure":
				SurfaceGrid.DistanceMeasure = DistanceMeasure;
				break;
			}
			if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.PropertyChanged(this, e);
			}
		}

		private void HandleSurfaceGridCollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (this.CollectionChanged != null)
			{
				this.CollectionChanged(this, new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset));
			}
		}

			return GetEnumerator();
		}

	internal sealed class FastItemColumn : IFastItemColumnInternal, IFastItemColumn<double>, IList<double>, ICollection<double>, IEnumerable<double>, IEnumerable, IFastItemColumnPropertyName, IGetItemAtIndex
	{
		[Weak]

		[DontObfuscate]
		private string _propertyName;

		public double Minimum
		{
			get
			{
				if (double.IsNaN(minimum) && Values != null)
				{
					minimum = double.PositiveInfinity;
					foreach (double value in Values)
					{
						if (!double.IsNaN(value))
						{
							minimum = Math.Min(minimum, value);
						}
					}
				}
				return minimum;
			}
			private set
			{
				minimum = value;
			}
		}

		public double Maximum
		{
			get
			{
				if (double.IsNaN(maximum) && Values != null)
				{
					maximum = double.NegativeInfinity;
					foreach (double value in Values)
					{
						if (!double.IsNaN(value))
						{
							maximum = Math.Max(maximum, value);
						}
					}
				}
				return maximum;
			}
			private set
			{
				maximum = value;
			}
		}

		public bool Reset()
		{
			Values = null;
			Minimum = double.NaN;
			Maximum = double.NaN;
			_unknownCount = 0;
			if (FastItemsSource == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return InsertRange(0, FastItemsSource.Count);
		}

		public bool InsertRange(int position, int count)
		{
			List<double> list = new List<double>
			{
				Capacity = count
			};
			IFastItemsSource fastItemsSource = this.fastItemsSource;
			double num = Minimum;
			double num2 = Maximum;
			bool flag = double.IsNaN(Minimum);
			bool flag2 = double.IsNaN(Maximum);
			IList list2 = fastItemsSource.ContentsAsIList();
			if (list2 != null && _propertyName != null && _propertyName.StartsWith("[") && list2.Count > 0 && list2[0] is double[])
			{
				if (int.TryParse(_propertyName.Replace("[", "").Replace("]", ""), out var result) && result >= 0)
				{
					for (int i = position; i < position + count; i++)
					{
						double[] array = (double[])list2[i];
						double num3 = double.NaN;
						if (result < array.Length)
						{
							num3 = array[result];
						}
						bool flag3 = num3 != num3;
						if (flag3)
						{
							_unknownCount++;
						}
						if (flag || num3 < num)
						{
							num = num3;
							flag = flag3;
						}
						if (flag2 || num3 > num2)
						{
							num2 = num3;
							flag2 = flag3;
						}
						list.Add(num3);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				for (int j = position; j < position + count; j++)
				{
					double num3 = ToDouble(fastItemsSource[j]);
					bool flag4 = num3 != num3;
					if (flag4)
					{
						_unknownCount++;
					}
					if (flag || num3 < num)
					{
						num = num3;
						flag = flag4;
					}
					if (flag2 || num3 > num2)
					{
						num2 = num3;
						flag2 = flag4;
					}
					list.Add(num3);
				}
			}
			Minimum = num;
			Maximum = num2;
			if (Values == null)
			{
				Values = list;
			}
			else
			{
				Values.InsertRange(position, list);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public bool RemoveRange(int position, int count)
		{
			for (int i = position; i < position + count; i++)
			{
				if (double.IsNaN(Minimum))
				{
					break;
				}
				if (double.IsNaN(Maximum))
				{
					break;
				}
				if (this[i] == Minimum)
				{
					Minimum = double.NaN;
				}
				if (this[i] == Maximum)
				{
					Maximum = double.NaN;
				}
				if (double.IsNaN(this[i]))
				{
					_unknownCount--;
				}
			}
			Values.RemoveRange(position, count);
			return true;
		}

		public void ReplaceMinMax(double oldValue, double newValue)
		{
			if (double.IsNaN(oldValue))
			{
				if (!double.IsNaN(newValue))
				{
					if (!double.IsNaN(Minimum))
					{
						Minimum = Math.Min(newValue, Minimum);
					}
					if (!double.IsNaN(Maximum))
					{
						Maximum = Math.Max(newValue, Maximum);
					}
				}
				return;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(newValue))
			{
				Minimum = ((!double.IsNaN(Minimum) && oldValue == Minimum) ? double.NaN : Minimum);
				Maximum = ((!double.IsNaN(Maximum) && oldValue == Maximum) ? double.NaN : Maximum);
				return;
			}
			if (!double.IsNaN(Minimum))
			{
				if (oldValue == Minimum && newValue > Minimum)
				{
					Minimum = double.NaN;
				}
				else
				{
					Minimum = Math.Min(newValue, Minimum);
				}
			}
			if (!double.IsNaN(Maximum))
			{
				if (oldValue == Maximum && newValue < Maximum)
				{
					Maximum = double.NaN;
				}
				else
				{
					Maximum = Math.Max(newValue, Maximum);
				}
			}
		}

		public bool ReplaceRange(int position, int count)
		{
			bool result = false;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				double num = Values[position + i];
				double num2 = ToDouble(FastItemsSource[position + i]);
				if (double.IsNaN(num))
				{
					_unknownCount--;
				}
				if (double.IsNaN(num2))
				{
					_unknownCount++;
				}
				if (num != num2)
				{
					Values[position + i] = num2;
					result = true;
					ReplaceMinMax(num, num2);
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private double ToDouble(object item)
		{
			if (item == null)
			{
				return double.NaN;
			}
			if (fastReflectionHelper == null)
			{
				fastReflectionHelper = new FastReflectionHelper(useTraditionalReflection: false, PropertyName);
			}
			if (!fastReflectionHelper.Invalid)
			{
				item = fastReflectionHelper.GetPropertyValue(item.GetType(), item);
				if (item == null)
				{
					return double.NaN;
				}
			}
			if (item is double)
			{
				return (double)item;
			}
			if (item is int)
			{
				return (int)item;
			}
			if (item is Duration duration)
			{
				item = duration.TimeSpan;
			}
			if (item is DateTime dateTime)
			{
				return dateTime.Ticks;
			}
			if (item is TimeSpan timeSpan)
			{
				return timeSpan.Ticks;
			}
			if (item is string && string.IsNullOrEmpty((string)item))
			{
				return double.NaN;
			}
			if (item is IConvertible)
			{
				try
				{
					if (item == DBNull.Value)
					{
						return double.NaN;
					}
					return Convert.ToDouble(item);
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
			return double.NaN;
		}

		public static List<int> GetSortedIndices(IList values)
		{
			return (from i in Enumerable.Range(0, values.Count)
				orderby values[i]
				select i).ToList();
		}

		internal List<int> GetSortedIndices()
		{
			return GetSortedIndices(Values);
		}

		object IGetItemAtIndex.GetItem(int index)
		{
			return this[index];
		}
	}

		public bool Reset()
		{
			Values = null;
			hasMinimum = false;
			hasMaximum = false;
			if (FastItemsSource == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return InsertRange(0, FastItemsSource.Count);
		}

		public bool InsertRange(int position, int count)
		{
			List<DateTime> list = new List<DateTime>
			{
				Capacity = count
			};
			IFastItemsSource fastItemsSource = this.fastItemsSource;
			DateTime dateTime = Minimum;
			DateTime dateTime2 = Maximum;
			for (int i = position; i < position + count; i++)
			{
				DateTime dateTime3 = ToDateTime(fastItemsSource[i]);
				if (!hasMinimum)
				{
					dateTime = dateTime3;
					hasMinimum = true;
				}
				else if (dateTime3 < dateTime)
				{
					dateTime = dateTime3;
				}
				if (!hasMaximum)
				{
					dateTime2 = dateTime3;
					hasMaximum = true;
				}
				else if (dateTime3 > dateTime2)
				{
					dateTime2 = dateTime3;
				}
				list.Add(dateTime3);
			}
			Minimum = dateTime;
			Maximum = dateTime2;
			if (Values == null)
			{
				Values = list;
			}
			else
			{
				Values.InsertRange(position, list);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public bool RemoveRange(int position, int count)
		{
			for (int i = position; i < position + count; i++)
			{
				if (this[i] == Minimum)
				{
					hasMinimum = false;
				}
				if (this[i] == Maximum)
				{
					hasMaximum = false;
				}
			}
			Values.RemoveRange(position, count);
			return true;
		}

		public void ReplaceMinMax(DateTime oldValue, DateTime newValue)
		{
			if (oldValue != DateTime.MinValue)
			{
				if (newValue != DateTime.MinValue)
				{
					Minimum = ((newValue < Minimum) ? newValue : Minimum);
					Maximum = ((newValue > Maximum) ? newValue : Maximum);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				Minimum = ((newValue < Minimum) ? newValue : Minimum);
				Maximum = ((newValue > Maximum) ? newValue : Maximum);
			}
		}

		public bool ReplaceRange(int position, int count)
		{
			bool result = false;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				DateTime dateTime = Values[position + i];
				DateTime dateTime2 = ToDateTime(FastItemsSource[position + i]);
				if (dateTime != dateTime2)
				{
					Values[position + i] = dateTime2;
					result = true;
					ReplaceMinMax(dateTime, dateTime2);
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private DateTime ToDateTime(object item)
		{
			if (item == null)
			{
				return DateTime.MinValue;
			}
			if (fastReflectionHelper == null)
			{
				fastReflectionHelper = new FastReflectionHelper(useTraditionalReflection: false, PropertyName);
			}
			if (!fastReflectionHelper.Invalid)
			{
				item = fastReflectionHelper.GetPropertyValue(item.GetType(), item);
				if (item == null)
				{
					return DateTime.MinValue;
				}
			}
			if (item is DateTime)
			{
				return (DateTime)item;
			}
			if (item is double)
			{
				return DateTime.FromOADate((double)item);
			}
			if (item is Duration duration)
			{
				item = duration.TimeSpan;
			}
			if (item is TimeSpan timeSpan)
			{
				return new DateTime(timeSpan.Ticks);
			}
			if (item is IConvertible)
			{
				try
				{
					return Convert.ToDateTime(item);
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
			return DateTime.MinValue;
		}

		public List<int> GetSortedIndices()

			return FastItemColumn.GetSortedIndices(Values);
		}

			return this[index];

		public bool Reset()
		{
			Values = null;
			if (FastItemsSource == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return InsertRange(0, FastItemsSource.Count);
		}

		public bool InsertRange(int position, int count)
		{
			List<int> list = new List<int>
			{
				Capacity = count
			};
			IFastItemsSource fastItemsSource = this.fastItemsSource;
			_ = Minimum;
			_ = Maximum;
			for (int i = position; i < position + count; i++)
			{
				int item = ToInt(fastItemsSource[i]);
				list.Add(item);
			}
			if (Values == null)
			{
				Values = list;
			}
			else
			{
				Values.InsertRange(position, list);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public bool ReplaceRange(int position, int count)
		{
			bool result = false;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				int num = Values[position + i];
				int num2 = ToInt(FastItemsSource[position + i]);
				if (num != num2)
				{
					Values[position + i] = num2;
					result = true;
				}
			}
			return result;

		private int ToInt(object item)

				return int.MinValue;

				item = fastReflectionHelper.GetPropertyValue(item.GetType(), item);
				if (item == null)
				{
					return int.MinValue;
				}
			}
			if (item is int)
			{
				return (int)item;
			}
			if (item is Duration duration)
			{
				item = duration.TimeSpan;
			}
			if (item is TimeSpan timeSpan)
			{
				item = timeSpan.Ticks;
			}
			if (item is DateTime dateTime)
			{
				item = dateTime.Ticks;
			}
			if (item is IConvertible)
			{
				try
				{
					return Convert.ToInt32(item);
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
			return int.MinValue;
		}

	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	internal sealed class FastItemProxyColumn : IFastItemColumnInternal, IFastItemColumn<double>, IList<double>, ICollection<double>, IEnumerable<double>, IEnumerable, IFastItemColumnPropertyName, IGetItemAtIndex
	{
		private double minimum;

		public double Minimum
		{
			get
			{
				if (double.IsNaN(minimum) && FastItemsSource != null)
				{
					minimum = double.PositiveInfinity;
					for (int i = 0; i < FastItemsSource.Count; i++)
					{
						double num = ToDouble(FastItemsSource[i]);
						if (!double.IsNaN(num))
						{
							minimum = Math.Min(minimum, num);
						}
					}
				}
				return minimum;
			}
			private set
			{
				minimum = value;
			}
		}

		public double Maximum
		{
			get
			{
				if (double.IsNaN(maximum) && FastItemsSource != null)
				{
					maximum = double.NegativeInfinity;
					for (int i = 0; i < FastItemsSource.Count; i++)
					{
						double num = ToDouble(FastItemsSource[i]);
						if (!double.IsNaN(num))
						{
							maximum = Math.Max(maximum, num);
						}
					}
				}
				return maximum;
			}
			private set
			{
				maximum = value;
			}
		}

		public double this[int index]

			set

		public int Count

				if (FastItemsSource == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return FastItemsSource.Count;
			}
		}

		public bool IsReadOnly => true;

		internal IFastItemsSource FastItemsSource
		{
			get
			{
				return fastItemsSource;
			}
			set

				Reset();
			}
		}

		public bool MayContainUnknowns => true;

		public IEnumerator<double> GetEnumerator()
		{
			if (FastItemsSource != null)
			{
				int i = 0;
				while (i < FastItemsSource.Count)
				{
					yield return ToDouble(FastItemsSource[i]);
					int num = i + 1;
					i = num;
				}
			}
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			if (FastItemsSource != null)
			{
				int i = 0;
				while (i < FastItemsSource.Count)
				{
					yield return ToDouble(FastItemsSource[i]);
					int num = i + 1;
					i = num;
				}
			}
		}

		public bool Contains(double item)
		{
			using (IEnumerator<double> enumerator = GetEnumerator())
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					if (enumerator.Current == item)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		{
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				if (this[i] == item)
				{
					return i;
				}
			}
			return -1;

		internal FastItemProxyColumn(IFastItemsSource fastItemsSource, string propertyName)

			FastItemsSource = fastItemsSource;

		private double ToDouble(object item)
		{
			if (item == null)
			{
				return double.NaN;
			}
			if (fastReflectionHelper == null)
			{
				fastReflectionHelper = new FastReflectionHelper(useTraditionalReflection: false, PropertyName);
			}
			if (!fastReflectionHelper.Invalid)
			{
				item = fastReflectionHelper.GetPropertyValue(item.GetType(), item);
				if (item == null)
				{
					return double.NaN;
				}
			}
			if (item is double)
			{
				return (double)item;
			}
			if (item is IConvertible)
			{
				try
				{
					return Convert.ToDouble(item);
				}
				catch
				{
					return double.NaN;
				}
			}
			if (item is TimeSpan timeSpan)
			{
				return timeSpan.TotalMilliseconds;
			}
			if (item is DateTime dateTime)
			{
				return dateTime.ToOADate();
			}
			if (item is DateTime? { Value: var value })
			{
				return value.ToOADate();
			}
			return double.NaN;
		}

	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	[WidgetModule("Gauge")]
	[TSSuppressImportModule("igniteui-core/FastItemIntColumn", "FastItemIntColumn")]
	[TSSuppressImportModule("igniteui-core/FastItemDateTimeColumn", "FastItemDateTimeColumn")]
	[TSSuppressImportModule("igniteui-core/FastItemObjectColumn", "FastItemObjectColumn")]
	[TSImportModule("igniteui-core/type", "TypeRegistrar")]
	public class FastItemsSource : IEnumerable, IFastItemsSource, IGetItemAtIndex
	{
		internal ItemSourceEventProxy ItemsSourceEventProxy;

		private Dictionary<string, ColumnReference> columns = new Dictionary<string, ColumnReference>();

		private IEnumerable itemsSource;

		private ArrayList contents = new ArrayList();

		private Dictionary<object, int> index;

		public Dispatcher Dispatcher { get; set; }

		public IEnumerable ItemsSource
		{
			get
			{
				return itemsSource;
			}
			set
			{
				if (itemsSource == value)
				{
					return;
				}
				Detach();
				itemsSource = value;
				contents.Clear();
				index = null;
				Attach();
				foreach (ColumnReference value2 in columns.Values)
				{
					value2.FastItemColumn.Reset();
				}
				RaiseDataSourceEvent(FastItemsSourceEventAction.Insert, 0, contents.Count);
			}
		}

		public int Count => contents.Count;

		public object this[int i] => contents[i];

		public event EventHandler<FastItemsSourceEventArgs> Event;

		private void RaiseDataSourceEvent(FastItemsSourceEventAction action, int position, int count)
		{
			if (this.Event != null)
			{
				this.Event(this, new FastItemsSourceEventArgs(action, position, count));
			}
		}

		private void RaiseDataSourceEvent(int position, string propertyName)
		{
			if (this.Event != null)
			{
				this.Event(this, new FastItemsSourceEventArgs(position, propertyName));
			}
		}

		public void Detach()
		{
			if (itemsSource == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (itemsSource is INotifyCollectionChanged)
			{
				((INotifyCollectionChanged)itemsSource).CollectionChanged -= ItemsSourceEventProxy.CollectionChanged;
			}
			if (itemsSource is INotifyPropertyChanged)
			{
				((INotifyPropertyChanged)itemsSource).PropertyChanged -= ItemsSourceEventProxy.CollectionPropertyChanged;
			}
			foreach (object content in contents)
			{
				if (content is INotifyPropertyChanged)
				{
					((INotifyPropertyChanged)content).PropertyChanged -= ItemsSourceEventProxy.PropertyChanged;
				}
			}
			ItemsSourceEventProxy.WeakCollectionChanged = null;
			ItemsSourceEventProxy.WeakCollectionPropertyChanged = null;
			ItemsSourceEventProxy.WeakPropertyChanged = null;
			ItemsSourceEventProxy = null;
		}

		internal void OnItemsSourceEventProxyWeakCollectionChanged(IFastItemsSource fastItemsSource, object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			FastItemsSource fastItemsSource2 = (FastItemsSource)fastItemsSource;
			switch (e.Action)
			{
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add:
				fastItemsSource2.dataSourceAdd(e.NewStartingIndex, e.NewItems);
				break;
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove:
				fastItemsSource2.dataSourceRemove(e.OldStartingIndex, e.OldItems);
				break;
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace:
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Move:
				fastItemsSource2.dataSourceReplace(e.NewStartingIndex, e.OldItems, e.NewItems);
				break;
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset:
				fastItemsSource2.dataSourceReset();
				break;
			}
		}

		public void Attach()
		{
			if (itemsSource == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ItemsSourceEventProxy = new ItemSourceEventProxy(this);
			ItemsSourceEventProxy.WeakCollectionChanged = delegate(IFastItemsSource fastItemsSource, object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				OnItemsSourceEventProxyWeakCollectionChanged(fastItemsSource, sender, e);
			};
			ItemsSourceEventProxy.WeakPropertyChanged = delegate(IFastItemsSource fastItemsSource, object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((FastItemsSource)fastItemsSource).dataSourceChange(sender, e.PropertyName);
			};
			ItemsSourceEventProxy.WeakCollectionPropertyChanged = delegate(IFastItemsSource fastItemsSource, object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				FastItemsSource fastItemsSource2 = (FastItemsSource)fastItemsSource;
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(e.PropertyName))
				{
					fastItemsSource2.dataSourceReset();
				}
			};
			if (itemsSource is INotifyCollectionChanged)
			{
				((INotifyCollectionChanged)itemsSource).CollectionChanged += ItemsSourceEventProxy.CollectionChanged;
			}
			if (itemsSource is INotifyPropertyChanged)
			{
				(itemsSource as INotifyPropertyChanged).PropertyChanged += ItemsSourceEventProxy.CollectionPropertyChanged;
			}
			foreach (object item in itemsSource)
			{
				contents.Add(item);
				if (item is INotifyPropertyChanged)
				{
					((INotifyPropertyChanged)item).PropertyChanged += ItemsSourceEventProxy.PropertyChanged;
				}
			}
		}

		private void dataSourceAdd(int position, IList newItems)
		{
			foreach (object newItem in newItems)
			{
				if (newItem is INotifyPropertyChanged)
				{
					((INotifyPropertyChanged)newItem).PropertyChanged += ItemsSourceEventProxy.PropertyChanged;
				}
			}
			if (index != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < newItems.Count; i++)
				{
					index.Add(newItems[i], position + i);
				}
				for (int j = position; j < contents.Count; j++)
				{
					index[contents[j]] = j + newItems.Count;
				}
			}
			contents.InsertRange(position, newItems);
			foreach (ColumnReference value in columns.Values)
			{
				value.FastItemColumn.InsertRange(position, newItems.Count);
			}
			RaiseDataSourceEvent(FastItemsSourceEventAction.Insert, position, newItems.Count);
		}

		private void dataSourceRemove(int position, IList oldItems)
		{
			foreach (object oldItem in oldItems)
			{
				if (oldItem is INotifyPropertyChanged)
				{
					((INotifyPropertyChanged)oldItem).PropertyChanged -= ItemsSourceEventProxy.PropertyChanged;
				}
			}
			contents.RemoveRange(position, oldItems.Count);
			if (index != null)
			{
				foreach (object oldItem2 in oldItems)
				{
					index.Remove(oldItem2);
				}
				for (int i = position; i < contents.Count; i++)
				{
					index[contents[i]] = i;
				}
			}
			foreach (ColumnReference value in columns.Values)
			{
				value.FastItemColumn.RemoveRange(position, oldItems.Count);
			}
			RaiseDataSourceEvent(FastItemsSourceEventAction.Remove, position, oldItems.Count);
		}

		private void dataSourceReplace(int position, IList oldItems, IList newItems)
		{
			foreach (object oldItem in oldItems)
			{
				if (oldItem is INotifyPropertyChanged)
				{
					((INotifyPropertyChanged)oldItem).PropertyChanged -= ItemsSourceEventProxy.PropertyChanged;
				}
			}
			foreach (object newItem in newItems)
			{
				if (newItem is INotifyPropertyChanged)
				{
					((INotifyPropertyChanged)newItem).PropertyChanged += ItemsSourceEventProxy.PropertyChanged;
				}
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < newItems.Count; i++)
			{
				contents[position + i] = newItems[i];
			}
			if (index != null)
			{
				foreach (object oldItem2 in oldItems)
				{
					index.Remove(oldItem2);
				}
				for (int j = 0; j < newItems.Count; j++)
				{
					index.Add(newItems[j], position + j);
				}
			}
			foreach (ColumnReference value in columns.Values)
			{
				value.FastItemColumn.ReplaceRange(position, newItems.Count);
			}
			RaiseDataSourceEvent(FastItemsSourceEventAction.Replace, position, oldItems.Count);
		}

		private void dataSourceReset()
		{
			foreach (object content in contents)
			{
				if (content is INotifyPropertyChanged)
				{
					((INotifyPropertyChanged)content).PropertyChanged -= ItemsSourceEventProxy.PropertyChanged;
				}
			}
			contents.Clear();
			index = null;
			foreach (object item in itemsSource)
			{
				contents.Add(item);
				if (item is INotifyPropertyChanged)
				{
					((INotifyPropertyChanged)item).PropertyChanged += ItemsSourceEventProxy.PropertyChanged;
				}
			}
			foreach (ColumnReference value in columns.Values)
			{
				value.FastItemColumn.Reset();
			}
			RaiseDataSourceEvent(FastItemsSourceEventAction.Reset, 0, contents.Count);
		}

		private void dataSourceChange(object item, string propertyName)
		{
			ColumnReference value = null;
			int num = IndexOf(item);
			if (num == -1)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("item");
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(propertyName))
			{
				foreach (KeyValuePair<string, ColumnReference> column in columns)
				{
					column.Value.FastItemColumn.ReplaceRange(num, 1);
					RaiseDataSourceEvent(num, column.Value.FastItemColumn.PropertyName);
				}
				return;
			}
			if (propertyName == "Item[]")
			{
				foreach (KeyValuePair<string, ColumnReference> column2 in columns)
				{
					if (column2.Key != null && column2.Key.StartsWith("[") && column2.Key.EndsWith("]"))
					{
						column2.Value.FastItemColumn.ReplaceRange(num, 1);
						RaiseDataSourceEvent(num, column2.Value.FastItemColumn.PropertyName);
					}
				}
				return;
			}
			if (columns.TryGetValue(propertyName, out value))
			{
				value.FastItemColumn.ReplaceRange(num, 1);
			}
			if (columns.TryGetValue(propertyName + "_object", out value))
			{
				value.FastItemColumn.ReplaceRange(num, 1);
			}
			RaiseDataSourceEvent(num, propertyName);
		}

		public IEnumerator GetEnumerator()
		{
			return contents.GetEnumerator();
		}

		public int IndexOf(object item)
		{
			if (index == null && contents.Count > 0)
			{
				index = new Dictionary<object, int>();
				_ = contents;
				_ = index;
				for (int i = 0; i < contents.Count; i++)
				{
					object key = contents[i];
					if (!index.ContainsKey(key))
					{
						index.Add(key, i);
					}
				}
			}
			if (index != null && index.TryGetValue(item, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return -1;
		}

		[TSRequiredModule("igniteui-core/FastItemDateTimeColumn", "FastItemDateTimeColumn")]
		public IFastItemColumn<DateTime> RegisterColumnDateTime(string propertyName)
		{
			IFastItemColumn<DateTime> result = null;
			if (propertyName != null)
			{
				ColumnReference value = null;
				if (!columns.TryGetValue(propertyName, out value))
				{
					value = new ColumnReference(new FastItemDateTimeColumn(this, propertyName));
					columns.Add(propertyName, value);
				}
				value.References++;
				result = value.FastItemColumn as IFastItemColumn<DateTime>;
			}
			return result;
		}

		[TSRequiredModule("igniteui-core/FastItemObjectColumn", "FastItemObjectColumn")]
		public IFastItemColumn<object> RegisterColumnObject(string propertyName)
		{
			IFastItemColumn<object> result = null;
			string key = propertyName + "_object";
			if (propertyName != null)
			{
				ColumnReference value = null;
				if (!columns.TryGetValue(key, out value))
				{
					value = new ColumnReference(new FastItemObjectColumn(this, propertyName));
					columns.Add(key, value);
				}
				value.References++;
				result = value.FastItemColumn as IFastItemColumn<object>;
			}
			return result;
		}

		[TSRequiredModule("igniteui-core/FastItemIntColumn", "FastItemIntColumn")]
		public IFastItemColumn<int> RegisterColumnInt(string propertyName)
		{
			if (propertyName == null)
			{
				propertyName = "";
			}
			ColumnReference value = null;
			if (!columns.TryGetValue(propertyName, out value))
			{
				value = new ColumnReference(new FastItemIntColumn(this, propertyName));
				columns.Add(propertyName, value);
			}
			value.References++;
			return value.FastItemColumn as IFastItemColumn<int>;
		}

		public IFastItemColumn<double> RegisterColumn(string propertyName)
		{
			if (propertyName == null)
			{
				propertyName = "";
			}
			ColumnReference value = null;
			if (!columns.TryGetValue(propertyName, out value))
			{
				value = new ColumnReference(new FastItemColumn(this, propertyName));
				columns.Add(propertyName, value);
			}
			value.References++;
			return value.FastItemColumn as IFastItemColumn<double>;
		}

		public void DeregisterColumn(IFastItemColumnPropertyName fastItemColumn)
		{
			string text = fastItemColumn?.PropertyName;
			string text2 = text;
			if (fastItemColumn is IFastItemColumn<object>)
			{
				text2 += "_object";
			}
			if (text == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ColumnReference value = null;
			if (columns.TryGetValue(text, out value))
			{
				value.References--;
				if (value.References == 0)
				{
					columns.Remove(text2);
				}
			}
		}

		public IList ContentsAsIList()
		{
			return contents;
		}

		object IGetItemAtIndex.GetItem(int index)
		{
			return this[index];
		}
	}
