			textBlock.FontStretch = fontStretch;
			textBlock.FontStyle = fontStyle;
			textBlock.FontWeight = fontWeight;
			return new Size(textBlock.ActualWidth, textBlock.ActualHeight);
		}

		public static int GetBestFitStringSize(string text, double width, FontFamily fontFamily, double fontSize, FontStretch fontStretch, FontStyle fontStyle, FontWeight fontWeight)
		{
			int num = 0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			char[] array = text.ToCharArray();
			foreach (char c in array)
			{
				num2 += GetStringSizePixels(c.ToString(), fontFamily, fontSize, fontStretch, fontStyle, fontWeight).Width;
				if (num2 > width)
				{
					return num;
				}
				num++;
			}
			return num;
		}
	}
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	public class PriorityQueue<T>
	{
		private struct HeapItem
		{
			public T Item { get; private set; }

			public double Priority { get; private set; }

			public HeapItem(T item, double priority)
			{
				this = default(HeapItem);
				Item = item;
				Priority = priority;
			}
		}

		private HeapItem[] heap;

		public int Count { get; private set; }

		private int Capacity { get; set; }

		public PriorityQueue()
		{
			Count = 0;
			Capacity = 15;
			heap = new HeapItem[Capacity];
		}

		public T Dequeue()
		{
			if (Count == 0)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
			T item = heap[0].Item;
			int count = Count - 1;
			Count = count;
			TrickleDown(0, heap[Count]);
			return item;
		}

		public void Enqueue(T item, double priority)
		{
			if (Count == Capacity)
			{
				GrowHeap();
			}
			int count = Count + 1;
			Count = count;
			BubbleUp(Count - 1, new HeapItem(item, priority));
		}

		private void BubbleUp(int index, HeapItem he)
		{
			int num = Parent(index);
			while (index > 0 && heap[num].Priority < he.Priority)
			{
				heap[index] = heap[num];
				index = num;
				num = Parent(index);
			}
			heap[index] = he;
		}

		private void TrickleDown(int index, HeapItem he)
		{
			for (int num = LeftChild(index); num < Count; num = LeftChild(index))
			{
				if (num + 1 < Count && heap[num].Priority < heap[num + 1].Priority)
				{
					num++;
				}
				heap[index] = heap[num];
				index = num;
			}
			BubbleUp(index, he);
		}

		private void GrowHeap()
		{
			Capacity = Capacity * 2 + 1;
			HeapItem[] destinationArray = new HeapItem[Capacity];
			Array.Copy(heap, 0, destinationArray, 0, Count);
			heap = destinationArray;
		}

		private static int Parent(int index)
		{
			return (index - 1) / 2;
		}

		private static int LeftChild(int index)
		{
			return index * 2 + 1;
		}
	}
	public static class SafeSetters
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty SettersProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("Setters", typeof(SafeSetterCollection), typeof(SafeSetters), new PropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject o, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			OnSettersChanged(o, e.OldValue as SafeSetterCollection, e.NewValue as SafeSetterCollection);
		}));

		public static void SetSetters(DependencyObject target, SafeSetterCollection setters)
		{
			target.SetValue(SettersProperty, setters);
		}

		public static SafeSetterCollection GetSetters(DependencyObject target)
		{
			return (SafeSetterCollection)target.GetValue(SettersProperty);
		}

		private static void OnSettersChanged(DependencyObject o, SafeSetterCollection oldValue, SafeSetterCollection newValue)
		{
			newValue?.Apply(o);
		}
	}
	public class SafeSetterCollection : ObservableCollection<SafeSetter>
	{
		protected override void InsertItem(int index, SafeSetter item)
		{
			base.InsertItem(index, item);
			if (item.CanFreeze)
			{
				item.Freeze();
			}
		}

		public void Apply(DependencyObject target)
		{
			if (target == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			using IEnumerator<SafeSetter> enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				enumerator.Current.Apply(target);
			}
		}
	}
	[ContentProperty("Value")]
	public class SafeSetter : Freezable
	{
		public static readonly bool IsSafe;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ValueProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ValueAsXamlStringProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty PropertyNameProperty;

		internal static bool TestPartialTrust { get; set; }

		public object Value
		{
			get
			{
				return GetValue(ValueProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ValueProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public string ValueAsXamlString
		{
			get
			{
				return (string)GetValue(ValueAsXamlStringProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ValueAsXamlStringProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public string PropertyName
		{
			get
			{
				return (string)GetValue(PropertyNameProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(PropertyNameProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected override Freezable CreateInstanceCore()
		{
			return new SafeSetter();
		}

		static SafeSetter()
		{
			ValueProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Value", typeof(object), typeof(SafeSetter), new PropertyMetadata(null));
			ValueAsXamlStringProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ValueAsXamlString", typeof(string), typeof(SafeSetter), new PropertyMetadata(null));
			PropertyNameProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("PropertyName", typeof(string), typeof(SafeSetter), new PropertyMetadata(null));
			IsSafe = IsPermissionGranted(new UIPermission(PermissionState.Unrestricted));
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private static bool IsPermissionGranted(CodeAccessPermission uIPermission)
		{
			try
			{
				uIPermission.Demand();
				return true;
			}
			catch
			{
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal void Apply(DependencyObject target)
		{
			if (PropertyName == null || target == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (base.CanFreeze)
			{
				Freeze();
			}
			if (IsSafe && !TestPartialTrust)
			{
				PropertyInfo property = target.GetType().GetProperty(PropertyName);
				if (!(property == null))
				{
					property.SetValue(target, EffectiveValue(), null);
				}
			}
		}

		private object EffectiveValue()
		{
			if (ValueAsXamlString != null)
			{
				return LoadXamlString(ValueAsXamlString);
			}
			return Value;
		}

		private object LoadXamlString(string value)
		{
			using StringReader input = new StringReader(value);
			using XmlReader reader = XmlReader.Create(input);
			return XamlReader.Load(reader);
		}
	}
	public static class ShapeUtil
	{
		public static Shape Duplicate(this Shape shape)
		{
			if (shape is Ellipse ellipse)
			{
				return ellipse.Duplicate();
			}
			if (shape is Line line)
			{
				return line.Duplicate();
			}
			if (shape is Rectangle rectangle)
			{
				return rectangle.Duplicate();
			}
			if (shape is Polygon polygon)
			{
				return polygon.Duplicate();
			}
			if (shape is Polyline polyline)
			{
				return polyline.Duplicate();
			}
			if (shape is System.Windows.Shapes.Path path)
			{
				return path.Duplicate();
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static Ellipse Duplicate(this Ellipse ellipse)
		{
			Ellipse ellipse2 = new Ellipse();
			DuplicateShapeProperties(ellipse2, ellipse);
			return ellipse2;
		}

		public static Line Duplicate(this Line line)
		{
			Line obj = new Line
			{
				X1 = line.X1,
				X2 = line.X2,
				Y1 = line.Y1,
				Y2 = line.Y2
			};
			DuplicateShapeProperties(obj, line);
			return obj;
		}

		public static Rectangle Duplicate(this Rectangle rectangle)
		{
			Rectangle obj = new Rectangle
			{
				RadiusX = rectangle.RadiusX,
				RadiusY = rectangle.RadiusY
			};
			DuplicateShapeProperties(obj, rectangle);
			return obj;
		}

		public static Polygon Duplicate(this Polygon polygon)
		{
			Polygon obj = new Polygon
			{
				Points = polygon.Points.Duplicate(),
				FillRule = polygon.FillRule
			};
			DuplicateShapeProperties(obj, polygon);
			return obj;
		}

		public static Polyline Duplicate(this Polyline polyline)
		{
			Polyline obj = new Polyline
			{
				Points = polyline.Points.Duplicate(),
				FillRule = polyline.FillRule
			};
			DuplicateShapeProperties(obj, polyline);
			return obj;
		}

		public static System.Windows.Shapes.Path Duplicate(this System.Windows.Shapes.Path path)
		{
			System.Windows.Shapes.Path path2 = new System.Windows.Shapes.Path();
			Geometry data = path.Data.Duplicate();
			path2.Data = data;
			DuplicateShapeProperties(path2, path);
			return path2;
		}

		private static void DuplicateShapeProperties(Shape newShape, Shape shape)
		{
			newShape.Fill = shape.Fill.Duplicate();
			newShape.Stroke = shape.Stroke.Duplicate();
			newShape.StrokeDashArray = shape.StrokeDashArray.Duplicate();
			newShape.StrokeDashCap = shape.StrokeDashCap;
			newShape.StrokeDashOffset = shape.StrokeDashOffset;
			newShape.StrokeEndLineCap = shape.StrokeEndLineCap;
			newShape.StrokeLineJoin = shape.StrokeLineJoin;
			newShape.StrokeMiterLimit = shape.StrokeMiterLimit;
			newShape.StrokeStartLineCap = shape.StrokeStartLineCap;
			newShape.StrokeThickness = shape.StrokeThickness;
			newShape.HorizontalAlignment = shape.HorizontalAlignment;
			newShape.VerticalAlignment = shape.VerticalAlignment;
			newShape.Visibility = shape.Visibility;
			newShape.Margin = shape.Margin;
			newShape.Stretch = shape.Stretch;
			newShape.RenderTransform = shape.RenderTransform.Duplicate();
			newShape.RenderTransformOrigin = shape.RenderTransformOrigin;
			newShape.IsHitTestVisible = shape.IsHitTestVisible;
		}

		public static DoubleCollection Duplicate(this DoubleCollection doubleCollection)
		{
			if (doubleCollection == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			DoubleCollection doubleCollection2 = new DoubleCollection();
			foreach (double item in doubleCollection)
			{
				doubleCollection2.Add(item);
			}
			return doubleCollection2;
		}

		public static PointCollection Duplicate(this PointCollection pointCollection)
		{
			if (pointCollection == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			PointCollection pointCollection2 = new PointCollection();
			foreach (Point item in pointCollection)
			{
				pointCollection2.Add(item);
			}
			return pointCollection2;
		}
	}
	public class StringFormatter
	{
		public delegate object ValueDelegate(object obj, string propertyName);

		private string formatString;

		private static Regex regex = new Regex("(.*)\\[(\\d+)\\]$");

		public string FormatString
		{
			get
			{
				return formatString;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!(formatString != value))
				{
					return;
				}
				formatString = value;
				int num = 0;
				int num2 = 0;
				PropertyNames = new List<string>();
				StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
				for (int num3 = formatString.IndexOf('{', num2); num3 >= num2; num3 = formatString.IndexOf('{', num2))
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(formatString.Substring(num2, num3 - num2));
					int num4 = formatString.IndexOf('}', num3);
					if (num4 <= num3)
					{
						return;
					}
					string text = formatString.Substring(num3 + 1, num4 - num3 - 1).Trim();
					int num5 = text.IndexOf(':');
					if (num5 == -1)
					{
						PropertyNames.Add(text);
						stringBuilder.Append("{" + num + "}");
					}
					else
					{
						PropertyNames.Add(text.Substring(0, num5).Trim());
						stringBuilder.Append("{" + num + ":" + text.Substring(num5 + 1).Trim() + "}");
					}
					num++;
					num2 = num4 + 1;
				}
				stringBuilder.Append(formatString.Substring(num2));
				CompiledFormatString = stringBuilder.ToString();
			}
		}

		public string CompiledFormatString { get; private set; }

		public List<string> PropertyNames { get; private set; }

		public bool References(string propertyName)
		{
			return PropertyNames.Contains(propertyName);
		}

		public string Format(object obj, ValueDelegate propertyValue)
		{
			if (CompiledFormatString == null || PropertyNames == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			object[] array = new object[PropertyNames.Count];
			for (int i = 0; i < PropertyNames.Count; i++)
			{
				string text = PropertyNames[i];
				array[i] = ((propertyValue == null) ? GetPropertyValue(obj, text) : propertyValue(obj, text));
				if (array[i] == null)
				{
					if (!(text == "0"))
					{
						return null;
					}
					array[i] = obj;
				}
			}
			try
			{
				return string.Format(CompiledFormatString, array);
			}
			catch (FormatException)
			{
				return CompiledFormatString;
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return FormatString ?? "";
		}

		internal static object GetPropertyValue(object obj, string name)
		{
			string[] array = name.Split('.');
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				if (obj == null)
				{
					break;
				}
				Match match = regex.Match(array[i]);
				string text = (match.Success ? match.Groups[1].ToString() : array[i]);
				int num = (match.Success ? int.Parse(match.Groups[2].ToString()) : (-1));
				Type type = obj.GetType();
				bool isValueType = type.IsValueType;
				if (text == "0" && isValueType)
				{
					return obj;
				}
				if (text != "")
				{
					PropertyInfo property = type.GetProperty(text);
					if (property != null)
					{
						obj = ((property != null && property.CanRead) ? property.GetValue(obj, null) : null);
					}
					else if (typeof(ICustomTypeDescriptor).IsAssignableFrom(type))
					{
						PropertyDescriptorCollection properties = TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(obj);
						obj = ((properties == null || properties[text] == null) ? null : properties[text].GetValue(obj));
					}
					else
					{
						obj = null;
					}
				}
				if (obj != null && num >= 0)
				{
					PropertyInfo property2 = type.GetProperty("Item");
					object[] index = new object[1] { num };
					obj = ((property2 != null && property2.CanRead) ? property2.GetValue(obj, index) : null);
				}
			}
			return obj;
		}
	}
	public static class StringFormatUtil
	{
		public static string Format(this string format, object obj, StringFormatter.ValueDelegate propertyValue)
		{
			return ((format != null) ? new StringFormatter
			{
				FormatString = format
			} : null)?.Format(obj, propertyValue);
		}
	}
	public static class TransformUtil
	{
		private static Point P0 = new Point(0.0, 0.0);

		private static Point PX = new Point(1.0, 0.0);

		private static Point PY = new Point(0.0, 1.0);

		public static Transform Duplicate(this Transform transform)
		{
			Transform transform2 = null;
			if (transform is MatrixTransform transform3)
			{
				transform2 = transform3.Duplicate();
			}
			if (transform is RotateTransform transform4)
			{
				transform2 = transform4.Duplicate();
			}
			if (transform is ScaleTransform transform5)
			{
				transform2 = transform5.Duplicate();
			}
			if (transform is SkewTransform transform6)
			{
				transform2 = transform6.Duplicate();
			}
			if (transform is TransformGroup transform7)
			{
				transform2 = transform7.Duplicate();
			}
			if (transform is TranslateTransform transform8)
			{
				transform2 = transform8.Duplicate();
			}
			if (transform != null && transform2 == null)
			{
				throw new NotImplementedException();
			}
			return transform2;
		}

		public static MatrixTransform Duplicate(this MatrixTransform transform)
		{
			if (transform == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new MatrixTransform
			{
				Matrix = transform.Matrix.Duplicate()
			};
		}

		public static RotateTransform Duplicate(this RotateTransform transform)
		{
			if (transform == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new RotateTransform
			{
				Angle = transform.Angle,
				CenterX = transform.CenterX,
				CenterY = transform.CenterY
			};
		}

		public static ScaleTransform Duplicate(this ScaleTransform transform)
		{
			if (transform == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new ScaleTransform
			{
				CenterX = transform.CenterX,
				CenterY = transform.CenterY,
				ScaleX = transform.ScaleX,
				ScaleY = transform.ScaleY
			};
		}

		public static SkewTransform Duplicate(this SkewTransform transform)
		{
			if (transform == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new SkewTransform
			{
				AngleX = transform.AngleX,
				AngleY = transform.AngleY,
				CenterX = transform.CenterX,
				CenterY = transform.CenterY
			};
		}

		public static TransformGroup Duplicate(this TransformGroup transform)
		{
			TransformGroup transformGroup = null;
			if (transform != null)
			{
				transformGroup = new TransformGroup();
				foreach (Transform child in transform.Children)
				{
					transformGroup.Children.Add(child.Duplicate());
				}
			}
			return transformGroup;
		}

		public static TranslateTransform Duplicate(this TranslateTransform transform)
		{
			if (transform == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new TranslateTransform
			{
				X = transform.X,
				Y = transform.Y
			};
		}

		public static MatrixTransform SetProjectionMatrix(this MatrixTransform matrixTransform, Rect source, Rect target)
		{
			double left = target.Left;
			double num = target.Left + target.Width;
			double num2 = target.Top + target.Height;
			double top = target.Top;
			double left2 = source.Left;
			double num3 = source.Left + source.Width;
			double num4 = source.Top + source.Height;
			double top2 = source.Top;
			double num5 = (num - left) / (num3 - left2);
			double m = 0.0;
			double offsetX = (0.0 - left2) * num5 + left;
			double m2 = 0.0;
			double num6 = (top - num2) / (top2 - num4);
			double offsetY = (0.0 - num4) * num6 + num2;
			matrixTransform.Matrix = new Matrix(num5, m2, m, num6, offsetX, offsetY);
			return matrixTransform;
		}

		public static Matrix GetMatrix(this GeneralTransform transform)
		{
			if (transform is MatrixTransform matrixTransform)
			{
				return matrixTransform.Matrix.Duplicate();
			}
			Point point = transform.Transform(P0);
			Point point2 = transform.Transform(PX);
			Point point3 = transform.Transform(PY);
			return new Matrix(point2.X - point.X, point3.X - point.X, point2.Y - point.Y, point3.Y - point.Y, point.X, point.Y);
		}

		public static MatrixTransform GetInverse(this GeneralTransform transform)
		{
			return new MatrixTransform
			{
				Matrix = transform.GetMatrix().GetInverse()
			};
		}

		public static Rect Transform(this GeneralTransform generalTransform, Rect rect)
		{
			Point point = generalTransform.Transform(new Point(rect.Left, rect.Top));
			Point point2 = generalTransform.Transform(new Point(rect.Right, rect.Bottom));
			return new Rect(point, point2);
		}
	}
	public static class TypeUtil
	{
		public static TypeConverter GetTypeConverter(this Type type)
		{
			object[] customAttributes = type.GetCustomAttributes(typeof(TypeConverterAttribute), inherit: true);
			TypeConverterAttribute typeConverterAttribute = ((customAttributes != null && customAttributes.Length != 0) ? (customAttributes[0] as TypeConverterAttribute) : null);
			Type type2 = ((typeConverterAttribute != null) ? Type.GetType(typeConverterAttribute.ConverterTypeName) : null);
			if (!(type2 != null))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return Activator.CreateInstance(type2) as TypeConverter;
		}

		public static object ChangeType(this Type type, object value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return value;
			}
			Type type2 = value.GetType();
			object obj = (type.IsAssignableFrom(type2) ? value : null);
			if (obj == null)
			{
				try
				{
					obj = Convert.ChangeType(value, type, null);
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
			if (obj == null)
			{
				TypeConverter typeConverter = type.GetTypeConverter();
				if (typeConverter != null && typeConverter.CanConvertFrom(type2))
				{
					try
					{
						obj = typeConverter.ConvertFrom(value);
					}
					catch
					{
					}
				}
			}
			if (obj == null)
			{
				TypeConverter typeConverter2 = type2.GetTypeConverter();
				if (typeConverter2 != null && typeConverter2.CanConvertTo(type))
				{
					try
					{
						obj = typeConverter2.ConvertTo(value, type);
					}
					catch
					{
					}
				}
			}
			return obj;
		}
	}
	public sealed class InteractionHelper
	{
		private const double SequentialClickThresholdInMilliseconds = 500.0;

		private const double SequentialClickThresholdInPixelsSquared = 9.0;

		private IUpdateVisualState _updateVisualState;

		public Control Control { get; private set; }

		public bool IsFocused { get; private set; }

		public bool IsMouseOver { get; private set; }

		public bool IsReadOnly { get; private set; }

		public bool IsPressed { get; private set; }

		private DateTime LastClickTime { get; set; }

		private Point LastClickPosition { get; set; }

		public int ClickCount { get; private set; }

		public InteractionHelper(Control control)
		{
			Control = control;
			_updateVisualState = control as IUpdateVisualState;
			control.Loaded += OnLoaded;
			control.IsEnabledChanged += OnIsEnabledChanged;
		}

		private void UpdateVisualState(bool useTransitions)
		{
			if (_updateVisualState != null)
			{
				_updateVisualState.UpdateVisualState(useTransitions);
			}
		}

		public void UpdateVisualStateBase(bool useTransitions)
		{
			if (!Control.IsEnabled)
			{
				VisualStates.GoToState(Control, useTransitions, "Disabled", "Normal");
			}
			else if (IsReadOnly)
			{
				VisualStates.GoToState(Control, useTransitions, "ReadOnly", "Normal");
			}
			else if (IsPressed)
			{
				VisualStates.GoToState(Control, useTransitions, "Pressed", "MouseOver", "Normal");
			}
			else if (IsMouseOver)
			{
				VisualStates.GoToState(Control, useTransitions, "MouseOver", "Normal");
			}
			else
			{
				VisualStates.GoToState(Control, useTransitions, "Normal");
			}
			if (IsFocused)
			{
				VisualStates.GoToState(Control, useTransitions, "Focused", "Unfocused");
			}
			else
			{
				VisualStates.GoToState(Control, useTransitions, "Unfocused");
			}
		}

		private void OnLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateVisualState(useTransitions: false);
		}

		private void OnIsEnabledChanged(object sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!(bool)e.NewValue)
			{
				IsPressed = false;
				SetMouseOver(isOver: false);
				IsFocused = false;
			}
			UpdateVisualState(useTransitions: true);
		}

		public void OnIsReadOnlyChanged(bool value)
		{
			IsReadOnly = value;
			if (!value)
			{
				IsPressed = false;
				SetMouseOver(isOver: false);
				IsFocused = false;
			}
			UpdateVisualState(useTransitions: true);
		}

		private void SetMouseOver(bool isOver)
		{
			IsMouseOver = isOver;
		}

		public void OnApplyTemplateBase()
		{
			UpdateVisualState(useTransitions: false);
		}

		public bool AllowGotFocus(RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("e");
			}
			bool isEnabled = Control.IsEnabled;
			if (isEnabled)
			{
				IsFocused = true;
			}
			return isEnabled;
		}

		public void OnGotFocusBase()
		{
			UpdateVisualState(useTransitions: true);
		}

		public bool AllowLostFocus(RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("e");
			}
			bool isEnabled = Control.IsEnabled;
			if (isEnabled)
			{
				IsFocused = false;
			}
			return isEnabled;
		}

		public void OnLostFocusBase()
		{
			IsPressed = false;
			UpdateVisualState(useTransitions: true);
		}

		public bool AllowMouseEnter(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("e");
			}
			bool isEnabled = Control.IsEnabled;
			if (isEnabled)
			{
				SetMouseOver(isOver: true);
			}
			return isEnabled;
		}

		public void OnMouseEnterBase()
		{
			UpdateVisualState(useTransitions: true);
		}

		public bool AllowMouseLeave(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("e");
			}
			bool isEnabled = Control.IsEnabled;
			if (isEnabled)
			{
				SetMouseOver(isOver: false);
			}
			return isEnabled;
		}

		public void OnMouseLeaveBase()
		{
			UpdateVisualState(useTransitions: true);
		}

		public bool AllowMouseLeftButtonDown(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("e");
			}
			bool isEnabled = Control.IsEnabled;
			if (isEnabled)
			{
				DateTime utcNow = DateTime.UtcNow;
				Point position = e.GetPosition(Control);
				double totalMilliseconds = (utcNow - LastClickTime).TotalMilliseconds;
				Point lastClickPosition = LastClickPosition;
				double num = position.X - lastClickPosition.X;
				double num2 = position.Y - lastClickPosition.Y;
				double num3 = num * num + num2 * num2;
				if (totalMilliseconds < 500.0 && num3 < 9.0)
				{
					ClickCount++;
				}
				else
				{
					ClickCount = 1;
				}
				LastClickTime = utcNow;
				LastClickPosition = position;
				IsPressed = true;
				return isEnabled;
			}
			ClickCount = 1;
			return isEnabled;
		}

		public void OnMouseLeftButtonDownBase()
		{
			UpdateVisualState(useTransitions: true);
		}

		public bool AllowMouseLeftButtonUp(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("e");
			}
			bool isEnabled = Control.IsEnabled;
			if (isEnabled)
			{
				IsPressed = false;
			}
			return isEnabled;
		}

		public void OnMouseLeftButtonUpBase()
		{
			UpdateVisualState(useTransitions: true);
		}

		public bool AllowKeyDown(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("e");
			}
			return Control.IsEnabled;
		}

		public bool AllowKeyUp(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("e");
			}
			return Control.IsEnabled;
		}

		public static Key GetLogicalKey(FlowDirection flowDirection, Key originalKey)
		{
			Key result = originalKey;
			if (flowDirection == FlowDirection.RightToLeft)
			{
				switch (originalKey)
				{
				case Key.Left:
					result = Key.Right;
					break;
				case Key.Right:
					result = Key.Left;
					break;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public const string StateFocused = "Focused";

		public const string GroupSelection = "SelectionStates";

		public const string StateSelected = "Selected";

		public const string StateSelectedInactive = "SelectedInactive";

		public static void GoToState(Control control, bool useTransitions, params string[] stateNames)
		{
			foreach (string stateName in stateNames)
			{
				if (VisualStateManager.GoToState(control, stateName, useTransitions))
				{
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public static FrameworkElement GetImplementationRoot(DependencyObject dependencyObject)
		{
			if (1 != VisualTreeHelper.GetChildrenCount(dependencyObject))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return VisualTreeHelper.GetChild(dependencyObject, 0) as FrameworkElement;
		}

		public static VisualStateGroup TryGetVisualStateGroup(DependencyObject dependencyObject, string groupName)
		{
			FrameworkElement implementationRoot = GetImplementationRoot(dependencyObject);
			if (implementationRoot == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return (from @group in VisualStateManager.GetVisualStateGroups(implementationRoot).OfType<VisualStateGroup>()
				where string.CompareOrdinal(groupName, @group.Name) == 0
				select @group).FirstOrDefault();
		}

	internal class LabelCollisionManager
	{
		private LinkedList<LabelCollisionInfo> _labels = new LinkedList<LabelCollisionInfo>();

		private int _labelCount;

		private List<LabelCollisionInfo> _movedLabels = new List<LabelCollisionInfo>();

		private bool _stepQueued;

		private bool _stepCancelled;

		private static Random _rand = new Random();

		private int _totalSteps;

		private int _currentStep;

		private double _initialTemp;

		private double _temp;

		private int _overlappingCount;

		private bool _useOverlapAmount;

		private bool _allowLabelShifting;

		public List<LabelCollisionPlacementPositions> PreferredPlacements { get; set; }

		public Action Finished { get; set; }

		private QuadTree Tree { get; set; }

		public LabelCollisionManagerCollisionMode Mode { get; private set; }

		private IExecutionContext Execution { get; set; }

		public double PositionPadding { get; private set; }

		public int AnnealingStepCount { get; private set; }

		public int AnnealingMilliseconds { get; private set; }

		public Rect Viewport { get; private set; }

		public double Width { get; private set; }

		public double Height { get; private set; }

		public int CollisionsCount => _overlappingCount;

		public string CollisionChannel { get; internal set; }

		public object Owner { get; internal set; }

		public event CollisionManagerLabelsMovedEventHandler LabelsMoved;

		public LabelCollisionManager(double width, double height, Rect viewport, IExecutionContext execution, double positionPadding, LabelCollisionManagerCollisionMode mode, LabelCollisionPlacementPositions topPriority, int annealingStepCount, int annealingMilliseconds, bool allowLabelShifting)
		{
			Viewport = viewport;
			Width = width;
			Height = height;
			Tree = new QuadTree(width, height, 8, 8);
			Mode = mode;
			Execution = execution;
			PreferredPlacements = new List<LabelCollisionPlacementPositions>();
			PreferredPlacements.Add(LabelCollisionPlacementPositions.Top);
			PreferredPlacements.Add(LabelCollisionPlacementPositions.TopRight);
			PreferredPlacements.Add(LabelCollisionPlacementPositions.BottomRight);
			PreferredPlacements.Add(LabelCollisionPlacementPositions.Right);
			PreferredPlacements.Add(LabelCollisionPlacementPositions.Bottom);
			PreferredPlacements.Add(LabelCollisionPlacementPositions.BottomLeft);
			PreferredPlacements.Add(LabelCollisionPlacementPositions.Left);
			PreferredPlacements.Add(LabelCollisionPlacementPositions.TopLeft);
			PreferredPlacements.Remove(topPriority);
			PreferredPlacements.Insert(0, topPriority);
			PositionPadding = positionPadding;
			AnnealingStepCount = annealingStepCount;
			AnnealingMilliseconds = annealingMilliseconds;
			_allowLabelShifting = allowLabelShifting;
		}

		public QuadTreeBoundingBox TryPosition(LabelCollisionInfo info, LabelCollisionPlacementPositions position, double offsetX, double offsetY, bool overrideBoundsCheck)
		{
			double centerX = 0.0;
			double centerY = 0.0;
			switch (position)
			{
			case LabelCollisionPlacementPositions.Top:
				centerX = info.TargetX;
				centerY = info.TargetY - info.TargetHalfHeight - info.LabelHalfHeight - PositionPadding - offsetY;
				break;
			case LabelCollisionPlacementPositions.TopLeft:
				centerX = info.TargetX - info.TargetHalfWidth - info.LabelHalfWidth - PositionPadding - offsetX;
				centerY = info.TargetY - info.TargetHalfHeight - info.LabelHalfHeight - PositionPadding - offsetY;
				break;
			case LabelCollisionPlacementPositions.TopRight:
				centerX = info.TargetX + info.TargetHalfWidth + info.LabelHalfWidth + PositionPadding + offsetX;
				centerY = info.TargetY - info.TargetHalfHeight - info.LabelHalfHeight - PositionPadding - offsetY;
				break;
			case LabelCollisionPlacementPositions.Left:
				centerX = info.TargetX - info.TargetHalfWidth - info.LabelHalfWidth - PositionPadding - offsetX;
				centerY = info.TargetY;
				break;
			case LabelCollisionPlacementPositions.Right:
				centerX = info.TargetX + info.TargetHalfWidth + info.LabelHalfWidth + PositionPadding + offsetX;
				centerY = info.TargetY;
				break;
			case LabelCollisionPlacementPositions.Bottom:
				centerX = info.TargetX;
				centerY = info.TargetY + info.TargetHalfHeight + info.LabelHalfHeight + PositionPadding + offsetY;
				break;
			case LabelCollisionPlacementPositions.BottomLeft:
				centerX = info.TargetX - info.TargetHalfWidth - info.LabelHalfWidth - PositionPadding - offsetX;
				centerY = info.TargetY + info.TargetHalfHeight + info.LabelHalfHeight + PositionPadding + offsetY;
				break;
			case LabelCollisionPlacementPositions.BottomRight:
				centerX = info.TargetX + info.TargetHalfWidth + info.LabelHalfWidth + PositionPadding + offsetX;
				centerY = info.TargetY + info.TargetHalfHeight + info.LabelHalfHeight + PositionPadding - offsetY;
				break;
			}
			QuadTreeBoundingBox quadTreeBoundingBox = new QuadTreeBoundingBox();
			quadTreeBoundingBox.CenterX = centerX;
			quadTreeBoundingBox.CenterY = centerY;
			quadTreeBoundingBox.HalfWidth = info.LabelHalfWidth;
			quadTreeBoundingBox.HalfHeight = info.LabelHalfHeight;
			quadTreeBoundingBox.Data = info;
			if (CollidesWithEdge(quadTreeBoundingBox) && !overrideBoundsCheck)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return quadTreeBoundingBox;
		}

		private bool CollidesWithEdge(QuadTreeBoundingBox box)
		{
			double num = box.CenterX - box.HalfWidth;
			double num2 = box.CenterX + box.HalfWidth;
			double num3 = box.CenterY - box.HalfHeight;
			double num4 = box.CenterY + box.HalfHeight;
			Rect viewport = Viewport;
			if (num < viewport.Left || num2 > viewport.Right || num3 < viewport.Top || num4 > viewport.Bottom)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void MoveBox(QuadTreeBoundingBox box, double centerX, double centerY, double halfWidth, double halfHeight)
		{
			DoMoveBox(box, centerX, centerY, halfWidth, halfHeight);
		}

		private void DoMoveBox(QuadTreeBoundingBox box, double centerX, double centerY, double halfWidth, double halfHeight)
		{
			Tree.Remove(box);
			box.CenterX = centerX;
			box.CenterY = centerY;
			box.HalfWidth = halfWidth;
			box.HalfHeight = halfHeight;
			Tree.Insert(box);
		}

		public void RemoveBox(QuadTreeBoundingBox box)
		{
			Tree.Remove(box);
		}

		public void AddLabel(LabelCollisionInfo label)
		{
			_labelCount++;
			_labels.AddLast(label);
			label.LabelNode = _labels.Last;
			if (label.TargetBox == null)
			{
				label.TargetBox = new QuadTreeBoundingBox();
				label.TargetBox.CenterX = label.TargetX;
				label.TargetBox.CenterY = label.TargetY;
				label.TargetBox.HalfWidth = label.TargetHalfWidth;
				label.TargetBox.HalfHeight = label.TargetHalfHeight;
				label.TargetBox.Data = label;
				Tree.Insert(label.TargetBox);
			}
		}

		public void RemoveLabel(LabelCollisionInfo label)
		{
			if (label.TargetBox != null)
			{
				Tree.Remove(label.TargetBox);
				label.TargetBox = null;
			}
			if (label.ActualLabelBox != null)
			{
				Tree.Remove(label.ActualLabelBox);
				label.ActualLabelBox = null;
			}
			if (label.LabelNode != null)
			{
				_labels.Remove(label.LabelNode);
				label.LabelNode = null;
			}
			_labelCount--;
		}

		public void MoveTarget(LabelCollisionInfo label)
		{
			if (label.TargetBox != null && label.TargetBox.CenterX == label.TargetX && label.TargetBox.CenterY == label.TargetY)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (label.TargetBox != null)
			{
				Tree.Remove(label.TargetBox);
			}
			double num = double.NaN;
			double num2 = double.NaN;
			if (label.TargetBox == null)
			{
				label.TargetBox = new QuadTreeBoundingBox();
				label.TargetBox.Data = label;
			}
			else if (label.ActualLabelBox != null)
			{
				num = label.ActualLabelBox.CenterX - label.TargetBox.CenterX;
				num2 = label.ActualLabelBox.CenterY - label.TargetBox.CenterY;
			}
			label.TargetBox.CenterX = label.TargetX;
			label.TargetBox.CenterY = label.TargetY;
			label.TargetBox.HalfWidth = label.TargetHalfWidth;
			label.TargetBox.HalfHeight = label.TargetHalfHeight;
			Tree.Insert(label.TargetBox);
			if (label.ActualLabelBox != null)
			{
				Tree.Remove(label.ActualLabelBox);
				if (!double.IsNaN(num))
				{
					label.ActualLabelBox = new QuadTreeBoundingBox();
					label.ActualLabelBox.CenterX = label.TargetBox.CenterX + num;
					label.ActualLabelBox.CenterY = label.TargetBox.CenterY + num2;
					label.ActualLabelBox.Data = label;
					label.ActualLabelBox.HalfWidth = label.LabelHalfWidth;
					label.ActualLabelBox.HalfHeight = label.LabelHalfHeight;
					label.ActualCenterX = label.ActualLabelBox.CenterX;
					label.ActualCenterY = label.ActualLabelBox.CenterY;
					Tree.Insert(label.ActualLabelBox);
				}
				else
				{
					label.ActualLabelBox = TryPosition(label, label.ActualPosition, 0.0, 0.0, overrideBoundsCheck: true);
					label.ActualCenterX = label.ActualLabelBox.CenterX;
					label.ActualCenterY = label.ActualLabelBox.CenterY;
					Tree.Insert(label.ActualLabelBox);
				}
			}
		}

		public void MoveLabel(LabelCollisionInfo label)
		{
			Tree.Remove(label.ActualLabelBox);
			label.ActualLabelBox.CenterX = label.ActualCenterX;
			label.ActualLabelBox.CenterY = label.ActualCenterY;
			label.ActualLabelBox.HalfWidth = label.LabelHalfWidth;
			label.ActualLabelBox.HalfHeight = label.LabelHalfHeight;
			Tree.Insert(label.ActualLabelBox);
		}

		public void StartCollision()
		{
			_stepCancelled = false;
			for (LinkedListNode<LabelCollisionInfo> linkedListNode = _labels.First; linkedListNode != null; linkedListNode = linkedListNode.Next)
			{
				if (linkedListNode.Value.ActualLabelBox != null)
				{
					Tree.Remove(linkedListNode.Value.ActualLabelBox);
					linkedListNode.Value.ActualLabelBox = null;
					if (linkedListNode.Value.CollidesWith != null)
					{
						linkedListNode.Value.CollidesWith.Clear();
					}
				}
			}
			_overlappingCount = 0;
			_currentStep = 0;
			_initialTemp = 0.4;
			_temp = 0.4;
			int totalSteps = (int)Math.Ceiling((double)AnnealingMilliseconds / 150.0 * (double)AnnealingStepCount);
			_totalSteps = totalSteps;
			CollisionStep();
		}

		public void ClearMovedLabelsCache()
		{
			_movedLabels.Clear();
		}

		public void Cancel()
		{
			_stepCancelled = true;
		}

		private void DoCollisionStep()
		{
			_stepQueued = false;
			if (!_stepCancelled)
			{
				CollisionStep();
			}
		}

		private void CollisionStep()
		{
			_movedLabels.Clear();
			PlaceUnplaced(byCenterOfMass: false);
			if (Mode == LabelCollisionManagerCollisionMode.SimulatedAnnealing)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < AnnealingStepCount; i++)
				{
					_temp = _initialTemp * (double)(_totalSteps - _currentStep) / (double)_totalSteps;
					DoAnnealingStep();
					_currentStep++;
					if (_currentStep > _totalSteps)
					{
						if (Finished != null)
						{
							Finished();
						}
						return;
					}
				}
				if (this.LabelsMoved != null)
				{
					this.LabelsMoved(_movedLabels);
				}
				if (_overlappingCount > 0)
				{
					if (!_stepQueued)
					{
						_stepQueued = true;
						Execution.ExecuteDelayed(DoCollisionStep, 150);
					}
				}
				else if (Finished != null)
				{
					Finished();
				}
				return;
			}
			if (Mode == LabelCollisionManagerCollisionMode.GreedyCenterOfMass)
			{
				LinkedListNode<LabelCollisionInfo> linkedListNode = _labels.First;
				Tree.UpdateCenterOfMass();
				while (linkedListNode != null)
				{
					LabelCollisionInfo value = linkedListNode.Value;
					if (value.ActualLabelBox != null)
					{
						Tree.Remove(value.ActualLabelBox);
						value.ActualLabelBox = null;
						value.Colliding = false;
						value.CollidesWith = null;
					}
					linkedListNode = linkedListNode.Next;
				}
				_overlappingCount = 0;
				PlaceUnplaced(byCenterOfMass: true);
			}
			if (this.LabelsMoved != null)
			{
				this.LabelsMoved(_movedLabels);
			}
		}

		private void DoAnnealingStep()
		{
			int num = (int)Math.Round((double)(_labelCount - 1) * _rand.NextDouble());
			int num2 = 0;
			LinkedListNode<LabelCollisionInfo> linkedListNode = _labels.First;
			double score = GetScore(null);
			int num3 = 30;
			int num4 = 60;
			while (linkedListNode != null)
			{
				LabelCollisionInfo value = linkedListNode.Value;
				double offsetX = 0.0;
				double offsetY = 0.0;
				if (_allowLabelShifting)
				{
					offsetX = _rand.NextDouble() * value.LabelHalfWidth * 2.0;
					offsetY = _rand.NextDouble() * value.LabelHalfHeight * 2.0;
				}
				if (num2 == num)
				{
					int index = (int)Math.Round((double)(PreferredPlacements.Count - 1) * _rand.NextDouble());
					while (PreferredPlacements[index] == value.ActualPosition)
					{
						index = (int)Math.Round((double)(PreferredPlacements.Count - 1) * _rand.NextDouble());
					}
					QuadTreeBoundingBox actualLabelBox = value.ActualLabelBox;
					QuadTreeBoundingBox quadTreeBoundingBox = TryPosition(value, PreferredPlacements[index], offsetX, offsetY, overrideBoundsCheck: false);
					int num5 = 0;
					while (quadTreeBoundingBox == null)
					{
						if (num5 >= num3)
						{
							offsetX = 0.0;
							offsetY = 0.0;
						}
						if (num5 >= num4)
						{
							break;
						}
						index = (int)Math.Round((double)(PreferredPlacements.Count - 1) * _rand.NextDouble());
						quadTreeBoundingBox = TryPosition(value, PreferredPlacements[index], offsetX, offsetY, overrideBoundsCheck: false);
						num5++;
					}
					value.ActualLabelBox = quadTreeBoundingBox;
					if (actualLabelBox != null)
					{
						Tree.Remove(actualLabelBox);
					}
					if (quadTreeBoundingBox != null)
					{
						Tree.Insert(quadTreeBoundingBox);
						double score2 = GetScore(value);
						bool flag = score > score2;
						if (!flag)
						{
							double num6 = Math.Exp((0.0 - (score2 - score)) / _temp);
							if (_rand.NextDouble() < num6)
							{
								flag = true;
							}
						}
						if (!flag && actualLabelBox != null)
						{
							Tree.Remove(quadTreeBoundingBox);
							Tree.Insert(actualLabelBox);
							value.ActualLabelBox = actualLabelBox;
							if (!_useOverlapAmount)
							{
								GetScore(value);
							}
						}
						else
						{
							value.ActualPosition = PreferredPlacements[index];
							value.ActualCenterX = value.ActualLabelBox.CenterX;
							value.ActualCenterY = value.ActualLabelBox.CenterY;
							_movedLabels.Add(value);
						}
					}
					else
					{
						if (!_useOverlapAmount)
						{
							GetScore(value);
						}
						value.Colliding = false;
						_movedLabels.Add(value);
					}
					break;
				}
				num2++;
				linkedListNode = linkedListNode.Next;
			}
		}

		private double GetScore(LabelCollisionInfo label)
		{
			if (_useOverlapAmount)
			{
				double num = 0.0;
				for (LinkedListNode<LabelCollisionInfo> linkedListNode = _labels.First; linkedListNode != null; linkedListNode = linkedListNode.Next)
				{
					LabelCollisionInfo value = linkedListNode.Value;
					bool colliding = value.Colliding;
					value.Colliding = false;
					if (value.ActualLabelBox != null)
					{
						List<QuadTreeNode> list = Tree.FindLeaves(value.ActualLabelBox);
						for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
						{
							LinkedListNode<QuadTreeBoundingBox> linkedListNode2 = list[i].Points.First;
							while (linkedListNode2 != null)
							{
								QuadTreeBoundingBox value2 = linkedListNode2.Value;
								if (value2.Data == value)
								{
									linkedListNode2 = linkedListNode2.Next;
									continue;
								}
								if (value.ActualLabelBox.Intersect(value2))
								{
									value.Colliding = true;
									num += value.ActualLabelBox.InsersectionArea(value2);
								}
								linkedListNode2 = linkedListNode2.Next;
							}
						}
						if (value.Colliding != colliding)
						{
							_movedLabels.Add(value);
						}
					}
				}
				return num;
			}
			if (label != null)
			{
				HashSet<LabelCollisionInfo> hashSet = new HashSet<LabelCollisionInfo>();
				HashSet<LabelCollisionInfo> hashSet2 = new HashSet<LabelCollisionInfo>();
				HashSet<LabelCollisionInfo> hashSet3 = new HashSet<LabelCollisionInfo>();
				List<LabelCollisionInfo> list2 = new List<LabelCollisionInfo>();
				if (label.CollidesWith != null)
				{
					for (int j = 0; j < label.CollidesWith.Count; j++)
					{
						hashSet.Add(label.CollidesWith[j]);
						hashSet2.Add(label.CollidesWith[j]);
					}
				}
				bool colliding2 = label.Colliding;
				label.Colliding = false;
				if (label.ActualLabelBox != null)
				{
					List<QuadTreeNode> list3 = Tree.FindLeaves(label.ActualLabelBox);
					for (int k = 0; k < list3.Count; k++)
					{
						LinkedListNode<QuadTreeBoundingBox> linkedListNode3 = list3[k].Points.First;
						while (linkedListNode3 != null)
						{
							QuadTreeBoundingBox value3 = linkedListNode3.Value;
							if (value3.Data == label)
							{
								linkedListNode3 = linkedListNode3.Next;
								continue;
							}
							if (label.ActualLabelBox.Intersect(value3) && !hashSet3.Contains((LabelCollisionInfo)value3.Data))
							{
								label.Colliding = true;
								hashSet3.Add((LabelCollisionInfo)value3.Data);
								list2.Add((LabelCollisionInfo)value3.Data);
							}
							linkedListNode3 = linkedListNode3.Next;
						}
					}
					list3 = Tree.FindLeaves(label.TargetBox);
					for (int l = 0; l < list3.Count; l++)
					{
						LinkedListNode<QuadTreeBoundingBox> linkedListNode4 = list3[l].Points.First;
						while (linkedListNode4 != null)
						{
							QuadTreeBoundingBox value4 = linkedListNode4.Value;
							if (value4.Data == label)
							{
								linkedListNode4 = linkedListNode4.Next;
								continue;
							}
							if (BothTargets(label.TargetBox, value4))
							{
								linkedListNode4 = linkedListNode4.Next;
								continue;
							}
							if (label.TargetBox.Intersect(value4) && !hashSet3.Contains((LabelCollisionInfo)value4.Data))
							{
								label.Colliding = true;
								hashSet3.Add((LabelCollisionInfo)value4.Data);
								list2.Add((LabelCollisionInfo)value4.Data);
							}
							linkedListNode4 = linkedListNode4.Next;
						}
					}
					if (label.Colliding != colliding2)
					{
						_movedLabels.Add(label);
					}
					if (label.CollidesWith != null)
					{
						for (int num2 = label.CollidesWith.Count - 1; num2 >= 0; num2--)
						{
							if (!hashSet3.Contains(label.CollidesWith[num2]))
							{
								LabelCollisionInfo labelCollisionInfo = label.CollidesWith[num2];
								bool flag = labelCollisionInfo.CollidesWith.Remove(label);
								label.CollidesWith.RemoveAt(num2);
								if (labelCollisionInfo.CollidesWith.Count == 0 && flag)
								{
									_overlappingCount--;
								}
								bool flag2 = hashSet.Remove(labelCollisionInfo);
								if (hashSet.Count == 0 && flag2)
								{
									_overlappingCount--;
								}
							}
						}
					}
					for (int m = 0; m < list2.Count; m++)
					{
						LabelCollisionInfo labelCollisionInfo2 = list2[m];
						if (!hashSet.Contains(labelCollisionInfo2))
						{
							if (label.CollidesWith == null)
							{
								label.CollidesWith = new List<LabelCollisionInfo>();
							}
							label.CollidesWith.Add(labelCollisionInfo2);
							if (hashSet.Count == 0)
							{
								_overlappingCount++;
							}
							hashSet.Add(labelCollisionInfo2);
							if (labelCollisionInfo2.CollidesWith == null)
							{
								labelCollisionInfo2.CollidesWith = new List<LabelCollisionInfo>();
							}
							if (labelCollisionInfo2.CollidesWith.Count == 0)
							{
								_overlappingCount++;
							}
							labelCollisionInfo2.CollidesWith.Add(label);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return _overlappingCount;
		}

		private bool BothTargets(QuadTreeBoundingBox targetBox, QuadTreeBoundingBox testBox)
		{
			if (((LabelCollisionInfo)targetBox.Data).TargetBox == targetBox && ((LabelCollisionInfo)testBox.Data).TargetBox == testBox)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void Resize(double width, double height, Rect viewport)
		{
			Viewport = viewport;
			QuadTree quadTree = new QuadTree(width, height, Tree.MaxDepth, Tree.Capacity);
			for (LinkedListNode<LabelCollisionInfo> linkedListNode = _labels.First; linkedListNode != null; linkedListNode = linkedListNode.Next)
			{
				quadTree.Insert(linkedListNode.Value.TargetBox);
				if (linkedListNode.Value.ActualLabelBox != null)
				{
					quadTree.Insert(linkedListNode.Value.ActualLabelBox);
				}
			}
			Tree = quadTree;
			Width = width;
			Height = height;
		}

		public bool HasBoundaryCollisions()
		{
			for (LinkedListNode<LabelCollisionInfo> linkedListNode = _labels.First; linkedListNode != null; linkedListNode = linkedListNode.Next)
			{
				linkedListNode.Value.Colliding = false;
				if (linkedListNode.Value.ActualLabelBox != null && CollidesWithEdge(linkedListNode.Value.ActualLabelBox))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public int GetCurrentCollisionCount()
		{
			for (LinkedListNode<LabelCollisionInfo> linkedListNode = _labels.First; linkedListNode != null; linkedListNode = linkedListNode.Next)
			{
				linkedListNode.Value.Colliding = false;
			}
			for (LinkedListNode<LabelCollisionInfo> linkedListNode = _labels.First; linkedListNode != null; linkedListNode = linkedListNode.Next)
			{
				QuadTreeBoundingBox actualLabelBox = linkedListNode.Value.ActualLabelBox;
				QuadTreeBoundingBox targetBox = linkedListNode.Value.TargetBox;
				List<QuadTreeNode> list = Tree.FindLeaves(targetBox);
				for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
				{
					LinkedListNode<QuadTreeBoundingBox> linkedListNode2 = list[i].Points.First;
					while (linkedListNode2 != null)
					{
						QuadTreeBoundingBox value = linkedListNode2.Value;
						if (BothTargets(targetBox, value))
						{
							linkedListNode2 = linkedListNode2.Next;
							continue;
						}
						if (targetBox.Intersect(value))
						{
							LabelCollisionInfo labelCollisionInfo = (LabelCollisionInfo)linkedListNode2.Value.Data;
							if (labelCollisionInfo != linkedListNode.Value)
							{
								labelCollisionInfo.Colliding = true;
								linkedListNode.Value.Colliding = true;
							}
						}
						linkedListNode2 = linkedListNode2.Next;
					}
				}
				if (actualLabelBox == null)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				list = Tree.FindLeaves(actualLabelBox);
				for (int j = 0; j < list.Count; j++)
				{
					for (LinkedListNode<QuadTreeBoundingBox> linkedListNode3 = list[j].Points.First; linkedListNode3 != null; linkedListNode3 = linkedListNode3.Next)
					{
						QuadTreeBoundingBox value2 = linkedListNode3.Value;
						if (actualLabelBox.Intersect(value2))
						{
							LabelCollisionInfo labelCollisionInfo2 = (LabelCollisionInfo)linkedListNode3.Value.Data;
							if (labelCollisionInfo2 != linkedListNode.Value)
							{
								labelCollisionInfo2.Colliding = true;
								linkedListNode.Value.Colliding = true;
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			int num = 0;
			for (LinkedListNode<LabelCollisionInfo> linkedListNode = _labels.First; linkedListNode != null; linkedListNode = linkedListNode.Next)
			{
				if (linkedListNode.Value.Colliding)
				{
					num++;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		private void PlaceUnplaced(bool byCenterOfMass)
		{
			for (LinkedListNode<LabelCollisionInfo> linkedListNode = _labels.First; linkedListNode != null; linkedListNode = linkedListNode.Next)
			{
				LabelCollisionInfo value = linkedListNode.Value;
				if (value.ActualLabelBox == null || byCenterOfMass)
				{
					bool flag = false;
					if (byCenterOfMass)
					{
						QuadTreeForceVector forceVectorForPoint = Tree.GetForceVectorForPoint(value.TargetX, value.TargetY, 1.5);
						LabelCollisionPlacementPositions[] placementIndicesForForceVector = GetPlacementIndicesForForceVector(forceVectorForPoint);
						foreach (LabelCollisionPlacementPositions labelCollisionPlacementPositions in placementIndicesForForceVector)
						{
							QuadTreeBoundingBox quadTreeBoundingBox = TryPosition(value, labelCollisionPlacementPositions, 0.0, 0.0, overrideBoundsCheck: false);
							if (quadTreeBoundingBox == null)
							{
								continue;
							}
							List<QuadTreeNode> list = Tree.FindLeaves(quadTreeBoundingBox);
							flag = true;
							for (int j = 0; j < list.Count; j++)
							{
								for (LinkedListNode<QuadTreeBoundingBox> linkedListNode2 = list[j].Points.First; linkedListNode2 != null; linkedListNode2 = linkedListNode2.Next)
								{
									QuadTreeBoundingBox value2 = linkedListNode2.Value;
									if (quadTreeBoundingBox.Intersect(value2))
									{
										flag = false;
										break;
									}
								}
							}
							if (flag)
							{
								value.ActualLabelBox = quadTreeBoundingBox;
								value.ActualPosition = labelCollisionPlacementPositions;
								value.ActualCenterX = value.ActualLabelBox.CenterX;
								value.ActualCenterY = value.ActualLabelBox.CenterY;
								Tree.Insert(value.ActualLabelBox);
								_movedLabels.Add(value);
								break;
							}
						}
					}
					if (!flag)
					{
						flag = FindOptimisticPosition(value);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool FindOptimisticPosition(LabelCollisionInfo info)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			if (!flag)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < PreferredPlacements.Count; i++)
				{
					QuadTreeBoundingBox quadTreeBoundingBox = TryPosition(info, PreferredPlacements[i], 0.0, 0.0, overrideBoundsCheck: false);
					if (quadTreeBoundingBox != null)
					{
						flag = !CheckCollision(quadTreeBoundingBox, info);
						QuadTreeBoundingBox quadTreeBoundingBox2 = info.TargetBox;
						if (quadTreeBoundingBox2 == null)
						{
							quadTreeBoundingBox2 = new QuadTreeBoundingBox();
							quadTreeBoundingBox2.Data = info;
							quadTreeBoundingBox2.CenterX = info.TargetX;
							quadTreeBoundingBox2.CenterY = info.TargetY;
							quadTreeBoundingBox2.HalfWidth = info.TargetHalfWidth;
							quadTreeBoundingBox2.HalfHeight = info.TargetHalfHeight;
							Tree.Insert(quadTreeBoundingBox2);
							info.TargetBox = quadTreeBoundingBox2;
						}
						bool flag2 = CheckCollision(quadTreeBoundingBox2, info);
						flag = flag && !flag2;
						if (flag)
						{
							info.ActualLabelBox = quadTreeBoundingBox;
							info.ActualPosition = PreferredPlacements[i];
							info.ActualCenterX = info.ActualLabelBox.CenterX;
							info.ActualCenterY = info.ActualLabelBox.CenterY;
							Tree.Insert(info.ActualLabelBox);
							_movedLabels.Add(info);
							break;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				double num = double.PositiveInfinity;
				int index = 0;
				List<LabelCollisionInfo> list = null;
				for (int j = 0; j < PreferredPlacements.Count; j++)
				{
					double num2 = 0.0;
					List<LabelCollisionInfo> list2 = null;
					HashSet<LabelCollisionInfo> hashSet = new HashSet<LabelCollisionInfo>();
					if (!_useOverlapAmount)
					{
						list2 = new List<LabelCollisionInfo>();
					}
					QuadTreeBoundingBox quadTreeBoundingBox3 = TryPosition(info, PreferredPlacements[j], 0.0, 0.0, overrideBoundsCheck: false);
					if (quadTreeBoundingBox3 == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					List<QuadTreeNode> list3 = Tree.FindLeaves(quadTreeBoundingBox3);
					for (int k = 0; k < list3.Count; k++)
					{
						for (LinkedListNode<QuadTreeBoundingBox> linkedListNode = list3[k].Points.First; linkedListNode != null; linkedListNode = linkedListNode.Next)
						{
							QuadTreeBoundingBox value = linkedListNode.Value;
							if (quadTreeBoundingBox3.Intersect(value))
							{
								num2 += quadTreeBoundingBox3.InsersectionArea(value);
								if (!_useOverlapAmount && !hashSet.Contains((LabelCollisionInfo)value.Data))
								{
									list2.Add((LabelCollisionInfo)value.Data);
									hashSet.Add((LabelCollisionInfo)value.Data);
								}
							}
						}
					}
					QuadTreeBoundingBox quadTreeBoundingBox4 = info.TargetBox;
					if (quadTreeBoundingBox4 == null)
					{
						quadTreeBoundingBox4 = new QuadTreeBoundingBox();
						quadTreeBoundingBox4.Data = info;
						quadTreeBoundingBox4.CenterX = info.TargetX;
						quadTreeBoundingBox4.CenterY = info.TargetY;
						quadTreeBoundingBox4.HalfWidth = info.TargetHalfWidth;
						quadTreeBoundingBox4.HalfHeight = info.TargetHalfHeight;
					}
					list3 = Tree.FindLeaves(quadTreeBoundingBox4);
					for (int l = 0; l < list3.Count; l++)
					{
						LinkedListNode<QuadTreeBoundingBox> linkedListNode2 = list3[l].Points.First;
						while (linkedListNode2 != null)
						{
							QuadTreeBoundingBox value2 = linkedListNode2.Value;
							if (linkedListNode2.Value.Data == info)
							{
								linkedListNode2 = linkedListNode2.Next;
								continue;
							}
							if (BothTargets(quadTreeBoundingBox4, value2))
							{
								linkedListNode2 = linkedListNode2.Next;
								continue;
							}
							if (quadTreeBoundingBox4.Intersect(value2) && !_useOverlapAmount && !hashSet.Contains((LabelCollisionInfo)value2.Data))
							{
								list2.Add((LabelCollisionInfo)value2.Data);
								hashSet.Add((LabelCollisionInfo)value2.Data);
							}
							linkedListNode2 = linkedListNode2.Next;
						}
					}
					if (num2 < num && TryPosition(info, PreferredPlacements[j], 0.0, 0.0, overrideBoundsCheck: false) != null)
					{
						num = num2;
						index = j;
						if (!_useOverlapAmount)
						{
							list = list2;
						}
					}
				}
				QuadTreeBoundingBox actualLabelBox = TryPosition(info, PreferredPlacements[index], 0.0, 0.0, overrideBoundsCheck: false);
				info.Colliding = true;
				if (!_useOverlapAmount)
				{
					if (info.CollidesWith != null && info.CollidesWith.Count > 0)
					{
						_overlappingCount--;
						for (int num3 = info.CollidesWith.Count - 1; num3 >= 0; num3--)
						{
							LabelCollisionInfo labelCollisionInfo = info.CollidesWith[num3];
							if (labelCollisionInfo.CollidesWith != null)
							{
								labelCollisionInfo.CollidesWith.Remove(info);
								if (labelCollisionInfo.CollidesWith.Count == 0)
								{
									_overlappingCount--;
								}
							}
						}
					}
					if (list == null)
					{
						info.Colliding = false;
						_movedLabels.Add(info);
						return false;
					}
					info.CollidesWith = list;
					if (list.Count > 0)
					{
						_overlappingCount++;
					}
					for (int m = 0; m < list.Count; m++)
					{
						LabelCollisionInfo labelCollisionInfo2 = list[m];
						if (labelCollisionInfo2.CollidesWith == null)
						{
							labelCollisionInfo2.CollidesWith = new List<LabelCollisionInfo>();
						}
						if (!labelCollisionInfo2.CollidesWith.Contains(info))
						{
							if (labelCollisionInfo2.CollidesWith.Count == 0)
							{
								_overlappingCount++;
							}
							labelCollisionInfo2.CollidesWith.Add(info);
						}
					}
				}
				info.ActualLabelBox = actualLabelBox;
				info.ActualPosition = PreferredPlacements[index];
				info.ActualCenterX = info.ActualLabelBox.CenterX;
				info.ActualCenterY = info.ActualLabelBox.CenterY;
				Tree.Insert(info.ActualLabelBox);
				_movedLabels.Add(info);
			}
			return flag;
		}

		private bool CheckCollision(QuadTreeBoundingBox box, LabelCollisionInfo info)
		{
			bool result = false;
			List<QuadTreeNode> list = Tree.FindLeaves(box);
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				LinkedListNode<QuadTreeBoundingBox> linkedListNode = list[i].Points.First;
				while (linkedListNode != null)
				{
					if (linkedListNode.Value.Data == info)
					{
						linkedListNode = linkedListNode.Next;
						continue;
					}
					QuadTreeBoundingBox value = linkedListNode.Value;
					if (BothTargets(box, value))
					{
						linkedListNode = linkedListNode.Next;
						continue;
					}
					if (box.Intersect(value))
					{
						result = true;
						break;
					}
					linkedListNode = linkedListNode.Next;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private LabelCollisionPlacementPositions[] GetPlacementIndicesForForceVector(QuadTreeForceVector forceVector)
		{
			LabelCollisionPlacementPositions[] array = new LabelCollisionPlacementPositions[3];
			double angleTo = GeometryUtil.GetAngleTo(new Point(0.0, 0.0), new Point(forceVector.X, forceVector.Y));
			angleTo = angleTo * 180.0 / Math.PI;
			angleTo = GeometryUtil.SimplifyAngle(angleTo);
			if ((angleTo >= 0.0 && angleTo <= 22.5) || (angleTo >= 337.5 && angleTo <= 360.0))
			{
				array[0] = LabelCollisionPlacementPositions.Right;
				array[1] = LabelCollisionPlacementPositions.TopRight;
				array[2] = LabelCollisionPlacementPositions.BottomRight;
			}
			if (angleTo >= 22.5 && angleTo <= 67.5)
			{
				array[0] = LabelCollisionPlacementPositions.Right;
				array[1] = LabelCollisionPlacementPositions.BottomRight;
				array[2] = LabelCollisionPlacementPositions.Bottom;
			}
			if (angleTo >= 67.5 && angleTo <= 112.5)
			{
				array[0] = LabelCollisionPlacementPositions.BottomRight;
				array[1] = LabelCollisionPlacementPositions.Bottom;
				array[2] = LabelCollisionPlacementPositions.BottomLeft;
			}
			if (angleTo >= 112.5 && angleTo <= 157.5)
			{
				array[0] = LabelCollisionPlacementPositions.Bottom;
				array[1] = LabelCollisionPlacementPositions.BottomLeft;
				array[2] = LabelCollisionPlacementPositions.Left;
			}
			if (angleTo >= 157.5 && angleTo <= 202.5)
			{
				array[0] = LabelCollisionPlacementPositions.BottomLeft;
				array[1] = LabelCollisionPlacementPositions.Left;
				array[2] = LabelCollisionPlacementPositions.TopLeft;
			}
			if (angleTo >= 202.5 && angleTo <= 247.5)
			{
				array[0] = LabelCollisionPlacementPositions.Left;
				array[1] = LabelCollisionPlacementPositions.TopLeft;
				array[2] = LabelCollisionPlacementPositions.Top;
			}
			if (angleTo >= 247.5 && angleTo <= 292.5)
			{
				array[0] = LabelCollisionPlacementPositions.TopLeft;
				array[1] = LabelCollisionPlacementPositions.Top;
				array[2] = LabelCollisionPlacementPositions.TopRight;
			}
			if (angleTo >= 292.5 && angleTo <= 337.5)
			{
				array[0] = LabelCollisionPlacementPositions.Top;
				array[1] = LabelCollisionPlacementPositions.TopRight;
				array[2] = LabelCollisionPlacementPositions.Right;
			}
			return array;
		}

		public LabelCollisionInfo TestHit(Point position, bool isFinger)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			QuadTreeBoundingBox quadTreeBoundingBox = null;
			QuadTreeBoundingBox quadTreeBoundingBox2 = new QuadTreeBoundingBox();
			quadTreeBoundingBox2.CenterX = position.X;
			quadTreeBoundingBox2.CenterY = position.Y;
			quadTreeBoundingBox2.HalfWidth = 5.0;
			quadTreeBoundingBox2.HalfHeight = 5.0;
			List<QuadTreeNode> list = Tree.FindLeaves(quadTreeBoundingBox2);
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				LinkedListNode<QuadTreeBoundingBox> linkedListNode = list[i].Points.First;
				while (linkedListNode != null)
				{
					QuadTreeBoundingBox value = linkedListNode.Value;
					if (((LabelCollisionInfo)value.Data).TargetBox == value)
					{
						linkedListNode = linkedListNode.Next;
						continue;
					}
					if (quadTreeBoundingBox2.Intersect(value))
					{
						quadTreeBoundingBox = value;
						flag = true;
						break;
					}
					linkedListNode = linkedListNode.Next;
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				return (LabelCollisionInfo)quadTreeBoundingBox.Data;
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
