	internal delegate void CollisionManagerLabelsMovedEventHandler(List<LabelCollisionInfo> movedLabels);
	internal class QuadTree
	{
		public int Capacity;

		public int MaxDepth;

		private QuadTreeNode Root { get; set; }

		public QuadTree(double width, double height, int maxDepthValue, int nodeCapacity)
		{
			Root = new QuadTreeNode();
			Root.Owner = this;
			Root.Box = new QuadTreeBoundingBox();
			double num = Math.Max(width, height);
			Root.Box.CenterX = num / 2.0;
			Root.Box.CenterY = num / 2.0;
			Root.Box.HalfWidth = num / 2.0;
			Root.Box.HalfHeight = num / 2.0;
			Capacity = nodeCapacity;
			MaxDepth = maxDepthValue;
		}

		public bool Insert(QuadTreeBoundingBox p)
		{
			return Root.Insert(p);
		}

		public bool Remove(QuadTreeBoundingBox p)
		{
			return Root.Remove(p);
		}

		public List<QuadTreeNode> FindLeaves(QuadTreeBoundingBox p)
		{
			List<QuadTreeNode> list = new List<QuadTreeNode>();
			Root.FindLeaves(p, list);
			return list;
		}

		public void Cleanup()
		{
			Root.CheckEmpty();
		}

		public void UpdateCenterOfMass()
		{
			Root.UpdateCenterOfMass();
		}

		public int DistinctCount()
		{
			return DistinctCountHelper(Root, new HashSet<QuadTreeBoundingBox>());
		}

		public int DistinctCountHelper(QuadTreeNode node, HashSet<QuadTreeBoundingBox> seen)
		{
			if (node.IsLeaf)
			{
				int num = 0;
				for (LinkedListNode<QuadTreeBoundingBox> linkedListNode = node.Points.First; linkedListNode != null; linkedListNode = linkedListNode.Next)
				{
					if (!seen.Contains(linkedListNode.Value))
					{
						num++;
						seen.Add(linkedListNode.Value);
					}
				}
				return num;
			}
			return DistinctCountHelper(node.NW, seen) + DistinctCountHelper(node.NE, seen) + DistinctCountHelper(node.SW, seen) + DistinctCountHelper(node.SE, seen);
		}

		public QuadTreeForceVector GetForceVectorForPoint(double targetX, double targetY, double ratio)
		{
			return Root.GetForceVectorForPoint(targetX, targetY, ratio);
		}
	}
	internal class QuadTreeForceVector
	{
		public double X;

		public double Y;
	}
	internal class QuadTreeBoundingBox
	{
		public double CenterX;

		public double CenterY;

		public double HalfWidth;

		public double HalfHeight;

		public object Data;

		public bool Intersect(QuadTreeBoundingBox other)
		{
			if (CenterX + HalfWidth < other.CenterX - other.HalfWidth || CenterY + HalfHeight < other.CenterY - other.HalfHeight || CenterX - HalfWidth > other.CenterX + other.HalfWidth || CenterY - HalfHeight > other.CenterY + other.HalfHeight)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public double InsersectionArea(QuadTreeBoundingBox testBox)
		{
			double val = CenterX - HalfWidth;
			double val2 = CenterY - HalfHeight;
			double val3 = CenterX + HalfWidth;
			double val4 = CenterY + HalfHeight;
			double val5 = testBox.CenterX - testBox.HalfWidth;
			double val6 = testBox.CenterY - testBox.HalfHeight;
			double val7 = testBox.CenterX + testBox.HalfWidth;
			double val8 = testBox.CenterY + testBox.HalfHeight;
			double num = Math.Max(val, val5);
			double num2 = Math.Min(val3, val7);
			double num3 = Math.Max(val2, val6);
			double num4 = Math.Min(val4, val8);
			return (num2 - num) * (num4 - num3);
		}
	}
	internal class QuadTreeNode
	{
		[Weak]
		public QuadTree Owner;

		public LinkedList<QuadTreeBoundingBox> Points;

		public int PointsCount;

		public QuadTreeBoundingBox Box;

		public const int NWIndex = 0;

		public const int NEIndex = 1;

		public const int SWIndex = 2;

		public const int SEIndex = 3;

		public const int ChildrenCount = 4;

		public int Depth;

		public QuadTreeNode[] Children;

		public double CenterOfMassX;

		public double CenterOfMassY;

		public double Mass;

		public bool IsLeaf
		{
			get
			{
				if (NW == null && NE == null && SW == null)
				{
					return SE == null;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public QuadTreeNode NW
		{
			get
			{
				return Children[0];
			}
			set
			{
				Children[0] = value;
			}
		}

		public QuadTreeNode NE
		{
			get
			{
				return Children[1];
			}
			set
			{
				Children[1] = value;
			}
		}

		public QuadTreeNode SW
		{
			get
			{
				return Children[2];
			}
			set
			{
				Children[2] = value;
			}
		}

		public QuadTreeNode SE
		{
			get
			{
				return Children[3];
			}
			set
			{
				Children[3] = value;
			}
		}

		public QuadTreeNode()
		{
			CenterOfMassX = 0.0;
			CenterOfMassY = 0.0;
			Mass = 0.0;
			Points = new LinkedList<QuadTreeBoundingBox>();
			Children = new QuadTreeNode[4];
			Box = new QuadTreeBoundingBox();
			for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
			{
				Children[i] = null;
			}
		}

		public bool Remove(QuadTreeBoundingBox p)
		{
			if (!Box.Intersect(p))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (NW == null && NE == null && SW == null && SE == null)
			{
				for (LinkedListNode<QuadTreeBoundingBox> linkedListNode = Points.First; linkedListNode != null; linkedListNode = linkedListNode.Next)
				{
					if (linkedListNode.Value == p)
					{
						Points.Remove(linkedListNode);
						PointsCount--;
						return true;
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
			NW.Remove(p);
			NE.Remove(p);
			SW.Remove(p);
			SE.Remove(p);
			return false;
		}

		public void FindLeaves(QuadTreeBoundingBox bbox, List<QuadTreeNode> leaves)
		{
			if (Box.Intersect(bbox))
			{
				if (IsLeaf)
				{
					leaves.Add(this);
					return;
				}
				NW.FindLeaves(bbox, leaves);
				NE.FindLeaves(bbox, leaves);
				SW.FindLeaves(bbox, leaves);
				SE.FindLeaves(bbox, leaves);
			}
		}

		internal void CheckEmpty()
		{
			if (NW != null)
			{
				NW.CheckEmpty();
			}
			if (NE != null)
			{
				NE.CheckEmpty();
			}
			if (SW != null)
			{
				SW.CheckEmpty();
			}
			if (SE != null)
			{
				SW.CheckEmpty();
			}
			if (NW.IsLeaf && NW.PointsCount == 0 && NE.IsLeaf && NE.PointsCount == 0 && SW.IsLeaf && SW.PointsCount == 0 && SE.IsLeaf && SE.PointsCount == 0)
			{
				NW = null;
				NE = null;
				SW = null;
				SE = null;
			}
		}

		public bool Insert(QuadTreeBoundingBox p)
		{
			if (!Box.Intersect(p))
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool flag = NW == null && NE == null && SW == null && SE == null;
			if (flag && PointsCount < Owner.Capacity)
			{
				Points.AddLast(p);
				PointsCount++;
				return true;
			}
			if (flag && Depth < Owner.MaxDepth)
			{
				SubDivide();
			}
			else if (flag)
			{
				Points.AddLast(p);
				PointsCount++;
				return true;
			}
			bool flag2 = NW.Insert(p);
			flag2 = NE.Insert(p) || flag2;
			flag2 = SW.Insert(p) || flag2;
			return SE.Insert(p) || flag2;
		}

		private void SubDivide()
		{
			NW = new QuadTreeNode();
			NE = new QuadTreeNode();
			SW = new QuadTreeNode();
			SE = new QuadTreeNode();
			double num = Box.HalfWidth / 2.0;
			NW.Box.CenterX = Box.CenterX - num;
			NW.Box.CenterY = Box.CenterY - num;
			NE.Box.CenterX = Box.CenterX + num;
			NE.Box.CenterY = Box.CenterY - num;
			SW.Box.CenterX = Box.CenterX - num;
			SW.Box.CenterY = Box.CenterY + num;
			SE.Box.CenterX = Box.CenterX + num;
			SE.Box.CenterY = Box.CenterY + num;
			for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
			{
				Children[i].Depth = Depth + 1;
				Children[i].Box.HalfWidth = num;
				Children[i].Box.HalfHeight = num;
				Children[i].Owner = Owner;
			}
			for (LinkedListNode<QuadTreeBoundingBox> linkedListNode = Points.First; linkedListNode != null; linkedListNode = linkedListNode.Next)
			{
				QuadTreeBoundingBox value = linkedListNode.Value;
				NW.Insert(value);
				NE.Insert(value);
				SW.Insert(value);
				SE.Insert(value);
			}
			Points.Clear();
			PointsCount = 0;
		}

		public void UpdateCenterOfMass()
		{
			if (IsLeaf)
			{
				double num = 0.0;
				double num2 = 0.0;
				for (LinkedListNode<QuadTreeBoundingBox> linkedListNode = Points.First; linkedListNode != null; linkedListNode = linkedListNode.Next)
				{
					QuadTreeBoundingBox value = linkedListNode.Value;
					num += value.CenterX;
					num2 += value.CenterY;
				}
				if (PointsCount == 0)
				{
					CenterOfMassX = 0.0;
					CenterOfMassY = 0.0;
					Mass = 0.0;
				}
				else
				{
					CenterOfMassX = num / (double)PointsCount;
					CenterOfMassY = num2 / (double)PointsCount;
					Mass = PointsCount;
				}
				return;
			}
			NW.UpdateCenterOfMass();
			SW.UpdateCenterOfMass();
			NE.UpdateCenterOfMass();
			SE.UpdateCenterOfMass();
			double num3 = 0.0;
			double num4 = 0.0;
			double num5 = 0.0;
			for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
			{
				num5 += Children[i].Mass;
				num3 += Children[i].CenterOfMassX * Children[i].Mass;
				num4 += Children[i].CenterOfMassY * Children[i].Mass;
			}
			if (Mass > 0.0)
			{
				CenterOfMassX = num3 / num5;
				CenterOfMassY = num4 / num5;
			}
			Mass = num5;
		}

		internal QuadTreeForceVector GetForceVectorForPoint(double targetX, double targetY, double ratio)
		{
			double num = Math.Sqrt((targetX - CenterOfMassX) * (targetX - CenterOfMassX) + (targetY - CenterOfMassY) * (targetY - CenterOfMassY));
			if (Box.HalfWidth * 2.0 / num < ratio || IsLeaf)
			{
				double x = (targetX - CenterOfMassX) * Mass / (num * num);
				double y = (targetY - CenterOfMassY) * Mass / (num * num);
				return new QuadTreeForceVector
				{
					X = x,
					Y = y
				};
			}
			double num2 = 0.0;
			double num3 = 0.0;
			for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
			{
				QuadTreeForceVector forceVectorForPoint = Children[i].GetForceVectorForPoint(targetX, targetY, ratio);
				num2 += forceVectorForPoint.X;
				num3 += forceVectorForPoint.Y;
			}
			return new QuadTreeForceVector
			{
				X = num2,
				Y = num3
			};
		}
	}
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	public class Clipper
	{
		private IList<Point> Head;

		private EdgeClipper _firstClipper;

		[SwiftClientName("_target")]
		private IList<Point> target;

		private LeftClipper leftClipper;

		private BottomClipper bottomClipper;

		private RightClipper rightClipper;

		private TopClipper topClipper;

		public IList<Point> Target
		{
			get
			{
				return target;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_firstClipper != null)
				{
					_firstClipper.Clear();
				}
				_firstClipper = null;
				target = value;
				IList<Point> list = target;
				if (leftClipper != null)
				{
					leftClipper.Dst = list;
					list = leftClipper;
					_firstClipper = leftClipper;
				}
				if (bottomClipper != null)
				{
					bottomClipper.Dst = list;
					list = bottomClipper;
					bottomClipper.NextClipper = _firstClipper;
					_firstClipper = bottomClipper;
				}
				if (rightClipper != null)
				{
					rightClipper.Dst = list;
					list = rightClipper;
					rightClipper.NextClipper = _firstClipper;
					_firstClipper = rightClipper;
				}
				if (topClipper != null)
				{
					topClipper.Dst = list;
					list = topClipper;
					topClipper.NextClipper = _firstClipper;
					_firstClipper = topClipper;
				}
				Head = list;
			}
		}

		public bool IsClosed
		{
			get
			{
				if ((leftClipper == null || leftClipper.IsClosed) && (bottomClipper == null || bottomClipper.IsClosed) && (rightClipper == null || rightClipper.IsClosed))
				{
					if (topClipper != null)
					{
						return topClipper.IsClosed;
					}
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
			set
			{
				if (leftClipper != null)
				{
					leftClipper.IsClosed = value;
				}
				if (bottomClipper != null)
				{
					bottomClipper.IsClosed = value;
				}
				if (rightClipper != null)
				{
					rightClipper.IsClosed = value;
				}
				if (topClipper != null)
				{
					topClipper.IsClosed = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public Clipper(Rect clip, bool isClosed)
		{
			leftClipper = new LeftClipper
			{
				Edge = clip.Left,
				IsClosed = isClosed
			};
			bottomClipper = new BottomClipper
			{
				Edge = clip.Bottom,
				IsClosed = isClosed
			};
			rightClipper = new RightClipper
			{
				Edge = clip.Right,
				IsClosed = isClosed
			};
			topClipper = new TopClipper
			{
				Edge = clip.Top,
				IsClosed = isClosed
			};
		}

		public Clipper(double left, double bottom, double right, double top, bool isClosed)
		{
			leftClipper = ((!double.IsNaN(left)) ? new LeftClipper
			{
				Edge = left,
				IsClosed = isClosed
			} : null);
			bottomClipper = ((!double.IsNaN(bottom)) ? new BottomClipper
			{
				Edge = bottom,
				IsClosed = isClosed
			} : null);
			rightClipper = ((!double.IsNaN(right)) ? new RightClipper
			{
				Edge = right,
				IsClosed = isClosed
			} : null);
			topClipper = ((!double.IsNaN(top)) ? new TopClipper
			{
				Edge = top,
				IsClosed = isClosed
			} : null);
		}

		public void Add(Point point)
		{
			Head.Add(point);
		}

		public void BulkAdd(IList<Point> points, bool inReverseOrder)
		{
			int count = points.Count;
			EdgeClipper[] array = new EdgeClipper[4] { topClipper, rightClipper, bottomClipper, leftClipper };
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			double num3 = 0.0;
			double num4 = 0.0;
			if (topClipper != null)
			{
				num = topClipper.Edge;
			}
			if (rightClipper != null)
			{
				num2 = rightClipper.Edge;
			}
			if (bottomClipper != null)
			{
				num3 = bottomClipper.Edge;
			}
			if (leftClipper != null)
			{
				num4 = leftClipper.Edge;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			int num5 = array.Length;
			int num6 = num5 + 1;
			EdgeClipper edgeClipper = null;
			int num7 = 0;
			Point[] array2 = new Point[16];
			int num8 = 0;
			Point[] array3 = new Point[16];
			int num9 = 0;
			int num10 = 1;
			if (inReverseOrder)
			{
				num9 = count - 1;
				num10 = -1;
			}
			for (int i = num9; i < count && i >= 0; i += num10)
			{
				Point point = points[i];
				array2[num7] = point;
				num7++;
				for (int j = 0; j < num6; j++)
				{
					if (j < num5)
					{
						edgeClipper = array[j];
						if (edgeClipper == null)
						{
							continue;
						}
					}
					for (int k = 0; k < num7; k++)
					{
						point = array2[k];
						double x = point.X;
						double y = point.Y;
						if (j >= num5)
						{
							target.Add(point);
							continue;
						}
						flag = (j == 0 && y >= num) || (j == 1 && x <= num2) || (j == 2 && y <= num3) || (j == 3 && x >= num4);
						if (edgeClipper.init)
						{
							edgeClipper.init = false;
							edgeClipper.First = point;
						}
						else if (flag)
						{
							if (!edgeClipper.PrevInside)
							{
								array3[num8] = edgeClipper.Intersection(edgeClipper.Prev, point);
								num8++;
							}
							else if (!edgeClipper.IsClosed && !edgeClipper.IsOutput)
							{
								array3[num8] = edgeClipper.Prev;
								num8++;
								edgeClipper.IsOutput = true;
							}
							array3[num8] = point;
							num8++;
						}
						else if (edgeClipper.PrevInside)
						{
							if (!edgeClipper.IsClosed && !edgeClipper.IsOutput)
							{
								array3[num8] = edgeClipper.Prev;
								num8++;
								edgeClipper.IsOutput = true;
							}
							array3[num8] = edgeClipper.Intersection(edgeClipper.Prev, point);
							num8++;
						}
						edgeClipper.Prev = point;
						edgeClipper.PrevInside = flag;
					}
					Point[] array4 = array2;
					array2 = array3;
					array3 = array4;
					num7 = num8;
					num8 = 0;
				}
			}
		}
	}
	internal abstract class EdgeClipper : IList<Point>, ICollection<Point>, IEnumerable<Point>, IEnumerable
	{
		[SwiftClientName("_dst")]
		public IList<Point> dst;

		[DontObfuscate]
		private EdgeClipper _nextClipper;

		[SwiftClientName("_init")]
		internal bool init = true;

		internal Point First;

		internal Point Prev;

		internal bool PrevInside;

		public bool IsClosed;

		internal bool IsOutput;

		public IList<Point> Dst
		{
			get
			{
				return dst;
			}
			set
			{
				if (dst != value)
				{
					init = true;
					dst = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public EdgeClipper NextClipper
		{
			get
			{
				return _nextClipper;
			}
			set
			{
				_nextClipper = value;
			}
		}

		public bool IsReadOnly => false;

		public int Count => 0;

		public Point this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return new Point(0.0, 0.0);
			}
			set
			{
			}
		}

		public void Add([SwiftParameterLabel("item")] Point cur)
		{
			bool flag = IsInside(cur);
			if (init)
			{
				init = false;
				First = cur;
			}
			else if (flag)
			{
				if (!PrevInside)
				{
					dst.Add(Intersection(Prev, cur));
				}
				else if (!IsClosed && !IsOutput)
				{
					dst.Add(Prev);
					IsOutput = true;
				}
				dst.Add(cur);
			}
			else if (PrevInside)
			{
				if (!IsClosed && !IsOutput)
				{
					dst.Add(Prev);
					IsOutput = true;
				}
				dst.Add(Intersection(Prev, cur));
			}
			Prev = cur;
			PrevInside = flag;
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			if (IsClosed && !init)
			{
				Add(First);
			}
			if (_nextClipper != null)
			{
				_nextClipper.Clear();
			}
			init = true;
			IsOutput = false;
		}

		protected abstract bool IsInside(Point pt);

		protected internal abstract Point Intersection(Point b, Point e);

		[JSEmitIgnore]
		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return null;
		}

		public IEnumerator<Point> GetEnumerator()
		{
			return null;
		}

		public bool Remove(Point item)
		{
			return false;
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
		}

		public void CopyTo(Point[] array, int arrayIndex)
		{
		}

		public bool Contains(Point item)
		{
			return false;
		}

		public void Insert(int index, Point item)
		{
		}

		public int IndexOf(Point item)
		{
			return -1;
		}
	}
	internal class LeftClipper : EdgeClipper
	{
		public double Edge;

		protected override bool IsInside(Point pt)
		{
			return pt.X >= Edge;
		}

		protected internal override Point Intersection(Point b, Point e)
		{
			return new Point(Edge, b.Y + (e.Y - b.Y) * (Edge - b.X) / (e.X - b.X));
		}
	}
	internal class BottomClipper : EdgeClipper
	{
		public double Edge;

		protected override bool IsInside(Point pt)
		{
			return pt.Y <= Edge;
		}

		protected internal override Point Intersection(Point b, Point e)
		{
			return new Point(b.X + (e.X - b.X) * (Edge - b.Y) / (e.Y - b.Y), Edge);
		}
	}
	internal class RightClipper : EdgeClipper
	{
		public double Edge;

		protected override bool IsInside(Point pt)
		{
			return pt.X <= Edge;
		}

		protected internal override Point Intersection(Point b, Point e)
		{
			return new Point(Edge, b.Y + (e.Y - b.Y) * (Edge - b.X) / (e.X - b.X));
		}
	}
	internal class TopClipper : EdgeClipper
	{
		public double Edge;

		protected override bool IsInside(Point pt)
		{
			return pt.Y >= Edge;
		}

		protected internal override Point Intersection(Point b, Point e)
		{
			return new Point(b.X + (e.X - b.X) * (Edge - b.Y) / (e.Y - b.Y), Edge);
		}
	}
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	public class Flattener
	{
		private Flattener()
		{
		}

		public static IList<int> Flatten(int count, Func<int, double> X, Func<int, double> Y, double resolution)
		{
			List<int> result = new List<int>();
			Flatten(result, X, Y, 0, count - 1, resolution);
			return result;
		}

		public static IList<int> Flatten(IList<int> result, Func<int, double> X, Func<int, double> Y, int b, int e, double E)
		{
			return Flatten(result, (int i) => i, X, Y, b, e, E);
		}

		public static IList<int> Flatten(IList<int> result, IList<int> indices, Func<int, double> X, Func<int, double> Y, int b, int e, double E)
		{
			return Flatten(result, (int i) => indices[i], X, Y, b, e, E);
		}

		private static IList<int> Flatten(IList<int> result, Func<int, int> getIndex, Func<int, double> X, Func<int, double> Y, [SwiftMutableParameter] int b, [SwiftMutableParameter] int e, double E)
		{
			if (b > e)
			{
				return result;
			}
			double d = X(getIndex(b));
			double d2 = Y(getIndex(b));
			while ((double.IsNaN(d) || double.IsNaN(d2)) && b < e)
			{
				b++;
				d = X(getIndex(b));
				d2 = Y(getIndex(b));
			}
			double d3 = X(getIndex(e));
			double d4 = Y(getIndex(e));
			while ((double.IsNaN(d3) || double.IsNaN(d4)) && b < e)
			{
				e--;
				d3 = X(getIndex(e));
				d4 = Y(getIndex(e));
			}
			if (b == e)
			{
				result.Add(getIndex(b));
				return result;
			}
			result.Add(getIndex(b));
			FlattenRecursive(result, getIndex, X, Y, b, e, E);
			result.Add(getIndex(e));
			return result;
		}

		private static void FlattenRecursive(IList<int> result, Func<int, int> getIndex, Func<int, double> X, Func<int, double> Y, [SwiftMutableParameter] int b, [SwiftMutableParameter] int e, double E)
		{
			double num = X(getIndex(b));
			double num2 = Y(getIndex(b));
			while ((double.IsNaN(num) || double.IsNaN(num2)) && b < e)
			{
				b++;
				num = X(getIndex(b));
				num2 = Y(getIndex(b));
			}
			double num3 = X(getIndex(e));
			double num4 = Y(getIndex(e));
			while ((double.IsNaN(num3) || double.IsNaN(num4)) && b < e)
			{
				e--;
				num3 = X(getIndex(e));
				num4 = Y(getIndex(e));
			}
			if (b + 1 >= e)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num5 = -1;
			double num6 = E;
			if (MathUtil.Hypot(num3 - num, num4 - num2) == 0.0)
			{
				for (int i = b + 1; i < e; i++)
				{
					double num7 = X(getIndex(i));
					double num8 = Y(getIndex(i));
					if (!double.IsNaN(num7) && !double.IsNaN(num8))
					{
						double num9 = MathUtil.Hypot(num3 - num7, num4 - num8);
						if (num9 >= num6)
						{
							num6 = num9;
							num5 = i;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				double num10 = num3 - num;
				double num11 = num4 - num2;
				for (int j = b + 1; j < e; j++)
				{
					double num12 = X(getIndex(j));
					double num13 = Y(getIndex(j));
					if (double.IsNaN(num12) || double.IsNaN(num13))
					{
						continue;
					}
					double num14 = double.NaN;
					double num15 = X(getIndex(j)) - num;
					double num16 = Y(getIndex(j)) - num2;
					double num17 = num10 * num15 + num11 * num16;
					if (num17 <= 0.0)
					{
						num14 = MathUtil.Hypot(num - num12, num2 - num13);
					}
					else
					{
						double num18 = num10 * num10 + num11 * num11;
						if (num18 <= num17)
						{
							num14 = MathUtil.Hypot(num3 - num12, num4 - num13);
						}
						else
						{
							double num19 = num17 / num18;
							num14 = MathUtil.Hypot(num + num19 * num10 - num12, num2 + num19 * num11 - num13);
						}
					}
					if (num14 >= num6)
					{
						num6 = num14;
						num5 = j;
					}
				}
			}
			if (num5 != -1)
			{
				FlattenRecursive(result, getIndex, X, Y, b, num5, E);
				result.Add(getIndex(num5));
				FlattenRecursive(result, getIndex, X, Y, num5, e, E);
			}
		}

		public static PathFigure Smooth(int count, Func<int, double> X, Func<int, double> Y, double resolution)
		{
			IList<int> indices = Flatten(count, X, Y, resolution);
			return Smooth(indices.Count, (int i) => X(indices[i]), (int i) => Y(indices[i]));
		}

		public static PathFigure Smooth(int count, Func<int, double> X, Func<int, double> Y)
		{
			PathFigure pathFigure = new PathFigure
			{
				StartPoint = new Point(X(0), Y(0))
			};
			int num = count - 1;
			Point point = new Point(X(0), Y(0));
			Point point2 = new Point(X(1), Y(1));
			Point point3 = new Point(X(2), Y(2));
			Point point4 = new Point(point2.X - point.X, point2.Y - point.Y);
			double num2 = MathUtil.Hypot(point4.X, point4.Y);
			Point point5 = new Point(point3.X - point2.X, point3.Y - point2.Y);
			double num3 = MathUtil.Hypot(point5.X, point5.Y);
			double num4 = 0.15;
			double num5 = 0.45;
			Point point6 = new Point(point3.X - point.X, point3.Y - point.Y);
			double num6 = MathUtil.Hypot(point6.X, point6.Y);
			point6.X /= num6;
			point6.Y /= num6;
			double num7 = 0.5 + (point4.X * point5.X + point4.Y * point5.Y) / (2.0 * num2 * num3);
			QuadraticBezierSegment value = new QuadraticBezierSegment
			{
				Point1 = new Point(point2.X - point6.X * (num4 + num5 * num7) * num2, point2.Y - point6.Y * (num4 + num5 * num7) * num2),
				Point2 = point2
			};
			pathFigure.Segments.Add(value);
			for (int i = 1; i < num - 1; i++)
			{
				point = point2;
				point2 = point3;
				point3 = new Point(X(i + 2), Y(i + 2));
				point4 = point5;
				num2 = num3;
				point5 = new Point(point3.X - point2.X, point3.Y - point2.Y);
				num3 = MathUtil.Hypot(point5.X, point5.Y);
				Point point7 = point6;
				double num8 = num7;
				point6 = new Point(point3.X - point.X, point3.Y - point.Y);
				double num9 = MathUtil.Hypot(point6.X, point6.Y);
				point6.X /= num9;
				point6.Y /= num9;
				num7 = 0.5 + (point4.X * point5.X + point4.Y * point5.Y) / (2.0 * num2 * num3);
				BezierSegment value2 = new BezierSegment
				{
					Point1 = new Point(point.X + point7.X * (num4 + num5 * num8) * num2, point.Y + point7.Y * (num4 + num5 * num8) * num2),
					Point2 = new Point(point2.X - point6.X * (num4 + num5 * num7) * num2, point2.Y - point6.Y * (num4 + num5 * num7) * num2),
					Point3 = point2
				};
				pathFigure.Segments.Add(value2);
			}
			point = point2;
			point2 = point3;
			point4 = point5;
			num2 = num3;
			Point point8 = point6;
			double num10 = num7;
			QuadraticBezierSegment value3 = new QuadraticBezierSegment
			{
				Point1 = new Point(point.X + point8.X * (num4 + num5 * num10) * num2, point.Y + point8.Y * (num4 + num5 * num10) * num2),
				Point2 = point2
			};
			pathFigure.Segments.Add(value3);
			return pathFigure;
		}
	}
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	public class FastFlattener
	{
		private FastFlattener()
		{
		}

		public static List<int> FastFlatten(List<int> result, double[] X, double[] Y, [SwiftMutableParameter] int b, [SwiftMutableParameter] int e, double E)
		{
			if (b > e)
			{
				return result;
			}
			double d = X[b];
			double d2 = Y[b];
			while ((double.IsNaN(d) || double.IsNaN(d2)) && b < e)
			{
				b++;
				d = X[b];
				d2 = Y[b];
			}
			double d3 = X[e];
			double d4 = Y[e];
			while ((double.IsNaN(d3) || double.IsNaN(d4)) && b < e)
			{
				e--;
				d3 = X[e];
				d4 = Y[e];
			}
			if (b == e)
			{
				result.Add(b);
				return result;
			}
			result.Add(b);
			FastFlattenRecursive(result, X, Y, b, e, E);
			result.Add(e);
			return result;
		}

		public static IList<int> FastFlatten(int count, List<double[]> buckets, bool point0, bool useX0AsX1, double resolution)
		{
			int xIndex;
			int yIndex;
			if (point0)
			{
				xIndex = 0;
				yIndex = 1;
			}
			else if (useX0AsX1)
			{
				xIndex = 0;
				yIndex = 2;
			}
			else
			{
				xIndex = 2;
				yIndex = 3;
			}
			return FastFlatten(count, buckets, xIndex, yIndex, resolution);
		}

		public static IList<int> ChunkedFastFlatten(int count, List<double[]> buckets, bool point0, bool useX0AsX1, double resolution)
		{
			return ChunkedFastFlatten(new List<int>(), buckets, point0, useX0AsX1, 0, count - 1, resolution);
		}

		public static IList<int> FastFlatten(int count, List<double[]> buckets, int xIndex, int yIndex, double resolution)
		{
			List<int> result = new List<int>();
			FastFlatten(result, buckets, xIndex, yIndex, 0, count - 1, resolution);
			return result;
		}

		public static IList<int> ChunkedFastFlatten(List<int> result, List<double[]> buckets, bool point0, bool useX0AsX1, int b, int e, double E)
		{
			int chunkingAmount = FlattenerSettings.Instance.ChunkingAmount;
			if (e - b + 1 <= chunkingAmount)
			{
				return FastFlatten(result, buckets, point0, useX0AsX1, b, e, E);
			}
			if (chunkingAmount < 0)
			{
				for (int i = b; i <= e; i++)
				{
					result.Add(i);
				}
				return result;
			}
			int num = b;
			for (int num2 = e - num + 1; num2 > 0; num2 = e - num + 1)
			{
				if (num2 <= chunkingAmount)
				{
					FastFlatten(result, buckets, point0, useX0AsX1, num, e, E);
					num = e + 1;
				}
				else
				{
					int num3 = num + chunkingAmount - 1;
					FastFlatten(result, buckets, point0, useX0AsX1, num, num3, E);
					num = num3 + 1;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public static List<int> FastFlatten(List<int> result, List<double[]> buckets, bool point0, bool useX0AsX1, [SwiftMutableParameter] int b, [SwiftMutableParameter] int e, double E)
		{
			int xIndex;
			int yIndex;
			if (point0)
			{
				xIndex = 0;
				yIndex = 1;
			}
			else if (useX0AsX1)
			{
				xIndex = 0;
				yIndex = 2;
			}
			else
			{
				xIndex = 2;
				yIndex = 3;
			}
			return FastFlatten(result, buckets, xIndex, yIndex, b, e, E);
		}

		public static List<int> FastFlatten(List<int> result, List<double[]> buckets, int xIndex, int yIndex, [SwiftMutableParameter] int b, [SwiftMutableParameter] int e, double E)
		{
			if (b > e)
			{
				return result;
			}
			double[] array = buckets[b];
			double d = array[xIndex];
			double d2 = array[yIndex];
			while ((double.IsNaN(d) || double.IsNaN(d2)) && b < e)
			{
				b++;
				double[] array2 = buckets[b];
				d = array2[xIndex];
				d2 = array2[yIndex];
			}
			double[] array3 = buckets[e];
			double d3 = array3[xIndex];
			double d4 = array3[yIndex];
			while ((double.IsNaN(d3) || double.IsNaN(d4)) && b < e)
			{
				e--;
				double[] array4 = buckets[e];
				d3 = array4[xIndex];
				d4 = array4[yIndex];
			}
			if (b == e)
			{
				result.Add(b);
				return result;
			}
			result.Add(b);
			FastFlattenRecursive(result, buckets, xIndex, yIndex, b, e, E);
			result.Add(e);
			return result;
		}

		private static void FastFlattenRecursive(List<int> result, double[] X, double[] Y, [SwiftMutableParameter] int b, [SwiftMutableParameter] int e, double E)
		{
			double num = X[b];
			double num2 = Y[b];
			while ((double.IsNaN(num) || double.IsNaN(num2)) && b < e)
			{
				b++;
				num = X[b];
				num2 = Y[b];
			}
			double num3 = X[e];
			double num4 = Y[e];
			while ((double.IsNaN(num3) || double.IsNaN(num4)) && b < e)
			{
				e--;
				num3 = X[e];
				num4 = Y[e];
			}
			if (b + 1 >= e)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num5 = -1;
			double num6 = E * E;
			double num7 = num3 - num;
			double num8 = num4 - num2;
			if (num7 * num7 + num8 * num8 == 0.0)
			{
				for (int i = b + 1; i < e; i++)
				{
					double num9 = X[i];
					double num10 = Y[i];
					if (!double.IsNaN(num9) && !double.IsNaN(num10))
					{
						double num11 = num3 - num9;
						num8 = num4 - num10;
						double num12 = num11 * num11 + num8 * num8;
						if (num12 >= num6)
						{
							num6 = num12;
							num5 = i;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				double num13 = num3 - num;
				double num14 = num4 - num2;
				for (int j = b + 1; j < e; j++)
				{
					double num15 = X[j];
					double num16 = Y[j];
					if (double.IsNaN(num15) || double.IsNaN(num16))
					{
						continue;
					}
					double num17 = double.NaN;
					double num18 = X[j] - num;
					double num19 = Y[j] - num2;
					double num20 = num13 * num18 + num14 * num19;
					if (num20 <= 0.0)
					{
						double num21 = num - num15;
						num8 = num2 - num16;
						num17 = num21 * num21 + num8 * num8;
					}
					else
					{
						double num22 = num13 * num13 + num14 * num14;
						if (num22 <= num20)
						{
							double num23 = num3 - num15;
							num8 = num4 - num16;
							num17 = num23 * num23 + num8 * num8;
						}
						else
						{
							double num24 = num20 / num22;
							double num25 = num + num24 * num13 - num15;
							num8 = num2 + num24 * num14 - num16;
							num17 = num25 * num25 + num8 * num8;
						}
					}
					if (num17 >= num6)
					{
						num6 = num17;
						num5 = j;
					}
				}
			}
			if (num5 != -1)
			{
				FastFlattenRecursive(result, X, Y, b, num5, E);
				result.Add(num5);
				FastFlattenRecursive(result, X, Y, num5, e, E);
			}
		}

		private static void FastFlattenRecursive(List<int> result, List<double[]> buckets, int xIndex, int yIndex, [SwiftMutableParameter] int b, [SwiftMutableParameter] int e, double E)
		{
			double[] array = buckets[b];
			double num = array[xIndex];
			double num2 = array[yIndex];
			while (num != num || (num2 != num2 && b < e))
			{
				b++;
				double[] array2 = buckets[b];
				num = array2[xIndex];
				num2 = array2[yIndex];
			}
			double[] array3 = buckets[e];
			double num3 = array3[xIndex];
			double num4 = array3[yIndex];
			while (num3 != num3 || (num4 != num4 && b < e))
			{
				e--;
				double[] array4 = buckets[e];
				num3 = array4[xIndex];
				num4 = array4[yIndex];
			}
			if (b + 1 >= e)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num5 = -1;
			double num6 = E * E;
			double num7 = num3 - num;
			double num8 = num4 - num2;
			if (num7 * num7 + num8 * num8 == 0.0)
			{
				for (int i = b + 1; i < e; i++)
				{
					double[] array5 = buckets[i];
					double num9 = array5[xIndex];
					double num10 = array5[yIndex];
					if (num9 == num9 && num10 == num10)
					{
						double num11 = num3 - num9;
						num8 = num4 - num10;
						double num12 = num11 * num11 + num8 * num8;
						if (num12 >= num6)
						{
							num6 = num12;
							num5 = i;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				double num13 = num3 - num;
				double num14 = num4 - num2;
				for (int j = b + 1; j < e; j++)
				{
					double[] array6 = buckets[j];
					double num15 = array6[xIndex];
					double num16 = array6[yIndex];
					if (num15 != num15 || num16 != num16)
					{
						continue;
					}
					double num17 = double.NaN;
					double num18 = num15 - num;
					double num19 = num16 - num2;
					double num20 = num13 * num18 + num14 * num19;
					if (num20 <= 0.0)
					{
						double num21 = num - num15;
						num8 = num2 - num16;
						num17 = num21 * num21 + num8 * num8;
					}
					else
					{
						double num22 = num13 * num13 + num14 * num14;
						if (num22 <= num20)
						{
							double num23 = num3 - num15;
							num8 = num4 - num16;
							num17 = num23 * num23 + num8 * num8;
						}
						else
						{
							double num24 = num20 / num22;
							double num25 = num + num24 * num13 - num15;
							num8 = num2 + num24 * num14 - num16;
							num17 = num25 * num25 + num8 * num8;
						}
					}
					if (num17 >= num6)
					{
						num6 = num17;
						num5 = j;
					}
				}
			}
			if (num5 != -1)
			{
				FastFlattenRecursive(result, buckets, xIndex, yIndex, b, num5, E);
				result.Add(num5);
				FastFlattenRecursive(result, buckets, xIndex, yIndex, num5, e, E);
			}
		}
	}
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	public class SpiralFlattener
	{
		private SpiralFlattener()
		{
		}

		public static List<double> Spiral(double startAngle, double startRadius, double endAngle, double endRadius, [SwiftMutableParameter] double error)
		{
			if (double.IsNaN(error) || error <= 0.0)
			{
				error = 1.0;
			}
			List<double> list = new List<double>();
			Stack<SpiralTodo> stack = new Stack<SpiralTodo>();
			double num = (endRadius - startRadius) / (endAngle - startAngle);
			double num2 = startRadius - num * startAngle;
			double num3 = num * num;
			double num4 = num2 * num2;
			double num5 = num2 * num;
			stack.Push(new SpiralTodo
			{
				p0 = 0.0,
				p1 = 1.0
			});
			while (stack.Count != 0)
			{
				SpiralTodo spiralTodo = stack.Pop();
				double num6 = startRadius + spiralTodo.p0 * (endRadius - startRadius);
				double num7 = startAngle + spiralTodo.p0 * (endAngle - startAngle);
				double num8 = num7 * num7;
				double num9 = num8 * num7;
				double num10 = startRadius + spiralTodo.p1 * (endRadius - startRadius);
				double num11 = startAngle + spiralTodo.p1 * (endAngle - startAngle);
				double num12 = num11 * num11;
				double num13 = num12 * num11;
				double num14 = ((num != 0.0) ? ((Math.Pow(num2 + num * num11, 3.0) - Math.Pow(num2 + num * num7, 3.0)) / (6.0 * num)) : (num4 * (num11 - num7) / 2.0 + num5 * (num12 - num8) / 2.0 + num3 * (num13 - num9) / 6.0));
				double num15 = 0.5 * num6 * num10 * Math.Sin(num11 - num7);
				if (num14 - num15 > error)
				{
					double num16 = 0.5 * (spiralTodo.p0 + spiralTodo.p1);
					stack.Push(new SpiralTodo
					{
						p0 = num16,
						p1 = spiralTodo.p1
					});
					stack.Push(new SpiralTodo
					{
						p0 = spiralTodo.p0,
						p1 = num16
					});
				}
				else
				{
					list.Add(spiralTodo.p0);
				}
			}
			list.Add(1.0);
			return list;
		}
	}
	internal struct SpiralTodo
	{
		public double p0;

		public double p1;
	}

	}

		public static double SimplifyAngle([SwiftMutableParameter] double angle)
		{
			if (double.IsNaN(angle) || double.IsInfinity(angle))
			{
				return angle;
			}
			while (angle > 360.0)
			{
				angle -= 360.0;
			}
			while (angle < 0.0)
			{
				angle += 360.0;
			}
			return angle;
		}

		public static double AngleFromSlope(double slope)
		{
			return Math.Atan(slope);
		}

		public static double Slope(Point point1, Point point2)
		{
			return (point2.Y - point1.Y) / (point2.X - point1.X);
		}

		public static double Eccentricity(Rect bounds)
		{
			return 1.0 - Math.Pow(bounds.Height / 2.0, 2.0) / Math.Pow(bounds.Width / 2.0, 2.0);
		}

		public static Point PointOnEllipse(double theta, double eccentricity, Point center, double halfHeight, double extent)
		{
			double num = Math.Cos(theta);
			double num2 = Math.Sin(theta);
			double num3 = Math.Sqrt(halfHeight * halfHeight / (1.0 - eccentricity * Math.Pow(num, 2.0)));
			num3 *= extent;
			return new Point(num3 * num + center.X, num3 * num2 + center.Y);
		}

		public static Point FindCenter(double width, double height, bool exploded, double angle, double radius)
		{
			if (exploded)
			{
				return FindRadialPoint(new Point(width / 2.0, height / 2.0), angle, radius);
			}
			return new Point(width / 2.0, height / 2.0);
		}

		public static Point FindRadialPoint(Point center, [SwiftMutableParameter] double angle, double radius)
		{
			angle = angle / 180.0 * Math.PI;
			double y = center.Y + radius * Math.Sin(angle);
			return new Point(center.X + radius * Math.Cos(angle), y);
		}

		public static Point PointAtDistance(Point p1, Point p2, double distance)
		{
			double num = p2.X - p1.X;
			double num2 = p2.Y - p1.Y;
			double num3 = Math.Sqrt(num * num + num2 * num2);
			num = num / num3 * distance;
			num2 = num2 / num3 * distance;
			return new Point(p1.X + num, p1.Y + num2);
		}

		public static double GetSegmentLength(Point p1, Point p2)
		{
			double num = Math.Abs(p2.X - p1.X);
			double num2 = Math.Abs(p2.Y - p1.Y);
			return Math.Sqrt(num * num + num2 * num2);
		}

		public static Geometry Duplicate(this Geometry G)
		{
			return G?.Clone();
		}

		private static Geometry PolygonGeometry(double[] xy)
		{
			PointCollection pointCollection = new PointCollection();
			for (int i = 2; i < xy.Length; i += 2)
			{
				pointCollection.Add(new Point(xy[i], xy[i + 1]));
			}
			PathFigure pathFigure = new PathFigure
			{
				Segments = new PathSegmentCollection(),
				IsClosed = true,
				IsFilled = true,
				StartPoint = new Point(xy[0], xy[1])
			};
			pathFigure.Segments.Add(new PolyLineSegment
			{
				Points = pointCollection
			});
			PathGeometry pathGeometry = new PathGeometry();
			pathGeometry.Figures = new PathFigureCollection();
			pathGeometry.Figures.Add(pathFigure);
			return pathGeometry;
		}

		public static Point GetCenterFromArcSegment(Point startPoint, Point endPoint, double radius, bool isCounter, bool isLargeArc)
		{
			return CoreGeometryUtil.GetCenterFromArcSegment(startPoint, endPoint, radius, isCounter, isLargeArc);
		}

		public static double GetAngleTo(Point center, Point toPoint)
		{
			double num = Math.Sqrt(Math.Pow(toPoint.X - center.X, 2.0) + Math.Pow(toPoint.Y - center.Y, 2.0));
			double num2 = Math.Acos((toPoint.X - center.X) / num);
			if (toPoint.Y - center.Y < 0.0)
			{
				num2 = Math.PI * 2.0 - num2;
			}
			return num2;
		}

		public static Tuple<Point, Point> GetCircleIntersection(Point startPoint, Point endPoint, Point circleCenter, double circleRadius)
		{
			double num = startPoint.X - circleCenter.X;
			double num2 = startPoint.Y - circleCenter.Y;
			double num3 = endPoint.X - circleCenter.X;
			double num4 = endPoint.Y - circleCenter.Y;
			double num5 = num3 - num;
			double num6 = num4 - num2;
			double num7 = Math.Sqrt(num5 * num5 + num6 * num6);
			double num8 = num * num4 - num3 * num2;
			double num9 = circleRadius * circleRadius;
			double num10 = num7 * num7;
			double num11 = num8 * num8;
			double num12 = num9 * num10 - num11;
			if (num12 < 0.0)
			{
				return new Tuple<Point, Point>(new Point(double.NaN, double.NaN), new Point(double.NaN, double.NaN));
			}
			int num13 = 1;
			if (num6 < 0.0)
			{
				num13 = -1;
			}
			double num14 = (num8 * num6 + (double)num13 * num5 * Math.Sqrt(num12)) / num10;
			double num15 = (num8 * num6 - (double)num13 * num5 * Math.Sqrt(num12)) / num10;
			double num16 = (-1.0 * num8 * num5 + Math.Abs(num6) * Math.Sqrt(num12)) / num10;
			double num17 = (-1.0 * num8 * num5 - Math.Abs(num6) * Math.Sqrt(num12)) / num10;
			return new Tuple<Point, Point>(new Point(num14 + circleCenter.X, num16 + circleCenter.Y), new Point(num15 + circleCenter.X, num17 + circleCenter.Y));
		}

		public static bool IsPointNearLineSegment(Point targetPoint, Point startPoint, Point endPoint, double closeness)
		{
			double num = closeness * closeness;
			double x = startPoint.X;
			double y = startPoint.Y;
			double x2 = endPoint.X;
			double y2 = endPoint.Y;
			double x3 = targetPoint.X;
			double y3 = targetPoint.Y;
			if (y == y2)
			{
				bool num2 = Math.Abs(y - y3) < closeness;
				bool flag = x3 >= Math.Min(x, x2) - closeness && x3 <= Math.Max(x, x2) + closeness;
				if (num2 && flag)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (x == x2)
			{
				bool num3 = Math.Abs(x - x3) < closeness;
				bool flag2 = y3 >= Math.Min(y, y2) - closeness && y3 <= Math.Max(y, y2) + closeness;
				if (num3 && flag2)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
			double num4 = x2 - x;
			double num5 = y2 - y;
			double num6 = num4 * num4 + num5 * num5;
			if (num6 == 0.0)
			{
				return (x3 - x) * (x3 - x) + (y3 - y) * (y3 - y) < num;
			}
			double num7 = ((x3 - x) * num4 + (y3 - y) * num5) / num6;
			num7 = ((num7 < 0.0) ? 0.0 : ((num7 > 1.0) ? 1.0 : num7));
			double num8 = x + num4 * num7;
			double num9 = y + num5 * num7;
			if ((num8 - x3) * (num8 - x3) + (num9 - y3) * (num9 - y3) < num)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static double DistSquaredToLineSegment(Point targetPoint, Point startPoint, Point endPoint)
		{
			double x = startPoint.X;
			double y = startPoint.Y;
			double x2 = endPoint.X;
			double y2 = endPoint.Y;
			double x3 = targetPoint.X;
			double y3 = targetPoint.Y;
			double num = x2 - x;
			double num2 = y2 - y;
			double num3 = num * num + num2 * num2;
			if (num3 == 0.0)
			{
				return (x3 - x) * (x3 - x) + (y3 - y) * (y3 - y);
			}
			double num4 = ((x3 - x) * num + (y3 - y) * num2) / num3;
			num4 = ((num4 < 0.0) ? 0.0 : ((num4 > 1.0) ? 1.0 : num4));
			double num5 = x + num * num4;
			double num6 = y + num2 * num4;
			return (num5 - x3) * (num5 - x3) + (num6 - y3) * (num6 - y3);
		}

		public static double ProjectPointToLineSegment(Point targetPoint, Point startPoint, Point endPoint)
		{
			double x = startPoint.X;
			double y = startPoint.Y;
			double x2 = endPoint.X;
			double y2 = endPoint.Y;
			double x3 = targetPoint.X;
			double y3 = targetPoint.Y;
			double num = x2 - x;
			double num2 = y2 - y;
			double num3 = num * num + num2 * num2;
			if (num3 == 0.0)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			double num4 = ((x3 - x) * num + (y3 - y) * num2) / num3;
			return (num4 < 0.0) ? 0.0 : ((num4 > 1.0) ? 1.0 : num4);
		}

		public static bool IsPointNearPolyline(Point targetPoint, Point firstPoint, IList<Point> linePoints, double closeness)
		{
			double num = closeness * closeness;
			int count = linePoints.Count;
			if (count == 0)
			{
				return (targetPoint.X - firstPoint.X) * (targetPoint.X - firstPoint.X) + (targetPoint.Y - firstPoint.Y) * (targetPoint.Y - firstPoint.Y) < num;
			}
			double x = targetPoint.X;
			double y = targetPoint.Y;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				Point point;
				Point point2;
				if (i == 0)
				{
					point = linePoints[i];
					point2 = firstPoint;
				}
				else
				{
					point = linePoints[i];
					point2 = linePoints[i - 1];
				}
				double x2 = point2.X;
				double y2 = point2.Y;
				double x3 = point.X;
				double y3 = point.Y;
				if (y2 == y3)
				{
					bool num2 = Math.Abs(y2 - y) < closeness;
					bool flag = x >= Math.Min(x2, x3) - closeness && x <= Math.Max(x2, x3) + closeness;
					if (num2 && flag)
					{
						return true;
					}
					continue;
				}
				if (x2 == x3)
				{
					bool num3 = Math.Abs(x2 - x) < closeness;
					bool flag2 = y >= Math.Min(y2, y3) - closeness && y <= Math.Max(y2, y3) + closeness;
					if (num3 && flag2)
					{
						return true;
					}
					continue;
				}
				double num4 = x3 - x2;
				double num5 = y3 - y2;
				double num6 = num4 * num4 + num5 * num5;
				if (num6 == 0.0)
				{
					return (x - x2) * (x - x2) + (y - y2) * (y - y2) < num;
				}
				double num7 = ((x - x2) * num4 + (y - y2) * num5) / num6;
				num7 = ((num7 < 0.0) ? 0.0 : ((num7 > 1.0) ? 1.0 : num7));
				double num8 = x2 + num4 * num7;
				double num9 = y2 + num5 * num7;
				if ((num8 - x) * (num8 - x) + (num9 - y) * (num9 - y) < num)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public static class AngleSimplifier
	{
		public static double SimplifyAngle([SwiftMutableParameter] double angle)
		{
			if (double.IsNaN(angle) || double.IsInfinity(angle))
			{
				return angle;
			}
			while (angle > 360.0)
			{
				angle -= 360.0;
			}
			while (angle < 0.0)
			{
				angle += 360.0;
			}
			return angle;
		}
	}
	public static class PathFigureUtil
	{
		public static PathFigureCollection Duplicate(this PathFigureCollection pathFigureCollection)
		{
			PathFigureCollection pathFigureCollection2 = new PathFigureCollection();
			foreach (PathFigure item in pathFigureCollection)
			{
				pathFigureCollection2.Add(item.Duplicate());
			}
			return pathFigureCollection2;
		}

		public static PathFigure Duplicate(this PathFigure pathFigure)
		{
			if (pathFigure == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			PathSegmentCollection pathSegmentCollection = new PathSegmentCollection();
			foreach (PathSegment segment in pathFigure.Segments)
			{
				if (segment is ArcSegment arcSegment)
				{
					pathSegmentCollection.Add(new ArcSegment
					{
						IsLargeArc = arcSegment.IsLargeArc,
						Point = arcSegment.Point,
						RotationAngle = arcSegment.RotationAngle,
						Size = arcSegment.Size,
						SweepDirection = arcSegment.SweepDirection
					});
				}
				else if (segment is BezierSegment bezierSegment)
				{
					pathSegmentCollection.Add(new BezierSegment
					{
						Point1 = bezierSegment.Point1,
						Point2 = bezierSegment.Point2,
						Point3 = bezierSegment.Point3
					});
				}
				else if (segment is LineSegment lineSegment)
				{
					pathSegmentCollection.Add(new LineSegment
					{
						Point = lineSegment.Point
					});
				}
				else if (segment is PolyBezierSegment polyBezierSegment)
				{
					PointCollection pointCollection = new PointCollection();
					foreach (Point point in polyBezierSegment.Points)
					{
						pointCollection.Add(point);
					}
					pathSegmentCollection.Add(new PolyBezierSegment
					{
						Points = pointCollection
					});
				}
				else if (segment is PolyLineSegment polyLineSegment)
				{
					PointCollection pointCollection2 = new PointCollection();
					foreach (Point point2 in polyLineSegment.Points)
					{
						pointCollection2.Add(point2);
					}
					pathSegmentCollection.Add(new PolyLineSegment
					{
						Points = pointCollection2
					});
				}
				else if (segment is PolyQuadraticBezierSegment polyQuadraticBezierSegment)
				{
					PointCollection pointCollection3 = new PointCollection();
					foreach (Point point3 in polyQuadraticBezierSegment.Points)
					{
						pointCollection3.Add(point3);
					}
					pathSegmentCollection.Add(new PolyQuadraticBezierSegment
					{
						Points = pointCollection3
					});
				}
				else
				{
					if (!(segment is QuadraticBezierSegment quadraticBezierSegment))
					{
						throw new NotImplementedException("PathFigure.Duplicate: " + segment.ToString());
					}
					pathSegmentCollection.Add(new QuadraticBezierSegment
					{
						Point1 = quadraticBezierSegment.Point1,
						Point2 = quadraticBezierSegment.Point2
					});
				}
			}
			return new PathFigure
			{
				IsClosed = pathFigure.IsClosed,
				IsFilled = pathFigure.IsFilled,
				StartPoint = pathFigure.StartPoint,
				Segments = pathSegmentCollection
			};
		}
	}
	public class PolygonUtil
	{
		public static bool PolygonContainsPoint(IList<Point> points, Point pt)
		{
			if (points == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int count = points.Count;
			if (count < 4)
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			int num = 0;
			int index = count - 1;
			while (num < count)
			{
				if (points[num].Y > pt.Y != points[index].Y > pt.Y && pt.X < (points[index].X - points[num].X) * (pt.Y - points[num].Y) / (points[index].Y - points[num].Y) + points[num].X)
				{
					flag = !flag;
				}
				index = num++;
			}
			return flag;
		}
	}
	public static class PolySimplification
	{
		public static int VertexReduction(Tuple<double[], double[]> points, double tolerance)
		{
			double[] item = points.Item1;
			double[] item2 = points.Item2;
			if (item.Length == 0)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			double num3 = tolerance * tolerance;
			num++;
			for (int i = 0; i < item.Length; i++)
			{
				double num4 = item[i] - item[num2];
				double num5 = item2[i] - item2[num2];
				if (num4 * num4 + num5 * num5 > num3)
				{
					item[num] = item[i];
					item2[num] = item2[i];
					num++;
					num2 = i;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		private static double SquareDistance(Point p1, Point p2)
		{
			double num = p2.X - p1.X;
			double num2 = p2.Y - p1.Y;
			return num * num + num2 * num2;
		}
	}
	public class SmartPlaceableWrapper<T> : ISmartPlaceable where T : FrameworkElement
	{
		private T _element;

		private static SmartPosition[] smartPositionDefault = new SmartPosition[1] { SmartPosition.CenterCenter };

		private static SmartPosition[] smartPositions = new SmartPosition[9]
		{
			SmartPosition.CenterCenter,
			SmartPosition.RightCenter,
			SmartPosition.RightTop,
			SmartPosition.CenterTop,
			SmartPosition.RightBottom,
			SmartPosition.CenterBottom,
			SmartPosition.LeftTop,
			SmartPosition.LeftCenter,
			SmartPosition.LeftBottom
		};

		private SmartPosition _smartPosition;

		public bool NoWiggle { get; set; }

		public T Element
		{
			get
			{
				return _element;
			}
			set
			{
				_element = value;
			}
		}

		public Point ElementLocationResult { get; protected set; }

		public Point OriginalLocation { get; set; }

		public double Opacity
		{
			get
			{
				return Element.Opacity;
			}
			set
			{
				Element.Opacity = value;
			}
		}

		public SmartPosition SmartPosition
		{
			get
			{
				return _smartPosition;
			}
			set
			{
				_smartPosition = value;
				Size smartElementSize = GetSmartElementSize();
				double height = smartElementSize.Height;
				double width = smartElementSize.Width;
				Point offset;
				if (Element.RenderTransform != null && Element.RenderTransform is ScaleTransform)
				{
					ScaleTransform scaleTransform = (ScaleTransform)Element.RenderTransform;
					double num = width * scaleTransform.ScaleX;
					double num2 = height * scaleTransform.ScaleY;
					offset = GetOffset(_smartPosition, num, num2);
					offset.X += (num - smartElementSize.Width) / 2.0;
					offset.Y += (num2 - smartElementSize.Height) / 2.0;
				}
				else
				{
					offset = GetOffset(_smartPosition, width, height);
				}
				ElementLocationResult = new Point(OriginalLocation.X + offset.X, OriginalLocation.Y + offset.Y);
			}
		}

		public SmartPlaceableWrapper()
		{
			NoWiggle = false;
		}

		public virtual SmartPosition[] GetSmartPositions()
		{
			if (NoWiggle)
			{
				return smartPositionDefault;
			}
			return smartPositions;
		}

		internal Size GetSmartElementSize()
		{
			Element.Measure(new Size(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity));
			double height = Element.DesiredSize.Height;
			double width = Element.DesiredSize.Width;
			if (Element.ActualHeight > 0.0 && Element.ActualWidth > 0.0)
			{
				height = Element.ActualHeight;
				width = Element.ActualWidth;
			}
			return new Size(width, height);
		}

		public Rect GetSmartBounds(SmartPosition position)
		{
			Size smartElementSize = GetSmartElementSize();
			double num = smartElementSize.Width;
			double num2 = smartElementSize.Height;
			Point offset;
			if (Element.RenderTransform != null && Element.RenderTransform is ScaleTransform)
			{
				ScaleTransform scaleTransform = (ScaleTransform)Element.RenderTransform;
				num *= scaleTransform.ScaleX;
				num2 *= scaleTransform.ScaleY;
				offset = GetOffset(position, num, num2);
				offset.X += (num - smartElementSize.Width) / 2.0;
				offset.Y += (num2 - smartElementSize.Height) / 2.0;
			}
			else
			{
				offset = GetOffset(position, num, num2);
			}
			return new Rect(OriginalLocation.X + offset.X, OriginalLocation.Y + offset.Y, num, num2);
		}

		private Point GetOffset(SmartPosition position, double w, double h)
		{
			return position switch
			{
				SmartPosition.LeftTop => new Point((0.0 - w) * 0.25, (0.0 - h) * 0.25), 
				SmartPosition.CenterTop => new Point(0.0, (0.0 - h) * 0.25), 
				SmartPosition.RightTop => new Point(w * 0.25, (0.0 - h) * 0.25), 
				SmartPosition.LeftCenter => new Point((0.0 - w) * 0.25, 0.0), 
				SmartPosition.CenterCenter => new Point(0.0, 0.0), 
				SmartPosition.RightCenter => new Point(w * 0.25, 0.0), 
				SmartPosition.LeftBottom => new Point((0.0 - w) * 0.25, h * 0.25), 
				SmartPosition.CenterBottom => new Point(0.0, h * 0.25), 
				_ => new Point(w * 0.25, h * 0.25), 
			};
		}
	}
	public enum SmartPosition
	{
		LeftTop,
		CenterTop,
		RightTop,
		LeftCenter,
		CenterCenter,
		RightCenter,
		LeftBottom,
		CenterBottom,
		RightBottom
	}
	public interface ISmartPlaceable
	{
		SmartPosition SmartPosition { get; set; }

		double Opacity { get; set; }

		SmartPosition[] GetSmartPositions();

		Rect GetSmartBounds(SmartPosition position);
	}
	public class SmartPlacer
	{
		private List<Rect> placed = new List<Rect>();

		public Rect? Bounds { get; set; }

		public double Overlap { get; set; }

		public double Fade { get; set; }

		public SmartPlacer()
		{
			Overlap = 0.3;
			Fade = 2.0;
		}

		public void Place([SwiftMutableParameter] ISmartPlaceable smartPlaceable)
		{
			if (smartPlaceable == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			double num = double.MaxValue;
			Rect rect = Rect.Empty;
			SmartPosition smartPosition = SmartPosition.CenterBottom;
			bool flag = false;
			SmartPosition[] smartPositions = smartPlaceable.GetSmartPositions();
			foreach (SmartPosition smartPosition2 in smartPositions)
			{
				Rect smartBounds = smartPlaceable.GetSmartBounds(smartPosition2);
				if (Bounds.HasValue && !Bounds.Value.Contains(smartBounds))
				{
					continue;
				}
				double num2 = 0.0;
				foreach (Rect item in placed)
				{
					num2 += smartBounds.IntersectionArea(item);
				}
				if (num2 == 0.0)
				{
					num = num2;
					smartPosition = smartPosition2;
					rect = smartBounds;
					flag = true;
					break;
				}
				if (num2 < num)
				{
					num = num2;
					smartPosition = smartPosition2;
					rect = smartBounds;
					flag = true;
				}
			}
			double num3 = 0.0;
			if (flag)
			{
				num3 = num / rect.GetArea();
			}
			if (!flag || num3 > Overlap)
			{
				smartPlaceable.Opacity = 0.0;
				return;
			}
			if (num > 0.0)
			{
				smartPlaceable.Opacity = Math.Pow(1.0 - MathUtil.Clamp(0.0, num3, 1.0), Fade);
			}
			else
			{
				smartPlaceable.Opacity = 1.0;
			}
			smartPlaceable.SmartPosition = smartPosition;
			placed.Add(rect);
		}
	}
	public interface IVisualData
	{
		string Serialize();
	}
	[DontObfuscate]
	public class PrimitiveVisualDataList : List<PrimitiveVisualData>, IVisualData
	{
		public PrimitiveVisualDataList ContainingTag(string tag)
		{
			PrimitiveVisualDataList primitiveVisualDataList = new PrimitiveVisualDataList();
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Count; i++)
			{
				PrimitiveVisualData primitiveVisualData = base[i];
				for (int j = 0; j < primitiveVisualData.Tags.Count; j++)
				{
					if (primitiveVisualData.Tags[j] == tag)
					{
						primitiveVisualDataList.Add(primitiveVisualData);
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			return primitiveVisualDataList;
		}

		public string Serialize()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			stringBuilder.Append("{ items: [");
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Count; i++)
			{
				if (i != 0)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(", ");
				}
				stringBuilder.Append(base[i].Serialize());
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}
	}
	[DontObfuscate]
	public class LabelAppearanceData : IVisualData
	{
		public string Text { get; set; }

		public string HorizontalAlignment { get; set; }

		public string VerticalAlignment { get; set; }

		public string TextAlignment { get; set; }

		public string TextWrapping { get; set; }

		public string TextPosition { get; set; }

		public ColorData LabelBrush { get; set; }

		public BrushAppearanceData LabelBrushExtended { get; set; }

		public double Angle { get; set; }

		public double Opacity { get; set; }

		public bool Visibility { get; set; }

		public string Font { get; set; }

		public string FontFamily { get; set; }

		public double FontSize { get; set; }

		public string FontWeight { get; set; }

		public string FontStyle { get; set; }

		public string FontStretch { get; set; }

		public double MarginLeft { get; set; }

		public double MarginRight { get; set; }

		public double MarginTop { get; set; }

		public double MarginBottom { get; set; }

		public string Serialize()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("{");
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("text: \"" + ((Text != null) ? Text : "") + "\", ");
			if (TextAlignment != null)
			{
				stringBuilder.AppendLine("textAlignment: \"" + TextAlignment + "\", ");
			}
			if (TextWrapping != null)
			{
				stringBuilder.AppendLine("textWrapping: \"" + TextWrapping + "\", ");
			}
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("labelBrush: " + ((LabelBrush != null) ? LabelBrush.Serialize() : "null") + ", ");
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("labelBrushExtended: " + ((LabelBrushExtended != null) ? LabelBrushExtended.Serialize() : "null") + ", ");
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("angle: " + Angle + ", ");
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("marginLeft: " + MarginLeft + ", ");
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("marginRight: " + MarginRight + ", ");
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("marginTop: " + MarginTop + ", ");
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("marginBottom: " + MarginBottom + ", ");
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("opacity: " + Opacity + ", ");
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("visibility: " + (Visibility ? "true" : "false") + ", ");
			if (HorizontalAlignment != null)
			{
				stringBuilder.AppendLine("horizontalAlignment: \"" + HorizontalAlignment + "\", ");
			}
			if (VerticalAlignment != null)
			{
				stringBuilder.AppendLine("verticalAlignment: \"" + VerticalAlignment + "\", ");
			}
			if (Font != null)
			{
				stringBuilder.AppendLine("font: \"" + Font + "\",");
			}
			if (FontFamily != null)
			{
				stringBuilder.AppendLine("fontFamily: \"" + FontFamily.Replace("\"", "'") + "\",");
			}
			if (FontWeight != null)
			{
				stringBuilder.AppendLine("fontWeight: \"" + FontWeight + "\",");
			}
			if (FontStyle != null)
			{
				stringBuilder.AppendLine("fontStyle: \"" + FontStyle + "\",");
			}
			if (FontStretch != null)
			{
				stringBuilder.AppendLine("fontStretch: \"" + FontStretch + "\",");
			}
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("fontSize: " + FontSize);
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("}");
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}
	}

	public class ColorData : IVisualData
	{
		public int A { get; set; }

		public int R { get; set; }

		public int G { get; set; }

		public int B { get; set; }

		public string Serialize()
		{
			return "{ a: " + A + ", r: " + R + ", g: " + G + ", b: " + B + "}";
		}

		internal static ColorData FromColor(Color color)
		{
			return new ColorData
			{
				A = color.A,
				R = color.R,
				G = color.G,
				B = color.B
			};
		}

		internal Color ToColor()
		{
			return new Color
			{
				A = (byte)A,
				R = (byte)R,
				G = (byte)G,
				B = (byte)B
			};
		}
	}
	[DontObfuscate]
	public class RectData : IVisualData
	{
		public double Top { get; set; }

		public double Left { get; set; }

		public double Width { get; set; }

		public double Height { get; set; }

		public bool IsEmpty => Width < 0.0;

		public static RectData Empty => new RectData(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity, double.NegativeInfinity, double.NegativeInfinity);

		public RectData(double left, double top, double width, double height)
		{
			Left = left;
			Top = top;
			Width = width;
			Height = height;
		}

		public string Serialize()
		{
			return "{ top: " + Top + ", left: " + Left + ", width: " + Width + ", height: " + Height + "}";
		}

		internal static RectData FromRect(Rect rect)
		{
			return new RectData(rect.Left, rect.Top, rect.Width, rect.Height);
		}

		internal Rect ToRect()
		{
			return new Rect(Left, Top, Width, Height);
		}
	}
	[DontObfuscate]
	public class PointData : IVisualData
	{
		public double X { get; set; }

		public double Y { get; set; }

		public static PointData Empty => new PointData(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity);

		public PointData(double x, double y)
		{
			X = x;
			Y = y;
		}

		public string Serialize()
		{
			return "{ x: " + X + ", y: " + Y + "}";
		}

		internal static PointData FromPoint(Point p)
		{
			return new PointData(p.X, p.Y);
		}

		internal Point ToPoint()
		{
			return new Point
			{
				X = X,
				Y = Y
			};
		}

		public override bool Equals(object other)
		{
			if (!(other is PointData pointData))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (pointData.X == X)
			{
				return pointData.Y == Y;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return (X.GetHashCode() * 397) ^ Y.GetHashCode();
		}
	}

	[DontObfuscate]
	public class PrimitiveAppearanceData : IVisualData
	{
		public ColorData Stroke { get; set; }

		public BrushAppearanceData StrokeExtended { get; set; }

		public ColorData Fill { get; set; }

		public BrushAppearanceData FillExtended { get; set; }

		public double StrokeThickness { get; set; }

		public bool IsVisible { get; set; }

		public double Opacity { get; set; }

		public double CanvasLeft { get; set; }

		public double CanvasTop { get; set; }

		public int CanvaZIndex { get; set; }

		public List<double> DashArray { get; set; }

		public int DashCap { get; set; }

		internal void ScaleByViewport(RectData viewport)
		{
			CanvasLeft = (CanvasLeft - viewport.Left) / viewport.Width;
			CanvasTop = (CanvasTop - viewport.Top) / viewport.Height;
		}

		public string Serialize()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("{");
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("stroke: " + ((Stroke != null) ? Stroke.Serialize() : "null") + ", ");
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("fill: " + ((Fill != null) ? Fill.Serialize() : "null") + ", ");
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("strokeExtended: " + ((StrokeExtended != null) ? StrokeExtended.Serialize() : "null") + ", ");
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("fillExtended: " + ((FillExtended != null) ? FillExtended.Serialize() : "null") + ", ");
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("strokeThickness: " + StrokeThickness + ", ");
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("isVisible: " + (IsVisible ? "true" : "false") + ", ");
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("opacity: " + Opacity + ", ");
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("canvasLeft: " + CanvasLeft + ", ");
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("canvasTop: " + CanvasTop + ", ");
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("canvasZIndex: " + CanvaZIndex + ", ");
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("dashArray: null, ");
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("dashCap: " + DashCap);
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("}");
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}
	}

	[DontObfuscate]
	public abstract class PrimitiveVisualData : IVisualData
	{
		public PrimitiveAppearanceData Appearance { get; set; }

		public ShapeTags Tags { get; set; }

		public abstract string Type { get; }

		public string Name { get; set; }

		protected PrimitiveVisualData()
		{
		}

		protected PrimitiveVisualData(string name)
		{
			Name = name;
			Tags = new ShapeTags();
			Appearance = new PrimitiveAppearanceData();
		}

		public virtual void ScaleByViewport(RectData viewport)
		{
			Appearance.ScaleByViewport(viewport);
		}

		public List<List<PointData>> GetPoints(GetPointsSettings settings)
		{
			List<List<PointData>> list = new List<List<PointData>>();
			GetPointsOverride(list, settings);
			return list;
		}

		public abstract void GetPointsOverride(List<List<PointData>> points, GetPointsSettings settings);

		public string Serialize()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("{");
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("appearance: " + ((Appearance != null) ? Appearance.Serialize() : "null") + ", ");
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("tags: [");
			for (int i = 0; i < Tags.Count; i++)
			{
				if (i != 0)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(", ");
				}
				stringBuilder.Append("\"" + Tags[i] + "\"");
			}
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("],");
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("type: \"" + Type + "\", ");
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("name: \"" + Name + "\", ");
			stringBuilder.AppendLine(SerializeOverride());
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("}");
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		protected virtual string SerializeOverride()
		{
			return "";
		}
	}
	[DontObfuscate]
	public class RectangleVisualData : PrimitiveVisualData
	{
		public double Width { get; set; }

		public double Height { get; set; }

		public double RadiusX { get; set; }

		public double RadiusY { get; set; }

		public override string Type => "Rectangle";

		public RectangleVisualData()
			: base("rect1")
		{
		}

		protected override string SerializeOverride()
		{
			return "width: " + Width + ", height: " + Height + ", radiusX: " + RadiusX + ", radiusY: " + RadiusY;
		}

		internal RectangleVisualData(string name, Rectangle rect)
			: base(name)
		{
			Width = rect.Width;
			Height = rect.Height;
			RadiusX = rect.RadiusX;
			RadiusY = rect.RadiusY;
			AppearanceHelper.GetShapeAppearance(base.Appearance, rect);
		}

		public override void ScaleByViewport(RectData viewport)
		{
			base.ScaleByViewport(viewport);
			Width /= viewport.Width;
			Height /= viewport.Height;
		}

		public override void GetPointsOverride(List<List<PointData>> points, GetPointsSettings settings)
		{
			List<PointData> list = new List<PointData>();
			points.Add(list);
			list.Add(new PointData(base.Appearance.CanvasLeft, base.Appearance.CanvasTop));
			list.Add(new PointData(base.Appearance.CanvasLeft + Width, base.Appearance.CanvasTop));
			list.Add(new PointData(base.Appearance.CanvasLeft + Width, base.Appearance.CanvasTop + Height));
			list.Add(new PointData(base.Appearance.CanvasLeft, base.Appearance.CanvasTop + Height));
		}
	}

	[DontObfuscate]
	public class PolyLineVisualData : PrimitiveVisualData
	{
		public override string Type => "Polyline";

		public List<PointData> Points { get; set; }

		public PolyLineVisualData()
			: base("polyLine1")
		{
			Points = new List<PointData>();
		}

		internal PolyLineVisualData(string name, Polyline line)
			: base(name)
		{
			Points = new List<PointData>();
			for (int i = 0; i < line.Points.Count; i++)
			{
				Points.Add(PointData.FromPoint(line.Points[i]));
			}
			AppearanceHelper.GetShapeAppearance(base.Appearance, line);
		}

		protected override string SerializeOverride()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("points: [");
			for (int i = 0; i < Points.Count; i++)
			{
				if (i != 0)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(", ");
				}
				stringBuilder.Append("{ x: " + Points[i].X + ", y: " + Points[i].Y + "}");
			}
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("]");
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		public override void ScaleByViewport(RectData viewport)
		{
			base.ScaleByViewport(viewport);
			for (int i = 0; i < Points.Count; i++)
			{
				Points[i] = new PointData((Points[i].X - viewport.Left) / viewport.Width, (Points[i].Y - viewport.Top) / viewport.Height);
			}
		}

		public override void GetPointsOverride(List<List<PointData>> points, GetPointsSettings settings)
		{
			List<PointData> list = new List<PointData>();
			points.Add(list);
			for (int i = 0; i < Points.Count; i++)
			{
				list.Add(Points[i]);
			}
		}
	}

	[DontObfuscate]
	public class PathVisualData : PrimitiveVisualData
	{
		public override string Type => "Path";

		public List<GeometryData> Data { get; set; }

		public PathVisualData()
			: base("path1")
		{
			Data = new List<GeometryData>();
		}

		internal PathVisualData(string name, System.Windows.Shapes.Path path)
			: base(name)
		{
			Data = AppearanceHelper.FromGeometry(path.Data);
			AppearanceHelper.GetShapeAppearance(base.Appearance, path);
		}

		internal PathVisualData(string name, Line line)
			: base(name)
		{
			Data = AppearanceHelper.FromLineData(line);
			AppearanceHelper.GetShapeAppearance(base.Appearance, line);
		}

		protected override string SerializeOverride()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("data: [");
			for (int i = 0; i < Data.Count; i++)
			{
				if (i != 0)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(", ");
				}
				stringBuilder.Append((Data[i] != null) ? Data[i].Serialize() : "null");
			}
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("]");
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		public override void ScaleByViewport(RectData viewport)
		{
			base.ScaleByViewport(viewport);
			foreach (GeometryData datum in Data)
			{
				datum.ScaleByViewport(viewport);
			}
		}

		public override void GetPointsOverride(List<List<PointData>> points, GetPointsSettings settings)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < Data.Count; i++)
			{
				Data[i].GetPointsOverride(points, settings);
			}
		}
	}
	[DontObfuscate]
	public abstract class GeometryData : IVisualData
	{
		public abstract string Type { get; }

		public abstract void ScaleByViewport(RectData viewport);

		public abstract void GetPointsOverride(List<List<PointData>> points, GetPointsSettings settings);

		public string Serialize()
		{
			return "{ type: \"" + Type + "\", " + SerializeOverride() + "}";
		}

		protected virtual string SerializeOverride()
		{
			return "";
		}
	}
	[DontObfuscate]
	public class PathGeometryData : GeometryData
	{
		public override string Type => "Path";

		public List<PathFigureData> Figures { get; set; }

		public PathGeometryData()
		{
			Figures = new List<PathFigureData>();
		}

		protected override string SerializeOverride()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("figures: [");
			for (int i = 0; i < Figures.Count; i++)
			{
				if (i != 0)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(", ");
				}
				stringBuilder.Append(Figures[i].Serialize());
			}
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("]");
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		public override void ScaleByViewport(RectData viewport)
		{
			foreach (PathFigureData figure in Figures)
			{
				figure.ScaleByViewport(viewport);
			}
		}

		public override void GetPointsOverride(List<List<PointData>> points, GetPointsSettings settings)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < Figures.Count; i++)
			{
				Figures[i].GetPointsOverride(points, settings);
			}
		}
	}

			return "x1: " + X1 + ", y1: " + Y1 + ", x2: " + X2 + ", y2:" + Y2;
		}

		public override void ScaleByViewport(RectData viewport)
		{
			X1 = (X1 - viewport.Left) / viewport.Width;
			Y1 = (Y1 - viewport.Top) / viewport.Height;
			X2 = (X2 - viewport.Left) / viewport.Width;
			Y2 = (Y2 - viewport.Top) / viewport.Height;
		}

		public override void GetPointsOverride(List<List<PointData>> points, GetPointsSettings settings)
		{
			List<PointData> list = new List<PointData>();
			points.Add(list);
			list.Add(new PointData(X1, Y1));
			list.Add(new PointData(X2, Y2));
		}
	}
	[DontObfuscate]
	public class RectangleGeometryData : GeometryData
	{
		public override string Type => "Rectangle";

		public double X { get; set; }

		public double Y { get; set; }

		public double Width { get; set; }

		public double Height { get; set; }

		protected override string SerializeOverride()
		{
			return "x: " + X + ", y: " + Y + ", width: " + Width + ", height: " + Height;
		}

		public override void ScaleByViewport(RectData viewport)
		{
			X = (X - viewport.Left) / viewport.Width;
			Y = (Y - viewport.Top) / viewport.Height;
			Width /= viewport.Width;
			Height /= viewport.Height;
		}

		public override void GetPointsOverride(List<List<PointData>> points, GetPointsSettings settings)
		{
			List<PointData> list = new List<PointData>();
			points.Add(list);
			list.Add(new PointData(X, Y));
			list.Add(new PointData(X + Width, Y));
			list.Add(new PointData(X + Width, Y + Height));
			list.Add(new PointData(X, Y + Height));
		}
	}

	[DontObfuscate]
	public class PathFigureData : IVisualData
	{
		public PointData StartPoint { get; set; }

		public List<SegmentData> Segments { get; set; }

		public PathFigureData()
		{
			Segments = new List<SegmentData>();
			StartPoint = new PointData(double.NaN, double.NaN);
		}

		internal PathFigureData(PathFigure fig)
		{
			Segments = new List<SegmentData>();
			StartPoint = PointData.FromPoint(fig.StartPoint);
			for (int i = 0; i < fig.Segments.Count; i++)
			{
				PathSegment pathSegment = fig.Segments[i];
				SegmentData item = null;
				if (pathSegment is LineSegment)
				{
					item = new LineSegmentData((LineSegment)pathSegment);
				}
				else if (pathSegment is PolyLineSegment)
				{
					item = new PolylineSegmentData((PolyLineSegment)pathSegment);
				}
				else if (pathSegment is ArcSegment)
				{
					item = new ArcSegmentData((ArcSegment)pathSegment);
				}
				else if (pathSegment is PolyBezierSegment)
				{
					item = new PolyBezierSegmentData((PolyBezierSegment)pathSegment);
				}
				else if (pathSegment is BezierSegment)
				{
					item = new BezierSegmentData((BezierSegment)pathSegment);
				}
				Segments.Add(item);
			}
		}

		public string Serialize()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("{");
			if (StartPoint != null)
			{
				stringBuilder.AppendLine("startPoint: { x: " + StartPoint.X + ", y: " + StartPoint.Y + "}, ");
			}
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("segments: [");
			for (int i = 0; i < Segments.Count; i++)
			{
				if (i != 0)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(", ");
				}
				stringBuilder.Append(Segments[i].Serialize());
			}
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("]");
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("}");
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		internal void ScaleByViewport(RectData viewport)
		{
			if (StartPoint != null)
			{
				StartPoint = new PointData((StartPoint.X - viewport.Left) / viewport.Width, (StartPoint.Y - viewport.Top) / viewport.Height);
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < Segments.Count; i++)
			{
				Segments[i].ScaleByViewport(viewport);
			}
		}

		public void GetPointsOverride(List<List<PointData>> points, GetPointsSettings settings)
		{
			List<PointData> list = new List<PointData>();
			points.Add(list);
			if (!settings.IgnoreFigureStartPoint)
			{
				list.Add(new PointData(StartPoint.X, StartPoint.Y));
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < Segments.Count; i++)
			{
				Segments[i].GetPointsOverride(list, settings);
			}
		}
	}
	[DontObfuscate]
	public abstract class SegmentData : IVisualData
	{
		public abstract string Type { get; }

		public abstract void ScaleByViewport(RectData viewport);

		public abstract void GetPointsOverride(List<PointData> current, GetPointsSettings settings);

		public string Serialize()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("{");
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("type: \"" + Type + "\", ");
			stringBuilder.AppendLine(SerializeOverride());
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("}");
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		protected virtual string SerializeOverride()
		{
			return "";
		}
	}
	[DontObfuscate]
	public class LineSegmentData : SegmentData
	{
		public override string Type => "Line";

		public PointData Point { get; set; }

		public LineSegmentData()
		{
			Point = new PointData(double.NaN, double.NaN);
		}

		internal LineSegmentData(LineSegment seg)
		{
			Point = PointData.FromPoint(seg.Point);
		}

		protected override string SerializeOverride()
		{
			return "point: { x: " + Point.X + ", y: " + Point.Y + "}";
		}

		public override void ScaleByViewport(RectData viewport)
		{
			Point = new PointData((Point.X - viewport.Left) / viewport.Width, (Point.Y - viewport.Top) / viewport.Height);
		}

		public override void GetPointsOverride(List<PointData> current, GetPointsSettings settings)
		{
			current.Add(new PointData(Point.X, Point.Y));
		}
	}
	[DontObfuscate]
	public class PolylineSegmentData : SegmentData
	{
		public override string Type => "Polyline";

		public List<PointData> Points { get; set; }

		public PolylineSegmentData()
		{
			Points = new List<PointData>();
		}

		internal PolylineSegmentData(PolyLineSegment poly)
		{
			Points = new List<PointData>();
			for (int i = 0; i < poly.Points.Count; i++)
			{
				Points.Add(PointData.FromPoint(poly.Points[i]));
			}
		}

		protected override string SerializeOverride()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("points: [");
			for (int i = 0; i < Points.Count; i++)
			{
				if (i != 0)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(", ");
				}
				stringBuilder.Append("{ x: " + Points[i].X + ", y: " + Points[i].Y + "}");
			}
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("]");
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		public override void ScaleByViewport(RectData viewport)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < Points.Count; i++)
			{
				Points[i] = new PointData((Points[i].X - viewport.Left) / viewport.Width, (Points[i].Y - viewport.Top) / viewport.Height);
			}
		}

		public override void GetPointsOverride(List<PointData> current, GetPointsSettings settings)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < Points.Count; i++)
			{
				current.Add(new PointData(Points[i].X, Points[i].Y));
			}
		}
	}

				stringBuilder.Append("{ x: " + Points[i].X + ", y: " + Points[i].Y + "}");
			}
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("]");
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		public override void ScaleByViewport(RectData viewport)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < Points.Count && Points[i] != null; i++)
			{
				Points[i] = new PointData((Points[i].X - viewport.Left) / viewport.Width, (Points[i].Y - viewport.Top) / viewport.Height);
			}
		}

		public override void GetPointsOverride(List<PointData> current, GetPointsSettings settings)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < Points.Count; i++)
			{
				current.Add(new PointData(Points[i].X, Points[i].Y));
			}
		}
	}
