	[DontObfuscate]
	public class ArcSegmentData : SegmentData
	{
		public override string Type => "Arc";

		public PointData Point { get; set; }

		public bool IsLargeArc { get; set; }

		public bool IsCounterClockwise { get; set; }

		public double SizeX { get; set; }

		public double SizeY { get; set; }

		public double RotationAngle { get; set; }

		public ArcSegmentData()
		{
			Point = new PointData(double.NaN, double.NaN);
			IsLargeArc = false;
			IsCounterClockwise = true;
			RotationAngle = 0.0;
		}

		internal ArcSegmentData(ArcSegment arc)
		{
			Point = PointData.FromPoint(arc.Point);
			IsLargeArc = arc.IsLargeArc;
			IsCounterClockwise = arc.SweepDirection == SweepDirection.Counterclockwise;
			SizeX = arc.Size.Width;
			SizeY = arc.Size.Height;
			RotationAngle = arc.RotationAngle;
		}

		protected override string SerializeOverride()
		{
			return "point: { x: " + Point.X + ", y: " + Point.Y + " }, isLargeArc: " + (IsLargeArc ? "true" : "false") + ", isCounterClockwise: " + (IsCounterClockwise ? "true" : "false") + ", sizeX: " + SizeX + ", sizeY: " + SizeY + ", rotationAngle: " + RotationAngle;
		}

		public override void ScaleByViewport(RectData viewport)
		{
			Point = new PointData((Point.X - viewport.Left) / viewport.Width, (Point.Y - viewport.Top) / viewport.Height);
			SizeX /= viewport.Width;
			SizeY /= viewport.Height;
		}

		public override void GetPointsOverride(List<PointData> current, GetPointsSettings settings)
		{
			current.Add(new PointData(Point.X, Point.Y));
		}
	}
	[DontObfuscate]
	public class AppearanceHelper
	{
		internal static ColorData FromBrush(Brush b)
		{
			if (b == null)
			{
				return ColorData.FromColor(Color.FromArgb(0, 0, 0, 0));
			}
			Color color = Color.FromArgb(0, 0, 0, 0);
			if (b is SolidColorBrush)
			{
				byte a = (byte)(b.Opacity * (double)(int)((SolidColorBrush)b).Color.A);
				color = ((SolidColorBrush)b).Color;
				color.A = a;
			}
			else if (b is LinearGradientBrush && ((LinearGradientBrush)b).GradientStops.Count > 0)
			{
				color = ((LinearGradientBrush)b).GradientStops[0].Color;
			}
			else if (b is RadialGradientBrush && ((RadialGradientBrush)b).GradientStops.Count > 0)
			{
				color = ((RadialGradientBrush)b).GradientStops[0].Color;
			}
			return ColorData.FromColor(color);
		}

		internal static BrushAppearanceData FromBrushExtended(Brush b)
		{
			if (b is SolidColorBrush)
			{
				Color color = ((SolidColorBrush)b).Color;
				if (b.Opacity < 1.0)
				{
					color.A = (byte)(b.Opacity * 255.0);
				}
				return new SolidBrushAppearanceData
				{
					ColorValue = ColorData.FromColor(color)
				};
			}
			if (b is LinearGradientBrush)
			{
				LinearGradientBrushAppearanceData linearGradientBrushAppearanceData = new LinearGradientBrushAppearanceData();
				LinearGradientBrush linearGradientBrush = (LinearGradientBrush)b;
				linearGradientBrushAppearanceData.StartX = linearGradientBrush.StartPoint.X;
				linearGradientBrushAppearanceData.StartY = linearGradientBrush.StartPoint.Y;
				linearGradientBrushAppearanceData.EndX = linearGradientBrush.EndPoint.X;
				linearGradientBrushAppearanceData.EndY = linearGradientBrush.EndPoint.Y;
				{
					foreach (GradientStop gradientStop in linearGradientBrush.GradientStops)
					{
						linearGradientBrushAppearanceData.Stops.Add(new GradientStopAppearanceData
						{
							ColorValue = ColorData.FromColor(gradientStop.Color),
							Offset = gradientStop.Offset
						});
					}
					return linearGradientBrushAppearanceData;
				}
			}
			_ = b is RadialGradientBrush;
			return null;
		}

		internal static double GetCanvasLeft(FrameworkElement visual)
		{
			double num = Canvas.GetLeft(visual);
			Transform transform = visual.RenderTransform;
			if (transform is TransformGroup)
			{
				foreach (Transform child in ((TransformGroup)transform).Children)
				{
					if (child is TranslateTransform)
					{
						transform = child;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			if (transform != null && transform is TranslateTransform)
			{
				num = ((!double.IsNaN(num)) ? (num + ((TranslateTransform)transform).X) : ((TranslateTransform)transform).X);
			}
			return num;
		}

		internal static double GetCanvasTop(FrameworkElement visual)
		{
			double num = Canvas.GetTop(visual);
			Transform transform = visual.RenderTransform;
			if (transform is TransformGroup)
			{
				foreach (Transform child in ((TransformGroup)transform).Children)
				{
					if (child is TranslateTransform)
					{
						transform = child;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			if (transform != null && transform is TranslateTransform)
			{
				num = ((!double.IsNaN(num)) ? (num + ((TranslateTransform)transform).Y) : ((TranslateTransform)transform).Y);
			}
			return num;
		}

		internal static int GetCanvasZIndex(FrameworkElement line)
		{
			return Panel.GetZIndex(line);
		}

		internal static List<GeometryData> FromPathData(System.Windows.Shapes.Path path)
		{
			return FromGeometry(path.Data);
		}

		internal static List<GeometryData> FromLineData(Line line)
		{
			return FromGeometry(new LineGeometry
			{
				EndPoint = new Point(line.X2, line.Y2),
				StartPoint = new Point(line.X1, line.Y1)
			});
		}

		internal static List<GeometryData> FromGeometry(Geometry data)
		{
			if (data == null)
			{
				return new List<GeometryData>();
			}
			if (data is GeometryGroup)
			{
				List<GeometryData> list = new List<GeometryData>();
				GeometryGroup geometryGroup = (GeometryGroup)data;
				for (int i = 0; i < geometryGroup.Children.Count; i++)
				{
					List<GeometryData> list2 = FromGeometry(geometryGroup.Children[i]);
					for (int j = 0; j < list2.Count; j++)
					{
						list.Add(list2[j]);
					}
				}
				return list;
			}
			if (data is PathGeometry)
			{
				return FromPathGeometry((PathGeometry)data);
			}
			if (data is LineGeometry)
			{
				return FromLineGeometry((LineGeometry)data);
			}
			if (data is RectangleGeometry)
			{
				return FromRectangleGeometry((RectangleGeometry)data);
			}
			if (data is EllipseGeometry)
			{
				return FromEllipseGeometry((EllipseGeometry)data);
			}
			if (data is StreamGeometry)
			{
				return FromPathGeometry(PresentationUtilities.LoadXaml("<PathGeometry xmlns=\"http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation\" xmlns:x=\"http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml\" Figures=\"" + data.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + "\" />") as PathGeometry);
			}
			throw new NotSupportedException("not supported");
		}

		private static List<GeometryData> FromEllipseGeometry(EllipseGeometry ellipseGeometry)
		{
			List<GeometryData> list = new List<GeometryData>();
			EllipseGeometryData ellipseGeometryData = new EllipseGeometryData();
			list.Add(ellipseGeometryData);
			ellipseGeometryData.CenterX = ellipseGeometry.Center.X;
			ellipseGeometryData.CenterY = ellipseGeometry.Center.Y;
			ellipseGeometryData.RadiusX = ellipseGeometry.RadiusX;
			ellipseGeometryData.RadiusY = ellipseGeometry.RadiusY;
			return list;
		}

		private static List<GeometryData> FromRectangleGeometry(RectangleGeometry rectangleGeometry)
		{
			List<GeometryData> list = new List<GeometryData>();
			RectangleGeometryData rectangleGeometryData = new RectangleGeometryData();
			list.Add(rectangleGeometryData);
			rectangleGeometryData.X = rectangleGeometry.Rect.X;
			rectangleGeometryData.Y = rectangleGeometry.Rect.Y;
			rectangleGeometryData.Width = rectangleGeometry.Rect.Width;
			rectangleGeometryData.Height = rectangleGeometry.Rect.Height;
			return list;
		}

		private static List<GeometryData> FromLineGeometry(LineGeometry lineGeometry)
		{
			List<GeometryData> list = new List<GeometryData>();
			LineGeometryData lineGeometryData = new LineGeometryData();
			list.Add(lineGeometryData);
			lineGeometryData.X1 = lineGeometry.StartPoint.X;
			lineGeometryData.Y1 = lineGeometry.StartPoint.Y;
			lineGeometryData.X2 = lineGeometry.EndPoint.X;
			lineGeometryData.Y2 = lineGeometry.EndPoint.Y;
			return list;
		}

		private static List<GeometryData> FromPathGeometry(PathGeometry pathGeometry)
		{
			List<GeometryData> list = new List<GeometryData>();
			PathGeometryData pathGeometryData = new PathGeometryData();
			list.Add(pathGeometryData);
			for (int i = 0; i < pathGeometry.Figures.Count; i++)
			{
				PathFigureData item = new PathFigureData(pathGeometry.Figures[i]);
				pathGeometryData.Figures.Add(item);
			}
			return list;
		}

		internal static void GetShapeAppearance(PrimitiveAppearanceData appearance, Shape path)
		{
			appearance.Stroke = FromBrush(path.Stroke);
			appearance.Fill = FromBrush(path.Fill);
			appearance.StrokeExtended = FromBrushExtended(path.Stroke);
			appearance.FillExtended = FromBrushExtended(path.Fill);
			appearance.StrokeThickness = path.StrokeThickness;
			if (path.StrokeDashArray == null)
			{
				appearance.DashArray = null;
			}
			else
			{
				appearance.DashArray = new List<double>();
				foreach (double item in path.StrokeDashArray)
				{
					appearance.DashArray.Add(item);
				}
			}
			appearance.DashCap = (int)path.StrokeDashCap;
			appearance.IsVisible = path.Visibility == Visibility.Visible;
			appearance.Opacity = path.Opacity;
			appearance.CanvasLeft = GetCanvasLeft(path);
			appearance.CanvasTop = GetCanvasTop(path);
			appearance.CanvaZIndex = GetCanvasZIndex(path);
		}

		internal static LabelAppearanceData FromTextElement(FrameworkElement frameworkElement, [SwiftMutableParameter] FontInfo fontInfo)
		{
			LabelAppearanceData labelAppearanceData = new LabelAppearanceData();
			TextBlock textBlock = (TextBlock)frameworkElement;
			labelAppearanceData.Text = textBlock.Text;
			labelAppearanceData.LabelBrush = FromBrush(textBlock.Foreground);
			labelAppearanceData.LabelBrushExtended = FromBrushExtended(textBlock.Foreground);
			labelAppearanceData.Visibility = textBlock.Visibility == Visibility.Visible;
			labelAppearanceData.Opacity = textBlock.Opacity;
			if (fontInfo == null)
			{
				fontInfo = FontUtil.GetFontInfo(textBlock, null);
			}
			if (fontInfo != null)
			{
				if (fontInfo.FontFamily != null)
				{
					labelAppearanceData.FontFamily = fontInfo.FontFamily.Source;
				}
				if (fontInfo.FontSize.HasValue && !double.IsNaN(fontInfo.FontSize.Value))
				{
					labelAppearanceData.FontSize = fontInfo.FontSize.Value;
				}
				if (fontInfo.FontWeight.HasValue)
				{
					labelAppearanceData.FontWeight = ExtractFontWeight(fontInfo.FontWeight);
				}
				if (fontInfo.FontStyle.HasValue)
				{
					labelAppearanceData.FontStyle = fontInfo.FontStyle.ToString();
				}
				if (fontInfo.FontStretch.HasValue)
				{
					labelAppearanceData.FontStretch = fontInfo.FontStretch.ToString();
				}
			}
			double angle = 0.0;
			Transform renderTransform = textBlock.RenderTransform;
			if (renderTransform is RotateTransform)
			{
				angle = (renderTransform as RotateTransform).Angle;
			}
			else if (renderTransform is TransformGroup)
			{
				foreach (Transform child in (renderTransform as TransformGroup).Children)
				{
					if (child is RotateTransform)
					{
						angle = (child as RotateTransform).Angle;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			labelAppearanceData.Angle = angle;
			return labelAppearanceData;
		}

		private static string ExtractFontWeight(FontWeight? fontWeight)
		{
			if (!fontWeight.HasValue)
			{
				return "Normal";
			}
			return fontWeight.Value.ToString();
		}

		public static bool SerializeItems(StringBuilder sb, string name, IEnumerable<IVisualData> items, bool isFirst)
		{
			if (items != null)
			{
				if (!isFirst)
				{
					sb.Append(", ");
				}
				sb.Append(name);
				sb.Append(": [");
				bool flag = false;
				foreach (IVisualData item in items)
				{
					if (flag)
					{
						sb.AppendLine(", ");
					}
					else
					{
						flag = true;
					}
					sb.Append(item.Serialize());
				}
				sb.AppendLine("]");
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool SerializeItem(StringBuilder sb, string name, IVisualData item, bool isFirst)
		{
			if (item != null)
			{
				if (!isFirst)
				{
					sb.Append(", ");
				}
				sb.Append(name);
				sb.Append(": ");
				sb.AppendLine(item.Serialize());
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
}

		protected void OnPropertyUpdated(string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			OnPropertyUpdatedOverride(propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
			if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnPropertyUpdatedOverride(string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "StockPricesTimeRange":
			case "StockPricesTimeInterval":
			case "StockPricesTradeAfterHours":
				StockRegenerate();
				break;
			case "StockSymbols":
				StockGenerate((string[])oldValue, (string[])newValue);
				break;
			}
		}

		protected internal void OnStockSymbolsChanged(string[] oldStocks, string[] newStocks)

			{
				newStocks = new string[0];
			}
			Log("OnStockChanged " + oldStocks.Length + " -> " + newStocks.Length);
			if (this.StockSymbolsChanged != null)
			{
				this.StockSymbolsChanged(this, new StockChangedEventArgs(oldStocks, newStocks));
			}
		}

		}

		public void ClearData()
		{
			_StockSymbols = new string[0];
			CachedPrices.Clear();
			CachedPositions.Clear();
			StockPrices.Clear();
			StockPositions.Clear();
		}

		public void RemoveStockPosition(int index)
		{
			OnRemovingPosition(index);
		}

		public void RemoveStockPrices(string symbol)

			OnRemovingPrices(symbol, 0);
		}

		protected internal void StockAdd(string symbol, string name = "")
		{
			string[] stockSymbols = StockSymbols;
			foreach (string key in stockSymbols)
			{
				if (!StockNames.ContainsKey(key))
				{
					StockNames.Add(key, "");
				}
			}
			if (StockNames.ContainsKey(symbol))
			{
				StockNames[symbol] = name;
			}
			else
			{
				StockNames.Add(symbol, name);
			}
			List<string> list = ExtToList(StockSymbols);
			if (!list.Contains(symbol))
			{
				list.Add(symbol);
			}
			StockSymbols = ExtToArray(list);
		}

		protected internal void StockRemove(string symbol)
		{
			if (CachedPrices.ContainsKey(symbol))
			{
				List<string> list = ExtToList(StockSymbols);
				if (StockNames.ContainsKey(symbol))
				{
					StockNames.Remove(symbol);
				}
				List<string> list2 = ExtToList(StockSymbols);
				if (list2.Contains(symbol))
				{
					list2.Remove(symbol);
				}
				_StockSymbols = ExtToArray(list2);
				StockGenerate(ExtToArray(list), ExtToArray(list2));
			}
		}

		private string GetStockName(string stockSymbol)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(stockSymbol))
			{
				return "";
			}
			if (StockNames.ContainsKey(stockSymbol))
			{
				return StockNames[stockSymbol];
			}
			return "";
		}

		protected virtual StockPriceHistory OnGeneratingPrices(string stockSymbol)
		{
			DataGenerator.DateRange = StockPricesTimeRange;
			DataGenerator.DateInterval = StockPricesTimeInterval;
			DataGenerator.SkipAfterHours = !StockPricesTradeAfterHours;
			string stockName = GetStockName(stockSymbol);
			if (this.PopulateStockPrices == null)
			{
				Log("OnGeneratingPrices " + stockSymbol);
				return DataGenerator.GenerateStockPrices(stockSymbol, stockName);
			}
			Log("OnPopulatePrices " + stockSymbol);
			return this.PopulateStockPrices(stockSymbol);
		}

		protected virtual StockPosition OnGeneratingPosition(string stockSymbol)
		{
			DataGenerator.DateRange = StockPricesTimeRange;
			DataGenerator.DateInterval = StockPricesTimeInterval;
			DataGenerator.SkipAfterHours = !StockPricesTradeAfterHours;
			string stockName = GetStockName(stockSymbol);
			if (this.PopulateStockPosition == null)
			{
				Log("OnGeneratingPosition " + stockSymbol);
				return DataGenerator.GeneratePosition(stockSymbol, stockName);
			}
			Log("OnPopulatePosition " + stockSymbol);
			return this.PopulateStockPosition(stockSymbol);
		}

		protected virtual void OnAddingPosition(string stockSymbol, StockPosition stockPosition)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(stockSymbol) && stockPosition != null)
			{
				stockPosition.Index = CachedPositions.Count;
				CachedPositions.Add(stockPosition);
				StockPositions.Add(stockPosition);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnAddingPrices(string stockSymbol, StockPriceHistory stockPrices)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(stockSymbol) && stockPrices != null)
			{
				Log("OnAddingPrices " + stockSymbol);
				if (!CachedPrices.ContainsKey(stockSymbol))
				{
					CachedPrices.Add(stockSymbol, stockPrices);
					StockPrices.Add(stockPrices);
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnRemovingPrices(string stockSymbol, int stockIndex)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(stockSymbol))
			{
				return;
			}
			Log("OnRemovingPrices " + stockSymbol);
			if (!CachedPrices.ContainsKey(stockSymbol))
			{
				return;
			}
			CachedPrices.Remove(stockSymbol);
			StockPrices.Clear();
			foreach (StockPriceHistory value in CachedPrices.Values)
			{
				StockPrices.Add(value);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnRemovingPosition(int stockIndex)
		{
			Log("OnRemovingPosition " + stockIndex);
			if (CachedPositions.Count > stockIndex)
			{
				CachedPositions.RemoveAt(stockIndex);
				for (int i = 0; i < CachedPositions.Count; i++)
				{
					CachedPositions[i].Index = i;
				}
				StockPositions = ExtToCollection(CachedPositions);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnStockClearing()
		{
			Log("OnStockClearing ");
			StockUpdate(StockSymbols, new string[0], forceUpdate: true);
		}

		protected void StockUpdate(string[] oldStocks, string[] newStocks, bool forceUpdate = false)
		{
			if (ExtEquals(oldStocks, newStocks))
			{
				return;
			}
			List<string> list = ExtToList(oldStocks);
			foreach (string item in newStocks)
			{
				if (!list.Contains(item))
				{
					list.Add(item);
				}
			}
			_StockSymbols = ExtToArray(list);
			OnPropertyUpdated("StockSymbols", null, _StockSymbols);
			OnStockSymbolsChanged(oldStocks, _StockSymbols);
		}

		protected void StockGenerate(string[] oldStocks, string[] newStocks)
		{
			if (oldStocks == newStocks)
			{
				return;
			}
			Log("StockGenerate ");
			if (oldStocks != null && oldStocks.Length != 0)
			{
				for (int num = oldStocks.Length - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					string text = oldStocks[num];
					if (CachedPrices.ContainsKey(text))
					{
						OnRemovingPrices(text, num);
					}
				}
			}
			if (newStocks == null || newStocks.Length == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (string text2 in newStocks)
			{
				if (!CachedPrices.ContainsKey(text2))
				{
					StockPosition stockPosition = OnGeneratingPosition(text2);
					StockPriceHistory stockPrices = OnGeneratingPrices(text2);
					OnAddingPrices(text2, stockPrices);
					OnAddingPosition(text2, stockPosition);
				}
			}
		}

		protected void StockRegenerate()
		{
			DataGenerator.DateRange = StockPricesTimeRange;
			DataGenerator.DateInterval = StockPricesTimeInterval;
			DataGenerator.SkipAfterHours = !StockPricesTradeAfterHours;
			if (StockSymbols == null || StockSymbols.Length == 0)
			{
				CachedPrices.Clear();
				CachedPositions.Clear();
				StockPrices.Clear();
				StockPositions.Clear();
				return;
			}
			CachedPrices.Clear();
			CachedPositions.Clear();
			StockPrices.Clear();
			StockPositions.Clear();
			for (int i = 0; i < StockSymbols.Length; i++)
			{
				string stockSymbol = StockSymbols[i];
				StockPosition stockPosition = OnGeneratingPosition(stockSymbol);
				StockPriceHistory stockPrices = OnGeneratingPrices(stockSymbol);
				OnAddingPrices(stockSymbol, stockPrices);
				OnAddingPosition(stockSymbol, stockPosition);
			}
		}

		protected internal bool ExtContains(string[] array, string str)
		{
			if (array == null || array.Length == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			foreach (string text in array)
			{
				if (str == text)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal T[] ExtToArray<T>(ICollection<T> list)
		{
			if (list == null || list.Count == 0)
			{
				return new T[0];
			}
			T[] array = new T[list.Count];
			int num = 0;
			foreach (T item in list)
			{
				array[num] = item;
				num++;
			}
			return array;
		}

		protected internal List<T> ExtToList<T>(T[] array)
		{
			if (array == null || array.Length == 0)
			{
				return new List<T>();
			}
			List<T> list = new List<T>();
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				list.Add(array[i]);
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected internal ObservableCollection<T> ExtToCollection<T>(List<T> list)
		{
			if (list == null || list.Count == 0)
			{
				return new ObservableCollection<T>();
			}
			ObservableCollection<T> observableCollection = new ObservableCollection<T>();
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				observableCollection.Add(list[i]);
			}
			return observableCollection;
		}

		protected internal bool ExtEquals(object[] array1, object[] array2)
		{
			if (array1 == null || array2 == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (array1.Length != array2.Length)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < array1.Length; i++)
			{
				if (array1[i] != array2[i])
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	[DontObfuscate]

	public delegate StockPriceHistory PopulateStockPricesEventHandler(string stockSymbol);
	[DontObfuscate]
	[WFWidget]
	[XamWidget]
	public delegate void StockChangedEventHandler(object sender, StockChangedEventArgs args);
	[WFWidget]
	[XamWidget]
	[DontObfuscate]
	public class StockChangedEventArgs
	{
		public string[] AddedSymbols { get; private set; }

		public string[] RemovedSymbols { get; private set; }

		internal StockChangedEventArgs(string[] removed, string[] added)
		{
			AddedSymbols = removed;
			RemovedSymbols = added;
		}
	}
	[TSIgnore]
	[DontObfuscate]
	public class StockDataGenerator
	{
		private DateTime DateEnd;

		private DateTime DateStart;

		private Random Rand = new Random();

		public double PriceStart { get; set; }

		public double PriceRange { get; set; }

		public double PriceMinimum { get; set; }

		public double PriceMaximum { get; set; }

		public long VolumeStart { get; set; }

		public double VolumeRange { get; set; }

		public int DateRange { get; set; }

		public int DateInterval { get; set; }

		public TimeSpan StockInterval { get; set; }

		public bool SkipAfterHours { get; set; }

		public StockDataGenerator()
		{
			SkipAfterHours = false;
			PriceStart = 0.0;
			PriceRange = double.NaN;
			PriceMinimum = double.NaN;
			PriceMaximum = double.NaN;
			VolumeStart = 0L;
			VolumeRange = double.NaN;
			DateRange = 12;
			DateInterval = 1440;
		}

		public StockPosition GeneratePosition(string symbol, string company = "")
		{
			StockPricePoint stockPricePoint = StockDataLookup.Get(symbol);
			int num = Rand.Next(1, 10) / 100;
			return new StockPosition
			{
				Symbol = stockPricePoint.Symbol,
				Company = stockPricePoint.Company,
				Sector = stockPricePoint.Sector,
				CostPerShare = stockPricePoint.Close - stockPricePoint.Open * (double)num,
				MarketPrice = stockPricePoint.Close,
				TradeDate = DateTime.Now
			};
		}

		public StockDetails[] GenerateDetails()
		{
			List<StockDetails> list = new List<StockDetails>();
			foreach (StockPricePoint value in StockDataLookup.Dictionary.Values)
			{
				int num = Rand.Next(10, 30) / 100;
				StockDetails stockDetails = new StockDetails();
				stockDetails.Company = value.Company;
				stockDetails.Symbol = value.Symbol;
				stockDetails.Sector = value.Sector;
				stockDetails.MarketPrice = value.Close;
				stockDetails.MarketShares = value.Volume * Rand.Next(15, 20) / 1000000;
				stockDetails.AnnualLow = value.Close - value.Open * (double)num;
				stockDetails.AnnualHigh = value.Close + value.Open * (double)num;
				list.Add(stockDetails);
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		public StockPriceHistory GenerateStockPrices(string symbol, string company = "")
		{
			DateTime now = DateTime.Now;
			DateEnd = new DateTime(now.Year, now.Month, now.Day, 16, 30, 0);
			DateStart = DateEnd.AddMonths(-DateRange);
			double num = Math.Ceiling((DateEnd - DateStart).TotalMinutes / (double)DateInterval);
			double num2 = num * (double)DateInterval;
			Log(num + " steps, " + num2 + " range");
			if (num > 100000.0)
			{
				num = 100000.0;
				num2 = num * (double)DateInterval;
				Log(num + "^steps, " + num2 + " range");
			}
			DateTime dateStart = DateEnd.AddMinutes(0.0 - num2);
			if (DateStart.Ticks > dateStart.Ticks)
			{
				DateStart = dateStart;
			}
			StockPricePoint stockPricePoint = StockDataLookup.Get(symbol);
			stockPricePoint.Date = DateStart;
			_ = stockPricePoint.Sector;
			if (PriceStart > 0.0)
			{
				stockPricePoint.Open = PriceStart;
			}
			if (VolumeStart > 0)
			{
				stockPricePoint.Volume = VolumeStart;
			}
			VolumeRange = (double)stockPricePoint.Volume * 0.05;
			PriceRange = stockPricePoint.Open * 0.025;
			PriceMinimum = stockPricePoint.Open - stockPricePoint.Open * 0.75;
			PriceMaximum = stockPricePoint.Open + stockPricePoint.Open * 0.75;
			stockPricePoint.High = stockPricePoint.Open + stockPricePoint.Open * 0.02;
			stockPricePoint.Low = stockPricePoint.Open - stockPricePoint.Open * 0.02;
			stockPricePoint.Close = stockPricePoint.Open + (Rand.NextDouble() - 0.5) * PriceRange;
			StockPriceHistory stockPriceHistory = new StockPriceHistory();
			stockPriceHistory.Symbol = symbol;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(company))
			{
				stockPricePoint.Company = company;
				stockPriceHistory.Company = company;
			}
			else if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(stockPricePoint.Company))
			{
				stockPriceHistory.Company = stockPricePoint.Company;
			}
			do
			{
				if (SkipAfterHours)
				{
					if (!IsAfterHours(stockPricePoint.Date))
					{
						stockPriceHistory.Add(stockPricePoint);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					stockPriceHistory.Add(stockPricePoint);
				}
				stockPricePoint = GenerateStockPricePoint(stockPricePoint);
			}
			while (stockPricePoint.Date.Ticks <= DateEnd.Ticks);
			Log(" " + stockPriceHistory.Count + " items");
			return stockPriceHistory;
		}

		private bool IsAfterHours(DateTime date)
		{
			if (date.DayOfWeek == DayOfWeek.Saturday)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (date.DayOfWeek == DayOfWeek.Sunday)
			{
				return true;
			}
			TimeSpan timeSpan = new TimeSpan(9, 30, 0);
			TimeSpan timeSpan2 = new TimeSpan(16, 30, 0);
			TimeSpan timeOfDay = date.TimeOfDay;
			if (timeOfDay < timeSpan || timeOfDay > timeSpan2)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public StockPricePoint GenerateStockPricePoint(StockPricePoint previous)
		{
			double num = (Rand.NextDouble() - 0.499) * PriceRange;
			double close = previous.Close;
			double num2 = previous.Close + num;
			if (num2 < PriceMinimum)
			{
				num2 = PriceMinimum + num;
			}
			if (num2 > PriceMaximum)
			{
				num2 = PriceMaximum - num;
			}
			double num3 = Rand.NextDouble() * 1.5 * Math.Abs(num);
			double num4 = Rand.NextDouble() * 1.5 * Math.Abs(num);
			if (num2 > close)
			{
				num3 = num2 + num3;
				num4 = close - num4;
			}
			else
			{
				num3 = close + num3;
				num4 = num2 - num4;
			}
			double num5 = (Rand.NextDouble() - 0.49) * VolumeRange;
			long volume = (long)Math.Abs((double)previous.Volume + num5);
			if (previous.Date.AddMinutes(DateInterval).Ticks > DateEnd.Ticks)
			{
				DateTime dateEnd = DateEnd;
			}
			return new StockPricePoint
			{
				Date = previous.Date.AddMinutes(DateInterval),
				Symbol = previous.Symbol,
				Company = previous.Company,
				Sector = previous.Sector,
				Close = Math.Round(num2, 2),
				Open = Math.Round(close, 2),
				High = Math.Round(num3, 2),
				Low = Math.Round(num4, 2),
				Volume = volume
			};
		}

		internal void Log(string message_)
		{
		}
	}
	[TSIgnore]
	[DontObfuscate]
	public static class StockDataLookup
	{
		internal static Dictionary<string, StockPricePoint> Dictionary;

		internal static Random Rand;

		private static void Add(string symbol, string company, double price, long volume, string sector)
		{
			if (!Dictionary.ContainsKey(symbol))
			{
				StockPricePoint stockPricePoint = new StockPricePoint();
				stockPricePoint.Symbol = symbol;
				stockPricePoint.Company = company;
				stockPricePoint.Open = price;
				stockPricePoint.Close = price;
				stockPricePoint.Volume = volume;
				stockPricePoint.Sector = sector;
				Dictionary.Add(symbol, stockPricePoint);
			}
		}

		public static StockPricePoint Get(string symbol)
		{
			if (Dictionary.ContainsKey(symbol))
			{
				return Dictionary[symbol];
			}
			StockPricePoint stockPricePoint = new StockPricePoint();
			stockPricePoint.Symbol = symbol;
			stockPricePoint.Open = Rand.Next(100, 500);
			stockPricePoint.Volume = Rand.Next(100000, 500000);
			Dictionary.Add(symbol, stockPricePoint);
			return stockPricePoint;
		}

	[TSIgnore]
	[DontObfuscate]
	public class StockInfo
	{
		public string Company { get; set; }

		public string Symbol { get; set; }

		public string Sector { get; set; }
	}
	[TSIgnore]
	[DontObfuscate]
	public class StockPricePoint : StockInfo
	{
		public double Open { get; set; }

		public double High { get; set; }

		public double Low { get; set; }

		public double Close { get; set; }

		public long Volume { get; set; }

		public DateTime Date { get; set; }
	}
	[TSIgnore]
	[DontObfuscate]
	public class StockPriceHistory : List<StockPricePoint>
	{
		public string Title
		{
			get
			{
				string text = (string.IsNullOrEmpty(Company) ? "" : (" - " + Company));
				return Symbol + text;
			}
		}

		public string Symbol { get; set; }

		public string Company { get; set; }

		public StockPriceHistory()
		{
			Symbol = "";
			Company = "";
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return Symbol;
		}
	}
	[TSIgnore]
	[DontObfuscate]
	public class StockPosition : StockInfo
	{
		public int Index { get; set; }

		public DateTime TradeDate { get; set; }

		public double Shares { get; set; }

		public double CostPerShare { get; set; }

		public double CostTotal => Math.Round(Shares * CostPerShare);

		public double MarketValue => Math.Round(Shares * MarketPrice);

		public double MarketPrice { get; set; }

		public double GainValue => Math.Round(MarketValue - CostTotal);

		public double GainPercentage => GainValue / CostTotal * 100.0;

		public object Data { get; set; }

		public string Action { get; set; }
	}
	[TSIgnore]
	[DontObfuscate]
	public class StockDetails : StockInfo
	{
		public double AnnualLow { get; set; }

		public double AnnualHigh { get; set; }

		public double MarketPrice { get; set; }

		public long MarketShares { get; set; }

		public double MarketCap => Math.Round(MarketPrice * (double)MarketShares / 1000.0, 1);

		public double Volatility { get; set; }
	}

	public class XamZoombarAutomationPeer : FrameworkElementAutomationPeer, IScrollProvider
	{
		public XamZoombar Zoombar { get; set; }

		public bool HorizontallyScrollable => Zoombar.Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal;

		public double HorizontalScrollPercent
		{
			get
			{
				if (Zoombar.Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal)
				{
					return Zoombar.Range.Minimum + (Zoombar.Range.Maximum - Zoombar.Range.Minimum) / 2.0;
				}
				return 0.0;
			}
		}

		public double HorizontalViewSize
		{
			get
			{
				if (Zoombar.Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal)
				{
					return Zoombar.ActualMaximum - Zoombar.ActualMinimum;
				}
				return 0.0;
			}
		}

		public bool VerticallyScrollable => Zoombar.Orientation == Orientation.Vertical;

		public double VerticalScrollPercent
		{
			get
			{
				if (Zoombar.Orientation == Orientation.Vertical)
				{
					return Zoombar.Range.Minimum + (Zoombar.Range.Maximum - Zoombar.Range.Minimum) / 2.0;
				}
				return 0.0;
			}
		}

		public double VerticalViewSize
		{
			get
			{
				if (Zoombar.Orientation == Orientation.Vertical)
				{
					return Zoombar.ActualMaximum - Zoombar.ActualMinimum;
				}
				return 0.0;
			}
		}

		public XamZoombarAutomationPeer(XamZoombar zoombar)
			: base(zoombar)
		{
			Zoombar = zoombar;
		}

		public void Scroll(ScrollAmount horizontalAmount, ScrollAmount verticalAmount)
		{
			double num = Zoombar.Range.Maximum - Zoombar.Range.Minimum;
			if (Zoombar.Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal)
			{
				switch (horizontalAmount)
				{
				case ScrollAmount.LargeDecrement:
					if (Zoombar.Range.Minimum >= Zoombar.LargeChange)
					{
						Zoombar.Range.Minimum -= Zoombar.LargeChange;
						Zoombar.Range.Maximum -= Zoombar.LargeChange;
					}
					else
					{
						Zoombar.Range.Minimum = 0.0;
						Zoombar.Range.Maximum = num;
					}
					break;
				case ScrollAmount.SmallDecrement:
					if (Zoombar.Range.Minimum >= Zoombar.SmallChange)
					{
						Zoombar.Range.Minimum -= Zoombar.SmallChange;
						Zoombar.Range.Maximum -= Zoombar.SmallChange;
					}
					else
					{
						Zoombar.Range.Minimum = 0.0;
						Zoombar.Range.Maximum = num;
					}
					break;
				case ScrollAmount.LargeIncrement:
					if (Zoombar.Range.Maximum + Zoombar.LargeChange <= 1.0)
					{
						Zoombar.Range.Minimum += Zoombar.LargeChange;
						Zoombar.Range.Maximum += Zoombar.LargeChange;
					}
					else
					{
						Zoombar.Range.Minimum = 1.0 - num;
						Zoombar.Range.Maximum = 1.0;
					}
					break;
				case ScrollAmount.SmallIncrement:
					if (Zoombar.Range.Maximum + Zoombar.SmallChange <= 1.0)
					{
						Zoombar.Range.Minimum += Zoombar.SmallChange;
						Zoombar.Range.Maximum += Zoombar.SmallChange;
					}
					else
					{
						Zoombar.Range.Minimum = 1.0 - num;
						Zoombar.Range.Maximum = 1.0;
					}
					break;
				case ScrollAmount.NoAmount:
					break;
				}
				return;
			}
			switch (verticalAmount)
			{
			case ScrollAmount.LargeDecrement:
				if (Zoombar.Range.Minimum >= Zoombar.LargeChange)
				{
					Zoombar.Range.Minimum -= Zoombar.LargeChange;
					Zoombar.Range.Maximum -= Zoombar.LargeChange;
				}
				else
				{
					Zoombar.Range.Minimum = 0.0;
					Zoombar.Range.Maximum = num;
				}
				break;
			case ScrollAmount.SmallDecrement:
				if (Zoombar.Range.Minimum >= Zoombar.SmallChange)
				{
					Zoombar.Range.Minimum -= Zoombar.SmallChange;
					Zoombar.Range.Maximum -= Zoombar.SmallChange;
				}
				else
				{
					Zoombar.Range.Minimum = 0.0;
					Zoombar.Range.Maximum = num;
				}
				break;
			case ScrollAmount.LargeIncrement:
				if (Zoombar.Range.Maximum + Zoombar.LargeChange <= 1.0)
				{
					Zoombar.Range.Minimum += Zoombar.LargeChange;
					Zoombar.Range.Maximum += Zoombar.LargeChange;
				}
				else
				{
					Zoombar.Range.Minimum = 1.0 - num;
					Zoombar.Range.Maximum = 1.0;
				}
				break;
			case ScrollAmount.SmallIncrement:
				if (Zoombar.Range.Maximum + Zoombar.SmallChange <= 1.0)
				{
					Zoombar.Range.Minimum += Zoombar.SmallChange;
					Zoombar.Range.Maximum += Zoombar.SmallChange;
				}
				else
				{
					Zoombar.Range.Minimum = 1.0 - num;
					Zoombar.Range.Maximum = 1.0;
				}
				break;
			case ScrollAmount.NoAmount:
				break;
			}
		}

		public void SetScrollPercent(double horizontalPercent, double verticalPercent)
		{
			double num = Zoombar.Range.Maximum - Zoombar.Range.Minimum;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			double num3 = 1.0;
			if (Zoombar.Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal)
			{
				num2 = horizontalPercent / 100.0 - num / 2.0;
				num3 = horizontalPercent / 100.0 + num / 2.0;
				if (num2 < 0.0)
				{
					num2 = 0.0;
					num3 = num;
				}
				if (num3 > 1.0)
				{
					num2 = 1.0 - num;
					num3 = 1.0;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				num2 = verticalPercent / 100.0 - num / 2.0;
				num3 = verticalPercent / 100.0 + num / 2.0;
				if (num2 < 0.0)
				{
					num2 = 0.0;
					num3 = num;
				}
				if (num3 > 1.0)
				{
					num2 = 1.0 - num;
					num3 = 1.0;
				}
			}
			Zoombar.Range.Minimum = num2;
			Zoombar.Range.Maximum = num3;
		}

		public override object GetPattern(PatternInterface patternInterface)
		{
			if (patternInterface == PatternInterface.Scroll)
			{
				return this;
			}
			return base.GetPattern(patternInterface);
		}

		protected override AutomationControlType GetAutomationControlTypeCore()
		{
			return AutomationControlType.Custom;
		}

		protected override string GetClassNameCore()
		{
			return Zoombar.GetType().Name;
		}

		protected override string GetNameCore()
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(Zoombar.Name))
			{
				return Zoombar.GetType().Name;
			}
			return Zoombar.Name;
		}
	}

namespace Infragistics.Collections
{
	internal class AggregateValueEnumerator : IEnumerator
	{
		private AggregateValueCollection Parent { get; set; }

		private int CurrentValueSourceIndex { get; set; }

		private IEnumerator CurrentValueSourceEnumerator { get; set; }

		public object Current
		{
			get
			{
				if (CurrentValueSourceEnumerator != null)
				{
					return CurrentValueSourceEnumerator.Current;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public AggregateValueEnumerator(AggregateValueCollection parent)
		{
			if (parent == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("parent");
			}
			Parent = parent;
		}

		public bool MoveNext()
		{
			if (Parent.ItemsSources == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (CurrentValueSourceEnumerator != null)
			{
				if (CurrentValueSourceEnumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					return true;
				}
				CurrentValueSourceIndex++;
			}
			if (Parent.ItemsSources.Count > CurrentValueSourceIndex)
			{
				AggregateValueSource aggregateValueSource = Parent.ItemsSources[CurrentValueSourceIndex];
				if (aggregateValueSource.ValueColumn != null)
				{
					CurrentValueSourceEnumerator = aggregateValueSource.ValueColumn.GetEnumerator();
					return MoveNext();
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			CurrentValueSourceEnumerator = null;
			CurrentValueSourceIndex = 0;
		}
	}
	public class AggregateValueSource : DependencyObject, INotifyPropertyChanged, INotifyCollectionChanged
	{
		private const string ItemsSourcePropertyName = "ItemsSource";

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ItemsSourceProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ItemsSource", typeof(IEnumerable), typeof(AggregateValueSource), new PropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			(sender as AggregateValueSource).OnPropertyChanged("ItemsSource", e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
		}));

		private const string ValueMemberPathPropertyName = "ValueMemberPath";

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ValueMemberPathProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ValueMemberPath", typeof(string), typeof(AggregateValueSource), new PropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			(sender as AggregateValueSource).OnPropertyChanged("ValueMemberPath", e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
		}));

		private const string FastItemsSourcePropertyName = "FastItemsSource";

		private static readonly DependencyProperty FastItemsSourceProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("FastItemsSource", typeof(IFastItemsSource), typeof(AggregateValueSource), new PropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			(sender as AggregateValueSource).OnPropertyChanged("FastItemsSource", e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
		}));

		public IEnumerable ItemsSource
		{
			get
			{
				return GetValue(ItemsSourceProperty) as IEnumerable;
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ItemsSourceProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public string ValueMemberPath
		{
			get
			{
				return GetValue(ValueMemberPathProperty) as string;
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ValueMemberPathProperty, value);
			}
		}

		internal IFastItemColumn<double> ValueColumn { get; private set; }

		private IFastItemsSource FastItemsSource
		{
			get
			{
				return GetValue(FastItemsSourceProperty) as IFastItemsSource;
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(FastItemsSourceProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		public event NotifyCollectionChangedEventHandler CollectionChanged;

		private void HandleFastItemsSourceEvent(object sender, FastItemsSourceEventArgs e)
		{
			if (this.CollectionChanged != null)
			{
				this.CollectionChanged(this, new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset));
			}
		}

		private void OnPropertyChanged(string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "ItemsSource":
				FastItemsSource = new FastItemsSource
				{
					ItemsSource = ItemsSource
				};
				break;
			case "FastItemsSource":
				if (oldValue is IFastItemsSource fastItemsSource)
				{
					fastItemsSource.Event -= HandleFastItemsSourceEvent;
					fastItemsSource.DeregisterColumn(ValueColumn);
					ValueColumn = null;
				}
				if (newValue is IFastItemsSource fastItemsSource2)
				{
					fastItemsSource2.Event += HandleFastItemsSourceEvent;
					ValueColumn = fastItemsSource2.RegisterColumn(ValueMemberPath);
				}
				break;
			case "ValueMemberPath":
				if (FastItemsSource != null)
				{
					FastItemsSource.DeregisterColumn(ValueColumn);
					ValueColumn = FastItemsSource.RegisterColumn(ValueMemberPath);
				}
				break;
			}
			if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
			}
			if (this.CollectionChanged != null)
			{
				this.CollectionChanged(this, new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset));
			}
		}
	}
	public class AggregateValueCollection : DependencyObject, IEnumerable, INotifyCollectionChanged
	{
		public ObservableCollection<AggregateValueSource> ItemsSources { get; set; }

		public event NotifyCollectionChangedEventHandler CollectionChanged;

		public AggregateValueCollection()
		{
			ItemsSources = new ObservableCollection<AggregateValueSource>();
			ItemsSources.CollectionChanged += ItemSourcesCollectionChanged;
		}

		private void ItemSourcesCollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.OldItems != null)
			{
				foreach (object oldItem in e.OldItems)
				{
					(oldItem as AggregateValueSource).CollectionChanged -= ValueSourceCollectionChanged;
				}
			}
			if (e.NewItems != null)
			{
				foreach (object newItem in e.NewItems)
				{
					(newItem as AggregateValueSource).CollectionChanged += ValueSourceCollectionChanged;
				}
			}
			if (this.CollectionChanged != null)
			{
				this.CollectionChanged(this, new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset));
			}
		}

		private void ValueSourceCollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (this.CollectionChanged != null)
			{
				this.CollectionChanged(this, new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset));
			}
		}

		public IEnumerator GetEnumerator()
		{
			return new AggregateValueEnumerator(this);
		}
	}
}
namespace Infragistics.Silverlight
{
	public class HalfEdge
	{
		public int Beg { get; set; }

		public int End { get; set; }

		public HalfEdge(int beg, int end)
		{
			Beg = beg;
			End = end;
		}
	}
	public class HalfEdgeCollection : IEnumerable<HalfEdge>, IEnumerable
	{
		private class EdgeComparer : IEqualityComparer<HalfEdge>
		{
			public bool Equals(HalfEdge e1, HalfEdge e2)
			{
				if (e1.Beg != e2.Beg || e1.End != e2.End)
				{
					if (e1.Beg == e2.End)
					{
						return e1.End == e2.Beg;
					}
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}

			public int GetHashCode(HalfEdge e1)
			{
				return 65536 * Math.Max(e1.Beg, e1.End) + Math.Min(e1.Beg, e1.End);
			}
		}

		private Dictionary<HalfEdge, object> edges = new Dictionary<HalfEdge, object>(new EdgeComparer());

		public int Count => edges.Count;

		public IEnumerator<HalfEdge> GetEnumerator()
		{
			return edges.Keys.GetEnumerator();
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return GetEnumerator();
		}

		public void Add(HalfEdge edge)
		{
			edges.Add(edge, null);
		}

		public void Remove(HalfEdge edge)
		{
			edges.Remove(edge);
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			edges.Clear();
		}

		public bool Contains(HalfEdge edge)
		{
			return edges.ContainsKey(edge);
		}
	}
	public class Triangle
	{
		public int v0 { get; internal set; }

		public int v1 { get; internal set; }

		public int v2 { get; internal set; }
	}
	public class TriangleMesh
	{
		private class Comparer : IComparer<int>
		{
			private IList<Point> points;

			public Comparer(IList<Point> points)
			{
				this.points = points;
			}

			public int Compare(int i0, int i1)
			{
				if (points[i0].X < points[i1].X)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				if (points[i0].X == points[i1].X)
				{
					if (points[i0].Y < points[i1].Y)
					{
						return -1;
					}
					if (points[i0].Y == points[i1].Y)
					{
						return 0;
					}
				}
				return 1;
			}
		}

		private class PointTester
		{
			public bool Complete { get; private set; }

			public bool Inside { get; set; }

			public bool Test(Point P, Point P1, Point P2, Point P3)
			{
				double num = Math.Abs(P1.Y - P2.Y);
				double num2 = Math.Abs(P2.Y - P3.Y);
				double num3 = 0.0;
				double num4 = 0.0;
				if (num == 0.0 && num2 == 0.0)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (num == 0.0 && num2 != 0.0)
				{
					num3 = (P2.X + P1.X) / 2.0;
					num4 = (0.0 - (P3.X - P2.X)) / (P3.Y - P2.Y) * (num3 - (P2.X + P3.X) / 2.0) + (P2.Y + P3.Y) / 2.0;
				}
				if (num != 0.0 && num2 == 0.0)
				{
					num3 = (P3.X + P2.X) / 2.0;
					num4 = (0.0 - (P2.X - P1.X)) / (P2.Y - P1.Y) * (num3 - (P1.X + P2.X) / 2.0) + (P1.Y + P2.Y) / 2.0;
				}
				if (num != 0.0 && num2 != 0.0)
				{
					double num5 = (0.0 - (P2.X - P1.X)) / (P2.Y - P1.Y);
					double num6 = (0.0 - (P3.X - P2.X)) / (P3.Y - P2.Y);
					double num7 = (P1.X + P2.X) / 2.0;
					double num8 = (P2.X + P3.X) / 2.0;
					double num9 = (P1.Y + P2.Y) / 2.0;
					double num10 = (P2.Y + P3.Y) / 2.0;
					num3 = (num5 * num7 - num6 * num8 + num10 - num9) / (num5 - num6);
					num4 = ((num > num2) ? (num5 * (num3 - num7) + num9) : (num6 * (num3 - num8) + num10));
				}
				double num11 = P2.X - num3;
				double num12 = P2.Y - num4;
				double num13 = num11 * num11 + num12 * num12;
				double num14 = P.X - num3;
				num12 = P.Y - num4;
				double num15 = num14 * num14 + num12 * num12;
				Inside = num15 <= num13;
				Complete = num3 < P.X && (P.X - num3) * (P.X - num3) > num13;
				return true;
			}
		}

		private Collection<Triangle> triangleList;

		private HalfEdgeCollection _edgeCollection;

		private IList<Point> pointList;

		private Point s0;

		private Point s1;

		private Point s2;

		public Collection<Triangle> TriangleList
		{
			get
			{
				if (triangleList != null)
				{
					return triangleList;
				}
				if (pointList == null || pointList.Count < 3)
				{
					triangleList = new Collection<Triangle>();
					return triangleList;
				}
				HalfEdgeCollection halfEdgeCollection = new HalfEdgeCollection();
				PointTester pointTester = new PointTester();
				int num = 0;
				Triangle[] array = new Triangle[4 * pointList.Count];
				bool[] array2 = new bool[array.Length];
				List<int> list = new List<int>
				{
					Capacity = pointList.Count
				};
				for (int i = 0; i < pointList.Count; i++)
				{
					list.Add(i);
				}
				list.Sort(new Comparer(pointList));
				double x = pointList[list[0]].X;
				double x2 = pointList[list[pointList.Count - 1]].X;
				double num2 = pointList[0].Y;
				double num3 = num2;
				for (int j = 1; j < pointList.Count; j++)
				{
					num2 = Math.Min(num2, pointList[j].Y);
					num3 = Math.Max(num3, pointList[j].Y);
				}
				double val = x2 - x;
				double val2 = num3 - num2;
				double num4 = Math.Max(val, val2);
				double num5 = (x2 + x) / 2.0;
				double num6 = (num3 + num2) / 2.0;
				s0 = new Point(num5 - 20.0 * num4, num6 - num4);
				s1 = new Point(num5, num6 + 20.0 * num4);
				s2 = new Point(num5 + 20.0 * num4, num6 - num4);
				array[0] = new Triangle
				{
					v0 = pointList.Count,
					v1 = pointList.Count + 1,
					v2 = pointList.Count + 2
				};
				array2[0] = false;
				for (int k = 1; k < array.Length; k++)
				{
					array[k] = new Triangle();
					array2[k] = false;
				}
				num++;
				for (int l = 0; l < pointList.Count; l++)
				{
					halfEdgeCollection.Clear();
					for (int m = 0; m < num; m++)
					{
						if (array2[m])
						{
							continue;
						}
						pointTester.Test(point(list[l]), point(array[m].v0), point(array[m].v1), point(array[m].v2));
						array2[m] = pointTester.Complete;
						if (pointTester.Inside)
						{
							HalfEdge edge = new HalfEdge(array[m].v0, array[m].v1);
							if (halfEdgeCollection.Contains(edge))
							{
								halfEdgeCollection.Remove(edge);
							}
							else
							{
								halfEdgeCollection.Add(edge);
							}
							edge = new HalfEdge(array[m].v1, array[m].v2);
							if (halfEdgeCollection.Contains(edge))
							{
								halfEdgeCollection.Remove(edge);
							}
							else
							{
								halfEdgeCollection.Add(edge);
							}
							edge = new HalfEdge(array[m].v2, array[m].v0);
							if (halfEdgeCollection.Contains(edge))
							{
								halfEdgeCollection.Remove(edge);
							}
							else
							{
								halfEdgeCollection.Add(edge);
							}
							array[m].v0 = array[num - 1].v0;
							array[m].v1 = array[num - 1].v1;
							array[m].v2 = array[num - 1].v2;
							array2[m] = array2[num - 1];
							num--;
							m--;
						}
					}
					foreach (HalfEdge item in halfEdgeCollection)
					{
						array[num].v0 = item.Beg;
						array[num].v1 = item.End;
						array[num].v2 = list[l];
						array2[num] = false;
						num++;
					}
				}
				triangleList = new Collection<Triangle>();
				for (int n = 0; n < num; n++)
				{
					if (array[n].v0 < pointList.Count && array[n].v1 < pointList.Count && array[n].v2 < pointList.Count)
					{
						triangleList.Add(array[n]);
					}
				}
				return triangleList;
			}
		}

		public HalfEdgeCollection EdgeCollection
		{
			get
			{
				if (_edgeCollection == null)
				{
					_edgeCollection = new HalfEdgeCollection();
					HalfEdge halfEdge = null;
					foreach (Triangle triangle in TriangleList)
					{
						halfEdge = new HalfEdge(triangle.v0, triangle.v1);
						if (!_edgeCollection.Contains(halfEdge))
						{
							_edgeCollection.Add(halfEdge);
						}
						else
						{
							_edgeCollection.Remove(halfEdge);
						}
						halfEdge = new HalfEdge(triangle.v1, triangle.v2);
						if (!_edgeCollection.Contains(halfEdge))
						{
							_edgeCollection.Add(halfEdge);
						}
						else
						{
							_edgeCollection.Remove(halfEdge);
						}
						halfEdge = new HalfEdge(triangle.v2, triangle.v0);
						if (!_edgeCollection.Contains(halfEdge))
						{
							_edgeCollection.Add(halfEdge);
						}
						else
						{
							_edgeCollection.Remove(halfEdge);
						}
					}
				}
				return _edgeCollection;
			}
		}

		public IList<Point> Points => pointList ?? (pointList = new List<Point>());

		private Point point(int i)
		{
			if (i < pointList.Count)
			{
				return pointList[i];
			}
			if (i == pointList.Count)
			{
				return s0;
			}
			if (i == pointList.Count + 1)
			{
				return s1;
			}
			return s2;
		}
	}

namespace Infragistics.Controls
{
	public abstract class SelectedCollectionBase<T> : CollectionBase<T> where T : ISelectableObject
	{
		private Collection<T> _shiftSelectedItems;

		protected internal Collection<T> ShiftSelectedItems => _shiftSelectedItems ?? (_shiftSelectedItems = new Collection<T>());

		protected internal T PivotItem { get; set; }

		public void AddRange(SelectedCollectionBase<T> items)
		{
			if (items.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			SelectedCollectionBase<T> selectedCollectionBase = CreateNewInstance();
			selectedCollectionBase.InternalAddRangeSilently(this);
			foreach (T item in items)
			{
				InternalAddItemSilently(base.Count, item);
			}
			OnSelectionChanged(selectedCollectionBase, this);
		}

		protected internal virtual void SelectItem(T item, bool shiftKey)
		{
			if (shiftKey)
			{
				if (ShiftSelectedItems.Count == 0 && PivotItem == null)
				{
					PivotItem = item;
					if (item.IsSelected)
					{
						InternalRemoveItemSilently(IndexOf(item));
					}
					ShiftSelectedItems.Add(item);
				}
				else if (!item.IsSelected)
				{
					ShiftSelectedItems.Add(item);
				}
				else
				{
					Items.Remove(item);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				ShiftSelectedItems.Clear();
				PivotItem = default(T);
			}
			InternalAddItemSilently(base.Count, item);
		}

		protected abstract void OnSelectionChanged(SelectedCollectionBase<T> oldCollection, SelectedCollectionBase<T> newCollection);

		protected abstract SelectedCollectionBase<T> CreateNewInstance();

		internal void InternalAddItemSilently(int index, T item)
		{
			item.SetSelected(isSelected: true);
			base.AddItem(index, item);
		}

		internal bool InternalRemoveItemSilently(int index)
		{
			T item = Items[index];
			if (ShiftSelectedItems.Contains(item))
			{
				ShiftSelectedItems.Remove(item);
			}
			item.SetSelected(isSelected: false);
			return base.RemoveItem(index);
		}

		internal void InternalReplaceItemSilently(int index, T item)
		{
			Items[index].SetSelected(isSelected: false);
			item.SetSelected(isSelected: true);
			base.ReplaceItem(index, item);
		}

		internal void InternalResetItemsSilently()
		{
			foreach (T item in Items)
			{
				item.SetSelected(isSelected: false);
			}
			ShiftSelectedItems.Clear();
			PivotItem = default(T);
			base.ResetItems();
		}

		internal void InternalAddRangeSilently(SelectedCollectionBase<T> items)
		{
			foreach (T item in items)
			{
				InternalAddItemSilently(base.Count, item);
			}
		}

		protected override void AddItem(int index, T item)
		{
			if (!item.IsSelected)
			{
				SelectedCollectionBase<T> selectedCollectionBase = CreateNewInstance();
				selectedCollectionBase.InternalAddRangeSilently(this);
				InternalAddItemSilently(index, item);
				OnSelectionChanged(selectedCollectionBase, this);
			}
		}

		protected override void InsertItem(int index, T item)
		{
			if (!item.IsSelected)
			{
				SelectedCollectionBase<T> selectedCollectionBase = CreateNewInstance();
				selectedCollectionBase.InternalAddRangeSilently(this);
				InternalAddItemSilently(index, item);
				OnSelectionChanged(selectedCollectionBase, this);
			}
		}

		protected override bool RemoveItem(int index)
		{
			SelectedCollectionBase<T> selectedCollectionBase = CreateNewInstance();
			selectedCollectionBase.InternalAddRangeSilently(this);
			bool result = InternalRemoveItemSilently(index);
			OnSelectionChanged(selectedCollectionBase, this);
			return result;
		}

		protected override void ReplaceItem(int index, T newItem)
		{
			SelectedCollectionBase<T> selectedCollectionBase = CreateNewInstance();
			selectedCollectionBase.InternalAddRangeSilently(this);
			InternalReplaceItemSilently(index, newItem);
			OnSelectionChanged(selectedCollectionBase, this);
		}

		protected override void ResetItems()
		{
			SelectedCollectionBase<T> selectedCollectionBase = CreateNewInstance();
			selectedCollectionBase.InternalAddRangeSilently(this);
			InternalResetItemsSilently();
			OnSelectionChanged(selectedCollectionBase, this);
		}
	}
	internal class WPFExecutionContext : IExecutionContext
	{
		private Dispatcher _dispatcher;

		private DateTime _startTime;

		private List<DispatcherTimer> _timers = new List<DispatcherTimer>();

		private List<bool> _inUse = new List<bool>();

		private object _timersLock = new object();

		public WPFExecutionContext(Dispatcher dispatcher)
		{
			_dispatcher = dispatcher;
			_startTime = DateTime.Now;
		}

		public void Execute(ExecutionContextExecuteCallback handler)
		{
			_dispatcher.BeginInvoke(handler, DispatcherPriority.Normal);
		}

		public void ExecuteDelayed(ExecutionContextExecuteCallback callback, int delayMilliseconds)
		{
			DispatcherTimer dispatcherTimer = null;
			lock (_timersLock)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < _inUse.Count; i++)
				{
					if (!_inUse[i])
					{
						_inUse[i] = true;
						dispatcherTimer = _timers[i];
						break;
					}
				}
				if (dispatcherTimer == null)
				{
					dispatcherTimer = new DispatcherTimer();
					_inUse.Add(item: true);
					_timers.Add(dispatcherTimer);
				}
			}
			dispatcherTimer.Interval = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(delayMilliseconds);
			EventHandler tickMethod = null;
			tickMethod = delegate(object o, EventArgs e)
			{
				DispatcherTimer dispatcherTimer2 = (DispatcherTimer)o;
				bool flag = false;
				if (!dispatcherTimer2.IsEnabled)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				dispatcherTimer2.Tick -= tickMethod;
				dispatcherTimer2.Stop();
				lock (_timersLock)
				{
					for (int j = 0; j < _inUse.Count; j++)
					{
						if (_timers[j] == dispatcherTimer2)
						{
							_inUse[j] = false;
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					callback();
				}
			};
			dispatcherTimer.Tick += tickMethod;
			dispatcherTimer.Start();
		}

		public void EnqueueAction(ExecutionContextExecuteCallback callback)
		{
			_dispatcher.BeginInvoke(callback, DispatcherPriority.Normal);
		}

		public void EnqueueAnimationAction(ExecutionContextExecuteCallback callback)
		{
			_dispatcher.BeginInvoke(callback, DispatcherPriority.Normal);
		}

		public long GetCurrentRelativeTime()
		{
			return (long)Math.Round((DateTime.Now - _startTime).TotalMilliseconds);
		}
	}

		[JsonAPISuppressWidgetMember]
		public void GetTile(int z, int x, int y, TileImageCreated onCreated, TileImageCreating onCreating, TileImageZoomChanging zoomChanging)

		private void GetTile(int z, int x, int y, TileImageCreated onCreated, TileImageCreating onCreating, TileImageZoomChanging zoomChanging, bool testRun)
		{
			double globalMin = double.NaN;
			double globalMax = double.NaN;
			if (!testRun && UseGlobalMinMax && (double.IsNaN(_globalMin) || double.IsNaN(_globalMax)))
			{
				bool flag = false;
				lock (_globalLock)
				{
					if ((!double.IsNaN(_globalMin) && !double.IsNaN(_globalMax)) || _calculatingGlobals)
					{
						_globalWaiters.Add(delegate
						{
							ContinueTileGeneration(z, x, y, testRun, globalMax, globalMin, onCreated, onCreating, zoomChanging);
						});
						return;
					}
					flag = true;
					_calculatingGlobals = true;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					double level0Min = double.MaxValue;
					double level0Max = double.MinValue;
					double level0MinX = 0.0;
					double level0MinY = 0.0;
					double level0MaxX = 0.0;
					double level0MaxY = 0.0;
					GetTile(0, 0, 0, delegate(object o, TileImageCreatedEventArgs e)
					{
						HeatTileImageCreatedEventArgs e2 = (HeatTileImageCreatedEventArgs)e;
						level0Min = e2.GlobalMinimumValue;
						level0Max = e2.GlobalMaximumValue;
						level0MinX = e2.GlobalMinimumValueLongitude;
						level0MinY = e2.GlobalMinimumValueLatitude;
						level0MaxX = e2.GlobalMaximumValueLongitude;
						level0MaxY = e2.GlobalMaximumValueLatitude;
						new Rect(0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 1.0);
						_ = _tileViewport;
						globalMin = level0Min;
						globalMax = level0Max;
						List<Action> list = new List<Action>();
						lock (_globalLock)
						{
							_globalMin = globalMin;
							_globalMax = globalMax;
							_globalMinLat = level0MinY;
							_globalMinLon = level0MinX;
							_globalMaxLat = level0MaxY;
							_globalMaxLon = level0MaxX;
							for (int i = 0; i < _globalWaiters.Count; i++)
							{
								list.Add(_globalWaiters[i]);
							}
							_globalWaiters.Clear();
						}
						ContinueTileGeneration(z, x, y, testRun, globalMax, globalMin, onCreated, onCreating, zoomChanging);
						for (int j = 0; j < list.Count; j++)
						{
							list[j]();
						}
					}, delegate
					{
					}, delegate
					{
					}, testRun: true);
					return;
				}
				lock (_globalLock)
				{
					globalMin = _globalMin;
					globalMax = _globalMax;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				lock (_globalLock)
				{
					globalMin = _globalMin;
					globalMax = _globalMax;
				}
			}
			ContinueTileGeneration(z, x, y, testRun, globalMax, globalMin, onCreated, onCreating, zoomChanging);
		}
