		private void ContinueTileGeneration(int z, int x, int y, bool testRun, double globalMax, double globalMin, TileImageCreated onCreated, TileImageCreating onCreating, TileImageZoomChanging zoomChanging)
		{
			ContinueWhenZLevelReady(z, x, y, testRun, zoomChanging, delegate
			{
				if (UseGlobalMinMaxAdjustedForZoom && !testRun && z > 0 && _zBounds.ContainsKey(z.ToString()))
				{
					Tuple<double, double> tuple = _zBounds[z.ToString()];
					globalMax = tuple.Item1;
					globalMin = tuple.Item2;
				}
				Rect window = CalculateWindow(z, x, y);
				TileWorkSettings tileWorkSettings = new TileWorkSettings
				{
					Window = window,
					Z = z,
					X = x,
					Y = y,
					GlobalMinimum = globalMin,
					GlobalMaximum = globalMax,
					UseGlobalMinMax = UseGlobalMinMax,
					MinimumValue = MinimumValue,
					MaximumValue = MaximumValue,
					UseLogarithmicScale = UseLogarithmicScale,
					LogarithmBase = LogarithmBase
				};
				if (tileWorkSettings.LogarithmBase <= 0.0)
				{
					tileWorkSettings.LogarithmBase = 10.0;
				}
				tileWorkSettings.TileViewport = _tileViewport;
				tileWorkSettings.MaximumColor = MaximumColor;
				tileWorkSettings.MinimumColor = MinimumColor;
				tileWorkSettings.Scaler = _scaler;
				tileWorkSettings.Values = _values;
				tileWorkSettings.BlurRadius = BlurRadius;
				if (tileWorkSettings.BlurRadius <= 0.0)
				{
					tileWorkSettings.BlurRadius = 1.0;
				}
				tileWorkSettings.UseBlurRadiusAdjustedForZoom = UseBlurRadiusAdjustedForZoom;
				tileWorkSettings.MaxBlurRadius = MaxBlurRadius;
				if (tileWorkSettings.MaxBlurRadius <= 0.0)
				{
					tileWorkSettings.MaxBlurRadius = 1.0;
				}
				tileWorkSettings.Values = Values;
				tileWorkSettings.ScaleColors = ScaleColors;
				tileWorkSettings.ScaleColorOffsets = ScaleColorOffsets;
				tileWorkSettings.MinimumVisibleLatitude = _scaler.GetMinimumVisibleLatitude(window, _tileViewport);
				tileWorkSettings.MaximumVisibleLatitude = _scaler.GetMaximumVisibleLatitude(window, _tileViewport);
				tileWorkSettings.MinimumVisibleLongitude = _scaler.GetMinimumVisibleLongitude(window, _tileViewport);
				tileWorkSettings.MaximumVisibleLongitude = _scaler.GetMaximumVisibleLongitude(window, _tileViewport);
				tileWorkSettings.YValues = _yValues;
				tileWorkSettings.XValues = _xValues;
				if (_values == null && _yValues != null)
				{
					_values = new double[_yValues.Length];
					for (int i = 0; i < _yValues.Length; i++)
					{
						_values[i] = 1.0;
					}
					tileWorkSettings.Values = _values;
				}
				if (!_sentNewData)
				{
					_sentNewData = true;
					tileWorkSettings.IsNewData = true;
				}
				tileWorkSettings.TestRun = testRun;
				_manager.GetTile(tileWorkSettings, delegate(object o, TileImageCreatedEventArgs e)
				{
					e.ImageData = PrepareData(e.ImageData);
					onCreated(this, e);
				}, onCreating);
			});
		}

		private void ContinueWhenZLevelReady(int z, int x, int y, bool testRun, TileImageZoomChanging zoomChanging, Action action)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			lock (_zLock)
			{
				flag = _previousZ != z;
			}
			if (!flag || testRun)
			{
				action();
				return;
			}
			bool flag2 = false;
			bool flag3 = false;
			lock (_zLock)
			{
				if (z != _previousZ)
				{
					if (_zBounds.ContainsKey(z.ToString()) && !double.IsNaN(_zBounds[z.ToString()].Item1) && !double.IsNaN(_zBounds[z.ToString()].Item2))
					{
						_previousZ = z;
						zoomChanging(this, new TileImageZoomChangingEventArgs
						{
							Z = z,
							X = x,
							Y = y
						});
						flag2 = true;
					}
					else if (_zBounds.ContainsKey(z.ToString()))
					{
						if (z > 0 && UseGlobalMinMaxAdjustedForZoom)
						{
							List<Action> list;
							if (_zWaiters.ContainsKey(z.ToString()))
							{
								list = _zWaiters[z.ToString()];
							}
							else
							{
								list = new List<Action>();
								_zWaiters.Add(z.ToString(), list);
							}
							list.Add(action);
						}
					}
					else if (z > 0 && UseGlobalMinMaxAdjustedForZoom)
					{
						_zBounds.Add(z.ToString(), new Tuple<double, double>(double.NaN, double.NaN));
						flag3 = true;
					}
				}
			}
			if (flag3 && z > 0 && UseGlobalMinMaxAdjustedForZoom)
			{
				StoreZBounds(z, action);
			}
			if (flag2)
			{
				action();
			}
		}

		private byte[] PrepareData(byte[] imageData)
		{
			if (imageData == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int[] array = new int[imageData.Length / 4];
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				double num = (double)(int)imageData[i * 4] / 255.0;
				byte b = imageData[i * 4 + 1];
				byte b2 = imageData[i * 4 + 2];
				byte b3 = imageData[i * 4 + 3];
				array[i] = ((int)(255.0 * num) << 24) | ((int)(num * (double)(int)b) << 16) | ((int)(num * (double)(int)b2) << 8) | (int)(num * (double)(int)b3);
			}
			WriteableBitmap writeableBitmap = new WriteableBitmap(256, 256, 96.0, 96.0, PixelFormats.Pbgra32, null);
			writeableBitmap.WritePixels(new Int32Rect(0, 0, writeableBitmap.PixelWidth, writeableBitmap.PixelHeight), array, 4 * writeableBitmap.PixelWidth, 0);
			PngBitmapEncoder pngBitmapEncoder = new PngBitmapEncoder();
			pngBitmapEncoder.Frames.Add(BitmapFrame.Create(writeableBitmap));
			MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
			pngBitmapEncoder.Save(memoryStream);
			memoryStream.Flush();
			return memoryStream.ToArray();
		}

		private void StoreZBounds(int z, Action action)
		{
			int minTileX = 0;
			int minTileY = 0;
			int maxTileX = 0;
			int maxTileY = 0;
			Rect viewport = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, 256.0 * Math.Pow(2.0, z), 256.0 * Math.Pow(2.0, z));
			Rect window = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 1.0);
			double num = _scaler.ScaleLongitude(_globalMaxLon, window, viewport);
			double num2 = _scaler.ScaleLatitude(_globalMaxLat, window, viewport);
			double num3 = _scaler.ScaleLongitude(_globalMinLon, window, viewport);
			double num4 = _scaler.ScaleLatitude(_globalMinLat, window, viewport);
			minTileX = (int)Math.Floor(num3 / 256.0);
			minTileY = (int)Math.Floor(num4 / 256.0);
			maxTileX = (int)Math.Floor(num / 256.0);
			maxTileY = (int)Math.Floor(num2 / 256.0);
			double zGlobalMin = 0.0;
			double zGlobalMax = 0.0;
			GetTile(z, minTileX, minTileY, delegate(object o, TileImageCreatedEventArgs e)
			{
				HeatTileImageCreatedEventArgs e2 = (HeatTileImageCreatedEventArgs)e;
				zGlobalMin = e2.GlobalMinimumValue;
				zGlobalMax = e2.GlobalMaximumValue;
				if (maxTileX != minTileX && maxTileY != minTileY)
				{
					GetTile(z, maxTileX, maxTileY, delegate(object obj, TileImageCreatedEventArgs e4)
					{
						HeatTileImageCreatedEventArgs e3 = (HeatTileImageCreatedEventArgs)e4;
						zGlobalMax = e3.GlobalMaximumValue;
						UpdateZBounds(z, zGlobalMax, zGlobalMin, action);
					}, delegate
					{
					}, delegate
					{
					}, testRun: true);
				}
				else
				{
					UpdateZBounds(z, zGlobalMax, zGlobalMin, action);
				}
			}, delegate
			{
			}, delegate
			{
			}, testRun: true);
		}

		private void UpdateZBounds(int z, double zGlobalMax, double zGlobalMin, Action action)
		{
			if (zGlobalMax < _individualMaximum)
			{
				zGlobalMax = _individualMaximum;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(zGlobalMin) || zGlobalMin > _individualMinimum)
			{
				zGlobalMin = _individualMinimum;
			}
			List<Action> list = new List<Action>();
			lock (_zLock)
			{
				_zBounds[z.ToString()] = new Tuple<double, double>(zGlobalMax, zGlobalMin);
				if (_zWaiters.ContainsKey(z.ToString()))
				{
					List<Action> list2 = _zWaiters[z.ToString()];
					for (int i = 0; i < list2.Count; i++)
					{
						list.Add(list2[i]);
					}
				}
				_zWaiters.Remove(z.ToString());
				_previousZ = z;
			}
			action();
			for (int j = 0; j < list.Count; j++)
			{
				list[j]();
			}
		}

		private Rect CalculateWindow(int z, int x, int y)
		{
			int num = (int)Math.Pow(2.0, z) * 256;
			double x2 = (double)x * 256.0 / (double)num;
			double y2 = (double)y * 256.0 / (double)num;
			double width = 256.0 / (double)num;
			double height = 256.0 / (double)num;
			return new Rect(x2, y2, width, height);
		}

		private void OnDataChanged()
		{
			double num = double.MinValue;
			double num2 = double.MaxValue;
			if (_values != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < _values.Length; i++)
				{
					double num3 = _values[i];
					num = ((num3 > num) ? num3 : num);
					num2 = ((num3 < num2) ? num3 : num2);
				}
			}
			_individualMinimum = num2 * 0.01;
			_individualMaximum = num;
			_sentNewData = false;
		}
	}
	internal class HeatTileGeneratorWorker
	{
		private TileWorkSettings _settings;

		private byte[] _imageData;

		private int _x;

		private int _y;

		private int _z;

		private string _url;

		private static object _idLock = new object();

		private static long _nextId = 0L;

		private long _id;

		private static int _curr = 0;

		private double _maxAccPixelLatitude;

		private double _maxAccPixelLongitude;

		private double _minAccPixelLatitude;

		private double _minAccPixelLongitude;

		public long Id => _id;

		internal TileWorkSettings Settings => _settings;

		[DontObfuscate]
		public ITileWorkCompletedSink CompletedSink { get; set; }

		public HeatTileGeneratorWorker(TileWorkSettings settings)
		{
			_settings = settings;
			lock (_idLock)
			{
				_nextId++;
				if (_nextId == long.MaxValue)
				{
					_nextId = 0L;
				}
				_id = _nextId;
			}
		}

		[DontObfuscate]
		public void DoWork()
		{
			double blurRadius = Settings.BlurRadius;
			double num = blurRadius;
			double maxBlurRadius = Settings.MaxBlurRadius;
			HeatTileScaler scaler = Settings.Scaler;
			_x = Settings.X;
			_y = Settings.Y;
			_z = Settings.Z;
			_url = "heat://" + _z + "/" + _x + "/" + _y;
			if (Settings.UseBlurRadiusAdjustedForZoom && _z > 0)
			{
				double num2 = Math.Sqrt(2.0) * Math.Pow(2.0, _z - 1);
				num = blurRadius * num2;
			}
			if (!double.IsNaN(maxBlurRadius) && num > maxBlurRadius)
			{
				num = maxBlurRadius;
			}
			double[] xValues = Settings.XValues;
			double[] yValues = Settings.YValues;
			double[] values = Settings.Values;
			int num3 = Settings.XValues.Length;
			_ = Settings.YValues.Length;
			double minimumVisibleLongitude = Settings.MinimumVisibleLongitude;
			double maximumVisibleLongitude = Settings.MaximumVisibleLongitude;
			double minimumVisibleLatitude = Settings.MinimumVisibleLatitude;
			double maximumVisibleLatitude = Settings.MaximumVisibleLatitude;
			int filterBreadth = GetFilterBreadth(Settings.TileViewport, num);
			double[] filter = GetFilter(filterBreadth, num);
			double num4 = Math.Abs(scaler.UnscaleLatitude(0.0, Settings.Window, Settings.TileViewport) - scaler.UnscaleLatitude(num, Settings.Window, Settings.TileViewport));
			double num5 = Math.Abs(scaler.UnscaleLongitude(0.0, Settings.Window, Settings.TileViewport) - scaler.UnscaleLongitude(num, Settings.Window, Settings.TileViewport));
			List<double> list = new List<double>();
			List<double> list2 = new List<double>();
			List<double> list3 = new List<double>();
			for (int i = 0; i < num3; i++)
			{
				double num6 = xValues[i];
				double num7 = yValues[i];
				double item = values[i];
				double num8 = num6 - num5;
				double num9 = num6 + num5;
				double num10 = num7 - num4;
				double num11 = num7 + num4;
				if (!(num9 < minimumVisibleLongitude) && !(num11 < minimumVisibleLatitude) && !(num10 > maximumVisibleLatitude) && !(num8 > maximumVisibleLongitude))
				{
					list.Add(num6);
					list2.Add(num7);
					list3.Add(item);
				}
			}
			byte[] imageBytes = GetImageBytes(Settings.TileViewport);
			double[] accumulationData = GetAccumulationData(Settings.TileViewport);
			int num12 = (int)Settings.TileViewport.Width;
			int count = list2.Count;
			scaler.ScaleLatitudes(list2, Settings.Window, Settings.TileViewport);
			scaler.ScaleLongitudes(list, Settings.Window, Settings.TileViewport);
			for (int j = 0; j < count; j++)
			{
				int num13 = (int)Math.Floor(list[j] - num);
				int num14 = (int)Math.Floor(list2[j] - num);
				for (int k = num13; k < num13 + filterBreadth; k++)
				{
					for (int l = num14; l < num14 + filterBreadth; l++)
					{
						int num15 = k - num13;
						int num16 = l - num14;
						if (k >= 0 && k <= num12 - 1 && l >= 0 && l <= num12 - 1)
						{
							double num17 = filter[num16 * filterBreadth + num15];
							double num18 = list3[j] * num17;
							accumulationData[l * num12 + k] += num18;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			int num19 = accumulationData.Length;
			double num20 = double.MinValue;
			double num21 = double.MaxValue;
			if (!double.IsNaN(Settings.GlobalMinimum) && !double.IsNaN(Settings.GlobalMaximum) && Settings.UseGlobalMinMax && !Settings.TestRun)
			{
				num21 = Settings.GlobalMinimum;
				num20 = Settings.GlobalMaximum;
				if (!double.IsNaN(Settings.MinimumValue))
				{
					num21 = Settings.MinimumValue;
				}
				if (!double.IsNaN(Settings.MaximumValue))
				{
					num20 = Settings.MaximumValue;
				}
			}
			else if (!double.IsNaN(Settings.MinimumValue) && !double.IsNaN(Settings.MaximumValue))
			{
				num21 = Settings.MinimumValue;
				num20 = Settings.MaximumValue;
			}
			else
			{
				int num22 = -1;
				int num23 = -1;
				for (int m = 0; m < num19; m++)
				{
					double num24 = accumulationData[m];
					if (num24 > 0.0)
					{
						if (num24 > num20)
						{
							num20 = num24;
							num22 = m;
						}
						if (num24 < num21)
						{
							num21 = num24;
							num23 = m;
						}
					}
				}
				int num25 = (int)Math.Floor((double)num22 / (double)num12);
				int num26 = num22 % num12;
				int num27 = (int)Math.Floor((double)num23 / (double)num12);
				int num28 = num23 % num12;
				Settings.GlobalMinimum = num21;
				Settings.GlobalMaximum = num20;
				double num29 = 0.0;
				double num30 = 0.0;
				double num31 = 0.0;
				double num32 = 0.0;
				double num33 = 0.0;
				double num34 = 0.0;
				for (int n = 0; n < count; n++)
				{
					int num13 = (int)Math.Floor(list[n] - num);
					int num14 = (int)Math.Floor(list2[n] - num);
					for (int num35 = num13; num35 < num13 + filterBreadth; num35++)
					{
						for (int num36 = num14; num36 < num14 + filterBreadth; num36++)
						{
							int num15 = num35 - num13;
							int num16 = num36 - num14;
							if (num35 >= 0 && num35 <= num12 - 1 && num36 >= 0 && num36 <= num12 - 1)
							{
								if (num35 == num26 && num36 == num25)
								{
									num29 += 1.0;
									num31 += scaler.UnscaleLatitude(list2[n], Settings.Window, Settings.TileViewport);
									num32 += scaler.UnscaleLongitude(list[n], Settings.Window, Settings.TileViewport);
								}
								if (num35 == num28 && num36 == num27)
								{
									num30 += 1.0;
									num33 += scaler.UnscaleLatitude(list2[n], Settings.Window, Settings.TileViewport);
									num34 += scaler.UnscaleLongitude(list[n], Settings.Window, Settings.TileViewport);
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
				_maxAccPixelLatitude = num31 / num29;
				_maxAccPixelLongitude = num32 / num29;
				_minAccPixelLatitude = num33 / num30;
				_minAccPixelLongitude = num34 / num30;
				if (!double.IsNaN(Settings.MinimumValue))
				{
					num21 = Settings.MinimumValue;
				}
				if (!double.IsNaN(Settings.MaximumValue))
				{
					num20 = Settings.MaximumValue;
				}
			}
			if (!Settings.TestRun)
			{
				DoRGBInterpolation(imageBytes, accumulationData, num20, num21);
				_imageData = imageBytes;
			}
			Finish();
		}

		private void DoRGBInterpolation(byte[] imageData, double[] accumulationData, double maxValue, double minValue)
		{
			int num = accumulationData.Length;
			if (Settings.UseLogarithmicScale)
			{
				minValue = ((!(minValue <= 0.0)) ? Math.Log(minValue, Settings.LogarithmBase) : 0.0);
				maxValue = ((!(maxValue <= 0.0)) ? Math.Log(maxValue, Settings.LogarithmBase) : 0.0);
			}
			double num2 = 0.0;
			double num3 = maxValue - minValue;
			if (double.IsNaN(num3) || num3 <= 0.0)
			{
				num3 = 1.0;
			}
			bool useLogarithmicScale = Settings.UseLogarithmicScale;
			double logarithmBase = Settings.LogarithmBase;
			if (Settings.ScaleColors != null)
			{
				byte[] array = new byte[Settings.ScaleColors.Length];
				byte[] array2 = new byte[Settings.ScaleColors.Length];
				byte[] array3 = new byte[Settings.ScaleColors.Length];
				byte[] array4 = new byte[Settings.ScaleColors.Length];
				byte[] array5 = new byte[Settings.ScaleColors.Length];
				byte[] array6 = new byte[Settings.ScaleColors.Length];
				byte[] array7 = new byte[Settings.ScaleColors.Length];
				byte[] array8 = new byte[Settings.ScaleColors.Length];
				double[] array9 = new double[Settings.ScaleColors.Length];
				double[] array10 = new double[Settings.ScaleColors.Length];
				double[] array11 = new double[Settings.ScaleColors.Length];
				double[] array12 = new double[Settings.ScaleColors.Length];
				double[] array13 = Settings.ScaleColorOffsets;
				if (array13 == null || array13.Length != Settings.ScaleColors.Length)
				{
					array13 = new double[Settings.ScaleColors.Length];
					if (array13.Length == 1)
					{
						array13[0] = 0.0;
					}
					else
					{
						for (int i = 0; i < Settings.ScaleColors.Length; i++)
						{
							array13[i] = (double)i / (double)(Settings.ScaleColors.Length - 1);
						}
					}
				}
				for (int j = 0; j < Settings.ScaleColors.Length; j++)
				{
					array[j] = Settings.ScaleColors[j].A;
					array3[j] = Settings.ScaleColors[j].R;
					array5[j] = Settings.ScaleColors[j].G;
					array7[j] = Settings.ScaleColors[j].B;
					if (j < Settings.ScaleColors.Length - 1)
					{
						array2[j] = Settings.ScaleColors[j + 1].A;
						array4[j] = Settings.ScaleColors[j + 1].R;
						array6[j] = Settings.ScaleColors[j + 1].G;
						array8[j] = Settings.ScaleColors[j + 1].B;
					}
					else
					{
						array2[j] = Settings.ScaleColors[j].A;
						array4[j] = Settings.ScaleColors[j].R;
						array6[j] = Settings.ScaleColors[j].G;
						array8[j] = Settings.ScaleColors[j].B;
					}
					array9[j] = array2[j] - array[j];
					array10[j] = array4[j] - array3[j];
					array11[j] = array6[j] - array5[j];
					array12[j] = array8[j] - array7[j];
				}
				for (int k = 0; k < num; k++)
				{
					double num4 = accumulationData[k];
					if (num4 == 0.0)
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (useLogarithmicScale)
					{
						num4 = ((!(num4 <= 0.0)) ? Math.Log(num4, logarithmBase) : 0.0);
					}
					num2 = (num4 - minValue) / num3;
					if (num2 < 0.0)
					{
						num2 = 0.0;
					}
					if (num2 > 1.0)
					{
						num2 = 1.0;
					}
					int num5 = 0;
					for (int l = 0; l < array13.Length; l++)
					{
						if (array13[l] >= num2)
						{
							num5 = l - 1;
							break;
						}
					}
					if (num5 > array13.Length - 2)
					{
						num5 = array13.Length - 2;
					}
					if (num5 < 0)
					{
						num5 = 0;
					}
					num2 = (num2 - array13[num5]) / (array13[num5 + 1] - array13[num5]);
					byte b = (byte)Math.Floor((double)(int)array[num5] + num2 * array9[num5]);
					byte b2 = (byte)Math.Floor((double)(int)array3[num5] + num2 * array10[num5]);
					byte b3 = (byte)Math.Floor((double)(int)array5[num5] + num2 * array11[num5]);
					byte b4 = (byte)Math.Floor((double)(int)array7[num5] + num2 * array12[num5]);
					imageData[4 * k] = b;
					imageData[4 * k + 1] = b2;
					imageData[4 * k + 2] = b3;
					imageData[4 * k + 3] = b4;
				}
				return;
			}
			byte a = Settings.MinimumColor.A;
			byte a2 = Settings.MaximumColor.A;
			byte r = Settings.MinimumColor.R;
			byte r2 = Settings.MaximumColor.R;
			byte g = Settings.MinimumColor.G;
			byte g2 = Settings.MaximumColor.G;
			byte b5 = Settings.MinimumColor.B;
			byte b6 = Settings.MaximumColor.B;
			double num6 = a2 - a;
			double num7 = r2 - r;
			double num8 = g2 - g;
			double num9 = b6 - b5;
			for (int m = 0; m < num; m++)
			{
				double num4 = accumulationData[m];
				if (num4 != 0.0)
				{
					if (useLogarithmicScale)
					{
						num4 = Math.Log(num4, logarithmBase);
					}
					num2 = (num4 - minValue) / num3;
					if (num2 < 0.0)
					{
						num2 = 0.0;
					}
					if (num2 > 1.0)
					{
						num2 = 1.0;
					}
					byte b = (byte)Math.Floor((double)(int)a + num2 * num6);
					byte b2 = (byte)Math.Floor((double)(int)r + num2 * num7);
					byte b3 = (byte)Math.Floor((double)(int)g + num2 * num8);
					byte b4 = (byte)Math.Floor((double)(int)b5 + num2 * num9);
					imageData[4 * m] = b;
					imageData[4 * m + 1] = b2;
					imageData[4 * m + 2] = b3;
					imageData[4 * m + 3] = b4;
				}
			}
		}

		private double[] GetAccumulationData(Rect tileViewport)
		{
			return new double[(int)tileViewport.Width * (int)tileViewport.Height];
		}

		private byte[] GetImageBytes(Rect tileViewport)
		{
			return new byte[(int)tileViewport.Width * (int)tileViewport.Height * 4];
		}

		private double[] GetFilter(int filterBreadth, double zoomedBlurRadius)
		{
			double[] array = new double[filterBreadth * filterBreadth];
			double num = (double)filterBreadth / 2.0;
			double num2 = (double)filterBreadth / 2.0;
			for (int i = 0; i < filterBreadth; i++)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < filterBreadth; j++)
				{
					double num3 = Math.Sqrt(Math.Pow((double)i - num2, 2.0) + Math.Pow((double)j - num2, 2.0));
					if (num3 > num)
					{
						array[j * filterBreadth + i] = 0.0;
					}
					else
					{
						array[j * filterBreadth + i] = num - num3;
					}
				}
			}
			double num4 = 0.0;
			double num5 = double.MinValue;
			double num6 = double.MaxValue;
			for (int k = 0; k < filterBreadth; k++)
			{
				for (int l = 0; l < filterBreadth; l++)
				{
					double num7 = array[l * filterBreadth + k];
					if (num7 != 0.0)
					{
						num4 += num7;
						num5 = ((num7 > num5) ? num7 : num5);
						num6 = ((num7 < num6) ? num7 : num6);
					}
				}
			}
			for (int m = 0; m < filterBreadth; m++)
			{
				for (int n = 0; n < filterBreadth; n++)
				{
					double num8 = array[n * filterBreadth + m];
					if (num8 != 0.0)
					{
						double num9 = (num8 - num6) / (num5 - num6);
						array[n * filterBreadth + m] = 0.01 + num9 * 0.99;
					}
				}
			}
			array[(int)num2 * filterBreadth + (int)num2] = 1.0;
			return array;
		}

		private int GetFilterBreadth(Rect tileViewport, double zoomedBlurRadius)
		{
			return (int)Math.Floor(zoomedBlurRadius * 2.0);
		}

		private void Finish()
		{
			if (CompletedSink != null)
			{
				CompletedSink.OnCompleted(new HeatTileImageCreatedEventArgs
				{
					Url = _url,
					X = _x,
					Y = _y,
					Z = _z,
					GlobalMinimumValue = Settings.GlobalMinimum,
					GlobalMaximumValue = Settings.GlobalMaximum,
					GlobalMaximumValueLongitude = _maxAccPixelLongitude,
					GlobalMaximumValueLatitude = _maxAccPixelLatitude,
					GlobalMinimumValueLongitude = _minAccPixelLongitude,
					GlobalMinimumValueLatitude = _minAccPixelLatitude,
					ImageData = _imageData
				});
			}
		}
	}

	internal class HeatTileGeneratorWorkerManager
	{
		private ConcurrentDictionary<string, HeatTileGeneratorWorker> _activeWorkers = new ConcurrentDictionary<string, HeatTileGeneratorWorker>();

		private ConcurrentDictionary<string, HeatTileGeneratorWorker[]> _activeWorkersByTile = new ConcurrentDictionary<string, HeatTileGeneratorWorker[]>();

		public void GetTile(TileWorkSettings settings, TileImageCreated onCreated, TileImageCreating onCreating)
		{
			AddWork(settings, onCreated, onCreating);
		}

		private void RemoveFinishedWorker(HeatTileGeneratorWorker worker)
		{
			worker.CompletedSink = null;
			_activeWorkers.TryRemove(worker.Id.ToString(), out var _);
			if (!_activeWorkersByTile.TryRemove(worker.Settings.Z + "_" + worker.Settings.X + "_" + worker.Settings.Y, out var value2))
			{
				return;
			}
			List<HeatTileGeneratorWorker> list = new List<HeatTileGeneratorWorker>(value2);
			list.Remove(worker);
			if (list.Count != 0)
			{
				HeatTileGeneratorWorker[] workersCopyArr = list.ToArray();
				_activeWorkersByTile.AddOrUpdate(worker.Settings.Z + "_" + worker.Settings.X + "_" + worker.Settings.Y, workersCopyArr, delegate(string k, HeatTileGeneratorWorker[] o)
				{
					List<HeatTileGeneratorWorker> list2 = new List<HeatTileGeneratorWorker>(o);
					list2.AddRange(workersCopyArr);
					return list2.ToArray();
				});
			}
		}

		private void AddWork(TileWorkSettings settings, TileImageCreated onCreated, TileImageCreating onCreating)
		{
			HeatTileGeneratorWorker worker = new HeatTileGeneratorWorker(settings);
			worker.CompletedSink = new TileWorkCompletedSink(this, onCreated);
			if (_activeWorkers.TryAdd(worker.Id.ToString(), worker))
			{
				_activeWorkersByTile.AddOrUpdate(worker.Settings.Z + "_" + worker.Settings.X + "_" + worker.Settings.Y, new HeatTileGeneratorWorker[1] { worker }, (string k, HeatTileGeneratorWorker[] o) => new List<HeatTileGeneratorWorker>(o) { worker }.ToArray());
				Task.Factory.StartNew(worker.DoWork, CancellationToken.None, TaskCreationOptions.None, TaskScheduler.Default).ContinueWith(delegate
				{
					RemoveFinishedWorker(worker);
				});
			}
		}

		internal void Destroy()
		{
			KeyValuePair<string, HeatTileGeneratorWorker>[] array = _activeWorkers.ToArray();
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, HeatTileGeneratorWorker> keyValuePair in array)
			{
				RemoveFinishedWorker(keyValuePair.Value);
			}
		}

		public void CancelTile(int z, int x, int y)
		{
			if (!_activeWorkersByTile.TryGetValue(z + "_" + x + "_" + y, out var value))
			{
				return;
			}
			HeatTileGeneratorWorker[] array = value;
			foreach (HeatTileGeneratorWorker heatTileGeneratorWorker in array)
			{
				if (!heatTileGeneratorWorker.Settings.TestRun)
				{
					RemoveFinishedWorker(heatTileGeneratorWorker);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	internal class TileWorkCompletedSink : ITileWorkCompletedSink
	{
		private HeatTileGeneratorWorkerManager _manager;

		private TileImageCreated _onCreated;

		public TileWorkCompletedSink(HeatTileGeneratorWorkerManager manager, TileImageCreated onCreated)
		{
			_manager = manager;
			_onCreated = onCreated;
		}

		public void OnCompleted(TileImageCreatedEventArgs args)
		{
			_onCreated(_manager, args);
		}
	}
	internal class HeatTileScaler
	{
		private const double MinimumLatitude = -85.05112878;

		private const double MaximumLatitude = 85.05112878;

		private const double MinimumLongitude = -180.0;

		private const double MaximumLongitude = 180.0;

		private const double DegreeAsRadian = Math.PI / 180.0;

		private double _latitudeSpan;

		private double _longitudeSpan;

		private double _projectedMaximum;

		private double _projectedRange;

		public HeatTileScaler()
		{
			_latitudeSpan = 170.10225756;
			_longitudeSpan = 360.0;
			_projectedMaximum = GetProjectedValue(85.05112878);
			_projectedRange = GetProjectedValue(85.05112878) - GetProjectedValue(-85.05112878);
		}

		private double GetProjectedValue(double value)
		{
			double num = Math.Sin(value * (Math.PI / 180.0));
			return 0.5 * Math.Log((1.0 + num) / (1.0 - num));
		}

		private static ScalerVisibleBounds GetVisibleBounds(Rect window, Rect viewport)
		{
			Rect rect = new Rect(viewport.Left / window.Width, viewport.Top / window.Height, viewport.Width / window.Width, viewport.Height / window.Height);
			double left = rect.Left + rect.Width * window.Left;
			double right = rect.Left + rect.Width * window.Right;
			double top = rect.Top + rect.Height * window.Top;
			double bottom = rect.Top + rect.Height * window.Bottom;
			return new ScalerVisibleBounds(left, top, right, bottom);
		}

		public static double GetUnprojectedValue(double value)
		{
			value = Math.Exp(2.0 * value);
			return Math.Asin((value - 1.0) / (value + 1.0)) / (Math.PI / 180.0);
		}

		public double UnscaleLatitude(double value, Rect window, Rect viewport)
		{
			double num = (value - viewport.Top) * window.Width + window.Top * viewport.Height;
			num = GetProjectedValue(85.05112878) - num / (viewport.Height / _projectedRange);
			return GetUnprojectedValue(num);
		}

		public double ScaleLatitude(double value, Rect window, Rect viewport)
		{
			return (viewport.Top + GetScaledValue(value, viewport.Height) - window.Top * viewport.Height) / window.Width;
		}

		private double GetScaledValue(double unscaledValue, double viewportHeight)
		{
			unscaledValue = ((!(unscaledValue > -85.05112878)) ? (-85.05112878) : ((unscaledValue < 85.05112878) ? unscaledValue : 85.05112878));
			double projectedValue = GetProjectedValue(unscaledValue);
			return (_projectedMaximum - projectedValue) * viewportHeight / _projectedRange;
		}

		public double UnscaleLongitude(double value, Rect window, Rect viewport)
		{
			double num = window.Left + window.Width * (value - viewport.Left) / viewport.Width;
			return -180.0 + num * _longitudeSpan;
		}

		public double ScaleLongitude(double value, Rect window, Rect viewport)
		{
			double num = (value - -180.0) / _longitudeSpan;
			return viewport.Left + viewport.Width * (num - window.Left) / window.Width;
		}

		public double GetMinimumVisibleLatitude(Rect window, Rect viewport)
		{
			GetVisibleBounds(window, viewport);
			return UnscaleLatitude(viewport.Bottom, window, viewport);
		}

		public double GetMaximumVisibleLatitude(Rect window, Rect viewport)
		{
			GetVisibleBounds(window, viewport);
			return UnscaleLatitude(viewport.Top, window, viewport);
		}

		public double GetMinimumVisibleLongitude(Rect window, Rect viewport)
		{
			GetVisibleBounds(window, viewport);
			return UnscaleLongitude(viewport.Left, window, viewport);
		}

		public double GetMaximumVisibleLongitude(Rect window, Rect viewport)
		{
			GetVisibleBounds(window, viewport);
			return UnscaleLongitude(viewport.Right, window, viewport);
		}

		public void ScaleLatitudes(List<double> visibleLatitudes, Rect window, Rect viewport)
		{
			double height = viewport.Height;
			double top = viewport.Top;
			for (int i = 0; i < visibleLatitudes.Count; i++)
			{
				double num = visibleLatitudes[i];
				num = ((num > -85.05112878) ? ((num < 85.05112878) ? num : 85.05112878) : (-85.05112878));
				double num2 = Math.Sin(num * (Math.PI / 180.0));
				double num3 = 0.5 * Math.Log((1.0 + num2) / (1.0 - num2));
				double num4 = (_projectedMaximum - num3) * height / _projectedRange;
				num4 = top + num4;
				visibleLatitudes[i] = (num4 - window.Top * height) / window.Width;
			}
		}

		public void ScaleLongitudes(List<double> visibleLongitudes, Rect window, Rect viewport)
		{
			_ = viewport.Left;
			_ = viewport.Width;
			_ = window.Left;
			_ = window.Width;
			for (int i = 0; i < visibleLongitudes.Count; i++)
			{
				double num = (visibleLongitudes[i] - -180.0) / _longitudeSpan;
				visibleLongitudes[i] = viewport.Left + viewport.Width * (num - window.Left) / window.Width;
			}
		}
	}
	internal class ScalerVisibleBounds
	{
		public double Top { get; set; }

		public double Bottom { get; set; }

		public double Right { get; set; }

		public double Left { get; set; }

		public ScalerVisibleBounds(double left, double top, double right, double bottom)
		{
			Left = left;
			Top = top;
			Right = right;
			Bottom = bottom;
		}
	}
	[TSImportModule("igniteui-core/type", "TypeRegistrar")]
	[DontObfuscate]
	internal class DVContainer
	{
		private Dictionary<string, Func<object>> _factories = new Dictionary<string, Func<object>>();

		private static DVContainer _instance;

		public static DVContainer Instance
		{
			get
			{
				if (_instance == null)
				{
					_instance = new DVContainer();
				}
				return _instance;
			}
		}

		private DVContainer()
		{
		}

		public void RegisterFactory(Type interfaceType, Func<object> createInstance)
		{
			lock (_factories)
			{
				_factories.Add(interfaceType.Name, createInstance);
			}
		}

		public object CreateInstance(Type interfaceType, Func<string> errorMessage)
		{
			lock (_factories)
			{
				if (_factories.ContainsKey(interfaceType.Name))
				{
					return _factories[interfaceType.Name]();
				}
			}
			throw new Exception(errorMessage());
		}
	}

	internal class BindingFormatter
	{
		private string _formatString;

		private object[] _formatSpecifiers;

		private List<string> _parts;

		private List<FastReflectionHelper> _reflectionHelpers;

		private object[] _platformSpecifiers;

		private PlatformSpecifierType[] _platformSpecifierTypes;

		public string FormatString
		{
			get
			{
				return _formatString;
			}
			set
			{
				_formatString = value;
				OnFormatStringUpdated();
			}
		}

		public object[] FormatSpecifiers
		{
			get
			{
				return _formatSpecifiers;
			}
			set
			{
				_formatSpecifiers = value;
				OnFormatSpecifiersUpdated();
			}
		}

		private void OnFormatStringUpdated()
		{
			string formatString = FormatString;
			if (formatString == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = 0;
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			List<FastReflectionHelper> list2 = new List<FastReflectionHelper>();
			List<string> list3 = new List<string>();
			for (int num2 = formatString.IndexOf('{', num); num2 >= num; num2 = formatString.IndexOf('{', num))
			{
				list3.Add(formatString.Substring(num, num2 - num));
				int num3 = formatString.IndexOf('}', num2);
				if (num3 <= num2)
				{
					return;
				}
				string text = formatString.Substring(num2 + 1, num3 - num2 - 1).Trim();
				int num4 = text.IndexOf(':');
				if (num4 == -1)
				{
					list.Add(text);
					if (text == "0" || text == ".")
					{
						list2.Add(null);
					}
					else
					{
						list2.Add(new FastReflectionHelper(useTraditionalReflection: false, text));
					}
				}
				else
				{
					string text2 = text.Substring(0, num4).Trim();
					list2.Add(new FastReflectionHelper(useTraditionalReflection: false, text2));
					list.Add(text2);
					if (text2 == "0" || text2 == ".")
					{
						list2.Add(null);
					}
					else
					{
						list2.Add(new FastReflectionHelper(useTraditionalReflection: false, text));
					}
				}
				num = num3 + 1;
			}
			list3.Add(formatString.Substring(num));
			_parts = list3;
			_reflectionHelpers = list2;
		}

		private void OnFormatSpecifiersUpdated()
		{
			if (_formatSpecifiers == null)
			{
				_platformSpecifiers = null;
				_platformSpecifierTypes = null;
				return;
			}
			_platformSpecifiers = new object[_formatSpecifiers.Length];
			_platformSpecifierTypes = new PlatformSpecifierType[_formatSpecifiers.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < _formatSpecifiers.Length; i++)
			{
				object obj = _formatSpecifiers[i];
				PlatformSpecifierType platformSpecifierType = GetPlatformSpecifierType(obj);
				_platformSpecifierTypes[i] = platformSpecifierType;
				if (platformSpecifierType != PlatformSpecifierType.None)
				{
					_platformSpecifiers[i] = obj;
				}
			}
		}

		private PlatformSpecifierType GetPlatformSpecifierType(object v)
		{
			if (v == null)
			{
				return PlatformSpecifierType.None;
			}
			if (v is string)
			{
				return PlatformSpecifierType.Generic;
			}
			return PlatformSpecifierType.None;
		}

		public string Format(object item)
		{
			string text = "";
			if (_parts == null)
			{
				return text;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < _parts.Count; i++)
			{
				text += _parts[i];
				if (i < _reflectionHelpers.Count)
				{
					object obj = item;
					FastReflectionHelper fastReflectionHelper = _reflectionHelpers[i];
					if (fastReflectionHelper != null)
					{
						obj = fastReflectionHelper.GetPropertyValue(obj);
					}
					if (_platformSpecifiers != null && i < _platformSpecifiers.Length && _platformSpecifiers[i] != null)
					{
						object obj2 = _platformSpecifiers[i];
						_ = _platformSpecifierTypes[i];
						text = string.Format(string.Concat("{0:", obj2, "}"), obj);
					}
					else
					{
						text += ((obj != null) ? obj.ToString() : "");
					}
				}
			}
			return text;
		}
	}
	internal enum PlatformSpecifierType
	{
		None,
		Number,
		Date,
		Generic
	}

	[TSImportModule("igniteui-core/type", "IEnumerable$1")]
	public class InterpolationUtil
	{
		public static Thickness InterpolateThickness(double p, Thickness from, Thickness to)
		{
			return new Thickness(from.Left + p * (to.Left - from.Left), from.Top + p * (to.Top - from.Top), from.Right + p * (to.Right - from.Right), from.Bottom + p * (to.Bottom - from.Bottom));
		}

		public static CornerRadius InterpolateCornerRadius(double p, CornerRadius from, CornerRadius to)
		{
			return new CornerRadius(from.TopLeft + p * (to.TopLeft - from.TopLeft), from.TopRight + p * (to.TopRight - from.TopRight), from.BottomRight + p * (to.BottomRight - from.BottomRight), from.BottomLeft + p * (to.BottomLeft - from.BottomLeft));
		}

		public static Rect InterpolateRect(double p, Rect from, Rect to)
		{
			return new Rect(from.Left + p * (to.Left - from.Left), from.Top + p * (to.Top - from.Top), from.Width + p * (to.Width - from.Width), from.Height + p * (to.Height - from.Height));
		}

		public static List<Point> InterpolatePoints([SwiftMutableParameter] List<Point> interpolatedPoints, double p, [SwiftMutableParameter] List<Point> minPoints, List<Point> maxPoints)
		{
			double num = 1.0 - p;
			if (interpolatedPoints == null)
			{
				interpolatedPoints = new List<Point>();
			}
			if (minPoints == null)
			{
				minPoints = new List<Point>();
			}
			int count = minPoints.Count;
			int count2 = maxPoints.Count;
			int num2 = Math.Max(count, count2);
			int count3 = interpolatedPoints.Count;
			if (count3 < num2)
			{
				interpolatedPoints.InsertRange(count3, new Point[num2 - count3]);
			}
			if (count3 > num2)
			{
				interpolatedPoints.RemoveRange(num2, count3 - num2);
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < Math.Min(count, count2); i++)
			{
				interpolatedPoints[i] = new Point(minPoints[i].X * num + maxPoints[i].X * p, minPoints[i].Y * num + maxPoints[i].Y * p);
			}
			if (count < count2)
			{
				Point point = ((count > 0) ? minPoints[count - 1] : new Point(0.0, 0.0));
				for (int j = count; j < count2; j++)
				{
					interpolatedPoints[j] = new Point(point.X * num + maxPoints[j].X * p, point.Y * num + maxPoints[j].Y * p);
				}
			}
			if (count > count2)
			{
				Point point2 = ((count2 > 0) ? maxPoints[count2 - 1] : new Point(0.0, 0.0));
				for (int k = count2; k < count; k++)
				{
					interpolatedPoints[k] = new Point(minPoints[k].X * num + point2.X * p, minPoints[k].Y * num + point2.Y * p);
				}
			}
			return interpolatedPoints;
		}

		public static List<T> InterpolateValues<T>([SwiftMutableParameter] List<T> interpolatedValues, double p, [SwiftMutableParameter] List<T> minValues, List<T> maxValues, Func<T> createEmpty, Func<double, double, T, T, T> interpolate)
		{
			double arg = 1.0 - p;
			if (interpolatedValues == null)
			{
				interpolatedValues = new List<T>();
			}
			if (minValues == null)
			{
				minValues = new List<T>();
			}
			int count = minValues.Count;
			int count2 = maxValues.Count;
			int num = Math.Max(count, count2);
			if (interpolatedValues.Count < num)
			{
				T[] collection = new T[num - interpolatedValues.Count];
				interpolatedValues.InsertRange(interpolatedValues.Count, collection);
			}
			if (interpolatedValues.Count > num)
			{
				interpolatedValues.RemoveRange(num, interpolatedValues.Count - num);
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < Math.Min(count, count2); i++)
			{
				interpolatedValues[i] = interpolate(p, arg, minValues[i], maxValues[i]);
			}
			if (count < count2)
			{
				T arg2 = ((count > 0) ? minValues[count - 1] : createEmpty());
				for (int j = count; j < count2; j++)
				{
					interpolatedValues[j] = interpolate(p, arg, arg2, maxValues[j]);
				}
			}
			if (count > count2)
			{
				T arg3 = ((count2 > 0) ? maxValues[count2 - 1] : createEmpty());
				for (int k = count2; k < count; k++)
				{
					interpolatedValues[k] = interpolate(p, arg, minValues[k], arg3);
				}
			}
			return interpolatedValues;
		}

		public static double[] InterpolateDashArrays(double p, [SwiftMutableParameter] double[] startValue, double[] endValue)
		{
			if (startValue == null)
			{
				startValue = new double[0];
			}
			int num = startValue.Length;
			int num2 = endValue.Length;
			double[] array = new double[Math.Max(num, num2)];
			for (int i = 0; i < Math.Min(num, num2); i++)
			{
				array[i] = startValue[i] + p * (endValue[i] - startValue[i]);
			}
			if (num < num2)
			{
				double num3 = ((num > 0) ? startValue[num - 1] : 0.0);
				for (int j = num; j < num2; j++)
				{
					array[j] = num3 + p * (endValue[j] - num3);
				}
			}
			if (num > num2)
			{
				double num4 = ((num2 > 0) ? endValue[num2 - 1] : 0.0);
				for (int k = num2; k < num; k++)
				{
					array[k] = startValue[k] + p * (num4 - startValue[k]);
				}
			}
			return array;
		}
	}

	[DontObfuscate]
	public class SyncableObservableCollection<T> : SyncableObservableCollection<T, T>
	{
		public SyncableObservableCollection()
		{
			base.Compare = (T left, T right) => left.Equals(right);
			base.CreateFrom = (T right) => right;
			base.CreateTo = (T left) => left;
		}
	}
	[DontObfuscate]
	public class SyncableObservableCollection<T1, T2> : ObservableCollection<T1>
	{
		private SyncableObservableCollection<T2> _syncTarget;

		private bool _duringSync;

		private bool _duringTargetChange;

		private bool _duringSelfChange;

		public SyncableObservableCollection<T2> SyncTarget
		{
			get
			{
				return _syncTarget;
			}
			set
			{
				SyncableObservableCollection<T2> syncTarget = _syncTarget;
				_syncTarget = value;
				OnSyncTargetChanged(syncTarget, _syncTarget);
			}
		}

		public Func<T1, T2, bool> Compare { get; set; }

		public Func<T1, T2> CreateTo { get; set; }

		public Func<T2, T1> CreateFrom { get; set; }

		internal IList<T1> All => this;

		private void OnSyncTargetChanged(SyncableObservableCollection<T2> oldValue, SyncableObservableCollection<T2> newValue)
		{
			oldValue?.RemoveListener(TargetChanged);
			SyncWithTarget();
			newValue?.AddListener(TargetChanged);
		}

		private void SyncWithTarget()
		{
			if (_syncTarget == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			_duringSync = true;
			List<T1> list = new List<T1>();
			HashSet<T1> hashSet = new HashSet<T1>();
			for (int i = 0; i < All.Count; i++)
			{
				if (!hashSet.Contains(All[i]))
				{
					list.Add(All[i]);
					hashSet.Add(All[i]);
				}
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < _syncTarget.All.Count; j++)
			{
				if (!ListContains(hashSet, _syncTarget.All[j]))
				{
					T1 item = CreateFrom(_syncTarget.All[j]);
					list.Add(item);
					hashSet.Add(item);
				}
			}
			SyncWithUnion(list, All);
			SyncWithUnion(list, _syncTarget.All);
			_duringSync = false;
		}

		private bool ListContains(IEnumerable<T1> list, T2 item)
		{
			if (Compare == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("SyncableObservableCollection has no Compare function provided.");
			}
			foreach (T1 item2 in list)
			{
				if (Compare(item2, item))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void SyncWithUnion(List<T1> union, IList<T1> list)
		{
			List<int> list2 = new List<int>();
			int i = 0;
			for (int j = 0; j < list.Count; j++)
			{
				if (list[j] == null)
				{
					list2.Add(j);
					continue;
				}
				if (i > union.Count - 1)
				{
					list2.Add(j);
					continue;
				}
				if (list[j].Equals(union[i]))
				{
					i++;
					continue;
				}
				list.Insert(j, union[i]);
				i++;
			}
			for (int num = list2.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				list.RemoveAt(num);
			}
			for (; i < union.Count; i++)
			{
				list.Add(union[i]);
			}
		}

		[JAVAClientName("syncWithUnion2")]
		private void SyncWithUnion(List<T1> union, IList<T2> list)
		{
			List<int> list2 = new List<int>();
			int i = 0;
			for (int j = 0; j < list.Count; j++)
			{
				if (list[j] == null)
				{
					list2.Add(j);
					continue;
				}
				if (i > union.Count - 1)
				{
					list2.Add(j);
					continue;
				}
				if (list[j].Equals(union[i]))
				{
					i++;
					continue;
				}
				list.Insert(j, CreateTo(union[i]));
				i++;
			}
			for (int num = list2.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				list.RemoveAt(num);
			}
			for (; i < union.Count; i++)
			{
				list.Add(CreateTo(union[i]));
			}
		}

		[Weak]
		private void TargetChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (_syncTarget != null && !_duringSync && !_duringSelfChange)
			{
				IList<T2> all = _syncTarget.All;
				_duringTargetChange = true;
				SyncChange(e, All, all);
				_duringTargetChange = false;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnSelfChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
		}

		[Weak]
		private void SelfChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			OnSelfChanged(e);
			if (_syncTarget != null && !_duringSync && !_duringTargetChange)
			{
				IList<T2> all = _syncTarget.All;
				_duringSelfChange = true;
				SyncChange(e, all, All);
				_duringSelfChange = false;
			}
		}

		private void SyncChange<T, F>(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e, IList<T> to, IList<F> from)
		{
			switch (e.Action)
			{
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add:
			{
				if (e.NewItems == null)
				{
					break;
				}
				for (int l = 0; l < e.NewItems.Count; l++)
				{
					object obj2 = e.NewItems[l];
					if (typeof(F) != typeof(T))
					{
						if (typeof(F) == typeof(T1))
						{
							obj2 = CreateTo((T1)e.NewItems[l]);
						}
						if (typeof(F) == typeof(T2))
						{
							obj2 = CreateFrom((T2)e.NewItems[l]);
						}
					}
					to.Insert(l + e.NewStartingIndex, (T)obj2);
				}
				break;
			}
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove:
				if (e.OldItems != null)
				{
					for (int k = 0; k < e.OldItems.Count; k++)
					{
						to.RemoveAt(e.OldStartingIndex);
					}
				}
				break;
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace:
			{
				if (e.OldItems != null)
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < e.OldItems.Count; i++)
					{
						to.RemoveAt(e.OldStartingIndex);
					}
				}
				if (e.NewItems == null)
				{
					break;
				}
				for (int j = 0; j < e.NewItems.Count; j++)
				{
					_ = e.NewItems[j];
					if (typeof(F) != typeof(T))
					{
						if (typeof(F) == typeof(T1))
						{
							CreateTo((T1)e.NewItems[j]);
						}
						if (typeof(F) == typeof(T2))
						{
							CreateFrom((T2)e.NewItems[j]);
						}
					}
					to.Insert(j + e.NewStartingIndex, (T)e.NewItems[j]);
				}
				break;
			}
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset:
				to.Clear();
				{
					foreach (F item in from)
					{
						object obj = item;
						if (typeof(F) != typeof(T))
						{
							if (typeof(F) == typeof(T1))
							{
								obj = CreateTo((T1)obj);
							}
							if (typeof(F) == typeof(T2))
							{
								obj = CreateFrom((T2)obj);
							}
						}
						to.Add((T)obj);
					}
					break;
				}
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Move:
				break;
			}
		}

		public SyncableObservableCollection()
		{
			AddListener(SelfChanged);
		}

		internal void AddListener(NotifyCollectionChangedEventHandler eventHandler)
		{
			CollectionChanged += eventHandler;
		}

		internal void RemoveListener(NotifyCollectionChangedEventHandler eventHandler)
		{
			CollectionChanged -= eventHandler;
		}
	}

		private void MeasureToFit(UIElement element, Size availableSize)
		{
			Size size = new Size(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity);
			if (GetEdge(element) == DockEdge.Central)
			{
				element.Measure(availableSize);
				Size desiredSize = element.DesiredSize;
				element.Measure(size);
				Size desiredSize2 = element.DesiredSize;
				Size availableSize2 = ((!(desiredSize.Height >= desiredSize2.Height) || !(desiredSize.Width >= desiredSize2.Width) || !(desiredSize.Width <= availableSize.Width) || !(desiredSize.Height <= availableSize.Height)) ? size : availableSize);
				element.Measure(availableSize2);
			}
			else
			{
				element.Measure(size);
			}
			if (element.DesiredSize.Width > availableSize.Width && element.DesiredSize.Height < availableSize.Height)
			{
				element.Measure(new Size(availableSize.Width, double.PositiveInfinity));
				if (element.DesiredSize.Width > availableSize.Width || element.DesiredSize.Height > availableSize.Height)
				{
					element.Measure(size);
				}
			}
			else if (element.DesiredSize.Height > availableSize.Height && element.DesiredSize.Width < availableSize.Width)
			{
				element.Measure(new Size(double.PositiveInfinity, availableSize.Height));
				if (element.DesiredSize.Width > availableSize.Width || element.DesiredSize.Height > availableSize.Height)
				{
					element.Measure(size);
				}
			}
			else if (element.DesiredSize.Height > availableSize.Height && element.DesiredSize.Width > availableSize.Width)
			{
				element.Measure(availableSize);
				if (element.DesiredSize.Width > availableSize.Width || element.DesiredSize.Height > availableSize.Height)
				{
					element.Measure(size);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override Size MeasureOverride(Size availableSize)
		{
			List<UIElement>[] array = ByEdge(base.Children);
			double[,] array2 = new double[4, 4];
			double[,] array3 = new double[4, 4];
			double[] array4 = new double[4];
			double[] array5 = new double[4];

						array3[i, num] += item.DesiredSize.Height;
						num = (int)GetHorizontalDockAlignment(item);
						array2[i, num] = Math.Max(array2[i, num], item.DesiredSize.Width);
					}
					else
					{
						num = (int)GetVerticalDockAlignment(item);
						array3[i, num] = Math.Max(array3[i, num], item.DesiredSize.Height);
						num = (int)GetHorizontalDockAlignment(item);
						array2[i, num] += item.DesiredSize.Width;
					}
				}
				if (i % 2 == 1)
				{
					array5[i] = Math.Max(Math.Max(array3[i, 0], array3[i, 1]), array3[i, 2] + array3[i, 3]);
					array4[i] = array2[i, 0] + array2[i, 1] + array2[i, 2];
					if (array2[i, 1] > 0.0)
					{
						array4[i] = Math.Max(array2[i, 0] * 2.0 + array2[i, 1], array2[i, 2] * 2.0 + array2[i, 1]);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					array4[i] = Math.Max(Math.Max(array2[i, 0], array2[i, 1]), array2[i, 2]);
					array5[i] = array3[i, 0] + array3[i, 1] + array3[i, 2] + array3[i, 3];
					if (array3[i, 1] > 0.0)
					{
						array5[i] = Math.Max(array3[i, 0] * 2.0 + array3[i, 1], array3[i, 2] * 2.0 + array3[i, 1]);
					}
				}
			}
			if (LayoutPriority == LayoutPriority.TopAndBottom)
			{
				double num2 = array5[1] + array5[3];
				array5[0] += num2;
				array5[2] += num2;
			}
			else if (LayoutPriority == LayoutPriority.LeftAndRight)
			{
				double num3 = array4[0] + array4[2];
				array4[1] += num3;
				array4[3] += num3;
			}
			Size availableSize2 = new Size(Math.Max(0.0, availableSize.Width - array4[0] - array4[2]), Math.Max(0.0, availableSize.Height - array5[3] - array5[1]));
			for (int j = 4; j < 8; j++)

				foreach (UIElement item2 in array[j])

					MeasureToFit(item2, availableSize2);

			foreach (UIElement item3 in array[8])
			{
				MeasureToFit(item3, availableSize2);
				result.Height = Math.Max(Math.Max(Math.Max(array5[0], array5[2]), array5[1] + array5[3] + item3.DesiredSize.Height), result.Height);
				result.Width = Math.Max(Math.Max(Math.Max(array4[1], array4[3]), array4[0] + array4[2] + item3.DesiredSize.Width), result.Width);
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected override Size ArrangeOverride(Size finalSize)
		{
			List<UIElement>[] array = ByEdge(base.Children);
			Rect bounds = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, finalSize.Width, finalSize.Height);
			Rect rect = Arrange(bounds, array[0], array[1], array[2], array[3]);
			Rect rect2 = new Rect(double.MaxValue, double.MaxValue, 0.0, 0.0);
			if (array[8].Count == 0)
			{
				rect2 = rect;
			}
			else
			{
				foreach (UIElement item in array[8])
				{
					item.Arrange(rect);
					if (item is FrameworkElement)
					{
						rect2 = new Rect(Math.Min((rect.Width - ((FrameworkElement)item).ActualWidth) / 2.0, rect2.X), Math.Min((rect.Height - ((FrameworkElement)item).ActualHeight) / 2.0, rect2.Y), Math.Max(((FrameworkElement)item).ActualWidth, rect2.Width), Math.Max(((FrameworkElement)item).ActualHeight, rect2.Height));
					}
				}
				rect2 = new Rect(Math.Max(rect2.X, 0.0) + rect.X, Math.Max(rect2.Y, 0.0) + rect.Y, Math.Min(rect2.Width, rect.Width), Math.Min(rect2.Height, rect.Height));
			}
			Arrange(rect2, array[4], array[5], array[6], array[7]);
			return finalSize;
		}

		protected override AutomationPeer OnCreateAutomationPeer()
		{
			return new XamDockAutomationPeer(this);
		}

		private Rect Arrange(Rect bounds, List<UIElement> leftElements, List<UIElement> bottomElements, List<UIElement> rightElements, List<UIElement> topElements)
		{
			Size size = Size(leftElements, bounds, DockDirection.Vertical);
			Size size2 = Size(bottomElements, bounds, DockDirection.Horizontal);
			Size size3 = Size(rightElements, bounds, DockDirection.Vertical);
			Size size4 = Size(topElements, bounds, DockDirection.Horizontal);
			if (LayoutPriority == LayoutPriority.None)
			{
				ArrangeEdge(leftElements, new Rect(bounds.Left, bounds.Top, size.Width, bounds.Height), DockDirection.Vertical);
				ArrangeEdge(bottomElements, new Rect(bounds.Left, bounds.Bottom - size2.Height, bounds.Width, size2.Height), DockDirection.Horizontal);
				ArrangeEdge(rightElements, new Rect(bounds.Right - size3.Width, bounds.Top, size3.Width, bounds.Height), DockDirection.Vertical);
				ArrangeEdge(topElements, new Rect(bounds.Left, bounds.Top, bounds.Width, size4.Height), DockDirection.Horizontal);
			}
			else if (LayoutPriority == LayoutPriority.LeftAndRight)
			{
				ArrangeEdge(rightElements, new Rect(bounds.Right - size3.Width, bounds.Top, size3.Width, bounds.Height), DockDirection.Vertical);
				ArrangeEdge(leftElements, new Rect(bounds.Left, bounds.Top, size.Width, bounds.Height), DockDirection.Vertical);
				ArrangeEdge(bottomElements, new Rect(bounds.Left + size.Width, bounds.Bottom - size2.Height, Math.Max(0.0, bounds.Width - size.Width - size3.Width), size2.Height), DockDirection.Horizontal);
				ArrangeEdge(topElements, new Rect(bounds.Left + size.Width, bounds.Top, Math.Max(0.0, bounds.Width - size.Width - size3.Width), size4.Height), DockDirection.Horizontal);
			}
			else
			{
				ArrangeEdge(topElements, new Rect(bounds.Left, bounds.Top, bounds.Width, size4.Height), DockDirection.Horizontal);
				ArrangeEdge(bottomElements, new Rect(bounds.Left, bounds.Bottom - size2.Height, bounds.Width, size2.Height), DockDirection.Horizontal);
				ArrangeEdge(rightElements, new Rect(bounds.Right - size3.Width, bounds.Top + size4.Height, size3.Width, Math.Max(0.0, bounds.Height - size4.Height - size2.Height)), DockDirection.Vertical);
				ArrangeEdge(leftElements, new Rect(bounds.Left, bounds.Top + size4.Height, size.Width, Math.Max(0.0, bounds.Height - size4.Height - size2.Height)), DockDirection.Vertical);
			}
			return new Rect(bounds.Left + size.Width, bounds.Top + size4.Height, Math.Max(0.0, bounds.Width - (size.Width + size3.Width)), Math.Max(0.0, bounds.Height - (size4.Height + size2.Height)));
		}

		private void ArrangeEdge(List<UIElement> elements, Rect bounds, DockDirection edge)
		{
			List<UIElement>[] array = ByPosition(elements, edge);
			Size[] array2 = new Size[array.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				array2[i] = Size(array[i], bounds, edge);
			}
			if (edge == DockDirection.Horizontal)
			{
				Arrange(array[0], new Rect(bounds.Left, bounds.Top, array2[0].Width, bounds.Height), edge, isStrech: false);
				Arrange(array[1], new Rect(bounds.Left + 0.5 * (bounds.Width - array2[1].Width), bounds.Top, array2[1].Width, bounds.Height), edge, isStrech: false);
				Arrange(array[2], new Rect(bounds.Left + (bounds.Width - array2[2].Width), bounds.Top, array2[2].Width, bounds.Height), edge, isStrech: false);
				Arrange(array[3], new Rect(bounds.Left + array2[0].Width, bounds.Top, Math.Max(0.0, bounds.Width - array2[0].Width - array2[2].Width), bounds.Height), edge, isStrech: true);
			}
			else
			{
				Arrange(array[0], new Rect(bounds.Left, bounds.Top, bounds.Width, array2[0].Height), edge, isStrech: false);
				Arrange(array[1], new Rect(bounds.Left, bounds.Top + 0.5 * (bounds.Height - array2[1].Height), bounds.Width, array2[1].Height), edge, isStrech: false);
				Arrange(array[2], new Rect(bounds.Left, bounds.Top + (bounds.Height - array2[2].Height), bounds.Width, array2[2].Height), edge, isStrech: false);
				Arrange(array[3], new Rect(bounds.Left, bounds.Top + array2[0].Width, bounds.Width, Math.Max(0.0, bounds.Height - array2[0].Width - array2[2].Width)), edge, isStrech: true);
			}
		}

		private Size Size(List<UIElement> elements, Rect bounds, DockDirection direction)
		{
			Size result = default(Size);
			foreach (UIElement element in elements)
			{
				double width = element.DesiredSize.Width;
				double height = element.DesiredSize.Height;
				if (direction == DockDirection.Vertical)
				{
					result.Height += height;
					result.Width = Math.Max(result.Width, width);
				}
				else
				{
					result.Width += width;
					result.Height = Math.Max(result.Height, height);
				}
			}
			result.Width = Math.Min(result.Width, bounds.Width);
			result.Height = Math.Min(result.Height, bounds.Height);
			return result;
		}

		private void Arrange(List<UIElement> elements, Rect bounds, DockDirection direction, bool isStrech)
		{
			Rect finalRect = new Rect(bounds.Left, bounds.Top, bounds.Width, bounds.Height);
			if (direction == DockDirection.Horizontal)
			{
				if (isStrech)
				{
					finalRect.Width /= elements.Count;
					{
						foreach (UIElement element in elements)
						{
							element.Arrange(finalRect);
							finalRect.X += finalRect.Width;
						}
						return;
					}
				}
				{
					foreach (UIElement element2 in elements)
					{
						finalRect.Width = element2.DesiredSize.Width;
						finalRect.Width = Math.Min(finalRect.Width, bounds.Width);
						element2.Arrange(finalRect);
						finalRect.X += finalRect.Width;
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			if (isStrech)
			{
				finalRect.Height /= elements.Count;
				{
					foreach (UIElement element3 in elements)
					{
						element3.Arrange(finalRect);
						finalRect.Y += finalRect.Height;
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			foreach (UIElement element4 in elements)
			{
				finalRect.Height = element4.DesiredSize.Height;
				finalRect.Height = Math.Min(finalRect.Height, bounds.Height);
				element4.Arrange(finalRect);
				finalRect.Y += finalRect.Height;
			}
		}

		private List<UIElement>[] ByEdge(UIElementCollection elements)
		{
			List<UIElement>[] array = new List<UIElement>[9];
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i] = new List<UIElement>();
			}
			foreach (UIElement element in elements)
			{
				array[(int)GetEdge(element)].Add(element);
			}
			return array;
		}

		private List<UIElement>[] ByPosition(IList<UIElement> elements, DockDirection direction)
		{
			List<UIElement>[] array = new List<UIElement>[4];
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i] = new List<UIElement>();
			}
			foreach (UIElement element in elements)
			{
				array[GetPosition(element, direction)].Add(element);
			}
			return array;
		}

		public static HorizontalAlignment GetHorizontalDockAlignment(DependencyObject d)
		{
			return (HorizontalAlignment)d.GetValue(HorizontalDockAlignmentProperty);
		}

		public static VerticalAlignment GetVerticalDockAlignment(DependencyObject d)
		{
			return (VerticalAlignment)d.GetValue(VerticalDockAlignmentProperty);
		}

		public static void SetHorizontalDockAlignment(DependencyObject d, HorizontalAlignment value)
		{
			d.SetValue(HorizontalDockAlignmentProperty, value);
		}

		public static void SetVerticalDockAlignment(DependencyObject d, VerticalAlignment value)
		{
			d.SetValue(VerticalDockAlignmentProperty, value);
		}

		private int GetPosition(UIElement element, DockDirection direction)
		{
			if (direction == DockDirection.Horizontal)
			{
				return (int)GetHorizontalDockAlignment(element);
			}
			return (int)GetVerticalDockAlignment(element);
		}
	}

	public class Range : DependencyObject
	{
		private const double MinScale = 0.001;

		private const double MaxScale = 1.0;

		private const double MinScroll = 0.0;

		private const double MaxScroll = 1.0;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty MinimumProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Minimum", typeof(double), typeof(Range), new PropertyMetadata(0.0, OnMinimumChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty MaximumProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Maximum", typeof(double), typeof(Range), new PropertyMetadata(1.0, OnMaximumChanged));

		private bool _initialize;

		private XamZoombar _zoombar;

		public double Minimum
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(MinimumProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(MinimumProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public double Maximum
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(MaximumProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(MaximumProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public double Scale
		{
			get
			{
				double result = 0.0;
				if (Zoombar == null)
				{
					return result;
				}
				double num = Zoombar.ActualMaximum - Zoombar.ActualMinimum;
				double num2 = Maximum - Minimum;
				if (num2 > 0.0 && num > 0.0)
				{
					result = num2 / num;
				}
				return result;
			}
		}

		public double Scroll
		{
			get
			{
				double result = 0.0;
				if (Zoombar == null)
				{
					return result;
				}
				double num = Zoombar.ActualMaximum - Zoombar.ActualMinimum;
				double num2 = Maximum - Minimum;
				double num3 = Minimum - Zoombar.ActualMinimum;
				double num4 = num - num2;
				if (num4 > 0.0)
				{
					result = num3 / num4;
				}
				return result;
			}
		}

		internal bool Initialize
		{
			get
			{
				return _initialize;
			}
			set
			{
				_initialize = value;
			}
		}

		internal XamZoombar Zoombar
		{
			get
			{
				return _zoombar;
			}
			set
			{
				_zoombar = value;
			}
		}

		private static void OnMinimumChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			(d as Range).OnMinimumChanged((double)e.OldValue, (double)e.NewValue);
		}

		protected virtual void OnMinimumChanged(double oldValue, double newValue)
		{
			if (Zoombar == null || Initialize)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (newValue < Zoombar.ActualMinimum)
			{
				Minimum = Zoombar.ActualMinimum;
				return;
			}
			double val = Math.Min(Zoombar.ActualMaximum, Maximum);
			val = Math.Max(Zoombar.ActualMinimum, val);
			if (newValue > val)
			{
				Minimum = val;
				return;
			}
			Range range = new Range();
			Initialize = true;
			range.Minimum = oldValue;
			range.Maximum = Maximum;
			Initialize = false;
			Zoombar.ChangeRange(range, Zoombar.Range);
		}

		private static void OnMaximumChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			(d as Range).OnMaximumChanged((double)e.OldValue, (double)e.NewValue);
		}

		protected virtual void OnMaximumChanged(double oldValue, double newValue)
		{
			if (Zoombar == null || Initialize)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (newValue > Zoombar.ActualMaximum)
			{
				Maximum = Zoombar.ActualMaximum;
				return;
			}
			double val = Math.Max(Zoombar.ActualMinimum, Minimum);
			val = Math.Min(Zoombar.ActualMaximum, val);
			if (newValue < val)
			{
				Maximum = val;
				return;
			}
			Range range = new Range();
			Initialize = true;
			range.Minimum = Minimum;
			range.Maximum = oldValue;
			Initialize = false;
			Zoombar.ChangeRange(range, Zoombar.Range);
		}

		public void FromScaleScroll(double scale, double scroll)
		{
			if (Zoombar != null)
			{
				scale = GetPossibleScale(scale);
				scroll = GetPossibleScroll(scroll);
				double num = Zoombar.ActualMaximum - Zoombar.ActualMinimum;
				double num2 = num * scale;
				double num3 = (num - num2) * scroll;
				double maximum = num3 + num2;
				Initialize = true;
				Minimum = num3;
				Maximum = maximum;
				Initialize = false;
				Zoombar.ChangeRange(null, Zoombar.Range);
			}
		}

		private double GetPossibleScale(double scale)
		{
			double num = Zoombar.CalculateMinScale();
			if (num < 0.001)
			{
				num = 0.001;
			}
			if (scale < num)
			{
				scale = num;
			}
			else if (scale > 1.0)
			{
				scale = 1.0;
			}
			return scale;
		}

		private static double GetPossibleScroll(double scroll)
		{
			if (scroll < 0.0)
			{
				scroll = 0.0;
			}
			else if (scroll > 1.0)
			{
				scroll = 1.0;
			}
			return scroll;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return $"Minimum = {Minimum}, Maximum = {Maximum}";
		}

		internal Range Clone()
		{
			Range range = new Range();
			range.Initialize = true;
			range.Minimum = Minimum;
			range.Maximum = Maximum;
			range.Initialize = false;
			return range;
		}
	}
	internal class ScrollShape : ShapeElement
	{
		private const string NormalState = "Normal";

		private const string MouseOverState = "MouseOver";

		private const string PressedState = "Pressed";

		private FrameworkElement _frameworkElement;

		private bool _moveLeft;

		public FrameworkElement FrameworkElement
		{
			get
			{
				return _frameworkElement;
			}
			set
			{
				_frameworkElement = value;
			}
		}

		private XamZoombar Zoombar => View as XamZoombar;

		public bool MoveLeft
		{
			get
			{
				return _moveLeft;
			}
			set
			{
				_moveLeft = value;
			}
		}

		public ScrollShape(FrameworkElement frameworkElement)
		{
			FrameworkElement = frameworkElement;
			base.FrameworkElements.Add(frameworkElement);
		}

		protected override void ChangeFrameworkElementSettings(FrameworkElement frameworkElement)
		{
		}

		public override void Render()
		{
		}

		public override void Remove()
		{
		}

		public override void OnMouseLeftButtonDown(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseLeftButtonDown(e);
			ChangeVisualState("Pressed");
			double newValue = (MoveLeft ? Zoombar.ActualMinimum : Zoombar.ActualMaximum);
			Zoombar.MoveTo(newValue, isSmallChange: true);
		}

		public override void OnMouseLeftButtonUp(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			Zoombar.StopMove();
			if (base.IsMouseOver)
			{
				ChangeVisualState("MouseOver");
			}
			else
			{
				ChangeVisualState("Normal");
			}
			base.OnMouseLeftButtonUp(e);
		}

		public override void OnMouseEnter(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseEnter(e);
			ChangeVisualState("MouseOver");
		}

		public override void OnMouseLeave(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseLeave(e);
			ChangeVisualState("Normal");
		}

		private void ChangeVisualState(string newState)
		{
			foreach (FrameworkElement frameworkElement in base.FrameworkElements)
			{
				if (frameworkElement is Control control)
				{
					VisualStateManager.GoToState(control, newState, useTransitions: true);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	internal class HorizontalThumbNode : ThumbNode
	{
		private ShapeElement _scaleLeftElement;

		private ShapeElement _scaleRightElement;

		private ShapeElement _thumbBackground;

		internal bool _isLeft;

		public ShapeElement ScaleLeftElement
		{
			get
			{
				return _scaleLeftElement;
			}
			set
			{
				_scaleLeftElement = value;
			}
		}

		public ShapeElement ScaleRightElement
		{
			get
			{
				return _scaleRightElement;
			}
			set
			{
				_scaleRightElement = value;
			}
		}

		public ShapeElement ThumbBackground
		{
			get
			{
				return _thumbBackground;
			}
			set
			{
				_thumbBackground = value;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsLeft
		{
			get
			{
				return _isLeft;
			}
			set
			{
				_isLeft = value;
			}
		}

		public override void ArrangeChildren(Rect oldBounds, Rect newBounds)
		{
			double x = newBounds.X + base.Zoombar.LeftScaleWidth / 2.0;
			double num = newBounds.Width - base.Zoombar.LeftScaleWidth / 2.0 - base.Zoombar.RightScaleWidth / 2.0;
			if (num < 0.0)
			{
				num = 0.0;
			}
			ThumbBackground.Bounds = new Rect(x, newBounds.Y, num, newBounds.Height);
			double x2 = newBounds.Right - base.Zoombar.RightScaleWidth;
			ScaleLeftElement.Bounds = new Rect(newBounds.X, newBounds.Y, base.Zoombar.LeftScaleWidth, newBounds.Height);
			ScaleRightElement.Bounds = new Rect(x2, newBounds.Y, base.Zoombar.RightScaleWidth, newBounds.Height);
		}

		public override ShapeElement HitResizeThumb(Point point)
		{
			if (ScaleLeftElement.HitTest(point))
			{
				IsLeft = true;
				return ScaleLeftElement;
			}
			if (ScaleRightElement.HitTest(point))
			{
				IsLeft = false;
				return ScaleRightElement;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override void DoMove(Point pt)
		{
			double num = pt.X;
			double num2 = base.Bounds.Left + num;
			double num3 = base.Bounds.Right + num;
			double num4 = base.Zoombar.ActualWidth - base.Zoombar.RightOffset;
			double leftOffset = base.Zoombar.LeftOffset;
			if (num2 < leftOffset)
			{
				num += leftOffset - num2;
			}
			if (num3 > num4)
			{
				num -= num3 - num4;
			}
			num2 = base.Bounds.Left + num;
			num3 = base.Bounds.Right + num;
			double minimum = base.Zoombar.CalculateValue(new Point(num2, 0.0));
			double maximum = base.Zoombar.CalculateValue(new Point(num3, 0.0));
			base.Zoombar.TempRange.Minimum = minimum;
			base.Zoombar.TempRange.Maximum = maximum;
			base.Zoombar.UpdateTempThumb();
			base.Zoombar.RaiseZoomChangingEvent();
		}

		public override void DoResize(Point offset)
		{
			double num = base.Bounds.Left;
			double num2 = base.Bounds.Right;
			double num3 = base.Zoombar.LeftScaleWidth + base.Zoombar.RightScaleWidth;
			if (IsLeft)
			{
				num += offset.X;
				if (num < base.Zoombar.LeftOffset)
				{
					num = base.Zoombar.LeftOffset;
				}
				double num4 = num2 - num3;
				if (num > num4)
				{
					num = num4;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				num2 += offset.X;
				double num5 = base.Zoombar.ActualWidth - base.Zoombar.RightOffset;
				if (num2 > num5)
				{
					num2 = num5;
				}
				double num6 = num + num3;
				if (num2 < num6)
				{
					num2 = num6;
				}
			}
			double minimum = base.Zoombar.CalculateValue(new Point(num, 0.0));
			double maximum = base.Zoombar.CalculateValue(new Point(num2, 0.0));
			base.Zoombar.TempRange.Minimum = minimum;
			base.Zoombar.TempRange.Maximum = maximum;
			base.Zoombar.UpdateTempThumb();
			base.Zoombar.RaiseZoomChangingEvent();
		}

		protected override void ChangeVisualState(string newState)
		{
			foreach (FrameworkElement frameworkElement in ScaleLeftElement.FrameworkElements)
			{
				if (frameworkElement is Control control)
				{
					VisualStateManager.GoToState(control, newState, useTransitions: true);
				}
			}
			foreach (FrameworkElement frameworkElement2 in ScaleRightElement.FrameworkElements)
			{
				if (frameworkElement2 is Control control2)
				{
					VisualStateManager.GoToState(control2, newState, useTransitions: true);
				}
			}
			foreach (FrameworkElement frameworkElement3 in ThumbBackground.FrameworkElements)
			{
				if (frameworkElement3 is Control control3)
				{
					VisualStateManager.GoToState(control3, newState, useTransitions: true);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	internal abstract class ThumbNode : Group
	{
		private const string NormalState = "Normal";

		private const string MouseOverState = "MouseOver";

		private const string PressedState = "Pressed";

		protected XamZoombar Zoombar => View as XamZoombar;

		public ThumbNode()
		{
		}

		public void ClearChildren()
		{
			while (base.Children.Count > 0)
			{
				base.Children.RemoveAt(0);
			}
		}

		public abstract ShapeElement HitResizeThumb(Point point);

		public abstract void DoMove(Point offset);

		public abstract void DoResize(Point offset);

		public virtual void Start()
		{
			if (Zoombar.Range != null)
			{
				Zoombar.TempRange.Minimum = Zoombar.Range.Minimum;
				Zoombar.TempRange.Maximum = Zoombar.Range.Maximum;
			}
		}

		public virtual void Finish(bool canceled)
		{
			if (!canceled)
			{
				Range range = Zoombar.TempRange.Clone();
				Zoombar.Range = range;
			}
			else
			{
				Zoombar.UpdateThumb();
			}
		}

		public override void OnMouseEnter(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseEnter(e);
			ChangeVisualState("MouseOver");
		}

		public override void OnMouseLeave(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseLeave(e);
			ChangeVisualState("Normal");
		}

		public override void OnMouseLeftButtonDown(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseLeftButtonDown(e);
			ChangeVisualState("Pressed");
		}

		public override void OnMouseLeftButtonUp(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (base.IsMouseOver)
			{
				ChangeVisualState("MouseOver");
			}
			else
			{
				ChangeVisualState("Normal");
			}
			base.OnMouseLeftButtonUp(e);
		}

		protected virtual void ChangeVisualState(string newState)
		{
		}
	}
	internal class VerticalThumbNode : ThumbNode
	{
		private ShapeElement _scaleTopElement;

		private ShapeElement _scaleBottomElement;

		private ShapeElement _thumbBackground;

		internal bool _isTop;

		public ShapeElement ScaleTopElement
		{
			get
			{
				return _scaleTopElement;
			}
			set
			{
				_scaleTopElement = value;
			}
		}

		public ShapeElement ScaleBottomElement
		{
			get
			{
				return _scaleBottomElement;
			}
			set
			{
				_scaleBottomElement = value;
			}
		}

		public ShapeElement ThumbBackground
		{
			get
			{
				return _thumbBackground;
			}
			set
			{
				_thumbBackground = value;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsTop
		{
			get
			{
				return _isTop;
			}
			set
			{
				_isTop = value;
			}
		}

		public override void ArrangeChildren(Rect oldBounds, Rect newBounds)
		{
			double y = newBounds.Y + base.Zoombar.TopScaleHeight / 2.0;
			double num = newBounds.Height - base.Zoombar.TopScaleHeight / 2.0 - base.Zoombar.BottomScaleHeight / 2.0;
			if (num < 0.0)
			{
				num = 0.0;
			}
			ThumbBackground.Bounds = new Rect(newBounds.X, y, newBounds.Width, num);
			double y2 = newBounds.Bottom - base.Zoombar.BottomScaleHeight;
			ScaleTopElement.Bounds = new Rect(newBounds.X, newBounds.Y, newBounds.Width, base.Zoombar.TopScaleHeight);
			ScaleBottomElement.Bounds = new Rect(newBounds.X, y2, newBounds.Width, base.Zoombar.BottomScaleHeight);
		}

		public override ShapeElement HitResizeThumb(Point point)
		{
			if (_scaleTopElement.HitTest(point))
			{
				IsTop = true;
				return _scaleTopElement;
			}
			if (_scaleBottomElement.HitTest(point))
			{
				IsTop = false;
				return _scaleBottomElement;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override void DoMove(Point pt)
		{
			double num = pt.Y;
			double num2 = base.Bounds.Top + num;
			double num3 = base.Bounds.Bottom + num;
			double num4 = base.Zoombar.ActualHeight - base.Zoombar.BottomOffset;
			double topOffset = base.Zoombar.TopOffset;
			if (num2 < topOffset)
			{
				num += topOffset - num2;
			}
			if (num3 > num4)
			{
				num -= num3 - num4;
			}
			num2 = base.Bounds.Top + num;
			num3 = base.Bounds.Bottom + num;
			double minimum = base.Zoombar.CalculateValue(new Point(0.0, num2));
			double maximum = base.Zoombar.CalculateValue(new Point(0.0, num3));
			base.Zoombar.TempRange.Minimum = minimum;
			base.Zoombar.TempRange.Maximum = maximum;
			base.Zoombar.UpdateTempThumb();
			base.Zoombar.RaiseZoomChangingEvent();
		}

		public override void DoResize(Point offset)
		{
			double topOffset = base.Zoombar.TopOffset;
			double num = base.Bounds.Top;
			double num2 = base.Bounds.Bottom;
			double num3 = base.Zoombar.TopScaleHeight + base.Zoombar.BottomScaleHeight;
			if (IsTop)
			{
				num += offset.Y;
				if (num < topOffset)
				{
					num = topOffset;
				}
				double num4 = num2 - num3;
				if (num > num4)
				{
					num = num4;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				num2 += offset.Y;
				double num5 = base.Zoombar.ActualHeight - base.Zoombar.BottomOffset;
				if (num2 > num5)
				{
					num2 = num5;
				}
				double num6 = num + num3;
				if (num2 < num6)
				{
					num2 = num6;
				}
			}
			double minimum = base.Zoombar.CalculateValue(new Point(0.0, num));
			double maximum = base.Zoombar.CalculateValue(new Point(0.0, num2));
			base.Zoombar.TempRange.Minimum = minimum;
			base.Zoombar.TempRange.Maximum = maximum;
			base.Zoombar.UpdateTempThumb();
			base.Zoombar.RaiseZoomChangingEvent();
		}

		protected override void ChangeVisualState(string newState)
		{
			foreach (FrameworkElement frameworkElement in ScaleTopElement.FrameworkElements)
			{
				if (frameworkElement is Control control)
				{
					VisualStateManager.GoToState(control, newState, useTransitions: true);
				}
			}
			foreach (FrameworkElement frameworkElement2 in ScaleBottomElement.FrameworkElements)
			{
				if (frameworkElement2 is Control control2)
				{
					VisualStateManager.GoToState(control2, newState, useTransitions: true);
				}
			}
			foreach (FrameworkElement frameworkElement3 in ThumbBackground.FrameworkElements)
			{
				if (frameworkElement3 is Control control3)
				{
					VisualStateManager.GoToState(control3, newState, useTransitions: true);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class DraggingTool : Tool, ICancelableTool
	{
		private Point _prevPoint;

		private ThumbNode _thumbNode;

		private bool _isCanceled;

		bool ICancelableTool.IsCanceled
		{
			get
			{
				return IsCanceled;
			}
			set
			{
				IsCanceled = value;
			}
		}

		private Point PrevPoint
		{
			get
			{
				return _prevPoint;
			}
			set
			{
				_prevPoint = value;
			}
		}

		private ThumbNode ThumbNode
		{
			get
			{
				return _thumbNode;
			}
			set
			{
				_thumbNode = value;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsCanceled
		{
			get
			{
				return _isCanceled;
			}
			set
			{
				_isCanceled = value;
			}
		}

		public DraggingTool(InteractiveControl view)
			: base(view)
		{
		}

		public override bool CanStart(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			Point docMousePosition = base.LastInput.DocMousePosition;
			InteractiveElement interactiveElement = base.View.HitTest(docMousePosition);
			if (interactiveElement != null && interactiveElement is ThumbNode thumbNode)
			{
				ThumbNode = thumbNode;
				PrevPoint = docMousePosition;
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override void Start()
		{
			base.Start();
			ThumbNode.Start();
			IsCanceled = false;
		}

		public override void MouseMove()
		{
			Point docMousePosition = base.LastInput.DocMousePosition;
			double x = docMousePosition.X - PrevPoint.X;
			double y = docMousePosition.Y - PrevPoint.Y;
			Point offset = new Point(x, y);
			ThumbNode.DoMove(offset);
			PrevPoint = docMousePosition;
		}

		public override void KeyDown()
		{
			base.KeyDown();
			if (base.LastInput.Key == Key.Escape)
			{
				IsCanceled = true;
				StopTool();
			}
		}

		public override void MouseLeftButtonUp(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			StopTool();
		}

		public override void Stop()
		{
			ThumbNode.Finish(IsCanceled);
			base.Stop();
		}
	}
	internal interface ICancelableTool
	{
		bool IsCanceled { get; set; }

		void StopTool();
	}

			Point docMousePosition = base.LastInput.DocMousePosition;

				ThumbNode = thumbNode;
				PrevPoint = docMousePosition;
				return true;
			}
			return false;

		public override void Start()
		{
			base.Start();
			ThumbNode.Start();
			IsCanceled = false;
		}

		public override void MouseMove()

			Point docMousePosition = base.LastInput.DocMousePosition;
			double x = docMousePosition.X - PrevPoint.X;
			double y = docMousePosition.Y - PrevPoint.Y;
			Point offset = new Point(x, y);
			PrevPoint = docMousePosition;
			ThumbNode.DoResize(offset);
		}

		public void MouseMove(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			Point docMousePosition = base.LastInput.DocMousePosition;
			double x = docMousePosition.X - PrevPoint.X;
			double y = docMousePosition.Y - PrevPoint.Y;
			Point offset = new Point(x, y);
			PrevPoint = docMousePosition;
			ThumbNode.DoResize(offset);
		}

		{
			base.KeyDown();
			if (base.LastInput.Key == Key.Escape)
			{
				IsCanceled = true;
				StopTool();
			}
		}

		public override void MouseLeftButtonUp(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			StopTool();
		}

		public override void Stop()
		{
			ThumbNode.Finish(IsCanceled);
			base.Stop();
		}

	public class TrackbarTool : Tool
	{
		private XamZoombar zoombar;

		public TrackbarTool(InteractiveControl view)
			: base(view)
		{
			zoombar = view as XamZoombar;
		}

		public override bool CanStart(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			if (base.View.HitTest(base.View.LastInput.DocMousePosition) is TrackShape)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override void Start()
		{
			base.Start();
			double newValue = zoombar.CalculateValue(base.LastInput.DocMousePosition);
			zoombar.MoveTo(newValue, isSmallChange: false);
		}

		public override void MouseLeftButtonUp(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			base.MouseLeftButtonUp(e);
			StopTool();
		}

		public override void Stop()
		{
			zoombar.StopMove();
			base.Stop();
		}
	}
