		static XamZoombar()
		{
			VisibilityProxyProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("VisibilityProxy", typeof(Visibility), typeof(XamZoombar), new PropertyMetadata(Visibility.Visible, delegate(DependencyObject sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((XamZoombar)sender).OnVisibilityChanged((Visibility)e.OldValue, (Visibility)e.NewValue);
			}));
			HorizontalPreviewContentProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("HorizontalPreviewContent", typeof(object), typeof(XamZoombar), new PropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				if (e.OldValue != null)
				{
					((XamZoombar)sender).RemoveLogicalChild(e.OldValue);
				}
				if (e.NewValue != null)
				{
					((XamZoombar)sender).AddLogicalChild(e.NewValue);
				}
			}));
			VerticalPreviewContentProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("VerticalPreviewContent", typeof(object), typeof(XamZoombar), new PropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				if (e.OldValue != null)
				{
					((XamZoombar)sender).RemoveLogicalChild(e.OldValue);
				}
				if (e.NewValue != null)
				{
					((XamZoombar)sender).AddLogicalChild(e.NewValue);
				}
			}));
			HorizontalScaleLeftStyleProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("HorizontalScaleLeftStyle", typeof(Style), typeof(XamZoombar), null);
			HorizontalScaleRightStyleProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("HorizontalScaleRightStyle", typeof(Style), typeof(XamZoombar), null);
			HorizontalThumbStyleProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("HorizontalThumbStyle", typeof(Style), typeof(XamZoombar), null);
			HorizontalScrollLeftStyleProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("HorizontalScrollLeftStyle", typeof(Style), typeof(XamZoombar), new PropertyMetadata(null));
			HorizontalScrollRightStyleProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("HorizontalScrollRightStyle", typeof(Style), typeof(XamZoombar), new PropertyMetadata(null));
			VerticalScaleTopStyleProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("VerticalScaleTopStyle", typeof(Style), typeof(XamZoombar), null);
			VerticalScaleBottomStyleProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("VerticalScaleBottomStyle", typeof(Style), typeof(XamZoombar), null);
			VerticalThumbStyleProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("VerticalThumbStyle", typeof(Style), typeof(XamZoombar), null);
			VerticalScrollTopStyleProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("VerticalScrollTopStyle", typeof(Style), typeof(XamZoombar), new PropertyMetadata(null));
			VerticalScrollBottomStyleProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("VerticalScrollBottomStyle", typeof(Style), typeof(XamZoombar), new PropertyMetadata(null));
			MinimumProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Minimum", typeof(double), typeof(XamZoombar), new PropertyMetadata(0.0, OnMinimumChanged));
			MaximumProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Maximum", typeof(double), typeof(XamZoombar), new PropertyMetadata(1.0, OnMaximumChanged));
			RangeProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Range", typeof(Range), typeof(XamZoombar), new PropertyMetadata(OnRangeChanged));
			SmallChangeProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("SmallChange", typeof(double), typeof(XamZoombar), new PropertyMetadata(0.1, OnSmallChangeChanged));
			LargeChangeProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("LargeChange", typeof(double), typeof(XamZoombar), new PropertyMetadata(0.2, OnLargeChangeChanged));
			OrientationProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Orientation", typeof(Orientation), typeof(XamZoombar), new PropertyMetadata(Orientation.Horizontal, OnOrientationChanged));
			NewStyleProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("NewStyle", typeof(Style), typeof(XamZoombar), new PropertyMetadata(null, OnNewStyleChanged));
			ThemeManager.RegisterControl(typeof(XamZoombar));
		}

		public XamZoombar()
		{
			base.DefaultStyleKey = typeof(XamZoombar);
			SetBinding(NewStyleProperty, new Binding("Style")
			{
				Source = this
			});
			horizontalThumbNode = new HorizontalThumbNode();
			base.VisualElements.Add(horizontalThumbNode);
			verticalThumbNode = new VerticalThumbNode();
			base.VisualElements.Add(verticalThumbNode);
			Timer = new DispatcherTimer();
			Timer.Tick += timer_Tick;
			Timer.Interval = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(250.0);
			ActualMinimum = 0.0;
			ActualMaximum = 1.0;
			base.MouseDownTools.Add(new TrackbarTool(this));
			base.MouseDownTools.Add(new ResizingTool(this));
			base.MouseDownTools.Add(new DraggingTool(this));
			horizontalVisualElements = new List<VisualElement>();
			verticalVisualElements = new List<VisualElement>();
			Initialize = true;
			Range = new Range();
			TempRange = new Range();
			TempRange.Zoombar = this;
			TempRange.Initialize = true;
			base.SizeChanged += XamZoombar_SizeChanged;
			base.LayoutUpdated += XamZoombar_LayoutUpdated;
			Utilities.ValidateLicense(typeof(XamZoombar), this);
			SetBinding(VisibilityProxyProperty, new Binding("Visibility")
			{
				Source = this
			});
		}

		private void OnVisibilityChanged(Visibility oldValue, Visibility newValue)
		{
			UpdateThumb();
		}

		private IEnumerator LogicalChildrenInternal()
		{
			if (_logicalChildrenInternal == null)
			{
				_logicalChildrenInternal = new List<FrameworkElement>
				{
					VerticalPreviewContent as FrameworkElement,
					HorizontalPreviewContent as FrameworkElement
				};
			}
			return _logicalChildrenInternal.GetEnumerator();
		}

		private static void OnMinimumChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			(d as XamZoombar).OnMinimumChanged((double)e.OldValue, (double)e.NewValue);
		}

		protected virtual void OnMinimumChanged(double oldValue, double newValue)
		{
			ActualMinimum = newValue;
			if (ActualMaximum < ActualMinimum)
			{
				ActualMaximum = ActualMinimum;
			}
			else
			{
				UpdateThumb();
			}
		}

		private static void OnMaximumChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			(d as XamZoombar).OnMaximumChanged((double)e.OldValue, (double)e.NewValue);
		}

		protected virtual void OnMaximumChanged(double oldValue, double newValue)
		{
			ActualMaximum = newValue;
			if (ActualMinimum > ActualMaximum)
			{
				ActualMinimum = ActualMaximum;
			}
			else
			{
				UpdateThumb();
			}
		}

		private static void OnRangeChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			(d as XamZoombar).OnRangeChanged((Range)e.OldValue, (Range)e.NewValue);
		}

		internal void ChangeRange(Range oldRange, Range newRange)
		{
			OnRangeChanged(oldRange, newRange);
		}

		protected virtual void OnRangeChanged(Range oldRange, Range newRange)
		{
			if (newRange == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			newRange.Zoombar = this;
			UpdateThumb();
			if (ZoomCanceled)
			{
				ZoomCanceled = false;
				return;
			}
			if (!Initialize)
			{
				ZoomChangeEventArgs e = new ZoomChangeEventArgs(newRange);
				OnZoomChanging(e);
				if (e.Cancel)
				{
					ZoomCanceled = true;
					Range = oldRange;
					return;
				}
			}
			ZoomChangedEventArgs e2 = new ZoomChangedEventArgs(newRange);
			OnZoomChanged(e2);
			ZoomCanceled = false;
		}

		private static void OnSmallChangeChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((XamZoombar)d).OnSmallChangeChanged((double)e.OldValue, (double)e.NewValue);
		}

		protected virtual void OnSmallChangeChanged(double oldValue, double newValue)
		{
			if (!IsValidChange(newValue))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Zoombar_InvalidChangeValue", SmallChangeProperty.ToString());
			}
		}

		private static void OnLargeChangeChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((XamZoombar)d).OnLargeChangeChanged((double)e.OldValue, (double)e.NewValue);
		}

		protected virtual void OnLargeChangeChanged(double oldValue, double newValue)
		{
			if (!IsValidChange(newValue))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Zoombar_InvalidChangeValue", LargeChangeProperty.ToString());
			}
		}

		private static void OnOrientationChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((XamZoombar)d).OnOrientationChanged((Orientation)e.OldValue, (Orientation)e.NewValue);
		}

		protected virtual void OnOrientationChanged(Orientation oldValue, Orientation newValue)
		{
			if (!Initialize && verticalRootCanvas != null && horizontalRootCanvas != null)
			{
				if (Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal)
				{
					verticalRootCanvas.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
					SetClipMode(verticalRootCanvas, clip: true);
					SetClipMode(horizontalRootCanvas, clip: false);
					horizontalRootCanvas.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
					SetHorizontalVisualElements();
				}
				else
				{
					horizontalRootCanvas.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
					SetClipMode(horizontalRootCanvas, clip: true);
					SetClipMode(verticalRootCanvas, clip: false);
					verticalRootCanvas.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
					SetVerticalVisualElements();
				}
				UpdateThumb();
			}
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			if (horizontalThumbNode != null)
			{
				horizontalThumbNode.ClearChildren();
			}
			if (verticalThumbNode != null)
			{
				verticalThumbNode.ClearChildren();
			}
			InitHorionatalTemplate();
			InitVerticalTemplate();
			if (Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal)
			{
				SetClipMode(verticalRootCanvas, clip: true);
				SetHorizontalVisualElements();
			}
			else
			{
				SetClipMode(horizontalRootCanvas, clip: true);
				SetVerticalVisualElements();
			}
		}

		private void SetClipMode(FrameworkElement ele, bool clip)
		{
			if (ele != null)
			{
				ele.ClipToBounds = clip;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeftButtonDown(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseLeftButtonDown(e);
			if (!e.Handled)
			{
				e.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeftButtonUp(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseLeftButtonUp(e);
			if (!e.Handled)
			{
				e.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnKeyDown(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnKeyDown(e);
			if (Orientation == Orientation.Vertical)
			{
				switch (e.Key)
				{
				case Key.Up:
					MoveTo(ActualMinimum, isSmallChange: true);
					break;
				case Key.Down:
					MoveTo(ActualMaximum, isSmallChange: true);
					break;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				switch (e.Key)
				{
				case Key.Left:
					MoveTo(ActualMinimum, isSmallChange: true);
					break;
				case Key.Right:
					MoveTo(ActualMaximum, isSmallChange: true);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnKeyUp(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnKeyUp(e);
			switch (e.Key)
			{
			case Key.Left:
			case Key.Up:
			case Key.Right:
			case Key.Down:
				StopMove();
				break;
			}
		}

		protected override Size MeasureOverride(Size availableSize)
		{
			Size size = base.MeasureOverride(availableSize);
			if (double.IsInfinity(availableSize.Width))
			{
				availableSize.Width = size.Width;
			}
			if (double.IsInfinity(availableSize.Height))
			{
				availableSize.Height = size.Height;
			}
			return availableSize;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (Range != null)
			{
				return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0} Minimum:{1} Maximum:{2} Range.Minimum:{3} Range.Maximum:{4}", base.ToString(), ActualMinimum, ActualMaximum, Range.Minimum, Range.Maximum);
			}
			return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0} Minimum:{1} Maximum:{2} Range.Minimum:{3} Range.Maximum:{4}", base.ToString(), ActualMinimum, ActualMaximum, ActualMinimum, ActualMaximum);
		}

		protected override AutomationPeer OnCreateAutomationPeer()
		{
			return new XamZoombarAutomationPeer(this);
		}

		protected virtual void OnZoomChanged(ZoomChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (this.ZoomChanged != null)
			{
				this.ZoomChanged(this, e);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnZoomChanging(ZoomChangeEventArgs e)
		{
			if (this.ZoomChanging != null)
			{
				this.ZoomChanging(this, e);
			}
		}

		private static void OnNewStyleChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((XamZoombar)d).OnNewStyleChanged((Style)e.OldValue, (Style)e.NewValue);
		}

		private void OnNewStyleChanged(Style oldValue, Style newValue)
		{
			if (horizontalPreviewPanel != null && horizontalPreviewPanel.Children.Count > 0 && horizontalPreviewPanel.Children[0] is ContentPresenter { Content: not null } contentPresenter)
			{
				contentPresenter.Content = null;
			}
			if (verticalPreviewPanel != null && verticalPreviewPanel.Children.Count > 0 && verticalPreviewPanel.Children[0] is ContentPresenter { Content: not null } contentPresenter2)
			{
				contentPresenter2.Content = null;
			}
		}

		internal double CalculateMinScale()
		{
			if (Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal)
			{
				if (ScrollAreaWidth <= 0.0)
				{
					return 1.0;
				}
				return (LeftScaleWidth + RightScaleWidth) / ScrollAreaWidth;
			}
			if (ScrollAreaHeight <= 0.0)
			{
				return 1.0;
			}
			return (TopScaleHeight + BottomScaleHeight) / ScrollAreaHeight;
		}

		internal double CalculateValue(Point pt)
		{
			double num3;
			if (Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal)
			{
				double num = pt.X - LeftOffset;
				double num2 = ScrollAreaWidth;
				num3 = ((!(num2 <= 0.0)) ? (num / num2) : ((num != 0.0) ? 1.0 : 0.0));
			}
			else
			{
				double num4 = pt.Y - TopOffset;
				double num5 = ScrollAreaHeight;
				num3 = ((!(num5 <= 0.0)) ? (num4 / num5) : ((num4 != 0.0) ? 1.0 : 0.0));
			}
			double num6 = ActualMaximum - ActualMinimum;
			return ActualMinimum + num6 * num3;
		}

		internal void RaiseZoomChangingEvent()
		{
			ZoomChangeEventArgs e = new ZoomChangeEventArgs(TempRange);
			OnZoomChanging(e);
			if (e.Cancel && base.CurrentTool is ICancelableTool cancelableTool)
			{
				cancelableTool.IsCanceled = true;
				cancelableTool.StopTool();
			}
		}

		private void SizeUpdated()
		{
			Initialize = false;
			if (base.ActualWidth != 0.0 && base.ActualHeight != 0.0)
			{
				UpdateElementPositions();
			}
		}

		private static bool IsValidChange(double value)
		{
			if (IsValidDoubleValue(value))
			{
				return value >= 0.0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool IsValidDoubleValue(double value)
		{
			if (!double.IsNaN(value))
			{
				return !double.IsInfinity(value);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void InitHorionatalTemplate()
		{
			if (horizontalRootCanvas != null)
			{
				horizontalRootCanvas.SizeChanged -= HorizontalRootCanvas_SizeChanged;
				horizontalRootCanvas.Children.Clear();
			}
			horizontalRootCanvas = GetTemplateChild("HorizontalRootCanvasElement") as Canvas;
			if (horizontalRootCanvas != null)
			{
				horizontalRootCanvas.SizeChanged += HorizontalRootCanvas_SizeChanged;
			}
			if (horizontalPreviewPanel != null)
			{
				horizontalPreviewPanel.Children.Clear();
			}
			horizontalPreviewPanel = GetTemplateChild("HorizontalPreviewElement") as Panel;
			horizontalScrollbarElement = GetTemplateChild("HorizontalScrollbarElement") as Grid;
			if (GetTemplateChild("HorizontalTrackElement") is FrameworkElement frameworkElement)
			{
				horizontalTrackShape = new TrackShape(frameworkElement);
				horizontalVisualElements.Add(horizontalTrackShape);
			}
			horizontalScrollLeftElement = GetTemplateChild("HorizontalScrollLeftElement") as FrameworkElement;
			if (horizontalScrollLeftElement != null)
			{
				horizontalScrollLeftShape = new ScrollShape(horizontalScrollLeftElement);
				horizontalVisualElements.Add(horizontalScrollLeftShape);
			}
			horizontalScrollRightElement = GetTemplateChild("HorizontalScrollRightElement") as FrameworkElement;
			if (horizontalScrollRightElement != null)
			{
				horizontalScrollRightShape = new ScrollShape(horizontalScrollRightElement);
				horizontalVisualElements.Add(horizontalScrollRightShape);
			}
			if (GetTemplateChild("HorizontalThumbElement") is FrameworkElement item)
			{
				horizontalThumbShape = new ShapeElement();
				horizontalThumbShape.FrameworkElements.Add(item);
			}
			if (GetTemplateChild("HorizontalScaleLeftElement") is FrameworkElement item2)
			{
				horizontalScaleLeftShape = new ShapeElement();
				horizontalScaleLeftShape.FrameworkElements.Add(item2);
			}
			if (GetTemplateChild("HorizontalScaleRightElement") is FrameworkElement item3)
			{
				horizontalScaleRightShape = new ShapeElement();
				horizontalScaleRightShape.FrameworkElements.Add(item3);
			}
			horizontalThumbNode = CreateHorizontalThumbNode();
			horizontalVisualElements.Add(horizontalThumbNode);
		}

		private void InitVerticalTemplate()
		{
			if (verticalRootCanvas != null)
			{
				verticalRootCanvas.SizeChanged -= VerticalRootCanvas_SizeChanged;
				verticalRootCanvas.Children.Clear();
			}
			verticalRootCanvas = GetTemplateChild("VerticalRootCanvasElement") as Canvas;
			if (verticalRootCanvas != null)
			{
				verticalRootCanvas.SizeChanged += VerticalRootCanvas_SizeChanged;
			}
			if (verticalPreviewPanel != null)
			{
				verticalPreviewPanel.Children.Clear();
			}
			verticalPreviewPanel = GetTemplateChild("VerticalPreviewElement") as Panel;
			verticalScrollbarElement = GetTemplateChild("VerticalScrollbarElement") as Grid;
			if (GetTemplateChild("VerticalTrackElement") is FrameworkElement frameworkElement)
			{
				verticalTrackShape = new TrackShape(frameworkElement);
				verticalVisualElements.Add(verticalTrackShape);
			}
			verticalScrollTopElement = GetTemplateChild("VerticalScrollTopElement") as FrameworkElement;
			if (verticalScrollTopElement != null)
			{
				verticalScrollTopShape = new ScrollShape(verticalScrollTopElement);
				verticalVisualElements.Add(verticalScrollTopShape);
			}
			verticalScrollBottomElement = GetTemplateChild("VerticalScrollBottomElement") as FrameworkElement;
			if (verticalScrollBottomElement != null)
			{
				verticalScrollBottomShape = new ScrollShape(verticalScrollBottomElement);
				verticalVisualElements.Add(verticalScrollBottomShape);
			}
			if (GetTemplateChild("VerticalThumbElement") is FrameworkElement item)
			{
				verticalThumbShape = new ShapeElement();
				verticalThumbShape.FrameworkElements.Add(item);
			}
			if (GetTemplateChild("VerticalScaleTopElement") is FrameworkElement item2)
			{
				verticalScaleTopShape = new ShapeElement();
				verticalScaleTopShape.FrameworkElements.Add(item2);
			}
			if (GetTemplateChild("VerticalScaleBottomElement") is FrameworkElement item3)
			{
				verticalScaleBottomShape = new ShapeElement();
				verticalScaleBottomShape.FrameworkElements.Add(item3);
			}
			verticalThumbNode = CreateVerticalThumbNode();
			verticalVisualElements.Add(verticalThumbNode);
		}

		private void RemoveVisualElements()
		{
			if (!Initialize && Canvas != null)
			{
				for (int num = base.VisualElements.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					base.VisualElements.RemoveAt(num);
				}
			}
		}

		private void SetHorizontalVisualElements()
		{
			RemoveVisualElements();
			Canvas = horizontalRootCanvas;
			foreach (VisualElement horizontalVisualElement in horizontalVisualElements)
			{
				base.VisualElements.Add(horizontalVisualElement);
			}
		}

		private void SetVerticalVisualElements()
		{
			RemoveVisualElements();
			Canvas = verticalRootCanvas;
			foreach (VisualElement verticalVisualElement in verticalVisualElements)
			{
				base.VisualElements.Add(verticalVisualElement);
			}
		}

		private void HorizontalRootCanvas_SizeChanged(object sender, SizeChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (base.ActualWidth > 0.0 && base.ActualHeight > 0.0)
			{
				horizontalScrollbarElement.Width = base.ActualWidth;
				horizontalScrollbarElement.Height = base.ActualHeight;
			}
			UpdateElementPositions();
		}

		private void VerticalRootCanvas_SizeChanged(object sender, SizeChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (base.ActualWidth > 0.0 && base.ActualHeight > 0.0)
			{
				verticalScrollbarElement.Width = base.ActualWidth;
				verticalScrollbarElement.Height = base.ActualHeight;
			}
			UpdateElementPositions();
		}

		private void XamZoombar_SizeChanged(object sender, SizeChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			IsSizeChanged = true;
		}

		private void XamZoombar_LayoutUpdated(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (IsSizeChanged)
			{
				SizeUpdated();
				IsSizeChanged = false;
			}
		}

		private void HorizontalPreviewPanel_Unloaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (horizontalPreviewPanel != null && horizontalPreviewPanel.Children.Count > 0 && horizontalPreviewPanel.Children[0] is ContentPresenter { Content: not null } contentPresenter)
			{
				contentPresenter.Content = null;
			}
		}

		private void VerticalPreviewPanel_Unloaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (verticalPreviewPanel != null && verticalPreviewPanel.Children.Count > 0 && verticalPreviewPanel.Children[0] is ContentPresenter { Content: not null } contentPresenter)
			{
				contentPresenter.Content = null;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateElementPositions()
		{
			if (base.ActualWidth == 0.0 || base.ActualHeight == 0.0)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal)
			{
				UpdateVerticalLayout();
				if (verticalRootCanvas != null)
				{
					verticalRootCanvas.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
					horizontalRootCanvas.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
					horizontalRootCanvas.UpdateLayout();
				}
				UpdateHorizontalLayout();
			}
			else
			{
				UpdateHorizontalLayout();
				if (horizontalRootCanvas != null)
				{
					horizontalRootCanvas.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
					verticalRootCanvas.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
					verticalRootCanvas.UpdateLayout();
				}
				UpdateVerticalLayout();
			}
			UpdateThumb();
		}

		private void UpdateHorizontalLayout()
		{
			if (horizontalRootCanvas != null)
			{
				LeftScrollWidth = horizontalScrollLeftShape.FrameworkElement.ActualWidth;
				RightScrollWidth = horizontalScrollRightShape.FrameworkElement.ActualWidth;
				Size size = new Size(base.ActualWidth, base.ActualHeight);
				double num = Math.Max(size.Width, LeftOffset + RightOffset);
				LeftScaleWidth = horizontalScaleLeftShape.Width;
				RightScaleWidth = horizontalScaleRightShape.Width;
				double leftOffset = LeftOffset;
				double rightOffset = RightOffset;
				ScrollAreaWidth = num - leftOffset - rightOffset;
				double x = num / 2.0 - horizontalThumbShape.Width / 2.0;
				double width = horizontalThumbShape.Width;
				horizontalThumbNode.Bounds = new Rect(x, 0.0, width, size.Height);
				horizontalScrollLeftShape.MoveLeft = true;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateVerticalLayout()
		{
			if (verticalRootCanvas != null)
			{
				TopScrollHeight = verticalScrollTopShape.FrameworkElement.ActualHeight;
				BottomScrollHeight = verticalScrollBottomShape.FrameworkElement.ActualHeight;
				Size size = new Size(base.ActualWidth, base.ActualHeight);
				double num = Math.Max(size.Height, TopOffset + BottomOffset);
				TopScaleHeight = verticalScaleTopShape.Height;
				BottomScaleHeight = verticalScaleBottomShape.Height;
				double topOffset = TopOffset;
				double bottomOffset = BottomOffset;
				ScrollAreaHeight = num - topOffset - bottomOffset;
				double y = num / 2.0 - verticalThumbShape.Height / 2.0;
				double height = verticalThumbShape.Height;
				verticalThumbNode.Bounds = new Rect(0.0, y, size.Width, height);
				verticalScrollTopShape.MoveLeft = true;
			}
		}

		private HorizontalThumbNode CreateHorizontalThumbNode()
		{
			if (horizontalThumbShape != null)
			{
				horizontalThumbNode.Children.Add(horizontalThumbShape);
				horizontalThumbNode.ThumbBackground = horizontalThumbShape;
			}
			if (horizontalScaleLeftShape != null)
			{
				horizontalThumbNode.Children.Add(horizontalScaleLeftShape);
				horizontalThumbNode.ScaleLeftElement = horizontalScaleLeftShape;
			}
			if (horizontalScaleRightShape != null)
			{
				horizontalThumbNode.Children.Add(horizontalScaleRightShape);
				horizontalThumbNode.ScaleRightElement = horizontalScaleRightShape;
			}
			return horizontalThumbNode;
		}

		private VerticalThumbNode CreateVerticalThumbNode()
		{
			if (verticalThumbShape != null)
			{
				verticalThumbNode.Children.Add(verticalThumbShape);
				verticalThumbNode.ThumbBackground = verticalThumbShape;
			}
			if (verticalScaleTopShape != null)
			{
				verticalThumbNode.Children.Add(verticalScaleTopShape);
				verticalThumbNode.ScaleTopElement = verticalScaleTopShape;
			}
			if (verticalScaleBottomShape != null)
			{
				verticalThumbNode.Children.Add(verticalScaleBottomShape);
				verticalThumbNode.ScaleBottomElement = verticalScaleBottomShape;
			}
			return verticalThumbNode;
		}

		internal void UpdateThumb()
		{
			if (!Initialize && Range != null)
			{
				UpdateThumb(Range);
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateTempThumb()
		{
			UpdateThumb(TempRange);
		}

		private void UpdateThumb(Range range)
		{
			if (!Initialize)
			{
				if (Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal)
				{
					Rect bounds = horizontalThumbNode.Bounds;
					bounds.Width = Math.Max(0.0, ScrollAreaWidth * range.Scale);
					double num = ScrollAreaWidth - bounds.Width;
					bounds.X = LeftOffset + num * range.Scroll;
					bounds = CalculatePossibleBounds(bounds);
					horizontalThumbNode.Bounds = bounds;
				}
				else
				{
					Rect bounds2 = verticalThumbNode.Bounds;
					bounds2.Height = Math.Max(0.0, ScrollAreaHeight * range.Scale);
					double num2 = ScrollAreaHeight - bounds2.Height;
					bounds2.Y = TopOffset + num2 * range.Scroll;
					bounds2 = CalculatePossibleBounds(bounds2);
					verticalThumbNode.Bounds = bounds2;
				}
			}
		}

		private Rect CalculatePossibleBounds(Rect bounds)
		{
			if (Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal)
			{
				double leftOffset = LeftOffset;
				double num = base.ActualWidth - RightOffset;
				double num2 = Math.Max(0.0, num - leftOffset);
				if (bounds.Width > num2)
				{
					bounds.Width = num2;
				}
				double num3 = LeftScaleWidth + RightScaleWidth;
				if (bounds.Width < num3)
				{
					bounds.X -= (num3 - bounds.Width) / 2.0;
					bounds.Width = num3;
				}
				if (bounds.Right > num)
				{
					bounds.X = num - bounds.Width;
				}
				if (bounds.X < leftOffset)
				{
					bounds.X = leftOffset;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				double topOffset = TopOffset;
				double num4 = base.ActualHeight - BottomOffset;
				double num5 = Math.Max(0.0, num4 - topOffset);
				if (bounds.Height > num5)
				{
					bounds.Height = num5;
				}
				double num6 = TopScaleHeight + BottomScaleHeight;
				if (bounds.Height < num6)
				{
					bounds.Y -= (num6 - bounds.Height) / 2.0;
					bounds.Height = num6;
				}
				if (bounds.Bottom > num4)
				{
					bounds.Y = num4 - bounds.Height;
				}
				if (bounds.Y < topOffset)
				{
					bounds.Y = topOffset;
				}
			}
			return bounds;
		}

		internal void MoveTo(double newValue, bool isSmallChange)
		{
			IsMoved = false;
			NewValue = newValue;
			IsSmallChange = isSmallChange;
			Timer.Start();
		}

		internal void StopMove()
		{
			Timer.Stop();
			if (!IsMoved)
			{
				DoMove();
			}
		}

		private void timer_Tick(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			DoMove();
		}

		private void DoMove()
		{
			IsMoved = true;
			double num = (Range.Minimum + Range.Maximum) / 2.0;
			double num2 = (IsSmallChange ? SmallChange : LargeChange);
			if (num == NewValue)
			{
				StopMove();
				return;
			}
			Range range = new Range();
			range.Initialize = true;
			range.Minimum = Range.Minimum - num2;
			range.Maximum = Range.Maximum - num2;
			range.Initialize = false;
			if (NewValue < num)
			{
				if (range.Minimum < ActualMinimum)
				{
					double num3 = ActualMinimum - range.Minimum;
					range.Initialize = true;
					range.Minimum = ActualMinimum;
					range.Maximum += num3;
					range.Initialize = false;
					Range = range;
					StopMove();
				}
				else if (NewValue > num - num2)
				{
					Range = range;
					StopMove();
				}
				else
				{
					Range = range;
				}
				return;
			}
			range.Initialize = true;
			range.Minimum = Range.Minimum + num2;
			range.Maximum = Range.Maximum + num2;
			range.Initialize = false;
			if (NewValue > num)
			{
				if (range.Maximum > ActualMaximum)
				{
					double num4 = range.Maximum - ActualMaximum;
					range.Initialize = true;
					range.Minimum -= num4;
					range.Maximum = ActualMaximum;
					range.Initialize = false;
					Range = range;
					StopMove();
				}
				else if (NewValue < num + num2)
				{
					Range = range;
					StopMove();
				}
				else
				{
					Range = range;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void RegisterResources(string name, Assembly assembly)
		{
			SR.AddResource(name, assembly);
		}

		public static void UnregisterResources(string name)
		{
			SR.RemoveResource(name);
		}
	}

		public double ZoomLevel
		{
			get
			{
				if (!double.IsNaN(_initialZoomLevel))
				{
					return _initialZoomLevel;
				}
				if (WindowRect.IsEmpty || ViewportRect.IsEmpty)
				{
					return 1.0;
				}
				double num = Math.Min(ViewportRect.Width / WindowRect.Width, ViewportRect.Height / WindowRect.Height);
				if (double.IsNaN(num) || double.IsInfinity(num))
				{
					num = 1.0;
				}
				return num;
			}
			set
			{
				if (ViewportRect.IsEmpty || WorldRect.IsEmpty)
				{
					_initialZoomLevel = value;
					return;
				}
				_initialZoomLevel = double.NaN;
				double zoomLevel = ZoomLevel;
				double num = ClampZoomLevel(value);
				double num2 = zoomLevel / num;
				Point point = ViewportToWorld(new Point(ViewportRect.Width / 2.0, ViewportRect.Height / 2.0));
				double num3 = num2 * (WindowRect.Left - point.X) + point.X;
				double num4 = num2 * (WindowRect.Bottom - point.Y) + point.Y;
				double num5 = num2 * (WindowRect.Right - point.X) + point.X;
				double num6 = num2 * (WindowRect.Top - point.Y) + point.Y;
				WindowRect = new Rect(num3, num6, num5 - num3, num4 - num6);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnDragRectChanging(RectChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (this.DragRectChanging != null)
			{
				this.DragRectChanging(this, e);
			}
			if (WorldToViewport(e.NewRect).GetArea() > 16.0)
			{
				PreviewRect = Adjust(e.NewRect, AdjustmentPriority.Best);
			}
			else
			{
				PreviewRect = Rect.Empty;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnDragRectChanged(RectChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (this.DragRectChanged != null)
			{
				this.DragRectChanged(this, e);
			}
			PreviewRect = Rect.Empty;
			if (WorldToViewport(e.NewRect).GetArea() > 16.0)
			{
				WindowRect = Adjust(e.NewRect, AdjustmentPriority.Best);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnPropertyChanged(PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.PropertyChanged(this, e);
			}
		}

		private static void OnMinimumZoomLevelChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((SurfaceViewer)d).OnMinimumZoomLevelChanged((double)e.OldValue, (double)e.NewValue);
		}

		protected virtual void OnMinimumZoomLevelChanged(double oldValue, double newValue)
		{
			OnPropertyUpdated("MinimumZoomLevel", oldValue, newValue);
			ZoomLevel = ZoomLevel;
		}

		private static void OnMaximumZoomLevelChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((SurfaceViewer)d).OnMaximumZoomLevelChanged((double)e.OldValue, (double)e.NewValue);
		}

		protected virtual void OnMaximumZoomLevelChanged(double oldValue, double newValue)
		{
			OnPropertyUpdated("MaximumZoomLevel", oldValue, newValue);
			ZoomLevel = ZoomLevel;
		}

		private static void OnWorldRectChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((SurfaceViewer)d).OnWorldRectChanged((Rect)e.OldValue, (Rect)e.NewValue);
		}

		protected virtual void OnWorldRectChanged(Rect oldValue, Rect newValue)
		{
			OnPropertyChanged(new PropertyChangedEventArgs("WorldRect"));
			UpdateNavigators();
		}

		private static void OnWindowRectChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((SurfaceViewer)d).OnWindowRectChanged((Rect)e.OldValue, (Rect)e.NewValue);
		}

		protected virtual void OnWindowRectChanged(Rect oldValue, Rect newValue)
		{
			if (!newValue.IsEmpty)
			{
				double num = 1.0;
				if (!oldValue.IsEmpty)
				{
					num = ViewportRect.Width / oldValue.Width;
				}
				double num2 = ViewportRect.Width / newValue.Width;
				if (num != num2 || ZoomLevelDisplayText == null)
				{
					OnPropertyUpdated("ZoomLevel", num, num2);
				}
				OnPropertyChanged(new PropertyChangedEventArgs("WindowRect"));
				UpdateNavigators();
			}
		}

		private static void OnPreviewRectChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((SurfaceViewer)d).OnPreviewRectChanged((Rect)e.OldValue, (Rect)e.NewValue);
		}

		protected virtual void OnPreviewRectChanged(Rect oldValue, Rect newValue)
		{
			OnPropertyChanged(new PropertyChangedEventArgs("PreviewRect"));
			PreviewPath.Visibility = (PreviewRect.IsEmpty ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
			UpdateNavigators();
		}

		protected virtual void OnViewportRectChanged(Rect oldValue, Rect newValue)
		{
			if (!newValue.IsEmpty)
			{
				if (!WindowRect.IsEmpty)
				{
					if (oldValue.IsEmpty)
					{
						oldValue = _cachedOldViewPortRect;
					}
					if (!oldValue.IsEmpty)
					{
						Rect windowRect = WindowRect;
						windowRect.Width *= newValue.Width / oldValue.Width;
						windowRect.Height *= newValue.Height / oldValue.Height;
						WindowRect = windowRect;
					}
					if (OverviewPlusDetailPane != null)
					{
						OverviewPlusDetailPane.Window = WindowRect;
					}
				}
				((PreviewPath.Data as GeometryGroup).Children[0] as RectangleGeometry).Rect = newValue;
				(Overlay.Clip as RectangleGeometry).Rect = newValue;
			}
			else if (!oldValue.IsEmpty)
			{
				_cachedOldViewPortRect = oldValue;
			}
			UpdateNavigators();
		}

		private static void OnOverviewPlusDetailPaneStyleChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((SurfaceViewer)d).OnOverviewPlusDetailPaneStyleChanged((Style)e.OldValue, (Style)e.NewValue);
		}

		protected virtual void OnOverviewPlusDetailPaneStyleChanged(Style oldValue, Style newValue)
		{
			if (OverviewPlusDetailPane != null)
			{
				if (newValue != null)
				{
					OverviewPlusDetailPane.Style = newValue;
				}
				else
				{
					OverviewPlusDetailPane.ClearValue(FrameworkElement.StyleProperty);
				}
			}
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			if (OverviewPlusDetailPane != null)
			{
				OverviewPlusDetailPane.WindowChanging -= thumbnail_WindowRectChanging;
				OverviewPlusDetailPane.WindowChanged -= thumbnail_WindowRectChanged;
			}
			OverviewPlusDetailPane = GetTemplateChild("Thumbnail") as XamOverviewPlusDetailPane;
			if (OverviewPlusDetailPane != null)
			{
				OverviewPlusDetailPane.SurfaceViewer = this;
				OverviewPlusDetailPane.WindowChanging += thumbnail_WindowRectChanging;
				OverviewPlusDetailPane.WindowChanged += thumbnail_WindowRectChanged;
				if (OverviewPlusDetailPaneStyle != null)
				{
					OverviewPlusDetailPane.Style = OverviewPlusDetailPaneStyle;
				}
			}
			if (ContentPresenter != null)
			{
				ContentPresenter.SizeChanged -= ContentPresenter_SizeChanged;
			}
			ContentPresenter = GetTemplateChild("ContentPresenter") as ContentPresenter;
			if (ContentPresenter != null)
			{
				ContentPresenter.SizeChanged += ContentPresenter_SizeChanged;
			}
			if (Overlay != null)
			{
				Overlay.Children.Remove(PreviewPath);
				Overlay.Children.Remove(DragPath);
			}
			Overlay = GetTemplateChild("Overlay") as Canvas;
			if (Overlay != null)
			{
				Overlay.Clip = new RectangleGeometry();
				Overlay.Children.Add(PreviewPath);
				Overlay.Children.Add(DragPath);
			}
			DragPath.SetBinding(Shape.StrokeProperty, new Binding("DragStroke")
			{
				Source = this
			});
			DragPath.SetBinding(Shape.StrokeThicknessProperty, new Binding("DragStrokeThickness")
			{
				Source = this
			});
			DragPath.SetBinding(Shape.StrokeDashArrayProperty, new Binding("DragStrokeDashArray")
			{
				Source = this
			});
			PreviewPath.SetBinding(Shape.FillProperty, new Binding("PreviewBrush")
			{
				Source = this
			});
			ViewportRect = ((ContentPresenter != null && ContentPresenter.ActualWidth > 0.0 && ContentPresenter.ActualHeight > 0.0) ? new Rect(0.0, 0.0, ContentPresenter.ActualWidth, ContentPresenter.ActualHeight) : Rect.Empty);
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeftButtonDown(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseLeftButtonDown(e);
			if (!CanStartNavigation(e))
			{
				return;
			}
			Focus();
			Point position = e.GetPosition(Overlay);
			if (!ViewportRect.Contains(position))
			{
				return;
			}
			if ((Keyboard.Modifiers & ModifierKeys.Control) != ModifierKeys.None)
			{
				if (NavigationSettings.AllowZoom && NavigationSettings.AllowPan)
				{
					IsDragging = CaptureMouse();
				}
			}
			else if (NavigationSettings.AllowPan)
			{
				IsPanning = CaptureMouse();
			}
			if (IsDragging)
			{
				Anchor = ViewportToWorld(position);
				Rect rect = new Rect(Anchor, ViewportToWorld(e.GetPosition(Overlay)));
				(DragPath.Data as RectangleGeometry).Rect = WorldToViewport(rect);
				DragPath.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
				OnDragRectChanging(new RectChangedEventArgs(rect, rect));
				e.Handled = true;
			}
			else if (IsPanning)
			{
				Anchor = position;
				base.Cursor = Cursors.Hand;
				e.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseMove(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (IsDragging)
			{
				Rect rect = new Rect(Anchor, ViewportToWorld(e.GetPosition(Overlay)));
				(DragPath.Data as RectangleGeometry).Rect = WorldToViewport(rect);
				OnDragRectChanging(new RectChangedEventArgs(rect, rect));
			}
			else if (IsPanning)
			{
				Point position = e.GetPosition(Overlay);
				double num = Anchor.X - position.X;
				double num2 = Anchor.Y - position.Y;
				double zoomLevel = ZoomLevel;
				num /= zoomLevel;
				num2 /= zoomLevel;
				if (WindowRect != Rect.Empty)
				{
					Rect windowRect = WindowRect;
					windowRect.X += num;
					windowRect.Y += num2;
					WindowRect = windowRect;
				}
				Anchor = position;
			}
			base.OnMouseMove(e);
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeftButtonUp(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			if (IsDragging)
			{
				Rect rect = new Rect(Anchor, ViewportToWorld(e.GetPosition(Overlay)));
				ReleaseMouseCapture();
				DragPath.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				IsDragging = false;
				OnDragRectChanged(new RectChangedEventArgs(rect, rect));
				e.Handled = true;
			}
			else if (IsPanning)
			{
				base.Cursor = Cursors.Arrow;
				IsPanning = false;
				ReleaseMouseCapture();
				e.Handled = true;
			}
			base.OnMouseLeftButtonUp(e);
		}

		protected override void OnMouseWheel(MouseWheelEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseWheel(e);
			if (NavigationSettings.AllowZoom)
			{
				double num = 1.0 + Math.Min(0.5, Math.Max(-0.5, (double)e.Delta / 1200.0));
				ZoomLevel *= num;
				e.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnKeyDown(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnKeyDown(e);
			_ = e.Key;
			bool flag = (CurrentModifiers & ModifierKeys.Control) == ModifierKeys.Control;
			switch (e.Key)
			{
			case Key.Escape:
				if (IsDragging)
				{
					ReleaseMouseCapture();
					OnDragRectChanged(new RectChangedEventArgs(Rect.Empty, Rect.Empty));
					DragPath.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
					IsDragging = false;
					e.Handled = true;
				}
				break;
			case Key.Add:
				if (flag && NavigationSettings.AllowZoom)
				{
					ZoomIn();
					e.Handled = true;
				}
				break;
			case Key.Subtract:
				if (flag && NavigationSettings.AllowZoom)
				{
					ZoomOut();
					e.Handled = true;
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		public virtual void RenderPreview()
		{
		}

		public Rect Adjust(Rect rect)
		{
			return Adjust(rect, AdjustmentPriority.Biggest);
		}

		public void ScaleToFit()
		{
			Rect viewportRect = ViewportRect;
			if (!viewportRect.IsEmpty && !WorldRect.IsEmpty)
			{
				Rect worldRect = WorldRect;
				double x = 0.0;
				double y = 0.0;
				double width;
				if (worldRect.Width >= viewportRect.Width)
				{
					width = worldRect.Width;
				}
				else
				{
					width = viewportRect.Width;
					x = (worldRect.Width - width) / 2.0;
				}
				double height;
				if (worldRect.Height >= viewportRect.Height)
				{
					height = worldRect.Height;
				}
				else
				{
					height = viewportRect.Height;
					y = (worldRect.Height - height) / 2.0;
				}
				Rect rect = new Rect(x, y, width, height);
				WindowRect = Adjust(rect, AdjustmentPriority.Worst);
				if (!double.IsNaN(_initialZoomLevel))
				{
					ZoomLevel = _initialZoomLevel;
				}
			}
		}

		public void ZoomTo100()
		{
			ScaleToFit();
			ZoomLevel = 1.0;
		}

		public void ZoomIn()
		{
			ZoomLevel *= 1.1;
		}

		public void ZoomOut()
		{
			ZoomLevel *= 0.9;
		}

		internal Rect Adjust(Rect rect, AdjustmentPriority adjustmentPriority)
		{
			Rect viewportRect = ViewportRect;
			if (!viewportRect.IsEmpty)
			{
				double num = rect.Left + 0.5 * rect.Width;
				double num2 = rect.Top + 0.5 * rect.Height;
				double num3 = rect.Width;
				double num4 = rect.Height;
				switch (adjustmentPriority)
				{
				case AdjustmentPriority.Biggest:
					return Adjust(rect, (rect.Width > rect.Height) ? AdjustmentPriority.Width : AdjustmentPriority.Height);
				case AdjustmentPriority.Smallest:
					return Adjust(rect, (rect.Width > rect.Height) ? AdjustmentPriority.Height : AdjustmentPriority.Width);
				case AdjustmentPriority.Best:
					return Adjust(rect, (viewportRect.Width * num4 / (viewportRect.Height * num3) > 1.0) ? AdjustmentPriority.Width : AdjustmentPriority.Height);
				case AdjustmentPriority.Worst:
					return Adjust(rect, (viewportRect.Width * num4 / (viewportRect.Height * num3) > 1.0) ? AdjustmentPriority.Height : AdjustmentPriority.Width);
				case AdjustmentPriority.Width:
					num4 = (rect.Height = num3 * viewportRect.Height / viewportRect.Width);
					break;
				case AdjustmentPriority.Height:
					num3 = num4 * viewportRect.Width / viewportRect.Height;
					break;
				}
				rect = new Rect(num - 0.5 * num3, num2 - 0.5 * num4, num3, num4);
			}
			return FitRectInZoom(rect);
		}

		internal Point ViewportToWorld(Point point)
		{
			Rect viewportRect = ViewportRect;
			Rect windowRect = WindowRect;
			if (viewportRect.IsEmpty || windowRect.IsEmpty)
			{
				return new Point(double.NaN, double.NaN);
			}
			double x = windowRect.Left + windowRect.Width * (point.X - viewportRect.Left) / viewportRect.Width;
			double y = windowRect.Top + windowRect.Height * (point.Y - viewportRect.Top) / viewportRect.Height;
			return new Point(x, y);
		}

		internal Rect WorldToViewport(Rect rect)
		{
			Rect viewportRect = ViewportRect;
			Rect windowRect = WindowRect;
			if (viewportRect.IsEmpty || windowRect.IsEmpty || rect.IsEmpty)
			{
				return Rect.Empty;
			}
			double num = viewportRect.Left + viewportRect.Width * (rect.Left - windowRect.Left) / windowRect.Width;
			double num2 = viewportRect.Top + viewportRect.Height * (rect.Top - windowRect.Top) / windowRect.Height;
			double num3 = viewportRect.Left + viewportRect.Width * (rect.Right - windowRect.Left) / windowRect.Width;
			double num4 = viewportRect.Top + viewportRect.Height * (rect.Bottom - windowRect.Top) / windowRect.Height;
			return new Rect(num, num2, num3 - num, num4 - num2);
		}

		protected virtual void OnPropertyUpdated(string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			OnPropertyChanged(new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
			if (propertyName == "ZoomLevel")
			{
				UpdateZoomLevelDisplayText();
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool CanStartNavigation(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			return true;
		}

		private void UpdateNavigators()
		{
			if (OverviewPlusDetailPane != null)
			{
				OverviewPlusDetailPane.World = WorldRect;
				OverviewPlusDetailPane.Window = WindowRect;
				OverviewPlusDetailPane.Preview = PreviewRect;
			}
			((PreviewPath.Data as GeometryGroup).Children[1] as RectangleGeometry).Rect = WorldToViewport(PreviewRect);
		}

		private double ClampZoomLevel(double scale)
		{
			if (!double.IsNaN(MinimumZoomLevel))
			{
				scale = Math.Max(MinimumZoomLevel, scale);
			}
			if (!double.IsNaN(MaximumZoomLevel))
			{
				scale = Math.Min(MaximumZoomLevel, scale);
			}
			scale = Math.Max(scale, 1E-05);
			return scale;
		}

		private Rect FitRectInZoom(Rect rect)
		{
			double num = ViewportRect.Width / rect.Width;
			double num2 = ClampZoomLevel(num);
			if (num == num2)
			{
				return rect;
			}
			double num3 = num / num2;
			Point point = new Point(rect.X + rect.Width / 2.0, rect.Y + rect.Height / 2.0);
			double num4 = num3 * (rect.Left - point.X) + point.X;
			double num5 = num3 * (rect.Bottom - point.Y) + point.Y;
			double num6 = num3 * (rect.Right - point.X) + point.X;
			double num7 = num3 * (rect.Top - point.Y) + point.Y;
			rect = new Rect(num4, num7, num6 - num4, num5 - num7);
			return rect;
		}

		private void ContentPresenter_SizeChanged(object sender, SizeChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			Rect rect = ((ContentPresenter != null && ContentPresenter.ActualWidth > 0.0 && ContentPresenter.ActualHeight > 0.0) ? new Rect(0.0, 0.0, ContentPresenter.ActualWidth, ContentPresenter.ActualHeight) : Rect.Empty);
			if (ViewportRect != rect)
			{
				ViewportRect = rect;
			}
		}

		private void thumbnail_WindowRectChanging(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs<Rect> e)
		{
			WindowRect = Adjust(e.NewValue);
		}

		private void thumbnail_WindowRectChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs<Rect> e)
		{
			WindowRect = Adjust(e.NewValue);
		}

		private void UpdateZoomLevelDisplayText()
		{
			ZoomLevelDisplayText = Math.Round(100.0 * ZoomLevel).ToString();
		}
	}

		public XamOverviewPlusDetailPane()

			base.DefaultStyleKey = typeof(XamOverviewPlusDetailPane);
		}

		protected virtual void OnWindowChanging(PropertyChangedEventArgs<Rect> e)
		{
			if (e == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("e");
			}
			if (Immediate)
			{
				Window = e.NewValue;
			}
			if (this.WindowChanging != null)
			{
				this.WindowChanging(this, e);
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnWindowChanged(PropertyChangedEventArgs<Rect> a)
		{
			if (this.WindowChanged != null)
			{
				this.WindowChanged(this, a);
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnThumbnailSizeChanged(PropertyChangedEventArgs<Size> e)
		{

			{
				this.ThumbnailSizeChanged(this, e);
			}
		}

			_pixelRatio = actualPixelScalingRatio;

		private static void OnShrinkToThumbnailChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((XamOverviewPlusDetailPane)d).OnShrinkToThumbnailChanged((bool)e.OldValue, (bool)e.NewValue);
		}

		protected virtual void OnShrinkToThumbnailChanged(bool oldValue, bool newValue)
		{
			if (newValue)
			{
				GoToState(OverviewPlusDetailPaneMode.Minimal);
			}
			else
			{
				GoToState(OverviewPlusDetailPaneMode.Compact);
			}
		}

		private static void OnModeChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((XamOverviewPlusDetailPane)d).OnModeChanged((OverviewPlusDetailPaneMode)e.OldValue, (OverviewPlusDetailPaneMode)e.NewValue);
		}

		protected virtual void OnModeChanged(OverviewPlusDetailPaneMode oldValue, OverviewPlusDetailPaneMode newValue)
		{
			GoToState(newValue);
		}

		internal void GoToState(OverviewPlusDetailPaneMode mode)
		{
			switch (mode)
			{
			case OverviewPlusDetailPaneMode.Full:
				View.GoToFullState();
				if (IsZoomable)
				{
					View.GoToZoomEnabledState();
				}
				else
				{
					View.GoToZoomDisabledState();
				}
				break;
			case OverviewPlusDetailPaneMode.Compact:
				View.GoToMinimalState();
				if (IsZoomable)
				{
					View.GoToZoomEnabledState();
				}
				else
				{
					View.GoToZoomDisabledState();
				}
				break;
			case OverviewPlusDetailPaneMode.Minimal:
				View.GoToMinimalState();
				View.GoToZoomDisabledState();
				break;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateVisualState()
		{
			if (ShrinkToThumbnail)
			{
				GoToState(OverviewPlusDetailPaneMode.Minimal);
			}
			else
			{
				GoToState(OverviewPlusDetailPaneMode.Compact);
			}
		}

		private void SurfaceViewer_PropertyChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			string propertyName = e.PropertyName;
			if (propertyName == "DefaultInteraction")
			{
				View.UpdateInteractionButtonStates(_surfaceViewer.DefaultInteraction);
			}
		}

		}

		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			View.OnTemplateProvided();
			UpdateVisualState();
		}

		protected override Size MeasureOverride(Size availableSize)
		{
			base.MeasureOverride(availableSize);
			return GetDesiredSize(availableSize);
		}

		internal Size GetDesiredSize(Size availableSize)
		{
			double num = availableSize.Width;
			double num2 = availableSize.Height;
			double num3 = ((!World.IsEmpty) ? (World.Width / World.Height) : 1.0);
			if (double.IsInfinity(num2))
			{
				if (double.IsInfinity(num))
				{
					num = 128.0;
				}
				num2 = num / num3;
			}
			else if (double.IsInfinity(num))
			{
				num = num2 * num3;
			}
			return new Size(num, num2);
		}

		internal void OnMouseEnter()
		{
			if (ShrinkToThumbnail)
			{
				GoToState(OverviewPlusDetailPaneMode.Full);
			}
		}

		internal void OnMouseLeave()
		{
			if (ShrinkToThumbnail)
			{
				GoToState(OverviewPlusDetailPaneMode.Minimal);
			}
		}

		internal bool OnKeyDown(Key key)
		{
			if (key == Key.Escape && IsPanning)
			{
				View.CancelMouseOperations();
				IsPanning = false;
				Preview = Rect.Empty;
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void OnMouseLeftButtonDown(Point p)
		{
			if (!_pinching)
			{
				_ignoreContactUp = false;
			}
			_lastPosition = p;
			if (WorldToCanvas(World).Contains(p))
			{
				Rect newValue = ((!((!Viewport.IsEmpty) ? World : Rect.Empty).IsEmpty) ? Window : Rect.Empty);
				Anchor = CanvasToWorld(p);
				if (!newValue.IsEmpty && View.CaptureMouse())
				{
					IsPanning = true;
					newValue = new Rect(Anchor.X - 0.5 * newValue.Width, Anchor.Y - 0.5 * newValue.Height, newValue.Width, newValue.Height);
					OnWindowChanging(new PropertyChangedEventArgs<Rect>("Window", Window, newValue));
				}
			}
		}

		internal void OnMouseMove(Point p, bool onMouseMove, bool isFinger)
		{
			if (double.IsNaN(Anchor.X) || double.IsNaN(Anchor.Y))
			{
				Anchor = CanvasToWorld(p);
			}
			double num = 2.0;
			if (isFinger)
			{
				num = 10.0;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			Point point = WorldPointToCanvas(Anchor);
			Rect rect = new Rect(point, p);
			if (rect.Width > num && rect.Height > num)
			{
				flag = true;
			}
			if (!_pinching && flag)
			{
				_ignoreContactUp = false;
			}
			_lastPosition = p;
			Rect rect2 = ((!((!Viewport.IsEmpty) ? World : Rect.Empty).IsEmpty) ? Window : Rect.Empty);
			if (IsPanning && !_ignoreContactUp)
			{
				Point point2 = CanvasToWorld(p);
				OnWindowChanging(new PropertyChangedEventArgs<Rect>(newValue: new Rect(point2.X - 0.5 * rect2.Width, point2.Y - 0.5 * rect2.Height, rect2.Width, rect2.Height), propertyName: "Window", oldValue: Window));
			}
		}

		internal bool OnMouseLeftButtonUp(Point p)
		{
			_lastPosition = p;
			Rect rect = ((!((!Viewport.IsEmpty) ? World : Rect.Empty).IsEmpty) ? Window : Rect.Empty);
			if (IsPanning && !_ignoreContactUp)
			{
				View.CancelMouseOperations();
				IsPanning = false;
				Point point = CanvasToWorld(p);
				OnWindowChanged(new PropertyChangedEventArgs<Rect>(newValue: new Rect(point.X - 0.5 * rect.Width, point.Y - 0.5 * rect.Height, rect.Width, rect.Height), propertyName: "Window", oldValue: Window));
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool OnMouseWheel(double delta)
		{
			Point center = Window.GetCenter();
			double num = 1.0 - MathUtil.Clamp(delta, -0.5, 0.5);
			double num2 = center.X - num * (center.X - Window.Left);
			double num3 = center.Y + num * (Window.Bottom - center.Y);
			double num4 = center.X + num * (Window.Right - center.X);
			double num5 = center.Y - num * (center.Y - Window.Top);
			OnWindowChanged(new PropertyChangedEventArgs<Rect>(newValue: new Rect(num2, num5, num4 - num2, num3 - num5), propertyName: "Window", oldValue: Window));
			return true;
		}

		protected virtual void OnPropertyUpdated(string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			OnPropertyChanged(new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
		}

		protected virtual void OnPropertyChanged(PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.PropertyChanged(this, e);
			}
			switch (e.PropertyName)
			{
			case "World":
				UpdateLayout();
				Refresh(immediate: false);
				break;
			case "Window":
				Refresh(immediate: false);
				break;
			case "Preview":
				Refresh(immediate: false);
				break;
			}
		}

		private void SetRenderOrigin()
		{
			View.SetRenderOrigin();
		}

		private Point CanvasToWorld(Point point)
		{
			Rect viewport = Viewport;
			Rect rect = ((!viewport.IsEmpty) ? World : Rect.Empty);
			if (!rect.IsEmpty)
			{
				double num = ((viewport.Width / viewport.Height > rect.Width / rect.Height) ? (viewport.Height / rect.Height) : (viewport.Width / rect.Width));
				double num2 = 0.5 * (viewport.Left + viewport.Right - (rect.Left + rect.Right) * num);
				double num3 = 0.5 * (viewport.Top + viewport.Bottom - (rect.Top + rect.Bottom) * num);
				return new Point((point.X - num2) / num, (point.Y - num3) / num);
			}
			return new Point(double.NaN, double.NaN);
		}

		private Point WorldPointToCanvas(Point pt)
		{
			Rect viewport = Viewport;
			Rect rect = ((!viewport.IsEmpty) ? World : Rect.Empty);
			if (!rect.IsEmpty)
			{
				double num = ((viewport.Width / viewport.Height > rect.Width / rect.Height) ? (viewport.Height / rect.Height) : (viewport.Width / rect.Width));
				double num2 = 0.5 * (viewport.Left + viewport.Right - (rect.Left + rect.Right) * num);
				double num3 = 0.5 * (viewport.Top + viewport.Bottom - (rect.Top + rect.Bottom) * num);
				return new Point(pt.X * num + num2, pt.Y * num + num3);
			}
			return new Point(double.NaN, double.NaN);
		}

		private Rect WorldToCanvas(Rect rect)
		{
			Rect viewport = Viewport;
			Rect rect2 = ((!viewport.IsEmpty) ? World : Rect.Empty);
			if (!rect2.IsEmpty && !rect.IsEmpty)
			{
				double num = ((viewport.Width / viewport.Height > rect2.Width / rect2.Height) ? (viewport.Height / rect2.Height) : (viewport.Width / rect2.Width));
				double num2 = 0.5 * (viewport.Left + viewport.Right - (rect2.Left + rect2.Right) * num);
				double num3 = 0.5 * (viewport.Top + viewport.Bottom - (rect2.Top + rect2.Bottom) * num);
				return new Rect(rect.Left * num + num2, rect.Top * num + num3, rect.Width * num, rect.Height * num);
			}
			return Rect.Empty;
		}

		void IOverviewPlusDetailPane.DoRefresh(bool immediate)
		{
			Refresh(immediate);
		}

		internal void Refresh(bool immediate)
		{
			UpdateSliderRanges();
			if (!immediate)
			{
				if (base.ActualWidth != 0.0 && base.ActualHeight != 0.0 && !RefreshPending)
				{
					RefreshPending = true;
					base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(new Action<bool>(Refresh), true);
				}
				return;
			}
			RefreshPending = false;
			Rect world = WorldToCanvas(World);
			Rect window = WorldToCanvas(Window);
			Rect preview = WorldToCanvas(Preview);
			if (base.Visibility != Visibility.Visible || world.IsEmpty || double.IsNaN(world.X) || double.IsNaN(world.Y))
			{
				RefreshPending = false;
				return;
			}
			View.UpdateWorldRect(world);
			View.PositionPreview(world);
			View.UpdateWindowPath(world, window);
			View.UpdatePreviewPath(world, preview);
			if (SurfaceViewer != null)
			{
				SurfaceViewer.RenderPreview();
			}
		}

		private void UpdateSliderRanges()
		{
			if (base.Visibility != Visibility.Visible || SurfaceViewer == null || !View.IsReady())
			{
				return;
			}
			Rect viewportRect = SurfaceViewer.ViewportRect;
			Rect worldRect = SurfaceViewer.WorldRect;
			if (!viewportRect.IsEmpty && !worldRect.IsEmpty)
			{
				UpdatingSliderRanges = true;
				double sliderValue = View.GetSliderValue();
				double num = SurfaceViewer.MinimumZoomLevel;
				double num2 = SurfaceViewer.MaximumZoomLevel;
				if (double.IsNaN(num))
				{
					num = Math.Min(viewportRect.Width / worldRect.Width, viewportRect.Height / worldRect.Height);
					num = Math.Min(num, 0.5);
					num = Math.Min(num, sliderValue);
				}
				if (double.IsNaN(num2))
				{
					num2 = 2.0;
					num2 = Math.Max(num2, sliderValue);
				}
				View.SetSliderMin(num);
				View.SetSliderMax(num2);
				UpdatingSliderRanges = false;
			}
		}

		internal void OnDefaultInteraction(InteractionState state)
		{
			if (SurfaceViewer != null)
			{
				SurfaceViewer.DefaultInteraction = state;
			}
		}

		internal void OnScaleToFit()
		{
			if (SurfaceViewer != null)
			{
				SurfaceViewer.ScaleToFit();
			}
		}

		internal void OnZoomTo100()
		{
			if (SurfaceViewer != null)
			{
				SurfaceViewer.ZoomTo100();
			}
		}

		internal void OnContainerSizeChanged()
		{
			Refresh(immediate: false);
		}

		internal void OnGestureCompleted(Point pt)
		{
			_pinching = false;
			Anchor = new Point(double.NaN, double.NaN);
		}

		public Rect ChangeRect(Rect oldRect, Rect newRect, bool horizontalZoomable, bool verticalZoomable, Rect worldRect)
		{
			double width;
			double left;
			if (horizontalZoomable)
			{
				left = newRect.Left;
				width = newRect.Width;
			}
			else
			{
				left = oldRect.Left;
				width = oldRect.Width;
			}
			double height;
			double top;
			if (verticalZoomable)
			{
				top = newRect.Top;
				height = newRect.Height;
			}
			else
			{
				top = oldRect.Top;
				height = oldRect.Height;
			}
			double num = left + width;
			double num2 = top + height;
			double num3 = Math.Max(0.0, worldRect.Left - left);
			double num4 = Math.Max(0.0, num - worldRect.Right);
			double num5 = Math.Max(0.0, worldRect.Top - top);
			double num6 = Math.Max(0.0, num2 - worldRect.Bottom);
			left += num3 - num4;
			top += num5 - num6;
			Rect result = new Rect(left, top, width, height);
			result.Intersect(worldRect);
			return result;
		}

		Visibility IOverviewPlusDetailPane.get_Visibility()
		{
			return base.Visibility;
		}

		[SpecialName]
		void IOverviewPlusDetailPane.set_Visibility(Visibility value)
		{
			base.Visibility = value;
		}

				ButtonZoomIn.Click += ButtonZoomIn_Click;

				ButtonZoomOut.Click -= ButtonZoomOut_Click;
			}

				ButtonZoomOut.Click += ButtonZoomOut_Click;
			}

				ButtonZoomTo100.Click -= ButtonZoomTo100_Click;
			}

			if (ButtonZoomTo100 != null)

				ButtonZoomTo100.Click += ButtonZoomTo100_Click;
			}
			if (ButtonScaleToFit != null)
			{
				ButtonScaleToFit.Click -= ButtonScaleToFit_Click;
			}
			ButtonScaleToFit = Model.FetchChildByName("ScaleToFit") as ButtonBase;
			if (ButtonScaleToFit != null)
			{
				ButtonScaleToFit.Click += ButtonScaleToFit_Click;
			}
			SliderZoomLevel = Model.FetchChildByName("ZoomLevel") as Slider;
			RootElement = Model.FetchChildByName("Root") as FrameworkElement;
			if (ButtonCursor != null)

		private void ButtonZoomOut_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (SliderZoomLevel != null)
			{
				if (SliderZoomLevel.Value - SliderZoomLevel.SmallChange >= SliderZoomLevel.Minimum)
				{
					SliderZoomLevel.Value -= SliderZoomLevel.SmallChange;
				}
				else if (SliderZoomLevel.Value - SliderZoomLevel.Minimum < SliderZoomLevel.SmallChange)
				{
					SliderZoomLevel.Value = SliderZoomLevel.Minimum;
				}
			}
		}

		private void ButtonZoomIn_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (SliderZoomLevel != null)
			{
				if (SliderZoomLevel.Value + SliderZoomLevel.SmallChange <= SliderZoomLevel.Maximum)
				{
					SliderZoomLevel.Value += SliderZoomLevel.SmallChange;
				}
				else if (SliderZoomLevel.Value < SliderZoomLevel.Maximum)
				{
					SliderZoomLevel.Value = SliderZoomLevel.Maximum;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void SetRenderOrigin()
		{
			if (RootElement != null)
			{
				Point renderTransformOrigin = new Point(0.0, 0.0);
				switch (Model.HorizontalAlignment)
				{
				case HorizontalAlignment.Right:
					renderTransformOrigin.X = 1.0;
					break;
				default:
					renderTransformOrigin.X = 0.5;
					break;
				case HorizontalAlignment.Left:
					break;
				}
				switch (Model.VerticalAlignment)
				{
				case VerticalAlignment.Bottom:
					renderTransformOrigin.Y = 1.0;
					break;
				default:
					renderTransformOrigin.Y = 0.5;
					break;
				case VerticalAlignment.Top:
					break;
				}
				RootElement.RenderTransformOrigin = renderTransformOrigin;
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateWorldRect(Rect world)
		{
			(WorldPath.Data as RectangleGeometry).Rect = world;
			WorldPath.Visibility = (world.IsEmpty ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
		}

		internal void UpdateWindowPath(Rect world, Rect window)
		{
			(WindowPath.Clip as RectangleGeometry).Rect = world;
			((WindowPath.Data as GeometryGroup).Children[0] as RectangleGeometry).Rect = RectUtil.InflateBy(world, new Thickness(2.0));
			((WindowPath.Data as GeometryGroup).Children[1] as RectangleGeometry).Rect = window;
			WindowPath.Visibility = (window.IsEmpty ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
		}

		internal void UpdatePreviewPath(Rect world, Rect preview)
		{
			(PreviewPath.Clip as RectangleGeometry).Rect = world;
			((PreviewPath.Data as GeometryGroup).Children[0] as RectangleGeometry).Rect = RectUtil.InflateBy(world, new Thickness(2.0));
			((PreviewPath.Data as GeometryGroup).Children[1] as RectangleGeometry).Rect = preview;
			PreviewPath.Visibility = (preview.IsEmpty ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
		}

		internal void UpdateInteractionButtonStates(InteractionState activeState)
		{
			_activeInteractionState = activeState;

			{
				ButtonDragPan.IsChecked = activeState == InteractionState.DragPan;
			}
			if (ButtonDragZoom != null)
			{
				ButtonDragZoom.IsChecked = activeState == InteractionState.DragZoom;
			}
		}

		{

				{
					Mode = BindingMode.TwoWay
				});
			}
		}

		}

		internal bool CaptureMouse()
		{
			return Model.CaptureMouse();
		}

		internal void PositionPreview(Rect world)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			Size oldValue = new Size(PreviewCanvas.Width, PreviewCanvas.Height);
			if (Math.Round(PreviewCanvas.Width) != Math.Round(world.Width))
			{
				flag = true;
				PreviewCanvas.Width = world.Width;
			}
			if (Math.Round(PreviewCanvas.Height) != Math.Round(world.Height))
			{
				flag = true;
				PreviewCanvas.Height = world.Height;
			}
			Canvas.SetLeft(PreviewCanvas, world.X);
			Canvas.SetTop(PreviewCanvas, world.Y);
			if (flag)
			{
				Size newValue = new Size(PreviewCanvas.Width, PreviewCanvas.Height);
				Model.OnThumbnailSizeChanged(new PropertyChangedEventArgs<Size>("ThumbnailSize", oldValue, newValue));
			}
		}

	public class StringArrayConverter : TypeConverter
	{
		public override bool CanConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type sourceType)
		{
			return sourceType == typeof(string);
		}

		public override object ConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value)
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			char[] separator = new char[2] { ' ', ',' };
			string[] array = value.ToString().Split(separator, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
			foreach (string item in array)
			{
				list.Add(item);
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}
	}
	public static class PointCollectionUtil
	{
		public static void FlattenTo(this IList<Point> points, IList<Point> list, double E)
		{
			if (list == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			list.Clear();
			if (points.Count < 2)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (int item in Flattener.Flatten(points.Count, (int i) => points[i].X, (int i) => points[i].Y, E))
			{
				list.Add(points[item]);
			}
		}

		public static Rect GetBounds(this IEnumerable<Point> points)
		{
			double num = double.PositiveInfinity;
			double num2 = double.PositiveInfinity;
			double num3 = double.NegativeInfinity;
			double num4 = double.NegativeInfinity;
			foreach (Point point in points)
			{
				num = Math.Min(num, point.X);
				num2 = Math.Min(num2, point.Y);
				num3 = Math.Max(num3, point.X);
				num4 = Math.Max(num4, point.Y);
			}
			if (double.IsInfinity(num) || double.IsInfinity(num2) || double.IsInfinity(num2) || double.IsInfinity(num4))
			{
				return Rect.Empty;
			}
			return new Rect(num, num2, num3 - num, num4 - num2);
		}

		public static Rect GetBounds(this IEnumerable<IEnumerable<Point>> points)
		{
			Rect empty = Rect.Empty;
			foreach (IEnumerable<Point> point in points)
			{
				empty.Union(point.GetBounds());
			}
			return empty;
		}

		public static Rect GetBounds(this IList<Point> points)
		{
			double num = double.PositiveInfinity;
			double num2 = double.PositiveInfinity;
			double num3 = double.NegativeInfinity;
			double num4 = double.NegativeInfinity;
			for (int i = 0; i < points.Count; i++)
			{
				Point point = points[i];
				num = Math.Min(num, point.X);
				num2 = Math.Min(num2, point.Y);
				num3 = Math.Max(num3, point.X);
				num4 = Math.Max(num4, point.Y);
			}
			if (double.IsInfinity(num) || double.IsInfinity(num2) || double.IsInfinity(num2) || double.IsInfinity(num4))
			{
				return Rect.Empty;
			}
			return new Rect(num, num2, num3 - num, num4 - num2);
		}

		public static Rect GetBounds(this List<List<Point>> points)
		{
			if (points == null)
			{
				return Rect.Empty;
			}
			Rect empty = Rect.Empty;
			for (int i = 0; i < points.Count; i++)
			{
				List<Point> points2 = points[i];
				empty.Union(points2.GetBounds());
			}
			return empty;
		}

		public static Rect GetBounds(this List<PointCollection> points)
		{
			Rect empty = Rect.Empty;
			for (int i = 0; i < points.Count; i++)
			{
				PointCollection points2 = points[i];
				empty.Union(points2.GetBounds());
			}
			return empty;
		}

		public static void ClipTo(this IList<Point> points, IList<Point> list, Clipper clipper)
		{
			int count = points.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				clipper.Add(points[i]);
			}
			clipper.Target = null;
		}

		public static Point GetCentroid(this IEnumerable<Point> points)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			double num3 = 0.0;
			foreach (Point point in points)
			{
				num += point.X;
				num2 += point.Y;
				num3 += 1.0;
			}
			return new Point(num / num3, num2 / num3);
		}

		public static PointCollection ToPointCollection(this IEnumerable<Point> points)
		{
			PointCollection pointCollection = new PointCollection();
			foreach (Point point in points)
			{
				pointCollection.Add(point);
			}
			return pointCollection;
		}

		public static List<Point> ToPointList(this IEnumerable<Point> points)
		{
			List<Point> list = new List<Point>();
			foreach (Point point in points)
			{
				list.Add(point);
			}
			return list;
		}

		public static List<PointCollection> ToPointCollections(this List<List<Point>> points)
		{
			List<PointCollection> list = new List<PointCollection>();
			int count = points.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				List<Point> list2 = points[i];
				PointCollection pointCollection = new PointCollection();
				int count2 = list2.Count;
				for (int j = 0; j < count2; j++)
				{
					Point value = list2[j];
					pointCollection.Add(value);
				}
				list.Add(pointCollection);
			}
			return list;
		}
	}
