		private double _transDeltaX;

		private double _transDeltaY;

		public TouchGestureState CurrentState { get; set; }

		public double HoldSlopDistance
		{
			get
			{
				return _holdSlopDistance;
			}
			set
			{
				_holdSlopDistance = value;
			}
		}

		public double CentroidX => _centroidX;

		public double CentroidY => _centroidY;

		public long CheckHoldTime { get; set; }

		public event TouchGestureEventHandler HoldStarting;

		public event TouchGestureEventHandler HoldEnding;

		public event TouchGestureEventHandler PanStarting;

		public event TouchGestureEventHandler ManipulationStarting;

		public event TouchGestureEventHandler ManipulationChanging;

		public event TouchGestureEventHandler ManipulationEnding;

		public event TouchGestureEventHandler PanEnding;

		public event TouchGestureEventHandler ZoomStarting;

		public event TouchGestureEventHandler ZoomEnding;

		public event CancelableTouchGestureEventHandler FlingStarting;

		public event TouchGestureEventHandler DoubleTapped;

		public TouchGestureRecognizer(IExecutionContext executionContext)
		{
			CheckHoldTime = 500L;
			CurrentState = TouchGestureState.None;
			_executionContext = executionContext;
		}

		public Point GetPendingPanDisplacement()
		{
			return new Point(Math.Abs(_checkPanDisplacementX - _pendingX), Math.Abs(_checkPanDisplacementY - _pendingY));
		}

		public void UpdateDisplacement(List<TouchPointInfo> touchPoints)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			if (!double.IsNaN(_pendingX) && !double.IsNaN(_pendingY))
			{
				_checkPanDisplacementX = touchPoints[0].X;
				_checkPanDisplacementY = touchPoints[0].Y;
				if (Math.Abs(touchPoints[0].X - _pendingX) > _holdSlopDistance || Math.Abs(touchPoints[0].Y - _pendingY) > _holdSlopDistance)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				StopHoldTimer();
			}
		}

		public void ProcessTouches(List<TouchPointInfo> touchPoints)
		{
			int count = touchPoints.Count;
			TouchGestureState touchGestureState = CurrentState;
			bool flag = false;
			bool flag2 = false;
			bool flag3 = false;
			bool flag4 = false;
			bool flag5 = false;
			bool flag6 = false;
			bool flag7 = false;
			bool flag8 = false;
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			double num3 = 0.0;
			TouchGestureState currentState = CurrentState;
			if (count > 0 && count < 2)
			{
				switch (CurrentState)
				{
				case TouchGestureState.Flinging:
					touchGestureState = TouchGestureState.PendingPan;
					flag2 = true;
					flag7 = true;
					break;
				case TouchGestureState.None:
					touchGestureState = TouchGestureState.PendingPan;
					flag2 = true;
					break;
				case TouchGestureState.Zoom:
					touchGestureState = TouchGestureState.Pan;
					flag7 = true;
					flag4 = true;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (count > 1)
			{
				switch (CurrentState)
				{
				case TouchGestureState.Flinging:
					touchGestureState = TouchGestureState.Zoom;
					flag5 = true;
					flag8 = true;
					break;
				case TouchGestureState.PendingPan:
					flag3 = true;
					touchGestureState = TouchGestureState.Zoom;
					flag5 = true;
					break;
				case TouchGestureState.None:
					touchGestureState = TouchGestureState.Zoom;
					flag5 = true;
					break;
				case TouchGestureState.Pan:
					touchGestureState = TouchGestureState.Zoom;
					flag6 = true;
					flag5 = true;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (count == 0)
			{
				switch (CurrentState)
				{
				case TouchGestureState.PendingPan:
					if (CheckDoubleTap(new TouchPointInfo(_centroidX, _centroidY)))
					{
						touchGestureState = TouchGestureState.None;
						flag3 = true;
						if (this.DoubleTapped != null)
						{
							this.DoubleTapped(this, GetGestureArgs());
						}
					}
					else
					{
						flag3 = true;
						touchGestureState = TouchGestureState.None;
					}
					break;
				case TouchGestureState.Pan:
					touchGestureState = TouchGestureState.None;
					flag6 = true;
					break;
				case TouchGestureState.Zoom:
					touchGestureState = TouchGestureState.None;
					flag4 = true;
					break;
				case TouchGestureState.Hold:
					touchGestureState = TouchGestureState.None;
					flag = true;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (flag8)
			{
				if (flag7)
				{
					if (this.PanEnding != null)
					{
						this.PanEnding(this, GetGestureArgs());
					}
					if (this.ManipulationEnding != null)
					{
						this.ManipulationEnding(this, GetGestureArgs());
					}
				}
				CancelFling();
			}
			if (flag2)
			{
				_pendingX = touchPoints[0].X;
				_pendingY = touchPoints[0].Y;
			}
			if (touchGestureState == TouchGestureState.PendingPan && !double.IsNaN(_pendingX) && !double.IsNaN(_pendingY))
			{
				_checkPanDisplacementX = touchPoints[0].X;
				_checkPanDisplacementY = touchPoints[0].Y;
				if (Math.Abs(touchPoints[0].X - _pendingX) > _holdSlopDistance || Math.Abs(touchPoints[0].Y - _pendingY) > _holdSlopDistance)
				{
					flag3 = true;
					flag7 = true;
					touchGestureState = TouchGestureState.Pan;
				}
			}
			double num4 = 0.0;
			double num5 = 0.0;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				num4 += touchPoints[i].X;
				num5 += touchPoints[i].Y;
			}
			num4 /= (double)count;
			num5 /= (double)count;
			if (count == 0)
			{
				num4 = _previousPosX;
				num5 = _previousPosY;
			}
			_centroidX = num4;
			_centroidY = num5;
			_tracker.TrackPoint(_centroidX, _centroidY, GetCurrentTime());
			if (flag5)
			{
				double num6 = touchPoints[0].X - touchPoints[1].X;
				double num7 = touchPoints[0].Y - touchPoints[1].Y;
				_startDistanceX = Math.Abs(num6);
				_startDistanceY = Math.Abs(num7);
				_startDistanceLine = Math.Sqrt(num6 * num6 + num7 * num7);
				if (_startDistanceX < 1.0)
				{
					_startDistanceX = 1.0;
				}
				if (_startDistanceY < 1.0)
				{
					_startDistanceY = 1.0;
				}
				if (_startDistanceLine < 1.0)
				{
					_startDistanceLine = 1.0;
				}
			}
			if (touchGestureState == TouchGestureState.Zoom)
			{
				double num8 = touchPoints[0].X - touchPoints[1].X;
				double num9 = touchPoints[0].Y - touchPoints[1].Y;
				num = Math.Abs(num8);
				num2 = Math.Abs(num9);
				num3 = Math.Sqrt(num8 * num8 + num9 * num9);
				if (num < 1.0)
				{
					num = 1.0;
				}
				if (num2 < 1.0)
				{
					num2 = 1.0;
				}
				if (num3 < 1.0)
				{
					num3 = 1.0;
				}
				_scaleX = num / _startDistanceX;
				_scaleY = num2 / _startDistanceY;
				_isoScale = num3 / _startDistanceLine;
			}
			else
			{
				_startDistanceX = double.NaN;
				_startDistanceY = double.NaN;
				_scaleX = 1.0;
				_scaleY = 1.0;
				_scaleDeltaX = 1.0;
				_scaleDeltaY = 1.0;
				_isoScaleDelta = 1.0;
			}
			CurrentState = touchGestureState;
			if (((currentState == TouchGestureState.None && CurrentState == TouchGestureState.Pan) || CurrentState == TouchGestureState.Zoom) && this.ManipulationStarting != null)
			{
				this.ManipulationStarting(this, GetGestureArgs());
			}
			if (flag4)
			{
				EndZoom();
			}
			if (flag6)
			{
				EndPan();
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				EndHold();
			}
			if (flag3)
			{
				StopHoldTimer();
			}
			if (flag7)
			{
				StartPan();
			}
			if (flag2)
			{
				StartHoldTimer();
			}
			if (flag5)
			{
				StartZoom();
			}
			if (CurrentState == TouchGestureState.Zoom)
			{
				_scaleDeltaX = _scaleX / _previousScaleX;
				_scaleDeltaY = _scaleY / _previousScaleY;
				_isoScaleDelta = _isoScale / _previousIsoScale;
				_transDeltaX = _centroidX - _previousPosX;
				_transDeltaY = _centroidY - _previousPosY;
				_previousScaleX *= _scaleDeltaX;
				_previousScaleY *= _scaleDeltaY;
				_previousIsoScale *= _isoScaleDelta;
				_previousPosX = _centroidX;
				_previousPosY = _centroidY;
				if (this.ManipulationChanging != null)
				{
					this.ManipulationChanging(this, GetGestureArgs());
				}
			}
			if (CurrentState == TouchGestureState.Pan)
			{
				_transDeltaX = _centroidX - _previousPosX;
				_transDeltaY = _centroidY - _previousPosY;
				_previousPosX = _centroidX;
				_previousPosY = _centroidY;
				if (this.ManipulationChanging != null)
				{
					this.ManipulationChanging(this, GetGestureArgs());
				}
			}
			_previousPosX = _centroidX;
			_previousPosY = _centroidY;
			if ((flag6 || flag4) && CurrentState == TouchGestureState.None && this.ManipulationEnding != null)
			{
				this.ManipulationEnding(this, GetGestureArgs());
			}
		}

		private bool CheckDoubleTap(TouchPointInfo touchPointInfo)
		{
			long currentTime = GetCurrentTime();
			if (currentTime - _tapTime < 500 && Math.Abs(touchPointInfo.X - _tapLocationX) < 50.0 && Math.Abs(touchPointInfo.Y - _tapLocationY) < 50.0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			_tapLocationX = touchPointInfo.X;
			_tapLocationY = touchPointInfo.Y;
			_tapTime = currentTime;
			return false;
		}

		private void StartHoldTimer()
		{
			_startHoldTime = GetCurrentTime();
			if (!_holding)
			{
				_holding = true;
				_executionContext.ExecuteDelayed(CheckHold, 1000);
			}
		}

		[Weak]
		private void CheckHold()
		{
			if (_holding)
			{
				long currentTime = GetCurrentTime();
				if (currentTime - _startHoldTime >= CheckHoldTime)
				{
					StartHold();
				}
				else
				{
					_executionContext.ExecuteDelayed(CheckHold, (int)(CheckHoldTime - (currentTime - _startHoldTime)));
				}
			}
		}

		public void StopHoldTimer()
		{
			_holding = false;
		}

		private void EndZoom()
		{
			_tracker.Clear();
			if (this.ZoomEnding != null)
			{
				this.ZoomEnding(this, GetGestureArgs());
			}
		}

		private void StartHold()
		{
			if (this.HoldStarting != null)
			{
				this.HoldStarting(this, GetGestureArgs());
			}
		}

		private void StartZoom()
		{
			_tracker.Clear();
			CancelFling();
			_previousScaleX = 1.0;
			_previousScaleY = 1.0;
			_previousIsoScale = 1.0;
			_previousPosX = _centroidX;
			_previousPosY = _centroidY;
			if (this.ZoomStarting != null)
			{
				this.ZoomStarting(this, GetGestureArgs());
			}
		}

		private void EndHold()
		{
			if (this.HoldEnding != null)
			{
				this.HoldEnding(this, GetGestureArgs());
			}
		}

		private void StartPan()
		{
			_tracker.Clear();
			CancelFling();
			_previousPosX = _centroidX;
			_previousPosY = _centroidY;
			if (this.PanStarting != null)
			{
				this.PanStarting(this, GetGestureArgs());
			}
		}

		private void CancelFling()
		{
			if (CurrentState == TouchGestureState.Flinging)
			{
				CurrentState = TouchGestureState.None;
			}
		}

		[Weak]
		private void UpdateFling()
		{
			if (CurrentState != TouchGestureState.Flinging)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (_flingVel == null || _flingTime == -1)
			{
				CancelFling();
				return;
			}
			long currentTime = GetCurrentTime();
			long num = currentTime - _flingTime;
			if (num < 16)
			{
				QueueFrame(UpdateFling);
				return;
			}
			_flingTime = currentTime;
			double num2 = (double)num / 1000.0;
			double num3 = decelFactor * num2;
			TouchVelocityReading flingVel = _flingVel;
			if (flingVel.X > 0.0)
			{
				flingVel.X -= num3;
				if (flingVel.X < 0.0)
				{
					flingVel.X = 0.0;
				}
			}
			if (flingVel.X < 0.0)
			{
				flingVel.X += num3;
				if (flingVel.X > 0.0)
				{
					flingVel.X = 0.0;
				}
			}
			if (flingVel.Y > 0.0)
			{
				flingVel.Y -= num3;
				if (flingVel.Y < 0.0)
				{
					flingVel.Y = 0.0;
				}
			}
			if (flingVel.Y < 0.0)
			{
				flingVel.Y += num3;
				if (flingVel.Y > 0.0)
				{
					flingVel.Y = 0.0;
				}
			}
			if (flingVel.X == 0.0 && flingVel.Y == 0.0)
			{
				CurrentState = TouchGestureState.None;
				if (this.PanEnding != null)
				{
					this.PanEnding(this, GetGestureArgs());
				}
				if (this.ManipulationEnding != null)
				{
					this.ManipulationEnding(this, GetGestureArgs());
				}
				CancelFling();
				return;
			}
			_centroidX += flingVel.X * num2;
			_centroidY += flingVel.Y * num2;
			_transDeltaX = _centroidX - _previousPosX;
			_transDeltaY = _centroidY - _previousPosY;
			_previousPosX = _centroidX;
			_previousPosY = _centroidY;
			if (this.ManipulationChanging != null)
			{
				this.ManipulationChanging(this, GetGestureArgs());
			}
			QueueFrame(UpdateFling);
		}

		private bool StartFling(TouchVelocityReading vel)
		{
			if (CurrentState == TouchGestureState.Flinging)
			{
				CancelFling();
			}
			_flingTime = GetCurrentTime();
			_flingVel = vel;
			CurrentState = TouchGestureState.Flinging;
			QueueFrame(UpdateFling);
			if (this.FlingStarting != null && !this.FlingStarting(this, GetGestureArgs()))
			{
				CancelFling();
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void QueueFrame(ExecutionContextExecuteCallback action)
		{
			_executionContext.EnqueueAnimationAction(action);
		}

		private void EndPan()
		{
			TouchVelocityReading velocity = _tracker.GetVelocity(GetCurrentTime());
			if ((velocity.X > 5.0 || velocity.X < -5.0 || velocity.Y > 5.0 || velocity.Y < -5.0) && CurrentState == TouchGestureState.None)
			{
				CurrentState = TouchGestureState.Pan;
				if (!StartFling(velocity) && CurrentState == TouchGestureState.None)
				{
					if (this.PanEnding != null)
					{
						this.PanEnding(this, GetGestureArgs());
					}
					if (this.ManipulationEnding != null)
					{
						this.ManipulationEnding(this, GetGestureArgs());
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (this.PanEnding != null)
				{
					this.PanEnding(this, GetGestureArgs());
				}
				if (CurrentState == TouchGestureState.None && this.ManipulationEnding != null)
				{
					this.ManipulationEnding(this, GetGestureArgs());
				}
			}
		}

		private TouchGestureEventArgs GetGestureArgs()
		{
			return new TouchGestureEventArgs
			{
				CentroidX = _centroidX,
				CentroidY = _centroidY,
				ScaleDeltaX = _scaleDeltaX,
				ScaleDeltaY = _scaleDeltaY,
				IsoScaleDelta = _isoScaleDelta,
				TranslationDeltaX = _transDeltaX,
				TranslationDeltaY = _transDeltaY,
				VelocityX = ((_flingVel != null) ? _flingVel.X : _tracker.GetVelocity(GetCurrentTime()).X),
				VelocityY = ((_flingVel != null) ? _flingVel.Y : _tracker.GetVelocity(GetCurrentTime()).Y)
			};
		}

		private long GetCurrentTime()
		{
			return _executionContext.GetCurrentRelativeTime();
		}
	}
	internal delegate void TouchGestureEventHandler(object sender, TouchGestureEventArgs args);
	internal delegate bool CancelableTouchGestureEventHandler(object sender, TouchGestureEventArgs args);
	internal class TouchGestureEventArgs
	{
		public double ScaleDeltaX { get; set; }

		public double ScaleDeltaY { get; set; }

		public double IsoScaleDelta { get; set; }

		public double TranslationDeltaX { get; set; }

		public double TranslationDeltaY { get; set; }

		public double CentroidX { get; set; }

		public double CentroidY { get; set; }

		public double VelocityX { get; set; }

		public double VelocityY { get; set; }
	}
	internal class TouchHistoryItem
	{
		public double X { get; set; }

		public double Y { get; set; }

		public long Time { get; set; }
	}
	internal class TouchVelocityReading
	{
		public double X { get; set; }

		public double Y { get; set; }
	}
	internal class TouchVelocityTracker
	{
		private const int TouchHistoryLength = 5;

		private TouchHistoryItem[] _history = new TouchHistoryItem[5];

		private int _touchHistoryPosition;

		internal const double MinimumMovement = 5.0;

		public void TrackPoint(double x, double y, long time)
		{
			if (!double.IsNaN(x) && !double.IsNaN(y))
			{
				TouchHistoryItem touchHistoryItem = new TouchHistoryItem
				{
					X = x,
					Y = y,
					Time = time
				};
				_history[_touchHistoryPosition] = touchHistoryItem;
				_touchHistoryPosition++;
				if (_touchHistoryPosition > 4)
				{
					_touchHistoryPosition = 0;
				}
			}
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			_touchHistoryPosition = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++)
			{
				_history[i] = null;
			}
		}

		public TouchVelocityReading GetVelocity(long time)
		{
			double num = double.NaN;
			double num2 = double.NaN;
			double num3 = double.NaN;
			double num4 = double.NaN;
			long num5 = 0L;
			long num6 = 0L;
			bool flag = true;
			for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++)
			{
				if (_history[i] == null || _history[i].Time - time > 300)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					flag = false;
					num = _history[i].X;
					num2 = _history[i].X;
					num3 = _history[i].Y;
					num4 = _history[i].Y;
					num5 = _history[i].Time;
					num6 = _history[i].Time;
					continue;
				}
				if (_history[i].Time < num5)
				{
					num5 = _history[i].Time;
					num2 = _history[i].X;
					num4 = _history[i].Y;
				}
				if (_history[i].Time > num6)
				{
					num6 = _history[i].Time;
					num = _history[i].X;
					num3 = _history[i].Y;
				}
			}
			if (num5 == num6 || double.IsNaN(num) || double.IsNaN(num2) || double.IsNaN(num3) || double.IsNaN(num4))
			{
				return new TouchVelocityReading
				{
					X = double.NaN,
					Y = double.NaN
				};
			}
			return new TouchVelocityReading
			{
				X = (num - num2) / ((double)(num6 - num5) / 1000.0),
				Y = (num3 - num4) / ((double)(num6 - num5) / 1000.0)
			};
		}
	}
}
namespace Infragistics.Controls.Inputs
{
	internal interface IIcon
	{
		Brush Fill { get; set; }

		[ClientName("svgPath")]
		string SVGPath { get; set; }
	}
	[XamWidget]
	[UwpWidget]
	[WpfWidget]
	public delegate void KeyEventHandler(object sender, KeyEventArgs args);
	[XamWidget]
	[UwpWidget]
	[WpfWidget]
	public class KeyEventArgs : EventArgs
	{
		private int _keyCode;

		private ModifierKeys _modifiers;

		private object _originalEvent;

		private bool _defaultPrevented;

		public bool Alt => ModifierKeys.Alt == (_modifiers & ModifierKeys.Alt);

		public bool Ctrl => ModifierKeys.Control == (_modifiers & ModifierKeys.Control);

		public int KeyCode => _keyCode;

		[UwpSuppressWidgetMember]
		[XamSuppressWidgetMember]
		[SwiftSuppressWidgetMember]
		[JAVASuppressWidgetMember]
		public ModifierKeys Modifiers => _modifiers;

		public bool Shift => ModifierKeys.Shift == (_modifiers & ModifierKeys.Shift);

		public bool DefaultPrevented => _defaultPrevented;

		public KeyEventArgs(int keyCode, bool altKey, bool shiftKey, bool ctrlKey, object originalEvent)
		{
			_originalEvent = originalEvent;
			_keyCode = keyCode;
			_modifiers = GetModifiers(altKey, shiftKey, ctrlKey);
		}

		public KeyEventArgs(System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs originalEvent)
		{
			_originalEvent = originalEvent;
			_keyCode = ToKeyCode(originalEvent.Key);
			ModifierKeys modifierKeys = ModifierKeys.None;
			if (originalEvent.KeyboardDevice.IsKeyDown(Key.LeftAlt) || originalEvent.KeyboardDevice.IsKeyDown(Key.RightAlt))
			{
				modifierKeys |= ModifierKeys.Alt;
			}
			if (originalEvent.KeyboardDevice.IsKeyDown(Key.LeftShift) || originalEvent.KeyboardDevice.IsKeyDown(Key.RightShift))
			{
				modifierKeys |= ModifierKeys.Shift;
			}
			if (originalEvent.KeyboardDevice.IsKeyDown(Key.LeftCtrl) || originalEvent.KeyboardDevice.IsKeyDown(Key.RightCtrl))
			{
				modifierKeys |= ModifierKeys.Control;
			}
			_modifiers = modifierKeys;
		}

		private int ToKeyCode(Key key)
		{
			switch (key)
			{
			case Key.Return:
				return 13;
			case Key.Space:
				return 32;
			case Key.Escape:
				return 27;
			case Key.Left:
				return 37;
			case Key.Up:
				return 38;
			case Key.Right:
				return 39;
			case Key.Down:
				return 40;
			case Key.F2:
				return 113;
			case Key.Tab:
				return 9;
			case Key.LeftCtrl:
			case Key.RightCtrl:
				return 17;
			case Key.Z:
				return 90;
			case Key.Y:
				return 89;
			case Key.X:
				return 88;
			case Key.Back:
				return 8;
			case Key.Delete:
				return 46;
			case Key.ImeModeChange:
				return 229;
			default:
				return -1;
			}
		}

		public void PreventDefault()
		{
			_defaultPrevented = true;
			if (_originalEvent != null)
			{
				((KeyboardEventArgs)_originalEvent).Handled = true;
			}
		}

		public void StopPropagation()
		{
			if (_originalEvent != null)
			{
				((KeyboardEventArgs)_originalEvent).Handled = true;
			}
		}

		private static ModifierKeys GetModifiers(bool altKey, bool shiftKey, bool ctrlKey)
		{
			ModifierKeys modifierKeys = ModifierKeys.None;
			if (altKey)
			{
				modifierKeys |= ModifierKeys.Alt;
			}
			if (shiftKey)
			{
				modifierKeys |= ModifierKeys.Shift;
			}
			if (ctrlKey)
			{
				modifierKeys |= ModifierKeys.Control;
			}
			return modifierKeys;
		}
	}

	}

	internal class ScrollerView : IScrollerView
	{
		private bool _processRequestedWorkImmediately;

		public Scroller Model { get; private set; }

		internal ScrollViewer ScrollContainer { get; private set; }

		internal Panel RootContainer { get; private set; }

		internal FrameworkElement ContentContainer { get; private set; }

		public ScrollerView(Scroller model)
		{
			Model = model;
		}

		public double GetInitialScrollLeft()
		{
			return 0.0;
		}

		public double GetInitialScrollTop()
		{
			return 0.0;
		}

		public Brush GetDefaultScrollbarBrush()
		{
			return new SolidColorBrush(Color.FromArgb(byte.MaxValue, 102, 102, 102));
		}

		public void UpdateVScrollbar(double trackPosition, double size)
		{
		}

		public void UpdateScrollTop(double scrollTop)
		{
			ScrollContainer.ScrollToVerticalOffset(scrollTop);
		}

		public void UpdateScrollLeft(double scrollLeft)
		{
			ScrollContainer.ScrollToHorizontalOffset(scrollLeft);
		}

		public void UpdateScrollbarStatus(bool styleChange)
		{
		}

		public void UpdateHScrollbar(double trackPosition, double size)
		{
		}

		public void RequestWork(Action update)
		{
			if (_processRequestedWorkImmediately)
			{
				update();
			}
			else
			{
				ScrollContainer.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.Normal, update);
			}
		}

		public void ProvideContent(object content)
		{
			ContentContainer = (FrameworkElement)content;
			ScrollContainer.Content = ContentContainer;
		}

		public void ProvideContainer(object container)
		{
			if (container != RootContainer)
			{
				if (RootContainer != null)
				{
					Panel rootContainer = RootContainer;
					RootContainer = null;
					rootContainer?.Children.Remove(ScrollContainer);
				}
				if (container != null)
				{
					RootContainer = (Panel)container;
					ScrollContainer = new ScrollViewer();
					ScrollContainer.PanningMode = PanningMode.Both;
					RootContainer.Children.Add(ScrollContainer);
					UpdateScrollbarStatus(styleChange: false);
					ScrollContainer.ManipulationBoundaryFeedback += OnScrollContainerBoundaryFeedback;
					ScrollContainer.ScrollChanged += OnScrollContainerScrollChanged;
					ScrollContainer.SizeChanged += OnScrollContainerSizeChanged;
					ScrollContainer.Loaded += OnScrollContainerLoaded;
					ScrollContainer.PreviewKeyDown += OnScrollContainerPreviewKeyDown;
					Model.OnViewportSizeChanged(ScrollContainer.ViewportWidth, ScrollContainer.ViewportHeight, notify: true);
				}
			}
		}

		public void OnScrollContainerPreviewKeyDown(object sender, KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			bool isShiftPressed = false;
			bool isCtrlPressed = false;
			if (Keyboard.IsKeyDown(Key.LeftShift) || Keyboard.IsKeyDown(Key.RightShift))
			{
				isShiftPressed = true;
			}
			if (Keyboard.IsKeyDown(Key.LeftCtrl) || Keyboard.IsKeyDown(Key.RightCtrl))
			{
				isCtrlPressed = true;
			}
			if (Model.OnKeyDown(e.Key, isShiftPressed, isCtrlPressed))
			{
				e.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		private void OnScrollContainerLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			Model.OnViewportSizeChanged(Math.Floor(ScrollContainer.ViewportWidth), Math.Floor(ScrollContainer.ViewportHeight), notify: true);
			ScrollContainer.HorizontalScrollBarVisibility = ScrollBarVisibility.Auto;
			ScrollContainer.VerticalScrollBarVisibility = ScrollBarVisibility.Auto;
		}

		private void OnScrollContainerSizeChanged(object sender, SizeChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			Model.OnViewportSizeChanged(Math.Floor(ScrollContainer.ViewportWidth), Math.Floor(ScrollContainer.ViewportHeight), notify: true);
		}

		private void OnScrollContainerScrollChanged(object sender, ScrollChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			bool processRequestedWorkImmediately = _processRequestedWorkImmediately;
			_processRequestedWorkImmediately = true;
			try
			{
				if (e.ViewportHeightChange != 0.0 || e.ViewportWidthChange != 0.0)
				{
					Model.OnViewportSizeChanged(Math.Floor(e.ViewportWidth), Math.Floor(e.ViewportHeight), notify: true);
				}
				if (e.HorizontalChange != 0.0 || e.VerticalChange != 0.0)
				{
					Model.ScrollTo(e.HorizontalOffset, e.VerticalOffset);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				_processRequestedWorkImmediately = processRequestedWorkImmediately;
			}
		}

		private void OnScrollContainerBoundaryFeedback(object sender, ManipulationBoundaryFeedbackEventArgs e)
		{
			e.Handled = true;
		}

		public void OnViewportHeightChanged(double viewportHeight)
		{
		}

		public void OnViewportWidthChanged(double viewportWidth)
		{
		}

		public void OnContentHeightChanged(double contentHeight)
		{
		}

		public void OnContentWidthChanged(double contentWidth)
		{
		}

		public void OnDetachedFromUI()
		{
		}

		public void OnAttachedToUI()
		{
		}

		public void HideVScrollbar()
		{
		}

		public void HideHScrollbar()
		{
		}

		public void Focus()
		{
		}

		public void CancelInertia()
		{
		}

		public void DetachNativeScroll()
		{
		}

		public void AttachNativeScroll()
		{
		}
	}

		public Scroller()
		{
			_scrollbarBrush = View.GetDefaultScrollbarBrush();
			_horizontalAnimation = new DoubleAnimator(0.0, 1.0, 400);
			_verticalAnimation = new DoubleAnimator(0.0, 1.0, 400);
			_horizontalAnimation.EasingFunction = new CubicEase
			{
				EasingMode = EasingMode.EaseInOut
			};
			_verticalAnimation.EasingFunction = new CubicEase
			{
				EasingMode = EasingMode.EaseInOut
			};
			_horizontalAnimation.PropertyChanged += _horizontalAnimation_PropertyChanged;
			_verticalAnimation.PropertyChanged += _verticalAnimation_PropertyChanged;
		}

		internal bool OnKeyDown(Key key, bool isShiftPressed, bool isCtrlPressed)
		{
			return key switch
			{
				Key.Next => OnPageDown(isShiftPressed, isCtrlPressed), 
				Key.Prior => OnPageUp(isShiftPressed, isCtrlPressed), 
				Key.Down => OnDownArrow(isShiftPressed, isCtrlPressed), 
				Key.Up => OnUpArrow(isShiftPressed, isCtrlPressed), 
				Key.Left => OnLeftArrow(isShiftPressed, isCtrlPressed), 
				Key.Right => OnRightArrow(isShiftPressed, isCtrlPressed), 
				Key.Home => OnHome(isShiftPressed, isCtrlPressed), 
				Key.End => OnEnd(isShiftPressed, isCtrlPressed), 
				Key.Tab => OnTab(isShiftPressed, isCtrlPressed), 
				Key.Return => OnEnter(isShiftPressed, isCtrlPressed), 
				Key.Escape => OnEscape(), 
				Key.F2 => OnF2(), 
				Key.Space => OnSpace(isShiftPressed, isCtrlPressed), 
				_ => OnKey(key, isShiftPressed, isCtrlPressed), 
			};
		}

		private bool OnSpace(bool isShiftPressed, bool isCtrlPressed)
		{
			if (KeyboardListener != null && KeyboardListener.OnSpace(isShiftPressed, isCtrlPressed))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool OnF2()
		{
			if (KeyboardListener != null && KeyboardListener.OnF2())
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool OnEscape()
		{
			if (KeyboardListener != null && KeyboardListener.OnEscape())
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool OnTab(bool isShiftPressed, bool isCtrlPressed)
		{
			if (KeyboardListener != null && KeyboardListener.OnTab(isShiftPressed, isCtrlPressed))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool OnEnd(bool isShiftPressed, bool isCtrlPressed)
		{
			if (KeyboardListener != null && KeyboardListener.OnEnd(isShiftPressed, isCtrlPressed))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool OnHome(bool isShiftPressed, bool isCtrlPressed)
		{
			if (KeyboardListener != null && KeyboardListener.OnHome(isShiftPressed, isCtrlPressed))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool OnRightArrow(bool isShiftPressed, bool isCtrlPressed)
		{
			if (KeyboardListener != null && KeyboardListener.OnRightArrow(isShiftPressed, isCtrlPressed))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (ScrollLeft + ViewportWidth >= ContentWidth)
			{
				return false;
			}
			ScrollBy(ActualSmallHorizontalChange, 0.0);
			return true;
		}

		private bool OnLeftArrow(bool isShiftPressed, bool isCtrlPressed)
		{
			if (KeyboardListener != null && KeyboardListener.OnLeftArrow(isShiftPressed, isCtrlPressed))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (ScrollLeft <= 0.0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			ScrollBy(ActualSmallHorizontalChange * -1.0, 0.0);
			return true;
		}

		private bool OnUpArrow(bool isShiftPressed, bool isCtrlPressed)
		{
			if (KeyboardListener != null && KeyboardListener.OnUpArrow(isShiftPressed, isCtrlPressed))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (ScrollTop <= 0.0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			ScrollBy(0.0, ActualSmallVerticalChange * -1.0);
			return true;
		}

		private bool OnDownArrow(bool isShiftPressed, bool isCtrlPressed)
		{
			if (KeyboardListener != null && KeyboardListener.OnDownArrow(isShiftPressed, isCtrlPressed))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (ScrollTop + ViewportHeight >= ContentHeight)
			{
				return false;
			}
			ScrollBy(0.0, ActualSmallVerticalChange);
			return true;
		}

		private bool OnPageUp(bool isShiftPressed, bool isCtrlPressed)
		{
			if (KeyboardListener != null && KeyboardListener.OnPageUp(isShiftPressed, isCtrlPressed))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (ScrollTop < 0.0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			ScrollBy(0.0, ActualLargeVerticalChange * -1.0);
			return true;
		}

		private bool OnPageDown(bool isShiftPressed, bool isCtrlPressed)
		{
			if (KeyboardListener != null && KeyboardListener.OnPageDown(isShiftPressed, isCtrlPressed))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (ScrollTop + ViewportHeight >= ContentHeight)
			{
				return false;
			}
			ScrollBy(0.0, ActualLargeVerticalChange);
			return true;
		}

		private bool OnEnter(bool isShiftPressed, bool isCtrlPressed)
		{
			if (KeyboardListener != null && KeyboardListener.OnEnter(isShiftPressed, isCtrlPressed))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool OnKey(Key key, bool isShiftPressed, bool isCtrlPressed)
		{
			if (KeyboardListener != null)
			{
				return KeyboardListener.OnKeyDown(key, isShiftPressed, isCtrlPressed);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void OnPropertyUpdated(string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
			}
			PropertyUpdatedOverride(propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
		}

		protected virtual void PropertyUpdatedOverride(string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "ContentWidth":
			{
				View.OnContentWidthChanged(ContentWidth);
				double num3 = (double)newValue;
				double num4 = (double)oldValue;
				if (num3 < num4 && ScrollLeft + ViewportWidth >= num3)
				{
					ScrollByImmediate(num3 - (ScrollLeft + ViewportWidth), 0.0);
				}
				UpdateHScrollbar();
				break;
			}
			case "ContentHeight":
			{
				View.OnContentHeightChanged(ContentHeight);
				double num = (double)newValue;
				double num2 = (double)oldValue;
				if (num < num2 && ScrollTop > 0.0 && ScrollTop + ViewportHeight >= num)
				{
					ScrollByImmediate(0.0, num - (ScrollTop + ViewportHeight));
				}
				UpdateVScrollbar();
				break;
			}
			case "ScrollTop":
				if (!SuspendScrollUpdates)
				{
					View.UpdateScrollTop(ScrollTop);
				}
				break;
			case "ScrollLeft":
				if (!SuspendScrollUpdates)
				{
					View.UpdateScrollLeft(ScrollLeft);
				}
				break;
			case "ViewportWidth":
				View.OnViewportWidthChanged(ViewportWidth);
				if (double.IsNaN(LargeVerticalChange))
				{
					ActualLargeHorizontalChange = ViewportWidth;
				}
				if (ContentWidth > 0.0 && ScrollLeft + ViewportWidth > ContentWidth)
				{
					ScrollByImmediate(ContentWidth - ViewportWidth - ScrollLeft, 0.0);
				}
				UpdateHScrollbar();
				if (View.GetInitialScrollLeft() != ScrollLeft)
				{
					View.UpdateScrollLeft(ScrollLeft);
				}
				break;
			case "ViewportHeight":
				View.OnViewportHeightChanged(ViewportHeight);
				if (double.IsNaN(LargeVerticalChange))
				{
					ActualLargeVerticalChange = ViewportHeight;
				}
				UpdateVScrollbar();
				if (View.GetInitialScrollTop() != ScrollTop)
				{
					View.UpdateScrollTop(ScrollTop);
				}
				break;
			case "ScrollbarBrush":
			case "ScrollbarSpan":
			case "MinScrollbarSize":
			case "VerticalTrackStartInset":
				UpdateVScrollbar();
				UpdateHScrollbar();
				break;
			case "HorizontalScrollbarStatus":
			case "VerticalOpacity":
				View.UpdateScrollbarStatus(styleChange: false);
				break;
			case "ScrollbarStyle":
				View.UpdateScrollbarStatus(styleChange: true);
				break;
			}
		}

		internal void OnVBarDelta(double dist)
		{
			double num = Math.Max(MinScrollbarSize, ActualVerticalScrollbarHeight);
			double num2 = VerticalTrackStartInset + num / 2.0;
			double num3 = ViewportHeight - num / 2.0;
			double deltaY = dist / (num3 - num2) * (ContentHeight - ViewportHeight);
			ScrollBy(0.0, deltaY);
		}

		internal void OnHBarDelta(double dist)
		{
			double num = Math.Max(MinScrollbarSize, ActualHorizontalScrollbarWidth);
			double num2 = 0.0 + num / 2.0;
			double num3 = ViewportWidth - num / 2.0;
			double deltaX = dist / (num3 - num2) * (ContentWidth - ViewportWidth);
			ScrollBy(deltaX, 0.0);
		}

		internal void OnViewportSizeChanged(double width, double height, bool notify = false)
		{
			double viewportWidth = _viewportWidth;
			double viewportHeight = _viewportHeight;
			_viewportWidth = width;
			_viewportHeight = height;
			if (notify && (viewportWidth != width || viewportHeight != height))
			{
				OnPropertyUpdated("ViewportWidth", viewportWidth, width);
				OnPropertyUpdated("ViewportHeight", viewportHeight, height);
			}
		}

		public void ProvideContainer(object container)
		{
			View.ProvideContainer(container);
			_scrollTop = View.GetInitialScrollTop();
			_scrollLeft = View.GetInitialScrollLeft();
			UpdateHScrollbar();
			UpdateVScrollbar();
		}

		[DontObfuscate]
		internal void OnDetachedFromUI()
		{
			View.OnDetachedFromUI();
		}

		[DontObfuscate]
		internal void OnAttachedToUI()
		{
			View.OnAttachedToUI();
		}

		public void ProvideContent(object content)
		{
			View.ProvideContent(content);
		}

		internal bool OnMouseWheel(Point point, double deltaX, double deltaY)
		{
			_isScrollDirectionLocked = false;
			_isHorizontalExclusive = false;
			_isVerticalExclusive = false;
			View.CancelInertia();
			if (KeyboardListener != null)
			{
				KeyboardListener.OnWheel();
			}
			ScrollBy(deltaX, deltaY);
			return true;
		}

		public void Focus()
		{
			View.Focus();
		}

		internal void OnDragStarted(Point point)
		{
			View.Focus();
			_isVerticalExclusive = false;
			_isHorizontalExclusive = false;
			_isScrollDirectionLocked = false;
			_isDragging = true;
			_previousDragPosition = new Point(point.X, point.Y);
		}

		internal void OnDragDelta(Point point)
		{
			if (!_isDragging)
			{
				return;
			}
			double num = point.Y - _previousDragPosition.Y;
			double num2 = point.X - _previousDragPosition.X;
			if (LockScrollDirection && !_isScrollDirectionLocked)
			{
				_isScrollDirectionLocked = true;
				if (num > 0.0 || num2 > 0.0)
				{
					if (num > num2)
					{
						_isVerticalExclusive = true;
					}
					else
					{
						_isVerticalExclusive = true;
					}
				}
			}
			_previousDragPosition = new Point(point.X, point.Y);
			ScrollBy(0.0 - num2, 0.0 - num);
		}

		public void ScrollTo(double x, double y)
		{
			View.DetachNativeScroll();
			_pendingScrollX = x - ScrollLeft;
			_pendingScrollY = y - ScrollTop;
			QueueUpdate();
		}

		private void ScrollBy(double deltaX, double deltaY)
		{
			View.DetachNativeScroll();
			_pendingScrollX += deltaX;
			_pendingScrollY += deltaY;
			QueueUpdate();
		}

		private void ScrollByImmediate(double deltaX, double deltaY)
		{
			View.DetachNativeScroll();
			_pendingScrollX += deltaX;
			_pendingScrollY += deltaY;
			Update();
		}

		private void QueueUpdate()
		{
			if (!_pendingUpdate)
			{
				_pendingUpdate = true;
				View.RequestWork(Update);
			}
		}

		private void Update()
		{
			_pendingUpdate = false;
			double deltaX = _pendingScrollX;
			double deltaY = _pendingScrollY;
			_pendingScrollX = 0.0;
			_pendingScrollY = 0.0;
			if (_isScrollDirectionLocked)
			{
				if (_isVerticalExclusive)
				{
					deltaX = 0.0;
				}
				if (_isHorizontalExclusive)
				{
					deltaY = 0.0;
				}
			}
			if (deltaX != 0.0)
			{
				_killHTimer = false;
				ActivateHorizontalScrollbar();
				DeactivateHorizontalScrollbar();
				_killHTimer = true;
			}
			if (deltaY != 0.0)
			{
				_killVTimer = false;
				ActivateVerticalScrollbar();
				DeactivateVerticalScrollbar();
				_killVTimer = true;
			}
			double num = Math.Round(ScrollTop + deltaY);
			double num2 = Math.Round(ScrollLeft + deltaX);
			if (num < 0.0)
			{
				num = 0.0;
				View.CancelInertia();
			}
			if (num2 < 0.0)
			{
				num2 = 0.0;
				View.CancelInertia();
			}
			if (num + ViewportHeight > ContentHeight)
			{
				num = ContentHeight - ViewportHeight;
				if (num < 0.0)
				{
					num = 0.0;
				}
				View.CancelInertia();
			}
			if (num2 + ViewportWidth > ContentWidth)
			{
				num2 = ContentWidth - ViewportWidth;
				if (num2 < 0.0)
				{
					num2 = 0.0;
				}
				View.CancelInertia();
			}
			deltaY = num - ScrollTop;
			deltaX = num2 - ScrollLeft;
			if (deltaY == 0.0 && deltaX == 0.0)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				SuspendScrollUpdates = true;
				IgnoreScrollUpdates = true;
				ScrollTop = num;
				ScrollLeft = num2;
				UpdateVScrollbar();
				UpdateHScrollbar();
				IgnoreScrollUpdates = false;
				if (!IsScrolling)
				{
					IsScrolling = true;
					if (this.OnScrollStart != null)
					{
						this.OnScrollStart(this, new ScrollerScrollingEventArgs
						{
							DeltaX = deltaX,
							DeltaY = deltaY
						});
					}
				}
				if (this.OnScrolling != null)
				{
					this.OnScrolling(this, new ScrollerScrollingEventArgs
					{
						DeltaX = deltaX,
						DeltaY = deltaY
					});
				}
				if (_timerStates.Count > 0)
				{
					_timerStates[_timerStates.Count - 1] = false;
				}
				_timerStates.Add(item: true);
				ExecutionContext.ExecuteDelayed(delegate
				{
					if (_timerStates[0])
					{
						if (this.OnScrollStop != null)
						{
							this.OnScrollStop(this, new ScrollerScrollingEventArgs
							{
								DeltaX = deltaX,
								DeltaY = deltaY
							});
						}
						IsScrolling = false;
						View.AttachNativeScroll();
					}
					_timerStates.RemoveAt(0);
				}, 50);
			}
			finally
			{
				SuspendScrollUpdates = false;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateVScrollbar()
		{
			UpdateScrollbar(ContentHeight, ViewportHeight, ScrollTop, isVertical: true);
		}

		private void UpdateHScrollbar()
		{
			UpdateScrollbar(ContentWidth, ViewportWidth, ScrollLeft, isVertical: false);
		}

		private void UpdateScrollbar(double contentSize, double viewportSize, double scrollStart, bool isVertical)
		{
			double num = Math.Round(viewportSize / contentSize * viewportSize);
			double num2 = (isVertical ? VerticalTrackStartInset : 0.0);
			num -= num2;
			if (num < MinScrollbarSize)
			{
				num = MinScrollbarSize;
			}
			if (num >= viewportSize - num2)
			{
				if (isVertical)
				{
					View.HideVScrollbar();
				}
				else
				{
					View.HideHScrollbar();
				}
				return;
			}
			double num3 = num2 + num / 2.0;
			double num4 = viewportSize - num / 2.0;
			double num5 = scrollStart / (contentSize - viewportSize);
			double trackPosition = Math.Round(num3 + (num4 - num3) * num5);
			if (isVertical)
			{
				ActualVerticalScrollbarHeight = num;
				View.UpdateVScrollbar(trackPosition, num);
			}
			else
			{
				ActualHorizontalScrollbarWidth = num;
				View.UpdateHScrollbar(trackPosition, num);
			}
		}

		internal void OnDragCompleted(Point point)
		{
			_isScrollDirectionLocked = false;
			_isHorizontalExclusive = false;
			_isVerticalExclusive = false;
			_isDragging = false;
		}

		private void _horizontalAnimation_PropertyChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			HorizontalScrollbarStatus = FromHorizontalStatus + _horizontalAnimation.TransitionProgress * (ToHorizontalStatus - FromHorizontalStatus);
		}

		private void _verticalAnimation_PropertyChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			VerticalScrollbarStatus = FromVerticalStatus + _verticalAnimation.TransitionProgress * (ToVerticalStatus - FromVerticalStatus);
		}

		internal void ActivateHorizontalScrollbar()
		{
			if (_hActive)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (ScrollbarStyle == ScrollbarStyle.Fading || ScrollbarStyle == ScrollbarStyle.Thin)
			{
				if (_horizontalAnimation.AnimationActive())
				{
					_horizontalAnimation.Stop();
				}
				HorizontalScrollbarStatus = 1.0;
				if (_hRunning && _killHTimer)
				{
					_hRunning = false;
				}
			}
			_hActive = true;
		}

		internal void ActivateVerticalScrollbar()
		{
			if (_vActive)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (ScrollbarStyle == ScrollbarStyle.Fading || ScrollbarStyle == ScrollbarStyle.Thin)
			{
				if (_verticalAnimation.AnimationActive())
				{
					_verticalAnimation.Stop();
				}
				VerticalScrollbarStatus = 1.0;
				if (_vRunning && _killVTimer)
				{
					_vRunning = false;
				}
			}
			_vActive = true;
		}

		internal void DeactivateHorizontalScrollbar()
		{
			if (_hActive && !IsDraggingHBar)
			{
				if (ScrollbarStyle == ScrollbarStyle.Fading || ScrollbarStyle == ScrollbarStyle.Thin)
				{
					StartHTimer();
				}
				_hActive = false;
			}
		}

		internal void DeactivateVerticalScrollbar()
		{
			if (_vActive && !IsDraggingVBar)
			{
				if (ScrollbarStyle == ScrollbarStyle.Fading || ScrollbarStyle == ScrollbarStyle.Thin)
				{
					StartVTimer();
				}
				_vActive = false;
			}
		}

		private void StartHTimer()
		{
			if (!_hRunning)
			{
				_hRunning = true;
				_hStartTime = ExecutionContext.GetCurrentRelativeTime();
				ExecutionContext.ExecuteDelayed(CheckHTimer, _deactivateDuration);
			}
			else
			{
				_hStartTime = ExecutionContext.GetCurrentRelativeTime();
			}
		}

		private void StartVTimer()
		{
			if (!_vRunning)
			{
				_vRunning = true;
				_vStartTime = ExecutionContext.GetCurrentRelativeTime();
				ExecutionContext.ExecuteDelayed(CheckVTimer, _deactivateDuration);
			}
			else
			{
				_vStartTime = ExecutionContext.GetCurrentRelativeTime();
			}
		}

		private void CheckHTimer()
		{
			if (!_hRunning)
			{
				return;
			}
			long currentRelativeTime = ExecutionContext.GetCurrentRelativeTime();
			if (currentRelativeTime - _hStartTime >= _deactivateDuration)
			{
				if (!_horizontalAnimation.AnimationActive() && HorizontalScrollbarStatus != 0.0)
				{
					FromHorizontalStatus = HorizontalScrollbarStatus;
					ToHorizontalStatus = 0.0;
					_horizontalAnimation.Start();
				}
				_hRunning = false;
			}
			else
			{
				ExecutionContext.ExecuteDelayed(CheckHTimer, (int)(_deactivateDuration - (currentRelativeTime - _hStartTime)));
			}
		}

		private void CheckVTimer()
		{
			if (!_vRunning)
			{
				return;
			}
			long currentRelativeTime = ExecutionContext.GetCurrentRelativeTime();
			if (currentRelativeTime - _vStartTime >= _deactivateDuration)
			{
				if (!_verticalAnimation.AnimationActive() && VerticalScrollbarStatus != 0.0)
				{
					FromVerticalStatus = VerticalScrollbarStatus;
					ToVerticalStatus = 0.0;
					_verticalAnimation.Start();
				}
				_vRunning = false;
			}
			else
			{
				ExecutionContext.ExecuteDelayed(CheckVTimer, (int)(_deactivateDuration - (currentRelativeTime - _vStartTime)));
			}
		}
	}
	[DontObfuscate]
	internal delegate void ScrollerScrollingEventHandler(object sender, ScrollerScrollingEventArgs args);
	[DontObfuscate]
	internal class ScrollerScrollingEventArgs : EventArgs
	{
		public double DeltaX { get; set; }

		public double DeltaY { get; set; }
	}

namespace Infragistics.Controls.Description
{
	public class JsonSchemaEmitter
	{
		private Dictionary<string, Type> _descriptionMap = new Dictionary<string, Type>();

		private Dictionary<string, List<string>> _descendants = new Dictionary<string, List<string>>();

		private JsonDictionaryObject _schema;

		private TypeDescriptionContext _context;

		public JsonSchemaEmitter(Type[] types, CodeGenerationLibrary library = null)
		{
			ComponentRenderer componentRenderer = new ComponentRenderer();
			TypeDescriptionContext context = componentRenderer.Context;
			Assembly[] assemblies = AppDomain.CurrentDomain.GetAssemblies();
			Type[] types2;
			foreach (Assembly assembly in assemblies)
			{
				Module[] modules;
				if (assembly.GetName().Name.StartsWith("InfragisticsWPF4"))
				{
					modules = assembly.GetModules();
					for (int j = 0; j < modules.Length; j++)
					{
						modules[j].GetType();
					}
				}
				if (!assembly.GetName().Name.StartsWith("InfragisticsWPF4.DataVisualization"))
				{
					continue;
				}
				modules = assembly.GetModules();
				for (int j = 0; j < modules.Length; j++)
				{
					types2 = modules[j].GetTypes();
					foreach (Type type in types2)
					{
						if (type.Name.EndsWith("DescriptionMetadata"))
						{
							MethodInfo method = type.GetMethod("Register");
							if (method != null)
							{
								method.Invoke(null, new object[1] { context });
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			_context = componentRenderer.Context;
			types2 = types;
			foreach (Type type2 in types2)
			{
				if (type2.Name.EndsWith("Description"))
				{
					_descriptionMap.Add(type2.Name, type2);
				}
			}
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			Type type3 = _descriptionMap["Description"];
			foreach (Type value2 in _descriptionMap.Values)
			{
				if (!type3.IsAssignableFrom(value2))
				{
					list.Add(value2.Name);
				}
			}
			foreach (string item2 in list)
			{
				_descriptionMap.Remove(item2);
			}
			foreach (Type value3 in _descriptionMap.Values)
			{
				_descendants[value3.Name] = new List<string>();
				foreach (Type value4 in _descriptionMap.Values)
				{
					if (!value4.IsAbstract && value3.IsAssignableFrom(value4) && value3 != value4)
					{
						_descendants[value3.Name].Add(value4.Name);
					}
				}
			}
			JsonDictionaryObject jsonDictionaryObject = new JsonDictionaryObject
			{

		private JsonDictionaryItem StringValue(string v)
		{
			return new JsonDictionaryValue
			{
				Type = JsonDictionaryValueType.StringValue,
				Value = v
			};
		}

		private JsonDictionaryObject GetDefinition(Type type)
		{
			JsonDictionaryObject jsonDictionaryObject = new JsonDictionaryObject();
			JsonDictionaryObject jsonDictionaryObject2 = (JsonDictionaryObject)(jsonDictionaryObject["properties"] = new JsonDictionaryObject());
			List<string> list = new List<string> { "type" };
			jsonDictionaryObject2["type"] = new JsonDictionaryObject
			{
				["type"] = StringValue("string"),
				["const"] = StringValue(ToName(type.Name))
			};
			jsonDictionaryObject["additionalProperties"] = BoolValue(v: false);
			jsonDictionaryObject["name"] = new JsonDictionaryObject { ["type"] = StringValue("string") };
			WriteProps(type, jsonDictionaryObject2, list);
			jsonDictionaryObject["required"] = new JsonDictionaryArray
			{
				Items = list.Select((string i) => StringValue(i)).ToArray()
			};
			return jsonDictionaryObject;
		}

		private JsonDictionaryItem BoolValue(bool v)
		{
			return new JsonDictionaryValue
			{
				Type = JsonDictionaryValueType.BooleanValue,
				Value = v
			};
		}

		private void WriteProps(Type type, JsonDictionaryObject props, List<string> required)
		{
			if (type.Name != "Description" && type.BaseType != null)
			{
				WriteProps(type.BaseType, props, required);
			}
			PropertyInfo[] properties = type.GetProperties();
			foreach (PropertyInfo prop in properties)
			{
				WriteProperty(type, prop, props);
			}
		}

		private void WriteProperty(Type type, PropertyInfo prop, JsonDictionaryObject props)
		{
			TypeDescriptionMetadata metadata = _context.GetMetadata(ToName(type.Name), prop.Name);
			if (metadata == null && prop.Name == "Name")
			{
				WriteSimpleProp(type, prop, metadata, props, "string");
			}
			else if (metadata != null || !(prop.Name == "Type"))
			{
				switch (metadata.KnownType)
				{
				case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Array:
					WriteArrayProp(type, prop, metadata, props);
					break;
				case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Boolean:
					WriteSimpleProp(type, prop, metadata, props, "boolean");
					break;
				case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Brush:
					WriteRefProp(type, prop, metadata, props, "Brush");
					break;
				case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.BrushCollection:
					WriteRefProp(type, prop, metadata, props, "BrushCollection");
					break;
				case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Collection:
					WriteArrayProp(type, prop, metadata, props);
					break;
				case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Color:
					WriteRefProp(type, prop, metadata, props, "Color");
					break;
				case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.ColorCollection:
					WriteRefProp(type, prop, metadata, props, "ColorCollection");
					break;
				case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.DataRef:
					WriteRefProp(type, prop, metadata, props, "DataRef");
					break;
				case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.DataTemplate:
					WriteRefProp(type, prop, metadata, props, "DataTemplate");
					break;
				case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Date:
					WriteRefProp(type, prop, metadata, props, "Date");
					break;
				case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.EventRef:
					WriteRefProp(type, prop, metadata, props, "EventRef");
					break;
				case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.ExportedType:
					WritePublicTypeProp(type, prop, metadata, props);
					break;
				case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.IList:
					WriteRefProp(type, prop, metadata, props, "DataRef");
					break;
				case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.MethodRef:
					WriteRefProp(type, prop, metadata, props, "MethodRef");
					break;
				case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Number:
					WriteSimpleProp(type, prop, metadata, props, "number");
					break;
				case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Point:
					WriteRefProp(type, prop, metadata, props, "Point");
					break;
				case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Rect:
					WriteRefProp(type, prop, metadata, props, "Rect");
					break;
				case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Size:
					WriteRefProp(type, prop, metadata, props, "Size");
					break;
				case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.String:
					WriteSimpleProp(type, prop, metadata, props, "string");
					break;
				case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.TimeSpan:
					WriteSimpleProp(type, prop, metadata, props, "number");
					break;
				case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Unknown:
					WriteRefProp(type, prop, metadata, props, "Any");
					break;
				case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Void:
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private void WritePublicTypeProp(Type type, PropertyInfo prop, TypeDescriptionMetadata meta, JsonDictionaryObject props)
		{
			bool flag = true;
			if (meta.SpecificExternalType == null)
			{
				WriteSimpleProp(type, prop, meta, props, "object");
				return;
			}
			if (meta.SpecificExternalType == "string")
			{
				string[] enumNames = _context.GetEnumNames(ToName(type.Name), prop.Name);
				if (enumNames != null)
				{
					JsonDictionaryObject jsonDictionaryObject = new JsonDictionaryObject();
					jsonDictionaryObject["type"] = StringValue("string");
					JsonDictionaryArray jsonDictionaryArray = (JsonDictionaryArray)(jsonDictionaryObject["enum"] = new JsonDictionaryArray());
					List<JsonDictionaryItem> list = new List<JsonDictionaryItem>();
					string[] array = enumNames;
					foreach (string v in array)
					{
						list.Add(StringValue(v));
					}
					jsonDictionaryArray.Items = list.ToArray();
					props[CodeGeneratingComponentRenderer.Camelify(prop.Name)] = jsonDictionaryObject;
				}
				else
				{
					WriteSimpleProp(type, prop, meta, props, "string");
				}
				return;
			}
			string text = meta.SpecificExternalType + "Description";
			if (text.StartsWith("Xam"))
			{
				text = text.Replace("Xam", "");
			}
			if (text.StartsWith("CellModel"))
			{
				text = text.Replace("CellModel", "CellInfo");
			}
			if (text.StartsWith("CellModel"))
			{
				text = text.Replace("CellModel", "CellInfo");
			}
			if (text.StartsWith("ShapefileConverter"))
			{
				text = text.Replace("ShapefileConverter", "ShapeDataSource");
			}
			if (text == "GridDescription")
			{
				text = "DataGridDescription";
			}
			if (text == "IFilterExpressionDescription")
			{
				text = "FilterExpressionDescription";
			}
			_ = meta.SpecificExternalType;
			if (!_descriptionMap.ContainsKey(text) && _descriptionMap.ContainsKey(meta.SpecificExternalType + "Description"))
			{
				text = meta.SpecificExternalType + "Description";
				_ = meta.SpecificExternalType;
			}
			if (_descendants.ContainsKey(text) && _descendants[text].Count > 0)
			{
				if (_descriptionMap.ContainsKey(text) && _descriptionMap[text].IsAbstract)
				{
					flag = false;
				}
				List<string> list2 = new List<string>();
				foreach (string item in _descendants[text])
				{
					list2.Add(ToRef(ToName(item)));
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					list2.Add(ToRef(meta.SpecificExternalType));
				}
				JsonDictionaryArray jsonDictionaryArray2 = new JsonDictionaryArray();
				List<JsonDictionaryItem> list3 = new List<JsonDictionaryItem>();
				foreach (string item2 in list2)
				{
					JsonDictionaryObject jsonDictionaryObject2 = new JsonDictionaryObject();
					jsonDictionaryObject2["$ref"] = StringValue(item2);
					list3.Add(jsonDictionaryObject2);
				}
				jsonDictionaryArray2.Items = list3.ToArray();
				JsonDictionaryObject jsonDictionaryObject3 = new JsonDictionaryObject();
				jsonDictionaryObject3["anyOf"] = jsonDictionaryArray2;
				props[CodeGeneratingComponentRenderer.Camelify(prop.Name)] = jsonDictionaryObject3;
			}
			else
			{
				WriteRefProp(type, prop, meta, props, ToName(text));
			}
		}

		private void WriteRefProp(Type type, PropertyInfo prop, TypeDescriptionMetadata meta, JsonDictionaryObject props, string v)
		{
			JsonDictionaryObject jsonDictionaryObject = new JsonDictionaryObject();
			jsonDictionaryObject["$ref"] = StringValue(ToRef(v));
			props[CodeGeneratingComponentRenderer.Camelify(prop.Name)] = jsonDictionaryObject;
		}

		private void WriteSimpleProp(Type type, PropertyInfo prop, TypeDescriptionMetadata meta, JsonDictionaryObject props, string v)
		{
			JsonDictionaryObject jsonDictionaryObject = new JsonDictionaryObject();
			jsonDictionaryObject["type"] = StringValue(v);
			props[CodeGeneratingComponentRenderer.Camelify(prop.Name)] = jsonDictionaryObject;
		}

		private void WriteArrayProp(Type type, PropertyInfo prop, TypeDescriptionMetadata meta, JsonDictionaryObject props)
		{
			bool flag = true;
			if (meta.CollectionElementType != null)
			{
				string key = meta.CollectionElementType + "Description";
				string d = meta.CollectionElementType;
				if (!_descriptionMap.ContainsKey(key) && _descriptionMap.ContainsKey(meta.SpecificExternalType + "Description"))
				{
					key = meta.SpecificExternalType + "Description";
					d = meta.SpecificExternalType;
				}
				if (_descendants.ContainsKey(key) && _descendants[key].Count > 0)
				{
					if (_descriptionMap.ContainsKey(key) && _descriptionMap[key].IsAbstract)
					{
						flag = false;
					}
					List<string> list = new List<string>();
					foreach (string item in _descendants[key])
					{
						list.Add(ToRef(ToName(item)));
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						list.Add(ToRef(d));
					}
					JsonDictionaryArray jsonDictionaryArray = new JsonDictionaryArray();
					List<JsonDictionaryItem> list2 = new List<JsonDictionaryItem>();
					foreach (string item2 in list)
					{
						JsonDictionaryObject jsonDictionaryObject = new JsonDictionaryObject();
						jsonDictionaryObject["$ref"] = StringValue(item2);
						list2.Add(jsonDictionaryObject);
					}
					jsonDictionaryArray.Items = list2.ToArray();
					JsonDictionaryObject jsonDictionaryObject2 = new JsonDictionaryObject();
					JsonDictionaryObject jsonDictionaryObject3 = new JsonDictionaryObject();
					jsonDictionaryObject2["type"] = StringValue("array");
					jsonDictionaryObject2["items"] = jsonDictionaryObject3;
					jsonDictionaryObject3["anyOf"] = jsonDictionaryArray;
					props[CodeGeneratingComponentRenderer.Camelify(prop.Name)] = jsonDictionaryObject2;
					return;
				}
				JsonDictionaryObject jsonDictionaryObject4 = new JsonDictionaryObject();
				JsonDictionaryObject jsonDictionaryObject5 = new JsonDictionaryObject();
				jsonDictionaryObject4["type"] = StringValue("array");
				jsonDictionaryObject4["items"] = jsonDictionaryObject5;
				if (meta.CollectionElementType == "String")
				{
					jsonDictionaryObject5["type"] = StringValue("string");
				}
				else if (meta.CollectionElementType == "Object")
				{
					jsonDictionaryObject5["type"] = StringValue("object");
				}
				else if (meta.CollectionElementType == "Int32")
				{
					jsonDictionaryObject5["type"] = StringValue("integer");
				}
				else
				{
					if (meta.SpecificExternalType == "string")
					{
						string[] enumNames = _context.GetEnumNames(ToName(type.Name), prop.Name);
						if (enumNames != null)
						{
							jsonDictionaryObject5["type"] = StringValue("string");
							JsonDictionaryArray jsonDictionaryArray2 = (JsonDictionaryArray)(jsonDictionaryObject5["enum"] = new JsonDictionaryArray());
							List<JsonDictionaryItem> list3 = new List<JsonDictionaryItem>();
							string[] array = enumNames;
							foreach (string v in array)
							{
								list3.Add(StringValue(v));
							}
							jsonDictionaryArray2.Items = list3.ToArray();
							props[CodeGeneratingComponentRenderer.Camelify(prop.Name)] = jsonDictionaryObject4;
						}
						else
						{
							WriteSimpleProp(type, prop, meta, props, "string");
						}
						return;
					}
					jsonDictionaryObject5["$ref"] = StringValue(ToRef(d));
				}
				props[CodeGeneratingComponentRenderer.Camelify(prop.Name)] = jsonDictionaryObject4;
			}
			else
			{
				JsonDictionaryObject jsonDictionaryObject6 = new JsonDictionaryObject();
				JsonDictionaryObject jsonDictionaryObject7 = new JsonDictionaryObject();
				jsonDictionaryObject6["type"] = StringValue("array");
				jsonDictionaryObject6["items"] = jsonDictionaryObject7;
				jsonDictionaryObject7["type"] = ToArrayType(meta);
				props[CodeGeneratingComponentRenderer.Camelify(prop.Name)] = jsonDictionaryObject6;
			}
		}

		private JsonDictionaryItem ToArrayType(TypeDescriptionMetadata meta)
		{
			if (meta.SpecificType == "int" || meta.SpecificType == "double")
			{
				return StringValue("number");
			}
			_ = meta.SpecificType == "string";
			return StringValue("string");
		}

		private string ToRef(string d)
		{
			return "#/definitions/" + d;
		}

		private string ToName(string d)
		{
			string text = d;
			if (text.EndsWith("Description"))
			{
				text = text.Substring(0, text.Length - "Description".Length);
			}
			if (text == "")
			{
				text = "Description";
			}
			return text;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return _schema.ToJson();
		}
	}
	internal class WPFComponentRendererAdapter : IComponentRendererAdapter
	{
		private Dictionary<string, Type> _qualifiedNames = new Dictionary<string, Type>();

		internal Type GetTypeFromName(string type, TypeDescriptionContext context)
		{
			TypeDescriptionMetadata metadata = context.GetMetadata(type, "_qualifiedName");
			if (_qualifiedNames.ContainsKey(type))
			{
				return _qualifiedNames[type];
			}
			Assembly[] assemblies;
			if (metadata != null)
			{
				string text = metadata.SpecificExternalType;
				if (text == "Infragistics.Controls.Grids.XamDataGrid")
				{
					text = "Infragistics.Controls.XamDataGrid";
				}
				Type type2 = Type.GetType(text);
				if (type2 != null && type2.Assembly != null && type2.Assembly.FullName.Contains(".Excel"))
				{
					type2 = null;
				}
				if (type2 == null)
				{
					assemblies = AppDomain.CurrentDomain.GetAssemblies();
					foreach (Assembly assembly in assemblies)
					{
						if (!assembly.FullName.Contains("Infragistics") || assembly.FullName.Contains(".Excel"))
						{
							continue;
						}
						try
						{
							Type[] types = assembly.GetTypes();
							foreach (Type type3 in types)
							{
								if (type3.FullName == text)
								{
									_qualifiedNames[type] = type3;
									return type3;
								}
							}
						}
						catch
						{
						}
					}
				}
				return type2;
			}
			assemblies = AppDomain.CurrentDomain.GetAssemblies();
			foreach (Assembly assembly2 in assemblies)
			{
				if (!assembly2.FullName.Contains("Infragistics") || assembly2.FullName.Contains(".Excel"))
				{
					continue;
				}
				try
				{
					Type[] types = assembly2.GetTypes();
					foreach (Type type4 in types)
					{
						if (type4.IsPublic && type4.Name == type)
						{
							_qualifiedNames[type] = type4;
							return type4;
						}
					}
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
			assemblies = AppDomain.CurrentDomain.GetAssemblies();
			foreach (Assembly assembly3 in assemblies)
			{
				try
				{
					Type[] types = assembly3.GetTypes();
					foreach (Type type5 in types)
					{
						if (type5.Namespace != null && type5.Namespace.StartsWith("System") && type5.Name == type)
						{
							_qualifiedNames[type] = type5;
							return type5;
						}
					}
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public Type GetObjectType(string type, TypeDescriptionContext context)
		{
			return GetTypeFromName(type, context);
		}

		public Type GetDescriptionObjectType(string type, TypeDescriptionContext context)
		{
			return GetTypeFromName(type + "Description", context);
		}

		public object CreateColorCollection(object[] colors)
		{
			ObservableCollection<Color> observableCollection = new ObservableCollection<Color>();
			for (int i = 0; i < colors.Length; i++)
			{
				observableCollection.Add((Color)colors[i]);
			}
			return observableCollection;
		}

		public object CreateBrushCollection(object[] brushes)
		{
			BrushCollection brushCollection = new BrushCollection();
			for (int i = 0; i < brushes.Length; i++)
			{
				brushCollection.Add((Brush)brushes[i]);
			}
			return brushCollection;
		}

		public object CreateObject(string type, object container, TypeDescriptionContext context)
		{
			Type objectType = GetObjectType(type, context);
			if (objectType == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return Activator.CreateInstance(objectType);
		}

		public object CoerceToEnum(string type, TypeDescriptionContext context, string value)
		{
			Type objectType = GetObjectType(type, context);
			if (objectType != null && objectType.IsEnum)
			{
				return Enum.Parse(objectType, value);
			}
			return value;
		}

		public void OnUIThread(object container, Action action)
		{
			Panel panel = (Panel)container;
			if (panel.Dispatcher.Thread == Thread.CurrentThread)
			{
				action();
			}
			else
			{
				panel.Dispatcher.Invoke(DispatcherPriority.Normal, action);
			}
		}

		public void SetOrUpdateCollectionOnTarget(object container, string propertyName, TypeDescriptionMetadata propertyMetadata, TypeDescriptionContext context, object target, object value)
		{
			object propertyValue = GetPropertyValue(target, propertyName);
			if (propertyValue == null)
			{
				IList list = (IList)CreateObject(propertyMetadata.SpecificType, container, context);
				IList list2 = (IList)value;
				for (int i = 0; i < list2.Count; i++)
				{
					list.Add(list2[i]);
				}
				SetPropertyValue(target, propertyName, propertyMetadata, list, null, null);
			}
			else
			{
				IList list3 = (IList)value;
				IList list4 = (IList)propertyValue;
				list4.Clear();
				for (int j = 0; j < list3.Count; j++)
				{
					list4.Add(list3[j]);
				}
			}
		}

		private bool IsFrozen(object val)
		{
			if (val == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (val is Freezable)
			{
				return ((Freezable)val).IsFrozen;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void OnPendingRef(object target, string propertyName, TypeDescriptionMetadata propertyMetadata, DescriptionRef sourceRef)
		{
		}

		public void SetPropertyValue(object target, string propertyName, TypeDescriptionMetadata propertyMetadata, object value, object oldValue, DescriptionRef sourceRef)
		{
			while (propertyName.Contains("."))
			{
				string[] array = propertyName.Split('.');
				object propertyValue = GetPropertyValue(target, array[0]);
				if (propertyValue != null && !IsFrozen(propertyValue))
				{
					propertyName = "";
					for (int i = 1; i < array.Length; i++)
					{
						if (i > 1)
						{
							propertyName += ".";
						}
						propertyName += array[i];
					}
					target = propertyValue;
					continue;
				}
				propertyValue = Activator.CreateInstance(GetPropertyType(target, array[0]));
				SetPropertyValue(target, array[0], propertyMetadata, propertyValue, null, sourceRef);
				propertyName = "";
				for (int j = 1; j < array.Length; j++)
				{
					if (j > 1)
					{
						propertyName += ".";
					}
					propertyName += array[j];
				}
				target = propertyValue;
			}
			PropertyInfo property = target.GetType().GetProperty(propertyName);
			if (property == null && propertyName.EndsWith("TextColor"))
			{
				property = target.GetType().GetProperty(propertyName.Replace("TextColor", "Foreground"));
			}
			if (property == null)
			{
				EventInfo eventInfo = target.GetType().GetEvent(propertyName);
				if (eventInfo != null)
				{
					if (value != null && value is Delegate)
					{
						eventInfo.AddEventHandler(target, (Delegate)value);
					}
					else if (value == null && oldValue != null)
					{
						eventInfo.RemoveEventHandler(target, (Delegate)oldValue);
					}
				}
				return;
			}
			if (property.PropertyType.IsArray && value != null)
			{
				Type type = value.GetType();
				if (type.HasElementType && type.GetElementType() != property.PropertyType.GetElementType())
				{
					Array array2 = (Array)value;
					Array array3 = Array.CreateInstance(property.PropertyType.GetElementType(), array2.Length);
					for (int k = 0; k < array2.Length; k++)
					{
						array3.SetValue(array2.GetValue(k), k);
					}
					value = array3;
				}
			}
			property.SetValue(target, value, null);
		}

		public object GetPropertyValue(object target, string propertyName)
		{
			while (propertyName.Contains("."))
			{
				string[] array = propertyName.Split('.');
				object propertyValue = GetPropertyValue(target, array[0]);
				if (propertyValue != null)
				{
					propertyName = "";
					for (int i = 1; i < array.Length; i++)
					{
						if (i > 1)
						{
							propertyName += ".";
						}
						propertyName += array[i];
					}
					target = propertyValue;
					continue;
				}
				propertyValue = Activator.CreateInstance(GetPropertyType(target, array[0]));
				for (int j = 1; j < array.Length; j++)
				{
					if (j > 1)
					{
						propertyName += ".";
					}
					propertyName += array[j];
				}
				target = propertyValue;
			}
			return target.GetType().GetProperty(propertyName).GetValue(target, null);
		}

		public object GetRootObject(object container)
		{
			Panel panel = (Panel)container;
			if (panel.Children.Count <= 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return panel.Children[0];
		}

		private Type GetPropertyType(object target, string propertyName)
		{
			return target.GetType().GetProperty(propertyName).PropertyType;
		}

		public void ClearContainer(object container, TypeDescriptionContext context, Action<bool> continueActions)
		{
			Panel panel = (Panel)container;
			if (panel.Children.Count > 0)
			{
				_ = panel.Children[0];
			}
			panel.Children.Clear();
			continueActions(obj: false);
		}

		public void ForPropertyValueItem(object target, string propertyName, Action<object> forItem)
		{
			object propertyValue = GetPropertyValue(target, propertyName);
			if (propertyValue is IList)
			{
				IList list = (IList)propertyValue;
				for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
				{
					forItem(list[i]);
				}
			}
			else if (propertyValue is Array)
			{
				object[] array = (object[])propertyValue;
				for (int j = 0; j < array.Length; j++)
				{
					forItem(array[j]);
				}
			}
		}

		public void ClearCollection(object target, string propertyName, TypeDescriptionMetadata metadata)
		{
			object propertyValue = GetPropertyValue(target, propertyName);
			if (propertyValue is IList && !(propertyValue is Array))
			{
				((IList)propertyValue).Clear();
			}
			else if (propertyValue is Array)
			{
				SetPropertyValue(target, propertyName, metadata, null, propertyValue, null);
			}
		}

		public void AddItemToCollection(string propertyName, TypeDescriptionMetadata propertyMetadata, object target, int newIndex, object item)
		{
			object propertyValue = GetPropertyValue(target, propertyName);
			Type propertyType = GetPropertyType(target, propertyName);
			propertyType.GetElementType();
			if (propertyValue is IList && !(propertyValue is Array))
			{
				((IList)propertyValue).Insert(newIndex, item);
			}
			else if (propertyValue is Array)
			{
				IList list = (IList)propertyValue;
				List<object> list2 = new List<object>();
				for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
				{
					list2.Add(list[i]);
				}
				list2.Insert(newIndex, item);
				object[] array = (object[])Activator.CreateInstance(propertyType, list.Count + 1);
				for (int j = 0; j < array.Length; j++)
				{
					array[j] = list2[j];
				}
				SetPropertyValue(target, propertyName, propertyMetadata, array, propertyValue, null);
			}
		}

		public void ResetPropertyOnTarget(object container, string propertyName, TypeDescriptionMetadata propertyMetadata, object target)
		{
			while (propertyName.Contains("."))
			{
				string[] array = propertyName.Split('.');
				object propertyValue = GetPropertyValue(target, array[0]);
				if (propertyValue != null && !IsFrozen(propertyValue))
				{
					propertyName = "";
					for (int i = 1; i < array.Length; i++)
					{
						if (i > 1)
						{
							propertyName += ".";
						}
						propertyName += array[i];
					}
					target = propertyValue;
					continue;
				}
				propertyValue = Activator.CreateInstance(GetPropertyType(target, array[0]));
				SetPropertyValue(target, array[0], propertyMetadata, propertyValue, null, null);
				propertyName = "";
				for (int j = 1; j < array.Length; j++)
				{
					if (j > 1)
					{
						propertyName += ".";
					}
					propertyName += array[j];
				}
				target = propertyValue;
			}
			FieldInfo field = target.GetType().GetField(propertyName + "Property");
			if (field == null && propertyName.EndsWith("TextColor"))
			{
				field = target.GetType().GetField(propertyName.Replace("TextColor", "Foreground") + "Property");
			}
			if (field != null)
			{
				DependencyProperty dp = (DependencyProperty)field.GetValue(null);
				((DependencyObject)target).ClearValue(dp);
			}
		}

		public void ReplaceItemInCollection(string propertyName, TypeDescriptionMetadata propertyMetadata, object target, int newIndex, object item)
		{
			object propertyValue = GetPropertyValue(target, propertyName);
			Type propertyType = GetPropertyType(target, propertyName);
			propertyType.GetElementType();
			if (propertyValue is IList)
			{
				((IList)propertyValue)[newIndex] = item;
			}
			else if (propertyValue is Array)
			{
				IList list = (IList)propertyValue;
				List<object> list2 = new List<object>();
				for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
				{
					list2.Add(list[i]);
				}
				list2[newIndex] = item;
				object[] array = (object[])Activator.CreateInstance(propertyType, list.Count + 1);
				for (int j = 0; j < array.Length; j++)
				{
					array[j] = list2[j];
				}
				SetPropertyValue(target, propertyName, propertyMetadata, array, propertyValue, null);
			}
		}

		public void ReplaceRootItem(object container, string type, TypeDescriptionContext context, Action<bool> continueActions)
		{
			object obj = CreateObject(type, container, context);
			Panel panel = (Panel)container;
			if (panel.Children.Count > 0)
			{
				_ = panel.Children[0];
			}
			panel.Children.Clear();
			if (obj is UIElement)
			{
				panel.Children.Add((UIElement)obj);
			}
			continueActions(obj: false);
		}

		public void RemoveItemFromCollection(string propertyName, TypeDescriptionMetadata propertyMetadata, object target, int oldIndex)
		{
			object propertyValue = GetPropertyValue(target, propertyName);
			Type propertyType = GetPropertyType(target, propertyName);
			propertyType.GetElementType();
			if (propertyValue is IList && !(propertyValue is Array))
			{
				((IList)propertyValue).RemoveAt(oldIndex);
			}
			else if (propertyValue is Array)
			{
				IList list = (IList)propertyValue;
				List<object> list2 = new List<object>();
				for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
				{
					list2.Add(list[i]);
				}
				list2.RemoveAt(oldIndex);
				object[] array = (object[])Activator.CreateInstance(propertyType, list.Count - 1);
				for (int j = 0; j < array.Length; j++)
				{
					array[j] = list2[j];
				}
				SetPropertyValue(target, propertyName, propertyMetadata, array, propertyValue, null);
			}
		}

		public void RemoveRootItem(object container, TypeDescriptionContext context, Action<bool> continueActions)
		{
			Panel panel = (Panel)container;
			if (panel.Children.Count > 0)
			{
				_ = panel.Children[0];
			}
			panel.Children.Clear();
			continueActions(obj: false);
		}

		public void FlushChanges(object container)
		{
		}
	}
	[DontHide]
	[DontObfuscate]
	public class CodeGenerationLibrary
	{
		private List<CodeGenerationLibraryItem> _items = new List<CodeGenerationLibraryItem>();

		private Dictionary<string, CodeGenerationLibraryItem> _itemsByName = new Dictionary<string, CodeGenerationLibraryItem>();

		public static CodeGenerationLibrary FromFolder(string path)
		{
			CodeGenerationLibrary codeGenerationLibrary = new CodeGenerationLibrary();
			if (Directory.Exists(path))
			{
				DirectoryInfo directoryInfo = new DirectoryInfo(path);
				DirectoryInfo[] directories = directoryInfo.GetDirectories();
				foreach (DirectoryInfo directoryInfo2 in directories)
				{
					_ = directoryInfo.Name;
					codeGenerationLibrary.AddItemFromFolder(directoryInfo2.Name, directoryInfo2.FullName);
				}
			}
			return codeGenerationLibrary;
		}

		public void AddItemFromFolder(string name, string fullName)
		{
			CodeGenerationLibraryItem codeGenerationLibraryItem = new CodeGenerationLibraryItem();
			codeGenerationLibraryItem.Name = name;
			codeGenerationLibraryItem.Type = GetItemType(fullName);
			if (Directory.Exists(fullName))
			{
				FileInfo[] files = new DirectoryInfo(fullName).GetFiles();
				foreach (FileInfo fileInfo in files)
				{
					codeGenerationLibraryItem.AddPlatformsFromFile(fileInfo.FullName);
				}
			}
			_items.Add(codeGenerationLibraryItem);
			_itemsByName.Add(codeGenerationLibraryItem.Name, codeGenerationLibraryItem);
		}

		private CodeGenerationLibraryItemType GetItemType(string fullName)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			if (Directory.Exists(fullName))
			{
				FileInfo[] files = new DirectoryInfo(fullName).GetFiles();
				foreach (FileInfo fileInfo in files)
				{
					if (fileInfo.Extension == ".json")
					{
						flag = true;
						break;
					}
					if (File.ReadAllText(fileInfo.FullName).Contains("//begin data"))
					{
						flag = true;
						break;
					}
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					return CodeGenerationLibraryItemType.Data;
				}
				return CodeGenerationLibraryItemType.EventHandler;
			}
			return CodeGenerationLibraryItemType.Unknown;
		}

		public static CodeGenerationLibrary FromJson(string json)
		{
			JsonDictionaryItem jsonDictionaryItem = new JsonDictionaryParser().Parse(json);
			CodeGenerationLibrary codeGenerationLibrary = new CodeGenerationLibrary();
			if (jsonDictionaryItem is JsonDictionaryObject)
			{
				JsonDictionaryObject jsonDictionaryObject = (JsonDictionaryObject)jsonDictionaryItem;
				if (jsonDictionaryObject.ContainsKey("items") && jsonDictionaryObject["items"] is JsonDictionaryArray { Items: var items })
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < items.Length; i++)
					{
						CodeGenerationLibraryItem codeGenerationLibraryItem = CodeGenerationLibraryItem.FromJson(items[i]);
						codeGenerationLibrary._items.Add(codeGenerationLibraryItem);
						codeGenerationLibrary._itemsByName.Add(codeGenerationLibraryItem.Name, codeGenerationLibraryItem);
					}
				}
			}
			return codeGenerationLibrary;
		}

		public string ToJson()
		{
			JsonDictionaryObject jsonDictionaryObject = new JsonDictionaryObject();
			JsonDictionaryArray jsonDictionaryArray = (JsonDictionaryArray)(jsonDictionaryObject["items"] = new JsonDictionaryArray());
			List<JsonDictionaryItem> list = new List<JsonDictionaryItem>();
			foreach (CodeGenerationLibraryItem item2 in _items)
			{
				JsonDictionaryItem item = item2.ToJson();
				list.Add(item);
			}
			jsonDictionaryArray.Items = list.ToArray();
			return jsonDictionaryObject.ToJson();
		}

		public bool HasItem(string name)
		{
			return _itemsByName.ContainsKey(name);
		}

		public string[] GetKeys()
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			foreach (string key in _itemsByName.Keys)
			{
				list.Add(key);
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		public CodeGenerationLibraryItem GetItem(string name)
		{
			return _itemsByName[name];
		}
	}
	[DontHide]
	[DontObfuscate]
	public class CodeGenerationLibraryItem
	{
		private Dictionary<CodeGenerationLibraryItemPlatform, CodeGenerationLibraryItemContent> _contentByPlatform = new Dictionary<CodeGenerationLibraryItemPlatform, CodeGenerationLibraryItemContent>();

		private List<CodeGenerationLibraryItemContent> _content = new List<CodeGenerationLibraryItemContent>();

		private Dictionary<string, CodeGenerationLibraryItemPlatform> _platformMap;

		public string Name { get; set; }

		public CodeGenerationLibraryItemType Type { get; set; }

		public CodeGenerationLibraryItemContent GetContentForPlatformString(string platform)
		{
			CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms platform2 = (CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms)Enum.Parse(typeof(CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms), platform, ignoreCase: true);
			return GetContentForPlatform(platform2);
		}

		public CodeGenerationLibraryItemContent GetContentForPlatform(CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms platform)
		{
			foreach (CodeGenerationLibraryItemContent item in _content)
			{
				if (PlatformMatches(item, platform))
				{
					return item;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private bool PlatformMatches(CodeGenerationLibraryItemContent content, CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms platform)
		{
			switch (content.Platform)
			{
			case CodeGenerationLibraryItemPlatform.All:
				return true;
			case CodeGenerationLibraryItemPlatform.AllWeb:
				if (platform != CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms.Angular && platform != CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms.React)
				{
					return platform == CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms.WebComponents;
				}
				return true;
			case CodeGenerationLibraryItemPlatform.Angular:
				return platform == CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms.Angular;
			case CodeGenerationLibraryItemPlatform.Desktop:
				if (platform != CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms.WPF)
				{
					return platform == CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms.WindowsForms;
				}
				return true;
			case CodeGenerationLibraryItemPlatform.JQuery:
				return false;
			case CodeGenerationLibraryItemPlatform.React:
				return platform == CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms.React;
			case CodeGenerationLibraryItemPlatform.Unknown:
				return false;
			case CodeGenerationLibraryItemPlatform.Web:
				if (platform != CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms.Angular && platform != CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms.React)
				{
					return platform == CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms.WebComponents;
				}
				return true;
			case CodeGenerationLibraryItemPlatform.WebComponents:
				return platform == CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms.WebComponents;
			case CodeGenerationLibraryItemPlatform.Win:
				if (platform != CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms.WPF)
				{
					return platform == CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms.WindowsForms;
				}
				return true;
			case CodeGenerationLibraryItemPlatform.WindowsForms:
				return platform == CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms.WindowsForms;
			case CodeGenerationLibraryItemPlatform.WPF:
				return platform == CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms.WPF;
			case CodeGenerationLibraryItemPlatform.XPlat:
				return true;
