			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		public void AddPlatformContent(CodeGenerationLibraryItemPlatform platform, CodeGenerationLibraryItemContent content)
		{
			if (content != null)
			{
				_contentByPlatform[platform] = content;
				content.Platform = platform;
				_content.Add(content);
			}
		}

		private CodeGenerationLibraryItemContent BasicContent(string content)
		{
			if (content == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new CodeGenerationLibraryItemContent
			{
				Content = content
			};
		}

		private CodeGenerationLibraryItemContent JsonContent(string content)
		{
			if (content == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new CodeGenerationLibraryItemContent
			{
				Content = content,
				IsJson = true
			};
		}

		internal static CodeGenerationLibraryItem FromJson(JsonDictionaryItem item)
		{
			CodeGenerationLibraryItem codeGenerationLibraryItem = new CodeGenerationLibraryItem();
			if (item is JsonDictionaryObject)
			{
				JsonDictionaryObject jsonDictionaryObject = (JsonDictionaryObject)item;
				if (jsonDictionaryObject.ContainsKey("name"))
				{
					codeGenerationLibraryItem.Name = ((JsonDictionaryValue)jsonDictionaryObject["name"]).Value.ToString();
				}
				if (jsonDictionaryObject.ContainsKey("type"))
				{
					string value = ((JsonDictionaryValue)jsonDictionaryObject["type"]).Value.ToString();
					CodeGenerationLibraryItemType type = (CodeGenerationLibraryItemType)Enum.Parse(typeof(CodeGenerationLibraryItemType), value, ignoreCase: true);
					codeGenerationLibraryItem.Type = type;
				}
				if (jsonDictionaryObject.ContainsKey("content"))
				{
					JsonDictionaryItem jsonDictionaryItem = jsonDictionaryObject["content"];
					if (jsonDictionaryItem is JsonDictionaryArray)
					{
						JsonDictionaryArray jsonDictionaryArray = (JsonDictionaryArray)jsonDictionaryItem;
						if (jsonDictionaryArray.Items != null && jsonDictionaryArray.Items.Length != 0)
						{
							for (int i = 0; i < jsonDictionaryArray.Items.Length; i++)
							{
								CodeGenerationLibraryItemContent codeGenerationLibraryItemContent = CodeGenerationLibraryItemContent.FromJson(jsonDictionaryArray.Items[i]);
								codeGenerationLibraryItem._content.Add(codeGenerationLibraryItemContent);
								codeGenerationLibraryItem._contentByPlatform.Add(codeGenerationLibraryItemContent.Platform, codeGenerationLibraryItemContent);
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return codeGenerationLibraryItem;
		}

		internal JsonDictionaryItem ToJson()
		{
			JsonDictionaryObject jsonDictionaryObject = new JsonDictionaryObject();
			jsonDictionaryObject["name"] = new JsonDictionaryValue
			{
				Type = JsonDictionaryValueType.StringValue,
				Value = Name
			};
			JsonDictionaryArray jsonDictionaryArray = (JsonDictionaryArray)(jsonDictionaryObject["content"] = new JsonDictionaryArray());
			jsonDictionaryObject["type"] = new JsonDictionaryValue
			{
				Type = JsonDictionaryValueType.StringValue,
				Value = Type.ToString()
			};
			List<JsonDictionaryItem> list = new List<JsonDictionaryItem>();
			foreach (CodeGenerationLibraryItemContent item2 in _content)
			{
				JsonDictionaryItem item = item2.ToJson();
				list.Add(item);
			}
			jsonDictionaryArray.Items = list.ToArray();
			return jsonDictionaryObject;
		}

		public void AddPlatformsFromFile(string fullName)
		{
			switch (Type)
			{
			case CodeGenerationLibraryItemType.Data:
				AddPlatformsFromFileForData(fullName);
				break;
			case CodeGenerationLibraryItemType.EventHandler:
				AddPlatformsFromFileForEventHandler(fullName);
				break;
			case CodeGenerationLibraryItemType.Unknown:
				break;
			}
		}

		private void AddPlatformsFromFileForEventHandler(string fullName)
		{
			CodeGenerationLibraryItemPlatform platformFromFile = GetPlatformFromFile(fullName);
			CodeGenerationLibraryItemContent content = ExtractEventHandlerContent(fullName);
			AddPlatformContent(platformFromFile, content);
		}

		private void AddPlatformsFromFileForData(string fullName)
		{
			CodeGenerationLibraryItemPlatform platformFromFile = GetPlatformFromFile(fullName);
			CodeGenerationLibraryItemContent content = ExtractDataContent(fullName);
			AddPlatformContent(platformFromFile, content);
		}

		private CodeGenerationLibraryItemContent ExtractDataContent(string fullName)
		{
			if (File.Exists(fullName))
			{
				string text = File.ReadAllText(fullName);
				if (System.IO.Path.GetExtension(fullName) == ".json")
				{
					JsonDictionaryItem obj = new JsonDictionaryParser().Parse(text);
					return GetDataContentFromJson(obj);
				}
				Match match = new Regex("(?:(<!--)|(\\/\\/))\\s*begin data(?:(\\s*-->)?)[\\w\\W\\r\\n]*?(?:(<!--)|(\\/\\/))\\s*end data(?:(\\s*-->)?)").Match(text);
				if (!match.Success)
				{
					return BasicContent(text);
				}
				return BasicContent(match.Value);
			}
			return null;
		}

		private CodeGenerationLibraryItemContent GetDataContentFromJson(JsonDictionaryItem obj)
		{
			if (obj is JsonDictionaryArray)
			{
				return JsonContent(obj.ToJson());
			}
			if (obj is JsonDictionaryObject)
			{
				JsonDictionaryObject jsonDictionaryObject = (JsonDictionaryObject)obj;
				if (jsonDictionaryObject.ContainsKey("data"))
				{
					return JsonContent(jsonDictionaryObject["data"].ToJson());
				}
				return JsonContent(jsonDictionaryObject.ToJson());
			}
			return null;
		}

		private CodeGenerationLibraryItemContent ExtractEventHandlerContent(string fullName)
		{
			if (File.Exists(fullName))
			{
				string text = File.ReadAllText(fullName);
				Match match = new Regex("(?:(<!--)|(\\/\\/))\\s*begin imports(?:(\\s*-->)?)([\\w\\W\\r\\n]*?)(?:(<!--)|(\\/\\/))\\s*end imports(?:(\\s*-->)?)").Match(text);
				Match match2 = new Regex("(?:(<!--)|(\\/\\/))\\s*begin eventHandler(?:(\\s*-->)?)([\\w\\W\\r\\n]*?)(?:(<!--)|(\\/\\/))\\s*end eventHandler(?:(\\s*-->)?)").Match(text);
				string text2 = text;
				string value = null;
				text2 = (match2.Success ? match2.Groups[4].Value : text);
				if (match.Success)
				{
					value = match.Groups[4].Value;
				}
				return new CodeGenerationLibraryItemContent
				{
					IsJson = true,
					Content = new JsonDictionaryObject
					{
						["imports"] = new JsonDictionaryValue
						{
							Type = JsonDictionaryValueType.StringValue,
							Value = value
						},
						["handler"] = new JsonDictionaryValue
						{
							Type = JsonDictionaryValueType.StringValue,
							Value = text2
						}
					}.ToJson()
				};
			}
			return null;
		}

		private CodeGenerationLibraryItemPlatform GetPlatformFromFile(string fullName)
		{
			if (_platformMap == null)
			{
				_platformMap = new Dictionary<string, CodeGenerationLibraryItemPlatform>();
				FieldInfo[] fields = typeof(CodeGenerationLibraryItemPlatform).GetFields();
				foreach (FieldInfo fieldInfo in fields)
				{
					if (fieldInfo.IsPublic && !fieldInfo.IsSpecialName)
					{
						_platformMap[fieldInfo.Name.ToLower()] = (CodeGenerationLibraryItemPlatform)fieldInfo.GetValue(null);
					}
				}
			}
			if (File.Exists(fullName))
			{
				string fileNameWithoutExtension = System.IO.Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(fullName);
				if (_platformMap.ContainsKey(fileNameWithoutExtension.ToLower()))
				{
					return _platformMap[fileNameWithoutExtension.ToLower()];
				}
			}
			return CodeGenerationLibraryItemPlatform.Unknown;
		}
	}
	[DontHide]
	[DontObfuscate]
	public class CodeGenerationLibraryItemContent
	{
		public CodeGenerationLibraryItemPlatform Platform { get; set; }

		public string Content { get; set; }

		public bool IsJson { get; set; }

		internal static CodeGenerationLibraryItemContent FromJson(JsonDictionaryItem item)
		{
			CodeGenerationLibraryItemContent codeGenerationLibraryItemContent = new CodeGenerationLibraryItemContent();
			if (item is JsonDictionaryObject)
			{
				JsonDictionaryObject jsonDictionaryObject = (JsonDictionaryObject)item;
				if (jsonDictionaryObject.ContainsKey("platform"))
				{
					JsonDictionaryValue plat = (JsonDictionaryValue)jsonDictionaryObject["platform"];
					codeGenerationLibraryItemContent.Platform = ParsePlatform(plat);
				}
				if (jsonDictionaryObject.ContainsKey("content"))
				{
					JsonDictionaryValue jsonDictionaryValue = (JsonDictionaryValue)jsonDictionaryObject["content"];
					codeGenerationLibraryItemContent.Content = (string)jsonDictionaryValue.Value;
				}
				if (jsonDictionaryObject.ContainsKey("isJson"))
				{
					JsonDictionaryValue jsonDictionaryValue2 = (JsonDictionaryValue)jsonDictionaryObject["isJson"];
					codeGenerationLibraryItemContent.IsJson = (bool)jsonDictionaryValue2.Value;
				}
			}
			return codeGenerationLibraryItemContent;
		}

		internal JsonDictionaryItem ToJson()
		{
			return new JsonDictionaryObject
			{
				["platform"] = new JsonDictionaryValue
				{
					Type = JsonDictionaryValueType.StringValue,
					Value = Platform.ToString()
				},
				["content"] = new JsonDictionaryValue
				{
					Type = JsonDictionaryValueType.StringValue,
					Value = Content
				},
				["isJson"] = new JsonDictionaryValue
				{
					Type = JsonDictionaryValueType.BooleanValue,
					Value = IsJson
				}
			};
		}

		private static CodeGenerationLibraryItemPlatform ParsePlatform(JsonDictionaryValue plat)
		{
			if (Enum.TryParse<CodeGenerationLibraryItemPlatform>((string)plat.Value, ignoreCase: true, out var result))
			{
				return result;
			}
			return CodeGenerationLibraryItemPlatform.Unknown;
		}
	}
	[DontHide]
	[DontObfuscate]
	public enum CodeGenerationLibraryItemType
	{
		Data,
		EventHandler,
		Unknown
	}
	[DontHide]
	[DontObfuscate]
	public enum CodeGenerationLibraryItemPlatform
	{
		Angular,
		React,
		WebComponents,
		JQuery,
		WPF,
		WindowsForms,
		Web,
		AllWeb,
		Desktop,
		Win,
		XPlat,
		All,
		Unknown
	}
	internal class ReactMarkupCodeGeneratingComponentRendererCodeEmitter : CodeGeneratingComponentRendererCodeEmitter
	{
		private HashSet<string> _boundItems = new HashSet<string>();

		private HashSet<string> _imports = new HashSet<string>();

		protected override bool UseRgba => true;

		protected override string Prefix => "Igr";

		public ReactMarkupCodeGeneratingComponentRendererCodeEmitter(CodeGenerationRendererOptions options, CodeGeneratingRendererResult result)
			: base(options, result)
		{
		}

		protected override string GetArrayLiteral(CodeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo val)
		{
			if (val.Value == null)
			{
				return "{null}";
			}
			object[] array = (object[])val.Value;
			string text = "[";
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				if (i > 0)
				{
					text += ", ";
				}
				text = text + "\"" + array[i].ToString() + "\"";
			}
			return text + "]";
		}

		public override void BeginType(string typeName)
		{
			base.BeginType(typeName);
			base.Writer.WriteLine(("<" + ToMarkupName(typeName)) ?? "");
			base.Writer.IncreaseIndent();
			if (!_boundItems.Contains(base.CurrentName))
			{
				_boundItems.Add(base.CurrentName);
				if (!_imports.Contains(base.CurrentTypeName))
				{
					_imports.Add(base.CurrentTypeName);
					AddTypeImport(base.CurrentTypeName);
				}
				base.BindingFieldsWriter.WriteLine("private " + CodeGeneratingComponentRenderer.Camelify(base.CurrentName) + ": " + base.CurrentTypeName);
				if (base.IsRoot)
				{
					base.BindingFieldsWriter.WriteLine("private " + CodeGeneratingComponentRenderer.Camelify(base.CurrentName) + "Ref(r: " + base.CurrentTypeName + ") {");
					base.BindingFieldsWriter.IncreaseIndent();
					base.BindingFieldsWriter.WriteLine("this." + CodeGeneratingComponentRenderer.Camelify(base.CurrentName) + " = r;");
					base.BindingFieldsWriter.WriteLine("this.setState({});");
					base.BindingFieldsWriter.DecreaseIndent();
					base.BindingFieldsWriter.WriteLine("}");
					base.BindingInitCodeWriter.WriteLine("this." + CodeGeneratingComponentRenderer.Camelify(base.CurrentName) + "Ref = this." + CodeGeneratingComponentRenderer.Camelify(base.CurrentName) + "Ref.bind(this);");
				}
			}
		}

		private string ToMarkupName(string typeName)
		{
			if (typeName.EndsWith("Component"))
			{
				typeName = typeName.Substring(0, typeName.Length - "Component".Length);
			}
			return CodeGeneratingComponentRenderer.Pascalify(typeName);
		}

		public override void StartSubProperties()
		{
			if (!base.IsRoot && !base.HasCurrentName)
			{
				string anonName = GetAnonName();
				base.Writer.WriteLine("");
				base.Writer.WriteLine("name=\"" + anonName + "\"");
			}
			base.Writer.DecreaseIndent();
			base.Writer.WriteLine(">");
			base.Writer.IncreaseIndent();
		}

		private string GetAnonName()
		{
			string anonName = CodeGeneratingComponentRenderer.Camelify(base.CurrentTypeName.Replace(Prefix, "").Replace("Component", ""));
			return base.Result.Decollide(anonName);
		}

		protected override string GetEventReference(CodeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo val)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(val.SourceRef.Name))
			{
				TrackBinding(val);
				if (!_boundItems.Contains(val.SourceRef.Name))
				{
					base.BindingInitCodeWriter.WriteLine("this." + CodeGeneratingComponentRenderer.Camelify(val.SourceRef.Name) + " = this." + CodeGeneratingComponentRenderer.Camelify(val.SourceRef.Name) + ".bind(this);");
				}
				return "this." + CodeGeneratingComponentRenderer.Camelify(val.SourceRef.Name);
			}
			return GetNullString();
		}

		public override void EndType(string typeName)
		{
			base.Writer.DecreaseIndent();
			base.Writer.WriteLine("</" + ToMarkupName(typeName) + ">");
			base.EndType(typeName);
		}

		public override void EmitProperty(int simplePropCount, string prop, CodeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo val, TypeDescriptionContext context)
		{
			string text = CodeGeneratingComponentRenderer.Camelify(prop);
			string text2 = GetValueAsString(val, isPascal: true);
			if (val.MetaData != null && context.HasNameBinding(val.MetaData.OwningType, CodeGeneratingComponentRenderer.Pascalify(val.MetaData.PropertyName)) && IsBinding(val))
			{
				TrackBinding(val);
				if (simplePropCount > 0)
				{
					base.Writer.WriteLine("");
				}
				if (val.SourceRef == null || val.SourceRef.Name == null)
				{
					base.Writer.Write(text + "Name={null}");
				}
				else
				{
					base.Writer.Write(text + "Name=\"" + val.SourceRef.Name + "\"");
				}
				return;
			}
			if (!(text == "name") || !base.IsRoot)
			{
				bool flag = val.MetaData != null && val.MetaData.KnownType == TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Array;
				if (IsBinding(val) || flag)
				{
					TrackBinding(val);
					text2 = "{" + text2 + "}";
				}
				if (simplePropCount > 0)
				{
					base.Writer.WriteLine("");
				}
				base.Writer.Write(text);
				base.Writer.Write("=");
				if (!IsBinding(val) && !flag)
				{
					base.Writer.Write("\"");
				}
				base.Writer.Write(text2);
				if (!IsBinding(val) && !flag)
				{
					base.Writer.Write("\"");
				}
				simplePropCount++;
			}
			if (text == "name" && base.IsRoot)
			{
				if (simplePropCount > 0)
				{
					base.Writer.WriteLine("");
				}
				base.Writer.Write("ref={this." + CodeGeneratingComponentRenderer.Camelify(GetValueAsString(val, isPascal: true)) + "Ref}");
			}
		}

		protected override object ResolveSpecialValue(CodeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo val)
		{
			CodeGenerationSpecialValue codeGenerationSpecialValue = (CodeGenerationSpecialValue)val.Value;
			return codeGenerationSpecialValue.Type switch
			{
				CodeGenerationSpecialValueType.Color => codeGenerationSpecialValue.Value, 
				CodeGenerationSpecialValueType.FontFamily => codeGenerationSpecialValue.Value, 
				CodeGenerationSpecialValueType.FontStyles => codeGenerationSpecialValue.Value, 
				CodeGenerationSpecialValueType.FontWeights => codeGenerationSpecialValue.Value, 
				_ => codeGenerationSpecialValue.Value, 
			};
		}

		protected override string GetNullString()
		{
			return "null";
		}

		protected override string GetElementBinding(CodeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo val)
		{
			return "this." + CodeGeneratingComponentRenderer.Camelify(val.SourceRef.Name);
		}

		protected override string GetRefBinding(CodeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo val)
		{
			return "this." + CodeGeneratingComponentRenderer.Camelify(val.SourceRef.Name);
		}

		public override void EmitSubProperty(int subPropCount, string prop, CodeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo val, TypeDescriptionContext context)
		{
			if (val.MetaData.KnownType == TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Collection)
			{
				if (!(val.Value is IList list))
				{
					return;
				}
				{
					foreach (object item in list)
					{
						if (item is CodeGenerationItemBuilder)
						{
							((CodeGenerationItemBuilder)item).Emit(this, isRoot: false);
						}
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			if (val.Value is CodeGenerationItemBuilder)
			{
				((CodeGenerationItemBuilder)val.Value).Emit(this, isRoot: false);
			}
		}

		protected override void CollectImportsOverride(List<string> importedTypes, CodeGeneratingImportManager imports)
		{
			base.CollectImportsOverride(importedTypes, imports);
			foreach (string importedType in importedTypes)
			{
				imports.AddPackageImport("igniteui-react-" + base.PackageName, importedType);
			}
		}
	}
	internal class ReactCodeBehindCodeGeneratingComponentRendererCodeEmitter : CodeGeneratingComponentRendererCodeEmitter
	{
		public ReactCodeBehindCodeGeneratingComponentRendererCodeEmitter(CodeGenerationRendererOptions options, CodeGeneratingRendererResult result)
			: base(options, result)
		{
		}
	}
	internal class WebComponentsMarkupCodeGeneratingComponentRendererCodeEmitter : CodeGeneratingComponentRendererCodeEmitter
	{
		private int _numBindings;

		private HashSet<string> _boundItems = new HashSet<string>();

		private HashSet<string> _imports = new HashSet<string>();

		protected override bool UseRgba => true;

		protected override string Prefix => "Igc";

		public WebComponentsMarkupCodeGeneratingComponentRendererCodeEmitter(CodeGenerationRendererOptions options, CodeGeneratingRendererResult result)
			: base(options, result)
		{
		}

		protected override string GetArrayLiteral(CodeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo val)
		{
			if (val.Value == null)
			{
				return "null";
			}
			object[] array = (object[])val.Value;
			string text = "";
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				if (i > 0)
				{
					text += ", ";
				}
				text += array[i];
			}
			return text;
		}

		public override void BeginType(string typeName)
		{
			base.BeginType(typeName);
			base.Writer.WriteLine(("<" + ToMarkupName(typeName)) ?? "");
			if (_boundItems.Contains(base.CurrentName))
			{
				return;
			}
			_boundItems.Add(base.CurrentName);
			if (!_imports.Contains(base.CurrentTypeName))
			{
				_imports.Add(base.CurrentTypeName);
				AddTypeImport(base.CurrentTypeName);
			}
			base.BindingFieldsWriter.WriteLine("private " + CodeGeneratingComponentRenderer.Camelify(base.CurrentName) + ": " + base.CurrentTypeName);
			if (!base.HasCurrentName)
			{
				if (base.IsRoot)
				{
					base.BindingInitCodeWriter.WriteLine("var " + CodeGeneratingComponentRenderer.Camelify(base.CurrentName) + " = this." + CodeGeneratingComponentRenderer.Camelify(base.CurrentName) + " = document.querySelector('" + CodeGeneratingComponentRenderer.Spinalify(base.CurrentTypeName.Replace("Component", "")) + "') as " + base.CurrentTypeName + ";");
				}
			}
			else
			{
				base.BindingInitCodeWriter.WriteLine("var " + CodeGeneratingComponentRenderer.Camelify(base.CurrentName) + " = this." + CodeGeneratingComponentRenderer.Camelify(base.CurrentName) + " = document.getElementById('" + base.CurrentName + "') as " + base.CurrentTypeName + ";");
			}
		}

		private string ToMarkupName(string typeName)
		{
			if (typeName.EndsWith("Component"))
			{
				typeName = typeName.Substring(0, typeName.Length - "Component".Length);
			}
			return CodeGeneratingComponentRenderer.Spinalify(typeName);
		}

		public override void StartSubProperties()
		{
			base.Writer.WriteLine(">");
			base.Writer.IncreaseIndent();
		}

		public override void EndType(string typeName)
		{
			base.Writer.DecreaseIndent();
			base.Writer.WriteLine("</" + ToMarkupName(typeName) + ">");
			base.EndType(typeName);
		}

		protected override void CollectImportsOverride(List<string> importedTypes, CodeGeneratingImportManager imports)
		{
			base.CollectImportsOverride(importedTypes, imports);
			foreach (string importedType in importedTypes)
			{
				imports.AddPackageImport("igniteui-webcomponents-" + base.PackageName, importedType);
			}
		}

		public override void EmitProperty(int simplePropCount, string prop, CodeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo val, TypeDescriptionContext context)
		{
			string text = CodeGeneratingComponentRenderer.Camelify(prop);
			if (IsBinding(val))
			{
				TrackBinding(val);
				if (!_boundItems.Contains(base.CurrentName))
				{
					_boundItems.Add(base.CurrentName);
					if (!_imports.Contains(base.CurrentTypeName))
					{
						_imports.Add(base.CurrentTypeName);
						AddTypeImport(base.CurrentTypeName);
					}
					base.BindingFieldsWriter.WriteLine("private " + CodeGeneratingComponentRenderer.Camelify(base.CurrentName) + ": " + base.CurrentTypeName);
					if (!base.HasCurrentName)
					{
						if (base.IsRoot)
						{
							base.BindingInitCodeWriter.WriteLine("var " + CodeGeneratingComponentRenderer.Camelify(base.CurrentName) + " = this." + CodeGeneratingComponentRenderer.Camelify(base.CurrentName) + " = document.querySelector('" + CodeGeneratingComponentRenderer.Spinalify(base.CurrentTypeName.Replace("Component", "")) + "') as " + base.CurrentTypeName + ";");
						}
					}
					else
					{
						base.BindingInitCodeWriter.WriteLine("var " + CodeGeneratingComponentRenderer.Camelify(base.CurrentName) + " = this." + CodeGeneratingComponentRenderer.Camelify(base.CurrentName) + " = document.getElementById('" + base.CurrentName + "') as " + base.CurrentTypeName + ";");
					}
				}
				string text2 = CodeGeneratingComponentRenderer.Camelify(GetValueAsString(val, isPascal: true));
				if (text2 != "null" && !text2.StartsWith("this."))
				{
					text2 = "this." + text2;
				}
				base.BindingCodeWriter.WriteLine(CodeGeneratingComponentRenderer.Camelify(base.CurrentName) + "." + text + " = " + text2);
			}
			else
			{
				if (simplePropCount > 0)
				{
					base.Writer.WriteLine("");
				}
				base.Writer.Write(CodeGeneratingComponentRenderer.Spinalify(text));
				base.Writer.Write("=");
				base.Writer.Write("\"");
				base.Writer.Write(GetValueAsString(val, isPascal: true));
				base.Writer.Write("\"");
				if (text == "name")
				{
					base.Writer.WriteLine("");
					base.Writer.Write("id =\"" + GetValueAsString(val, isPascal: true) + "\"");
				}
			}
		}

		protected override object ResolveSpecialValue(CodeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo val)
		{
			CodeGenerationSpecialValue codeGenerationSpecialValue = (CodeGenerationSpecialValue)val.Value;
			return codeGenerationSpecialValue.Type switch
			{
				CodeGenerationSpecialValueType.Color => codeGenerationSpecialValue.Value, 
				CodeGenerationSpecialValueType.FontFamily => codeGenerationSpecialValue.Value, 
				CodeGenerationSpecialValueType.FontStyles => codeGenerationSpecialValue.Value, 
				CodeGenerationSpecialValueType.FontWeights => codeGenerationSpecialValue.Value, 
				_ => codeGenerationSpecialValue.Value, 
			};
		}

		protected override string GetNullString()
		{
			return "null";
		}

		protected override string GetElementBinding(CodeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo val)
		{
			return CodeGeneratingComponentRenderer.Camelify(val.SourceRef.Name);
		}

		protected override string GetRefBinding(CodeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo val)
		{
			return CodeGeneratingComponentRenderer.Camelify(val.SourceRef.Name);
		}

		protected override string GetEventReference(CodeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo val)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(val.SourceRef.Name))
			{
				TrackBinding(val);
				if (!_boundItems.Contains(val.SourceRef.Name))
				{
					base.BindingInitCodeWriter.WriteLine("this." + CodeGeneratingComponentRenderer.Camelify(val.SourceRef.Name) + " = this." + CodeGeneratingComponentRenderer.Camelify(val.SourceRef.Name) + ".bind(this);");
				}
				return "this." + CodeGeneratingComponentRenderer.Camelify(val.SourceRef.Name);
			}
			return GetNullString();
		}

		public override void EmitSubProperty(int subPropCount, string prop, CodeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo val, TypeDescriptionContext context)
		{
			if (val.MetaData.KnownType == TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Collection)
			{
				if (!(val.Value is IList list))
				{
					return;
				}
				{
					foreach (object item in list)
					{
						if (item is CodeGenerationItemBuilder)
						{
							((CodeGenerationItemBuilder)item).Emit(this, isRoot: false);
						}
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			if (val.Value is CodeGenerationItemBuilder)
			{
				((CodeGenerationItemBuilder)val.Value).Emit(this, isRoot: false);
			}
		}
	}
	internal class WebComponentsCodeBehindCodeGeneratingComponentRendererCodeEmitter : CodeGeneratingComponentRendererCodeEmitter
	{
		public WebComponentsCodeBehindCodeGeneratingComponentRendererCodeEmitter(CodeGenerationRendererOptions options, CodeGeneratingRendererResult result)
			: base(options, result)
		{
		}
	}
	internal class TSCodeGeneratingComponentRendererHandlerEmitter : CodeGeneratingComponentRendererHandlerEmitter
	{
		private CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms _platform;

		protected string PlatformLower => _platform switch
		{
			CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms.Angular => "angular", 
			CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms.React => "react", 
			CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms.WebComponents => "webcomponents", 
			_ => "", 
		};

		protected string Prefix => _platform switch
		{
			CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms.Angular => "Igx", 
			CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms.React => "Igr", 
			CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms.WebComponents => "Igc", 
			_ => "", 
		};

		public TSCodeGeneratingComponentRendererHandlerEmitter(CodeGenerationRendererOptions options, CodeGeneratingRendererResult result, CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms platform)
			: base(options, result)
		{
			_platform = platform;
		}

		protected override void WriteImport(CodeGeneratingImportManager importsWriter, string str)
		{
			base.WriteImport(importsWriter, str);
			new CodeGeneratingRegexHelper("import {([^}]+)}\\s+from\\s+['\"]([^'\"]+)['\"]").Execute(str, delegate(Func<int, string> getGroup, int start, int length)
			{
				string text = getGroup(1);
				string text2 = getGroup(2);
				text2 = text2.Replace("webcomponents", PlatformLower);
				text2 = text2.Replace("react", PlatformLower);
				text2 = text2.Replace("angular", PlatformLower);
				string[] array = text.Split(',');
				for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
				{
					string text3 = array[i].Trim();
					if (text3.StartsWith("Igc"))
					{
						text3 = Prefix + text3.Substring(3);
					}
					if (text3.StartsWith("Igr"))
					{
						text3 = Prefix + text3.Substring(3);
					}
					if (text3.StartsWith("Igx"))
					{
						text3 = Prefix + text3.Substring(3);
					}
					if (text3.StartsWith("Igr") && text3.EndsWith("Component"))
					{
						text3 = text3.Substring(0, text3.Length - "Component".Length);
					}
					importsWriter.AddPackageImport(text2.Trim(), text3.Trim());
				}
				return (string)null;
			});
		}

		protected override string TransformHandlerCode(string str)
		{
			str = new CodeGeneratingRegexHelper("(Ig[crx])(\\w+)").Execute(str, delegate(Func<int, string> getGroup, int start, int length)
			{
				getGroup(1);
				string text = getGroup(2);
				string text2 = "";
				string prefix = Prefix;
				if (text.EndsWith("Component"))
				{
					text2 = "Component";
					text = text.Substring(0, text.Length - text2.Length);
				}
				if (_platform == CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms.React)
				{
					text2 = "";
				}
				return prefix + text + text2;
			});
			str = new CodeGeneratingRegexHelper("CodeGenHelper\\.getDescription<([^\\]]+)>\\(\"([^\"]*)\"\\)").Execute(str, delegate(Func<int, string> getGroup, int start, int length)
			{
				getGroup(1);
				string name = getGroup(2);
				if (base.Result.HasDescription(name))
				{
					string descriptionField = base.Result.GetDescriptionField(name);
					return "this." + descriptionField;
				}
				return (string)null;
			});
			return str;
		}
	}
	internal class TSCodeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitter : CodeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitter
	{
		private Dictionary<CodeGeneratingCodeWriter, int> _importsCount = new Dictionary<CodeGeneratingCodeWriter, int>();

		protected override string Extension => ".ts";

		public TSCodeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitter(CodeGenerationRendererOptions options, CodeGeneratingRendererResult result)
			: base(options, result)
		{
		}

		protected override string ToTypeName(string name, bool isItem = false)
		{
			name = CodeGeneratingComponentRenderer.Pascalify(name);
			name = name.Replace("-", "_");
			if (isItem)
			{
				name += "Item";
			}
			return name;
		}

		protected override string ToPropertyName(string name)
		{
			name = name.Replace("-", "_");
			return CodeGeneratingComponentRenderer.Camelify(name);
		}

		protected string ToFieldName(string name)
		{
			name = name.Replace("-", "_");
			return "_" + CodeGeneratingComponentRenderer.Camelify(name);
		}

		protected override void StartData(string refName, string[] propertyNames, CodeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterPropertyType[] propertyTypes, CodeGeneratingCodeWriter typeWriter, CodeGeneratingImportManager importsWriter)
		{
			base.StartData(refName, propertyNames, propertyTypes, typeWriter, importsWriter);
			foreach (CodeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterItemType itemType in GetItemTypes(ToTypeName(refName, isItem: true), ToTypeName(refName), propertyNames, propertyTypes))
			{
				EmitItemType(itemType, typeWriter, importsWriter);
			}
			if (importsWriter == base.VmImportsWriter)
			{
				importsWriter.AddPackageImport("./" + ToTypeName(refName), ToTypeName(refName));
			}
			else
			{
				importsWriter.AddPackageImport("./" + ToTypeName(refName), ToTypeName(refName));
			}
			typeWriter.WriteLine("export class " + ToTypeName(refName) + " extends Array<" + ToTypeName(refName, isItem: true) + "> {");
			typeWriter.IncreaseIndent();
			typeWriter.WriteLine("public constructor() {");
			typeWriter.IncreaseIndent();
			typeWriter.WriteLine("super();");
		}

		protected override void EmitVMArrayProperty(string key)
		{
			base.EmitVMArrayProperty(key);
			base.VmPropsWriter.WriteLine("private " + ToFieldName(key) + ": " + ToTypeName(key) + " = null;");
			base.VmPropsWriter.WriteLine("public get " + ToPropertyName(key) + "(): " + ToTypeName(key) + " {");
			base.VmPropsWriter.IncreaseIndent();
			base.VmPropsWriter.WriteLine("if (this." + ToFieldName(key) + " == null)");
			base.VmPropsWriter.WriteLine("{");
			base.VmPropsWriter.IncreaseIndent();
			base.VmPropsWriter.WriteLine("this." + ToFieldName(key) + " = new " + ToTypeName(key) + "();");
			base.VmPropsWriter.DecreaseIndent();
			base.VmPropsWriter.WriteLine("}");
			base.VmPropsWriter.WriteLine("return this." + ToFieldName(key) + ";");
			base.VmPropsWriter.DecreaseIndent();
			base.VmPropsWriter.WriteLine("}");
			base.VmPropsWriter.WriteLine("");
		}

		protected override void EmitVMPrimitiveProperty(string key, JsonDictionaryValue val)
		{
			base.EmitVMPrimitiveProperty(key, val);
			base.VmPropsWriter.WriteLine("private " + ToFieldName(key) + ": " + GetPrimitivePropertyType(val.Type) + " = " + GetPrimitivePropertyValueString(val) + ";");
			base.VmPropsWriter.WriteLine("public get " + ToPropertyName(key) + "(): " + GetPrimitivePropertyType(val.Type) + " {");
			base.VmPropsWriter.IncreaseIndent();
			base.VmPropsWriter.WriteLine("return this." + ToFieldName(key) + ";");
			base.VmPropsWriter.DecreaseIndent();
			base.VmPropsWriter.WriteLine("}");
			base.VmPropsWriter.WriteLine("");
		}

		protected override void EmitVMSubObjectProperty(string key, string[] propertyNames, CodeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterPropertyType[] propertyTypes, JsonDictionaryObject itemObj)
		{
			base.EmitVMSubObjectProperty(key, propertyNames, propertyTypes, itemObj);
			base.VmPropsWriter.WriteLine("private " + ToFieldName(key) + ": " + ToTypeName(key) + "Item = null;");
			base.VmPropsWriter.WriteLine("public get " + ToPropertyName(key) + "(): " + ToTypeName(key) + "Item {");
			base.VmPropsWriter.IncreaseIndent();
			base.VmPropsWriter.WriteLine("if (this." + ToFieldName(key) + " == null)");
			base.VmPropsWriter.WriteLine("{");
			base.VmPropsWriter.IncreaseIndent();
			base.VmPropsWriter.WriteLine("this." + ToFieldName(key) + " = ");
			WriteItem(ToTypeName(key, isItem: true), propertyNames, propertyTypes, itemObj, base.VmPropsWriter);
			base.VmPropsWriter.WriteLine("}");
			base.VmPropsWriter.WriteLine("return this." + ToFieldName(key) + ";");
			base.VmPropsWriter.DecreaseIndent();
			base.VmPropsWriter.WriteLine("}");
			base.VmPropsWriter.WriteLine("");
		}

		protected override void AddImportsForRawFile(string key, CodeGeneratingImportManager newFileImportsWriter)
		{
			newFileImportsWriter.AddPackageImport("./" + key, key);
			newFileImportsWriter.AddPackageImport("./" + key, key + "Item");
		}

		protected override void CollectNewFileImports(string key, CodeGeneratingImportManager newFileImportsWriter)
		{
			base.VmLibraryImportsWriter = CodeGeneratingImportManager.Merge(base.VmLibraryImportsWriter, newFileImportsWriter);
		}

		protected override void EmitItemType(CodeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterItemType itemType, CodeGeneratingCodeWriter writer, CodeGeneratingImportManager importsWriter)
		{
			if (importsWriter == base.VmImportsWriter)
			{
				importsWriter.AddPackageImport("./" + itemType.Name, itemType.Name);
			}
			else
			{
				importsWriter.AddPackageImport("./" + itemType.DataName, itemType.Name);
			}
			writer.WriteLine("export class " + itemType.Name + " {");
			writer.IncreaseIndent();
			writer.WriteLine("public constructor(init: Partial<" + itemType.Name + ">) {");
			writer.IncreaseIndent();
			writer.WriteLine("Object.assign(this, init);");
			writer.DecreaseIndent();
			writer.WriteLine("}");
			writer.WriteLine("");
			for (int i = 0; i < itemType.PropertyNames.Length; i++)
			{
				string name = itemType.PropertyNames[i];
				CodeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterPropertyType type = itemType.PropertyTypes[i];
				writer.WriteLine("public " + ToPropertyName(name) + ": " + GetPropertyType(itemType, name, type) + ";");
			}
			writer.DecreaseIndent();
			writer.WriteLine("");
			writer.WriteLine("}");
		}

		private string GetPrimitivePropertyType(JsonDictionaryValueType type)
		{
			return type switch
			{
				JsonDictionaryValueType.BooleanValue => "boolean", 
				JsonDictionaryValueType.NumberValue => "number", 
				JsonDictionaryValueType.StringValue => "string", 
				JsonDictionaryValueType.NullValue => "any", 
				_ => "any", 
			};
		}

		private string GetPropertyType(CodeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterItemType itemType, string name, CodeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterPropertyType type)
		{
			if (type.IsArray)
			{
				return itemType.Name + "_" + ToPropertyName(name) + "[]";
			}
			if (type.IsSubObject)
			{
				return itemType.Name + "_" + ToPropertyName(name);
			}
			return type.JsonType switch
			{
				JsonDictionaryValueType.BooleanValue => "boolean", 
				JsonDictionaryValueType.NumberValue => "number", 
				JsonDictionaryValueType.StringValue => "string", 
				JsonDictionaryValueType.NullValue => "any", 
				_ => "any", 
			};
		}

		protected override void EndData(string refName, string[] propertyNames, CodeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterPropertyType[] propertyTypes, CodeGeneratingCodeWriter typeWriter)
		{
			base.EndData(refName, propertyNames, propertyTypes, typeWriter);
			typeWriter.DecreaseIndent();
			typeWriter.WriteLine("}");
			typeWriter.DecreaseIndent();
			typeWriter.WriteLine("}");
		}

		protected override void AddDataItem(string refName, string[] propertyNames, CodeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterPropertyType[] propertyTypes, JsonDictionaryItem item, int i, CodeGeneratingCodeWriter typeWriter)
		{
			base.AddDataItem(refName, propertyNames, propertyTypes, item, i, typeWriter);
			typeWriter.Write("this.push(");
			WriteItem(ToTypeName(refName, isItem: true), propertyNames, propertyTypes, item, typeWriter);
			typeWriter.WriteLine(");");
		}

		private void WriteItem(string typeName, string[] propertyNames, CodeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterPropertyType[] propertyTypes, JsonDictionaryItem item, CodeGeneratingCodeWriter typeWriter)
		{
			if (item == null)
			{
				typeWriter.Write("null");
			}
			else if (item is JsonDictionaryArray)
			{
				JsonDictionaryArray jsonDictionaryArray = (JsonDictionaryArray)item;
				typeWriter.WriteLine("[");
				typeWriter.IncreaseIndent();
				if (jsonDictionaryArray.Items != null && jsonDictionaryArray.Items.Length != 0)
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < jsonDictionaryArray.Items.Length; i++)
					{
						if (i > 0)
						{
							typeWriter.WriteLine(",");
						}
						WriteItem(typeName, propertyNames, propertyTypes, jsonDictionaryArray.Items[i], typeWriter);
					}
				}
				typeWriter.DecreaseIndent();
				typeWriter.WriteLine("]");
			}
			else
			{
				if (!(item is JsonDictionaryObject))
				{
					return;
				}
				JsonDictionaryObject jsonDictionaryObject = (JsonDictionaryObject)item;
				typeWriter.WriteLine("new " + typeName + "(");
				typeWriter.WriteLine("{");
				typeWriter.IncreaseIndent();
				for (int j = 0; j < propertyNames.Length; j++)
				{
					string text = propertyNames[j];
					CodeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterPropertyType codeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterPropertyType = propertyTypes[j];
					if (j > 0)
					{
						typeWriter.WriteLine(",");
					}
					typeWriter.Write(ToPropertyName(text) + ": ");
					if (codeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterPropertyType.IsArray)
					{
						string typeName2 = typeName + "_" + ToPropertyName(text) + "Item";
						WriteItem(typeName2, codeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterPropertyType.SubObjectPropertyNames, codeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterPropertyType.SubObjectPropertyTypes, jsonDictionaryObject[text], typeWriter);
					}
					else if (codeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterPropertyType.IsSubObject)
					{
						string typeName3 = typeName + "_" + ToPropertyName(text);
						WriteItem(typeName3, codeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterPropertyType.SubObjectPropertyNames, codeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterPropertyType.SubObjectPropertyTypes, jsonDictionaryObject[text], typeWriter);
					}
					else
					{
						JsonDictionaryValue jsonVal = (JsonDictionaryValue)jsonDictionaryObject[text];
						typeWriter.Write(GetPropertyValueString(codeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterPropertyType, jsonVal));
					}
				}
				typeWriter.WriteLine("");
				typeWriter.DecreaseIndent();
				typeWriter.Write("})");
			}
		}

		protected override string GetPropertyValueString(CodeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterPropertyType type, JsonDictionaryValue jsonVal)
		{
			if (jsonVal.Value == null)
			{
				return "null";
			}
			switch (type.JsonType)
			{
			case JsonDictionaryValueType.BooleanValue:
				if (!(bool)jsonVal.Value)
				{
					return "false";
				}
				return "true";
			case JsonDictionaryValueType.NumberValue:
				return ((double)jsonVal.Value).ToString();
			case JsonDictionaryValueType.StringValue:
				return "`" + (string)jsonVal.Value + "`";
			case JsonDictionaryValueType.NullValue:
				return "null";
			default:
				return "";
			}
		}

		protected string GetPrimitivePropertyValueString(JsonDictionaryValue jsonVal)
		{
			switch (jsonVal.Type)
			{
			case JsonDictionaryValueType.BooleanValue:
				if (!(bool)jsonVal.Value)
				{
					return "false";
				}
				return "true";
			case JsonDictionaryValueType.NumberValue:
				return ((double)jsonVal.Value).ToString();
			case JsonDictionaryValueType.StringValue:
				return "`" + (string)jsonVal.Value + "`";
			case JsonDictionaryValueType.NullValue:
				return "null";
			default:
				return "";
			}
		}
	}
	internal class TSCodeGeneratingComponentRendererModuleEmitter : CodeGeneratingComponentRendererModuleEmitter
	{
		private CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms _platform;

		private int _moduleCount;

		private bool _emitDescriptionModules;

		private Dictionary<string, List<string>> _moduleMaps = new Dictionary<string, List<string>>();

		protected string Prefix => _platform switch
		{
			CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms.Angular => "Igx", 
			CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms.React => "Igr", 
			CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms.WebComponents => "Igc", 
			_ => "", 
		};

		protected string PlatformLower => _platform switch
		{
			CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms.Angular => "angular", 
			CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms.React => "react", 
			CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms.WebComponents => "webcomponents", 
			_ => "", 
		};

		public TSCodeGeneratingComponentRendererModuleEmitter(CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms platform, CodeGenerationRendererOptions options, CodeGeneratingRendererResult result)
			: base(options, result)
		{
			_platform = platform;
		}

		protected override void StartModules()
		{
			base.StartModules();
			_moduleCount = 0;
		}

		protected override void EmitModule(string modString)
		{
			base.EmitModule(modString);
			if (modString == "withDescriptions")
			{
				_emitDescriptionModules = true;
				return;
			}
			string key = "igniteui-" + PlatformLower + "-core";
			string text = "";
			string[] array = modString.Split('/');
			if (array.Length == 1)
			{
				text = array[0];
			}
			else
			{
				key = array[0];
				key = "igniteui-" + PlatformLower + "-" + key;
				text = array[1];
			}
			if (!_moduleMaps.ContainsKey(key))
			{
				_moduleMaps.Add(key, new List<string>());
			}
			List<string> list = _moduleMaps[key];
			if (_moduleCount > 0)
			{
				base.Writer.WriteLine(",");
			}
			base.Writer.Write(Prefix + text);
			list.Add(Prefix + text);
			if (_emitDescriptionModules)
			{
				if (_moduleCount == 0)
				{
					base.DescriptionRegisterWriter.WriteLine("private _componentRenderer: ComponentRenderer = null;");
					base.DescriptionRegisterWriter.WriteLine("public get renderer(): ComponentRenderer {");
					base.DescriptionRegisterWriter.IncreaseIndent();
					base.DescriptionRegisterWriter.WriteLine("if (this._componentRenderer == null) {");
					base.DescriptionRegisterWriter.IncreaseIndent();
					base.DescriptionRegisterWriter.WriteLine("this._componentRenderer = new ComponentRenderer();");
					base.DescriptionRegisterWriter.WriteLine("var context = this._componentRenderer.context;");
					base.DescriptionImportsWriter.AddPackageImport("igniteui-" + PlatformLower + "-core", "ComponentRenderer");
				}
				string text2 = text;
				if (text2.EndsWith("Module"))
				{
					text2 = text2.Substring(0, text2.Length - "Module".Length);
					text2 += "DescriptionModule";
				}
				base.DescriptionImportsWriter.AddPackageImport("igniteui-" + PlatformLower + "-core", text2);
				base.DescriptionRegisterWriter.WriteLine(text2 + ".register(context);");
			}
			_moduleCount++;
		}

		protected override void EndModules()
		{
			base.EndModules();
			foreach (string key in _moduleMaps.Keys)
			{
				string package = key;
				foreach (string item in _moduleMaps[key])
				{
					base.ImportsWriter.AddPackageImport(package, item);
				}
			}
			if (_emitDescriptionModules)
			{
				base.DescriptionRegisterWriter.DecreaseIndent();
				base.DescriptionRegisterWriter.WriteLine("}");
				base.DescriptionRegisterWriter.WriteLine("return this._componentRenderer");
				base.DescriptionRegisterWriter.DecreaseIndent();
				base.DescriptionRegisterWriter.WriteLine("}");
			}
		}
	}
	internal class AngularTemplateCodeGeneratingComponentRendererCodeEmitter : CodeGeneratingComponentRendererCodeEmitter
	{
		protected override bool UseRgba => true;

		protected override string Prefix => "Igx";

		public AngularTemplateCodeGeneratingComponentRendererCodeEmitter(CodeGenerationRendererOptions options, CodeGeneratingRendererResult result)
			: base(options, result)
		{
		}

		protected override string GetArrayLiteral(CodeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo val)
		{
			if (val.Value == null)
			{
				return "null";
			}
			object[] array = (object[])val.Value;
			string text = "";
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				if (i > 0)
				{
					text += ", ";
				}
				text += array[i];
			}
			return text;
		}

		public override void BeginType(string typeName)
		{
			base.BeginType(typeName);
			base.Writer.WriteLine(("<" + ToMarkupName(typeName)) ?? "");
		}

		private string ToMarkupName(string typeName)
		{
			if (typeName.EndsWith("Component"))
			{
				typeName = typeName.Substring(0, typeName.Length - "Component".Length);
			}
			return CodeGeneratingComponentRenderer.Spinalify(typeName);
		}

		public override void StartSubProperties()
		{
			base.Writer.WriteLine(">");
			base.Writer.IncreaseIndent();
		}

		public override void EndType(string typeName)
		{
			base.Writer.DecreaseIndent();
			base.Writer.WriteLine("</" + ToMarkupName(typeName) + ">");
			base.EndType(typeName);
		}

		public override void EmitProperty(int simplePropCount, string prop, CodeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo val, TypeDescriptionContext context)
		{
			string text = CodeGeneratingComponentRenderer.Camelify(prop);
			if (IsBinding(val))
			{
				TrackBinding(val);
				text = "[" + text + "]";
			}
			if (simplePropCount > 0)
			{
				base.Writer.WriteLine("");
			}
			base.Writer.Write(text);
			base.Writer.Write("=");
			base.Writer.Write("\"");
			base.Writer.Write(GetValueAsString(val, isPascal: true));
			base.Writer.Write("\"");
			if (text == "name")
			{
				base.Writer.WriteLine("");
				base.Writer.Write("#" + CodeGeneratingComponentRenderer.Camelify(GetValueAsString(val, isPascal: true)));
			}
		}

		protected override string GetEventReference(CodeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo val)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(val.SourceRef.Name))
			{
				TrackBinding(val);
				return "this." + CodeGeneratingComponentRenderer.Camelify(val.SourceRef.Name) + "($event)";
			}
			return GetNullString();
		}

		protected override object ResolveSpecialValue(CodeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo val)
		{
			CodeGenerationSpecialValue codeGenerationSpecialValue = (CodeGenerationSpecialValue)val.Value;
			return codeGenerationSpecialValue.Type switch
			{
				CodeGenerationSpecialValueType.Color => codeGenerationSpecialValue.Value, 
				CodeGenerationSpecialValueType.FontFamily => codeGenerationSpecialValue.Value, 
				CodeGenerationSpecialValueType.FontStyles => codeGenerationSpecialValue.Value, 
				CodeGenerationSpecialValueType.FontWeights => codeGenerationSpecialValue.Value, 
				_ => codeGenerationSpecialValue.Value, 
			};
		}

		protected override string GetNullString()
		{
			return "null";
		}

		protected override string GetElementBinding(CodeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo val)
		{
			return CodeGeneratingComponentRenderer.Camelify(val.SourceRef.Name);
		}

		protected override string GetRefBinding(CodeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo val)
		{
			return CodeGeneratingComponentRenderer.Camelify(val.SourceRef.Name);
		}

		public override void EmitSubProperty(int subPropCount, string prop, CodeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo val, TypeDescriptionContext context)
		{
			if (val.MetaData.KnownType == TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Collection)
			{
				if (!(val.Value is IList list))
				{
					return;
				}
				{
					foreach (object item in list)
					{
						if (item is CodeGenerationItemBuilder)
						{
							((CodeGenerationItemBuilder)item).Emit(this, isRoot: false);
						}
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			if (val.Value is CodeGenerationItemBuilder)
			{
				((CodeGenerationItemBuilder)val.Value).Emit(this, isRoot: false);
			}
		}
	}
	internal class AngularCodeBehindCodeGeneratingComponentRendererCodeEmitter : CodeGeneratingComponentRendererCodeEmitter

		public AngularCodeBehindCodeGeneratingComponentRendererCodeEmitter(CodeGenerationRendererOptions options, CodeGeneratingRendererResult result)

	internal class DotNetCodeGeneratingComponentRendererHandlerEmitter : CodeGeneratingComponentRendererHandlerEmitter
	{
		public DotNetCodeGeneratingComponentRendererHandlerEmitter(CodeGenerationRendererOptions options, CodeGeneratingRendererResult result)
			: base(options, result)
		{
		}

		protected override void WriteImport(CodeGeneratingImportManager importsWriter, string str)
		{
			base.WriteImport(importsWriter, str);
			importsWriter.AddUsing(str);
		}

		protected override string TransformHandlerCode(string str)
		{
			str = new CodeGeneratingRegexHelper("CodeGenHelper\\.GetDescription<([^\\]]+)>\\(\"([^\"]*)\"\\)").Execute(str, delegate(Func<int, string> getGroup, int start, int length)
			{
				getGroup(1);
				string name = getGroup(2);
				if (base.Result.HasDescription(name))
				{
					string descriptionField = base.Result.GetDescriptionField(name);
					return "this." + descriptionField;
				}
				return (string)null;
			});
			return str;
		}
	}
	internal class DotNetCodeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitter : CodeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitter
	{
		private bool _importedDataNamespace;

		protected override string Extension => ".cs";

		public DotNetCodeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitter(CodeGenerationRendererOptions options, CodeGeneratingRendererResult result)
			: base(options, result)
		{
		}

		protected override void CollectNewFileImports(string key, CodeGeneratingImportManager newFileImportsWriter)
		{
			base.CollectNewFileImports(key, newFileImportsWriter);
			base.VmLibraryProjectFileWriter.WriteLine("<Compile Include=\"" + key + ".cs\">");
			base.VmLibraryProjectFileWriter.IncreaseIndent();
			base.VmLibraryProjectFileWriter.WriteLine("<SubType>Code</SubType>");
			base.VmLibraryProjectFileWriter.DecreaseIndent();
			base.VmLibraryProjectFileWriter.WriteLine("</Compile>");
		}

		protected override void EmitLibraryFileStart(CodeGeneratingCodeWriter newFileWriter)
		{
			newFileWriter.WriteLine("using System;");
			newFileWriter.WriteLine("using System.Collections.Generic;");
			if (!_importedDataNamespace)
			{
				_importedDataNamespace = true;
				base.VmImportsWriter.AddUsing("using Data;");
			}
			newFileWriter.WriteLine("namespace Data");
			newFileWriter.WriteLine("{");
			newFileWriter.IncreaseIndent();
			base.EmitLibraryFileStart(newFileWriter);
		}

		protected override void EmitLibraryFileEnd(CodeGeneratingCodeWriter newFileWriter)
		{
			newFileWriter.DecreaseIndent();
			newFileWriter.WriteLine("}");
			base.EmitLibraryFileEnd(newFileWriter);
		}

		protected override string ToTypeName(string name, bool isItem = false)
		{
			name = CodeGeneratingComponentRenderer.Pascalify(name);
			name = name.Replace("-", "_");
			if (isItem)
			{
				name += "Item";
			}
			return name;
		}

		protected override string ToPropertyName(string name)
		{
			name = name.Replace("-", "_");
			return CodeGeneratingComponentRenderer.Pascalify(name);
		}

		protected string ToFieldName(string name)
		{
			name = name.Replace("-", "_");
			return "_" + CodeGeneratingComponentRenderer.Camelify(name);
		}

		protected override void StartData(string refName, string[] propertyNames, CodeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterPropertyType[] propertyTypes, CodeGeneratingCodeWriter typeWriter, CodeGeneratingImportManager importsWriter)
		{
			base.StartData(refName, propertyNames, propertyTypes, typeWriter, importsWriter);
			foreach (CodeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterItemType itemType in GetItemTypes(ToTypeName(refName, isItem: true), ToTypeName(refName), propertyNames, propertyTypes))
			{
				EmitItemType(itemType, typeWriter, importsWriter);
			}
			typeWriter.WriteLine("public class " + ToTypeName(refName));
			typeWriter.IncreaseIndent();
			typeWriter.WriteLine(": List<" + ToTypeName(refName, isItem: true) + ">");
			typeWriter.DecreaseIndent();
			typeWriter.WriteLine("{");
			typeWriter.IncreaseIndent();
			typeWriter.WriteLine("public " + ToTypeName(refName) + "()");
			typeWriter.WriteLine("{");
			typeWriter.IncreaseIndent();
		}

		protected override void EmitVMArrayProperty(string key)
		{
			base.EmitVMArrayProperty(key);
			base.VmPropsWriter.WriteLine("private " + ToTypeName(key) + " " + ToFieldName(key) + " = null;");
			base.VmPropsWriter.WriteLine("public " + ToTypeName(key) + " " + ToPropertyName(key));
			base.VmPropsWriter.WriteLine("{");
			base.VmPropsWriter.IncreaseIndent();
			base.VmPropsWriter.WriteLine("get");
			base.VmPropsWriter.WriteLine("{");
			base.VmPropsWriter.IncreaseIndent();
			base.VmPropsWriter.WriteLine("if (" + ToFieldName(key) + " == null)");
			base.VmPropsWriter.WriteLine("{");
			base.VmPropsWriter.IncreaseIndent();
			base.VmPropsWriter.WriteLine(ToFieldName(key) + " = new " + ToTypeName(key) + "();");
			base.VmPropsWriter.DecreaseIndent();
			base.VmPropsWriter.WriteLine("}");
			base.VmPropsWriter.WriteLine("return " + ToFieldName(key) + ";");
			base.VmPropsWriter.DecreaseIndent();
			base.VmPropsWriter.WriteLine("}");
			base.VmPropsWriter.DecreaseIndent();
			base.VmPropsWriter.WriteLine("}");
			base.VmPropsWriter.WriteLine("");
		}

		protected override void EmitVMPrimitiveProperty(string key, JsonDictionaryValue val)
		{
			base.EmitVMPrimitiveProperty(key, val);
			base.VmPropsWriter.WriteLine("private " + GetPrimitivePropertyType(val.Type) + " " + ToFieldName(key) + " = " + GetPrimitivePropertyValueString(val) + ";");
			base.VmPropsWriter.WriteLine("public " + GetPrimitivePropertyType(val.Type) + " " + ToPropertyName(key));
			base.VmPropsWriter.WriteLine("{");
			base.VmPropsWriter.IncreaseIndent();
			base.VmPropsWriter.WriteLine("get");
			base.VmPropsWriter.WriteLine("{");
			base.VmPropsWriter.IncreaseIndent();
			base.VmPropsWriter.WriteLine("return " + ToFieldName(key) + ";");
			base.VmPropsWriter.DecreaseIndent();
			base.VmPropsWriter.WriteLine("}");
			base.VmPropsWriter.DecreaseIndent();
			base.VmPropsWriter.WriteLine("}");
			base.VmPropsWriter.WriteLine("");
		}

		protected override void EmitVMSubObjectProperty(string key, string[] propertyNames, CodeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterPropertyType[] propertyTypes, JsonDictionaryObject itemObj)
		{
			base.EmitVMSubObjectProperty(key, propertyNames, propertyTypes, itemObj);
			base.VmPropsWriter.WriteLine("private " + ToTypeName(key) + "Item " + ToFieldName(key) + " = null;");
			base.VmPropsWriter.WriteLine("public " + ToTypeName(key) + "Item " + ToPropertyName(key));
			base.VmPropsWriter.WriteLine("{");
			base.VmPropsWriter.IncreaseIndent();
			base.VmPropsWriter.WriteLine("get");
			base.VmPropsWriter.WriteLine("{");
			base.VmPropsWriter.IncreaseIndent();
			base.VmPropsWriter.WriteLine("if (" + ToFieldName(key) + " == null)");
			base.VmPropsWriter.WriteLine("{");
			base.VmPropsWriter.IncreaseIndent();
			base.VmPropsWriter.WriteLine("_" + key + " = ");
			WriteItem(ToTypeName(key, isItem: true), propertyNames, propertyTypes, itemObj, base.VmPropsWriter);
			base.VmPropsWriter.DecreaseIndent();
			base.VmPropsWriter.WriteLine("}");
			base.VmPropsWriter.WriteLine("return " + ToFieldName(key) + ";");
			base.VmPropsWriter.DecreaseIndent();
			base.VmPropsWriter.WriteLine("}");
			base.VmPropsWriter.DecreaseIndent();
			base.VmPropsWriter.WriteLine("}");
			base.VmPropsWriter.WriteLine("");
		}

		protected override void EmitItemType(CodeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterItemType itemType, CodeGeneratingCodeWriter writer, CodeGeneratingImportManager importsWriter)
		{
			writer.WriteLine("public class " + itemType.Name);
			writer.WriteLine("{");
			writer.IncreaseIndent();
			for (int i = 0; i < itemType.PropertyNames.Length; i++)
			{
				string name = itemType.PropertyNames[i];
				CodeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterPropertyType type = itemType.PropertyTypes[i];
				writer.WriteLine("public " + GetPropertyType(itemType, name, type) + " " + ToPropertyName(name) + "{ get; set; }");
			}
			writer.DecreaseIndent();
			writer.WriteLine("}");
		}

		private string GetPrimitivePropertyType(JsonDictionaryValueType type)
		{
			return type switch
			{
				JsonDictionaryValueType.BooleanValue => "bool", 
				JsonDictionaryValueType.NumberValue => "double", 
				JsonDictionaryValueType.StringValue => "string", 
				JsonDictionaryValueType.NullValue => "object", 
				_ => "object", 
			};
		}

		private string GetPropertyType(CodeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterItemType itemType, string name, CodeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterPropertyType type)
		{
			if (type.IsArray)
			{
				return "List<" + itemType.Name + "_" + ToPropertyName(name) + "Item>";
			}
			if (type.IsSubObject)
			{
				return itemType.Name + "_" + ToPropertyName(name);
			}
			return type.JsonType switch
			{
				JsonDictionaryValueType.BooleanValue => "bool", 
				JsonDictionaryValueType.NumberValue => "double", 
				JsonDictionaryValueType.StringValue => "string", 
				JsonDictionaryValueType.NullValue => "object", 
				_ => "object", 
			};
		}

		protected override void EndData(string refName, string[] propertyNames, CodeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterPropertyType[] propertyTypes, CodeGeneratingCodeWriter typeWriter)
		{
			base.EndData(refName, propertyNames, propertyTypes, typeWriter);
			typeWriter.DecreaseIndent();
			typeWriter.WriteLine("}");
			typeWriter.DecreaseIndent();
			typeWriter.WriteLine("}");
		}

		protected override void AddDataItem(string refName, string[] propertyNames, CodeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterPropertyType[] propertyTypes, JsonDictionaryItem item, int i, CodeGeneratingCodeWriter typeWriter)
		{
			base.AddDataItem(refName, propertyNames, propertyTypes, item, i, typeWriter);
			typeWriter.Write("this.Add(");
			WriteItem(ToTypeName(refName, isItem: true), propertyNames, propertyTypes, item, typeWriter);
			typeWriter.WriteLine(");");
		}

		private void WriteItem(string typeName, string[] propertyNames, CodeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterPropertyType[] propertyTypes, JsonDictionaryItem item, CodeGeneratingCodeWriter typeWriter)
		{
			if (item == null)
			{
				typeWriter.Write("null");
			}
			else if (item is JsonDictionaryArray)
			{
				JsonDictionaryArray jsonDictionaryArray = (JsonDictionaryArray)item;
				typeWriter.WriteLine("new List<" + typeName + ">()");
				typeWriter.WriteLine("{");
				typeWriter.IncreaseIndent();
				if (jsonDictionaryArray.Items != null && jsonDictionaryArray.Items.Length != 0)
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < jsonDictionaryArray.Items.Length; i++)
					{
						if (i > 0)
						{
							typeWriter.WriteLine(",");
						}
						WriteItem(typeName, propertyNames, propertyTypes, jsonDictionaryArray.Items[i], typeWriter);
					}
				}
				typeWriter.DecreaseIndent();
				typeWriter.WriteLine("}");
			}
			else
			{
				if (!(item is JsonDictionaryObject))
				{
					return;
				}
				JsonDictionaryObject jsonDictionaryObject = (JsonDictionaryObject)item;
				typeWriter.WriteLine("new " + typeName + "()");
				typeWriter.WriteLine("{");
				typeWriter.IncreaseIndent();
				for (int j = 0; j < propertyNames.Length; j++)
				{
					string text = propertyNames[j];
					CodeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterPropertyType codeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterPropertyType = propertyTypes[j];
					if (j > 0)
					{
						typeWriter.WriteLine(",");
					}
					typeWriter.Write(text + " = ");
					if (codeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterPropertyType.IsArray)
					{
						string typeName2 = typeName + "_" + ToPropertyName(text) + "Item";
						WriteItem(typeName2, codeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterPropertyType.SubObjectPropertyNames, codeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterPropertyType.SubObjectPropertyTypes, jsonDictionaryObject[text], typeWriter);
					}
					else if (codeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterPropertyType.IsSubObject)
					{
						string typeName3 = typeName + "_" + ToPropertyName(text);
						WriteItem(typeName3, codeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterPropertyType.SubObjectPropertyNames, codeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterPropertyType.SubObjectPropertyTypes, jsonDictionaryObject[text], typeWriter);
					}
					else
					{
						JsonDictionaryValue jsonVal = (JsonDictionaryValue)jsonDictionaryObject[text];
						typeWriter.Write(GetPropertyValueString(codeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterPropertyType, jsonVal));
					}
				}
				typeWriter.WriteLine("");
				typeWriter.DecreaseIndent();
				typeWriter.Write("}");
			}
		}

		protected override string GetPropertyValueString(CodeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterPropertyType type, JsonDictionaryValue jsonVal)
		{
			switch (type.JsonType)
			{
			case JsonDictionaryValueType.BooleanValue:
				if (!(bool)jsonVal.Value)
				{
					return "false";
				}
				return "true";
			case JsonDictionaryValueType.NumberValue:
				return ((double)jsonVal.Value).ToString();
			case JsonDictionaryValueType.StringValue:
				return "@\"" + ((string)jsonVal.Value).Replace("\"", "\"\"") + "\"";
			case JsonDictionaryValueType.NullValue:
				return "null";
			default:
				return "";
			}
		}

		protected string GetPrimitivePropertyValueString(JsonDictionaryValue jsonVal)
		{
			switch (jsonVal.Type)
			{
			case JsonDictionaryValueType.BooleanValue:
				if (!(bool)jsonVal.Value)
				{
					return "false";
				}
				return "true";
			case JsonDictionaryValueType.NumberValue:
				return ((double)jsonVal.Value).ToString();
			case JsonDictionaryValueType.StringValue:
				return "@\"" + ((string)jsonVal.Value).Replace("\"", "\"\"") + "\"";
			case JsonDictionaryValueType.NullValue:
				return "null";
			default:
				return "";
			}
		}
	}
	internal class DotNetCodeGeneratingComponentRendererModuleEmitter : CodeGeneratingComponentRendererModuleEmitter
	{
		private CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms _platform;

		private int _moduleCount;

		private bool _emitDescriptionModules;

		private Dictionary<string, List<string>> _moduleMaps = new Dictionary<string, List<string>>();

		protected string Prefix => _platform switch
		{
			CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms.WPF => "Xam", 
			CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms.WindowsForms => "Ultra", 
			_ => "", 
		};

		public DotNetCodeGeneratingComponentRendererModuleEmitter(CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms platform, CodeGenerationRendererOptions options, CodeGeneratingRendererResult result)
			: base(options, result)
		{
			_platform = platform;
		}

		protected override void StartModules()
		{
			base.StartModules();
			_moduleCount = 0;
		}

		protected override void EmitModule(string modString)
		{
			base.EmitModule(modString);
			if (modString == "withDescriptions")
			{
				_emitDescriptionModules = true;
				return;
			}
			string text = "";
			string[] array = modString.Split('/');
			text = ((array.Length != 1) ? array[1] : array[0]);
			if (_emitDescriptionModules)
			{
				if (_moduleCount == 0)
				{
					base.DescriptionRegisterWriter.WriteLine("private ComponentRenderer _componentRenderer = null;");
					base.DescriptionRegisterWriter.WriteLine("public ComponentRenderer Renderer");
					base.DescriptionRegisterWriter.WriteLine("{");
					base.DescriptionRegisterWriter.IncreaseIndent();
					base.DescriptionRegisterWriter.WriteLine("get");
					base.DescriptionRegisterWriter.WriteLine("{");
					base.DescriptionRegisterWriter.IncreaseIndent();
					base.DescriptionRegisterWriter.WriteLine("if (this._componentRenderer == null)");
					base.DescriptionRegisterWriter.WriteLine("{");
					base.DescriptionRegisterWriter.IncreaseIndent();
					base.DescriptionRegisterWriter.WriteLine("this._componentRenderer = new ComponentRenderer();");
					base.DescriptionRegisterWriter.WriteLine("var context = this._componentRenderer.Context;");
				}
				string text2 = text;
				if (text2.EndsWith("Module"))
				{
					text2 = text2.Substring(0, text2.Length - "Module".Length);
					text2 += "DescriptionModule";
				}
				base.DescriptionRegisterWriter.WriteLine(text2 + ".Register(context);");
			}
			_moduleCount++;
		}

		protected override void EndModules()
		{
			base.EndModules();
			base.DescriptionImportsWriter.AddUsing("using Infragistics.Controls.Description;");
			if (_emitDescriptionModules)
			{
				base.DescriptionRegisterWriter.DecreaseIndent();
				base.DescriptionRegisterWriter.WriteLine("}");
				base.DescriptionRegisterWriter.DecreaseIndent();
				base.DescriptionRegisterWriter.WriteLine("return this._componentRenderer;");
				base.DescriptionRegisterWriter.WriteLine("}");
				base.DescriptionRegisterWriter.DecreaseIndent();
				base.DescriptionRegisterWriter.WriteLine("}");
			}
		}
	}
	internal class WPFXamlCodeGeneratingComponentRendererCodeEmitter : CodeGeneratingComponentRendererCodeEmitter
	{
		public override bool UsesCamelProperties => false;

		protected override string Prefix => "Xam";

		public WPFXamlCodeGeneratingComponentRendererCodeEmitter(CodeGenerationRendererOptions options, CodeGeneratingRendererResult result)
			: base(options, result)
		{
		}

		protected override string GetArrayLiteral(CodeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo val)
		{
			if (val.Value == null)
			{
				return "null";
			}
			object[] array = (object[])val.Value;
			string text = "";
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				if (i > 0)
				{
					text += ", ";
				}
				text += array[i];
			}
			return text;
		}

		public override void BeginType(string typeName)
		{
			base.BeginType(typeName);
			base.Writer.WriteLine(("<ig:" + typeName) ?? "");
		}

		public override void StartSubProperties()
		{
			base.Writer.WriteLine(">");
			base.Writer.IncreaseIndent();
		}

		public override void EndType(string typeName)
		{
			base.Writer.DecreaseIndent();
			base.Writer.WriteLine("</ig:" + typeName + ">");
			base.EndType(typeName);
		}

		public override void EmitProperty(int simplePropCount, string prop, CodeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo val, TypeDescriptionContext context)
		{
			if (prop == "Label" && val.MetaData != null && val.MetaData.OwningType.Contains("Axis") && val.Value != null && ((string)val.Value).Contains("{"))
			{
				if (simplePropCount > 0)
				{
					base.Writer.WriteLine("");
				}
				base.Writer.Write(prop);
				base.Writer.Write("=");
				base.Writer.Write("\"");
				base.Writer.Write("{}" + GetValueAsString(val, isPascal: true));
				base.Writer.Write("\"");
			}
			else
			{
				if (simplePropCount > 0)
				{
					base.Writer.WriteLine("");
				}
				base.Writer.Write(prop);
				base.Writer.Write("=");
				base.Writer.Write("\"");
				base.Writer.Write(GetValueAsString(val, isPascal: true));
				base.Writer.Write("\"");
			}
		}

		protected override object ResolveSpecialValue(CodeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo val)
		{
			CodeGenerationSpecialValue codeGenerationSpecialValue = (CodeGenerationSpecialValue)val.Value;
			return codeGenerationSpecialValue.Type switch
			{
				CodeGenerationSpecialValueType.Color => codeGenerationSpecialValue.Value, 
				CodeGenerationSpecialValueType.FontFamily => codeGenerationSpecialValue.Value, 
				CodeGenerationSpecialValueType.FontStyles => codeGenerationSpecialValue.Value, 
				CodeGenerationSpecialValueType.FontWeights => codeGenerationSpecialValue.Value, 
				_ => codeGenerationSpecialValue.Value, 
			};
		}

		protected override string GetNullString()
		{
			return "{x:Null}";
		}

		protected override string GetElementBinding(CodeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo val)
		{
			return "{Binding ElementName=" + val.SourceRef.Name + "}";
		}

		private string ToPropertyName(string name)
		{
			name = name.Replace("-", "_");
			return CodeGeneratingComponentRenderer.Pascalify(name);
		}

		protected override string GetRefBinding(CodeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo val)
		{
			TrackBinding(val);
			return "{Binding " + ToPropertyName(val.SourceRef.Name) + "}";
		}

		public override void EmitSubProperty(int subPropCount, string prop, CodeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo val, TypeDescriptionContext context)
		{
			base.Writer.Write("<ig:");
			base.Writer.Write(base.CurrentTypeName);
			base.Writer.Write(".");
			base.Writer.Write(prop);
			base.Writer.WriteLine(">");
			base.Writer.IncreaseIndent();
			if (val.MetaData.KnownType == TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Collection)
			{
				if (val.Value is IList list)
				{
					foreach (object item in list)
					{
						if (item is CodeGenerationItemBuilder)
						{
							((CodeGenerationItemBuilder)item).Emit(this, isRoot: false);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			else if (val.Value is CodeGenerationItemBuilder)
			{
				((CodeGenerationItemBuilder)val.Value).Emit(this, isRoot: false);
			}
			base.Writer.DecreaseIndent();
			base.Writer.Write("</ig:");
			base.Writer.Write(base.CurrentTypeName);
			base.Writer.Write(".");
			base.Writer.Write(prop);
			base.Writer.WriteLine(">");
		}
	}

		public WPFCodeBehindCodeGeneratingComponentRendererCodeEmitter(CodeGenerationRendererOptions options, CodeGeneratingRendererResult result)
			: base(options, result)
		{
		}
	}
	[DontHide]
	[DontObfuscate]
	public class CodeGeneratingComponentRenderer : ComponentRenderer
	{
		private CodeGenerationRendererOptions _options;

		private CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms _codePlatform;

		private JsonDictionaryItem _outputModules;

		private JsonDictionaryItem _outputRefs;

		private JsonDictionaryItem _outputStrings;

		public void LoadCodeJson(string json)
		{
			LoadJson(json, (string c) => new CodeGenerationContainer
			{
				Id = c
			});
		}

		internal static string Camelify(string value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (value.Length == 1)
			{
				return value.ToLower();
			}
			return value.Substring(0, 1).ToLower() + value.Substring(1);
		}

		internal static string Pascalify(string value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (value.Length == 1)
			{
				return value.ToUpper();
			}
			return value.Substring(0, 1).ToUpper() + value.Substring(1);
		}

		internal static string Spinalify(string value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<char> list = new List<char>();
			int num = 0;
			foreach (char c in value)
			{
				char num2 = char.ToUpper(c);
				char c2 = char.ToLower(c);
				bool flag = num == 0 && list.Count > 0;
				bool flag2 = num > 1;
				if (num2 == c)
				{
					if (flag)
					{
						list.Add('-');
					}
					num++;
				}
				else if (c2 == c)
				{
					if (flag2)
					{
						list.Insert(list.Count - 1, '-');
					}
					num = 0;
				}
				else
				{
					num = 0;
				}
				list.Add(c2);
			}
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			for (int j = 0; j < list.Count; j++)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(list[j]);
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		protected override bool ShouldForcePascal()
		{
			return true;
		}

		internal override bool ProcessModules(JsonDictionaryItem modules)
		{
			base.ProcessModules(modules);
			_outputModules = modules;
			return true;
		}

		internal override bool ProcessStrings(JsonDictionaryItem strings)
		{
			base.ProcessStrings(strings);
			_outputStrings = strings;
			return true;
		}

		internal override bool ProcessRefs(JsonDictionaryItem refs)
		{
			base.ProcessRefs(refs);
			_outputRefs = refs;
			return true;
		}

		internal CodeGeneratingComponentRendererCodeEmitter GetEmitter(CodeGenerationItemBuilder item, CodeGenerationRendererOptions options, CodeGeneratingRendererResult result)
		{
			switch (_codePlatform)
			{
			case CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms.Angular:
				if (options.ForceCodeBehind)
				{
					return new AngularCodeBehindCodeGeneratingComponentRendererCodeEmitter(options, result);
				}
				return new AngularTemplateCodeGeneratingComponentRendererCodeEmitter(options, result);
			case CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms.React:
				if (options.ForceCodeBehind)
				{
					return new ReactCodeBehindCodeGeneratingComponentRendererCodeEmitter(options, result);
				}
				return new ReactMarkupCodeGeneratingComponentRendererCodeEmitter(options, result);
			case CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms.WebComponents:
				if (options.ForceCodeBehind)
				{
					return new WebComponentsCodeBehindCodeGeneratingComponentRendererCodeEmitter(options, result);
				}
				return new WebComponentsMarkupCodeGeneratingComponentRendererCodeEmitter(options, result);
			case CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms.WPF:
				if (options.ForceCodeBehind)
				{
					return new WPFCodeBehindCodeGeneratingComponentRendererCodeEmitter(options, result);
				}
				return new WPFXamlCodeGeneratingComponentRendererCodeEmitter(options, result);
			default:
				return null;
			}
		}

		internal CodeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitter GetDataEmitter(CodeGenerationRendererOptions options, CodeGeneratingRendererResult result)
		{
			return _codePlatform switch
			{
				CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms.Angular => new TSCodeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitter(options, result), 
				CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms.React => new TSCodeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitter(options, result), 
				CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms.WebComponents => new TSCodeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitter(options, result), 
				CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms.WPF => new DotNetCodeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitter(options, result), 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		internal CodeGeneratingComponentRendererHandlerEmitter GetHandlerEmitter(CodeGenerationRendererOptions options, CodeGeneratingRendererResult result)
		{
			return _codePlatform switch
			{
				CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms.Angular => new TSCodeGeneratingComponentRendererHandlerEmitter(options, result, _codePlatform), 
				CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms.React => new TSCodeGeneratingComponentRendererHandlerEmitter(options, result, _codePlatform), 
				CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms.WebComponents => new TSCodeGeneratingComponentRendererHandlerEmitter(options, result, _codePlatform), 
				CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms.WPF => new DotNetCodeGeneratingComponentRendererHandlerEmitter(options, result), 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		internal CodeGeneratingComponentRendererModuleEmitter GetModuleEmitter(CodeGenerationRendererOptions options, CodeGeneratingRendererResult result)
		{
			return _codePlatform switch
			{
				CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms.Angular => new TSCodeGeneratingComponentRendererModuleEmitter(_codePlatform, options, result), 
				CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms.React => new TSCodeGeneratingComponentRendererModuleEmitter(_codePlatform, options, result), 
				CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms.WebComponents => new TSCodeGeneratingComponentRendererModuleEmitter(_codePlatform, options, result), 
				CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms.WPF => new DotNetCodeGeneratingComponentRendererModuleEmitter(_codePlatform, options, result), 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		public CodeGeneratingRendererResult EmitCode(ICodeGenerationRendererTemplate template)
		{
			CodeGeneratingRendererResult codeGeneratingRendererResult = new CodeGeneratingRendererResult();
			codeGeneratingRendererResult.Platform = _codePlatform;
			codeGeneratingRendererResult.GenerationOptions = _options;
			foreach (CodeGenerationContainer key2 in base.States.Keys)
			{
				string id = key2.Id;
				foreach (CodeGenerationItemBuilder childItem in key2.ChildItems)
				{
					if (childItem.GetPropertyValue("Name") != null)
					{
						codeGeneratingRendererResult.TrackDescriptionField(id, (string)childItem.GetPropertyValue("Name"));
					}
					if (childItem.GetPropertyValue("name") != null)
					{
						codeGeneratingRendererResult.TrackDescriptionField(id, (string)childItem.GetPropertyValue("name"));
					}
				}
			}
			foreach (CodeGenerationContainer key3 in base.States.Keys)
			{
				key3.Emit(codeGeneratingRendererResult, this, _options);
			}
			if (_outputModules != null)
			{
				GetModuleEmitter(_options, codeGeneratingRendererResult).EmitModules(_outputModules);
			}
			if (_outputStrings != null && _outputStrings is JsonDictionaryObject)
			{
				JsonDictionaryObject jsonDictionaryObject = (JsonDictionaryObject)_outputStrings;
				string[] keys = jsonDictionaryObject.GetKeys();
				foreach (string key in keys)
				{
					codeGeneratingRendererResult.DefineString(key, (string)((JsonDictionaryValue)jsonDictionaryObject[key]).Value);
				}
			}
			GetDataEmitter(_options, codeGeneratingRendererResult).EmitData(_outputRefs);
			GetHandlerEmitter(_options, codeGeneratingRendererResult).EmitHandlers();
			ProcessResults(codeGeneratingRendererResult, template);
			return codeGeneratingRendererResult;
		}

		private void ProcessResults(CodeGeneratingRendererResult result, ICodeGenerationRendererTemplate template)
		{
			template.Execute(result);
		}

		protected override Func<string, string> ResolveCustomMemberPathTransformer()
		{
			return TransformMemberPath;
		}

		private string ToMemberPath(string value)
		{
			value = value.Replace("-", "_");
			switch (_codePlatform)
			{
			case CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms.Angular:
			case CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms.React:
			case CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms.WebComponents:
				return Camelify(value);
			case CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms.WPF:
			case CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms.WindowsForms:
				return Pascalify(value);
			default:
				return value;
			}
		}

		private string TransformMemberPath(string value)
		{
			string result = value;
			if (value.StartsWith("{"))
			{
				if (!value.StartsWith("{["))
				{
					value = value.Substring(1, value.Length - 2);
					value = "{" + ToMemberPath(value) + "}";
					result = value;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				result = ToMemberPath(value);
			}
			return result;
		}

		public CodeGeneratingComponentRenderer(CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms platform, CodeGenerationRendererOptions options, Dispatcher dispatcher)
		{
			_options = options;
			_codePlatform = platform;
			Platform = ToPlatform(platform);
			base.Adapter = new CodeGenerationRendererAdapter(platform, base.Adapter, dispatcher);
			base.Context = new TypeDescriptionContext(base.Adapter, Platform);
			base.Transformer = new CodeGenerationTransformer(platform);
		}

		protected override Type GetObjectTypeForArray(string specificType)
		{
			return typeof(object);
		}

		private static TypeDescriptionPlatform ToPlatform(CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms platform)
		{
			return platform switch
			{
				CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms.Angular => TypeDescriptionPlatform.Angular, 
				CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms.React => TypeDescriptionPlatform.React, 
				CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms.WebComponents => TypeDescriptionPlatform.WebComponents, 
				CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms.WindowsForms => TypeDescriptionPlatform.WindowsForms, 
				CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms.WPF => TypeDescriptionPlatform.WPF, 
				_ => TypeDescriptionPlatform.WPF, 
			};
		}
	}

	public interface ICodeGenerationRendererTemplate
