	public class CodeGenerationFolderTemplate : ICodeGenerationRendererTemplate
	{
		private List<string> _filePaths = new List<string>();

		private List<string> _fileContents = new List<string>();

		private List<string> _fileOutputs = new List<string>();

		public void AddFile(string relativePath, string templateFileContent)
		{
			_filePaths.Add(relativePath);
			_fileContents.Add(templateFileContent);
		}

		public string[] GetFilePaths()
		{
			return _filePaths.ToArray();
		}

		public string GetFileOuutput(string relativePath)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < _filePaths.Count; i++)
			{
				if (_filePaths[i] == relativePath)
				{
					return _fileOutputs[i];
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public void LoadTemplate(string targetPath)
		{
			targetPath = System.IO.Path.GetFullPath(targetPath);
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			FindFiles(targetPath, targetPath, list);
			_filePaths = list;
			LoadFileContents(targetPath);
		}

		private void LoadFileContents(string targetPath)
		{
			_fileContents.Clear();
			foreach (string filePath in _filePaths)
			{
				string item = File.ReadAllText(System.IO.Path.Combine(targetPath, filePath));
				_fileContents.Add(item);
			}
		}

		private void FindFiles(string rootPath, string targetPath, List<string> files)
		{
			string[] directories = Directory.GetDirectories(targetPath);
			foreach (string text in directories)
			{
				string[] files2 = Directory.GetFiles(text);
				foreach (string text2 in files2)
				{
					if (text2.StartsWith(rootPath))
					{
						string item = text2.Substring(rootPath.Length + 1);
						files.Add(item);
					}
					else
					{
						files.Add(text2);
					}
				}
				FindFiles(rootPath, text, files);
			}
			directories = Directory.GetFiles(rootPath);
			foreach (string text3 in directories)
			{
				if (text3.StartsWith(rootPath))
				{
					string item2 = text3.Substring(rootPath.Length + 1);
					files.Add(item2);
				}
				else
				{
					files.Add(text3);
				}
			}
		}

		public void SaveOutput(string savePath)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < _filePaths.Count; i++)
			{
				string path = _filePaths[i];
				string path2 = System.IO.Path.Combine(savePath, path);
				Directory.CreateDirectory(System.IO.Path.GetDirectoryName(path2));
				if (_fileOutputs[i].Trim().Length > 0)
				{
					File.WriteAllText(path2, _fileOutputs[i]);
				}
			}
		}

		public string SaveTemplateToJson()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("{");
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("\"files\": [");
			for (int i = 0; i < _filePaths.Count; i++)
			{
				if (i >= 1)
				{
					stringBuilder.AppendLine(",");
				}
				stringBuilder.AppendLine("{");
				stringBuilder.Append("\"path\": \"");
				stringBuilder.Append(_filePaths[i]);
				stringBuilder.AppendLine("\"");
				stringBuilder.Append("\"content\": \"");
				stringBuilder.Append(_fileContents[i].Replace("\"", "\\\""));
				stringBuilder.AppendLine("\"");
				stringBuilder.AppendLine("}");
			}
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("]");
			stringBuilder.AppendLine("}");
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		public void LoadTemplateFromJson(string jsonTemplate)
		{
			JsonDictionaryItem jsonDictionaryItem = new JsonDictionaryParser().Parse(jsonTemplate);
			if (!(jsonDictionaryItem is JsonDictionaryObject))
			{
				return;
			}
			JsonDictionaryObject jsonDictionaryObject = (JsonDictionaryObject)jsonDictionaryItem;
			if (!jsonDictionaryObject.ContainsKey("files"))
			{
				return;
			}
			JsonDictionaryItem jsonDictionaryItem2 = jsonDictionaryObject["Files"];
			if (!(jsonDictionaryItem2 is JsonDictionaryArray))
			{
				return;
			}
			JsonDictionaryArray jsonDictionaryArray = (JsonDictionaryArray)jsonDictionaryItem2;
			for (int i = 0; i < jsonDictionaryArray.Items.Length; i++)
			{
				JsonDictionaryItem jsonDictionaryItem3 = jsonDictionaryArray.Items[i];
				if (jsonDictionaryItem3 is JsonDictionaryObject)
				{
					JsonDictionaryObject jsonDictionaryObject2 = (JsonDictionaryObject)jsonDictionaryItem3;
					if (jsonDictionaryObject2.ContainsKey("path") && jsonDictionaryObject2.ContainsKey("content"))
					{
						_filePaths.Add(((JsonDictionaryValue)jsonDictionaryObject2["path"]).Value.ToString());
						_fileContents.Add(((JsonDictionaryValue)jsonDictionaryObject2["content"]).Value.ToString());
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public void Execute(CodeGeneratingRendererResult result)
		{
			_fileOutputs.Clear();
			for (int i = 0; i < _fileContents.Count; i++)
			{
				_fileOutputs.Add(_fileContents[i]);
			}
			string[] keys = result.GetKeys();
			HashSet<string> hashSet = new HashSet<string>();
			for (int j = 0; j < keys.Length; j++)
			{
				hashSet.Add(keys[j]);
			}
			string[] importsKeys = result.GetImportsKeys();
			for (int k = 0; k < importsKeys.Length; k++)
			{
				hashSet.Add(importsKeys[k]);
			}
			string[] stringNames = result.GetStringNames();
			for (int l = 0; l < stringNames.Length; l++)
			{
				hashSet.Add(stringNames[l]);
			}
			for (int m = 0; m < _fileContents.Count; m++)
			{
				string currOutput = _fileOutputs[m];
				currOutput = RemoveUndefinedSections(currOutput, hashSet);
				_fileOutputs[m] = currOutput;
			}
			string[] importsKeys2;
			for (int n = 0; n < _fileContents.Count; n++)
			{
				List<string> list = new List<string>();
				importsKeys2 = result.GetImportsKeys();
				foreach (string item in importsKeys2)
				{
					list.Add(item);
				}
				string currOutput2 = _fileOutputs[n];
				currOutput2 = ReplaceImports(currOutput2, list.ToArray(), result);
				_fileOutputs[n] = currOutput2;
			}
			importsKeys2 = result.GetKeys();
			foreach (string text in importsKeys2)
			{
				for (int num2 = 0; num2 < _fileContents.Count; num2++)
				{
					string currOutput3 = _fileOutputs[num2];
					string contentForKey = result.GetContentForKey(text);
					currOutput3 = ReplaceContent(currOutput3, text, contentForKey, result);
					_fileOutputs[num2] = currOutput3;
				}
			}
			importsKeys2 = result.GetStringNames();
			foreach (string text2 in importsKeys2)
			{
				for (int num3 = 0; num3 < _fileContents.Count; num3++)
				{
					string text3 = _fileOutputs[num3];
					text3 = text3.Replace("$$" + text2, result.GetString(text2));
					_fileOutputs[num3] = text3;
				}
			}
			foreach (string newFile in result.GetNewFiles())
			{
				string newFileContent = result.GetNewFileContent(newFile);
				string text4 = "";
				foreach (string filePath in _filePaths)
				{
					if (filePath.StartsWith("src"))
					{
						text4 = "src/";
					}
				}
				_filePaths.Add(text4 + newFile);
				_fileOutputs.Add(newFileContent);
			}
		}

		private string RemoveUndefinedSections(string currOutput, HashSet<string> keyHash)
		{
			MatchCollection matchCollection = new Regex("(?:(<!--)|(\\/\\/))\\s*ifdef ([\\w]+)(?:(\\s*-->)?)([\\w\\W\\r\\n]*?)(?:(<!--)|(\\/\\/))\\s*endifdef \\3(?:(\\s*-->)?)((\\r\\n)|(\\n))").Matches(currOutput);
			if (matchCollection != null && matchCollection.Count > 0)
			{
				List<Match> list = new List<Match>();
				foreach (Match item in matchCollection)
				{
					list.Add(item);
				}
				list.Reverse();
				foreach (Match item2 in list)
				{
					System.Text.RegularExpressions.Group obj = item2.Groups[3];
					if (!keyHash.Contains(obj.Value))
					{
						int index = item2.Index;
						int length = item2.Length;
						currOutput = currOutput.Substring(0, index) + currOutput.Substring(index + length, currOutput.Length - (index + length));
						continue;
					}
					string text = item2.Groups[5].ToString();
					text = text.TrimStart('\r', '\n', '\t', ' ');
					text = text.TrimEnd('\r', '\n', '\t', ' ');
					int index2 = item2.Index;
					int length2 = item2.Length;
					currOutput = currOutput.Substring(0, index2) + text + currOutput.Substring(index2 + length2, currOutput.Length - (index2 + length2));
				}
			}
			return currOutput;
		}

		private string ReplaceImports(string currOutput, string[] importKeys, CodeGeneratingRendererResult result)
		{
			List<Tuple<int, string, CodeGeneratingImportManager>> importsList = new List<Tuple<int, string, CodeGeneratingImportManager>>();
			foreach (string key in importKeys)
			{
				CodeGeneratingRegexHelper codeGeneratingRegexHelper = new CodeGeneratingRegexHelper("(?:(<!--)|(\\/\\/))\\s*insert " + key + "(?:(\\s*-->)?)[\\w\\W\\r\\n]*?(?:(<!--)|(\\/\\/))\\s*end " + key + "(?:(\\s*-->)?)((\\r\\n)|(\\n))");
				currOutput = codeGeneratingRegexHelper.Execute(currOutput, delegate(Func<int, string> getGroups, int start, int length)
				{
					List<CodeGeneratingImportManager> importsForKey = result.GetImportsForKey(key);
					CodeGeneratingImportManager codeGeneratingImportManager2 = new CodeGeneratingImportManager();
					foreach (CodeGeneratingImportManager item3 in importsForKey)
					{
						codeGeneratingImportManager2 = CodeGeneratingImportManager.Merge(codeGeneratingImportManager2, item3);
					}
					importsList.Add(new Tuple<int, string, CodeGeneratingImportManager>(start, key, codeGeneratingImportManager2));
					return (string)null;
				});
			}
			importsList.Sort((Tuple<int, string, CodeGeneratingImportManager> tuple, Tuple<int, string, CodeGeneratingImportManager> tuple2) => tuple.Item1.CompareTo(tuple2.Item1));
			CodeGeneratingImportManager codeGeneratingImportManager = new CodeGeneratingImportManager();
			foreach (Tuple<int, string, CodeGeneratingImportManager> item4 in importsList)
			{
				string item = item4.Item2;
				CodeGeneratingImportManager item2 = item4.Item3;
				CodeGeneratingImportManager toWrite = item2.RemoveDuplicates(codeGeneratingImportManager);
				codeGeneratingImportManager = CodeGeneratingImportManager.Merge(codeGeneratingImportManager, item2);
				CodeGeneratingRegexHelper codeGeneratingRegexHelper2 = new CodeGeneratingRegexHelper("(?:(<!--)|(\\/\\/))\\s*insert " + item + "(?:(\\s*-->)?)[\\w\\W\\r\\n]*?(?:(<!--)|(\\/\\/))\\s*end " + item + "(?:(\\s*-->)?)((\\r\\n)|(\\n))");
				currOutput = codeGeneratingRegexHelper2.Execute(currOutput, delegate(Func<int, string> getGroups, int start, int length)
				{
					string text = GetImportsContent(toWrite, result);
					if (text != null && text.Length > 0)
					{
						text = AdjustContentTabbing(text, currOutput, start, result);
					}
					return text;
				});
			}
			return currOutput;
		}

		private string AdjustContentTabbing(string content, string currOutput, int start, CodeGeneratingRendererResult result)
		{
			int num = start;
			string text = "";
			while (num > 0)
			{
				if (currOutput[num] == ' ')
				{
					text += " ";
				}
				if (currOutput[num] == '\t')
				{
					text += "\t";
				}
				if (currOutput[num] == '\n')
				{
					break;
				}
				num--;
			}
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			string[] array = content.Replace("\r\n", "\n").Split('\n');
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				if (i != array.Length - 1 || array[i].Length != 0)
				{
					string value = array[i];
					if (i > 0)
					{
						stringBuilder.Append(text);
					}
					stringBuilder.AppendLine(value);
				}
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		private string GetImportsContent(CodeGeneratingImportManager toWrite, CodeGeneratingRendererResult result)
		{
			if (toWrite.HasPackageImports)
			{
				return toWrite.PackageImportsToString();
			}
			return toWrite.UsingsToString();
		}

		private string ReplaceContent(string currOutput, string key, string content, CodeGeneratingRendererResult result)
		{
			CodeGeneratingRegexHelper codeGeneratingRegexHelper = new CodeGeneratingRegexHelper("(?:(<!--)|(\\/\\/))\\s*insert " + key + "(?:(\\s*-->)?)[\\w\\W\\r\\n]*?(?:(<!--)|(\\/\\/))\\s*end " + key + "(?:(\\s*-->)?)((\\r\\n)|(\\n))");
			currOutput = codeGeneratingRegexHelper.Execute(currOutput, delegate(Func<int, string> getGroups, int start, int length)
			{
				if (content != null && content.Length > 0)
				{
					content = AdjustContentTabbing(content, currOutput, start, result);
				}
				return content;
			});
			return currOutput;
		}
	}
	internal class CodeGeneratingRegexHelper
	{
		private Regex _pattern;

		public CodeGeneratingRegexHelper(string pattern)
		{
			_pattern = new Regex(pattern);
		}

		public string Execute(string input, Func<Func<int, string>, int, int, string> onMatch)
		{
			MatchCollection matchCollection = _pattern.Matches(input);
			if (matchCollection != null && matchCollection.Count > 0)
			{
				List<Match> list = new List<Match>();
				foreach (Match item in matchCollection)
				{
					list.Add(item);
				}
				list.Reverse();
				foreach (Match m in list)
				{
					Func<int, string> arg = (int i) => m.Groups[i].Value;
					int num = m.Index;
					int num2 = m.Length;
					string text = onMatch(arg, num, num2);
					if (text == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (text.Length == 0)
					{
						int num3;
						for (num3 = num - 1; num3 > 0; num3--)
						{
							if (input[num3] == '\n' || (input[num3] != ' ' && input[num3] != '\t'))
							{
								if (input[num3] == '\n')
								{
									if (num3 > 0 && input[num3] == '\r')
									{
										num3--;
										num2++;
									}
								}
								else
								{
									num3++;
									num2--;
								}
								break;
							}
							num2++;
						}
						num = num3;
					}
					if (num < 0)
					{
						num = 0;
					}
					string text2 = input.Substring(0, num);
					string text3 = input.Substring(num + num2, input.Length - (num + num2));
					input = text2 + text + text3;
				}
			}
			return input;
		}
	}
	internal class CodeGeneratingCodeWriter
	{
		private StringBuilder _builder = new StringBuilder();

		private int _indentLevel;

		public bool _isNewLine = true;

		private CodeGenerationRendererOptions _options;

		public CodeGeneratingCodeWriter(CodeGenerationRendererOptions options)
		{
			_options = options;
		}

		public void IncreaseIndent()
		{
			_indentLevel++;
		}

		public void DecreaseIndent()
		{
			_indentLevel--;
		}

		public void Write(string content)
		{
			EnsureIndent();
			_builder.Append(content);
		}

		private void EnsureIndent()
		{
			if (!_isNewLine)
			{
				return;
			}
			_isNewLine = false;
			for (int i = 0; i < _indentLevel; i++)
			{
				if (_options.UseSpacesForIndent)
				{
					for (int j = 0; j < _options.IndentSpaces; j++)
					{
						_builder.Append(" ");
					}
				}
				else
				{
					_builder.Append("\t");
				}
			}
		}

		public void WriteLine(string content)
		{
			EnsureIndent();
			_builder.AppendLine(content);
			_isNewLine = true;
		}

		public void NewLine()
		{
			EnsureIndent();
			_builder.AppendLine();
			_isNewLine = true;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return _builder.ToString();
		}
	}
	internal class CodeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterPropertyType
	{
		public JsonDictionaryValueType JsonType { get; set; }

		public bool IsSubObject { get; set; }

		public string[] SubObjectPropertyNames { get; set; }

		public CodeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterPropertyType[] SubObjectPropertyTypes { get; set; }

		public bool IsArray { get; internal set; }

		public bool IsComplete()
		{
			if (JsonType == JsonDictionaryValueType.NullValue)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!IsSubObject && !IsArray)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (SubObjectPropertyNames == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < SubObjectPropertyNames.Length; i++)
			{
				CodeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterPropertyType codeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterPropertyType = SubObjectPropertyTypes[i];
				if (codeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterPropertyType.IsSubObject && !codeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterPropertyType.IsComplete())
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}
	}

	internal class CodeGeneratingComponentRendererHandlerEmitter
	{
		private CodeGenerationRendererOptions _options;

		private CodeGeneratingRendererResult _result;

		private CodeGeneratingCodeWriter _writer;

		private CodeGeneratingImportManager _importsWriter = new CodeGeneratingImportManager();

		private HashSet<string> _seenImports = new HashSet<string>();

		protected CodeGeneratingRendererResult Result => _result;

		protected CodeGeneratingCodeWriter Writer => _writer;

		protected CodeGeneratingImportManager ImportsWriter => _importsWriter;

		public CodeGeneratingComponentRendererHandlerEmitter(CodeGenerationRendererOptions options, CodeGeneratingRendererResult result)
		{
			_options = options;
			_result = result;
			_writer = new CodeGeneratingCodeWriter(_options);
		}

		public void EmitHandlers()
		{
			HashSet<string> hashSet = new HashSet<string>();
			for (int i = 0; i < _result.TrackedBindings.Count; i++)
			{
				CodeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo codeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo = _result.TrackedBindings[i];
				if (codeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo.SourceRef == null || codeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo.Value != null || _options.Library == null || !_options.Library.HasItem(codeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo.SourceRef.Name) || hashSet.Contains(codeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo.SourceRef.Name))
				{
					continue;
				}
				hashSet.Add(codeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo.SourceRef.Name);
				CodeGenerationLibraryItem item = _options.Library.GetItem(codeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo.SourceRef.Name);
				if (item.Type != CodeGenerationLibraryItemType.EventHandler)
				{
					continue;
				}
				CodeGenerationLibraryItemContent contentForPlatform = item.GetContentForPlatform(_result.Platform);
				if (contentForPlatform == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (contentForPlatform.IsJson)
				{
					JsonDictionaryObject jsonDictionaryObject = (JsonDictionaryObject)new JsonDictionaryParser().Parse(contentForPlatform.Content);
					string[] array;
					if (jsonDictionaryObject.ContainsKey("imports"))
					{
						array = ((string)((JsonDictionaryValue)jsonDictionaryObject["imports"]).Value).Replace("\r\n", "\n").Split('\n');
						foreach (string text in array)
						{
							if (text.Trim().Length != 0 && !_seenImports.Contains(text))
							{
								_seenImports.Add(text);
								WriteImport(ImportsWriter, text);
							}
						}
					}
					if (!jsonDictionaryObject.ContainsKey("handler"))
					{
						continue;
					}
					string str = (string)((JsonDictionaryValue)jsonDictionaryObject["handler"]).Value;
					str = TransformHandlerCode(str);
					string[] array2 = str.Replace("\r\n", "\n").Split('\n');
					int num = int.MaxValue;
					string text2 = "";
					for (int k = 0; k < _options.IndentSpaces; k++)
					{
						text2 += " ";
					}
					array = array2;
					foreach (string text3 in array)
					{
						string text4 = text3;
						if (text4.Trim().Length != 0)
						{
							text4 = text3.Replace("\t", text2);
							int num2 = 0;
							for (int l = 0; l < text4.Length && (text4[l] == ' ' || text4[l] == '\t'); l++)
							{
								num2++;
							}
							if (num2 < num)
							{
								num = num2;
							}
						}
					}
					array = array2;
					for (int j = 0; j < array.Length; j++)
					{
						string text5 = array[j];
						int num3 = 0;
						if (text5.Trim().Length > 0)
						{
							while (text5.Length > 0 && (text5[0] == ' ' || text5[0] == '\t') && num3 < num)
							{
								if (text5[0] == ' ')
								{
									text5 = text5.Substring(1);
									num3++;
								}
								if (text5[0] == '\t')
								{
									text5 = text5.Substring(1);
									num3 += _options.IndentSpaces;
								}
							}
						}
						Writer.WriteLine(text5);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					string content = contentForPlatform.Content;
					Writer.WriteLine(content);
				}
			}
			_result.AddContainerResult("eventHandlers", Writer.ToString());
			_result.AddImportResult("handlersImports", ImportsWriter);
		}

		protected virtual void WriteImport(CodeGeneratingImportManager importsWriter, string str)
		{
		}

		protected virtual string TransformHandlerCode(string str)
		{
			return str;
		}
	}

		public void EmitData(JsonDictionaryItem refs)
		{
			if (refs != null)
			{
				JsonDictionaryObject jsonDictionaryObject = (JsonDictionaryObject)refs;
				string[] keys = jsonDictionaryObject.GetKeys();
				foreach (string text in keys)
				{
					JsonDictionaryItem jsonDictionaryItem = jsonDictionaryObject[text];
					if (jsonDictionaryItem is JsonDictionaryValue)
					{
						JsonDictionaryValue val = (JsonDictionaryValue)jsonDictionaryItem;
						EmitVMPrimitiveProperty(text, val);
						continue;
					}
					if (jsonDictionaryItem is JsonDictionaryArray)
					{
						JsonDictionaryArray data = (JsonDictionaryArray)jsonDictionaryItem;
						EmitNamedData(text, data, Writer, VmImportsWriter);
						EmitVMArrayProperty(text);
						continue;
					}
					JsonDictionaryObject jsonDictionaryObject2 = (JsonDictionaryObject)jsonDictionaryItem;
					string[] propertyNames = GetPropertyNames(jsonDictionaryObject2);
					CodeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterPropertyType[] propertyTypes = GetPropertyTypes(jsonDictionaryObject2);
					foreach (CodeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterItemType itemType in GetItemTypes(ToTypeName(text, isItem: true), ToTypeName(text), propertyNames, propertyTypes))
					{
						EmitItemType(itemType, Writer, VmImportsWriter);
					}
					EmitVMSubObjectProperty(text, propertyNames, propertyTypes, jsonDictionaryObject2);
				}
			}
			HashSet<string> hashSet = new HashSet<string>();
			for (int j = 0; j < _result.TrackedBindings.Count; j++)
			{
				CodeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo codeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo = _result.TrackedBindings[j];
				if (codeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo.SourceRef == null || codeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo.Value != null || _options.Library == null || !_options.Library.HasItem(codeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo.SourceRef.Name) || hashSet.Contains(codeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo.SourceRef.Name))
				{
					continue;
				}
				hashSet.Add(codeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo.SourceRef.Name);
				CodeGenerationLibraryItem item = _options.Library.GetItem(codeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo.SourceRef.Name);
				if (item.Type == CodeGenerationLibraryItemType.Data)
				{
					CodeGeneratingCodeWriter codeGeneratingCodeWriter = new CodeGeneratingCodeWriter(_options);
					CodeGeneratingImportManager codeGeneratingImportManager = new CodeGeneratingImportManager();
					string name = item.Name;
					CodeGenerationLibraryItemContent contentForPlatform = item.GetContentForPlatform(_result.Platform);
					if (contentForPlatform.IsJson)
					{
						JsonDictionaryArray data2 = (JsonDictionaryArray)new JsonDictionaryParser().Parse(contentForPlatform.Content);
						EmitLibraryFileStart(codeGeneratingCodeWriter);
						EmitNamedData(name, data2, codeGeneratingCodeWriter, codeGeneratingImportManager);
						EmitLibraryFileEnd(codeGeneratingCodeWriter);
						EmitVMArrayProperty(name);
					}
					else
					{
						string content = contentForPlatform.Content;
						AddImportsForRawFile(name, codeGeneratingImportManager);
						codeGeneratingCodeWriter.Write(content);
						EmitVMArrayProperty(name);
					}
					CollectNewFileImports(name, codeGeneratingImportManager);
					_result.AddContainerNewFileResult(name + Extension, codeGeneratingCodeWriter.ToString());
				}
			}
			_result.AddContainerResult("vmProperties", VmPropsWriter.ToString());
			_result.AddImportResult("vmImports", VmImportsWriter);
			_result.AddImportResult("vmLibraryImports", VmLibraryImportsWriter);
			_result.AddContainerResult("vmLibraryProjectFiles", VmLibraryProjectFileWriter.ToString());

		public void EmitNamedData(string refName, JsonDictionaryItem data, CodeGeneratingCodeWriter typeWriter, CodeGeneratingImportManager importsWriter)
		{
			if (!(data is JsonDictionaryArray))
			{
				return;
			}
			JsonDictionaryArray jsonDictionaryArray = (JsonDictionaryArray)data;
			if (jsonDictionaryArray.Items == null || jsonDictionaryArray.Items.Length == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			JsonDictionaryItem representativeItem = GetRepresentativeItem(jsonDictionaryArray.Items);
			if (representativeItem == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			string[] propertyNames = GetPropertyNames(representativeItem);
			CodeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterPropertyType[] propertyTypes = GetPropertyTypes(representativeItem);
			if (propertyNames != null)
			{
				StartData(refName, propertyNames, propertyTypes, typeWriter, importsWriter);
				for (int i = 0; i < jsonDictionaryArray.Items.Length; i++)
				{
					AddDataItem(refName, propertyNames, propertyTypes, jsonDictionaryArray.Items[i], i, typeWriter);
				}
				EndData(refName, propertyNames, propertyTypes, typeWriter);
			}
		}

			codeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterItemType.PropertyNames = propertyNames;

			list.Add(codeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterItemType);
			for (int i = 0; i < propertyNames.Length; i++)
			{
				string text = propertyNames[i];
				CodeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterPropertyType codeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterPropertyType = propertyTypes[i];
				if (codeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterPropertyType.IsSubObject)
				{
					List<CodeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterItemType> itemTypes = GetItemTypes(ToTypeName(typeName) + "_" + text, ToTypeName(typeName) + "_" + text, codeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterPropertyType.SubObjectPropertyNames, codeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterPropertyType.SubObjectPropertyTypes);
					list.AddRange(itemTypes);
				}
				else if (codeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterPropertyType.IsArray)
				{
					List<CodeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterItemType> itemTypes2 = GetItemTypes(ToTypeName(typeName) + "_" + text + "Item", ToTypeName(typeName) + "_" + text, codeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterPropertyType.SubObjectPropertyNames, codeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterPropertyType.SubObjectPropertyTypes);
					list.AddRange(itemTypes2);
				}
			}
			return list;

		private CodeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterPropertyType[] GetPropertyTypes(JsonDictionaryItem representativeItem)
		{
			List<CodeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterPropertyType> list = new List<CodeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterPropertyType>();
			if (representativeItem is JsonDictionaryObject)
			{
				JsonDictionaryObject jsonDictionaryObject = (JsonDictionaryObject)representativeItem;
				string[] keys = jsonDictionaryObject.GetKeys();
				foreach (string key in keys)
				{
					JsonDictionaryItem jsonDictionaryItem = jsonDictionaryObject[key];
					CodeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterPropertyType codeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterPropertyType = new CodeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterPropertyType();
					if (jsonDictionaryItem is JsonDictionaryObject)
					{
						codeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterPropertyType.IsSubObject = true;
						string[] propertyNames = GetPropertyNames(jsonDictionaryItem);
						CodeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterPropertyType[] propertyTypes = GetPropertyTypes(jsonDictionaryItem);
						codeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterPropertyType.SubObjectPropertyNames = propertyNames;
						codeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterPropertyType.SubObjectPropertyTypes = propertyTypes;
					}
					else if (jsonDictionaryItem is JsonDictionaryArray)
					{
						codeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterPropertyType.IsArray = true;
						JsonDictionaryArray jsonDictionaryArray = (JsonDictionaryArray)jsonDictionaryItem;
						if (jsonDictionaryArray.Items != null && jsonDictionaryArray.Items.Length != 0)
						{
							JsonDictionaryItem representativeItem2 = GetRepresentativeItem(jsonDictionaryArray.Items);
							string[] propertyNames2 = GetPropertyNames(representativeItem2);
							CodeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterPropertyType[] propertyTypes2 = GetPropertyTypes(representativeItem2);
							codeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterPropertyType.SubObjectPropertyNames = propertyNames2;
							codeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterPropertyType.SubObjectPropertyTypes = propertyTypes2;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						JsonDictionaryValue jsonDictionaryValue = (JsonDictionaryValue)jsonDictionaryItem;
						codeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterPropertyType.JsonType = jsonDictionaryValue.Type;
					}
					list.Add(codeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterPropertyType);
				}
				return list.ToArray();
			}
			return null;
		}

		private string[] GetPropertyNames(JsonDictionaryItem representativeItem)
		{
			if (representativeItem is JsonDictionaryObject)
			{
				return ((JsonDictionaryObject)representativeItem).GetKeys();
			}
			return null;
		}

		private JsonDictionaryItem GetRepresentativeItem(JsonDictionaryItem[] items)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < items.Length; i++)
			{
				if (items[i] == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				CodeGeneratingComponentRendererDataEmitterPropertyType[] propertyTypes = GetPropertyTypes(items[i]);
				if (propertyTypes == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				bool flag = true;
				for (int j = 0; j < propertyTypes.Length; j++)
				{
					if (!propertyTypes[j].IsComplete())
					{
						flag = false;
					}
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					return items[i];
				}
			}
			return null;
		}
