	internal class CodeGeneratingComponentRendererModuleEmitter
	{
		private CodeGenerationRendererOptions _options;

		private CodeGeneratingRendererResult _result;

		private CodeGeneratingCodeWriter _writer;

		private CodeGeneratingImportManager _importsWriter = new CodeGeneratingImportManager();

		private CodeGeneratingImportManager _descriptionImportsWriter = new CodeGeneratingImportManager();

		private CodeGeneratingCodeWriter _descriptionRegisterWriter;

		protected CodeGeneratingCodeWriter Writer => _writer;

		protected CodeGeneratingImportManager ImportsWriter => _importsWriter;

		protected CodeGeneratingImportManager DescriptionImportsWriter => _descriptionImportsWriter;

		protected CodeGeneratingCodeWriter DescriptionRegisterWriter => _descriptionRegisterWriter;

		public CodeGeneratingComponentRendererModuleEmitter(CodeGenerationRendererOptions options, CodeGeneratingRendererResult result)
		{
			_options = options;
			_result = result;
			_writer = new CodeGeneratingCodeWriter(_options);
			_descriptionRegisterWriter = new CodeGeneratingCodeWriter(_options);
		}

		public void EmitModules(JsonDictionaryItem modules)
		{
			StartModules();
			if (modules is JsonDictionaryArray)
			{
				JsonDictionaryArray jsonDictionaryArray = (JsonDictionaryArray)modules;
				for (int i = 0; i < jsonDictionaryArray.Items.Length; i++)
				{
					JsonDictionaryItem jsonDictionaryItem = jsonDictionaryArray.Items[i];
					if (jsonDictionaryItem is JsonDictionaryValue)
					{
						JsonDictionaryValue jsonDictionaryValue = (JsonDictionaryValue)jsonDictionaryItem;
						if (jsonDictionaryValue != null)
						{
							string modString = jsonDictionaryValue.Value.ToString();
							EmitModule(modString);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			EndModules();
			_result.AddImportResult("modulesImports", ImportsWriter);
			_result.AddContainerResult("modulesRegister", Writer.ToString());
			_result.AddImportResult("descriptionImports", DescriptionImportsWriter);
			_result.AddContainerResult("descriptionRegister", DescriptionRegisterWriter.ToString());
		}

		protected virtual void EndModules()
		{
		}

		protected virtual void EmitModule(string modString)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void StartModules()
		{
		}
	}
	internal class CodeGeneratingComponentRendererCodeEmitter
	{
		private CodeGenerationRendererOptions _options;

		private CodeGeneratingRendererResult _result;

		private List<CodeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo> _bindings = new List<CodeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo>();

		private CodeGeneratingCodeWriter _writer;

		private CodeGeneratingCodeWriter _bindingCodeWriter;

		private CodeGeneratingCodeWriter _bindingInitCodeWriter;

		private CodeGeneratingCodeWriter _bindingFieldsWriter;

		private List<string> _importedTypes = new List<string>();

		private Stack<string> _typeNames = new Stack<string>();

		private Stack<string> _currentName = new Stack<string>();

		private Stack<bool> _hasAutoName = new Stack<bool>();

		protected CodeGeneratingRendererResult Result => _result;

		protected CodeGeneratingCodeWriter Writer => _writer;

		protected CodeGeneratingCodeWriter BindingCodeWriter => _bindingCodeWriter;

		protected CodeGeneratingCodeWriter BindingInitCodeWriter => _bindingInitCodeWriter;

		protected CodeGeneratingCodeWriter BindingFieldsWriter => _bindingFieldsWriter;

		protected string CurrentTypeName => _typeNames.Peek();

		protected virtual bool UseRgba => false;

		protected virtual string Prefix => "";

		protected internal string CurrentName
		{
			get
			{
				if (_currentName.Count > 0)
				{
					return _currentName.Peek();
				}
				return CodeGeneratingComponentRenderer.Camelify(CurrentTypeName.Replace(Prefix, "").Replace("Component", ""));
			}
		}

		protected bool IsRoot => _typeNames.Count == 1;

		protected bool HasAutoName
		{
			get
			{
				if (_hasAutoName.Count == 0)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return _hasAutoName.Peek();
			}
		}

		protected bool HasCurrentName
		{
			get
			{
				if (_currentName.Count > 0)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public string PackageName { get; internal set; }

		public virtual bool UsesCamelProperties => true;

		protected void TrackBinding(CodeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo val)
		{
			_result.TrackBinding(val);
		}

		public CodeGeneratingComponentRendererCodeEmitter(CodeGenerationRendererOptions options, CodeGeneratingRendererResult result)
		{
			_options = options;
			_result = result;
			_writer = new CodeGeneratingCodeWriter(_options);
			_bindingCodeWriter = new CodeGeneratingCodeWriter(_options);
			_bindingInitCodeWriter = new CodeGeneratingCodeWriter(_options);
			_bindingFieldsWriter = new CodeGeneratingCodeWriter(_options);
		}

		protected void AddTypeImport(string typeName)
		{
			_importedTypes.Add(typeName);
		}

		protected internal bool IsBinding(CodeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo val)
		{
			if (val.MetaData != null && (val.MetaData.KnownType == TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.DataRef || val.MetaData.KnownType == TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.EventRef || val.MetaData.KnownType == TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.MethodRef) && val.SourceRef != null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public virtual void BeginType(string typeName)
		{
			_typeNames.Push(typeName);
		}

		public virtual void StartSubProperties()
		{
		}

		public virtual void EndType(string typeName)
		{
			_typeNames.Pop();
		}

		public virtual void EmitProperty(int simplePropCount, string prop, CodeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo val, TypeDescriptionContext context)
		{
		}

		public virtual void EmitSubProperty(int subPropCount, string prop, CodeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo val, TypeDescriptionContext context)
		{
			EmitProperty(subPropCount, prop, val, context);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return _writer.ToString();
		}

		protected virtual string GetNullString()
		{
			return "null";
		}

		protected virtual string GetValueAsString(CodeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo val, bool isPascal)
		{
			if (val.MetaData == null)
			{
				return (string)val.Value;
			}
			if (val.Value is CodeGenerationSpecialValue)
			{
				val.Value = ResolveSpecialValue(val);
			}
			switch (val.MetaData.KnownType)
			{
			case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Array:
				return GetArrayLiteral(val);
			case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Boolean:
				if (!(bool)val.Value)
				{
					return "false";
				}
				return "true";
			case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Brush:
				return BrushToString(val);
			case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.BrushCollection:
			{
				string text = "";
				IList list = (IList)val.Value;
				for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
				{
					if (i >= 1)
					{
						text += " ";
					}
					text += BrushObjectToString(list[i]);
				}
				return text;
			}
			case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Collection:
				throw new NotSupportedException("shouldn't get here");
			case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Color:
				return ColorToString(val);
			case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.ColorCollection:
			{
				string text2 = "";
				IList list2 = (IList)val.Value;
				for (int j = 0; j < list2.Count; j++)
				{
					if (j >= 1)
					{
						text2 += " ";
					}
					text2 += ColorObjectToString(list2[j]);
				}
				return text2;
			}
			case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.DataRef:
				if (val.SourceRef != null)
				{
					return GetSourceRef(val);
				}
				if (val.Value == null)
				{
					return GetNullString();
				}
				break;
			case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.DataTemplate:
				throw new NotSupportedException("need to figure this out");
			case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Date:
				throw new NotSupportedException("need to figure this out");
			case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.EventRef:
				if (val.SourceRef != null)
				{
					return GetEventReference(val);
				}
				return GetNullString();
			case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.ExportedType:
				if (val.MetaData.SpecificExternalType == "string")
				{
					return GetEnumValue(val);
				}
				if (val.SourceRef != null)
				{
					return GetExportedTypeReference(val);
				}
				throw new NotSupportedException("shouldn't get here");
			case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.IList:
				throw new NotSupportedException("shouldn't get here");
			case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.MethodRef:
				if (val.SourceRef != null)
				{
					return GetMethodReference(val);
				}
				return GetNullString();
			case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Number:
				return val.Value.ToString();
			case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Point:
			{
				Point point = (Point)val.Value;
				return point.X + ", " + point.Y;
			}
			case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Rect:
			{
				Rect rect = (Rect)val.Value;
				return rect.Left + ", " + rect.Top + ", " + rect.Width + ", " + rect.Height;
			}
			case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Size:
			{
				Size size = (Size)val.Value;
				return size.Width + ", " + size.Height;
			}
			case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.String:
				if (val.Value == null)
				{
					return GetNullString();
				}
				return val.Value.ToString();
			case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.TimeSpan:
				return val.Value.ToString();
			case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Unknown:
				if (val.Value == null)
				{
					return "null";
				}
				_ = val.Value is string;
				return val.Value.ToString();
			case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Void:
				throw new NotSupportedException("shouldn't get here");
			}
			return "";
		}

		protected virtual string GetArrayLiteral(CodeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo val)
		{
			return "";
		}

		protected virtual object ResolveSpecialValue(CodeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo val)
		{
			return val.Value;
		}

		private string GetSourceRef(CodeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo val)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(val.SourceRef.Name))
			{
				if (val.SourceRef.HasSystemValue)
				{
					return GetElementBinding(val);
				}
				return GetRefBinding(val);
			}
			return GetNullString();
		}

		protected virtual string GetRefBinding(CodeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo val)
		{
			return "";
		}

		protected virtual string GetElementBinding(CodeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo val)
		{
			return "";
		}

		private string GetExportedTypeReference(CodeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo val)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(val.SourceRef.Name))
			{
				return val.SourceRef.Name;
			}
			return GetNullString();
		}

		protected virtual string GetEnumValue(CodeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo val)
		{
			if (val.Value == null)
			{
				return "";
			}
			return val.Value.ToString();
		}

		protected virtual string GetMethodReference(CodeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo val)
		{
			return GetEventReference(val);
		}

		protected virtual string GetEventReference(CodeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo val)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(val.SourceRef.Name))
			{
				TrackBinding(val);
				return val.SourceRef.Name;
			}
			return GetNullString();
		}

		protected virtual string ColorToString(CodeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo val)
		{
			return ColorUtil.ColorToString((Color)val.Value, UseRgba);
		}

		protected virtual string ColorObjectToString(object val)
		{
			return ColorUtil.ColorToString((Color)val, UseRgba);
		}

		protected virtual string BrushToString(CodeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo val)
		{
			if (val.Value == null)
			{
				return "";
			}
			return ColorUtil.ColorToString(((SolidColorBrush)val.Value).Color, UseRgba);
		}

		protected virtual string BrushObjectToString(object val)
		{
			if (val == null)
			{
				return "";
			}
			return ColorUtil.ColorToString(((SolidColorBrush)val).Color, UseRgba);
		}

		public void PushName(string value)
		{
			_currentName.Push(value);
			_hasAutoName.Push(item: false);
		}

		public void PushAutoName(string typeName)
		{
			string autoName = GetAutoName(typeName);
			_currentName.Push(autoName);
			_hasAutoName.Push(item: true);
		}

		private string GetAutoName(string typeName)
		{
			string value = typeName.Replace(Prefix, "").Replace("Component", "");
			value = CodeGeneratingComponentRenderer.Camelify(value);
			return _result.GetAutoName(value);
		}

		public void PopAutoName()
		{
			_currentName.Pop();
			_hasAutoName.Pop();
		}

		public void PopName()
		{
			_currentName.Pop();
		}

		public void CollectFields(StringBuilder fields)
		{
			string text = BindingFieldsWriter.ToString();
			if (text.Length > 0)
			{
				fields.Append(text);
			}
		}

		public void CollectInitBindings(StringBuilder bindings)
		{
			string text = BindingInitCodeWriter.ToString();
			if (text.Length > 0)
			{
				bindings.Append(text);
			}
		}

		public void CollectBindings(StringBuilder bindings)
		{
			string text = BindingCodeWriter.ToString();
			if (text.Length > 0)
			{
				bindings.Append(text);
			}
		}

		public virtual void CollectImports(CodeGeneratingImportManager imports)
		{
			if (_importedTypes.Count > 0)
			{
				CollectImportsOverride(_importedTypes, imports);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void CollectImportsOverride(List<string> importedTypes, CodeGeneratingImportManager imports)
		{
		}
	}
	[DontHide]
	[DontObfuscate]
	public class CodeGeneratingImportManager
	{
		private List<string> _usings = new List<string>();

		private HashSet<string> _seenUsings = new HashSet<string>();

		private List<string> _packages = new List<string>();

		private Dictionary<string, List<string>> _packageImports = new Dictionary<string, List<string>>();

		private Dictionary<string, HashSet<string>> _seenPackageImports = new Dictionary<string, HashSet<string>>();

		public string PackageOverride { get; set; }

		public bool IsImportsOnly { get; set; }

		public bool HasPackageImports => _packageImports.Count > 0;

		public void AddUsing(string usingStatement)
		{
			if (!_seenUsings.Contains(usingStatement))
			{
				_seenUsings.Add(usingStatement);
				_usings.Add(usingStatement);
			}
		}

		public string PackageImportsToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			for (int i = 0; i < _packages.Count; i++)
			{
				string text = _packages[i];
				List<string> values = _packageImports[text];
				string text2 = string.Join(", ", values);
				if (IsImportsOnly && i > 0)
				{
					stringBuilder.AppendLine(",");
				}
				if (IsImportsOnly)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(text2);
					continue;
				}
				stringBuilder.AppendLine("import { " + text2 + " } from '" + text + "';");
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		public string UsingsToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			for (int i = 0; i < _usings.Count; i++)
			{
				stringBuilder.AppendLine(_usings[i]);
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		public bool Any()
		{
			if (_packages.Count <= 0)
			{
				return _usings.Count > 0;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public void AddPackageImport(string package, string type)
		{
			if (PackageOverride != null)
			{
				package = PackageOverride;
			}
			if (!_seenPackageImports.ContainsKey(package))
			{
				_packages.Add(package);
				_seenPackageImports.Add(package, new HashSet<string>());
				_packageImports.Add(package, new List<string>());
			}
			if (!_seenPackageImports[package].Contains(type))
			{
				_seenPackageImports[package].Add(type);
				_packageImports[package].Add(type);
			}
		}

		public static CodeGeneratingImportManager Merge(CodeGeneratingImportManager a, CodeGeneratingImportManager b)
		{
			CodeGeneratingImportManager codeGeneratingImportManager = new CodeGeneratingImportManager();
			if (a.IsImportsOnly || b.IsImportsOnly)
			{
				codeGeneratingImportManager.IsImportsOnly = true;
			}
			if (b._packageImports.Count > 0 || a._packageImports.Count > 0)
			{
				foreach (string key in a._packageImports.Keys)
				{
					foreach (string item in a._packageImports[key])
					{
						codeGeneratingImportManager.AddPackageImport(key, item);
					}
				}
				foreach (string key2 in b._packageImports.Keys)
				{
					foreach (string item2 in b._packageImports[key2])
					{
						codeGeneratingImportManager.AddPackageImport(key2, item2);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				foreach (string @using in a._usings)
				{
					codeGeneratingImportManager.AddUsing(@using);
				}
				foreach (string using2 in b._usings)
				{
					codeGeneratingImportManager.AddUsing(using2);
				}
			}
			return codeGeneratingImportManager;
		}

		public CodeGeneratingImportManager RemoveDuplicates(CodeGeneratingImportManager toRemove)
		{
			CodeGeneratingImportManager codeGeneratingImportManager = Merge(this, new CodeGeneratingImportManager());
			if (IsImportsOnly)
			{
				codeGeneratingImportManager.IsImportsOnly = true;
			}
			if (toRemove._packageImports.Count > 0)
			{
				foreach (string key in toRemove._packageImports.Keys)
				{
					if (!_packageImports.ContainsKey(key))
					{
						continue;
					}
					foreach (string item in toRemove._packageImports[key])
					{
						if (codeGeneratingImportManager._seenPackageImports.ContainsKey(key) && codeGeneratingImportManager._seenPackageImports[key].Contains(item))
						{
							codeGeneratingImportManager._seenPackageImports[key].Remove(item);
							codeGeneratingImportManager._packageImports[key].Remove(item);
							if (codeGeneratingImportManager._packageImports[key].Count == 0)
							{
								codeGeneratingImportManager._packages.Remove(key);
								codeGeneratingImportManager._seenPackageImports.Remove(key);
								codeGeneratingImportManager._packageImports.Remove(key);
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				foreach (string @using in toRemove._usings)
				{
					if (codeGeneratingImportManager._seenUsings.Contains(@using))
					{
						codeGeneratingImportManager._seenUsings.Remove(@using);
						codeGeneratingImportManager._usings.Remove(@using);
					}
				}
			}
			return codeGeneratingImportManager;
		}
	}
	[DontHide]
	[DontObfuscate]
	public class CodeGeneratingRendererResult
	{
		private List<CodeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo> _trackedBindings = new List<CodeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo>();

		private Dictionary<string, List<string>> _containerResults = new Dictionary<string, List<string>>();

		private Dictionary<string, List<CodeGeneratingImportManager>> _importResults = new Dictionary<string, List<CodeGeneratingImportManager>>();

		private Dictionary<string, List<string>> _containerNewFileResults = new Dictionary<string, List<string>>();

		private Dictionary<string, int> _anon = new Dictionary<string, int>();

		private Dictionary<string, string> _strings = new Dictionary<string, string>();

		private Dictionary<string, string> _descriptionFields = new Dictionary<string, string>();

		private Dictionary<string, int> _autoNameCounts = new Dictionary<string, int>();

		internal List<CodeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo> TrackedBindings => _trackedBindings;

		public CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms Platform { get; internal set; }

		public CodeGenerationRendererOptions GenerationOptions { get; internal set; }

		public void AddContainerResult(string id, string res)
		{
			if (!_containerResults.ContainsKey(id))
			{
				_containerResults.Add(id, new List<string>());
			}
			_containerResults[id].Add(res);
		}

		public void AddImportResult(string id, CodeGeneratingImportManager imp)
		{
			if (!_importResults.ContainsKey(id))
			{
				_importResults.Add(id, new List<CodeGeneratingImportManager>());
			}
			_importResults[id].Add(imp);
		}

		public void AddContainerNewFileResult(string fileName, string content)
		{
			if (!_containerNewFileResults.ContainsKey(fileName))
			{
				_containerNewFileResults.Add(fileName, new List<string>());
			}
			_containerNewFileResults[fileName].Add(content);
		}

		public string[] GetKeys()
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			foreach (string key in _containerResults.Keys)
			{
				list.Add(key);
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		public string[] GetImportsKeys()
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			foreach (string key in _importResults.Keys)
			{
				list.Add(key);
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		public string GetContentForKey(string id)
		{
			if (!_containerResults.ContainsKey(id))
			{
				return "";
			}
			List<string> list = _containerResults[id];
			if (list.Count == 1)
			{
				return list[0];
			}
			string text = "";
			foreach (string item in list)
			{
				text += item;
			}
			return text;
		}

		internal List<CodeGeneratingImportManager> GetImportsForKey(string key)
		{
			if (!_importResults.ContainsKey(key))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return _importResults[key];
		}

		internal string Decollide(string anonName)
		{
			if (!_anon.ContainsKey(anonName))
			{
				_anon[anonName] = 1;
			}
			int num = _anon[anonName];
			string result = anonName + num;
			_anon[anonName] = num + 1;
			return result;
		}

		internal void TrackBinding(CodeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo val)
		{
			_trackedBindings.Add(val);
		}

		public List<string> GetNewFiles()
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			foreach (string key in _containerNewFileResults.Keys)
			{
				list.Add(key);
			}
			return list;
		}

		public string GetNewFileContent(string newFile)
		{
			List<string> list = _containerNewFileResults[newFile];
			string text = "";
			foreach (string item in list)
			{
				text += item;
			}
			return text;
		}

		public void DefineString(string key, string value)
		{
			_strings[key] = value;
		}

		public string[] GetStringNames()
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			foreach (string key in _strings.Keys)
			{
				list.Add(key);
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		public string GetString(string key)
		{
			return _strings[key];
		}

		public void TrackDescriptionField(string name, string field)
		{
			_descriptionFields[name] = field;
		}

		public bool HasDescription(string name)
		{
			return _descriptionFields.ContainsKey(name);
		}

		public string GetDescriptionField(string name)
		{
			return _descriptionFields[name];
		}

		internal string GetAutoName(string typeName)
		{
			int num = 0;
			if (!_autoNameCounts.ContainsKey(typeName))
			{
				_autoNameCounts.Add(typeName, num);
			}
			else
			{
				num = _autoNameCounts[typeName];
			}
			num++;
			_autoNameCounts[typeName] = num;
			return typeName + num;
		}
	}
	[DontHide]
	[DontObfuscate]
	public class CodeGenerationRendererOptions
	{
		public bool GenerateFullProject { get; set; }

		public bool ForceCodeBehind { get; set; }

		public CodeGenerationLibrary Library { get; set; }

		public bool UseSpacesForIndent { get; set; }

		public int IndentSpaces { get; set; }

		public CodeGenerationRendererOptions()
		{
			UseSpacesForIndent = true;
			IndentSpaces = 4;
		}
	}
	internal enum CodeGenerationSpecialValueType
	{
		FontFamily,
		FontStyles,
		FontWeights,
		Color
	}
	internal class CodeGenerationSpecialValue
	{
		public CodeGenerationSpecialValueType Type { get; set; }

		public object Value { get; set; }
	}
	internal class CodeGenerationTransformer : ITypeDescriptionPropertyTransforms
	{
		private CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms _platform;

		private Dictionary<string, Func<object, DescriptionTreeAction, object>> _transforms = new Dictionary<string, Func<object, DescriptionTreeAction, object>>();

		public CodeGenerationTransformer(CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms platform)
		{
			_platform = platform;
			_transforms["VisibilityToBooleanTransform"] = (object l, DescriptionTreeAction m) => (l.ToString().ToLower() == "visible") ? ((object)true) : ((object)false);
			if (platform == CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms.WPF)
			{
				_transforms["AxisLabelTransform"] = delegate(object l, DescriptionTreeAction m)
				{
					string text = (string)l;
					if (text == null)
					{
						return (object)null;
					}
					return (!text.Contains("{")) ? ("{" + text + "}") : text;
				};
				_transforms["FontFamilyTransform"] = delegate(object l, DescriptionTreeAction m)
				{
					string text = (string)l;
					return (text == null) ? null : new CodeGenerationSpecialValue
					{
						Type = CodeGenerationSpecialValueType.FontFamily,
						Value = text
					};
				};
				_transforms["FontStyleTransform"] = delegate(object l, DescriptionTreeAction m)
				{
					string text = (string)l;
					if (text == null)
					{
						return new CodeGenerationSpecialValue
						{
							Type = CodeGenerationSpecialValueType.FontStyles,
							Value = "Normal"
						};
					}
					text = text.ToLower();
					if (text == "normal")
					{
						return new CodeGenerationSpecialValue
						{
							Type = CodeGenerationSpecialValueType.FontStyles,
							Value = "Normal"
						};
					}
					return (text == "italic") ? new CodeGenerationSpecialValue
					{
						Type = CodeGenerationSpecialValueType.FontStyles,
						Value = "Italic"
					} : new CodeGenerationSpecialValue
					{
						Type = CodeGenerationSpecialValueType.FontStyles,
						Value = "Normal"
					};
				};
				_transforms["FontWeightTransform"] = delegate(object l, DescriptionTreeAction m)
				{
					string text = (string)l;
					if (text == null)
					{
						return new CodeGenerationSpecialValue
						{
							Type = CodeGenerationSpecialValueType.FontStyles,
							Value = "Normal"
						};
					}
					text = text.ToLower();
					if (text == "normal")
					{
						return new CodeGenerationSpecialValue
						{
							Type = CodeGenerationSpecialValueType.FontWeights,
							Value = "Normal"
						};
					}
					return (text == "bold") ? new CodeGenerationSpecialValue
					{
						Type = CodeGenerationSpecialValueType.FontWeights,
						Value = "Bold"
					} : new CodeGenerationSpecialValue
					{
						Type = CodeGenerationSpecialValueType.FontStyles,
						Value = "Normal"
					};
				};
			}
			if (platform == CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms.WindowsForms)
			{
				_transforms["ColorTransform"] = (object l, DescriptionTreeAction m) => new CodeGenerationSpecialValue
				{
					Type = CodeGenerationSpecialValueType.Color,
					Value = l
				};
				_transforms["FontFamilyTransform"] = delegate(object l, DescriptionTreeAction m)
				{
					string text = (string)l;
					return (text == null) ? null : new CodeGenerationSpecialValue
					{
						Type = CodeGenerationSpecialValueType.FontFamily,
						Value = text
					};
				};
				_transforms["FontStyleTransform"] = delegate(object l, DescriptionTreeAction m)
				{
					string text = (string)l;
					string propertyName = m.PropertyName.Replace("Style", "Weight");
					bool flag = false;
					if (m.TargetNode.Has(propertyName))
					{
						string text2 = (string)m.TargetNode.Get(propertyName).Value;
						if (text2 != null && text2.ToLower() == "bold")
						{
							flag = true;
						}
					}
					if (text == null)
					{
						if (flag)
						{
							return new CodeGenerationSpecialValue
							{
								Type = CodeGenerationSpecialValueType.FontStyles,
								Value = "Bold"
							};
						}
						return new CodeGenerationSpecialValue
						{
							Type = CodeGenerationSpecialValueType.FontStyles,
							Value = "Regular"
						};
					}
					text = text.ToLower();
					if (text == "normal")
					{
						if (flag)
						{
							return new CodeGenerationSpecialValue
							{
								Type = CodeGenerationSpecialValueType.FontStyles,
								Value = "Bold"
							};
						}
						return new CodeGenerationSpecialValue
						{
							Type = CodeGenerationSpecialValueType.FontStyles,
							Value = "Regular"
						};
					}
					if (text == "italic")
					{
						if (flag)
						{
							return new CodeGenerationSpecialValue
							{
								Type = CodeGenerationSpecialValueType.FontStyles,
								Value = "BoldItalic"
							};
						}
						return new CodeGenerationSpecialValue
						{
							Type = CodeGenerationSpecialValueType.FontStyles,
							Value = "Italic"
						};
					}
					return flag ? new CodeGenerationSpecialValue
					{
						Type = CodeGenerationSpecialValueType.FontStyles,
						Value = "Bold"
					} : new CodeGenerationSpecialValue
					{
						Type = CodeGenerationSpecialValueType.FontStyles,
						Value = "Regular"
					};
				};
				_transforms["FontWeightTransform"] = delegate(object l, DescriptionTreeAction m)
				{
					string text = (string)l;
					string propertyName = m.PropertyName.Replace("Weight", "Style");
					bool flag = false;
					if (m.TargetNode.Has(propertyName))
					{
						string text2 = (string)m.TargetNode.Get(propertyName).Value;
						if (text2 != null && text2.ToLower() == "italic")
						{
							flag = true;
						}
					}
					if (text == null)
					{
						if (flag)
						{
							return new CodeGenerationSpecialValue
							{
								Type = CodeGenerationSpecialValueType.FontStyles,
								Value = "Italic"
							};
						}
						return new CodeGenerationSpecialValue
						{
							Type = CodeGenerationSpecialValueType.FontStyles,
							Value = "Regular"
						};
					}
					text = text.ToLower();
					if (text == "normal")
					{
						if (flag)
						{
							return new CodeGenerationSpecialValue
							{
								Type = CodeGenerationSpecialValueType.FontStyles,
								Value = "Italic"
							};
						}
						return new CodeGenerationSpecialValue
						{
							Type = CodeGenerationSpecialValueType.FontStyles,
							Value = "Regular"
						};
					}
					if (text == "bold")
					{
						if (flag)
						{
							return new CodeGenerationSpecialValue
							{
								Type = CodeGenerationSpecialValueType.FontStyles,
								Value = "BoldItalic"
							};
						}
						return new CodeGenerationSpecialValue
						{
							Type = CodeGenerationSpecialValueType.FontStyles,
							Value = "Bold"
						};
					}
					return flag ? new CodeGenerationSpecialValue
					{
						Type = CodeGenerationSpecialValueType.FontStyles,
						Value = "Italic"
					} : new CodeGenerationSpecialValue
					{
						Type = CodeGenerationSpecialValueType.FontStyles,
						Value = "Regular"
					};
				};
			}
			if (platform != CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms.Angular && platform != CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms.React && platform != CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms.WebComponents)
			{
				return;
			}
			_transforms["FontFamilyTransform"] = delegate(object l, DescriptionTreeAction m)
			{
				string currentStyle = GetCurrentStyle(m);
				string currentSize = GetCurrentSize(m);
				string currentWeight = GetCurrentWeight(m);
				string text = (string)l;
				if (text == null)
				{
					text = "Verdana";
				}
				return currentStyle + " " + currentWeight + " " + currentSize + " " + text;
			};
			_transforms["FontStyleTransform"] = delegate(object l, DescriptionTreeAction m)
			{
				string currentFamily = GetCurrentFamily(m);
				string currentSize = GetCurrentSize(m);
				string currentWeight = GetCurrentWeight(m);
				string text = (string)l;
				if (text == null)
				{
					text = "normal";
				}
				return text + " " + currentWeight + " " + currentSize + " " + currentFamily;
			};
			_transforms["FontSizeTransform"] = delegate(object l, DescriptionTreeAction m)
			{
				string currentFamily = GetCurrentFamily(m);
				string currentStyle = GetCurrentStyle(m);
				string currentWeight = GetCurrentWeight(m);
				string text = ((l != null) ? (l.ToString() + "px") : null);
				if (text == null)
				{
					text = "14px";
				}
				return currentStyle + " " + currentWeight + " " + text + " " + currentFamily;
			};
			_transforms["FontWeightTransform"] = delegate(object l, DescriptionTreeAction m)
			{
				string currentFamily = GetCurrentFamily(m);
				string currentSize = GetCurrentSize(m);
				string currentStyle = GetCurrentStyle(m);
				string text = l?.ToString();
				if (text == null)
				{
					text = "normal";
				}
				text = text.ToLower();
				return currentStyle + " " + text + " " + currentSize + " " + currentFamily;
			};
		}

		internal string GetCurrentFamily(DescriptionTreeAction action)
		{
			string propertyName = action.PropertyName.Replace("Style", "Family").Replace("Weight", "Family").Replace("Size", "Family");
			string text = "Verdana";
			if (action.TargetNode.Has(propertyName))
			{
				text = (string)action.TargetNode.Get(propertyName).Value;
				if (text == null)
				{
					text = "Verdana";
				}
			}
			return text;
		}

		internal string GetCurrentStyle(DescriptionTreeAction action)
		{
			string propertyName = action.PropertyName.Replace("Family", "Style").Replace("Weight", "Style").Replace("Size", "Style");
			string text = "normal";
			if (action.TargetNode.Has(propertyName))
			{
				text = (string)action.TargetNode.Get(propertyName).Value;
				if (text == null)
				{
					text = "normal";
				}
			}
			return text;
		}

		internal string GetCurrentSize(DescriptionTreeAction action)
		{
			string propertyName = action.PropertyName.Replace("Family", "Size").Replace("Weight", "Size").Replace("Style", "Size");
			string result = "14px";
			if (action.TargetNode.Has(propertyName))
			{
				result = action.TargetNode.Get(propertyName).Value.ToString();
				result = ((result != null) ? (result.ToString() + "px") : "14px");
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal string GetCurrentWeight(DescriptionTreeAction action)
		{
			string propertyName = action.PropertyName.Replace("Family", "Weight").Replace("Size", "Weight").Replace("Style", "Weight");
			string result = "normal";
			if (action.TargetNode.Has(propertyName))
			{
				result = (string)action.TargetNode.Get(propertyName).Value;
				if (result == null)
				{
					result = "normal";
				}
				result = result.ToLower();
			}
			return result;
		}

		public object Transform(TypeDescriptionPlatform platform, object propertyValue, DescriptionTreeAction action)
		{
			TypeDescriptionMetadata propertyMetadata = action.PropertyMetadata;
			if (propertyMetadata == null)
			{
				return propertyValue;
			}
			string transformName = propertyMetadata.GetTransformName(platform);
			if (transformName != null && _transforms.ContainsKey(transformName))
			{
				return _transforms[transformName](propertyValue, action);
			}
			return propertyValue;
		}
	}
	[DontObfuscate]
	[DontHide]
	public enum CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms
	{
		WPF,
		Angular,
		React,
		WebComponents,
		WindowsForms
	}
	[DontObfuscate]
	[DontHide]
	public class CodeGenerationContainer : Panel
	{
		public string Id { get; set; }

		internal List<CodeGenerationItemBuilder> ChildItems { get; private set; }

		public CodeGenerationContainer()
		{
			ChildItems = new List<CodeGenerationItemBuilder>();
		}

		internal void Emit(CodeGeneratingRendererResult result, CodeGeneratingComponentRenderer renderer, CodeGenerationRendererOptions options)
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			StringBuilder stringBuilder2 = new StringBuilder();
			StringBuilder stringBuilder3 = new StringBuilder();
			CodeGeneratingImportManager codeGeneratingImportManager = new CodeGeneratingImportManager();
			foreach (CodeGenerationItemBuilder childItem in ChildItems)
			{
				CodeGeneratingComponentRendererCodeEmitter emitter = renderer.GetEmitter(childItem, options, result);
				childItem.Emit(emitter, isRoot: true);
				string res = emitter.ToString();
				result.AddContainerResult(Id, res);
				emitter.CollectFields(stringBuilder);
				emitter.CollectInitBindings(stringBuilder2);
				emitter.CollectBindings(stringBuilder3);
				emitter.CollectImports(codeGeneratingImportManager);
			}
			result.AddContainerResult("bindingFields", stringBuilder.ToString());
			result.AddContainerResult("bindingInit", stringBuilder2.ToString());
			result.AddContainerResult("bindingCode", stringBuilder3.ToString());
			result.AddImportResult("bindingImports", codeGeneratingImportManager);
		}
	}
	internal class CodeGenerationItemBuilder
	{
		private List<string> _propertiesList = new List<string>();

		private Dictionary<string, CodeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo> _properties = new Dictionary<string, CodeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo>();

		private TypeDescriptionContext _context;

		private CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms _platform;

		private string _type;

		private object _container;

		protected virtual string ComponentPrefix => _platform switch
		{
			CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms.Angular => "Igx", 
			CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms.React => "Igr", 
			CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms.WebComponents => "Igc", 
			CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms.WindowsForms => "Ultra", 
			CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms.WPF => "Xam", 
			_ => "", 
		};

		protected virtual string ComponentSuffix => _platform switch
		{
			CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms.Angular => "Component", 
			CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms.React => "", 
			CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms.WebComponents => "Component", 
			CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms.WindowsForms => "", 
			CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms.WPF => "", 
			_ => "", 
		};

		public CodeGenerationItemBuilder(CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms platform, string type, TypeDescriptionContext context, object container)
		{
			_platform = platform;
			_type = type;
			_context = context;
			_container = container;
		}

		internal CodeGenerationItemBuilder CreateSubObjectForProperty(string propertyName)
		{
			TypeDescriptionMetadata metadata = _context.GetMetadata(_type, propertyName);
			return new CodeGenerationItemBuilder(_platform, GetTypeName(metadata), _context, _container);
		}

		private string GetTypeName(TypeDescriptionMetadata metadata)
		{
			if (metadata.SpecificExternalType == null)
			{
				return metadata.SpecificType;
			}
			return metadata.SpecificExternalType;
		}

		public void SetPropertyValue(string propertyName, TypeDescriptionMetadata propertyMetadata, object value, DescriptionRef sourceRef)
		{
			if (!_properties.ContainsKey(propertyName))
			{
				_propertiesList.Add(propertyName);
			}
			_properties[propertyName] = new CodeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo
			{
				MetaData = propertyMetadata,
				Value = value,
				SourceRef = sourceRef
			};
		}

		public void OnPendingRef(string propertyName, TypeDescriptionMetadata propertyMetadata, DescriptionRef sourceRef)
		{
			object value = null;
			if (!_properties.ContainsKey(propertyName))
			{
				_propertiesList.Add(propertyName);
			}
			if (_properties.ContainsKey(propertyName))
			{
				value = _properties[propertyName].Value;
			}
			_properties[propertyName] = new CodeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo
			{
				MetaData = propertyMetadata,
				Value = value,
				SourceRef = sourceRef
			};
		}

		internal void ResetPropertyValue(string propertyName, TypeDescriptionMetadata propertyMetadata)
		{
			if (_properties.ContainsKey(propertyName))
			{
				_properties.Remove(propertyName);
			}
		}

		internal object GetPropertyValue(string propertyName)
		{
			if (_properties.ContainsKey(propertyName))
			{
				return _properties[propertyName].Value;
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal void Emit(CodeGeneratingComponentRendererCodeEmitter emitter, bool isRoot)
		{
			string itemType = GetItemType();
			if (isRoot)
			{
				string packageName = GetPackageName();
				emitter.PackageName = packageName;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			bool flag2 = false;
			if (_properties.ContainsKey("Name"))
			{
				flag = true;
				emitter.PushName((string)_properties["Name"].Value);
			}
			else if (_properties.ContainsKey("name"))
			{
				flag = true;
				emitter.PushName((string)_properties["name"].Value);
			}
			else if (NeedsAutoName(emitter))
			{
				flag2 = true;
				emitter.PushAutoName(itemType);
				if (emitter.UsesCamelProperties)
				{
					_propertiesList.Add("name");
					_properties.Add("name", new CodeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo
					{
						Value = emitter.CurrentName
					});
				}
				else
				{
					_propertiesList.Add("Name");
					_properties.Add("Name", new CodeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo
					{
						Value = emitter.CurrentName
					});
				}
			}
			emitter.BeginType(itemType);
			int num = 0;
			foreach (string properties in _propertiesList)
			{
				CodeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo codeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo = _properties[properties];
				if ((codeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo.MetaData != null || !(properties.ToLower() == "type")) && IsSimpleValue(properties, codeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo))
				{
					emitter.EmitProperty(num, properties, codeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo, _context);
					num++;
				}
			}
			emitter.StartSubProperties();
			int num2 = 0;
			foreach (string properties2 in _propertiesList)
			{
				CodeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo codeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo2 = _properties[properties2];
				if ((codeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo2.MetaData != null || !(properties2.ToLower() == "type")) && !IsSimpleValue(properties2, codeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo2))
				{
					emitter.EmitSubProperty(num2, properties2, codeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo2, _context);
					num2++;
				}
			}
			emitter.EndType(itemType);
			if (flag)
			{
				emitter.PopName();
			}
			else if (flag2)
			{
				emitter.PopAutoName();
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool NeedsAutoName(CodeGeneratingComponentRendererCodeEmitter emitter)
		{
			foreach (string properties in _propertiesList)
			{
				CodeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo val = _properties[properties];
				if (emitter.IsBinding(val))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool IsSimpleValue(string prop, CodeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo val)
		{
			if (val.MetaData == null && prop.ToLower() == "name")
			{
				return true;
			}
			switch (val.MetaData.KnownType)
			{
			case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Boolean:
			case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Array:
				return true;
			case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Brush:
				if (val.Value != null)
				{
					return val.Value is SolidColorBrush;
				}
				return true;
			case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.BrushCollection:
				return true;
			case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Collection:
				return false;
			case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Color:
				return true;
			case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.ColorCollection:
				return true;
			case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.DataRef:
				return true;
			case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.DataTemplate:
				return false;
			case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Date:
				return true;
			case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.EventRef:
				return true;
			case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.ExportedType:
				if (val.MetaData.SpecificExternalType == "string")
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (val.SourceRef != null)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.IList:
				return false;
			case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.MethodRef:
				return true;
			case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Number:
				return true;
			case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Point:
				return true;
			case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Rect:
				return true;
			case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Size:
				return true;
			case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.String:
				return true;
			case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.TimeSpan:
				return true;
			case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Unknown:
				return true;
			case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Void:
				return false;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		private string GetItemType()
		{
			if (_platform == CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms.WPF || _platform == CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms.WindowsForms)
			{
				TypeDescriptionMetadata metadata = _context.GetMetadata(_type, "_qualifiedName");
				if (metadata != null)
				{
					string specificExternalType = metadata.SpecificExternalType;
					int num = specificExternalType.LastIndexOf(".");
					if (num >= 0)
					{
						return specificExternalType.Substring(num + 1);
					}
					return specificExternalType;
				}
				return _type;
			}
			return ComponentPrefix + _type + ComponentSuffix;
		}

		private string GetPackageName()
		{
			TypeDescriptionMetadata metadata = _context.GetMetadata(_type, "_qualifiedName");
			if (metadata != null)
			{
				string[] array = metadata.SpecificExternalType.Split('.');
				if (array.Length > 2)
				{
					return array[array.Length - 2].ToLower();
				}
			}
			if (_type == "Legend" || _type == "ItemLegend")
			{
				return "charts";
			}
			return "core";
		}
	}
	internal class CodeGenerationItemBuilderPropertyInfo
	{
		public TypeDescriptionMetadata MetaData { get; set; }

		public object Value { get; set; }

		public DescriptionRef SourceRef { get; internal set; }
	}
	internal class CodeGenerationRendererAdapter : IComponentRendererAdapter
	{
		private Dispatcher _dispatcher;

		private CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms _platform;

		private IComponentRendererAdapter _innerAdapter;

		private Dictionary<string, Type> _qualifiedNames = new Dictionary<string, Type>();

		public CodeGenerationRendererAdapter(CodeGenerationTargetPlatforms platform, IComponentRendererAdapter innerAdapter, Dispatcher dispatcher)
		{
			_innerAdapter = innerAdapter;
			_platform = platform;
			_dispatcher = dispatcher;
		}

		internal Type GetTypeFromName(string type, TypeDescriptionContext context)
		{
			TypeDescriptionMetadata metadata = context.GetMetadata(type, "_qualifiedName");
			if (_qualifiedNames.ContainsKey(type))
			{
				return _qualifiedNames[type];
			}
			Assembly[] assemblies;
			if (metadata != null)
			{
				string specificExternalType = metadata.SpecificExternalType;
				Type type2 = Type.GetType(specificExternalType);
				if (type2 != null && type2.Assembly != null && type2.Assembly.FullName.Contains(".Excel"))
				{
					type2 = null;
				}
				if (type2 == null)
				{
					assemblies = AppDomain.CurrentDomain.GetAssemblies();
					foreach (Assembly assembly in assemblies)
					{
						if (!assembly.FullName.Contains("Infragistics") || assembly.FullName.Contains(".Excel"))
						{
							continue;
						}
						try
						{
							Type[] types = assembly.GetTypes();
							foreach (Type type3 in types)
							{
								if (type3.FullName == specificExternalType)
								{
									_qualifiedNames[type] = type3;
									return type3;
								}
							}
						}
						catch
						{
						}
					}
				}
				return type2;
			}
			assemblies = AppDomain.CurrentDomain.GetAssemblies();
			foreach (Assembly assembly2 in assemblies)
			{
				if (!assembly2.FullName.Contains("Infragistics") || assembly2.FullName.Contains(".Excel"))
				{
					continue;
				}
				try
				{
					Type[] types = assembly2.GetTypes();
					foreach (Type type4 in types)
					{
						if (type4.Name == type)
						{
							_qualifiedNames[type] = type4;
							return type4;
						}
					}
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
			assemblies = AppDomain.CurrentDomain.GetAssemblies();
			foreach (Assembly assembly3 in assemblies)
			{
				try
				{
					Type[] types = assembly3.GetTypes();
					foreach (Type type5 in types)
					{
						if (type5.Namespace != null && type5.Namespace.StartsWith("System") && type5.Name == type)
						{
							_qualifiedNames[type] = type5;
							return type5;
						}
					}
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public Type GetObjectType(string type, TypeDescriptionContext context)
		{
			return GetTypeFromName(type, context);
		}

		public Type GetDescriptionObjectType(string type, TypeDescriptionContext context)
		{
			return GetTypeFromName(type + "Description", context);
		}

		public object CreateColorCollection(object[] colors)
		{
			List<object> list = new List<object>();
			for (int i = 0; i < colors.Length; i++)
			{
				list.Add(colors[i]);
			}
			return list;
		}

		public object CreateBrushCollection(object[] brushes)
		{
			List<object> list = new List<object>();
			for (int i = 0; i < brushes.Length; i++)
			{
				list.Add(brushes[i]);
			}
			return list;
		}

		public object CreateObject(string type, object container, TypeDescriptionContext context)
		{
			return new CodeGenerationItemBuilder(_platform, type, context, container);
		}

		public object CoerceToEnum(string type, TypeDescriptionContext context, string value)
		{
			return value;
		}

		public void OnUIThread(object container, Action action)
		{
			if (_dispatcher.Thread == Thread.CurrentThread)
			{
				action();
			}
			else
			{
				_dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.Normal, action);
			}
		}

		public void SetOrUpdateCollectionOnTarget(object container, string propertyName, TypeDescriptionMetadata propertyMetadata, TypeDescriptionContext context, object target, object value)
		{
			object propertyValue = GetPropertyValue(target, propertyName);
			if (propertyValue == null)
			{
				List<object> list = new List<object>();
				IList list2 = (IList)value;
				for (int i = 0; i < list2.Count; i++)
				{
					list.Add(list2[i]);
				}
				SetPropertyValue(target, propertyName, propertyMetadata, list, null, null);
			}
			else
			{
				IList list3 = (IList)value;
				IList list4 = (IList)propertyValue;
				list4.Clear();
				for (int j = 0; j < list3.Count; j++)
				{
					list4.Add(list3[j]);
				}
			}
		}

		private bool IsFrozen(object val)
		{
			if (val == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (val is Freezable)
			{
				return ((Freezable)val).IsFrozen;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void OnPendingRef(object target, string propertyName, TypeDescriptionMetadata propertyMetadata, DescriptionRef sourceRef)
		{
			((CodeGenerationItemBuilder)target).OnPendingRef(propertyName, propertyMetadata, sourceRef);
		}

		public void SetPropertyValue(object target, string propertyName, TypeDescriptionMetadata propertyMetadata, object value, object oldValue, DescriptionRef sourceRef)
		{
			if (!(target is CodeGenerationItemBuilder))
			{
				_innerAdapter.SetPropertyValue(target, propertyName, propertyMetadata, value, oldValue, sourceRef);
				return;
			}
			while (propertyName.Contains("."))
			{
				string[] array = propertyName.Split('.');
				object propertyValue = GetPropertyValue(target, array[0]);
				if (propertyValue != null && !IsFrozen(propertyValue))
				{
					propertyName = "";
					for (int i = 1; i < array.Length; i++)
					{
						if (i > 1)
						{
							propertyName += ".";
						}
						propertyName += array[i];
					}
					target = propertyValue;
					continue;
				}
				propertyValue = ((CodeGenerationItemBuilder)target).CreateSubObjectForProperty(array[0]);
				SetPropertyValue(target, array[0], propertyMetadata, propertyValue, null, sourceRef);
				propertyName = "";
				for (int j = 1; j < array.Length; j++)
				{
					if (j > 1)
					{
						propertyName += ".";
					}
					propertyName += array[j];
				}
				target = propertyValue;
			}
			((CodeGenerationItemBuilder)target).SetPropertyValue(propertyName, propertyMetadata, value, sourceRef);
		}

		public object GetPropertyValue(object target, string propertyName)
		{
			while (propertyName.Contains("."))
			{
				string[] array = propertyName.Split('.');
				object propertyValue = GetPropertyValue(target, array[0]);
				if (propertyValue != null)
				{
					propertyName = "";
					for (int i = 1; i < array.Length; i++)
					{
						if (i > 1)
						{
							propertyName += ".";
						}
						propertyName += array[i];
					}
					target = propertyValue;
					continue;
				}
				propertyValue = ((CodeGenerationItemBuilder)target).CreateSubObjectForProperty(array[0]);
				for (int j = 1; j < array.Length; j++)
				{
					if (j > 1)
					{
						propertyName += ".";
					}
					propertyName += array[j];
				}
				target = propertyValue;
			}
			return ((CodeGenerationItemBuilder)target).GetPropertyValue(propertyName);
		}

		public object GetRootObject(object container)
		{
			CodeGenerationContainer codeGenerationContainer = (CodeGenerationContainer)container;
			if (codeGenerationContainer.ChildItems.Count <= 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return codeGenerationContainer.ChildItems[0];
		}

		public void ClearContainer(object container, TypeDescriptionContext context, Action<bool> continueActions)
		{
			CodeGenerationContainer codeGenerationContainer = (CodeGenerationContainer)container;
			if (codeGenerationContainer.ChildItems.Count > 0)
			{
				_ = codeGenerationContainer.ChildItems[0];
			}
			codeGenerationContainer.ChildItems.Clear();
			continueActions(obj: false);
		}

		public void ForPropertyValueItem(object target, string propertyName, Action<object> forItem)
		{
			object propertyValue = GetPropertyValue(target, propertyName);
			if (propertyValue is IList)
			{
				IList list = (IList)propertyValue;
				for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
				{
					forItem(list[i]);
				}
			}
			else if (propertyValue is Array)
			{
				object[] array = (object[])propertyValue;
				for (int j = 0; j < array.Length; j++)
				{
					forItem(array[j]);
				}
			}
		}

		public void ClearCollection(object target, string propertyName, TypeDescriptionMetadata metadata)
		{
			object propertyValue = GetPropertyValue(target, propertyName);
			if (propertyValue is IList)
			{
				((IList)propertyValue).Clear();
			}
			else if (propertyValue is Array)
			{
				SetPropertyValue(target, propertyName, metadata, null, propertyValue, null);
			}
		}

		public void AddItemToCollection(string propertyName, TypeDescriptionMetadata propertyMetadata, object target, int newIndex, object item)
		{
			object propertyValue = GetPropertyValue(target, propertyName);
			if (propertyValue is IList)
			{
				((IList)propertyValue).Insert(newIndex, item);
			}
			else if (propertyValue is Array)
			{
				IList list = (IList)propertyValue;
				List<object> list2 = new List<object>();
				for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
				{
					list2.Add(list[i]);
				}
				list2.Insert(newIndex, item);
				object[] array = new object[1] { list.Count + 1 };
				for (int j = 0; j < array.Length; j++)
				{
					array[j] = list2[j];
				}
				SetPropertyValue(target, propertyName, propertyMetadata, array, propertyValue, null);
			}
		}

		public void ResetPropertyOnTarget(object container, string propertyName, TypeDescriptionMetadata propertyMetadata, object target)
		{
			while (propertyName.Contains("."))
			{
				string[] array = propertyName.Split('.');
				object propertyValue = GetPropertyValue(target, array[0]);
				if (propertyValue != null && !IsFrozen(propertyValue))
				{
					propertyName = "";
					for (int i = 1; i < array.Length; i++)
					{
						if (i > 1)
						{
							propertyName += ".";
						}
						propertyName += array[i];
					}
					target = propertyValue;
					continue;
				}
				propertyValue = ((CodeGenerationItemBuilder)target).CreateSubObjectForProperty(array[0]);
				SetPropertyValue(target, array[0], propertyMetadata, propertyValue, null, null);
				propertyName = "";
				for (int j = 1; j < array.Length; j++)
				{
					if (j > 1)
					{
						propertyName += ".";
					}
					propertyName += array[j];
				}
				target = propertyValue;
			}
			((CodeGenerationItemBuilder)target).ResetPropertyValue(propertyName, propertyMetadata);
		}

		public void ReplaceItemInCollection(string propertyName, TypeDescriptionMetadata propertyMetadata, object target, int newIndex, object item)
		{
			object propertyValue = GetPropertyValue(target, propertyName);
			if (propertyValue is IList)
			{
				((IList)propertyValue)[newIndex] = item;
			}
			else if (propertyValue is Array)
			{
				IList list = (IList)propertyValue;
				List<object> list2 = new List<object>();
				for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
				{
					list2.Add(list[i]);
				}
				list2[newIndex] = item;
				object[] array = new object[1] { list.Count + 1 };
				for (int j = 0; j < array.Length; j++)
				{
					array[j] = list2[j];
				}
				SetPropertyValue(target, propertyName, propertyMetadata, array, propertyValue, null);
			}
		}

		public void ReplaceRootItem(object container, string type, TypeDescriptionContext context, Action<bool> continueActions)
		{
			object obj = CreateObject(type, container, context);
			CodeGenerationContainer codeGenerationContainer = (CodeGenerationContainer)container;
			if (codeGenerationContainer.ChildItems.Count > 0)
			{
				_ = codeGenerationContainer.ChildItems[0];
			}
			codeGenerationContainer.ChildItems.Clear();
			codeGenerationContainer.ChildItems.Add((CodeGenerationItemBuilder)obj);
			continueActions(obj: false);
		}

		public void RemoveItemFromCollection(string propertyName, TypeDescriptionMetadata propertyMetadata, object target, int oldIndex)
		{
			object propertyValue = GetPropertyValue(target, propertyName);
			if (propertyValue is IList)
			{
				((IList)propertyValue).RemoveAt(oldIndex);
			}
			else if (propertyValue is Array)
			{
				IList list = (IList)propertyValue;
				List<object> list2 = new List<object>();
				for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
				{
					list2.Add(list[i]);
				}
				list2.RemoveAt(oldIndex);
				object[] array = new object[1] { list.Count - 1 };
				for (int j = 0; j < array.Length; j++)
				{
					array[j] = list2[j];
				}
				SetPropertyValue(target, propertyName, propertyMetadata, array, propertyValue, null);
			}
		}

		public void RemoveRootItem(object container, TypeDescriptionContext context, Action<bool> continueActions)
		{
			CodeGenerationContainer codeGenerationContainer = (CodeGenerationContainer)container;
			if (codeGenerationContainer.ChildItems.Count > 0)
			{
				_ = codeGenerationContainer.ChildItems[0];
			}
			codeGenerationContainer.ChildItems.Clear();
			continueActions(obj: false);
		}

		{
		}
	}

	public class BingMapsMapImageryDescriptionMetadata
	{
		private static Dictionary<string, string> _metadata;

		private static void EnsureMetadata(TypeDescriptionContext context)
		{
			if (_metadata == null)
			{
				_metadata = new Dictionary<string, string>();
				FillMetadata(_metadata);
			}
			if (!context.HasMetadata(_metadata))
			{
				context.MarkSeen(_metadata);
			}
		}

		internal static void FillMetadata(Dictionary<string, string> metadata)
		{
			GeographicMapImageryDescriptionMetadata.FillMetadata(metadata);
			metadata["IsInitialized"] = "Boolean";
			metadata["IsDeferredLoad"] = "Boolean";
			metadata["TilePath"] = "String";
			metadata["ActualTilePath"] = "String";
			metadata["SubDomains"] = "Collection:String:SubDomainsCollection:String";
			metadata["ActualSubDomains"] = "Collection:String:SubDomainsCollection:String";
			metadata["BingImageryRestUri"] = "String";
			metadata["ActualBingImageryRestUri"] = "String";
			metadata["CultureName"] = "String";
			metadata["ApiKey"] = "String";
			metadata["ImageryStyle"] = "ExportedType:string:BingMapsImageryStyle";
			metadata["ImageryStyle@names"] = "Aerial;AerialWithLabels;Road;CanvasDark;CanvasLight;CanvasGray";
		}

		public static void Register(TypeDescriptionContext context)
		{
			EnsureMetadata(context);
			context.RegisterDescriptionConstructor("BingMapsMapImagery", () => new BingMapsMapImageryDescription());
			context.Register("BingMapsMapImagery", _metadata);
		}
	}
	[DontObfuscate]
	public class BingMapsMapImageryDescriptionModule
	{
		public static void Register(TypeDescriptionContext context)
		{
			BingMapsMapImageryDescriptionMetadata.Register(context);
		}
	}

	public class ButtonDescriptionMetadata
	{
		private static Dictionary<string, string> _metadata;

		private static void EnsureMetadata(TypeDescriptionContext context)
		{
			if (_metadata == null)
			{
				_metadata = new Dictionary<string, string>();
				FillMetadata(_metadata);
			}
			if (!context.HasMetadata(_metadata))
			{
				context.MarkSeen(_metadata);
				ButtonClickEventArgsDescriptionMetadata.Register(context);
			}
		}

				FunnelSliceEventArgsDescriptionMetadata.Register(context);

	public class IconDescriptionMetadata
	{
		private static Dictionary<string, string> _metadata;

		private static void EnsureMetadata(TypeDescriptionContext context)
		{
			if (_metadata == null)
			{
				_metadata = new Dictionary<string, string>();
				FillMetadata(_metadata);
			}
			if (!context.HasMetadata(_metadata))
			{
				context.MarkSeen(_metadata);
			}
		}

		internal static void FillMetadata(Dictionary<string, string> metadata)
		{
			metadata["__qualifiedNameTS"] = "String:XIcon";
			metadata["ActualFill"] = "Brush";
			metadata["ActualTextColor"] = "Brush";
			metadata["ActualHoverFill"] = "Brush";
			metadata["ActualHoverStroke"] = "Brush";
			metadata["ActualStroke"] = "Brush";
			metadata["ActualHoverStrokeThickness"] = "Number:double";
			metadata["ActualStrokeThickness"] = "Number:double";
			metadata["Fill"] = "Brush";
			metadata["TextColor"] = "Brush";
			metadata["SvgPath"] = "(w:SVGPath,wf:SVGPath)String";
			metadata["HoverFill"] = "Brush";
			metadata["HoverStroke"] = "Brush";
			metadata["Stroke"] = "Brush";
			metadata["HoverStrokeThickness"] = "Number:double";
			metadata["StrokeThickness"] = "Number:double";
			metadata["FontFamily"] = "(w:FontFamily/FontFamilyTransform,xam:FontFamily,wf:FontFamily,web:textStyle/FontFamilyTransform)String";
			metadata["FontSize"] = "(w:FontSize,xam:FontSize,wf:FontSize,web:textStyle/FontSizeTransform)Number:double";
			metadata["FontStyle"] = "(w:FontStyle/FontStyleTransform,xam:FontFamily/FontStyleTransform,wf:FontFamily/FontStyleTransform,web:textStyle/FontStyleTransform)String";
			metadata["FontWeight"] = "(w:FontWeight/FontWeightTransform,xam:FontFamily/FontWeightTransform,wf:FontFamily/FontWeightTransform,web:textStyle/FontWeightTransform)String";
			metadata["HoverTextColor"] = "Brush";
			metadata["Id"] = "String";
			metadata["TabIndex"] = "Number:int";
			metadata["AriaLabel"] = "String";
			metadata["IsHover"] = "Boolean";
			metadata["Disabled"] = "(w:IsDisabled,xam:IsDisabled,wf:IsDisabled)Boolean";
			metadata["Opacity"] = "Number:double";
		}

		public static void Register(TypeDescriptionContext context)
		{
			EnsureMetadata(context);
			context.RegisterDescriptionConstructor("Icon", () => new IconDescription());
			context.Register("Icon", _metadata);
		}
	}

	public class InputDescriptionMetadata
	{
		private static Dictionary<string, string> _metadata;

		private static void EnsureMetadata(TypeDescriptionContext context)
		{
			if (_metadata == null)
			{
				_metadata = new Dictionary<string, string>();
				FillMetadata(_metadata);
			}
			if (!context.HasMetadata(_metadata))
			{
				context.MarkSeen(_metadata);
				KeyEventArgsDescriptionMetadata.Register(context);
				InputChangeEventArgsDescriptionMetadata.Register(context);
			}
		}

		internal static void FillMetadata(Dictionary<string, string> metadata)
		{
			InputGroupItemDescriptionMetadata.FillMetadata(metadata);
			metadata["__qualifiedNameTS"] = "String:XInput";
			metadata["Density"] = "ExportedType:string:ControlDisplayDensity";
			metadata["Density@names"] = "Auto;Comfortable;Cosy;Compact";
			metadata["ActualDensity"] = "ExportedType:string:ControlDisplayDensity";
			metadata["ActualDensity@names"] = "Auto;Comfortable;Cosy;Compact";
			metadata["Mask"] = "String";
			metadata["PromptChar"] = "String";
			metadata["IncludeLiterals"] = "Boolean";
			metadata["ActualTextColor"] = "Brush";
			metadata["ActualHoverTextColor"] = "Brush";
			metadata["TextColor"] = "Brush";

				FillMetadata(_metadata);

			if (!context.HasMetadata(_metadata))

		{
			metadata["Value"] = "String";
			metadata["IsCompositionInProgress"] = "Boolean";
		}

		{
			EnsureMetadata(context);
			context.RegisterDescriptionConstructor("InputChangeEventArgs", () => new InputChangeEventArgsDescription());
			context.Register("InputChangeEventArgs", _metadata);
		}

		private string _name;

		public virtual string Type => "InputGroupItem";

		[ClientName("name")]
		public new string Name
		{
			get
			{
				return _name;
			}
			set
			{
				_name = value;
				MarkDirty("Name");
			}
		}

		public InputGroupItemDescription()
		{
		}
	}
	public class InputGroupItemDescriptionMetadata
	{
		private static Dictionary<string, string> _metadata;

		private static void EnsureMetadata(TypeDescriptionContext context)
		{
			if (_metadata == null)
			{
				_metadata = new Dictionary<string, string>();
				FillMetadata(_metadata);
			}
			if (!context.HasMetadata(_metadata))
			{
				context.MarkSeen(_metadata);
			}
		}

		internal static void FillMetadata(Dictionary<string, string> metadata)
		{
			metadata["__qualifiedNameTS"] = "String:XInputGroupItem";
			metadata["Name"] = "String";
		}

		public static void Register(TypeDescriptionContext context)
		{
			EnsureMetadata(context);
			context.Register("InputGroupItem", _metadata);
		}
	}

	public class LabelDescriptionMetadata
	{
		private static Dictionary<string, string> _metadata;

		private static void EnsureMetadata(TypeDescriptionContext context)
		{
			if (_metadata == null)
			{
				_metadata = new Dictionary<string, string>();
				FillMetadata(_metadata);
			}
			if (!context.HasMetadata(_metadata))
			{
				context.MarkSeen(_metadata);
			}
		}

		internal static void FillMetadata(Dictionary<string, string> metadata)
		{
			InputGroupItemDescriptionMetadata.FillMetadata(metadata);
			metadata["__qualifiedNameTS"] = "String:XLabel";
			metadata["BaseTheme"] = "ExportedType:string:BaseControlTheme";
			metadata["BaseTheme@names"] = "Default;DenaliLight;MaterialLight";
			metadata["Density"] = "ExportedType:string:ControlDisplayDensity";
			metadata["Density@names"] = "Auto;Comfortable;Cosy;Compact";
			metadata["ActualDensity"] = "ExportedType:string:ControlDisplayDensity";
			metadata["ActualDensity@names"] = "Auto;Comfortable;Cosy;Compact";
			metadata["ActualTextColor"] = "Brush";
			metadata["ActualHighlightTextColor"] = "Brush";
			metadata["ActualHoverHighlightTextColor"] = "Brush";
			metadata["ActualHoverTextColor"] = "Brush";
			metadata["TextColor"] = "Brush";
			metadata["HighlightTextColor"] = "Brush";
			metadata["HoverHighlightTextColor"] = "Brush";
			metadata["FontFamily"] = "(w:FontFamily/FontFamilyTransform,xam:FontFamily,wf:FontFamily,web:textStyle/FontFamilyTransform)String";
			metadata["FontSize"] = "(w:FontSize,xam:FontSize,wf:FontSize,web:textStyle/FontSizeTransform)Number:double";
			metadata["FontStyle"] = "(w:FontStyle/FontStyleTransform,xam:FontFamily/FontStyleTransform,wf:FontFamily/FontStyleTransform,web:textStyle/FontStyleTransform)String";
			metadata["FontWeight"] = "(w:FontWeight/FontWeightTransform,xam:FontFamily/FontWeightTransform,wf:FontFamily/FontWeightTransform,web:textStyle/FontWeightTransform)String";
			metadata["HoverTextColor"] = "Brush";
			metadata["Id"] = "String";
			metadata["Display"] = "String";
			metadata["FlexDirection"] = "String";
			metadata["FlexGrow"] = "String";

			metadata["AlignSelf"] = "String";
			metadata["TabIndex"] = "Number:int";

			metadata["IsHover"] = "Boolean";
			metadata["Value"] = "Boolean";
			metadata["Disabled"] = "(w:IsDisabled,xam:IsDisabled,wf:IsDisabled)Boolean";

	public class ShapeDataSourceDescriptionMetadata
	{
		private static Dictionary<string, string> _metadata;

		private static void EnsureMetadata(TypeDescriptionContext context)
		{
			if (_metadata == null)
			{
				_metadata = new Dictionary<string, string>();
				FillMetadata(_metadata);
			}
			if (!context.HasMetadata(_metadata))
			{
				context.MarkSeen(_metadata);
				AsyncCompletedEventArgsDescriptionMetadata.Register(context);
				ShapeFilterRecordEventArgsDescriptionMetadata.Register(context);
			}
		}

		internal static void FillMetadata(Dictionary<string, string> metadata)
		{
			metadata["WorldRect"] = "Rect";
			metadata["ComputedWorldRect"] = "Rect";
			metadata["DeferImportCompleted"] = "Boolean";
			metadata["ShapefileSource"] = "String";
			metadata["DatabaseSource"] = "String";
			metadata["ImportPendingRef"] = "EventRef::importPending";
			metadata["ImportCompletedRef"] = "EventRef::importCompleted";
			metadata["FilterRef"] = "EventRef::filter";
		}

		public static void Register(TypeDescriptionContext context)
		{
			EnsureMetadata(context);
			context.RegisterDescriptionConstructor("ShapeDataSource", () => new ShapeDataSourceDescription());
			context.Register("ShapeDataSource", _metadata);
		}
	}

	public class TreemapDescriptionMetadata
	{
		private static Dictionary<string, string> _metadata;

		private static void RegisterOtherMetadata(Dictionary<string, string> metadata)
		{
			metadata["_qualifiedName"] = "String:Infragistics.Controls.Charts.XamTreemap";
			metadata["Width"] = "(w:Width/DimensionTransform,xam:Width/DimensionTransform)String";
			metadata["Height"] = "(w:Height/DimensionTransform,xam:Height/DimensionTransform)String";
			metadata["Background"] = "(wf:BackColor/ColorTransform)Brush";
		}

		private static void EnsureMetadata(TypeDescriptionContext context)
		{
			if (_metadata == null)
			{
				_metadata = new Dictionary<string, string>();
				FillMetadata(_metadata);
			}
			if (!context.HasMetadata(_metadata))
			{
				context.MarkSeen(_metadata);
				TreemapNodeStylingEventArgsDescriptionMetadata.Register(context);
				TreemapNodePointerEventArgsDescriptionMetadata.Register(context);
			}
		}

		internal static void FillMetadata(Dictionary<string, string> metadata)
		{
			metadata["ValueMemberPath"] = "String";
			metadata["RootTitle"] = "String";
			metadata["BreadcrumbSequence"] = "String";
			metadata["ParentIdMemberPath"] = "String";
			metadata["LabelMemberPath"] = "String";
			metadata["CustomValueMemberPath"] = "String";
			metadata["IdMemberPath"] = "String";
			metadata["DataSourceRef"] = "(w:ItemsSource,xam:ItemsSource,j:dataSource,wf:ItemsSource)DataRef::object";
			metadata["FillBrushes"] = "BrushCollection:string";
			metadata["StyleMappings"] = "Collection:TreemapNodeStyleMapping:TreemapNodeStyleMappingCollection:TreemapNodeStyleMapping";
			metadata["FillScaleMode"] = "ExportedType:string:TreemapFillScaleMode";

	public class FinancialChartDescriptionMetadata
	{
		private static Dictionary<string, string> _metadata;

		private static void RegisterOtherMetadata(Dictionary<string, string> metadata)
		{
			metadata["TooltipTemplateRef"] = "(w:ToolTip)DataRef:String";
			metadata["_qualifiedName"] = "String:Infragistics.Controls.Charts.XamFinancialChart";
			metadata["Width"] = "(w:Width/DimensionTransform,xam:Width/DimensionTransform)String";
			metadata["Height"] = "(w:Height/DimensionTransform,xam:Height/DimensionTransform)String";
			metadata["Background"] = "(wf:BackColor/ColorTransform)Brush";
		}

		private static void EnsureMetadata(TypeDescriptionContext context)
		{
			if (_metadata == null)
			{
				_metadata = new Dictionary<string, string>();
				FillMetadata(_metadata);
			}
			if (!context.HasMetadata(_metadata))
			{
				context.MarkSeen(_metadata);
				FinancialChartCustomIndicatorArgsDescriptionMetadata.Register(context);
			}
		}

		internal static void FillMetadata(Dictionary<string, string> metadata)
		{
			XYChartDescriptionMetadata.FillMetadata(metadata);
			metadata["LeftMargin"] = "Number:double";
			metadata["IsHorizontalZoomEnabled"] = "Boolean";
			metadata["ToolbarHeight"] = "Number:double";

		{
			metadata["TemplateRef"] = "(w:Template,wf:Template,xam:Template)DataRef:String";
		}

		private static void EnsureMetadata(TypeDescriptionContext context)
		{
			if (_metadata == null)
			{
				_metadata = new Dictionary<string, string>();
				FillMetadata(_metadata);
			}
			if (!context.HasMetadata(_metadata))
			{
				context.MarkSeen(_metadata);
				TemplateCellUpdatingEventArgsDescriptionMetadata.Register(context);
			}
		}

		internal static void FillMetadata(Dictionary<string, string> metadata)
		{
			ColumnDescriptionMetadata.FillMetadata(metadata);
			metadata["CellUpdatingRef"] = "EventRef::cellUpdating";
			RegisterOtherMetadata(metadata);
		}

		public static void Register(TypeDescriptionContext context)
		{
			EnsureMetadata(context);
			context.RegisterDescriptionConstructor("TemplateColumn", () => new TemplateColumnDescription());
			context.Register("TemplateColumn", _metadata);
		}

		private static void EnsureMetadata(TypeDescriptionContext context)

	public class ZoomSliderDescriptionMetadata
	{
		private static Dictionary<string, string> _metadata;

		private static void RegisterOtherMetadata(Dictionary<string, string> metadata)
		{
			metadata["_qualifiedName"] = "String:Infragistics.Controls.Navigation.XamZoomSlider";
			metadata["Width"] = "(w:Width/DimensionTransform,xam:Width/DimensionTransform)String";
			metadata["Height"] = "(w:Height/DimensionTransform,xam:Height/DimensionTransform)String";
			metadata["Background"] = "(wf:BackColor/ColorTransform)Brush";
		}

		private static void EnsureMetadata(TypeDescriptionContext context)
		{
			if (_metadata == null)
			{
				_metadata = new Dictionary<string, string>();
				FillMetadata(_metadata);
			}
			if (!context.HasMetadata(_metadata))
			{
				context.MarkSeen(_metadata);
				ZoomSliderResolvingAxisValueEventArgsDescriptionMetadata.Register(context);
				RectChangedEventArgsDescriptionMetadata.Register(context);
			}
		}

		internal static void FillMetadata(Dictionary<string, string> metadata)
		{
			metadata["PanTransitionDuration"] = "Number:int";
			metadata["MaxZoomWidth"] = "Number:double";
			metadata["PixelScalingRatio"] = "Number:double";
			metadata["ActualPixelScalingRatio"] = "Number:double";
			metadata["WindowRect"] = "Rect";
			metadata["MinZoomWidth"] = "Number:double";
			metadata["StartInset"] = "Number:double";
			metadata["EndInset"] = "Number:double";
			metadata["TrackStartInset"] = "Number:double";
			metadata["TrackEndInset"] = "Number:double";

			metadata["HigherThumbHeight"] = "Number:double";
			metadata["LowerShadeBrush"] = "Brush";
			metadata["LowerShadeOutline"] = "Brush";
			metadata["LowerShadeStrokeThickness"] = "Number:double";
			metadata["HigherShadeBrush"] = "Brush";

	public class BulletGraphDescriptionMetadata
	{
		private static Dictionary<string, string> _metadata;

		private static void RegisterOtherMetadata(Dictionary<string, string> metadata)
		{
			metadata["FontFamily"] = "(w:FontFamily/FontFamilyTransform,xam:FontFamily,wf:FontFamily,web:TextStyle/FontFamilyTransform)String";
			metadata["FontSize"] = "(w:FontSize,xam:FontSize,wf:FontSize,web:TextStyle/FontSizeTransform)Number:double";
			metadata["FontStyle"] = "(w:FontStyle/FontStyleTransform,xam:FontStyle/FontStyleTransform,wf:FontStyle/FontStyleTransform,web:TextStyle/FontStyleTransform)String";
			metadata["FontWeight"] = "(w:FontWeight/FontWeightTransform,xam:FontStyle/FontWeightTransform,wf:FontStyle/FontWeightTransform,web:TextStyle/FontWeightTransform)String";
			metadata["_qualifiedName"] = "String:Infragistics.Controls.Gauges.XamBulletGraph";
			metadata["Width"] = "(w:Width/DimensionTransform,xam:Width/DimensionTransform)String";
			metadata["Height"] = "(w:Height/DimensionTransform,xam:Height/DimensionTransform)String";
			metadata["LegendRef"] = "(w:Legend)DataRef:String";
			metadata["Background"] = "(wf:BackColor/ColorTransform)Brush";
		}

		private static void EnsureMetadata(TypeDescriptionContext context)
		{
			if (_metadata == null)
			{
				_metadata = new Dictionary<string, string>();
				FillMetadata(_metadata);
			}
			if (!context.HasMetadata(_metadata))
			{
				context.MarkSeen(_metadata);
				FormatLinearGraphLabelEventArgsDescriptionMetadata.Register(context);
				AlignLinearGraphLabelEventArgsDescriptionMetadata.Register(context);
			}
		}

	public class LinearGaugeDescriptionMetadata
	{
		private static Dictionary<string, string> _metadata;

		private static void RegisterOtherMetadata(Dictionary<string, string> metadata)
		{
			metadata["FontFamily"] = "(w:FontFamily/FontFamilyTransform,xam:FontFamily,wf:FontFamily,web:TextStyle/FontFamilyTransform)String";
			metadata["FontSize"] = "(w:FontSize,xam:FontSize,wf:FontSize,web:TextStyle/FontSizeTransform)Number:double";
			metadata["FontStyle"] = "(w:FontStyle/FontStyleTransform,xam:FontStyle/FontStyleTransform,wf:FontStyle/FontStyleTransform,web:TextStyle/FontStyleTransform)String";
			metadata["FontWeight"] = "(w:FontWeight/FontWeightTransform,xam:FontStyle/FontWeightTransform,wf:FontStyle/FontWeightTransform,web:TextStyle/FontWeightTransform)String";
			metadata["_qualifiedName"] = "String:Infragistics.Controls.Gauges.XamLinearGauge";
			metadata["Width"] = "(w:Width/DimensionTransform,xam:Width/DimensionTransform)String";
			metadata["Height"] = "(w:Height/DimensionTransform,xam:Height/DimensionTransform)String";
			metadata["LegendRef"] = "(w:Legend)DataRef:String";
			metadata["Background"] = "(wf:BackColor/ColorTransform)Brush";
		}

		private static void EnsureMetadata(TypeDescriptionContext context)
		{
			if (_metadata == null)
			{
				_metadata = new Dictionary<string, string>();
				FillMetadata(_metadata);
			}
			if (!context.HasMetadata(_metadata))
			{
				context.MarkSeen(_metadata);
				FormatLinearGraphLabelEventArgsDescriptionMetadata.Register(context);
				AlignLinearGraphLabelEventArgsDescriptionMetadata.Register(context);
				DoubleValueChangedEventArgsDescriptionMetadata.Register(context);
			}
		}

		internal static void FillMetadata(Dictionary<string, string> metadata)
		{
			metadata["TransitionProgress"] = "Number:double";
			metadata["Orientation"] = "ExportedType:string:LinearScaleOrientation";
			metadata["Orientation@names"] = "Horizontal;Vertical";
			metadata["Ranges"] = "Collection:LinearGraphRange:LinearGraphRangeCollection:LinearGraphRange";
			metadata["RangeBrushes"] = "BrushCollection:string";
			metadata["RangeOutlines"] = "BrushCollection:string";
			metadata["MinimumValue"] = "Number:double";
			metadata["ActualMinimumValue"] = "Number:double";
			metadata["MaximumValue"] = "Number:double";
			metadata["ActualMaximumValue"] = "Number:double";
			metadata["Value"] = "Number:double";
			metadata["NeedleShape"] = "ExportedType:string:LinearGraphNeedleShape";
			metadata["NeedleShape@names"] = "Custom;Rectangle;Triangle;Needle;Trapezoid";
			metadata["NeedleName"] = "String";
			metadata["RangeInnerExtent"] = "Number:double";
			metadata["ScaleInnerExtent"] = "Number:double";
			metadata["RangeOuterExtent"] = "Number:double";
			metadata["ScaleOuterExtent"] = "Number:double";
			metadata["NeedleInnerExtent"] = "Number:double";
			metadata["NeedleOuterExtent"] = "Number:double";
