	public class CategoryChartDescriptionMetadata
	{
		private static Dictionary<string, string> _metadata;

		private static void RegisterOtherMetadata(Dictionary<string, string> metadata)
		{
			metadata["TooltipTemplateRef"] = "(w:ToolTip)DataRef:String";
			metadata["_qualifiedName"] = "String:Infragistics.Controls.Charts.XamCategoryChart";
			metadata["Width"] = "(w:Width/DimensionTransform,xam:Width/DimensionTransform)String";
			metadata["Height"] = "(w:Height/DimensionTransform,xam:Height/DimensionTransform)String";
			metadata["Background"] = "(wf:BackColor/ColorTransform)Brush";
		}

		private static void EnsureMetadata(TypeDescriptionContext context)
		{
			if (_metadata == null)
			{
				_metadata = new Dictionary<string, string>();
				FillMetadata(_metadata);
			}
			if (!context.HasMetadata(_metadata))
			{
				context.MarkSeen(_metadata);
			}
		}

		internal static void FillMetadata(Dictionary<string, string> metadata)
		{
			XYChartDescriptionMetadata.FillMetadata(metadata);
			metadata["TransitionInDuration"] = "Number:int";
			metadata["TransitionInEasingFunctionRef"] = "(w:TransitionInEasingFunction,wf:TransitionInEasingFunction)MethodRef";
			metadata["ChartType"] = "ExportedType:string:CategoryChartType";
			metadata["ChartType@names"] = "Line;Area;Column;Point;StepLine;StepArea;Spline;SplineArea;Waterfall;Auto";
			metadata["MarkerCollisionAvoidance"] = "ExportedType:string:CategorySeriesMarkerCollisionAvoidance";
			metadata["MarkerCollisionAvoidance@names"] = "None;Omit";
			metadata["IsTransitionInEnabled"] = "Boolean";
			metadata["TransitionInMode"] = "ExportedType:string:CategoryTransitionInMode";
			metadata["TransitionInMode@names"] = "Auto;FromZero;SweepFromLeft;SweepFromRight;SweepFromTop;SweepFromBottom;SweepFromCenter;AccordionFromLeft;AccordionFromRight;AccordionFromTop;AccordionFromBottom;Expand;SweepFromCategoryAxisMinimum;SweepFromCategoryAxisMaximum;SweepFromValueAxisMinimum;SweepFromValueAxisMaximum;AccordionFromCategoryAxisMinimum;AccordionFromCategoryAxisMaximum;AccordionFromValueAxisMinimum;AccordionFromValueAxisMaximum";
			metadata["TransitionInSpeedType"] = "ExportedType:string:TransitionInSpeedType";
			metadata["TransitionInSpeedType@names"] = "Auto;Normal;ValueScaled;IndexScaled;Random";
			metadata["XAxisInterval"] = "Number:double";
			metadata["XAxisMinorInterval"] = "Number:double";
			metadata["XAxisGap"] = "Number:double";

	{

		private static void RegisterOtherMetadata(Dictionary<string, string> metadata)
		{
			metadata["FontFamily"] = "(w:FontFamily/FontFamilyTransform,xam:FontFamily,wf:FontFamily,web:TextStyle/FontFamilyTransform)String";
			metadata["FontSize"] = "(w:FontSize,xam:FontSize,wf:FontSize,web:TextStyle/FontSizeTransform)Number:double";

			metadata["Width"] = "(w:Width/DimensionTransform,xam:Width/DimensionTransform)String";
			metadata["Height"] = "(w:Height/DimensionTransform,xam:Height/DimensionTransform)String";
			metadata["LegendRef"] = "(w:Legend)DataRef:String";
			metadata["Background"] = "(wf:BackColor/ColorTransform)Brush";
		}

		private static void EnsureMetadata(TypeDescriptionContext context)
		{
			if (_metadata == null)
			{
				_metadata = new Dictionary<string, string>();
				FillMetadata(_metadata);
			}
			if (!context.HasMetadata(_metadata))
			{
				context.MarkSeen(_metadata);
				FormatRadialGaugeLabelEventArgsDescriptionMetadata.Register(context);
				AlignRadialGaugeLabelEventArgsDescriptionMetadata.Register(context);
				DoubleValueChangedEventArgsDescriptionMetadata.Register(context);
			}
		}

	public class PieChartBaseDescriptionMetadata
	{
		private static Dictionary<string, string> _metadata;

		private static void RegisterOtherMetadata(Dictionary<string, string> metadata)
		{
			metadata["TooltipTemplateRef"] = "(w:ToolTip)DataRef:String";
			metadata["DataSourceRef"] = "(w:ItemsSource,xam:ItemsSource)DataRef:String";
			metadata["FontFamily"] = "(w:FontFamily/FontFamilyTransform,xam:FontFamily,wf:FontFamily,web:TextStyle/FontFamilyTransform)String";
			metadata["FontSize"] = "(w:FontSize,xam:FontSize,wf:FontSize,web:TextStyle/FontSizeTransform)Number:double";
			metadata["FontStyle"] = "(w:FontStyle/FontStyleTransform,xam:FontStyle/FontStyleTransform,wf:FontStyle/FontStyleTransform,web:TextStyle/FontStyleTransform)String";
			metadata["FontWeight"] = "(w:FontWeight/FontWeightTransform,xam:FontStyle/FontWeightTransform,wf:FontStyle/FontWeightTransform,web:TextStyle/FontWeightTransform)String";
		}

		private static void EnsureMetadata(TypeDescriptionContext context)
		{
			if (_metadata == null)
			{
				_metadata = new Dictionary<string, string>();
				FillMetadata(_metadata);
			}
			if (!context.HasMetadata(_metadata))
			{
				context.MarkSeen(_metadata);
				LabelClickEventArgsDescriptionMetadata.Register(context);
				SelectedItemChangingEventArgsDescriptionMetadata.Register(context);
				SelectedItemsChangingEventArgsDescriptionMetadata.Register(context);
				SelectedItemChangedEventArgsDescriptionMetadata.Register(context);

			metadata["OthersCategoryStrokeThickness"] = "(w:OthersCategoryStyle.StrokeThickness,wf:OthersCategoryStrokeThickness)Number:double";
			metadata["OthersCategoryOpacity"] = "(w:OthersCategoryStyle.Opacity,wf:OthersCategoryOpacity)Number:double";
			metadata["SelectedSliceFill"] = "(w:SelectedStyle.Fill,wf:SelectedSliceFill)String";
			metadata["SelectedSliceStroke"] = "(w:SelectedStyle.Stroke,wf:SelectedSliceStroke)String";
			metadata["SelectedSliceStrokeThickness"] = "(w:SelectedStyle.StrokeThickness,wf:SelectedSliceStrokeThickness)Number:double";
			metadata["SelectedSliceOpacity"] = "(w:SelectedStyle.Opacity,wf:SelectedSliceOpacity)Number:double";
			metadata["Brushes"] = "BrushCollection:string";
			metadata["Outlines"] = "BrushCollection:string";
			metadata["LabelOuterColor"] = "Brush";
			metadata["LabelInnerColor"] = "Brush";
			metadata["IsSurfaceInteractionDisabled"] = "Boolean";
			metadata["RadiusFactor"] = "Number:double";
			metadata["PropertyUpdatedRef"] = "EventRef::propertyUpdated";
			RegisterOtherMetadata(metadata);
		}

		public static void Register(TypeDescriptionContext context)
		{
			EnsureMetadata(context);
			context.Register("RingSeriesBase", _metadata);
		}
	}
	internal class JsonDictionaryParser
	{
		[DontObfuscate]
		public JsonDictionaryItem Parse(string json_)
		{
			List<JsonDictionaryToken> list = new JsonDictionaryLexer().Lex(json_);
			JsonDictionaryParseResult jsonDictionaryParseResult = ParseTokens(list);
			if (jsonDictionaryParseResult.CurrPosition != list.Count)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("content past expected end at: " + jsonDictionaryParseResult.CurrPosition);
			}
			return jsonDictionaryParseResult.Result;
		}

		private JsonDictionaryParseResult ParseTokens(List<JsonDictionaryToken> tokens)
		{
			if (MatchesObject(tokens, 0, tokens.Count))
			{
				return ParseObject(tokens, 0, tokens.Count);
			}
			if (MatchesArray(tokens, 0, tokens.Count))
			{
				return ParseArray(tokens, 0, tokens.Count);
			}
			return ParseValue(tokens, 0, tokens.Count);
		}

		private JsonDictionaryParseResult ParseValue(List<JsonDictionaryToken> tokens, int currPosition, int fullLen)
		{
			if (MatchesString(tokens, currPosition, fullLen))
			{
				return ParseString(tokens, currPosition, fullLen);
			}
			if (MatchesNumber(tokens, currPosition, fullLen))
			{
				return ParseNumber(tokens, currPosition, fullLen);
			}
			if (MatchesBoolean(tokens, currPosition, fullLen))
			{
				return ParseBoolean(tokens, currPosition, fullLen);
			}
			if (MatchesNull(tokens, currPosition, fullLen))
			{
				return ParseNull(tokens, currPosition, fullLen);
			}
			throw new InvalidOperationException("expected json value at: " + currPosition);
		}

		private JsonDictionaryParseResult ParseNull(List<JsonDictionaryToken> tokens, int currPosition, int fullLen)
		{
			JsonDictionaryToken jsonDictionaryToken = tokens[currPosition];
			currPosition++;
			if (jsonDictionaryToken.Type != JsonDictionaryTokenType.NullValue)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("expected null value at: " + currPosition);
			}
			JsonDictionaryValue result = new JsonDictionaryValue
			{
				Value = jsonDictionaryToken.Value,
				Type = JsonDictionaryValueType.NullValue
			};
			return new JsonDictionaryParseResult
			{
				Result = result,
				CurrPosition = currPosition
			};
		}

		private bool MatchesNull(List<JsonDictionaryToken> tokens, int currPosition, int fullLen)
		{
			if (currPosition > fullLen - 1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (tokens[currPosition].Type == JsonDictionaryTokenType.NullValue)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private JsonDictionaryParseResult ParseBoolean(List<JsonDictionaryToken> tokens, int currPosition, int fullLen)
		{
			JsonDictionaryToken jsonDictionaryToken = tokens[currPosition];
			currPosition++;
			if (jsonDictionaryToken.Type != JsonDictionaryTokenType.TrueValue && jsonDictionaryToken.Type != JsonDictionaryTokenType.FalseValue)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("expected boolean at: " + currPosition);
			}
			JsonDictionaryValue result = new JsonDictionaryValue
			{
				Value = jsonDictionaryToken.Value,
				Type = JsonDictionaryValueType.BooleanValue
			};
			return new JsonDictionaryParseResult
			{
				Result = result,
				CurrPosition = currPosition
			};
		}

		private bool MatchesBoolean(List<JsonDictionaryToken> tokens, int currPosition, int fullLen)
		{
			if (currPosition > fullLen - 1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (tokens[currPosition].Type == JsonDictionaryTokenType.TrueValue || tokens[currPosition].Type == JsonDictionaryTokenType.FalseValue)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private JsonDictionaryParseResult ParseNumber(List<JsonDictionaryToken> tokens, int currPosition, int fullLen)
		{
			JsonDictionaryToken jsonDictionaryToken = tokens[currPosition];
			currPosition++;
			if (jsonDictionaryToken.Type != JsonDictionaryTokenType.NumberValue)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("expected number at: " + currPosition);
			}
			JsonDictionaryValue result = new JsonDictionaryValue
			{
				Value = jsonDictionaryToken.Value,
				Type = JsonDictionaryValueType.NumberValue
			};
			return new JsonDictionaryParseResult
			{
				Result = result,
				CurrPosition = currPosition
			};
		}

		private bool MatchesNumber(List<JsonDictionaryToken> tokens, int currPosition, int fullLen)
		{
			if (currPosition > fullLen - 1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (tokens[currPosition].Type == JsonDictionaryTokenType.NumberValue)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private JsonDictionaryParseResult ParseArray(List<JsonDictionaryToken> tokens, int currPosition, int fullLen)
		{
			JsonDictionaryArray jsonDictionaryArray = new JsonDictionaryArray();
			if (tokens[currPosition].Type == JsonDictionaryTokenType.LeftSquareBracket)
			{
				currPosition++;
				List<JsonDictionaryItem> list = new List<JsonDictionaryItem>();
				while (currPosition < fullLen && tokens[currPosition].Type != JsonDictionaryTokenType.RightSquareBracket)
				{
					if (MatchesComma(tokens, currPosition, fullLen))
					{
						currPosition++;
						continue;
					}
					JsonDictionaryParseResult jsonDictionaryParseResult = (MatchesArray(tokens, currPosition, fullLen) ? ParseArray(tokens, currPosition, fullLen) : ((!MatchesObject(tokens, currPosition, fullLen)) ? ParseValue(tokens, currPosition, fullLen) : ParseObject(tokens, currPosition, fullLen)));
					list.Add(jsonDictionaryParseResult.Result);
					currPosition = jsonDictionaryParseResult.CurrPosition;
				}
				if (tokens[currPosition].Type == JsonDictionaryTokenType.RightSquareBracket)
				{
					currPosition++;
					jsonDictionaryArray.Items = list.ToArray();
					return new JsonDictionaryParseResult
					{
						Result = jsonDictionaryArray,
						CurrPosition = currPosition
					};
				}
				throw new InvalidOperationException("expected right curly brace at: " + currPosition);
			}
			throw new InvalidOperationException("expected left square bracket at: " + currPosition);
		}

		private bool MatchesComma(List<JsonDictionaryToken> tokens, int currPosition, int fullLen)
		{
			if (currPosition > fullLen - 1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (tokens[currPosition].Type == JsonDictionaryTokenType.Comma)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private JsonDictionaryParseResult ParseObject(List<JsonDictionaryToken> tokens, int currPosition, int fullLen)
		{
			JsonDictionaryObject jsonDictionaryObject = new JsonDictionaryObject();
			if (tokens[currPosition].Type == JsonDictionaryTokenType.LeftCurlyBracket)
			{
				currPosition++;
				while (currPosition < fullLen && tokens[currPosition].Type != JsonDictionaryTokenType.RightCurlyBracket)
				{
					if (MatchesComma(tokens, currPosition, fullLen))
					{
						currPosition++;
						continue;
					}
					if (MatchesString(tokens, currPosition, fullLen))
					{
						JsonDictionaryParseResult jsonDictionaryParseResult = ParseString(tokens, currPosition, fullLen);
						JsonDictionaryValue jsonDictionaryValue = (JsonDictionaryValue)jsonDictionaryParseResult.Result;
						currPosition = jsonDictionaryParseResult.CurrPosition;
						if (MatchesColon(tokens, currPosition, fullLen))
						{
							currPosition++;
							JsonDictionaryParseResult jsonDictionaryParseResult2 = (MatchesObject(tokens, currPosition, fullLen) ? ParseObject(tokens, currPosition, fullLen) : ((!MatchesArray(tokens, currPosition, fullLen)) ? ParseValue(tokens, currPosition, fullLen) : ParseArray(tokens, currPosition, fullLen)));
							currPosition = jsonDictionaryParseResult2.CurrPosition;
							jsonDictionaryObject[(string)jsonDictionaryValue.Value] = jsonDictionaryParseResult2.Result;
							continue;
						}
						throw new InvalidOperationException("expected colon after name in object at: " + currPosition);
					}
					throw new InvalidOperationException("expected name or end of object at: " + currPosition);
				}
				if (tokens[currPosition].Type == JsonDictionaryTokenType.RightCurlyBracket)
				{
					currPosition++;
					return new JsonDictionaryParseResult
					{
						Result = jsonDictionaryObject,
						CurrPosition = currPosition
					};
				}
				throw new InvalidOperationException("expected right curly brace at: " + currPosition);
			}
			throw new InvalidOperationException("expected left curly brace at: " + currPosition);
		}

		private bool MatchesColon(List<JsonDictionaryToken> tokens, int currPosition, int fullLen)
		{
			if (currPosition > fullLen - 1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (tokens[currPosition].Type == JsonDictionaryTokenType.Colon)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private JsonDictionaryParseResult ParseString(List<JsonDictionaryToken> tokens, int currPosition, int fullLen)
		{
			JsonDictionaryToken jsonDictionaryToken = tokens[currPosition];
			currPosition++;
			if (jsonDictionaryToken.Type != JsonDictionaryTokenType.StringValue)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("expected string at: " + currPosition);
			}
			JsonDictionaryValue result = new JsonDictionaryValue
			{
				Value = JsonDictionaryItem.Unescape((string)jsonDictionaryToken.Value),
				Type = JsonDictionaryValueType.StringValue
			};
			return new JsonDictionaryParseResult
			{
				Result = result,
				CurrPosition = currPosition
			};
		}

		private bool MatchesString(List<JsonDictionaryToken> tokens, int currPosition, int fullLen)
		{
			if (currPosition > fullLen - 1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (tokens[currPosition].Type == JsonDictionaryTokenType.StringValue)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool MatchesArray(List<JsonDictionaryToken> tokens, int currPosition, int fullLen)
		{
			if (currPosition > fullLen - 1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (tokens[currPosition].Type == JsonDictionaryTokenType.LeftSquareBracket)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool MatchesObject(List<JsonDictionaryToken> tokens, int currPosition, int fullLen)
		{
			if (currPosition > fullLen - 1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (tokens[currPosition].Type == JsonDictionaryTokenType.LeftCurlyBracket)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	internal class JsonDictionaryParseResult
	{
		public JsonDictionaryItem Result { get; set; }

		public int CurrPosition { get; set; }
	}
	internal class JsonDictionaryLexer
	{
		public List<JsonDictionaryToken> Lex(string input)
		{
			int num = 0;
			int length = input.Length;
			List<JsonDictionaryToken> list = new List<JsonDictionaryToken>();
			while (num < length)
			{
				num = LexHelper(list, num, length, input);
			}
			return list;
		}

		private int LexHelper(List<JsonDictionaryToken> tokens, int currPosition, int fullLen, string input)
		{
			while (currPosition < fullLen && IsWhitespace(input[currPosition]))
			{
				currPosition++;
			}
			if (currPosition > fullLen - 1)
			{
				return currPosition;
			}
			char c = input[currPosition];
			switch (c)
			{
			case '{':
				tokens.Add(new JsonDictionaryToken
				{
					Type = JsonDictionaryTokenType.LeftCurlyBracket
				});
				return currPosition + 1;
			case '}':
				tokens.Add(new JsonDictionaryToken
				{
					Type = JsonDictionaryTokenType.RightCurlyBracket
				});
				return currPosition + 1;
			case '[':
				tokens.Add(new JsonDictionaryToken
				{
					Type = JsonDictionaryTokenType.LeftSquareBracket
				});
				return currPosition + 1;
			case ']':
				tokens.Add(new JsonDictionaryToken
				{
					Type = JsonDictionaryTokenType.RightSquareBracket
				});
				return currPosition + 1;
			case ':':
				tokens.Add(new JsonDictionaryToken
				{
					Type = JsonDictionaryTokenType.Colon
				});
				return currPosition + 1;
			case ',':
				tokens.Add(new JsonDictionaryToken
				{
					Type = JsonDictionaryTokenType.Comma
				});
				return currPosition + 1;
			case '"':
			{
				string text = "";
				int num = currPosition;
				bool flag = false;
				for (num = currPosition + 1; num < fullLen; num++)
				{
					if (input[num] == '\\')
					{
						if (num + 1 < fullLen && input[num + 1] == '"')
						{
							text += input[num];
							text += input[num + 1];
							num++;
						}
						else
						{
							text += input[num];
						}
					}
					else
					{
						if (input[num] == '"')
						{
							flag = true;
							break;
						}
						text += input[num];
					}
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException("missing end quote for string starting at position: " + currPosition);
				}
				currPosition = num + 1;
				tokens.Add(new JsonDictionaryToken
				{
					Type = JsonDictionaryTokenType.StringValue,
					Value = text
				});
				return currPosition;
			}
			case 'T':
			case 't':
				if (currPosition + "true".Length < fullLen && input.Substring(currPosition, "true".Length).ToLower() == "true")
				{
					currPosition += "true".Length;
					tokens.Add(new JsonDictionaryToken
					{
						Type = JsonDictionaryTokenType.TrueValue,
						Value = true
					});
					return currPosition;
				}
				break;
			}
			if ((c == 'f' || c == 'F') && currPosition + "false".Length < fullLen && input.Substring(currPosition, "false".Length).ToLower() == "false")
			{
				currPosition += "false".Length;
				tokens.Add(new JsonDictionaryToken
				{
					Type = JsonDictionaryTokenType.FalseValue,
					Value = false
				});
				return currPosition;
			}
			if ((c == 'n' || c == 'N') && currPosition + "null".Length < fullLen && input.Substring(currPosition, "null".Length).ToLower() == "null")
			{
				currPosition += "null".Length;
				tokens.Add(new JsonDictionaryToken
				{
					Type = JsonDictionaryTokenType.NullValue
				});
				return currPosition;
			}
			if (c == '-' || IsDigit(c))
			{
				int num2 = currPosition;
				bool flag2 = true;
				bool flag3 = false;
				bool flag4 = false;
				string text2 = "";
				bool flag5 = false;
				if (c == '-')
				{
					text2 += c;
					num2++;
				}
				while (num2 < fullLen)
				{
					char c2 = input[num2];
					if (flag4)
					{
						if (!IsDigit(c2))
						{
							flag5 = true;
							break;
						}
						text2 += c2;
						num2++;
					}
					else if (flag3)
					{
						if (c2 == 'e' || c2 == 'E')
						{
							text2 += c2;
							num2++;
							flag4 = true;
							continue;
						}
						if (!IsDigit(c2))
						{
							flag5 = true;
							break;
						}
						text2 += c2;
						num2++;
					}
					else if (flag2)
					{
						switch (c2)
						{
						case '.':
							text2 += c2;
							num2++;
							flag3 = true;
							continue;
						case 'E':
						case 'e':
							text2 += c2;
							num2++;
							flag4 = true;
							continue;
						}
						if (!IsDigit(c2))
						{
							flag5 = true;
							break;
						}
						text2 += c2;
						num2++;
					}
				}
				if (!flag5)
				{
					if (text2[text2.Length - 1] == 'E' || text2[text2.Length - 1] == 'e' || text2[text2.Length - 1] == '.')
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException("expected end of number starting at: " + currPosition);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					currPosition = num2;
					tokens.Add(new JsonDictionaryToken
					{
						Type = JsonDictionaryTokenType.NumberValue,
						Value = double.Parse(text2)
					});
				}
				return currPosition;
			}
			if (IsAlpha(c))
			{
				string text3 = "";
				int num3 = currPosition;
				bool flag6 = false;
				for (num3 = currPosition; num3 < fullLen && input[num3] != '\r' && input[num3] != '\n'; num3++)
				{
					if (!IsWhitespace(input[num3]))
					{
						if (input[num3] == ':')
						{
							flag6 = true;
							break;
						}
						if (!IsAlphaNumeric(input[num3]))
						{
							break;
						}
						text3 += input[num3];
					}
				}
				if (!flag6)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException("invalidly formed name starting at position: " + currPosition);
				}
				currPosition = num3;
				tokens.Add(new JsonDictionaryToken
				{
					Type = JsonDictionaryTokenType.StringValue,
					Value = text3
				});
				return currPosition;
			}
			throw new InvalidOperationException("unexpected character: " + c.ToString() + " at position: " + currPosition);
		}

		private bool IsAlphaNumeric(char curr)
		{
			return char.IsLetterOrDigit(curr);
		}

		private bool IsAlpha(char curr)
		{
			return char.IsLetter(curr);
		}

		private bool IsDigit(char curr)
		{
			if (curr != '0' && curr != '1' && curr != '2' && curr != '3' && curr != '4' && curr != '5' && curr != '6' && curr != '7' && curr != '8')
			{
				return curr == '9';
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool IsWhitespace(char v)
		{
			if (v != '\r' && v != '\n' && v != ' ')
			{
				return v == '\t';
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	internal enum JsonDictionaryTokenType
	{
		LeftCurlyBracket,
		RightCurlyBracket,
		LeftSquareBracket,
		RightSquareBracket,
		Colon,
		Comma,
		StringValue,
		NumberValue,
		TrueValue,
		FalseValue,
		NullValue
	}
	internal class JsonDictionaryToken
	{
		public JsonDictionaryTokenType Type { get; set; }

		public object Value { get; set; }
	}
	internal class JsonDictionaryItem
	{
		public string ToJson()
		{
			JsonWriter jsonWriter = new JsonWriter();
			ToJsonHelper(jsonWriter);
			return jsonWriter.ToString();
		}

		protected internal virtual void ToJsonHelper(JsonWriter writer)
		{
		}

		protected string Escape(string val)
		{
			return val?.Replace("\\", "\\\\").Replace("\t", "\\t").Replace("\"", "\\\"")
				.Replace("\r", "\\r")
				.Replace("\n", "\\n");
		}

		protected internal static string Unescape(string val)
		{
			if (val == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			string text = "";
			int num = -1;
			for (int i = 0; i < val.Length; i++)
			{
				if (val[i] == '\\' && num == -1)
				{
					num = i;
				}
				else if (num == -1)
				{
					text += val[i];
				}
				else if (val[i] == 'n')
				{
					text += "\n";
					num = -1;
				}
				else if (val[i] == 'r')
				{
					text += "\r";
					num = -1;
				}
				else if (val[i] == 't')
				{
					text += "\t";
					num = -1;
				}
				else if (val[i] == '"')
				{
					text += "\"";
					num = -1;
				}
				else if (val[i] == '\\')
				{
					text += "\\";
					num = -1;
				}
				else
				{
					text = text + "\\" + val[i];
					num = -1;
				}
			}
			return text;
		}
	}
	internal class JsonDictionaryArray : JsonDictionaryItem
	{
		[DontObfuscate]
		public JsonDictionaryItem[] Items { get; set; }

		protected internal override void ToJsonHelper(JsonWriter writer)
		{
			writer.Write("[");
			writer.NewLine();
			writer.IncreaseIndent();
			if (Items != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < Items.Length; i++)
				{
					if (i > 0)
					{
						writer.WriteLine(",");
					}
					JsonDictionaryItem jsonDictionaryItem = Items[i];
					if (jsonDictionaryItem == null)
					{
						writer.Write("null");
					}
					else
					{
						jsonDictionaryItem.ToJsonHelper(writer);
					}
				}
			}
			writer.NewLine();
			writer.DecreaseIndent();
			writer.Write("]");
		}
	}
	internal class JsonWriter
	{
		private StringBuilder _builder = new StringBuilder();

		private int _indentLevel;

		public bool _isNewLine = true;

		public void IncreaseIndent()
		{
			_indentLevel++;
		}

		public void DecreaseIndent()
		{
			_indentLevel--;
		}

		public void Write(string content)
		{
			EnsureIndent();
			_builder.Append(content);
		}

		private void EnsureIndent()
		{
			if (_isNewLine)
			{
				_isNewLine = false;
				for (int i = 0; i < _indentLevel; i++)
				{
					_builder.Append("\t");
				}
			}
		}

		public void WriteLine(string content)
		{
			EnsureIndent();
			_builder.AppendLine(content);
			_isNewLine = true;
		}

		public void NewLine()
		{
			EnsureIndent();
			_builder.AppendLine();
			_isNewLine = true;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return _builder.ToString();
		}
	}
	internal class JsonDictionaryObject : JsonDictionaryItem
	{
		private Dictionary<string, JsonDictionaryItem> _items = new Dictionary<string, JsonDictionaryItem>();

		public JsonDictionaryItem this[string key]
		{
			get
			{
				return _items[key];
			}
			set
			{
				_items[key] = value;
			}
		}

		public void AddItem(string key, JsonDictionaryItem item)
		{
			_items[key] = item;
		}

		public void RemoveItem(string key)
		{
			_items.Remove(key);
		}

		public void ClearItems()
		{
			_items.Clear();
		}

		public bool ContainsKey(string key)
		{
			return _items.ContainsKey(key);
		}

		internal string[] GetKeys()
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			foreach (string key in _items.Keys)
			{
				list.Add(key);
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		protected internal override void ToJsonHelper(JsonWriter writer)
		{
			writer.Write("{");
			writer.NewLine();
			writer.IncreaseIndent();
			string[] keys = GetKeys();
			if (keys != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < keys.Length; i++)
				{
					if (i > 0)
					{
						writer.WriteLine(",");
					}
					string text = keys[i];
					JsonDictionaryItem jsonDictionaryItem = _items[text];
					writer.Write("\"" + Escape(text) + "\": ");
					if (jsonDictionaryItem == null)
					{
						writer.Write("null");
					}
					else
					{
						jsonDictionaryItem.ToJsonHelper(writer);
					}
				}
			}
			writer.NewLine();
			writer.DecreaseIndent();
			writer.Write("}");
		}
	}
	internal enum JsonDictionaryValueType
	{
		NumberValue,
		BooleanValue,
		StringValue,
		NullValue
	}
	internal class JsonDictionaryValue : JsonDictionaryItem
	{
		[DontObfuscate]
		public object Value { get; set; }

		public JsonDictionaryValueType Type { get; set; }

		protected internal override void ToJsonHelper(JsonWriter writer)
		{
			switch (Type)
			{
			case JsonDictionaryValueType.BooleanValue:
				if ((bool)Value)
				{
					writer.Write("true");
				}
				else
				{
					writer.Write("false");
				}
				break;
			case JsonDictionaryValueType.NullValue:
				writer.Write("null");
				break;
			case JsonDictionaryValueType.NumberValue:
				writer.Write(((double)Value).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
				break;
			case JsonDictionaryValueType.StringValue:
				writer.Write("\"" + Escape((string)Value) + "\"");
				break;
			}
		}
	}
	[DontObfuscate]
	public class Description
	{
		private Dictionary<string, bool> _isDirty = new Dictionary<string, bool>();

		private string _name;

		public string Name
		{
			get
			{
				return _name;
			}
			set
			{
				_name = value;
				MarkDirty("Name");
			}
		}

		protected void MarkDirty(string propertyName)
		{
			_isDirty[propertyName] = true;
		}

		internal bool IsDirty(string propertyName)
		{
			if (_isDirty.ContainsKey(propertyName))
			{
				return _isDirty[propertyName];
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

	internal class TypeDescriptionCleanups
	{
		private Dictionary<string, Action<object>> _cleanups = new Dictionary<string, Action<object>>();

		public TypeDescriptionCleanups()
		{
			_cleanups["Series"] = delegate(object s)
			{
				MethodInfo method = s.GetType().GetMethod("RemoveAxes");
				if (method != null)
				{
					method.Invoke(s, null);
				}
			};
		}

		public void Cleanup(TypeDescriptionPlatform platform, object obj)
		{
			if (obj == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			string text = "";
			Type type = obj.GetType();
			while (type != null)
			{
				text = type.Name;
				text = text.Replace("Ultra", "").Replace("Xam", "");
				if (_cleanups.ContainsKey(text))
				{
					_cleanups[text](obj);
				}
				type = type.BaseType;
				if (type != null && (type.Name == "Object" || type.Name == "Base"))
				{
					break;
				}
			}
		}
	}
	[DontObfuscate]
	[DontHide]
	public class DescriptionJsonValidator
	{
		private List<string> _typeNames = new List<string>();

		private Dictionary<string, List<string>> _containingModules = new Dictionary<string, List<string>>();

		private JsonDictionaryObject _schema;

		private TypeDescriptionContext _context;

		public DescriptionJsonValidator()
		{
		}

		public DescriptionJsonValidator(Type[] types)
		{
			List<Type> list = new List<Type>();
			Dictionary<string, Type> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, Type>();
			Assembly[] assemblies = AppDomain.CurrentDomain.GetAssemblies();
			Type[] types2;
			foreach (Assembly assembly in assemblies)
			{
				Module[] modules;
				if (assembly.GetName().Name.StartsWith("InfragisticsWPF4"))
				{
					modules = assembly.GetModules();
					for (int j = 0; j < modules.Length; j++)
					{
						modules[j].GetType();
					}
				}
				if (!assembly.GetName().Name.StartsWith("InfragisticsWPF4.DataVisualization"))
				{
					continue;
				}
				modules = assembly.GetModules();
				for (int j = 0; j < modules.Length; j++)
				{
					types2 = modules[j].GetTypes();
					foreach (Type type in types2)
					{
						if (type.Name.EndsWith("DescriptionModule") && type.GetMethod("Register") != null)
						{
							list.Add(type);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			types2 = types;
			foreach (Type type2 in types2)
			{
				if (type2.Name.EndsWith("Description"))
				{
					dictionary.Add(type2.Name, type2);
				}
			}
			List<string> list2 = new List<string>();
			Type type3 = dictionary["Description"];
			foreach (Type value in dictionary.Values)
			{
				if (!type3.IsAssignableFrom(value))
				{
					list2.Add(value.Name);
				}
			}
			foreach (string item in list2)
			{
				dictionary.Remove(item);
			}
			foreach (string key in dictionary.Keys)
			{
				_typeNames.Add(key.Substring(0, key.Length - "Description".Length));
			}
			foreach (Type item2 in list)
			{
				TypeDescriptionContext context = new ComponentRenderer().Context;
				string text = item2.Name.Replace("DescriptionModule", "Module");
				if (text == "DataGridModule")
				{
					_ = 0;
				}
				item2.GetMethod("Register", BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.Public).Invoke(null, new object[1] { context });
				string[] allKeys = context.GetAllKeys();
				foreach (string text2 in allKeys)
				{
					if (dictionary.ContainsKey(text2 + "Description"))
					{
						List<string> list3 = null;
						if (_containingModules.ContainsKey(text2))
						{
							list3 = _containingModules[text2];
						}
						else
						{
							list3 = new List<string>();
							_containingModules[text2] = list3;
						}
						if (!list3.Contains(text))
						{
							list3.Add(text);
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public string[] GetContainingModules(string type)
		{
			if (_containingModules.ContainsKey(type))
			{
				return _containingModules[type].ToArray();
			}
			return null;
		}

		public string Validate(string json)
		{
			JsonDictionaryObject jsonObj = (JsonDictionaryObject)new JsonDictionaryParser().Parse(json);
			string[] allTypeProperties = GetAllTypeProperties(jsonObj);
			string[] allModules = GetAllModules(jsonObj);
			HashSet<string> hashSet = new HashSet<string>();
			string[] array = allModules;
			foreach (string item in array)
			{
				hashSet.Add(item);
			}
			JsonDictionaryObject jsonDictionaryObject = null;
			array = allTypeProperties;
			foreach (string text in array)
			{
				string[] containingModules = GetContainingModules(text);
				bool flag = false;
				string[] array2 = containingModules;
				foreach (string item2 in array2)
				{
					if (hashSet.Contains(item2))
					{
						flag = true;
					}
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					int pos = json.IndexOf("\"" + text + "\"");
					Tuple<int, int> lineAndColumn = GetLineAndColumn(json, pos);
					int item3 = lineAndColumn.Item1;
					int item4 = lineAndColumn.Item2;
					int endColumn = item4 + ("\"" + text + "\"").Length;
					jsonDictionaryObject = AddWarning(jsonDictionaryObject, item3, item4, item3, endColumn, "Type " + text + " appears not to have a containing module, consider adding one of: " + string.Join(", ", containingModules));
				}
			}
			array = allTypeProperties;
			foreach (string text2 in array)
			{
				if (text2 == "PropertyEditor")
				{
					int pos2 = json.IndexOf("\"" + text2 + "\"");
					Tuple<int, int> lineAndColumn2 = GetLineAndColumn(json, pos2);
					int item5 = lineAndColumn2.Item1;
					int item6 = lineAndColumn2.Item2;
					int endColumn2 = item6 + ("\"" + text2 + "\"").Length;
					if (!hashSet.Contains("withDescriptions"))
					{
						jsonDictionaryObject = AddWarning(jsonDictionaryObject, item5, item6, item5, endColumn2, "Property editor is included, but withDescriptions is not in modules, did you forget it?");
					}
				}
			}
			return jsonDictionaryObject?.ToJson();
		}

		private Tuple<int, int> GetLineAndColumn(string json, int pos)
		{
			string[] array = json.Split('\n');
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			while (num2 <= pos && num < array.Length)
			{
				string text = array[num];
				if (text.Length + 1 >= pos - num2)
				{
					return new Tuple<int, int>(num + 1, pos - num2 + 1);
				}
				num2 += text.Length + 1;
				num++;
			}
			return new Tuple<int, int>(num + 1, pos - num2 + 1);
		}

		private JsonDictionaryObject AddWarning(JsonDictionaryObject result, int line, int column, int endLine, int endColumn, string warning)
		{
			if (result == null)
			{
				result = new JsonDictionaryObject();
				result["warnings"] = new JsonDictionaryArray();
			}
			JsonDictionaryArray jsonDictionaryArray = (JsonDictionaryArray)result["warnings"];
			JsonDictionaryItem[] items = jsonDictionaryArray.Items;
			List<JsonDictionaryItem> list = new List<JsonDictionaryItem>();
			if (items != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < items.Length; i++)
				{
					list.Add(items[i]);
				}
			}
			JsonDictionaryObject jsonDictionaryObject = new JsonDictionaryObject();
			jsonDictionaryObject["line"] = new JsonDictionaryValue
			{
				Type = JsonDictionaryValueType.NumberValue,
				Value = (double)line
			};
			jsonDictionaryObject["column"] = new JsonDictionaryValue
			{
				Type = JsonDictionaryValueType.NumberValue,
				Value = (double)column
			};
			jsonDictionaryObject["endLine"] = new JsonDictionaryValue
			{
				Type = JsonDictionaryValueType.NumberValue,
				Value = (double)endLine
			};
			jsonDictionaryObject["endColumn"] = new JsonDictionaryValue
			{
				Type = JsonDictionaryValueType.NumberValue,
				Value = (double)endColumn
			};
			jsonDictionaryObject["message"] = new JsonDictionaryValue
			{
				Type = JsonDictionaryValueType.StringValue,
				Value = warning
			};
			list.Add(jsonDictionaryObject);
			jsonDictionaryArray.Items = list.ToArray();
			return result;
		}

		private string[] GetAllModules(JsonDictionaryObject jsonObj)
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			if (jsonObj != null && jsonObj.ContainsKey("modules") && jsonObj["modules"] is JsonDictionaryArray)
			{
				JsonDictionaryArray jsonDictionaryArray = (JsonDictionaryArray)jsonObj["modules"];
				if (jsonDictionaryArray.Items != null)
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < jsonDictionaryArray.Items.Length; i++)
					{
						string text = ((JsonDictionaryValue)jsonDictionaryArray.Items[i]).Value.ToString();
						if (text.Contains("/"))
						{
							string[] array = text.Split('/');
							list.Add(array[1]);
						}
						else
						{
							list.Add(text);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		private string[] GetAllTypeProperties(JsonDictionaryObject jsonObj)
		{
			HashSet<string> hashSet = new HashSet<string>();
			GetAllTypePropertiesHelper(hashSet, null, jsonObj);
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			foreach (string item in hashSet)
			{
				list.Add(item);
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		private void GetAllTypePropertiesHelper(HashSet<string> props, string parentKey, JsonDictionaryItem curr)
		{
			if (curr is JsonDictionaryObject)
			{
				JsonDictionaryObject jsonDictionaryObject = (JsonDictionaryObject)curr;
				string[] keys = jsonDictionaryObject.GetKeys();
				foreach (string text in keys)
				{
					GetAllTypePropertiesHelper(props, text, jsonDictionaryObject[text]);
				}
			}
			if (curr is JsonDictionaryArray)
			{
				JsonDictionaryArray jsonDictionaryArray = (JsonDictionaryArray)curr;
				if (jsonDictionaryArray.Items != null)
				{
					for (int j = 0; j < jsonDictionaryArray.Items.Length; j++)
					{
						GetAllTypePropertiesHelper(props, parentKey + "[" + j + "]", jsonDictionaryArray.Items[j]);
					}
				}
			}
			if (curr is JsonDictionaryValue && parentKey != null && parentKey == "type")
			{
				props.Add(((JsonDictionaryValue)curr).Value.ToString());
			}
		}

		public static DescriptionJsonValidator FromJson(string json)
		{
			DescriptionJsonValidator descriptionJsonValidator = new DescriptionJsonValidator();
			if (new JsonDictionaryParser().Parse(json) is JsonDictionaryObject jsonDictionaryObject)
			{
				if (jsonDictionaryObject.ContainsKey("types"))
				{
					JsonDictionaryArray jsonDictionaryArray = (JsonDictionaryArray)jsonDictionaryObject["types"];
					if (jsonDictionaryArray.Items != null)
					{
						for (int i = 0; i < jsonDictionaryArray.Items.Length; i++)
						{
							descriptionJsonValidator._typeNames.Add(((JsonDictionaryValue)jsonDictionaryArray.Items[i]).Value.ToString());
						}
					}
				}
				if (jsonDictionaryObject.ContainsKey("containingModules"))
				{
					JsonDictionaryObject jsonDictionaryObject2 = (JsonDictionaryObject)jsonDictionaryObject["containingModules"];
					string[] keys = jsonDictionaryObject2.GetKeys();
					foreach (string key in keys)
					{
						JsonDictionaryArray jsonDictionaryArray2 = (JsonDictionaryArray)jsonDictionaryObject2[key];
						descriptionJsonValidator._containingModules[key] = new List<string>();
						for (int k = 0; k < jsonDictionaryArray2.Items.Length; k++)
						{
							JsonDictionaryValue jsonDictionaryValue = (JsonDictionaryValue)jsonDictionaryArray2.Items[k];
							descriptionJsonValidator._containingModules[key].Add(jsonDictionaryValue.Value.ToString());
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return descriptionJsonValidator;
		}

		public string ToJson()
		{
			JsonDictionaryObject jsonDictionaryObject = new JsonDictionaryObject();
			JsonDictionaryArray jsonDictionaryArray = new JsonDictionaryArray();
			List<JsonDictionaryItem> list = new List<JsonDictionaryItem>();
			foreach (string typeName in _typeNames)
			{
				list.Add(new JsonDictionaryValue
				{
					Value = typeName,
					Type = JsonDictionaryValueType.StringValue
				});
			}
			jsonDictionaryArray.Items = list.ToArray();
			jsonDictionaryObject["types"] = jsonDictionaryArray;
			JsonDictionaryObject jsonDictionaryObject2 = new JsonDictionaryObject();
			foreach (string key in _containingModules.Keys)
			{
				List<JsonDictionaryItem> list2 = new List<JsonDictionaryItem>();
				foreach (string item in _containingModules[key])
				{
					list2.Add(new JsonDictionaryValue
					{
						Value = item,
						Type = JsonDictionaryValueType.StringValue
					});
				}
				jsonDictionaryObject2[key] = new JsonDictionaryArray
				{
					Items = list2.ToArray()
				};
			}
			jsonDictionaryObject["containingModules"] = jsonDictionaryObject2;
			return jsonDictionaryObject.ToJson();
		}
	}
	internal interface ITypeDescriptionPropertyTransforms
	{
		object Transform(TypeDescriptionPlatform platform, object propertyValue, DescriptionTreeAction action);
	}
	internal class TypeDescriptionPropretyTransforms : ITypeDescriptionPropertyTransforms
	{
		private Dictionary<string, Func<object, DescriptionTreeAction, object>> _transforms = new Dictionary<string, Func<object, DescriptionTreeAction, object>>();

		public TypeDescriptionPropretyTransforms()
		{
			_transforms["VisibilityToBooleanTransform"] = (object l, DescriptionTreeAction m) => (l.ToString().ToLower() == "visible") ? ((object)true) : ((object)false);
			_transforms["AxisLabelTransform"] = delegate(object l, DescriptionTreeAction m)
			{
				string text = (string)l;
				if (text == null)
				{
					return (object)null;
				}
				return (!text.Contains("{")) ? ("{" + text + "}") : text;
			};
			_transforms["FontFamilyTransform"] = delegate(object l, DescriptionTreeAction m)
			{
				string text = (string)l;
				return (text == null) ? null : new FontFamily(text);
			};
			_transforms["FontStyleTransform"] = delegate(object l, DescriptionTreeAction m)
			{
				string text = (string)l;
				if (text == null)
				{
					return FontStyles.Normal;
				}
				text = text.ToLower();
				if (text == "normal")
				{
					return FontStyles.Normal;
				}
				return (text == "italic") ? ((object)FontStyles.Italic) : ((object)FontStyles.Normal);
			};
			_transforms["FontWeightTransform"] = delegate(object l, DescriptionTreeAction m)
			{
				string text = (string)l;
				if (text == null)
				{
					return FontStyles.Normal;
				}
				text = text.ToLower();
				if (text == "normal")
				{
					return FontWeights.Normal;
				}
				return (text == "bold") ? ((object)FontWeights.Bold) : ((object)FontStyles.Normal);
			};
		}

		public object Transform(TypeDescriptionPlatform platform, object propertyValue, DescriptionTreeAction action)
		{
			TypeDescriptionMetadata propertyMetadata = action.PropertyMetadata;
			if (propertyMetadata == null)
			{
				return propertyValue;
			}
			string transformName = propertyMetadata.GetTransformName(platform);
			if (transformName != null && _transforms.ContainsKey(transformName))
			{
				return _transforms[transformName](propertyValue, action);
			}
			return propertyValue;
		}
	}

			metadata["ActualIntervalChangeRef"] = "EventRef::actualIntervalChange";
			metadata["ActualMinorIntervalChangeRef"] = "EventRef::actualMinorIntervalChange";
		}

		public static void Register(TypeDescriptionContext context)
		{
			EnsureMetadata(context);
			context.RegisterDescriptionConstructor("CategoryYAxis", () => new CategoryYAxisDescription());
			context.Register("CategoryYAxis", _metadata);
		}
	}

	{
		public static void Register(TypeDescriptionContext context)
		{
			CategoryYAxisDescriptionMetadata.Register(context);
		}

			}
			if (!context.HasMetadata(_metadata))
			{
				context.MarkSeen(_metadata);
				SeriesDescriptionMetadata.Register(context);
				SeriesViewerDescriptionMetadata.Register(context);
			}
		}

		internal static void FillMetadata(Dictionary<string, string> metadata)
		{
			metadata["ItemRef"] = "(w:Item,wf:Item)DataRef";
			metadata["Series"] = "ExportedType:Series";
			metadata["Chart"] = "ExportedType:SeriesViewer";
		}

		public static void Register(TypeDescriptionContext context)
		{
			EnsureMetadata(context);
			context.RegisterDescriptionConstructor("ChartMouseEventArgs", () => new ChartMouseEventArgsDescription());
			context.Register("ChartMouseEventArgs", _metadata);
		}
	}

	public class ColumnDescriptionMetadata
	{
		private static Dictionary<string, string> _metadata;

		private static void EnsureMetadata(TypeDescriptionContext context)
		{
			if (_metadata == null)
			{
				_metadata = new Dictionary<string, string>();
				FillMetadata(_metadata);
			}
			if (!context.HasMetadata(_metadata))
			{
				context.MarkSeen(_metadata);
				GridColumnAnimationSettingsDescriptionMetadata.Register(context);
				ColumnWidthDescriptionMetadata.Register(context);
				ColumnFilterConditionDescriptionMetadata.Register(context);
				FilterExpressionDescriptionMetadata.Register(context);
				HeaderDescriptionMetadata.Register(context);
			}
		}

		internal static void FillMetadata(Dictionary<string, string> metadata)
		{
			DefinitionBaseDescriptionMetadata.FillMetadata(metadata);
			metadata["PaddingLeft"] = "Number:int";
			metadata["PaddingTop"] = "Number:int";
			metadata["PaddingRight"] = "Number:int";
			metadata["PaddingBottom"] = "Number:int";
			metadata["Name"] = "String";
			metadata["Field"] = "String";
			metadata["HeaderText"] = "String";
			metadata["ActualHeaderText"] = "String";
			metadata["SelectedBackground"] = "Brush";
			metadata["ActualSelectedBackground"] = "Brush";
			metadata["RowHoverBackground"] = "Brush";
			metadata["ActualHoverBackground"] = "Brush";
			metadata["RowHoverTextColor"] = "Brush";
			metadata["ActualRowHoverTextColor"] = "Brush";
			metadata["AnimationSettings"] = "ExportedType:GridColumnAnimationSettings";
			metadata["Width"] = "ExportedType:ColumnWidth";
			metadata["MinWidth"] = "Number:double";
			metadata["IsFromMarkup"] = "Boolean";
			metadata["IsAutoGenerated"] = "Boolean";
			metadata["Filter"] = "ExportedType:ColumnFilterCondition";
			metadata["FilterExpression"] = "ExportedType:IFilterExpression";
			metadata["Header"] = "ExportedType:Header";
			metadata["IsFilteringEnabled"] = "Boolean";
			metadata["IsResizingEnabled"] = "Boolean";
			metadata["IsHidden"] = "Boolean";
			metadata["ShouldRemoveWhenHidden"] = "Boolean";
			metadata["SortDirection"] = "ExportedType:string:ColumnSortDirection";
			metadata["SortDirection@names"] = "None;Ascending;Descending";
			metadata["Pinned"] = "ExportedType:string:PinnedPositions";
			metadata["Pinned@names"] = "None;Left;Right";
			metadata["ActualColumnOptionsIconAlignment"] = "ExportedType:string:ColumnOptionsIconAlignment";
			metadata["ActualColumnOptionsIconAlignment@names"] = "Unset;None;Opposite";
			metadata["ColumnOptionsIconAlignment"] = "ExportedType:string:ColumnOptionsIconAlignment";
			metadata["ColumnOptionsIconAlignment@names"] = "Unset;None;Opposite";
			metadata["ActualColumnOptionsIconColor"] = "Brush";
			metadata["ColumnOptionsIconColor"] = "Brush";
			metadata["ColumnOptionsIconBehavior"] = "ExportedType:string:ColumnOptionsIconBehavior";
			metadata["ColumnOptionsIconBehavior@names"] = "Unset;AlwaysVisible;AppearOnHover;AppearOnHoverAnimate";
			metadata["ActualColumnOptionsIconBehavior"] = "ExportedType:string:ColumnOptionsIconBehavior";
			metadata["ActualColumnOptionsIconBehavior@names"] = "Unset;AlwaysVisible;AppearOnHover;AppearOnHoverAnimate";
			metadata["ActualIsColumnOptionsEnabled"] = "Boolean";
			metadata["IsColumnOptionsEnabled"] = "Boolean";

			metadata["IsColumnOptionsSummariesEnabled"] = "Boolean";

	public class SelectedItemsChangingEventArgsDescription : SelectedItemsChangedEventArgsDescription
	{
		private bool _cancel;

		public override string Type => "SelectedItemsChangingEventArgs";

		[ClientName("cancel")]
		public bool Cancel
		{
			get
			{
				return _cancel;
			}
			set
			{
				_cancel = value;
				MarkDirty("Cancel");
			}
		}
	}
	public class SelectedItemsChangingEventArgsDescriptionMetadata
	{
		private static Dictionary<string, string> _metadata;

		private static void EnsureMetadata(TypeDescriptionContext context)
		{
			if (_metadata == null)
			{
				_metadata = new Dictionary<string, string>();
				FillMetadata(_metadata);
			}
			if (!context.HasMetadata(_metadata))
			{
				context.MarkSeen(_metadata);
			}
		}

		internal static void FillMetadata(Dictionary<string, string> metadata)
		{
			SelectedItemsChangedEventArgsDescriptionMetadata.FillMetadata(metadata);
			metadata["Cancel"] = "Boolean";
		}

		public static void Register(TypeDescriptionContext context)
		{
			EnsureMetadata(context);
			context.RegisterDescriptionConstructor("SelectedItemsChangingEventArgs", () => new SelectedItemsChangingEventArgsDescription());
			context.Register("SelectedItemsChangingEventArgs", _metadata);
		}
	}

	public class SeriesDescriptionMetadata
	{
		private static Dictionary<string, string> _metadata;

		private static void RegisterOtherMetadata(Dictionary<string, string> metadata)
		{
			metadata["DataSourceRef"] = "(w:ItemsSource,xam:ItemsSource)DataRef:String";
			metadata["Title"] = "String";
			metadata["TooltipTemplateRef"] = "(w:ToolTip)DataRef:String";
		}

		private static void EnsureMetadata(TypeDescriptionContext context)
		{
			if (_metadata == null)
			{
				_metadata = new Dictionary<string, string>();
				FillMetadata(_metadata);
			}
			if (!context.HasMetadata(_metadata))
			{
				context.MarkSeen(_metadata);
				RenderRequestedEventArgsDescriptionMetadata.Register(context);
			}
		}

		internal static void FillMetadata(Dictionary<string, string> metadata)
		{
			metadata["DataSourceRef"] = "(w:ItemsSource,xam:ItemsSource,wf:ItemsSource)DataRef::object";
			metadata["LegendRef"] = "(w:Legend,wf:Legend)DataRef::object";
			metadata["LegendItemVisibility"] = "ExportedType:string:Visibility";
			metadata["LegendItemVisibility@names"] = "Visible;Collapsed";
			metadata["LegendItemBadgeTemplateRef"] = "(w:LegendItemBadgeTemplate,wf:LegendItemBadgeTemplate)DataRef::object";
			metadata["ActualLegendItemBadgeTemplateRef"] = "(w:ActualLegendItemBadgeTemplate,wf:ActualLegendItemBadgeTemplate)DataRef::object";
			metadata["ActualLegendItemBadgeOutline"] = "Brush";
			metadata["ActualLegendItemBadgeBrush"] = "Brush";
			metadata["LegendItemBadgeShape"] = "ExportedType:string:LegendItemBadgeShape";
			metadata["LegendItemBadgeShape@names"] = "Automatic;Circle;Line;Square;Marker;Bar;Column;Hidden";
			metadata["LegendItemBadgeMode"] = "ExportedType:string:LegendItemBadgeMode";
			metadata["LegendItemBadgeMode@names"] = "Simplified;MatchSeries";
			metadata["LegendItemTemplateRef"] = "(w:LegendItemTemplate,wf:LegendItemTemplate)DataRef::object";
			metadata["DiscreteLegendItemTemplateRef"] = "(w:DiscreteLegendItemTemplate,wf:DiscreteLegendItemTemplate)DataRef::object";
			metadata["TransitionEasingFunctionRef"] = "(w:TransitionEasingFunction,wf:TransitionEasingFunction)MethodRef";
			metadata["TransitionInEasingFunctionRef"] = "(w:TransitionInEasingFunction,wf:TransitionInEasingFunction)MethodRef";
			metadata["TransitionDuration"] = "Number:int";
			metadata["Resolution"] = "Number:double";
			metadata["VisibleRangeMarginTop"] = "Number:double";
			metadata["VisibleRangeMarginBottom"] = "Number:double";
			metadata["VisibleRangeMarginLeft"] = "Number:double";
			metadata["VisibleRangeMarginRight"] = "Number:double";
			metadata["Brush"] = "Brush";
			metadata["ActualBrush"] = "Brush";
			metadata["Outline"] = "Brush";
			metadata["ActualOutline"] = "Brush";
			metadata["Thickness"] = "Number:double";
			metadata["ActualThickness"] = "Number:double";
			metadata["ActualHighlightingMode"] = "ExportedType:string:SeriesHighlightingMode";
			metadata["ActualHighlightingMode@names"] = "Auto;None;BrightenSpecific;Brighten;FadeOthersSpecific;FadeOthers";
			metadata["ActualHighlightingFadeOpacity"] = "Number:double";
			metadata["HighlightingFadeOpacity"] = "Number:double";
			metadata["IsComponentHighlightingModeIgnored"] = "Boolean";
			metadata["IsHighlightingEnabled"] = "Boolean";
			metadata["IsDropShadowEnabled"] = "Boolean";
			metadata["ShadowBlur"] = "Number:double";
			metadata["ShadowColor"] = "Color";

			metadata["ShowDefaultTooltip"] = "Boolean";
			metadata["VisibleRangeMode"] = "ExportedType:string:SeriesVisibleRangeMode";
			metadata["VisibleRangeMode@names"] = "Auto;ValuesOnly;IncludeReferenceValue";
			metadata["OutlineMode"] = "ExportedType:string:SeriesOutlineMode";
			metadata["OutlineMode@names"] = "Auto;Visible;Collapsed";
			metadata["TransitionInDuration"] = "Number:int";
			metadata["TransitionInSpeedType"] = "ExportedType:string:TransitionInSpeedType";
			metadata["TransitionInSpeedType@names"] = "Auto;Normal;ValueScaled;IndexScaled;Random";
			metadata["MouseOverEnabled"] = "Boolean";
			metadata["CoercionMethodsRef"] = "(w:CoercionMethods,wf:CoercionMethods)DataRef";
			metadata["ExpectFunctions"] = "Boolean";
			metadata["HitTestMode"] = "ExportedType:string:SeriesHitTestMode";
			metadata["HitTestMode@names"] = "Auto;Computational;ColorEncoded";
			metadata["ActualHitTestMode"] = "ExportedType:string:SeriesHitTestMode";
			metadata["ActualHitTestMode@names"] = "Auto;Computational;ColorEncoded";
			metadata["FinalValue"] = "Number:double";
			metadata["PercentChange"] = "Number:double";
			metadata["Opacity"] = "Number:double";
			metadata["Visibility"] = "ExportedType:string:Visibility";
			metadata["Visibility@names"] = "Visible;Collapsed";
			metadata["RenderRequestedRef"] = "EventRef::renderRequested";
			RegisterOtherMetadata(metadata);
		}

		public static void Register(TypeDescriptionContext context)
		{
			EnsureMetadata(context);
			context.Register("Series", _metadata);
		}

	}
	public class XYChartDescriptionMetadata
	{
		private static Dictionary<string, string> _metadata;

		private static void EnsureMetadata(TypeDescriptionContext context)
		{
			if (_metadata == null)
			{
				_metadata = new Dictionary<string, string>();
				FillMetadata(_metadata);
			}
			if (!context.HasMetadata(_metadata))
			{
				context.MarkSeen(_metadata);
			}
		}

		internal static void FillMetadata(Dictionary<string, string> metadata)
		{
			DomainChartDescriptionMetadata.FillMetadata(metadata);
			metadata["XAxisFormatLabelRef"] = "(w:XAxisFormatLabel,wf:XAxisFormatLabel)MethodRef";
			metadata["YAxisFormatLabelRef"] = "(w:YAxisFormatLabel,wf:YAxisFormatLabel)MethodRef";
			metadata["XAxisLabelLeftMargin"] = "Number:double";
			metadata["XAxisLabelTopMargin"] = "Number:double";
			metadata["XAxisLabelRightMargin"] = "Number:double";
			metadata["XAxisLabelBottomMargin"] = "Number:double";
			metadata["YAxisLabelLeftMargin"] = "Number:double";
			metadata["YAxisLabelTopMargin"] = "Number:double";
			metadata["YAxisLabelRightMargin"] = "Number:double";
			metadata["YAxisLabelBottomMargin"] = "Number:double";
			metadata["XAxisLabelTextColor"] = "Brush";
			metadata["YAxisLabelTextColor"] = "Brush";
			metadata["ActualXAxisLabelTextColor"] = "Brush";
