	internal class DescriptionTreeBuilder
	{
		[DontObfuscate]
		public static DescriptionTreeNode CreateTree(TypeDescriptionContext context, Description description_)
		{
			DescriptionTreeNode descriptionTreeNode = new DescriptionTreeNode();
			if (description_ == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			PropertyInfo[] properties = description_.GetType().GetProperties();
			foreach (PropertyInfo propertyInfo in properties)
			{
				if (propertyInfo.Name.ToLower() != "type" && !description_.IsDirty(propertyInfo.Name))
				{
					continue;
				}
				object obj = propertyInfo.GetValue(description_, null);
				if (obj is Description)
				{
					obj = CreateTree(context, (Description)obj);
				}
				if (obj is Array)
				{
					IList list = (IList)obj;
					object[] array = new object[list.Count];
					for (int j = 0; j < array.Length; j++)
					{
						object obj2 = list[j];
						if (obj2 is Description)
						{
							DescriptionTreeNode descriptionTreeNode2 = CreateTree(context, (Description)obj2);
							array[j] = descriptionTreeNode2;
						}
						else
						{
							array[j] = obj2;
						}
					}
					obj = array;
				}
				if (propertyInfo.Name.ToLower() == "type")
				{
					descriptionTreeNode.Type = (string)obj;
				}
				descriptionTreeNode.Add(ToPascal(propertyInfo.Name), obj);
			}
			if (descriptionTreeNode.Has("type"))
			{
				string typeName = (string)descriptionTreeNode.Get("type").Value;
				List<DescriptionPropertyValue> list2 = descriptionTreeNode.Items();
				for (int k = 0; k < list2.Count; k++)
				{
					DescriptionPropertyValue descriptionPropertyValue = list2[k];
					descriptionPropertyValue.Metadata = context.GetMetadata(typeName, descriptionPropertyValue.PropertyName);
				}
			}
			return descriptionTreeNode;
		}

		private static string ToPascal(string key_)
		{
			if (key_ == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return key_.Substring(0, 1).ToUpper() + key_.Substring(1);
		}
	}
	internal class DescriptionTreeNode
	{
		private static long NextId;

		private List<DescriptionPropertyValue> _items = new List<DescriptionPropertyValue>();

		private Dictionary<string, DescriptionPropertyValue> _map = new Dictionary<string, DescriptionPropertyValue>();

		public long Id { get; set; }

		public string Type { get; set; }

		public DescriptionTreeNode()
		{
			Id = NextId;
			NextId++;
			if (NextId >= long.MaxValue)
			{
				NextId = 0L;
			}
		}

		public void Add(string propertyName, object value)
		{
			DescriptionPropertyValue descriptionPropertyValue = new DescriptionPropertyValue();
			descriptionPropertyValue.PropertyName = propertyName;
			descriptionPropertyValue.Value = value;
			_map.Add(propertyName.ToLower(), descriptionPropertyValue);
			_items.Add(descriptionPropertyValue);
		}

		public void AddWithMeta(string propertyName, object value, TypeDescriptionMetadata meta)
		{
			DescriptionPropertyValue descriptionPropertyValue = new DescriptionPropertyValue();
			descriptionPropertyValue.PropertyName = propertyName;
			descriptionPropertyValue.Value = value;
			descriptionPropertyValue.Metadata = meta;
			_map.Add(propertyName.ToLower(), descriptionPropertyValue);
			_items.Add(descriptionPropertyValue);
		}

		public void Update(string propertyName, object value)
		{
			if (_map.ContainsKey(propertyName.ToLower()))
			{
				_map[propertyName.ToLower()].Value = value;
			}
			else
			{
				Add(propertyName, value);
			}
		}

		public void UpdateWithMeta(string propertyName, object value, TypeDescriptionMetadata meta)
		{
			if (_map.ContainsKey(propertyName.ToLower()))
			{
				_map[propertyName.ToLower()].Value = value;
			}
			else
			{
				AddWithMeta(propertyName, value, meta);
			}
		}

		public DescriptionPropertyValue Get(string propertyName)
		{
			return _map[propertyName.ToLower()];
		}

		public bool Has(string propertyName)
		{
			return _map.ContainsKey(propertyName.ToLower());
		}

		public void Remove(string propertyName)
		{
			if (_map.ContainsKey(propertyName.ToLower()))
			{
				DescriptionPropertyValue item = _map[propertyName.ToLower()];
				_map.Remove(propertyName.ToLower());
				_items.Remove(item);
			}
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			_map.Clear();
			_items.Clear();
		}

		public List<DescriptionPropertyValue> Items()
		{
			return _items;
		}
	}
	internal class DescriptionPropertyValue
	{
		public string PropertyName { get; set; }

		public object Value { get; set; }

		public TypeDescriptionMetadata Metadata { get; internal set; }
	}
	internal enum DescriptionTreeActionType
	{
		UpdateProperty,
		ResetProperty,
		InsertItem,
		ReplaceItem,
		RemoveItem,
		ClearItems
	}
	internal class DescriptionTreeAction
	{
		public DescriptionTreeActionType ActionType { get; set; }

		public DescriptionTreeNode TargetNode { get; set; }

		public TypeDescriptionMetadata PropertyMetadata { get; set; }

		public string PropertyName { get; set; }

		public object OldValue { get; set; }

		public object NewValue { get; set; }

		public int OldIndex { get; set; }

		public int NewIndex { get; set; }

		public string GetPlatformPropertyName(TypeDescriptionPlatform platform)
		{
			string text = PropertyName;
			if (PropertyMetadata != null)
			{
				text = PropertyMetadata.GetPlatformName(platform);
			}
			else if (TypeDescriptionMetadata.ShouldCamelize(platform))
			{
				text = TypeDescriptionMetadata.Camelize(PropertyName);
			}
			if (text.EndsWith("Ref"))
			{
				text = text.Substring(0, text.Length - "Ref".Length);
			}
			return text;
		}
	}
	internal class DiffApplyInfo
	{
		public HashSet<long> RemovedIds { get; set; }

		public List<DescriptionTreeAction> NewPropertyValues { get; set; }

		public List<DescriptionTreeAction> NewCollectionContent { get; set; }

		public List<DescriptionTreeAction> NewRootContent { get; set; }

		public DiffApplyInfo()
		{
			RemovedIds = new HashSet<long>();
			NewPropertyValues = new List<DescriptionTreeAction>();
			NewCollectionContent = new List<DescriptionTreeAction>();
			NewRootContent = new List<DescriptionTreeAction>();
		}
	}
	internal class DescriptionTreeReconciler
	{
		internal class TreeModeData
		{
			public string Name { get; set; }

			public DescriptionTreeNode Node { get; set; }

			public int Index { get; set; }

			public bool ToRemove { get; set; }

			public int TargetIndex { get; set; }

			public bool ToAdd { get; internal set; }
		}

		public static DiffApplyInfo ApplyDiff(DescriptionTreeNode oldTree, List<DescriptionTreeAction> diff)
		{
			DiffApplyInfo diffApplyInfo = new DiffApplyInfo();
			for (int i = 0; i < diff.Count; i++)
			{
				DescriptionTreeAction descriptionTreeAction = diff[i];
				switch (descriptionTreeAction.ActionType)
				{
				case DescriptionTreeActionType.UpdateProperty:
					if (descriptionTreeAction.OldValue is DescriptionTreeNode)
					{
						long id7 = ((DescriptionTreeNode)descriptionTreeAction.OldValue).Id;
						diffApplyInfo.RemovedIds.Add(id7);
					}
					descriptionTreeAction.TargetNode.Update(descriptionTreeAction.PropertyName, descriptionTreeAction.NewValue);
					if (descriptionTreeAction.NewValue is DescriptionTreeNode)
					{
						long id8 = ((DescriptionTreeNode)descriptionTreeAction.NewValue).Id;
						if (diffApplyInfo.RemovedIds.Contains(id8))
						{
							diffApplyInfo.RemovedIds.Remove(id8);
						}
						diffApplyInfo.NewPropertyValues.Add(descriptionTreeAction);
					}
					break;
				case DescriptionTreeActionType.ResetProperty:
					if (descriptionTreeAction.OldValue is DescriptionTreeNode)
					{
						long id3 = ((DescriptionTreeNode)descriptionTreeAction.OldValue).Id;
						diffApplyInfo.RemovedIds.Add(id3);
					}
					descriptionTreeAction.TargetNode.Remove(descriptionTreeAction.PropertyName);
					break;
				case DescriptionTreeActionType.ReplaceItem:
				{
					object[] obj3 = (object[])descriptionTreeAction.TargetNode.Get(descriptionTreeAction.PropertyName).Value;
					object obj4 = obj3[descriptionTreeAction.OldIndex];
					if (obj4 is DescriptionTreeNode)
					{
						long id5 = ((DescriptionTreeNode)obj4).Id;
						diffApplyInfo.RemovedIds.Add(id5);
					}
					obj3[descriptionTreeAction.OldIndex] = descriptionTreeAction.NewValue;
					if (descriptionTreeAction.NewValue is DescriptionTreeNode)
					{
						long id6 = ((DescriptionTreeNode)descriptionTreeAction.NewValue).Id;
						if (diffApplyInfo.RemovedIds.Contains(id6))
						{
							diffApplyInfo.RemovedIds.Remove(id6);
						}
						diffApplyInfo.NewCollectionContent.Add(descriptionTreeAction);
					}
					break;
				}
				case DescriptionTreeActionType.RemoveItem:
				{
					object[] array2 = (object[])descriptionTreeAction.TargetNode.Get(descriptionTreeAction.PropertyName).Value;
					object obj2 = array2[descriptionTreeAction.OldIndex];
					if (obj2 is DescriptionTreeNode)
					{
						long id2 = ((DescriptionTreeNode)obj2).Id;
						diffApplyInfo.RemovedIds.Add(id2);
					}
					object[] array3 = new object[array2.Length - 1];
					int num = 0;
					for (int k = 0; k < array2.Length; k++)
					{
						if (k != descriptionTreeAction.OldIndex)
						{
							array3[num] = array2[k];
							num++;
						}
					}
					descriptionTreeAction.TargetNode.Update(descriptionTreeAction.PropertyName, array3);
					break;
				}
				case DescriptionTreeActionType.InsertItem:
				{
					if (descriptionTreeAction.TargetNode == null && oldTree == null)
					{
						diffApplyInfo.NewRootContent.Add(descriptionTreeAction);
						break;
					}
					object[] array4 = (object[])descriptionTreeAction.TargetNode.Get(descriptionTreeAction.PropertyName).Value;
					object[] array5 = new object[array4.Length + 1];
					int num2 = 0;
					for (int l = 0; l < array5.Length; l++)
					{
						if (l == descriptionTreeAction.NewIndex)
						{
							array5[l] = descriptionTreeAction.NewValue;
							continue;
						}
						array5[l] = array4[num2];
						num2++;
					}
					descriptionTreeAction.TargetNode.Update(descriptionTreeAction.PropertyName, array5);
					if (descriptionTreeAction.NewValue is DescriptionTreeNode)
					{
						long id4 = ((DescriptionTreeNode)descriptionTreeAction.NewValue).Id;
						if (diffApplyInfo.RemovedIds.Contains(id4))
						{
							diffApplyInfo.RemovedIds.Remove(id4);
						}
						diffApplyInfo.NewCollectionContent.Add(descriptionTreeAction);
					}
					break;
				}
				case DescriptionTreeActionType.ClearItems:
				{
					object[] array = (object[])descriptionTreeAction.TargetNode.Get(descriptionTreeAction.PropertyName).Value;
					foreach (object obj in array)
					{
						if (obj is DescriptionTreeNode)
						{
							long id = ((DescriptionTreeNode)obj).Id;
							diffApplyInfo.RemovedIds.Add(id);
						}
					}
					descriptionTreeAction.TargetNode.Update(descriptionTreeAction.PropertyName, new object[0]);
					break;
				}
				}
			}
			return diffApplyInfo;
		}

		public static List<DescriptionTreeAction> DiffTrees(DescriptionTreeNode oldTree, DescriptionTreeNode newTree, bool isDelta)
		{
			List<DescriptionTreeAction> list = new List<DescriptionTreeAction>();
			if (oldTree == null && newTree == null)
			{
				return list;
			}
			if (oldTree != null && newTree == null)
			{
				DescriptionTreeAction descriptionTreeAction = new DescriptionTreeAction();
				descriptionTreeAction.ActionType = DescriptionTreeActionType.RemoveItem;
				descriptionTreeAction.OldIndex = 0;
				descriptionTreeAction.OldValue = oldTree;
				descriptionTreeAction.PropertyMetadata = null;
				descriptionTreeAction.PropertyName = null;
				list.Add(descriptionTreeAction);
				return list;
			}
			if (oldTree == null && newTree != null)
			{
				DescriptionTreeAction descriptionTreeAction2 = new DescriptionTreeAction();
				descriptionTreeAction2.ActionType = DescriptionTreeActionType.InsertItem;
				descriptionTreeAction2.OldIndex = 0;
				descriptionTreeAction2.NewValue = newTree;
				descriptionTreeAction2.PropertyMetadata = null;
				descriptionTreeAction2.PropertyName = null;
				list.Add(descriptionTreeAction2);
				return list;
			}
			if (newTree.Type != oldTree.Type)
			{
				DescriptionTreeAction descriptionTreeAction3 = new DescriptionTreeAction();
				descriptionTreeAction3.ActionType = DescriptionTreeActionType.ReplaceItem;
				descriptionTreeAction3.OldIndex = 0;
				descriptionTreeAction3.OldValue = oldTree;
				descriptionTreeAction3.NewValue = newTree;
				descriptionTreeAction3.PropertyMetadata = null;
				descriptionTreeAction3.PropertyName = null;
				list.Add(descriptionTreeAction3);
				return list;
			}
			DiffTreesHelper(list, oldTree, newTree, isDelta);
			return list;
		}

		private static void DiffTreesHelper(List<DescriptionTreeAction> actions, DescriptionTreeNode oldTree, DescriptionTreeNode newTree, bool isDelta)
		{
			newTree.Id = oldTree.Id;
			List<DescriptionPropertyValue> nonArrayProperties = GetNonArrayProperties(oldTree);
			List<DescriptionPropertyValue> nonArrayProperties2 = GetNonArrayProperties(newTree);
			List<DescriptionPropertyValue> list = new List<DescriptionPropertyValue>();
			List<DescriptionPropertyValue> list2 = new List<DescriptionPropertyValue>();
			List<DescriptionPropertyValue> list3 = new List<DescriptionPropertyValue>();
			for (int i = 0; i < nonArrayProperties.Count; i++)
			{
				DescriptionPropertyValue descriptionPropertyValue = nonArrayProperties[i];
				if (newTree.Has(descriptionPropertyValue.PropertyName))
				{
					if (descriptionPropertyValue.Equals(newTree.Get(descriptionPropertyValue.PropertyName)))
					{
						continue;
					}
					DescriptionPropertyValue descriptionPropertyValue2 = newTree.Get(descriptionPropertyValue.PropertyName);
					if (descriptionPropertyValue.Value is DescriptionTreeNode && descriptionPropertyValue2.Value is DescriptionTreeNode)
					{
						DescriptionTreeNode descriptionTreeNode = (DescriptionTreeNode)descriptionPropertyValue.Value;
						DescriptionTreeNode descriptionTreeNode2 = (DescriptionTreeNode)descriptionPropertyValue2.Value;
						if (descriptionTreeNode.Type == descriptionTreeNode2.Type)
						{
							if ((!descriptionTreeNode.Has("Name") && !descriptionTreeNode2.Has("Name")) || (descriptionTreeNode.Has("Name") && descriptionTreeNode2.Has("Name") && descriptionTreeNode.Get("Name").Value == descriptionTreeNode2.Get("Name").Value))
							{
								DiffTreesHelper(actions, descriptionTreeNode, descriptionTreeNode2, isDelta);
							}
							else
							{
								list3.Add(newTree.Get(descriptionPropertyValue.PropertyName));
							}
						}
						else
						{
							list3.Add(newTree.Get(descriptionPropertyValue.PropertyName));
						}
					}
					else
					{
						list3.Add(newTree.Get(descriptionPropertyValue.PropertyName));
					}
				}
				else if (!isDelta)
				{
					list.Add(descriptionPropertyValue);
				}
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < nonArrayProperties2.Count; j++)
			{
				DescriptionPropertyValue descriptionPropertyValue3 = nonArrayProperties2[j];
				if (!oldTree.Has(descriptionPropertyValue3.PropertyName))
				{
					list2.Add(descriptionPropertyValue3);
				}
			}
			for (int k = 0; k < list.Count; k++)
			{
				DescriptionPropertyValue descriptionPropertyValue4 = list[k];
				DescriptionTreeAction descriptionTreeAction = new DescriptionTreeAction();
				descriptionTreeAction.TargetNode = oldTree;
				descriptionTreeAction.ActionType = DescriptionTreeActionType.ResetProperty;
				descriptionTreeAction.PropertyName = descriptionPropertyValue4.PropertyName;
				descriptionTreeAction.PropertyMetadata = descriptionPropertyValue4.Metadata;
				descriptionTreeAction.OldValue = descriptionPropertyValue4.Value;
				actions.Add(descriptionTreeAction);
			}
			for (int l = 0; l < list2.Count; l++)
			{
				DescriptionPropertyValue descriptionPropertyValue5 = list2[l];
				DescriptionTreeAction descriptionTreeAction2 = new DescriptionTreeAction();
				descriptionTreeAction2.TargetNode = oldTree;
				descriptionTreeAction2.ActionType = DescriptionTreeActionType.UpdateProperty;
				descriptionTreeAction2.PropertyName = descriptionPropertyValue5.PropertyName;
				descriptionTreeAction2.PropertyMetadata = descriptionPropertyValue5.Metadata;
				descriptionTreeAction2.NewValue = descriptionPropertyValue5.Value;
				descriptionTreeAction2.OldValue = null;
				actions.Add(descriptionTreeAction2);
			}
			for (int m = 0; m < list3.Count; m++)
			{
				DescriptionPropertyValue descriptionPropertyValue6 = list3[m];
				object value = oldTree.Get(descriptionPropertyValue6.PropertyName).Value;
				if (!object.Equals(descriptionPropertyValue6.Value, value))
				{
					DescriptionTreeAction descriptionTreeAction3 = new DescriptionTreeAction();
					descriptionTreeAction3.TargetNode = oldTree;
					descriptionTreeAction3.ActionType = DescriptionTreeActionType.UpdateProperty;
					descriptionTreeAction3.PropertyName = descriptionPropertyValue6.PropertyName;
					descriptionTreeAction3.PropertyMetadata = descriptionPropertyValue6.Metadata;
					descriptionTreeAction3.NewValue = descriptionPropertyValue6.Value;
					descriptionTreeAction3.OldValue = oldTree.Get(descriptionPropertyValue6.PropertyName).Value;
					actions.Add(descriptionTreeAction3);
				}
			}
			List<DescriptionPropertyValue> arrayProperties = GetArrayProperties(oldTree);
			List<DescriptionPropertyValue> arrayProperties2 = GetArrayProperties(newTree);
			List<DescriptionPropertyValue> list4 = new List<DescriptionPropertyValue>();
			List<DescriptionPropertyValue> list5 = new List<DescriptionPropertyValue>();
			List<DescriptionPropertyValue> list6 = new List<DescriptionPropertyValue>();
			for (int n = 0; n < arrayProperties.Count; n++)
			{
				DescriptionPropertyValue descriptionPropertyValue7 = arrayProperties[n];
				if (newTree.Has(descriptionPropertyValue7.PropertyName))
				{
					if (!ArraysEquivalent(descriptionPropertyValue7.Value, newTree.Get(descriptionPropertyValue7.PropertyName).Value))
					{
						list6.Add(newTree.Get(descriptionPropertyValue7.PropertyName));
						continue;
					}
					object[] array = (object[])descriptionPropertyValue7.Value;
					object[] array2 = (object[])newTree.Get(descriptionPropertyValue7.PropertyName).Value;
					for (int num = 0; num < array.Length; num++)
					{
						object obj = array[num];
						object obj2 = array2[num];
						if (obj is DescriptionTreeNode && obj2 is DescriptionTreeNode)
						{
							DescriptionTreeNode descriptionTreeNode3 = (DescriptionTreeNode)obj;
							DescriptionTreeNode descriptionTreeNode4 = (DescriptionTreeNode)obj2;
							if (descriptionTreeNode3.Type == descriptionTreeNode4.Type)
							{
								DiffTreesHelper(actions, descriptionTreeNode3, descriptionTreeNode4, isDelta);
								continue;
							}
							DescriptionTreeAction descriptionTreeAction4 = new DescriptionTreeAction();
							descriptionTreeAction4.PropertyName = descriptionPropertyValue7.PropertyName;
							descriptionTreeAction4.PropertyMetadata = descriptionPropertyValue7.Metadata;
							descriptionTreeAction4.TargetNode = oldTree;
							descriptionTreeAction4.ActionType = DescriptionTreeActionType.ReplaceItem;
							descriptionTreeAction4.OldIndex = num;
							descriptionTreeAction4.NewIndex = num;
							descriptionTreeAction4.OldValue = descriptionTreeNode3;
							descriptionTreeAction4.NewValue = descriptionTreeNode4;
							actions.Add(descriptionTreeAction4);
						}
						else if (!obj.Equals(obj2))
						{
							DescriptionTreeAction descriptionTreeAction5 = new DescriptionTreeAction();
							descriptionTreeAction5.PropertyName = descriptionPropertyValue7.PropertyName;
							descriptionTreeAction5.PropertyMetadata = descriptionPropertyValue7.Metadata;
							descriptionTreeAction5.TargetNode = oldTree;
							descriptionTreeAction5.ActionType = DescriptionTreeActionType.ReplaceItem;
							descriptionTreeAction5.OldIndex = num;
							descriptionTreeAction5.NewIndex = num;
							descriptionTreeAction5.OldValue = obj;
							descriptionTreeAction5.NewValue = obj2;
							actions.Add(descriptionTreeAction5);
						}
					}
				}
				else if (!isDelta)
				{
					list4.Add(descriptionPropertyValue7);
				}
			}
			for (int num2 = 0; num2 < arrayProperties2.Count; num2++)
			{
				DescriptionPropertyValue descriptionPropertyValue8 = arrayProperties2[num2];
				if (!oldTree.Has(descriptionPropertyValue8.PropertyName))
				{
					list5.Add(descriptionPropertyValue8);
				}
			}
			for (int num3 = 0; num3 < list4.Count; num3++)
			{
				DescriptionPropertyValue descriptionPropertyValue9 = list4[num3];
				DescriptionTreeAction descriptionTreeAction6 = new DescriptionTreeAction();
				descriptionTreeAction6.TargetNode = oldTree;
				descriptionTreeAction6.PropertyName = descriptionPropertyValue9.PropertyName;
				descriptionTreeAction6.PropertyMetadata = descriptionPropertyValue9.Metadata;
				descriptionTreeAction6.ActionType = DescriptionTreeActionType.ClearItems;
				descriptionTreeAction6.OldValue = descriptionPropertyValue9.Value;
				actions.Add(descriptionTreeAction6);
			}
			for (int num4 = 0; num4 < list5.Count; num4++)
			{
				DescriptionPropertyValue descriptionPropertyValue10 = list5[num4];
				DescriptionTreeAction descriptionTreeAction7 = new DescriptionTreeAction();
				descriptionTreeAction7.TargetNode = oldTree;
				descriptionTreeAction7.PropertyName = descriptionPropertyValue10.PropertyName;
				descriptionTreeAction7.PropertyMetadata = descriptionPropertyValue10.Metadata;
				descriptionTreeAction7.ActionType = DescriptionTreeActionType.UpdateProperty;
				descriptionTreeAction7.OldValue = null;
				descriptionTreeAction7.NewValue = descriptionPropertyValue10.Value;
				actions.Add(descriptionTreeAction7);
			}
			for (int num5 = 0; num5 < list6.Count; num5++)
			{
				ReconcileArrays(actions, oldTree, newTree, oldTree.Get(list6[num5].PropertyName), list6[num5], isDelta);
			}
		}

		private static string GetNodeType(DescriptionTreeNode node)
		{
			if (node == null)
			{
				return "UNKOWN";
			}
			if (!node.Has("Type"))
			{
				return "UNKOWN";
			}
			return (string)node.Get("Type").Value;
		}

		private static void ReconcileArrays(List<DescriptionTreeAction> actions, DescriptionTreeNode oldTree, DescriptionTreeNode newTree, DescriptionPropertyValue oldArray, DescriptionPropertyValue newArray, bool isDelta)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			object[] array = (object[])oldArray.Value;
			object[] array2 = (object[])newArray.Value;
			if (array.Length != 0 && array[0] is DescriptionTreeNode)
			{
				DescriptionTreeNode descriptionTreeNode = (DescriptionTreeNode)array[0];
				if (descriptionTreeNode.Has("Name") && descriptionTreeNode.Get("Name") != null)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				if (descriptionTreeNode.Has("RefType") && (string)descriptionTreeNode.Get("RefType").Value == "uuid")
				{
					flag = true;
				}
			}
			if (array2.Length != 0 && array2[0] is DescriptionTreeNode)
			{
				DescriptionTreeNode descriptionTreeNode2 = (DescriptionTreeNode)array2[0];
				if (descriptionTreeNode2.Has("Name") && descriptionTreeNode2.Get("Name") != null)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				if (descriptionTreeNode2.Has("RefType") && (string)descriptionTreeNode2.Get("RefType").Value == "uuid")
				{
					flag = true;
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				Dictionary<string, TreeModeData> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, TreeModeData>();
				List<TreeModeData> list = new List<TreeModeData>();
				Dictionary<string, TreeModeData> dictionary2 = new Dictionary<string, TreeModeData>();
				List<TreeModeData> list2 = new List<TreeModeData>();
				int num = 0;
				for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
				{
					TreeModeData treeModeData = new TreeModeData();
					treeModeData.Node = (DescriptionTreeNode)array[i];
					treeModeData.Index = i;
					treeModeData.Name = (treeModeData.Node.Has("Name") ? ((string)treeModeData.Node.Get("Name").Value) : (treeModeData.Node.Has("RefType") ? ((string)treeModeData.Node.Get("Value").Value) : null));
					if (treeModeData.Name == null)
					{
						treeModeData.Name = "BADKEY_" + num;
						num++;
					}
					list.Add(treeModeData);
					dictionary.Add(treeModeData.Name, treeModeData);
				}
				for (int j = 0; j < array2.Length; j++)
				{
					TreeModeData treeModeData2 = new TreeModeData();
					treeModeData2.Node = (DescriptionTreeNode)array2[j];
					treeModeData2.Index = j;
					treeModeData2.Name = (treeModeData2.Node.Has("Name") ? ((string)treeModeData2.Node.Get("Name").Value) : (treeModeData2.Node.Has("RefType") ? ((string)treeModeData2.Node.Get("Value").Value) : null));
					if (treeModeData2.Name == null)
					{
						treeModeData2.Name = "BADKEY_" + num;
						num++;
					}
					list2.Add(treeModeData2);
					dictionary2.Add(treeModeData2.Name, treeModeData2);
				}
				for (int k = 0; k < list.Count; k++)
				{
					TreeModeData treeModeData3 = list[k];
					if (!dictionary2.ContainsKey(treeModeData3.Name) || (dictionary2.ContainsKey(treeModeData3.Name) && GetNodeType(treeModeData3.Node) != GetNodeType(dictionary2[treeModeData3.Name].Node)))
					{
						treeModeData3.ToRemove = true;
					}
				}
				for (int l = 0; l < list2.Count; l++)
				{
					TreeModeData treeModeData4 = list2[l];
					if (!dictionary.ContainsKey(treeModeData4.Name) || (dictionary.ContainsKey(treeModeData4.Name) && GetNodeType(treeModeData4.Node) != GetNodeType(dictionary[treeModeData4.Name].Node)))
					{
						treeModeData4.ToAdd = true;
					}
					else
					{
						dictionary[treeModeData4.Name].TargetIndex = l;
					}
				}
				for (int m = 0; m < list.Count; m++)
				{
					TreeModeData treeModeData5 = list[m];
					if (treeModeData5.ToRemove)
					{
						DescriptionTreeAction descriptionTreeAction = new DescriptionTreeAction();
						descriptionTreeAction.PropertyName = newArray.PropertyName;
						descriptionTreeAction.TargetNode = oldTree;
						descriptionTreeAction.PropertyMetadata = newArray.Metadata;
						descriptionTreeAction.OldIndex = treeModeData5.Index;
						descriptionTreeAction.ActionType = DescriptionTreeActionType.RemoveItem;
						descriptionTreeAction.OldValue = treeModeData5.Node;
						actions.Add(descriptionTreeAction);
						for (int n = m + 1; n < list.Count; n++)
						{
							list[n].Index--;
						}
					}
				}
				for (int num2 = 0; num2 < list2.Count; num2++)
				{
					TreeModeData treeModeData6 = list2[num2];
					if (treeModeData6.ToAdd)
					{
						DescriptionTreeAction descriptionTreeAction2 = new DescriptionTreeAction();
						descriptionTreeAction2.PropertyName = newArray.PropertyName;
						descriptionTreeAction2.TargetNode = oldTree;
						descriptionTreeAction2.PropertyMetadata = newArray.Metadata;
						descriptionTreeAction2.NewIndex = num2;
						descriptionTreeAction2.ActionType = DescriptionTreeActionType.InsertItem;
						descriptionTreeAction2.NewValue = array2[num2];
						actions.Add(descriptionTreeAction2);
						for (int num3 = 0; num3 < list.Count; num3++)
						{
							TreeModeData treeModeData7 = list[num3];
							if (!treeModeData7.ToRemove && treeModeData7.Index >= num2)
							{
								treeModeData7.Index++;
							}
						}
						continue;
					}
					TreeModeData treeModeData8 = dictionary[treeModeData6.Name];
					if (treeModeData8.Index == treeModeData8.TargetIndex)
					{
						DiffTreesHelper(actions, treeModeData8.Node, treeModeData6.Node, isDelta);
						continue;
					}
					DescriptionTreeAction descriptionTreeAction3 = new DescriptionTreeAction();
					descriptionTreeAction3.PropertyName = newArray.PropertyName;
					descriptionTreeAction3.TargetNode = oldTree;
					descriptionTreeAction3.PropertyMetadata = newArray.Metadata;
					descriptionTreeAction3.OldIndex = treeModeData8.Index;
					descriptionTreeAction3.ActionType = DescriptionTreeActionType.RemoveItem;
					descriptionTreeAction3.OldValue = treeModeData8.Node;
					actions.Add(descriptionTreeAction3);
					for (int num4 = 0; num4 < list.Count; num4++)
					{
						TreeModeData treeModeData9 = list[num4];
						if (!treeModeData9.ToRemove && treeModeData9.Node != treeModeData8.Node && treeModeData9.Index >= treeModeData8.Index)
						{
							treeModeData9.Index--;
						}
					}
					descriptionTreeAction3 = new DescriptionTreeAction();
					descriptionTreeAction3.PropertyName = newArray.PropertyName;
					descriptionTreeAction3.TargetNode = oldTree;
					descriptionTreeAction3.PropertyMetadata = newArray.Metadata;
					descriptionTreeAction3.NewIndex = treeModeData8.TargetIndex;
					descriptionTreeAction3.ActionType = DescriptionTreeActionType.InsertItem;
					descriptionTreeAction3.NewValue = treeModeData8.Node;
					actions.Add(descriptionTreeAction3);
					treeModeData8.Index = treeModeData8.TargetIndex;
					for (int num5 = 0; num5 < list.Count; num5++)
					{
						TreeModeData treeModeData10 = list[num5];
						if (!treeModeData10.ToRemove && treeModeData10.Node != treeModeData8.Node && treeModeData10.Index >= treeModeData8.Index)
						{
							treeModeData10.Index++;
						}
					}
					DiffTreesHelper(actions, treeModeData8.Node, treeModeData6.Node, isDelta);
				}
				return;
			}
			int num6 = Math.Max(array.Length, array2.Length);
			for (int num7 = 0; num7 < num6; num7++)
			{
				if (num7 >= array.Length)
				{
					DescriptionTreeAction descriptionTreeAction4 = new DescriptionTreeAction();
					descriptionTreeAction4.PropertyName = newArray.PropertyName;
					descriptionTreeAction4.TargetNode = oldTree;
					descriptionTreeAction4.PropertyMetadata = newArray.Metadata;
					descriptionTreeAction4.NewIndex = num7;
					descriptionTreeAction4.ActionType = DescriptionTreeActionType.InsertItem;
					descriptionTreeAction4.NewValue = array2[num7];
					actions.Add(descriptionTreeAction4);
					continue;
				}
				if (num7 >= array2.Length)
				{
					DescriptionTreeAction descriptionTreeAction5 = new DescriptionTreeAction();
					descriptionTreeAction5.PropertyName = newArray.PropertyName;
					descriptionTreeAction5.TargetNode = oldTree;
					descriptionTreeAction5.PropertyMetadata = newArray.Metadata;
					descriptionTreeAction5.OldIndex = array2.Length;
					descriptionTreeAction5.ActionType = DescriptionTreeActionType.RemoveItem;
					descriptionTreeAction5.OldValue = array[num7];
					actions.Add(descriptionTreeAction5);
					continue;
				}
				object obj = array[num7];
				object obj2 = array2[num7];
				if (obj is DescriptionTreeNode && obj2 is DescriptionTreeNode)
				{
					DescriptionTreeNode descriptionTreeNode3 = (DescriptionTreeNode)obj;
					DescriptionTreeNode descriptionTreeNode4 = (DescriptionTreeNode)obj2;
					if (descriptionTreeNode3.Type == descriptionTreeNode4.Type)
					{
						DiffTreesHelper(actions, descriptionTreeNode3, descriptionTreeNode4, isDelta);
						continue;
					}
					DescriptionTreeAction descriptionTreeAction6 = new DescriptionTreeAction();
					descriptionTreeAction6.PropertyName = newArray.PropertyName;
					descriptionTreeAction6.TargetNode = oldTree;
					descriptionTreeAction6.PropertyMetadata = newArray.Metadata;
					descriptionTreeAction6.OldIndex = num7;
					descriptionTreeAction6.ActionType = DescriptionTreeActionType.ReplaceItem;
					descriptionTreeAction6.OldValue = array[num7];
					descriptionTreeAction6.NewValue = array2[num7];
					actions.Add(descriptionTreeAction6);
				}
				else if (!object.Equals(obj, obj2))
				{
					DescriptionTreeAction descriptionTreeAction7 = new DescriptionTreeAction();
					descriptionTreeAction7.PropertyName = newArray.PropertyName;
					descriptionTreeAction7.TargetNode = oldTree;
					descriptionTreeAction7.PropertyMetadata = newArray.Metadata;
					descriptionTreeAction7.OldIndex = num7;
					descriptionTreeAction7.ActionType = DescriptionTreeActionType.ReplaceItem;
					descriptionTreeAction7.OldValue = array[num7];
					descriptionTreeAction7.NewValue = array2[num7];
					actions.Add(descriptionTreeAction7);
				}
			}
		}

		private static bool ArraysEquivalent(object value1, object value2)
		{
			object[] array = (object[])value1;
			object[] array2 = (object[])value2;
			if (array.Length != array2.Length)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				object obj = array[i];
				object obj2 = array2[i];
				if (obj is DescriptionTreeNode && !(obj2 is DescriptionTreeNode))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!(obj is DescriptionTreeNode) && obj2 is DescriptionTreeNode)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (obj is DescriptionTreeNode)
				{
					DescriptionTreeNode descriptionTreeNode = (DescriptionTreeNode)obj;
					DescriptionTreeNode descriptionTreeNode2 = (DescriptionTreeNode)obj2;
					if (descriptionTreeNode.Type != descriptionTreeNode2.Type)
					{
						return false;
					}
					string objA = (descriptionTreeNode.Has("Name") ? ((string)descriptionTreeNode.Get("Name").Value) : null);
					string objB = (descriptionTreeNode2.Has("Name") ? ((string)descriptionTreeNode2.Get("Name").Value) : null);
					if (!object.Equals(objA, objB))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				else if (!object.Equals(obj, obj2))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static List<DescriptionPropertyValue> GetNonArrayProperties(DescriptionTreeNode tree)
		{
			List<DescriptionPropertyValue> list = new List<DescriptionPropertyValue>();
			List<DescriptionPropertyValue> list2 = tree.Items();
			for (int i = 0; i < list2.Count; i++)
			{
				DescriptionPropertyValue descriptionPropertyValue = list2[i];
				if (descriptionPropertyValue.Metadata != null && descriptionPropertyValue.Metadata.KnownType != TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Array && descriptionPropertyValue.Metadata.KnownType != TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Collection)
				{
					list.Add(descriptionPropertyValue);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private static List<DescriptionPropertyValue> GetArrayProperties(DescriptionTreeNode tree)
		{
			List<DescriptionPropertyValue> list = new List<DescriptionPropertyValue>();
			List<DescriptionPropertyValue> list2 = tree.Items();
			for (int i = 0; i < list2.Count; i++)
			{
				DescriptionPropertyValue descriptionPropertyValue = list2[i];
				if (descriptionPropertyValue.Metadata != null && (descriptionPropertyValue.Metadata.KnownType == TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Array || descriptionPropertyValue.Metadata.KnownType == TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Collection))
				{
					list.Add(descriptionPropertyValue);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}
	}
	public class DescriptionSerializer
	{
		private bool _transformMemberPaths;

		private Func<string, string> _customMemberPathTransformer;

		private bool _skipProperties;

		public bool ThrowOnMissingDescription { get; set; }

		internal bool ForcePascal { get; set; }

		public string Serialize(TypeDescriptionContext context, Description desc)
		{
			DescriptionTreeNode tree = DescriptionTreeBuilder.CreateTree(context, desc);
			DescriptionSerializerBuilder descriptionSerializerBuilder = new DescriptionSerializerBuilder();
			SerializeHelper(context, tree, descriptionSerializerBuilder);
			return descriptionSerializerBuilder.ToString();
		}

		internal void SerializeTree(TypeDescriptionContext context, DescriptionTreeNode tree, DescriptionSerializerBuilder builder)
		{
			SerializeHelper(context, tree, builder);
		}

		public DescriptionResult Deserialize(TypeDescriptionContext context, string json)
		{
			JsonDictionaryItem item = new JsonDictionaryParser().Parse(json);
			return DeserializeItem(context, item, transformMemberPaths: false, null, skipProperties: false);
		}

		internal DescriptionResult DeserializeItem(TypeDescriptionContext context, JsonDictionaryItem item, bool transformMemberPaths, Func<string, string> customMemberPathTransformer, bool skipProperties)
		{
			if (!(item is JsonDictionaryObject))
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException("expected an object at the root of the json");
			}
			JsonDictionaryObject obj = (JsonDictionaryObject)item;
			if (transformMemberPaths)
			{
				_transformMemberPaths = true;
				_customMemberPathTransformer = customMemberPathTransformer;
			}
			if (skipProperties)
			{
				_skipProperties = true;
			}
			DescriptionResult result = ConvertObjToDescription(context, obj);
			_transformMemberPaths = false;
			_customMemberPathTransformer = null;
			_skipProperties = false;
			return result;
		}

		internal void SetDescriptionProperty(TypeDescriptionContext context, Description desc, string key, TypeDescriptionMetadata propertyMetaData, object value)
		{
			if (ForcePascal)
			{
				context.SetDescriptionPropertyPascal(desc, key, propertyMetaData, value);
			}
			else
			{
				context.SetDescriptionProperty(desc, key, propertyMetaData, value);
			}
		}

		private DescriptionResult ConvertObjToDescription(TypeDescriptionContext context, JsonDictionaryObject obj, TypeDescriptionWellKnownType wellKnownType = TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.ExportedType)
		{
			if (!obj.ContainsKey("type"))
			{
				if (obj.ContainsKey("refType"))
				{
					EmbeddedRefDescription embeddedRefDescription = new EmbeddedRefDescription();
					embeddedRefDescription.RefType = (string)((JsonDictionaryValue)obj["refType"]).Value;
					embeddedRefDescription.Value = (string)((JsonDictionaryValue)obj["id"]).Value;
					return new DescriptionResult
					{
						Result = embeddedRefDescription
					};
				}
				throw new NotSupportedException("expected type to be defined for the json object");
			}
			DescriptionResult descriptionResult = new DescriptionResult();
			string text = (string)((JsonDictionaryValue)obj["type"]).Value;
			Description description = (descriptionResult.Result = (Description)context.CreateDescriptionForType(text));
			if (description == null)
			{
				if (ThrowOnMissingDescription)
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException("missing description for type: " + text);
				}
				descriptionResult.AddWarning("couldn't find registered description for type: " + text);
				return descriptionResult;
			}
			string[] keys = obj.GetKeys();
			foreach (string text2 in keys)
			{
				TypeDescriptionMetadata metadata = context.GetMetadata(text, TypeDescriptionContext.ToPascal(text2));
				if (metadata == null)
				{
					if (TypeDescriptionContext.ToPascal(text2) == "Name")
					{
						string targetType = "string";
						JsonDictionaryValue v = (JsonDictionaryValue)obj[text2];
						object obj2 = ConvertDescriptionValue(descriptionResult, context, v, targetType);
						description.Name = (string)obj2;
					}
					continue;
				}
				JsonDictionaryItem jsonDictionaryItem = obj[text2];
				if (metadata.KnownType == TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Rect || metadata.KnownType == TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Point || metadata.KnownType == TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Size)
				{
					object value = jsonDictionaryItem;
					switch (metadata.KnownType)
					{
					case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Rect:
						value = ConvertObjToRect(context, (JsonDictionaryObject)jsonDictionaryItem);
						break;
					case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Size:
						value = ConvertObjToSize(context, (JsonDictionaryObject)jsonDictionaryItem);
						break;
					case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Point:
						value = ConvertObjToPoint(context, (JsonDictionaryObject)jsonDictionaryItem);
						break;
					}
					if (!_skipProperties)
					{
						SetDescriptionProperty(context, description, text2, metadata, value);
					}
					continue;
				}
				if (jsonDictionaryItem is JsonDictionaryObject)
				{
					JsonDictionaryObject obj3 = (JsonDictionaryObject)jsonDictionaryItem;
					DescriptionResult descriptionResult2 = ConvertObjToDescription(context, obj3, metadata.KnownType);
					descriptionResult.AddWarnings(descriptionResult2);
					SetDescriptionProperty(context, description, text2, metadata, descriptionResult2.Result);
					continue;
				}
				if (jsonDictionaryItem is JsonDictionaryArray)
				{
					JsonDictionaryArray a = (JsonDictionaryArray)jsonDictionaryItem;
					string eleType = "string";
					bool flag = false;
					if (metadata.KnownType == TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Array)
					{
						eleType = metadata.SpecificExternalType;
					}
					if (metadata.KnownType == TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Collection)
					{
						flag = true;
						eleType = metadata.CollectionElementType;
					}
					object[] value2 = ConvertArrayToDescriptionArray(descriptionResult, context, a, eleType);
					if (!_skipProperties || flag)
					{
						SetDescriptionProperty(context, description, text2, metadata, value2);
					}
					continue;
				}
				string text3 = metadata.SpecificExternalType;
				if (text3 == null && metadata.KnownType == TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Date)
				{
					text3 = "DateTime";
				}
				if (text3 == null)
				{
					text3 = "String";
				}
				JsonDictionaryValue v2 = (JsonDictionaryValue)jsonDictionaryItem;
				object obj4 = ConvertDescriptionValue(descriptionResult, context, v2, text3);
				if (_transformMemberPaths && (metadata.PropertyName.EndsWith("MemberPath") || (text != null && text.EndsWith("Axis") && metadata.PropertyName.ToLower() == "label")))
				{
					string text4 = obj4.ToString();
					if (_customMemberPathTransformer != null)
					{
						obj4 = _customMemberPathTransformer(text4);
					}
					else if (text4.StartsWith("{"))
					{
						if (!text4.StartsWith("{["))
						{
							text4 = text4.Substring(1, text4.Length - 2);
							text4 = "{[" + text4 + "]}";
							obj4 = text4;
						}
					}
					else if (!text4.StartsWith("["))
					{
						text4 = "[" + text4 + "]";
						obj4 = text4;
					}
				}
				if (!_skipProperties)
				{
					SetDescriptionProperty(context, description, text2, metadata, obj4);
				}
			}
			return descriptionResult;
		}

		private object ConvertObjToPoint(TypeDescriptionContext context, JsonDictionaryObject obj)
		{
			if (obj == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			double x = double.NaN;
			double y = double.NaN;
			if (obj.ContainsKey("x"))
			{
				x = (double)((JsonDictionaryValue)obj["x"]).Value;
			}
			if (obj.ContainsKey("y"))
			{
				y = (double)((JsonDictionaryValue)obj["y"]).Value;
			}
			return new PointDescription
			{
				X = x,
				Y = y
			};
		}

		private object ConvertObjToSize(TypeDescriptionContext context, JsonDictionaryObject obj)
		{
			if (obj == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			double width = double.NaN;
			double height = double.NaN;
			if (obj.ContainsKey("width"))
			{
				width = (double)((JsonDictionaryValue)obj["width"]).Value;
			}
			if (obj.ContainsKey("height"))
			{
				height = (double)((JsonDictionaryValue)obj["height"]).Value;
			}
			return new SizeDescription
			{
				Width = width,
				Height = height
			};
		}

		private object ConvertObjToRect(TypeDescriptionContext context, JsonDictionaryObject obj)
		{
			if (obj == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			double left = double.NaN;
			double top = double.NaN;
			double width = double.NaN;
			double height = double.NaN;
			if (obj.ContainsKey("left"))
			{
				left = (double)((JsonDictionaryValue)obj["left"]).Value;
			}
			if (obj.ContainsKey("top"))
			{
				top = (double)((JsonDictionaryValue)obj["top"]).Value;
			}
			if (obj.ContainsKey("width"))
			{
				width = (double)((JsonDictionaryValue)obj["width"]).Value;
			}
			if (obj.ContainsKey("height"))
			{
				height = (double)((JsonDictionaryValue)obj["height"]).Value;
			}
			return new RectDescription
			{
				Left = left,
				Top = top,
				Width = width,
				Height = height
			};
		}

		private object[] ConvertArrayToDescriptionArray(DescriptionResult res, TypeDescriptionContext context, JsonDictionaryArray a, string eleType)
		{
			Type descriptionObjectType = context.GetDescriptionObjectType(eleType);
			object[] array = null;
			if (descriptionObjectType == null)
			{
				descriptionObjectType = context.GetObjectType(eleType);
				array = new object[a.Items.Length];
			}
			else
			{
				array = (object[])Array.CreateInstance(descriptionObjectType, a.Items.Length);
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < a.Items.Length; i++)
			{
				JsonDictionaryItem jsonDictionaryItem = a.Items[i];
				if (jsonDictionaryItem is JsonDictionaryObject)
				{
					JsonDictionaryObject obj = (JsonDictionaryObject)jsonDictionaryItem;
					DescriptionResult descriptionResult = ConvertObjToDescription(context, obj);
					res.AddWarnings(descriptionResult);
					array[i] = descriptionResult.Result;
				}
				else if (jsonDictionaryItem is JsonDictionaryArray)
				{
					JsonDictionaryArray a2 = (JsonDictionaryArray)jsonDictionaryItem;
					object[] array2 = ConvertArrayToDescriptionArray(res, context, a2, eleType);
					array[i] = array2;
				}
				else
				{
					JsonDictionaryValue v = (JsonDictionaryValue)jsonDictionaryItem;
					object obj2 = ConvertDescriptionValue(res, context, v, eleType);
					array[i] = obj2;
				}
			}
			return array;
		}

		private object ConvertDescriptionValue(DescriptionResult res, TypeDescriptionContext context, JsonDictionaryValue v, string targetType)
		{
			switch (v.Type)
			{
			case JsonDictionaryValueType.BooleanValue:
				return v.Value;
			case JsonDictionaryValueType.NullValue:
				return v.Value;
			case JsonDictionaryValueType.NumberValue:
				switch (targetType.ToLower())
				{
				case "int":
					return (int)v.Value;
				case "double":
					return (double)v.Value;
				case "timespan":
					return (double)v.Value;
				case "short":
					return (short)v.Value;
				case "long":
					return (long)v.Value;
				case "float":
					return (float)v.Value;
				case "byte":
					return (byte)v.Value;
				default:
					res.AddWarning("unexpected target type for number: " + targetType);
					return v.Value;
				}
			case JsonDictionaryValueType.StringValue:
				if (targetType.ToLower() == "datetime")
				{
					return DateTime.Parse((string)v.Value, null, DateTimeStyles.RoundtripKind);
				}
				return v.Value;
			default:
				res.AddWarning("unexpected value type");
				return v.Value;
			}
		}

		private void SerializeHelper(TypeDescriptionContext context, DescriptionTreeNode tree, DescriptionSerializerBuilder builder)
		{
			builder.AppendLine("{");
			builder.IncreaseTabLevel();
			builder.AppendLine("\"type\": \"" + tree.Type + "\"");
			List<DescriptionPropertyValue> list = tree.Items();
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				DescriptionPropertyValue item = list[i];
				if (i >= 0)
				{
					builder.AppendLine(",");
				}
				SerializeItem(context, tree, item, builder);
			}
			builder.DecreaseTabLevel();
			builder.AppendLine("}");
		}

		private string Camelize(string val)
		{
			if (val == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return val.Substring(0, 1).ToLower() + val.Substring(1);
		}

		private void SerializeItem(TypeDescriptionContext context, DescriptionTreeNode owner, DescriptionPropertyValue item, DescriptionSerializerBuilder builder)
		{
			if (!(item.PropertyName.ToLower() == "type"))
			{
				builder.Append("\"" + Camelize(item.PropertyName) + "\": ");
				SerializeValue(context, owner, item, item.Value, builder);
			}
		}

		private void SerializeValue(TypeDescriptionContext context, DescriptionTreeNode owner, DescriptionPropertyValue item, object value, DescriptionSerializerBuilder builder)
		{
			TypeDescriptionWellKnownType typeDescriptionWellKnownType = TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.String;
			if (item.Metadata != null)
			{
				typeDescriptionWellKnownType = item.Metadata.KnownType;
			}
			switch (typeDescriptionWellKnownType)
			{
			case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.BrushCollection:
			case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Array:
			case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.ColorCollection:
			{
				builder.Append("[");
				object[] array = (object[])item.Value;
				string t = item.Metadata.SpecificType;
				if (item.Metadata.KnownType == TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.BrushCollection || item.Metadata.KnownType == TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.ColorCollection)
				{
					t = "String";
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
				{
					if (i > 0)
					{
						builder.Append(", ");
					}
					if (array[i] is DescriptionTreeNode)
					{
						SerializeHelper(context, (DescriptionTreeNode)array[i], builder);
					}
					else
					{
						SerializePrimitiveValue(context, t, array[i], builder);
					}
				}
				builder.Append("]");
				break;
			}
			case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Boolean:
				SerializePrimitiveValue(context, "Boolean", value, builder);
				break;
			case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Collection:
			{
				builder.Append("[");
				object[] array2 = (object[])item.Value;
				string collectionElementType = item.Metadata.CollectionElementType;
				for (int j = 0; j < array2.Length; j++)
				{
					if (j > 0)
					{
						builder.Append(", ");
					}
					if (array2[j] is DescriptionTreeNode)
					{
						SerializeHelper(context, (DescriptionTreeNode)array2[j], builder);
					}
					else
					{
						SerializePrimitiveValue(context, collectionElementType, array2[j], builder);
					}
				}
				builder.Append("]");
				break;
			}
			case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.String:
			case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Brush:
			case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Color:
			case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.MethodRef:
			case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.EventRef:
			case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.DataRef:
				SerializePrimitiveValue(context, "String", value, builder);
				break;
			case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Date:
				SerializePrimitiveValue(context, "DateTime", value, builder);
				break;
			case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.ExportedType:
				if (item.Metadata.SpecificExternalType.ToLower() == "string")
				{
					SerializePrimitiveValue(context, "String", value, builder);
				}
				else
				{
					SerializeHelper(context, (DescriptionTreeNode)value, builder);
				}
				break;
			case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Number:
				SerializePrimitiveValue(context, "Double", value, builder);
				break;
			case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Point:
			case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Size:
			case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Rect:
				SerializeHelper(context, (DescriptionTreeNode)value, builder);
				break;
			case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.TimeSpan:
				SerializePrimitiveValue(context, "TimeSpan", value, builder);
				break;
			case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Void:
			case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.IList:
			case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.DataTemplate:
			case TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Unknown:
				throw new NotImplementedException();
			}
		}

		private void SerializePrimitiveValue(TypeDescriptionContext context, string t, object v, DescriptionSerializerBuilder builder)
		{
			switch (t.ToLower())
			{
			case "string":
				if (v == null)
				{
					builder.Append("null");
				}
				else
				{
					builder.Append("\"" + ((string)v).Replace("\"", "\\\"") + "\"");
				}
				break;
			case "number":
			case "double":
				if (v == null)
				{
					builder.Append("null");
					break;
				}
				if (!(v is double))
				{
					v = Convert.ToDouble(v);
				}
				builder.Append(((double)v).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
				break;
			case "int":
				if (v == null)
				{
					builder.Append("null");
				}
				else
				{
					builder.Append(((int)v).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
				}
				break;
			case "float":
				if (v == null)
				{
					builder.Append("null");
				}
				else
				{
					builder.Append(((float)v).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
				}
				break;
			case "long":
				if (v == null)
				{
					builder.Append("null");
				}
				else
				{
					builder.Append(((long)v).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
				}
				break;
			case "decimal":
				if (v == null)
				{
					builder.Append("null");
				}
				else
				{
					builder.Append(((decimal)v).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
				}
				break;
			case "timespan":
				if (v == null)
				{
					builder.Append("null");
				}
				else
				{
					builder.Append(((int)v).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
				}
				break;
			case "boolean":
				builder.Append((v == null) ? "false" : v.ToString().ToLower());
				break;
			case "datetime":
				if (v == null)
				{
					builder.Append("null");
				}
				else
				{
					builder.Append("\"" + ((DateTime)v).ToString("o") + "\"");
				}
				break;
			}
		}
	}
	[DontObfuscate]
	public class DescriptionResult
	{
		private List<string> _warnings = new List<string>();

		public Description Result { get; internal set; }

		public string[] Warnings => _warnings.ToArray();

		internal void AddWarning(string warning)
		{
			_warnings.Add(warning);
		}

		internal void AddWarnings(DescriptionResult other)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < other._warnings.Count; i++)
			{
				_warnings.Add(other._warnings[i]);
			}
		}
	}
	internal class DescriptionSerializerBuilder
	{
		private StringBuilder _sb;

		private int _tabLevel;

		private bool _newLine;

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return _sb.ToString();
		}

		public DescriptionSerializerBuilder()
		{
			_sb = new StringBuilder();
		}

		public void Append(string val)
		{
			AppendTabs();
			_sb.Append(val);
		}

		public void AppendLine(string val)
		{
			AppendTabs();
			_sb.AppendLine(val);
			_newLine = true;
		}

		private void AppendTabs()
		{
			if (_newLine)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < _tabLevel; i++)
				{
					_sb.Append("\t");
				}
				_newLine = false;
			}
		}

		public void IncreaseTabLevel()
		{
			_tabLevel++;
		}

		public void DecreaseTabLevel()
		{
			_tabLevel--;
		}
	}

	[DontHide]
	[DontObfuscate]
	[TSImportModule("igniteui-core/ComponentRendererAdapter", "ComponentRendererAdapter")]
	public class ComponentRenderer
	{
		internal TypeDescriptionPlatform Platform;

		private Dictionary<Panel, Description> _pendingDescription = new Dictionary<Panel, Description>();

		private Dictionary<Panel, bool> _pendingDescriptionIsDelta = new Dictionary<Panel, bool>();

		private Dictionary<Panel, bool> _pendingDescriptionSkipApply = new Dictionary<Panel, bool>();

		private Dictionary<Panel, bool> _pendingCleanupUnusedRefs = new Dictionary<Panel, bool>();

		private Dictionary<Panel, DescriptionTreeNode> _currentDescription = new Dictionary<Panel, DescriptionTreeNode>();

		private Dictionary<Panel, ContainerState> _states = new Dictionary<Panel, ContainerState>();

		private Dictionary<Panel, Queue<Queue<DescriptionTreeAction>>> _queuedActions = new Dictionary<Panel, Queue<Queue<DescriptionTreeAction>>>();

		private Dictionary<Panel, bool> _actionsRunning = new Dictionary<Panel, bool>();

		private Dictionary<string, DescriptionRef> _refs = new Dictionary<string, DescriptionRef>();

		private Dictionary<string, object> _systemValues = new Dictionary<string, object>();

		private Dictionary<string, object> _userValues = new Dictionary<string, object>();

		private List<ComponentRendererTargetPropertyUpdatingHandler> _targetUpdatingHandlers = new List<ComponentRendererTargetPropertyUpdatingHandler>();

		private Dictionary<string, List<ComponentRendererPropertyUpdatingHandler>> _updatingHandlers = new Dictionary<string, List<ComponentRendererPropertyUpdatingHandler>>();

		private List<ComponentRendererReferenceLookupHandler> _lookupHandlers = new List<ComponentRendererReferenceLookupHandler>();

		private List<ComponentNamespaceLookupHandler> _namespaceLookupHandlers = new List<ComponentNamespaceLookupHandler>();

		internal IComponentRendererAdapter Adapter { get; set; }

		public TypeDescriptionContext Context { get; internal set; }

		public bool IsProceedOnErrorEnabled { get; set; }

		internal ITypeDescriptionPropertyTransforms Transformer { get; set; }

		internal TypeDescriptionCleanups CleanupMethods { get; private set; }

		public bool SkipTransformingMemberPaths { get; set; }

		internal Dictionary<Panel, ContainerState> States => _states;

		public bool ShouldNamespaceSystemRefValues { get; set; }

		public ComponentRenderer()
		{
			IComponentRendererAdapter adapter = CreateAdapter();
			Adapter = adapter;
			Context = new TypeDescriptionContext(Adapter, Platform);
			Transformer = new TypeDescriptionPropretyTransforms();
			CleanupMethods = new TypeDescriptionCleanups();
		}

		private IComponentRendererAdapter CreateAdapter()
		{
			return new WPFComponentRendererAdapter();
		}

		public string ToJson(Func<Panel, string> getContainerName)
		{
			DescriptionSerializerBuilder descriptionSerializerBuilder = new DescriptionSerializerBuilder();
			DescriptionSerializer descriptionSerializer = new DescriptionSerializer();
			descriptionSerializerBuilder.AppendLine("{");
			descriptionSerializerBuilder.IncreaseTabLevel();
			descriptionSerializerBuilder.AppendLine("\"descriptions\": {");
			descriptionSerializerBuilder.IncreaseTabLevel();
			bool flag = true;
			foreach (Panel key in _currentDescription.Keys)
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					flag = false;
				}
				else
				{
					descriptionSerializerBuilder.AppendLine(",");
				}
				Panel arg = key;
				DescriptionTreeNode tree = _currentDescription[key];
				string text = "root";
				text = getContainerName(arg);
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
				{
					text = "root";
				}
				descriptionSerializerBuilder.Append("\"" + text + "\"");
				descriptionSerializerBuilder.Append(": ");
				descriptionSerializer.SerializeTree(Context, tree, descriptionSerializerBuilder);
			}
			descriptionSerializerBuilder.AppendLine("");
			descriptionSerializerBuilder.DecreaseTabLevel();
			descriptionSerializerBuilder.Append("}");
			if (_userValues.Count > 0)
			{
				descriptionSerializerBuilder.Append(",");
			}
			descriptionSerializerBuilder.AppendLine("");
			if (_userValues.Count > 0)
			{
				flag = true;
				descriptionSerializerBuilder.AppendLine("refs: {");
				descriptionSerializerBuilder.IncreaseTabLevel();
				foreach (string key2 in _userValues.Keys)
				{
					if (CanSerializeRef(key2, _userValues[key2]))
					{
						if (flag)
						{
							flag = false;
						}
						else
						{
							descriptionSerializerBuilder.AppendLine(",");
						}
						SerializeRef(descriptionSerializerBuilder, key2, _userValues[key2]);
					}
				}
				descriptionSerializerBuilder.AppendLine("");
				descriptionSerializerBuilder.DecreaseTabLevel();
				descriptionSerializerBuilder.AppendLine("}");
			}
			descriptionSerializerBuilder.DecreaseTabLevel();
			descriptionSerializerBuilder.AppendLine("}");
			return descriptionSerializerBuilder.ToString();
		}

		private void SerializeRef(DescriptionSerializerBuilder sb, string key, object v)
		{
			sb.Append("\"" + key + "\": ");
			SerializeRefValue(sb, v);
		}

		private void SerializeRefValue(DescriptionSerializerBuilder sb, object v)
		{
			if (IsPrimitiveValue(v))
			{
				if (v is string)
				{
					sb.Append((v == null) ? "null" : ("\"" + v.ToString() + "\""));
				}
				else if (v is int)
				{
					sb.Append((v == null) ? "null" : ((int)v).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
				}
				else if (v is double)
				{
					sb.Append((v == null) ? "null" : ((double)v).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
				}
				else if (v is short)
				{
					sb.Append((v == null) ? "null" : ((short)v).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
				}
				else if (v is long)
				{
					sb.Append((v == null) ? "null" : ((long)v).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
				}
				else if (v is float)
				{
					sb.Append((v == null) ? "null" : ((float)v).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
				}
				else if (v is decimal)
				{
					sb.Append((v == null) ? "null" : ((decimal)v).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
				}
				else if (v is byte)
				{
					sb.Append((v == null) ? "null" : ((byte)v).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
				}
				else if (v is DateTime)
				{
					sb.Append("\"" + ((DateTime)v).ToString("o") + "\"");
				}
				else if (v is DateTimeOffset)
				{
					sb.Append("\"" + ((DateTimeOffset)v).ToString("o") + "\"");
				}
				else if (v is bool)
				{
					sb.Append((v == null) ? "null" : v.ToString().ToLower());
				}
				else
				{
					sb.Append("null");
				}
			}
			else if (v == null)
			{
				sb.Append("null");
			}
			else if (IsCollection(v))
			{
				sb.AppendLine("[");
				sb.IncreaseTabLevel();
				DataSourceLocalDataProvider dataSourceLocalDataProvider = new DataSourceLocalDataProvider();
				dataSourceLocalDataProvider.ItemsSource = (IEnumerable)v;
				for (int i = 0; i < dataSourceLocalDataProvider.ActualCount; i++)
				{
					if (i > 0)
					{
						sb.AppendLine(",");
					}
					SerializeDSItem(sb, dataSourceLocalDataProvider, i);
				}
				sb.AppendLine("");
				sb.DecreaseTabLevel();
				sb.Append("]");
			}
			else
			{
				object[] array = new object[1] { v };
				DataSourceLocalDataProvider dataSourceLocalDataProvider2 = new DataSourceLocalDataProvider();
				dataSourceLocalDataProvider2.ItemsSource = array;
				SerializeDSItem(sb, dataSourceLocalDataProvider2, 0);
			}
		}

		private bool IsPrimitiveValue(object v)
		{
			if (v is string)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (v is int || v is double || v is short || v is long || v is float || v is decimal || v is byte)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (v is DateTime)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (v is bool)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool IsCollection(object v)
		{
			if (v is Array)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (v is IEnumerable)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void SerializeDSItem(DescriptionSerializerBuilder sb, DataSourceLocalDataProvider lds, int index)
		{
			sb.AppendLine("{");
			sb.IncreaseTabLevel();
			IDataSourceSchema actualSchema = lds.ActualSchema;
			for (int i = 0; i < actualSchema.PropertyNames.Length; i++)
			{
				if (i > 0)
				{
					sb.AppendLine(",");
				}
				string text = actualSchema.PropertyNames[i];
				if (text.StartsWith("["))
				{
					text = text.Substring(1, text.Length - 2);
				}
				sb.Append("\"" + text + "\"");
				sb.Append(": ");
				object itemValue = lds.GetItemValue(lds.GetItemAtIndex(index), actualSchema.PropertyNames[i]);
				switch (actualSchema.PropertyTypes[i])
				{
				case DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.StringValue:
					sb.Append((itemValue == null) ? "null" : ("\"" + itemValue.ToString() + "\""));
					break;
				case DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.BooleanValue:
					sb.Append((itemValue == null) ? "null" : ("\"" + itemValue.ToString() + "\""));
					break;
				case DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.IntValue:
				case DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.LongValue:
				case DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.ShortValue:
				case DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.DoubleValue:
				case DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.DecimalValue:
				case DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.SingleValue:
				case DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.ByteValue:
					sb.Append((itemValue == null) ? "null" : itemValue.ToString());
					break;
				case DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.DateTimeOffsetValue:
					sb.Append("\"" + ((DateTimeOffset)itemValue).ToString("o") + "\"");
					break;
				case DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.DateTimeValue:
					sb.Append("\"" + ((DateTime)itemValue).ToString("o") + "\"");
					break;
				case DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.ObjectValue:
					SerializeRefValue(sb, itemValue);
					break;
				}
			}
			sb.DecreaseTabLevel();
			sb.AppendLine("}");
		}

		private bool CanSerializeRef(string key, object v)
		{
			if (v == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			Type type = v.GetType();
			if (typeof(Delegate).IsAssignableFrom(type))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

			LoadJsonHelper(json, getContainer, null, isDelta: false, skipApply: false, skipCreate: false);

		private void LoadJsonHelper(string json, Func<string, Panel> getContainer, Func<string, object> getTarget, bool isDelta, bool skipApply, bool skipCreate)
		{
			JsonDictionaryItem jsonDictionaryItem = new JsonDictionaryParser().Parse(json);
			DescriptionSerializer descriptionSerializer = new DescriptionSerializer();
			descriptionSerializer.ThrowOnMissingDescription = IsProceedOnErrorEnabled;
			descriptionSerializer.ForcePascal = ShouldForcePascal();
			Panel panel = null;
			if (!(jsonDictionaryItem is JsonDictionaryObject))
			{
				return;
			}
			JsonDictionaryObject jsonDictionaryObject = (JsonDictionaryObject)jsonDictionaryItem;
			if (jsonDictionaryObject.ContainsKey("descriptions"))
			{
				JsonDictionaryItem jsonDictionaryItem2 = jsonDictionaryObject["descriptions"];
				if (jsonDictionaryItem2 is JsonDictionaryObject)
				{
					JsonDictionaryObject jsonDictionaryObject2 = (JsonDictionaryObject)jsonDictionaryItem2;
					string[] keys = jsonDictionaryObject2.GetKeys();
					foreach (string text in keys)
					{
						JsonDictionaryItem item = jsonDictionaryObject2[text];
						Panel panel2 = getContainer(text);
						if (panel2 == null)
						{
							continue;
						}
						panel = panel2;
						bool flag = false;
						flag = true;
						if (SkipTransformingMemberPaths)
						{
							flag = false;
						}
						Func<string, string> func = ResolveCustomMemberPathTransformer();
						if (func != null)
						{
							flag = true;
						}
						DescriptionResult descriptionResult = null;
						if (IsProceedOnErrorEnabled)
						{
							try
							{
								descriptionResult = descriptionSerializer.DeserializeItem(Context, item, flag, func, skipProperties: false);
							}
							catch (Exception)
							{
								return;
							}
						}
						else
						{
							descriptionResult = descriptionSerializer.DeserializeItem(Context, item, flag, func, skipProperties: false);
						}
						if (descriptionResult.Result == null)
						{
							continue;
						}
						if (skipCreate && !States.ContainsKey(panel2))
						{
							DescriptionResult descriptionResult2 = null;
							if (IsProceedOnErrorEnabled)
							{
								try
								{
									descriptionResult2 = descriptionSerializer.DeserializeItem(Context, item, flag, func, skipProperties: true);
								}
								catch (Exception)
								{
									return;
								}
							}
							else
							{
								descriptionResult2 = descriptionSerializer.DeserializeItem(Context, item, flag, func, skipProperties: true);
							}
							RenderHelper(descriptionResult2.Result, panel2, isDelta, skipApply: true, cleanupUnusedRefs: false);
							object rootTarget = getTarget(text);
							ContainerState state = States[panel2];
							EnsureComponentsOverlay(_currentDescription[panel2], rootTarget, state, panel2);
						}
						RenderHelper(descriptionResult.Result, panel2, isDelta, skipApply, cleanupUnusedRefs: false);
					}
				}
			}
			if (jsonDictionaryObject.ContainsKey("refs") && panel != null)
			{
				JsonDictionaryItem jsonDictionaryItem3 = jsonDictionaryObject["refs"];
				if (!ProcessRefs(jsonDictionaryItem3) && jsonDictionaryItem3 is JsonDictionaryObject)
				{
					JsonDictionaryObject jsonDictionaryObject3 = (JsonDictionaryObject)jsonDictionaryItem3;
					string[] keys2 = jsonDictionaryObject3.GetKeys();
					foreach (string text2 in keys2)
					{
						JsonDictionaryItem jsonDictionaryItem4 = jsonDictionaryObject3[text2];
						if (jsonDictionaryItem4 is JsonDictionaryValue)
						{
							JsonDictionaryValue jsonDictionaryValue = (JsonDictionaryValue)jsonDictionaryItem4;
							ProvideRefValue(panel, text2, jsonDictionaryValue.Value);
						}
						else if (jsonDictionaryItem4 is JsonDictionaryArray)
						{
							JsonDictionaryArray valArr = (JsonDictionaryArray)jsonDictionaryItem4;
							object[] value = ConvertJSonArrayToObjectArray(valArr);
							ProvideRefValue(panel, text2, value);
						}
						else
						{
							object value2 = ConvertJsonObjectToObject((JsonDictionaryObject)jsonDictionaryItem4);
							ProvideRefValue(panel, text2, value2);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (jsonDictionaryObject.ContainsKey("modules") && panel != null)
			{
				JsonDictionaryItem refs = jsonDictionaryObject["modules"];
				ProcessModules(refs);
			}
			if (jsonDictionaryObject.ContainsKey("strings") && panel != null)
			{
				JsonDictionaryItem refs2 = jsonDictionaryObject["strings"];
				ProcessStrings(refs2);
			}
		}

		public void ProvideRefValueFromJson(Panel container, string refName, string json)
		{
			JsonDictionaryItem jsonDictionaryItem = new JsonDictionaryParser().Parse(json);
			if (jsonDictionaryItem is JsonDictionaryValue)
			{
				JsonDictionaryValue jsonDictionaryValue = (JsonDictionaryValue)jsonDictionaryItem;
				ProvideRefValue(container, refName, jsonDictionaryValue.Value);
			}
			else if (jsonDictionaryItem is JsonDictionaryArray)
			{
				JsonDictionaryArray valArr = (JsonDictionaryArray)jsonDictionaryItem;
				object[] value = ConvertJSonArrayToObjectArray(valArr);
				ProvideRefValue(container, refName, value);
			}
			else
			{
				object value2 = ConvertJsonObjectToObject((JsonDictionaryObject)jsonDictionaryItem);
				ProvideRefValue(container, refName, value2);
			}
		}
