		private string GetPlatformPropertyName(string propertyName, TypeDescriptionPlatform platform, TypeDescriptionMetadata propertyMetadata)
		{
			string text = propertyName;
			if (propertyMetadata != null)
			{
				text = propertyMetadata.GetPlatformName(platform);
			}
			else if (TypeDescriptionMetadata.ShouldCamelize(platform))
			{
				text = TypeDescriptionMetadata.Camelize(text);
			}
			if (text.EndsWith("Ref"))
			{
				text = text.Substring(0, text.Length - "Ref".Length);
			}
			return text;
		}

		private void EnsureComponentsOverlay(DescriptionTreeNode desc, object rootTarget, ContainerState state, Panel container)
		{
			if (!state.HasComponentObject(rootTarget))
			{
				state.AddComponent(container, _currentDescription[container].Id, rootTarget, _currentDescription[container], ProvideRefValueCore, -1L);
			}
			foreach (DescriptionPropertyValue item in desc.Items())
			{
				EnsureComponentsOverlayHelper(GetPlatformPropertyName(item.PropertyName, Platform, item.Metadata), item.Value, rootTarget, state, container, desc.Id);
			}
		}

		private void EnsureComponentsOverlayHelper(string path, object value, object rootTarget, ContainerState state, Panel container, long parentId)
		{
			if (value is DescriptionTreeNode)
			{
				DescriptionTreeNode descriptionTreeNode = (DescriptionTreeNode)value;
				object propertyValue = Adapter.GetPropertyValue(rootTarget, path);
				if (!state.HasComponentObject(propertyValue) && !state.HasComponent(descriptionTreeNode.Id))
				{
					state.AddComponent(container, descriptionTreeNode.Id, propertyValue, descriptionTreeNode, ProvideRefValueCore, parentId);
				}
				foreach (DescriptionPropertyValue item in descriptionTreeNode.Items())
				{
					EnsureComponentsOverlayHelper(path + "." + GetPlatformPropertyName(item.PropertyName, Platform, item.Metadata), item.Value, rootTarget, state, container, descriptionTreeNode.Id);
				}
			}
			if (!(value is Array))
			{
				return;
			}
			Dictionary<int, DescriptionTreeNode> nodeMap = new Dictionary<int, DescriptionTreeNode>();
			int i = 0;
			int num = ((object[])value).Length;
			object[] array = (object[])value;
			foreach (object obj in array)
			{
				if (obj is DescriptionTreeNode)
				{
					DescriptionTreeNode value2 = (DescriptionTreeNode)obj;
					nodeMap[i] = value2;
				}
				i++;
			}
			Adapter.GetPropertyValue(rootTarget, path);
			i = 0;
			Adapter.ForPropertyValueItem(rootTarget, path, delegate(object it)
			{
				if (nodeMap.ContainsKey(i))
				{
					DescriptionTreeNode descriptionTreeNode2 = nodeMap[i];
					if (!state.HasComponentObject(it) && !state.HasComponent(descriptionTreeNode2.Id))
					{
						state.AddComponent(container, descriptionTreeNode2.Id, it, descriptionTreeNode2, ProvideRefValueCore, parentId);
					}
					foreach (DescriptionPropertyValue item2 in descriptionTreeNode2.Items())
					{
						EnsureComponentsOverlayHelper(path + "." + item2.PropertyName, item2.Value, rootTarget, state, container, descriptionTreeNode2.Id);
					}
				}
				i++;
			});
			if (num <= 0 || i != 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			string actualPath = TransformToActualGetterPath(path);
			Adapter.ForPropertyValueItem(rootTarget, actualPath, delegate(object it)
			{
				if (nodeMap.ContainsKey(i))
				{
					DescriptionTreeNode descriptionTreeNode2 = nodeMap[i];
					if (!state.HasComponentObject(it) && !state.HasComponent(descriptionTreeNode2.Id))
					{
						state.AddComponent(container, descriptionTreeNode2.Id, it, descriptionTreeNode2, ProvideRefValueCore, parentId);
					}
					foreach (DescriptionPropertyValue item3 in descriptionTreeNode2.Items())
					{
						EnsureComponentsOverlayHelper(actualPath + "." + item3.PropertyName, item3.Value, rootTarget, state, container, descriptionTreeNode2.Id);
					}
				}
				int num2 = i;
				i = num2 + 1;
			});
		}

		private string TransformToActualGetterPath(string path)
		{
			int num = path.LastIndexOf('.');
			string text = null;
			string name = path;
			if (num > 0)
			{
				text = path.Substring(0, num);
				name = path.Substring(num + 1);
			}
			name = "actual" + Pascal(name);
			if (text != null)
			{
				return text + "." + name;
			}
			return name;
		}

		private string Pascal(string name)
		{
			return name.Substring(0, 1).ToUpper() + name.Substring(1);
		}

		private object[] ConvertJSonArrayToObjectArray(JsonDictionaryArray valArr)
		{
			object[] array = new object[valArr.Items.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < valArr.Items.Length; i++)
			{
				object obj = ConvertJsonObjectToObject((JsonDictionaryObject)valArr.Items[i]);
				array[i] = obj;
			}
			return array;
		}

		private object ConvertJsonObjectToObject(JsonDictionaryObject item)
		{
			if (item == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Dictionary<string, object> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, object>();
			string[] keys = item.GetKeys();
			foreach (string key in keys)
			{
				if (item[key] is JsonDictionaryObject)
				{
					dictionary[key] = ConvertJsonObjectToObject((JsonDictionaryObject)item[key]);
				}
				else if (item[key] is JsonDictionaryArray)
				{
					dictionary[key] = ConvertJSonArrayToObjectArray((JsonDictionaryArray)item[key]);
				}
				else
				{
					dictionary[key] = ((JsonDictionaryValue)item[key]).Value;
				}
			}
			return dictionary;
		}

		public void Cleanup(Panel container, bool cleanupUnusedRefs)
		{
			RenderHelper(null, container, isDelta: false, skipApply: false, cleanupUnusedRefs);
		}

		public void Render(Description description, Panel container)
		{
			RenderHelper(description, container, isDelta: false, skipApply: false, cleanupUnusedRefs: false);
		}

		private void RenderHelper(Description description, Panel container, bool isDelta, bool skipApply, bool cleanupUnusedRefs)
		{
			if (!_states.ContainsKey(container))
			{
				_states[container] = new ContainerState();
				_states[container].Container = container;
			}
			_pendingDescription[container] = description;
			_pendingDescriptionIsDelta[container] = isDelta;
			_pendingDescriptionSkipApply[container] = skipApply;
			_pendingCleanupUnusedRefs[container] = cleanupUnusedRefs;
			OnUIThread(container, delegate
			{
				RenderCore(container);
			});
		}

		private void OnUIThread(Panel c, Action p)
		{
			Adapter.OnUIThread(c, p);
		}

		private void RenderCore(Panel container)
		{
			if (!_pendingDescription.ContainsKey(container))
			{
				return;
			}
			bool isDelta = _pendingDescriptionIsDelta.ContainsKey(container) && _pendingDescriptionIsDelta[container];
			bool flag = _pendingDescriptionSkipApply.ContainsKey(container) && _pendingDescriptionSkipApply[container];
			Description description_ = _pendingDescription[container];
			_pendingDescription.Remove(container);
			DescriptionTreeNode descriptionTreeNode = DescriptionTreeBuilder.CreateTree(Context, description_);
			DescriptionTreeNode oldTree = null;
			if (_currentDescription.ContainsKey(container))
			{
				oldTree = _currentDescription[container];
			}
			List<DescriptionTreeAction> diff = DescriptionTreeReconciler.DiffTrees(oldTree, descriptionTreeNode, isDelta);
			if (flag)
			{
				DiffApplyInfo diffApplyInfo = DescriptionTreeReconciler.ApplyDiff(oldTree, diff);
				if (!_states.ContainsKey(container))
				{
					_states.Add(container, new ContainerState
					{
						Container = container
					});
				}
				ContainerState state = _states[container];
				if (diffApplyInfo.RemovedIds.Count > 0)
				{
					foreach (long removedId in diffApplyInfo.RemovedIds)
					{
						if (state.HasComponent(removedId))
						{
							object component = state.GetComponent(removedId);
							DestroyObject(container, component, state);
						}
					}
				}
				if (diffApplyInfo.NewPropertyValues.Count > 0)
				{
					foreach (DescriptionTreeAction newPropertyValue in diffApplyInfo.NewPropertyValues)
					{
						object target = GetTarget(container, state, newPropertyValue);
						object propertyValue = Adapter.GetPropertyValue(target, newPropertyValue.PropertyName);
						if (propertyValue != null && !state.HasComponentObject(propertyValue))
						{
							object newValue = newPropertyValue.NewValue;
							if (newValue is DescriptionTreeNode)
							{
								long id = ((DescriptionTreeNode)newValue).Id;
								state.AddComponent(container, id, propertyValue, (DescriptionTreeNode)newValue, ProvideRefValueCore, newPropertyValue.TargetNode.Id);
							}
						}
					}
				}
				if (diffApplyInfo.NewRootContent.Count > 0)
				{
					foreach (DescriptionTreeAction item in diffApplyInfo.NewRootContent)
					{
						object newValue2 = item.NewValue;
						if (newValue2 != null && !state.HasComponentObject(newValue2))
						{
							object newValue3 = item.NewValue;
							if (newValue3 is DescriptionTreeNode)
							{
								_ = ((DescriptionTreeNode)newValue3).Id;
								_currentDescription[container] = (DescriptionTreeNode)newValue3;
							}
						}
					}
				}
				if (diffApplyInfo.NewCollectionContent.Count > 0)
				{
					foreach (DescriptionTreeAction a in diffApplyInfo.NewCollectionContent)
					{
						object[] array = (object[])a.TargetNode.Get(a.PropertyName).Value;
						if (array == null)
						{
							continue;
						}
						Dictionary<string, DescriptionTreeNode> map = new Dictionary<string, DescriptionTreeNode>();
						foreach (object obj in array)
						{
							if (obj is DescriptionTreeNode)
							{
								DescriptionTreeNode descriptionTreeNode2 = (DescriptionTreeNode)obj;
								if (descriptionTreeNode2.Has("Name"))
								{
									map[(string)descriptionTreeNode2.Get("Name").Value] = descriptionTreeNode2;
								}
							}
						}
						if (map.Count == 0)
						{
							continue;
						}
						object target2 = GetTarget(container, state, a);
						if (Adapter.GetPropertyValue(target2, a.PropertyName) == null)
						{
							continue;
						}
						int i2 = 0;
						Adapter.ForPropertyValueItem(target2, a.PropertyName, delegate(object item)
						{
							if (map.ContainsKey(Adapter.GetPropertyValue(item, "Name").ToString()) && !state.HasComponentObject(item))
							{
								DescriptionTreeNode descriptionTreeNode3 = map[Adapter.GetPropertyValue(item, "Name").ToString()];
								if (descriptionTreeNode3 != null)
								{
									long id2 = descriptionTreeNode3.Id;
									state.AddComponent(container, id2, item, descriptionTreeNode3, ProvideRefValueCore, a.TargetNode.Id);
								}
							}
							i2++;
						});
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				_currentDescription[container] = descriptionTreeNode;
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				RenderDiff(container, diff);
			}
			if (_pendingCleanupUnusedRefs[container])
			{
				RemoveUnusedRefs(container);
				if (_states.ContainsKey(container))
				{
					_states.Remove(container);
				}
			}
		}

		public void ProvideRefValue(Panel container, string refName, object value)
		{
			OnUIThread(container, delegate
			{
				if (!_states.ContainsKey(container))
				{
					_states.Add(container, new ContainerState
					{
						Container = container
					});
				}
				_ = _states[container];
				ProvideRefValueCore(container, refName, value, isUserValue: true);
			});
		}

		public void RemoveRefValue(Panel container, string refName)
		{
			OnUIThread(container, delegate
			{
				if (!_states.ContainsKey(container))
				{
					_states.Add(container, new ContainerState
					{
						Container = container
					});
				}
				_ = _states[container];
				RemoveRefValueCore(container, refName, isUserValue: true);
			});
		}

		private void RemoveUnusedRefs(Panel container)
		{
			_ = _states[container];
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			foreach (string key in _refs.Keys)
			{
				if (_refs[key].RefCount == 0)
				{
					list.Add(key);
				}
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				bool shouldNamespaceSystemRefValues = ShouldNamespaceSystemRefValues;
				ShouldNamespaceSystemRefValues = false;
				RemoveRefValueCore(container, list[i], _userValues.ContainsKey(list[i]));
				ShouldNamespaceSystemRefValues = shouldNamespaceSystemRefValues;
			}
		}

		public void ClearRefValues(Panel container)
		{
			OnUIThread(container, delegate
			{
				if (!_states.ContainsKey(container))
				{
					_states.Add(container, new ContainerState
					{
						Container = container
					});
				}
				_ = _states[container];
				ClearUserRefValues();
			});
		}

		private void RenderDiff(Panel container, List<DescriptionTreeAction> diff)
		{
			ContainerState state = _states[container];
			ProcessActions(container, state, diff);
		}

		private void ResumeActions(Panel container, ContainerState state)
		{
			if (IsProceedOnErrorEnabled)
			{
				try
				{
					DoActions(container, state, fromSleep: true);
					return;
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
					_actionsRunning[container] = false;
					return;
				}
			}
			DoActions(container, state, fromSleep: true);
		}

		private void TryActions(Panel container, ContainerState state)
		{
			if (IsProceedOnErrorEnabled)
			{
				try
				{
					DoActions(container, state, fromSleep: false);
					return;
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
					_actionsRunning[container] = false;
					return;
				}
			}
			DoActions(container, state, fromSleep: false);
		}

		private void DoActions(Panel container, ContainerState state, bool fromSleep)
		{
			if (!fromSleep && _actionsRunning.ContainsKey(container) && _actionsRunning[container])
			{
				return;
			}
			_actionsRunning[container] = true;
			bool flag = true;
			while (flag && _queuedActions[container].Count > 0)
			{
				while (_queuedActions[container].Count > 0 && _queuedActions[container].Peek().Count < 1)
				{
					_queuedActions[container].Dequeue();
				}
				if (_queuedActions[container].Count < 1)
				{
					break;
				}
				Queue<DescriptionTreeAction> queue = _queuedActions[container].Peek();
				while (queue.Count > 0)
				{
					DescriptionTreeAction action = queue.Dequeue();
					flag = ProcessAction(container, state, action);
					if (!flag)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				_actionsRunning[container] = false;
			}
		}

		private void ProcessActions(Panel container, ContainerState state, List<DescriptionTreeAction> actions)
		{
			Queue<DescriptionTreeAction> queue = new Queue<DescriptionTreeAction>();
			for (int i = 0; i < actions.Count; i++)
			{
				queue.Enqueue(actions[i]);
			}
			if (!_queuedActions.ContainsKey(container))
			{
				_queuedActions.Add(container, new Queue<Queue<DescriptionTreeAction>>());
			}
			_queuedActions[container].Enqueue(queue);
			TryActions(container, state);
		}

		private void ProcessActionsImmediate(Panel container, ContainerState state, List<DescriptionTreeAction> actions)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < actions.Count; i++)
			{
				ProcessAction(container, state, actions[i]);
			}
		}

		private bool ProcessAction(Panel container, ContainerState state, DescriptionTreeAction action)
		{
			return action.ActionType switch
			{
				DescriptionTreeActionType.ClearItems => ProcessClearItemsAction(container, state, action), 
				DescriptionTreeActionType.InsertItem => ProcessInsertItemAction(container, state, action), 
				DescriptionTreeActionType.RemoveItem => ProcessRemoveItemAction(container, state, action), 
				DescriptionTreeActionType.ReplaceItem => ProcessReplaceItemAction(container, state, action), 
				DescriptionTreeActionType.ResetProperty => ProcessResetPropertyAction(container, state, action), 
				DescriptionTreeActionType.UpdateProperty => ProcessUpdatePropertyAction(container, state, action), 
				_ => true, 
			};
		}

		private bool ProcessUpdatePropertyAction(Panel container, ContainerState state, DescriptionTreeAction action)
		{
			object target = GetTarget(container, state, action);
			UpdatePropertyOnTarget(container, state, action, target);
			return true;
		}

		private bool UpdatePropertyOnTarget(Panel container, ContainerState state, DescriptionTreeAction action, object target)
		{
			object coercedValue = GetCoercedValue(action, container, state);
			coercedValue = Transformer.Transform(Platform, coercedValue, action);
			bool flag = false;
			if (_targetUpdatingHandlers != null && _targetUpdatingHandlers.Count > 0)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < _targetUpdatingHandlers.Count; i++)
				{
					ComponentRendererTargetPropertyUpdatingHandler componentRendererTargetPropertyUpdatingHandler = _targetUpdatingHandlers[i];
					string propertyPath = GetPropertyPath(container, action);
					if (componentRendererTargetPropertyUpdatingHandler(propertyPath, target, coercedValue))
					{
						flag = true;
					}
				}
			}
			if (action.PropertyName == "Type" || action.PropertyName == "type")
			{
				flag = true;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (action.PropertyMetadata != null && action.PropertyMetadata.KnownType == TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Collection)
			{
				SetOrUpdateCollectionOnTarget(container, state, action.GetPlatformPropertyName(Platform), action.PropertyMetadata, coercedValue, target);
			}
			else
			{
				SetPropertyOnTarget(container, state, action.GetPlatformPropertyName(Platform), action.PropertyMetadata, coercedValue, action.OldValue, target);
			}
			return true;
		}

		private string GetPropertyPath(Panel container, DescriptionTreeAction action)
		{
			DescriptionTreeNode targetNode = action.TargetNode;
			string text = "";
			if (targetNode != _currentDescription[container])
			{
				text = GetPathToNode(container, targetNode);
			}
			if (text.Length > 0)
			{
				text += ".";
			}
			return text + action.PropertyName;
		}

		private string GetPathToNode(Panel container, DescriptionTreeNode node)
		{
			if (node == null)
			{
				return "";
			}
			Tuple<bool, string> pathToNodeHelper = GetPathToNodeHelper("", _currentDescription[container], node);
			if (pathToNodeHelper.Item1)
			{
				return pathToNodeHelper.Item2;
			}
			return "";
		}

		private Tuple<bool, string> GetPathToNodeHelper(string currPath, DescriptionTreeNode currNode, DescriptionTreeNode findNode)
		{
			if (currNode == findNode)
			{
				return new Tuple<bool, string>(item1: true, currPath);
			}
			if (currPath.Length > 0)
			{
				currPath += ".";
			}
			List<DescriptionPropertyValue> list = currNode.Items();
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				DescriptionPropertyValue descriptionPropertyValue = list[i];
				if (descriptionPropertyValue.Value is DescriptionTreeNode)
				{
					if (((DescriptionTreeNode)descriptionPropertyValue.Value).Id == findNode.Id)
					{
						currPath += descriptionPropertyValue.PropertyName;
						return new Tuple<bool, string>(item1: true, currPath);
					}
					string currPath2 = currPath + descriptionPropertyValue.PropertyName;
					Tuple<bool, string> pathToNodeHelper = GetPathToNodeHelper(currPath2, (DescriptionTreeNode)descriptionPropertyValue.Value, findNode);
					if (pathToNodeHelper.Item1)
					{
						return pathToNodeHelper;
					}
				}
				if (descriptionPropertyValue.Metadata == null || descriptionPropertyValue.Metadata.KnownType != TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Collection)
				{
					continue;
				}
				object[] array = (object[])descriptionPropertyValue.Value;
				for (int j = 0; j < array.Length; j++)
				{
					if (array[j] is DescriptionTreeNode)
					{
						DescriptionTreeNode descriptionTreeNode = (DescriptionTreeNode)array[j];
						if (descriptionTreeNode.Id == findNode.Id)
						{
							currPath = currPath + descriptionPropertyValue.PropertyName + "[" + j + "]";
							return new Tuple<bool, string>(item1: true, currPath);
						}
						string currPath3 = currPath + descriptionPropertyValue.PropertyName + "[" + j + "]";
						Tuple<bool, string> pathToNodeHelper2 = GetPathToNodeHelper(currPath3, descriptionTreeNode, findNode);
						if (pathToNodeHelper2.Item1)
						{
							return pathToNodeHelper2;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return new Tuple<bool, string>(item1: false, currPath);
		}

		private bool SetOrUpdateCollectionOnTarget(Panel container, ContainerState state, string propertyName, TypeDescriptionMetadata propertyMetadata, object value, object target)
		{
			if (_updatingHandlers.ContainsKey(propertyName))
			{
				foreach (ComponentRendererPropertyUpdatingHandler item in _updatingHandlers[propertyName])
				{
					item(propertyName, target, value);
				}
			}
			Adapter.SetOrUpdateCollectionOnTarget(container, propertyName, propertyMetadata, Context, target, value);
			return true;
		}

		private object GetCoercedValue(DescriptionTreeAction action, Panel container, ContainerState state)
		{
			if (action.PropertyMetadata == null)
			{
				return action.NewValue;
			}
			return action.PropertyMetadata.KnownType switch
			{
				TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Array => CoerceToArray(action, container, state), 
				TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Boolean => CoerceToBoolean(action), 
				TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Brush => CoerceToBrush(action), 
				TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.BrushCollection => CoerceToBrushCollection(action), 
				TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Collection => CoerceToArray(action, container, state), 
				TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Color => CoerceToColor(action), 
				TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.ColorCollection => CoerceToColorCollection(action), 
				TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.DataRef => SetUpDataRef(action, state), 
				TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.DataTemplate => null, 
				TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Date => CoerceToDate(action), 
				TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.EventRef => SetUpEventRef(action, state), 
				TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.ExportedType => CoerceToExportedType(action, container, state), 
				TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.IList => null, 
				TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.MethodRef => SetUpMethodRef(action, state), 
				TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Number => CoerceToNumber(action), 
				TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Point => CoerceToPoint(action), 
				TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Rect => CoerceToRect(action), 
				TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Size => CoerceToSize(action), 
				TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.String => CoerceToString(action), 
				TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.TimeSpan => CoerceToTimeSpan(action), 
				TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Unknown => CoerceUnknown(action, container, state), 
				TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Void => null, 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		private object CoerceUnknown(DescriptionTreeAction action, Panel container, ContainerState state)
		{
			if (action.NewValue is DescriptionTreeNode)
			{
				DescriptionTreeNode descriptionTreeNode = (DescriptionTreeNode)action.NewValue;
				if (descriptionTreeNode.Type == "EmbeddedRef")
				{
					return CreateObject(descriptionTreeNode.Type, action.NewValue, container, state, skipTracking: false, action.TargetNode.Id);
				}
			}
			return action.NewValue;
		}

		private object CoerceToTimeSpan(DescriptionTreeAction action)
		{
			return TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds((double)action.NewValue);
		}

		private object CoerceToString(DescriptionTreeAction action)
		{
			if (action.NewValue == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return action.NewValue.ToString();
		}

		private object CoerceToSize(DescriptionTreeAction action)
		{
			SizeDescription sizeDescription = (SizeDescription)action.NewValue;
			return (sizeDescription == null) ? Size.Empty : new Size(sizeDescription.Width, sizeDescription.Height);
		}

		private object CoerceToRect(DescriptionTreeAction action)
		{
			RectDescription rectDescription = (RectDescription)action.NewValue;
			return (rectDescription == null) ? Rect.Empty : new Rect(rectDescription.Left, rectDescription.Top, rectDescription.Width, rectDescription.Height);
		}

		private object CoerceToPoint(DescriptionTreeAction action)
		{
			PointDescription pointDescription = (PointDescription)action.NewValue;
			return (pointDescription == null) ? new Point(double.NaN, double.NaN) : new Point(pointDescription.X, pointDescription.Y);
		}

		private object CoerceToNumber(DescriptionTreeAction action)
		{
			if (action.NewValue == null)
			{
				if (action.PropertyMetadata != null && (action.PropertyMetadata.SpecificType == "double" || action.PropertyMetadata.SpecificType == "float"))
				{
					return double.NaN;
				}
				return 0;
			}
			return action.NewValue;
		}

		internal DescriptionRef CreateRef(string name, ContainerState state)
		{
			if (_refs.ContainsKey(name))
			{
				return _refs[name];
			}
			DescriptionRef descriptionRef = new DescriptionRef(name);
			_refs.Add(name, descriptionRef);
			return descriptionRef;
		}

		private object CoerceToExportedType(DescriptionTreeAction action, Panel container, ContainerState state)
		{
			string text = action.PropertyMetadata.SpecificType;
			if (text == null)
			{
				text = action.PropertyMetadata.SpecificExternalType;
			}
			if (action.NewValue is DescriptionTreeNode)
			{
				DescriptionTreeNode descriptionTreeNode = (DescriptionTreeNode)action.NewValue;
				if (descriptionTreeNode.Has("Type"))
				{
					text = (string)descriptionTreeNode.Get("Type").Value;
				}
			}
			return CreateObject(text, action.NewValue, container, state, skipTracking: false, action.TargetNode.Id);
		}

		private object CoerceToArray(DescriptionTreeAction action, Panel container, ContainerState state)
		{
			if (action.NewValue == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			object[] array = (object[])action.NewValue;
			List<object> list = new List<object>();
			string text = action.PropertyMetadata.SpecificType;
			if (text == null)
			{
				text = action.PropertyMetadata.SpecificExternalType;
			}
			if (action.PropertyMetadata.KnownType == TypeDescriptionWellKnownType.Collection)
			{
				text = action.PropertyMetadata.CollectionElementType;
				if (text == null)
				{
					text = action.PropertyMetadata.SpecificExternalType;
				}
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				string type = text;
				if (array[i] is DescriptionTreeNode)
				{
					DescriptionTreeNode descriptionTreeNode = (DescriptionTreeNode)array[i];
					if (descriptionTreeNode.Has("Type"))
					{
						type = (string)descriptionTreeNode.Get("Type").Value;
					}
				}
				object item = CreateObject(type, array[i], container, state, skipTracking: false, action.TargetNode.Id);
				list.Add(item);
			}
			IList list2 = (IList)Activator.CreateInstance(GetObjectTypeForArray(text).MakeArrayType(), list.Count);
			for (int j = 0; j < list2.Count; j++)
			{
				list2[j] = list[j];
			}
			return list2;
		}

		protected virtual Type GetObjectTypeForArray(string specificType)
		{
			return specificType switch
			{
				"string" => typeof(string), 
				"double" => typeof(double), 
				"int" => typeof(int), 
				"object" => typeof(object), 
				"bool" => typeof(bool), 
				_ => Context.GetObjectType(specificType), 
			};
		}

		private void SetPropertyOnTarget(Panel container, ContainerState state, string propertyName, TypeDescriptionMetadata metadata, object value, object oldValue, object target)
		{
			if (value is DescriptionRef)
			{
				DescriptionRef descriptionRef = (DescriptionRef)value;
				bool flag = false;
				if (oldValue != null && oldValue is string && HasRef((string)oldValue))
				{
					DescriptionRef descriptionRef2 = GetRef((string)oldValue);
					if (descriptionRef2.Equals(value))
					{
						flag = true;
					}
					else
					{
						descriptionRef2.UnregisterValueChanged(container, target, propertyName);
					}
				}
				if (HasRefValue((DescriptionRef)value))
				{
					DescriptionRef descriptionRef3 = (DescriptionRef)value;
					if (descriptionRef3.Name != null && descriptionRef3.Name.Length > 0 && _systemValues.ContainsKey(descriptionRef3.Name))
					{
						descriptionRef3.HasSystemValue = true;
					}
					value = GetRefValue((DescriptionRef)value);
					SetPropertyValue(target, propertyName, metadata, value, oldValue, descriptionRef3);
				}
				else
				{
					Adapter.OnPendingRef(target, propertyName, metadata, (DescriptionRef)value);
				}
				DescriptionRefValueChangedEventHandler descriptionRefValueChangedEventHandler = null;
				descriptionRefValueChangedEventHandler = delegate(object rf, DescriptionRefValueChangedEventArgs args)
				{
					DescriptionRef descriptionRef4 = (DescriptionRef)rf;
					if (descriptionRef4.Name != null && descriptionRef4.Name.Length > 0 && _systemValues.ContainsKey(descriptionRef4.Name))
					{
						descriptionRef4.HasSystemValue = true;
					}
					object refValue = GetRefValue((DescriptionRef)rf);
					SetPropertyValue(target, propertyName, metadata, refValue, oldValue, descriptionRef4);
				};
				if (!flag)
				{
					descriptionRef.RegisterValueChanged(container, target, propertyName, descriptionRefValueChangedEventHandler);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				SetPropertyValue(target, propertyName, metadata, value, oldValue, null);
			}
		}

		public bool HasUserRef(string name)
		{
			return _userValues.ContainsKey(name);
		}

		internal void ProvideRefValueCore(object container, string name, object value, bool isUserValue)
		{
			object oldValue = null;
			if (isUserValue)
			{
				if (_userValues.ContainsKey(name))
				{
					oldValue = _userValues[name];
				}
				_userValues[name] = value;
			}
			else
			{
				if (ShouldNamespaceSystemRefValues)
				{
					string text = "";
					if (_namespaceLookupHandlers != null && _namespaceLookupHandlers.Count > 0)
					{
						for (int i = 0; i < _namespaceLookupHandlers.Count; i++)
						{
							text = _namespaceLookupHandlers[i](container);
						}
					}
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
					{
						name = text + "/" + name;
					}
				}
				if (_systemValues.ContainsKey(name))
				{
					oldValue = _systemValues[name];
				}
				_systemValues[name] = value;
				if (_refs.ContainsKey(name))
				{
					_refs[name].HasSystemValue = true;
				}
			}
			if (_refs.ContainsKey(name))
			{
				_refs[name].NotifyChanged(oldValue, value);
			}
		}

		public void RemoveRefValueCore(object container, string name, bool isUserValue)
		{
			object oldValue = null;
			if (isUserValue)
			{
				if (_userValues.ContainsKey(name))
				{
					oldValue = _userValues[name];
				}
				_userValues.Remove(name);
			}
			else
			{
				if (ShouldNamespaceSystemRefValues)
				{
					string text = "";
					if (_namespaceLookupHandlers != null && _namespaceLookupHandlers.Count > 0)
					{
						for (int i = 0; i < _namespaceLookupHandlers.Count; i++)
						{
							text = _namespaceLookupHandlers[i](container);
						}
					}
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
					{
						name = text + "/" + name;
					}
				}
				if (_systemValues.ContainsKey(name))
				{
					oldValue = _systemValues[name];
				}
				_systemValues.Remove(name);
			}
			if (_refs.ContainsKey(name))
			{
				_refs[name].NotifyChanged(oldValue, GetRefValue(_refs[name]));
				if (_refs[name].RefCount <= 0)
				{
					_refs[name].UnregisterAll();
					_refs.Remove(name);
				}
			}
		}

		public void ClearUserRefValues()
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			foreach (string key in _userValues.Keys)
			{
				list.Add(key);
			}
			foreach (string item in list)
			{
				RemoveRefValueCore(null, item, isUserValue: true);
			}
		}

		internal bool HasRefValue(DescriptionRef r)
		{
			if (!_userValues.ContainsKey(r.Name))
			{
				return _systemValues.ContainsKey(r.Name);
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal object GetRefValue(DescriptionRef r)
		{
			if (_userValues.ContainsKey(r.Name))
			{
				return _userValues[r.Name];
			}
			if (_systemValues.ContainsKey(r.Name))
			{
				return _systemValues[r.Name];
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal bool HasRef(string refName)
		{
			return _refs.ContainsKey(refName);
		}

		internal DescriptionRef GetRef(string refName)
		{
			return _refs[refName];
		}

		public string[] GetMissingRefs()
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			foreach (string key in _refs.Keys)
			{
				if (!HasRefValue(_refs[key]))
				{
					list.Add(key);
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		private object GetTarget(Panel container, ContainerState state, DescriptionTreeAction action)
		{
			return state.GetComponent(action.TargetNode.Id);
		}

		private bool ProcessResetPropertyAction(Panel container, ContainerState state, DescriptionTreeAction action)
		{
			object target = GetTarget(container, state, action);
			ResetPropertyOnTarget(container, state, action, target);
			return true;
		}

		private bool ResetPropertyOnTarget(Panel container, ContainerState state, DescriptionTreeAction action, object target)
		{
			Adapter.ResetPropertyOnTarget(container, action.GetPlatformPropertyName(Platform), action.PropertyMetadata, target);
			return true;
		}

		private bool ProcessReplaceItemAction(Panel container, ContainerState state, DescriptionTreeAction action)
		{
			if (action.TargetNode == null)
			{
				return ReplaceRootItem(container, state, action);
			}
			object target = GetTarget(container, state, action);
			ReplaceItemInCollection(container, state, action, target);
			return true;
		}

		private void ReplaceItemInCollection(Panel container, ContainerState state, DescriptionTreeAction action, object target)
		{
			string platformPropertyName = action.GetPlatformPropertyName(Platform);
			string text = action.PropertyMetadata.CollectionElementType;
			if (text == null)
			{
				text = action.PropertyMetadata.SpecificExternalType;
			}
			object item = CreateObject(text, action.NewValue, container, state, skipTracking: false, action.TargetNode.Id);
			Adapter.ReplaceItemInCollection(platformPropertyName, action.PropertyMetadata, target, action.NewIndex, item);
			if (action.OldValue == null || !(action.OldValue is DescriptionTreeNode))
			{
				return;
			}
			long id = ((DescriptionTreeNode)action.OldValue).Id;
			if (id >= 0)
			{
				object component = state.GetComponent(id);
				if (component != null)
				{
					DestroyObject(container, component, state);
				}
			}
		}

		private bool ReplaceRootItem(Panel container, ContainerState state, DescriptionTreeAction action)
		{
			object rootObject = Adapter.GetRootObject(container);
			if (rootObject != null)
			{
				DestroyObject(container, rootObject, state);
			}
			if (!(action.NewValue is DescriptionTreeNode))
			{
				throw new NotImplementedException();
			}
			DescriptionTreeNode node = (DescriptionTreeNode)action.NewValue;
			bool finished = false;
			Adapter.ReplaceRootItem(container, node.Type, Context, delegate(bool resumeRequired)
			{
				object rootObject2 = Adapter.GetRootObject(container);
				state.AddComponent(container, node.Id, rootObject2, node, ProvideRefValueCore, -1L);
				List<DescriptionTreeAction> actions = ToActions(node);
				ProcessActionsImmediate(container, state, actions);
				finished = true;
				if (resumeRequired)
				{
					ResumeActions(container, state);
				}
			});
			return finished;
		}

		internal void DestroyObject(Panel container, object current, ContainerState state)
		{
			long componentId = GetComponentId(container, current, state);
			foreach (DescriptionRef value in _refs.Values)
			{
				value.UnregisterAllValueChanged(current);
			}
			if (componentId != -1)
			{
				state.RemoveComponent(this, container, componentId, RemoveRefValueCore);
			}
			CleanupMethods.Cleanup(Platform, current);
		}

		private long GetComponentId(Panel container, object current, ContainerState state)
		{
			return state.GetComponentId(current);
		}

		private bool ProcessRemoveItemAction(Panel container, ContainerState state, DescriptionTreeAction action)
		{
			if (action.TargetNode == null)
			{
				return RemoveRootItem(container, state, action);
			}
			object target = GetTarget(container, state, action);
			RemoveItemFromCollection(container, state, action, target);
			return true;
		}

		private void RemoveItemFromCollection(Panel container, ContainerState state, DescriptionTreeAction action, object target)
		{
			string platformPropertyName = action.GetPlatformPropertyName(Platform);
			Adapter.RemoveItemFromCollection(platformPropertyName, action.PropertyMetadata, target, action.OldIndex);
			if (action.OldValue == null || !(action.OldValue is DescriptionTreeNode))
			{
				return;
			}
			long id = ((DescriptionTreeNode)action.OldValue).Id;
			if (id >= 0)
			{
				object component = state.GetComponent(id);
				if (component != null)
				{
					DestroyObject(container, component, state);
				}
			}
		}

		private bool RemoveRootItem(Panel container, ContainerState state, DescriptionTreeAction action)
		{
			object rootObject = Adapter.GetRootObject(container);
			if (rootObject != null)
			{
				DestroyObject(container, rootObject, state);
			}
			bool finished = false;
			Adapter.RemoveRootItem(container, Context, delegate(bool resumeRequired)
			{
				finished = true;
				if (resumeRequired)
				{
					ResumeActions(container, state);
				}
			});
			return finished;
		}

		private bool ProcessInsertItemAction(Panel container, ContainerState state, DescriptionTreeAction action)
		{
			if (action.TargetNode == null)
			{
				return AddRootItem(container, state, action);
			}
			object target = GetTarget(container, state, action);
			AddItemToCollection(container, state, action, target);
			return true;
		}

		private bool AddRootItem(Panel container, ContainerState state, DescriptionTreeAction action)
		{
			if (!(action.NewValue is DescriptionTreeNode))
			{
				throw new NotImplementedException();
			}
			DescriptionTreeNode node = (DescriptionTreeNode)action.NewValue;
			bool finished = false;
			Adapter.ReplaceRootItem(container, node.Type, Context, delegate(bool resumeRequired)
			{
				object rootObject = Adapter.GetRootObject(container);
				state.AddComponent(container, node.Id, rootObject, node, ProvideRefValueCore, -1L);
				List<DescriptionTreeAction> actions = ToActions(node);
				ProcessActionsImmediate(container, state, actions);
				finished = true;
				if (resumeRequired)
				{
					ResumeActions(container, state);
				}
			});
			return finished;
		}

		private void AddItemToCollection(Panel container, ContainerState state, DescriptionTreeAction action, object target)
		{
			string platformPropertyName = action.GetPlatformPropertyName(Platform);
			string text = action.PropertyMetadata.CollectionElementType;
			if (action.NewValue is DescriptionTreeNode)
			{
				DescriptionTreeNode descriptionTreeNode = (DescriptionTreeNode)action.NewValue;
				if (descriptionTreeNode.Has("Type"))
				{
					text = (string)descriptionTreeNode.Get("Type").Value;
				}
			}
			if (text == null)
			{
				text = action.PropertyMetadata.SpecificExternalType;
			}
			object item = CreateObject(text, action.NewValue, container, state, skipTracking: false, action.TargetNode.Id);
			Adapter.AddItemToCollection(platformPropertyName, action.PropertyMetadata, target, action.NewIndex, item);
		}

		private object CreateObject(string type, object newValue, Panel container, ContainerState state, bool skipTracking, long parentId)
		{
			if (IsPrimitiveType(type))
			{
				return newValue;
			}
			object obj = null;
			if (newValue != null && newValue is DescriptionTreeNode)
			{
				DescriptionTreeNode descriptionTreeNode = (DescriptionTreeNode)newValue;
				if (descriptionTreeNode.Has("Name"))
				{
					string text = (string)descriptionTreeNode.Get("Name").Value;
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
					{
						if (ShouldNamespaceSystemRefValues)
						{
							string text2 = "";
							if (_namespaceLookupHandlers != null && _namespaceLookupHandlers.Count > 0)
							{
								for (int i = 0; i < _namespaceLookupHandlers.Count; i++)
								{
									text2 = _namespaceLookupHandlers[i](container);
								}
							}
							if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text2))
							{
								text = text2 + "/" + text;
							}
						}
						if (_systemValues.ContainsKey(text))
						{
							obj = _systemValues[text];
						}
					}
				}
				if (obj == null)
				{
					obj = Context.CreateObject(type, container);
				}
			}
			else if (newValue != null)
			{
				obj = Context.CreateObject(type, container);
			}
			if (newValue == null)
			{
				return obj;
			}
			if (newValue is DescriptionTreeNode)
			{
				DescriptionTreeNode descriptionTreeNode2 = (DescriptionTreeNode)newValue;
				if (descriptionTreeNode2.Type == "EmbeddedRef")
				{
					string refType = "uuid";
					string text3 = null;
					for (int j = 0; j < descriptionTreeNode2.Items().Count; j++)
					{
						if (descriptionTreeNode2.Items()[j].PropertyName == "RefType")
						{
							refType = (string)descriptionTreeNode2.Items()[j].Value;
						}
						if (descriptionTreeNode2.Items()[j].PropertyName == "Value")
						{
							text3 = (string)descriptionTreeNode2.Items()[j].Value;
						}
					}
					if (text3 != null)
					{
						for (int k = 0; k < _lookupHandlers.Count; k++)
						{
							object obj2 = _lookupHandlers[k](container, refType, text3);
							if (obj2 != null)
							{
								return obj2;
							}
						}
						return null;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					state.AddComponent(container, descriptionTreeNode2.Id, obj, descriptionTreeNode2, ProvideRefValueCore, parentId);
					List<DescriptionTreeAction> actions = ToActions(descriptionTreeNode2);
					ProcessActionsImmediate(container, state, actions);
					if (skipTracking)
					{
						state.RemoveComponent(this, container, descriptionTreeNode2.Id, RemoveRefValueCore);
					}
				}
			}
			bool flag = type == "object" || type == "Object";
			if (!flag && newValue is string && type.ToLower() != "string")
			{
				return CoerceToEnum(type, (string)newValue);
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				return newValue;
			}
			return obj;
		}

		private bool IsPrimitiveType(string type)
		{
			switch (type)
			{
			default:
				return type == "String";
			case "int":
			case "Int32":
			case "short":
			case "Int16":
			case "double":
			case "Double":
			case "float":
			case "Float":
			case "Single":
			case "single":
			case "DateTime":
			case "decimal":
			case "Decimal":
			case "long":
			case "Int64":
			case "byte":
			case "bool":
			case "string":
				return true;
			}
		}

		private object CoerceToEnum(string type, string newValue)
		{
			return Context.CoerceToEnum(type, newValue);
		}

		private List<DescriptionTreeAction> ToActions(DescriptionTreeNode newValue)
		{
			List<DescriptionPropertyValue> list = newValue.Items();
			List<DescriptionTreeAction> list2 = new List<DescriptionTreeAction>();
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				DescriptionTreeAction descriptionTreeAction = new DescriptionTreeAction();
				descriptionTreeAction.ActionType = DescriptionTreeActionType.UpdateProperty;
				descriptionTreeAction.PropertyName = list[i].PropertyName;
				descriptionTreeAction.PropertyMetadata = list[i].Metadata;
				descriptionTreeAction.TargetNode = newValue;
				descriptionTreeAction.NewValue = list[i].Value;
				list2.Add(descriptionTreeAction);
			}
			return list2;
		}

		private bool ProcessClearItemsAction(Panel container, ContainerState state, DescriptionTreeAction action)
		{
			if (action.TargetNode == null)
			{
				return ClearRootItems(container, state, action);
			}
			object target = GetTarget(container, state, action);
			ClearCollection(container, state, action, target);
			return true;
		}

		private void ClearCollection(Panel container, ContainerState state, DescriptionTreeAction action, object target)
		{
			string platformPropertyName = action.GetPlatformPropertyName(Platform);
			Adapter.ClearCollection(target, platformPropertyName, action.PropertyMetadata);
			if (action.OldValue == null || !(action.OldValue is Array))
			{
				return;
			}
			object[] array = (object[])action.OldValue;
			foreach (object obj in array)
			{
				if (obj == null || !(obj is DescriptionTreeNode))
				{
					continue;
				}
				long id = ((DescriptionTreeNode)obj).Id;
				if (id >= 0)
				{
					object component = state.GetComponent(id);
					if (component != null)
					{
						DestroyObject(container, component, state);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void SetPropertyValue(object target, string propertyName, TypeDescriptionMetadata metadata, object value, object oldValue, DescriptionRef sourceRef)
		{
			if (_updatingHandlers.ContainsKey(propertyName))
			{
				foreach (ComponentRendererPropertyUpdatingHandler item in _updatingHandlers[propertyName])
				{
					item(propertyName, target, value);
				}
			}
			Adapter.SetPropertyValue(target, propertyName, metadata, value, oldValue, sourceRef);
		}

		private object GetPropertyValue(object target, string propertyName)
		{
			return Adapter.GetPropertyValue(target, propertyName);
		}

		private bool ClearRootItems(Panel container, ContainerState state, DescriptionTreeAction action)
		{
			return ClearContainer(container, state);
		}

		private bool ClearContainer(Panel container, ContainerState state)
		{
			object rootObject = Adapter.GetRootObject(container);
			if (rootObject != null)
			{
				DestroyObject(container, rootObject, state);
			}
			bool finished = false;
			Adapter.ClearContainer(container, Context, delegate(bool resumeRequired)
			{
				finished = true;
				if (resumeRequired)
				{
					ResumeActions(container, state);
				}
			});
			return finished;
		}
	}
	internal class DescriptionRef
	{
		private string _name;

		public string Name => _name;

		public int RefCount => ValueChangedTargets.Count;

		private List<RefValueChangedTarget> ValueChangedTargets { get; set; }

		public bool HasSystemValue { get; internal set; }

		public DescriptionRef(string name)
		{
			_name = name;
			ValueChangedTargets = new List<RefValueChangedTarget>();
		}

		public void RegisterValueChanged(object container, object target, string property, DescriptionRefValueChangedEventHandler handler)
		{
			ValueChangedTargets.Add(new RefValueChangedTarget
			{
				Container = container,
				Target = target,
				PropertyName = property,
				Handler = handler
			});
		}

		public void UnregisterValueChanged(object container, object target, string property)
		{
			for (int num = ValueChangedTargets.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				if (ValueChangedTargets[num].Target == target && ValueChangedTargets[num].PropertyName == property)
				{
					ValueChangedTargets.RemoveAt(num);
				}
			}
		}

		public void UnregisterValueChangedForTarget(object target)
		{
			for (int num = ValueChangedTargets.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				if (ValueChangedTargets[num].Target == target)
				{
					ValueChangedTargets.RemoveAt(num);
				}
			}
		}

		public void UnregisterValueChangedForContainer(object container)
		{
			for (int num = ValueChangedTargets.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				if (ValueChangedTargets[num].Container == container)
				{
					ValueChangedTargets.RemoveAt(num);
				}
			}
		}

		public void UnregisterAll()
		{
			ValueChangedTargets.Clear();
		}

		public void UnregisterAllValueChanged(object target)
		{
			for (int num = ValueChangedTargets.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				if (ValueChangedTargets[num].Target == target)
				{
					ValueChangedTargets.RemoveAt(num);
				}
			}
		}

		public void NotifyChanged(object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < ValueChangedTargets.Count; i++)
			{
				ValueChangedTargets[i].Handler(this, new DescriptionRefValueChangedEventArgs
				{
					OldValue = oldValue,
					NewValue = newValue
				});
			}
		}
	}
	internal class RefValueChangedTarget
	{
		public object Target { get; set; }

		public string PropertyName { get; set; }

		public DescriptionRefValueChangedEventHandler Handler { get; set; }

		public object Container { get; set; }
	}
	internal delegate void DescriptionRefValueChangedEventHandler(object sender, DescriptionRefValueChangedEventArgs args);
	internal class DescriptionRefValueChangedEventArgs
	{
		public object OldValue { get; set; }

		public object NewValue { get; set; }
	}
	internal class ContainerState
	{
		private Dictionary<long, object> _components = new Dictionary<long, object>();

		private Dictionary<object, long> _ids = new Dictionary<object, long>();

		private Dictionary<long, string> _componentNames = new Dictionary<long, string>();

		private Dictionary<long, HashSet<long>> _parentIds = new Dictionary<long, HashSet<long>>();

		private Dictionary<long, List<long>> _children = new Dictionary<long, List<long>>();

		public Panel Container { get; set; }

		public void AddComponent(object container, long id, object component, DescriptionTreeNode fromNode, Action<object, string, object, bool> provideRefValue, long parentId)
		{
			if (fromNode.Has("Name"))
			{
				_componentNames[id] = (string)fromNode.Get("Name").Value;
				provideRefValue(container, _componentNames[id], component, arg4: false);
			}
			_components[id] = component;
			_ids[component] = id;
			if (!_parentIds.ContainsKey(id))
			{
				_parentIds[id] = new HashSet<long>();
			}
			_parentIds[id].Add(parentId);
			if (parentId >= 0)
			{
				if (!_children.ContainsKey(parentId))
				{
					_children[parentId] = new List<long>();
				}
				_children[parentId].Add(id);
			}
		}

		public bool HasComponent(long id)
		{
			return _components.ContainsKey(id);
		}

		public bool HasComponentObject(object component)
		{
			return _ids.ContainsKey(component);
		}

		public object GetComponent(long id)
		{
			return _components[id];
		}

		public void RemoveComponent(ComponentRenderer renderer, Panel container, long id, Action<object, string, bool> removeRefValue)
		{
			if (_children.ContainsKey(id))
			{
				List<long> list = _children[id];
				for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
				{
					if ((!_parentIds.ContainsKey(list[i]) || _parentIds[list[i]].Count < 1 || (_parentIds[list[i]].Count == 1 && _parentIds[list[i]].Contains(id))) && _components.ContainsKey(list[i]))
					{
						renderer.DestroyObject(container, _components[list[i]], this);
					}
				}
				_children.Remove(id);
			}
			object key = _components[id];
			_ids.Remove(key);
			_components.Remove(id);
			if (_parentIds.ContainsKey(id))
			{
				_parentIds.Remove(id);
			}
			if (_componentNames.ContainsKey(id))
			{
				string arg = _componentNames[id];
				_componentNames.Remove(id);
				removeRefValue(container, arg, arg3: false);
			}
		}

		internal long GetComponentId(object current)
		{
			if (_ids.ContainsKey(current))
			{
				return _ids[current];
			}
			return -1L;
		}
	}

	[DontObfuscate]
	public delegate void ComponentRendererPropertyUpdatingHandler(string propertyName, object target, object newValue);
	[DontHide]
	[DontObfuscate]
	public delegate bool ComponentRendererTargetPropertyUpdatingHandler(string propertyPath, object target, object newValue);

	public delegate object ComponentRendererReferenceLookupHandler(object container, string refType, string id);
	[DontHide]
	[DontObfuscate]
	public delegate string ComponentNamespaceLookupHandler(object container);
	public class TypeDescriptionContext
	{
		private Dictionary<string, object> _metadataStore = new Dictionary<string, object>();

		private Dictionary<string, Func<object>> _constructorStore = new Dictionary<string, Func<object>>();

		private IComponentRendererAdapter _adapter;

		private TypeDescriptionPlatform _platform;

		private HashSet<Dictionary<string, string>> _seenMetadata = new HashSet<Dictionary<string, string>>();

		internal TypeDescriptionContext(IComponentRendererAdapter adapter, TypeDescriptionPlatform platform)
		{
			_adapter = adapter;
			_platform = platform;
		}

		internal void MarkSeen(Dictionary<string, string> metadata)
		{
			if (!_seenMetadata.Contains(metadata))
			{
				_seenMetadata.Add(metadata);
			}
		}

		internal bool HasMetadata(Dictionary<string, string> metadata)
		{
			return _seenMetadata.Contains(metadata);
		}

		internal void Register(string typeName, Dictionary<string, string> metadata)
		{
			_seenMetadata.Add(metadata);
			_metadataStore[typeName] = metadata;
		}

		internal void RegisterDescriptionConstructor(string typeName, Func<object> construct)
		{
			_constructorStore[typeName] = construct;
		}

		internal static string ToPascal(string key_)
		{
			if (key_ == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return key_.Substring(0, 1).ToUpper() + key_.Substring(1);
		}

		internal static string ToCamel(string key_)
		{
			if (key_ == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return key_.Substring(0, 1).ToLower() + key_.Substring(1);
		}

		internal string[] GetAllKeys()
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			foreach (string key in _metadataStore.Keys)
			{
				list.Add(key);
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		internal string[] GetAllProperties(string typeName)
		{
			if (_metadataStore.ContainsKey(typeName))
			{
				return new List<string>(((Dictionary<string, string>)_metadataStore[typeName]).Keys).ToArray();
			}
			return null;
		}

		[DontObfuscate]
		internal TypeDescriptionMetadata GetMetadata(string typeName, string propertyName)
		{
			if (_metadataStore.ContainsKey(typeName + "@@" + propertyName))
			{
				return (TypeDescriptionMetadata)_metadataStore[typeName + "@@" + propertyName];
			}
			if (_metadataStore.ContainsKey(typeName))
			{
				TypeDescriptionMetadata typeDescriptionMetadata = new TypeDescriptionMetadata();
				typeDescriptionMetadata.OwningType = typeName;
				typeDescriptionMetadata.PropertyName = propertyName;
				Dictionary<string, string> dictionary = (Dictionary<string, string>)_metadataStore[typeName];
				if (!dictionary.ContainsKey(propertyName))
				{
					_metadataStore[typeName + "@@" + propertyName] = null;
					return null;
				}
				string text = dictionary[propertyName];
				string value = "Unknown";
				string specificType = null;
				string specificExternalType = null;
				string collectionElementType = null;
				string[] array = text.Split(')');
				if (array.Length > 1)
				{
					string text2 = array[0];
					text = array[1];
					text2 = text2.Replace("(", "");
					string[] array2 = text2.Split(',');
					for (int i = 0; i < array2.Length; i++)
					{
						string[] array3 = array2[i].Split(':');
						string text3 = array3[0];
						string platName = array3[1];
						TypeDescriptionPlatform platform = TypeDescriptionPlatform.Angular;
						switch (text3)
						{
						case "web":
							typeDescriptionMetadata.AddMapping(TypeDescriptionPlatform.Angular, platName);
							typeDescriptionMetadata.AddMapping(TypeDescriptionPlatform.React, platName);
							typeDescriptionMetadata.AddMapping(TypeDescriptionPlatform.WebComponents, platName);
							typeDescriptionMetadata.AddMapping(TypeDescriptionPlatform.JQuery, platName);
							continue;
						case "xam":
							typeDescriptionMetadata.AddMapping(TypeDescriptionPlatform.XamarinAndroid, platName);
							typeDescriptionMetadata.AddMapping(TypeDescriptionPlatform.XamariniOS, platName);
							typeDescriptionMetadata.AddMapping(TypeDescriptionPlatform.XamarinForms, platName);
							typeDescriptionMetadata.AddMapping(TypeDescriptionPlatform.UWP, platName);
							typeDescriptionMetadata.AddMapping(TypeDescriptionPlatform.WinUI, platName);
							continue;
						case "w":
							platform = TypeDescriptionPlatform.WPF;
							break;
						case "a":
							platform = TypeDescriptionPlatform.Angular;
							break;
						case "r":
							platform = TypeDescriptionPlatform.React;
							break;
						case "j":
							platform = TypeDescriptionPlatform.JQuery;
							break;
						case "wc":
							platform = TypeDescriptionPlatform.WebComponents;
							break;
						case "xf":
							platform = TypeDescriptionPlatform.XamarinForms;
							break;
						case "xa":
							platform = TypeDescriptionPlatform.XamarinAndroid;
							break;
						case "xi":
							platform = TypeDescriptionPlatform.XamariniOS;
							break;
						case "wf":
							platform = TypeDescriptionPlatform.WindowsForms;
							break;
						case "uwp":
							platform = TypeDescriptionPlatform.UWP;
							break;
						case "winui":
							platform = TypeDescriptionPlatform.WinUI;
							break;
						}
						typeDescriptionMetadata.AddMapping(platform, platName);
					}
				}
				string[] array4 = text.Split(':');
				if (array4.Length >= 4)
				{
					collectionElementType = array4[3];
				}
				if (array4.Length >= 3)
				{
					specificType = array4[2];
				}
				if (array4.Length >= 2)
				{
					specificExternalType = array4[1];
				}
				if (array4.Length >= 1)
				{
					value = array4[0];
				}
				typeDescriptionMetadata.KnownType = (TypeDescriptionWellKnownType)Enum.Parse(typeof(TypeDescriptionWellKnownType), value, ignoreCase: true);
				typeDescriptionMetadata.SpecificExternalType = specificExternalType;
				typeDescriptionMetadata.SpecificType = specificType;
				typeDescriptionMetadata.CollectionElementType = collectionElementType;
				_metadataStore[typeName + "@@" + propertyName] = typeDescriptionMetadata;
				return typeDescriptionMetadata;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public Type GetDescriptionObjectType(string type)
		{
			return _adapter.GetDescriptionObjectType(type, this);
		}

		internal object CreateDescriptionForType(string type)
		{
			if (_constructorStore.ContainsKey(type))
			{
				return _constructorStore[type]();
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal void SetDescriptionProperty(Description desc, string key, TypeDescriptionMetadata propertyMetaData, object value)
		{
			key = ((!TypeDescriptionMetadata.ShouldCamelize(_platform)) ? ToPascal(key) : ToCamel(key));
			_adapter.SetPropertyValue(desc, key, propertyMetaData, value, null, null);
		}

		internal void SetDescriptionPropertyPascal(Description desc, string key, TypeDescriptionMetadata propertyMetaData, object value)
		{
			key = ToPascal(key);
			_adapter.SetPropertyValue(desc, key, propertyMetaData, value, null, null);
		}

		internal object CreateColorCollection(object[] colors)
		{
			return _adapter.CreateColorCollection(colors);
		}

		internal object CreateBrushCollection(object[] brushes)
		{
			return _adapter.CreateBrushCollection(brushes);
		}

		internal object CreateObject(string type, object container)
		{
			return _adapter.CreateObject(type, container, this);
		}

		internal object CoerceToEnum(string type, string newValue)
		{
			return _adapter.CoerceToEnum(type, this, newValue);
		}

		internal string[] GetEnumNames(string typeName, string propertyName)
		{
			if (_metadataStore.ContainsKey(typeName + "@@" + propertyName + "@names"))
			{
				return (string[])_metadataStore[typeName + "@@" + propertyName + "@names"];
			}
			if (_metadataStore.ContainsKey(typeName))
			{
				Dictionary<string, string> dictionary = (Dictionary<string, string>)_metadataStore[typeName];
				if (!dictionary.ContainsKey(propertyName + "@names"))
				{
					_metadataStore[typeName + "@@" + propertyName + "@names"] = null;
					return null;
				}
				string[] array = dictionary[propertyName + "@names"].Split(';');
				_metadataStore[typeName + "@@" + propertyName + "@names"] = array;
				return array;
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal bool HasNameBinding(string typeName, string propertyName)
		{
			if (_metadataStore.ContainsKey(typeName + "@@" + propertyName + "@nameBinding"))
			{
				return (string)_metadataStore[typeName + "@@" + propertyName + "@nameBinding"] == "true";
			}
			if (_metadataStore.ContainsKey(typeName))
			{
				Dictionary<string, string> dictionary = (Dictionary<string, string>)_metadataStore[typeName];
				if (!dictionary.ContainsKey(propertyName + "@nameBinding"))
				{
					_metadataStore[typeName + "@@" + propertyName + "@nameBinding"] = null;
					return false;
				}
				string text = dictionary[propertyName + "@nameBinding"];
				_metadataStore[typeName + "@@" + propertyName + "@names"] = text;
				return text == "true";
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal Type GetObjectType(string type)
		{
			return _adapter.GetObjectType(type, this);
		}
	}
	internal interface IComponentRendererAdapter
	{
		Type GetObjectType(string type, TypeDescriptionContext context);

		Type GetDescriptionObjectType(string type, TypeDescriptionContext context);

		object CreateObject(string type, object container, TypeDescriptionContext context);

		object CreateColorCollection(object[] colors);

		object CreateBrushCollection(object[] brushes);

		object CoerceToEnum(string type, TypeDescriptionContext context, string value);

		void OnUIThread(object container, Action action);

		void SetOrUpdateCollectionOnTarget(object container, string propertyName, TypeDescriptionMetadata propertyMetadata, TypeDescriptionContext context, object target, object value);

		void OnPendingRef(object target, string propertyName, TypeDescriptionMetadata propertyMetadata, DescriptionRef sourceRef);

		void SetPropertyValue(object target, string propertyName, TypeDescriptionMetadata propertyMetadata, object value, object oldValue, DescriptionRef sourceRef);

		object GetPropertyValue(object target, string propertyName);

		void ForPropertyValueItem(object target, string propertyName, Action<object> forItem);

		void ClearContainer(object container, TypeDescriptionContext context, Action<bool> continueAction);

		object GetRootObject(object container);

		void ClearCollection(object target, string propertyName, TypeDescriptionMetadata metadata);

		void AddItemToCollection(string propertyName, TypeDescriptionMetadata propertyMetadata, object target, int newIndex, object item);

		void ResetPropertyOnTarget(object container, string propertyName, TypeDescriptionMetadata propertyMetadata, object target);

		void ReplaceItemInCollection(string propertyName, TypeDescriptionMetadata propertyMetadata, object target, int newIndex, object item);

		void RemoveItemFromCollection(string propertyName, TypeDescriptionMetadata propertyMetadata, object target, int oldIndex);

		void ReplaceRootItem(object container, string type, TypeDescriptionContext context, Action<bool> continueAction);

		void RemoveRootItem(object container, TypeDescriptionContext context, Action<bool> continueAction);

		void FlushChanges(object container);
	}

	}

	[DontObfuscate]
	internal class TypeDescriptionMetadata
	{
		private Dictionary<TypeDescriptionPlatform, string> _mappings = new Dictionary<TypeDescriptionPlatform, string>();

		private Dictionary<TypeDescriptionPlatform, string> _transformNames = new Dictionary<TypeDescriptionPlatform, string>();

		public string OwningType { get; set; }

		public string PropertyName { get; set; }

		public TypeDescriptionWellKnownType KnownType { get; set; }

		public string SpecificType { get; set; }

		public string SpecificExternalType { get; set; }

		public string CollectionElementType { get; set; }

		internal void AddMapping(TypeDescriptionPlatform platform, string platName)
		{
			if (platName.Contains("/"))
			{
				string[] array = platName.Split('/');
				_transformNames[platform] = array[1].Trim();
				_mappings[platform] = array[0].Trim();
			}
			else
			{
				_mappings[platform] = platName.Trim();
			}
		}

		[DontObfuscate]
		public static string Camelize(string name)
		{
			if (name == null || name.Length == 0)
			{
				return name;
			}
			return name.Substring(0, 1).ToLower() + name.Substring(1);
		}

		internal string GetPlatformName(TypeDescriptionPlatform platform)
		{
			string text = "";
			text = ((!_mappings.ContainsKey(platform)) ? PropertyName : _mappings[platform]);
			if (ShouldCamelize(platform))
			{
				return Camelize(text);
			}
			return text;
		}

		public static bool ShouldCamelize(TypeDescriptionPlatform platform)
		{
			if (platform == TypeDescriptionPlatform.Angular || platform == TypeDescriptionPlatform.JQuery || platform == TypeDescriptionPlatform.WebComponents || platform == TypeDescriptionPlatform.React)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal string GetTransformName(TypeDescriptionPlatform platform)
		{
			if (_transformNames.ContainsKey(platform))
			{
				return _transformNames[platform];
			}
			return null;
		}
	}

	[DontObfuscate]
	public class Triangle
	{
		public int V1 { get; set; }

		public int V2 { get; set; }

		public int V3 { get; set; }
	}
	internal class HalfEdge
	{
		public int B { get; set; }

		public int E { get; set; }

		public HalfEdge(int b, int e)
		{
			B = b;
			E = e;
		}
	}
	internal class HalfEdgeSet : IEnumerable<HalfEdge>, IEnumerable
	{
		private Dictionary<HalfEdge, object> edges;

		public int Count => edges.Count;

		public HalfEdgeSet()
		{
			edges = new Dictionary<HalfEdge, object>(new EdgeComparer());
		}

		public IEnumerator<HalfEdge> GetEnumerator()
		{
			return edges.Keys.GetEnumerator();
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return GetEnumerator();
		}

		public void Add(HalfEdge edge)
		{
			edges.Add(edge, null);
		}

		public void Remove(HalfEdge edge)
		{
			edges.Remove(edge);
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			edges.Clear();
		}

		public bool Contains(HalfEdge edge)
		{
			return edges.ContainsKey(edge);
		}
	}
	internal class EdgeComparer : IEqualityComparer<HalfEdge>
	{
		public bool Equals(HalfEdge e1, HalfEdge e2)
		{
			if (e1.B != e2.B || e1.E != e2.E)
			{
				if (e1.B == e2.E)
				{
					return e1.E == e2.B;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public int GetHashCode(HalfEdge e1)
		{
			return 65536 * Math.Max(e1.B, e1.E) + Math.Min(e1.B, e1.E);
		}
	}
	internal class PointTester
	{
		public bool Complete;

		public bool Inside;

		public bool Test(double PX, double PY, double P1X, double P1Y, double P2X, double P2Y, double P3X, double P3Y)
		{
			double num = Math.Abs(P1Y - P2Y);
			double num2 = Math.Abs(P2Y - P3Y);
			double num3 = 0.0;
			double num4 = 0.0;
			if (num == 0.0 && num2 == 0.0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (num == 0.0 && num2 != 0.0)
			{
				num3 = (P2X + P1X) / 2.0;
				num4 = (0.0 - (P3X - P2X)) / (P3Y - P2Y) * (num3 - (P2X + P3X) / 2.0) + (P2Y + P3Y) / 2.0;
			}
			if (num != 0.0 && num2 == 0.0)
			{
				num3 = (P3X + P2X) / 2.0;
				num4 = (0.0 - (P2X - P1X)) / (P2Y - P1Y) * (num3 - (P1X + P2X) / 2.0) + (P1Y + P2Y) / 2.0;
			}
			if (num != 0.0 && num2 != 0.0)
			{
				double num5 = (0.0 - (P2X - P1X)) / (P2Y - P1Y);
				double num6 = (0.0 - (P3X - P2X)) / (P3Y - P2Y);
				double num7 = (P1X + P2X) / 2.0;
				double num8 = (P2X + P3X) / 2.0;
				double num9 = (P1Y + P2Y) / 2.0;
				double num10 = (P2Y + P3Y) / 2.0;
				num3 = (num5 * num7 - num6 * num8 + num10 - num9) / (num5 - num6);
				num4 = ((num > num2) ? (num5 * (num3 - num7) + num9) : (num6 * (num3 - num8) + num10));
			}
			double num11 = P2X - num3;
			double num12 = P2Y - num4;
			double num13 = num11 * num11 + num12 * num12;
			double num14 = PX - num3;
			num12 = PY - num4;
			double num15 = num14 * num14 + num12 * num12;
			Inside = num15 <= num13;
			Complete = num3 < PX && (PX - num3) * (PX - num3) > num13;
			return true;
		}
	}
	[TSWidget]
	public delegate void TriangulationStatusEventHandler(object sender, TriangulationStatusEventArgs args);
	[TSWidget]
	[HybridJavaWidget]
	public class TriangulationStatusEventArgs : EventArgs
	{
		public int CurrentStatus { get; set; }

		public TriangulationStatusEventArgs(int currentStatus)
