			CurrentStatus = currentStatus;
		}
	}
	public class Triangulator : DependencyObject
	{
		private int _count;

		private IList<double> _xColumn;

		private IList<double> _yColumn;

		private object ContextLock = new object();

		private int _status;

		private TriangulatorContext Context { get; set; }

		public int Status => _status;

		public event TriangulationStatusEventHandler TriangulationStatusChanged;

		public Triangulator(int count, IList<double> xColumn, IList<double> yColumn)
		{
			_count = count;
			_xColumn = xColumn;
			_yColumn = yColumn;
		}

		public void TriangulateAsync()
		{
			lock (ContextLock)
			{
				SetupContext();
				if (Context != null)
				{
					Context.Async = true;
				}
				ScheduleStep();
			}
		}

		public void Triangulate()
		{
			lock (ContextLock)
			{
				SetupContext();
				if (Context != null)
				{
					Context.Async = false;
				}
				ScheduleStep();
			}
		}

		private void SetupContext()
		{
			int count = _count;
			IList<double> xColumn = _xColumn;
			IList<double> yColumn = _yColumn;
			List<Triangle> result = new List<Triangle>();
			List<int> list = new List<int>
			{
				Capacity = count
			};
			HashSet<Point> hashSet = new HashSet<Point>();
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				double num = xColumn[i];
				double num2 = yColumn[i];
				if (!double.IsNaN(num) && !double.IsNaN(num2) && !double.IsInfinity(num) && !double.IsInfinity(num2))
				{
					Point item = new Point(num, num2);
					if (!hashSet.Contains(item))
					{
						hashSet.Add(item);
						list.Add(i);
					}
				}
			}
			count = list.Count;
			if (count < 3)
			{
				return;
			}
			Comparison<int> comparison = delegate(int a, int b)
			{
				if (xColumn[a] < xColumn[b])
				{
					return -1;
				}
				if (xColumn[a] > xColumn[b])
				{
					return 1;
				}
				if (yColumn[a] < yColumn[b])
				{
					return -1;
				}
				return (yColumn[a] > yColumn[b]) ? 1 : 0;
			};
			list.Sort(comparison);
			double num3 = xColumn[list[0]];
			double num4 = xColumn[list[count - 1]];
			double num5 = yColumn[list[0]];
			double num6 = num5;
			for (int num7 = 1; num7 < count; num7++)
			{
				double num8 = yColumn[list[num7]];
				if (!double.IsNaN(num8))
				{
					num5 = Math.Min(num5, num8);
					num6 = Math.Max(num6, num8);
				}
			}
			double val = num4 - num3;
			double val2 = num6 - num5;
			double num9 = Math.Max(val, val2);
			double num10 = (num4 + num3) / 2.0;
			double num11 = (num6 + num5) / 2.0;
			Point s = new Point(num10 - 20.0 * num9, num11 - num9);
			Point s2 = new Point(num10, num11 + 20.0 * num9);
			Point s3 = new Point(num10 + 20.0 * num9, num11 - num9);
			LinkedList<Triangle> linkedList = new LinkedList<Triangle>();
			LinkedList<Triangle> completedList = new LinkedList<Triangle>();
			HalfEdgeSet edgeBuffer = new HalfEdgeSet();
			PointTester pointTester = new PointTester();
			linkedList.AddFirst(new Triangle
			{
				V1 = count,
				V2 = count + 1,
				V3 = count + 2
			});
			TriangulatorContext triangulatorContext = new TriangulatorContext();
			triangulatorContext.Count = count;
			triangulatorContext.S0 = s;
			triangulatorContext.S1 = s2;
			triangulatorContext.S2 = s3;
			triangulatorContext.CompletedList = completedList;
			triangulatorContext.EdgeBuffer = edgeBuffer;
			triangulatorContext.Indices = list;
			triangulatorContext.PointTester = pointTester;
			triangulatorContext.Result = result;
			triangulatorContext.TriangleList = linkedList;
			triangulatorContext.XColumn = xColumn;
			triangulatorContext.YColumn = yColumn;
			int num12 = 1;
			if (count > 3000)
			{
				num12 = 20;
			}
			triangulatorContext.StepSize = (int)Math.Ceiling((double)count / (double)num12);
			triangulatorContext.CurrentStart = 0;
			triangulatorContext.CurrentEnd = triangulatorContext.StepSize;
			_status = 0;
			NotifyStatus();
			Context = triangulatorContext;
		}

		private void NotifyStatus()
		{
			base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(new ThreadStart(DoNotifyStatus), null);
		}

		private void DoNotifyStatus()
		{
			if (this.TriangulationStatusChanged != null)
			{
				this.TriangulationStatusChanged(this, new TriangulationStatusEventArgs(_status));
			}
		}

		public List<Triangle> GetResult()
		{
			if (Context == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return Context.Result;
		}

		private void Step()
		{
			lock (ContextLock)
			{
				if (Context == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				TriangulatorContext context = Context;
				int count = Context.Count;
				IList<double> xColumn = Context.XColumn;
				IList<double> yColumn = Context.YColumn;
				List<int> indices = Context.Indices;
				Point s = Context.S0;
				Point s2 = Context.S1;
				Point s3 = Context.S2;
				List<Triangle> result = Context.Result;
				LinkedList<Triangle> triangleList = Context.TriangleList;
				LinkedList<Triangle> completedList = Context.CompletedList;
				PointTester pointTester = Context.PointTester;
				HalfEdgeSet edgeBuffer = Context.EdgeBuffer;
				int currentStart = Context.CurrentStart;
				int currentEnd = Context.CurrentEnd;
				for (int i = currentStart; i < currentEnd; i++)
				{
					edgeBuffer.Clear();
					double pX;
					double pY;
					if (i < count)
					{
						pX = xColumn[indices[i]];
						pY = yColumn[indices[i]];
					}
					else if (i == count)
					{
						pX = s.X;
						pY = s.Y;
					}
					else if (i == count + 1)
					{
						pX = s2.X;
						pY = s2.Y;
					}
					else
					{
						pX = s3.X;
						pY = s3.Y;
					}
					LinkedListNode<Triangle> linkedListNode = null;
					for (LinkedListNode<Triangle> linkedListNode2 = triangleList.First; linkedListNode2 != null; linkedListNode2 = linkedListNode)
					{
						linkedListNode = linkedListNode2.Next;
						Triangle value = linkedListNode2.Value;
						int v = value.V1;
						int v2 = value.V2;
						int v3 = value.V3;
						double p1X;
						double p1Y;
						if (v < count)
						{
							p1X = xColumn[indices[v]];
							p1Y = yColumn[indices[v]];
						}
						else if (v == count)
						{
							p1X = s.X;
							p1Y = s.Y;
						}
						else if (v == count + 1)
						{
							p1X = s2.X;
							p1Y = s2.Y;
						}
						else
						{
							p1X = s3.X;
							p1Y = s3.Y;
						}
						double p2X;
						double p2Y;
						if (v2 < count)
						{
							p2X = xColumn[indices[v2]];
							p2Y = yColumn[indices[v2]];
						}
						else if (v2 == count)
						{
							p2X = s.X;
							p2Y = s.Y;
						}
						else if (v2 == count + 1)
						{
							p2X = s2.X;
							p2Y = s2.Y;
						}
						else
						{
							p2X = s3.X;
							p2Y = s3.Y;
						}
						double p3X;
						double p3Y;
						if (v3 < count)
						{
							p3X = xColumn[indices[v3]];
							p3Y = yColumn[indices[v3]];
						}
						else if (v3 == count)
						{
							p3X = s.X;
							p3Y = s.Y;
						}
						else if (v3 == count + 1)
						{
							p3X = s2.X;
							p3Y = s2.Y;
						}
						else
						{
							p3X = s3.X;
							p3Y = s3.Y;
						}
						pointTester.Test(pX, pY, p1X, p1Y, p2X, p2Y, p3X, p3Y);
						if (pointTester.Complete)
						{
							completedList.AddLast(value);
							triangleList.Remove(linkedListNode2);
						}
						if (pointTester.Inside)
						{
							HalfEdge edge = new HalfEdge(v, v2);
							if (edgeBuffer.Contains(edge))
							{
								edgeBuffer.Remove(edge);
							}
							else
							{
								edgeBuffer.Add(edge);
							}
							edge = new HalfEdge(v2, v3);
							if (edgeBuffer.Contains(edge))
							{
								edgeBuffer.Remove(edge);
							}
							else
							{
								edgeBuffer.Add(edge);
							}
							edge = new HalfEdge(v3, v);
							if (edgeBuffer.Contains(edge))
							{
								edgeBuffer.Remove(edge);
							}
							else
							{
								edgeBuffer.Add(edge);
							}
							triangleList.Remove(linkedListNode2);
						}
					}
					foreach (HalfEdge item in edgeBuffer)
					{
						Triangle triangle = new Triangle();
						triangle.V1 = item.B;
						triangle.V2 = item.E;
						triangle.V3 = i;
						triangleList.AddLast(triangle);
					}
				}
				if (currentEnd == count)
				{
					for (LinkedListNode<Triangle> linkedListNode3 = completedList.First; linkedListNode3 != null; linkedListNode3 = linkedListNode3.Next)
					{
						Triangle value = linkedListNode3.Value;
						if (value.V1 < count && value.V2 < count && value.V3 < count)
						{
							result.Add(new Triangle
							{
								V1 = indices[value.V1],
								V2 = indices[value.V2],
								V3 = indices[value.V3]
							});
						}
					}
					for (LinkedListNode<Triangle> linkedListNode4 = triangleList.First; linkedListNode4 != null; linkedListNode4 = linkedListNode4.Next)
					{
						Triangle value = linkedListNode4.Value;
						if (value.V1 < count && value.V2 < count && value.V3 < count)
						{
							result.Add(new Triangle
							{
								V1 = indices[value.V1],
								V2 = indices[value.V2],
								V3 = indices[value.V3]
							});
						}
					}
					_status = 100;
					NotifyStatus();
				}
				else
				{
					currentStart = currentEnd;
					currentEnd += context.StepSize;
					if (currentEnd > count)
					{
						currentEnd = count;
					}
					context.CurrentStart = currentStart;
					context.CurrentEnd = currentEnd;
					_status += (int)Math.Floor(5.0);
					NotifyStatus();
					ScheduleStep();
				}
			}
		}

		public void Cancel()
		{
			lock (ContextLock)
			{
				Context = null;
			}
		}

		private void ScheduleStep()
		{
			lock (ContextLock)
			{
				if (Context != null && Context.Async)
				{
					new Thread(Step).Start();
				}
				else
				{
					Step();
				}
			}
		}
	}
	internal class TriangulatorContext
	{
		public int Count;

		public IList<double> XColumn;

		public IList<double> YColumn;

		public List<Triangle> Result;

		public Point S0;

		public Point S1;

		public Point S2;

		public LinkedList<Triangle> TriangleList;

		public LinkedList<Triangle> CompletedList;

		public List<int> Indices;

		public HalfEdgeSet EdgeBuffer;

		public PointTester PointTester;

		public int StepSize;

		public int CurrentStart;

		public int CurrentEnd;

		public bool Async;
	}
	[DontObfuscate]
	public class TriangulationSource
	{
		private const string CRS = "LOCAL_CS[]";

		[WFSuppressWidgetMember]
		public ObservableCollection<TriangulationSourcePointRecord> Points { get; set; }

		public ObservableCollection<Triangle> Triangles { get; set; }

		[WFSuppressWidgetMember]
		public static TriangulationSource Create(int count, Func<int, Point> getXY, Func<int, float> getValue)
		{
			TriangulationSource triangulationSource = new TriangulationSource();
			ObservableCollection<TriangulationSourcePointRecord> observableCollection = new ObservableCollection<TriangulationSourcePointRecord>();
			double[] array = new double[count];
			double[] array2 = new double[count];
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				TriangulationSourcePointRecord triangulationSourcePointRecord = new TriangulationSourcePointRecord();
				Point point = getXY(i);
				num = point.X;
				num2 = point.Y;
				triangulationSourcePointRecord.Point = point;
				triangulationSourcePointRecord.Value = getValue(i);
				observableCollection.Add(triangulationSourcePointRecord);
				array[i] = num;
				array2[i] = num2;
			}
			triangulationSource.Points = observableCollection;
			Triangulator triangulator = new Triangulator(count, array, array2);
			triangulator.Triangulate();
			List<Triangle> result = triangulator.GetResult();
			triangulationSource.Triangles = ((result != null) ? new ObservableCollection<Triangle>(result) : null);
			return triangulationSource;
		}

		public static TriangulationSource LoadItf(Stream stream)
		{
			return LoadItf(new BinaryReader(stream));
		}

		public static TriangulationSource LoadItf(BinaryReader reader)
		{
			reader.ReadBytes(5);
			int num = reader.ReadInt32();
			int num2 = reader.ReadInt32();
			reader.ReadInt32();
			int count = reader.ReadInt32();
			reader.ReadBytes(count);
			TriangulationSource triangulationSource = new TriangulationSource();
			ObservableCollection<TriangulationSourcePointRecord> observableCollection = new ObservableCollection<TriangulationSourcePointRecord>();
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				TriangulationSourcePointRecord triangulationSourcePointRecord = new TriangulationSourcePointRecord();
				triangulationSourcePointRecord.Point = new Point(reader.ReadDouble(), reader.ReadDouble());
				triangulationSourcePointRecord.Value = reader.ReadSingle();
				observableCollection.Add(triangulationSourcePointRecord);
			}
			triangulationSource.Points = observableCollection;
			ObservableCollection<Triangle> observableCollection2 = new ObservableCollection<Triangle>();
			for (int j = 0; j < num2; j++)
			{
				Triangle triangle = new Triangle();
				triangle.V1 = reader.ReadInt32();
				triangle.V2 = reader.ReadInt32();
				triangle.V3 = reader.ReadInt32();
				observableCollection2.Add(triangle);
			}
			triangulationSource.Triangles = observableCollection2;
			return triangulationSource;
		}

		public void SaveItf(Stream stream)
		{
			BinaryWriter binaryWriter = new BinaryWriter(stream);
			binaryWriter.Write(new char[5] { 't', 'i', 'n', '0', '1' });
			binaryWriter.Write(Points.Count);
			binaryWriter.Write(Triangles.Count);
			int length = "LOCAL_CS[]".Length;
			int value = 21 + length;
			binaryWriter.Write(value);
			binaryWriter.Write(length);
			binaryWriter.Write("LOCAL_CS[]".ToCharArray());
			for (int i = 0; i < Points.Count; i++)
			{
				Point point = Points[i].Point;
				binaryWriter.Write(point.X);
				binaryWriter.Write(point.Y);
				binaryWriter.Write(Points[i].Value);
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < Triangles.Count; j++)
			{
				binaryWriter.Write(Triangles[j].V1);
				binaryWriter.Write(Triangles[j].V2);
				binaryWriter.Write(Triangles[j].V3);
			}
			binaryWriter.Close();
			binaryWriter.Dispose();
		}
	}

	public static class TrendCalculators
	{
		[CatchesAll]
		public static IEnumerable<double> WMA(IEnumerable<double> sequence, int period)
		{
			double[] buffer = new double[period];
			int i;
			for (i = 0; i < period; i++)
			{
				buffer[i] = 0.0;
			}
			double total = double.NaN;
			double numerator = double.NaN;
			double weightsum = double.NaN;
			double wma = double.NaN;
			i = 0;
			foreach (double item in sequence)
			{
				if (!double.IsNaN(item))
				{
					int num = i % period;
					if (i == 0)
					{
						weightsum = 1.0;
						wma = item;
						numerator = item;
						total = item;
					}
					else if (i < period)
					{
						weightsum += (double)(i + 1);
						total += item;
						numerator += (double)(i + 1) * item;
						wma = numerator / weightsum;
					}
					else
					{
						numerator = numerator + (double)period * item - total;
						wma = numerator / weightsum;
						total = total + item - buffer[num];
					}
					buffer[num] = item;
					int num2 = i + 1;
					i = num2;
				}
				yield return wma;
			}
		}

		[CatchesAll]
		public static IEnumerable<double> EMA(IEnumerable<double> sequence, int period)
		{
			int i = 0;
			double ema = double.NaN;
			double alpha = 2.0 / (1.0 + (double)period);
			foreach (double item in sequence)
			{
				if (!double.IsNaN(item))
				{
					ema = ((i >= period) ? ((item - ema) * alpha + ema) : (double.IsNaN(ema) ? item : ((ema * (double)i + item) / (double)(i + 1))));
					int num = i + 1;
					i = num;
				}
				yield return ema;
			}
		}

		[CatchesAll]
		public static IEnumerable<double> MMA(IEnumerable<double> sequence, int period)
		{
			int i = 0;
			double mma = double.NaN;
			double alpha = 1.0 / (double)period;
			foreach (double item in sequence)
			{
				if (!double.IsNaN(item))
				{
					mma = ((i >= period) ? ((item - mma) * alpha + mma) : (double.IsNaN(mma) ? item : ((mma * (double)i + item) / (double)(i + 1))));
					int num = i + 1;
					i = num;
				}
				yield return mma;
			}
		}

		[CatchesAll]
		public static IEnumerable<double> CMA(IEnumerable<double> sequence)
		{
			double cma = double.NaN;
			int i = 0;
			foreach (double item in sequence)
			{
				if (!double.IsNaN(item))
				{
					cma = (double.IsNaN(cma) ? item : ((cma * (double)i + item) / (double)(i + 1)));
					int num = i + 1;
					i = num;
				}
				yield return cma;
			}
		}

		[CatchesAll]
		public static IEnumerable<double> SMA(IEnumerable<double> sequence, int period)
		{
			double[] buffer = new double[period];
			int i;
			for (i = 0; i < period; i++)
			{
				buffer[i] = 0.0;
			}
			i = 0;
			double sma = double.NaN;
			foreach (double item in sequence)
			{
				if (!double.IsNaN(item))
				{
					double num = item / (double)period;
					int num2 = i % period;
					sma = ((i >= period) ? (sma + num - buffer[num2]) : (double.IsNaN(sma) ? item : ((sma * (double)i + item) / ((double)i + 1.0))));
					buffer[num2] = num;
					int num3 = i + 1;
					i = num3;
				}
				yield return sma;
			}
		}

		[CatchesAll]
		public static IEnumerable<double> MovingSum(IEnumerable<double> sequence, int period)
		{
			double[] buffer = new double[period];
			int i;
			for (i = 0; i < period; i++)
			{
				buffer[i] = 0.0;
			}
			i = 0;
			double ms = double.NaN;
			foreach (double item in sequence)
			{
				if (!double.IsNaN(item))
				{
					double num = item;
					int num2 = i % period;
					ms = ((i >= period) ? (ms + num - buffer[num2]) : (double.IsNaN(ms) ? num : (ms + num)));
					buffer[num2] = num;
					int num3 = i + 1;
					i = num3;
				}
				yield return ms;
			}
		}

		[CatchesAll]
		public static IEnumerable<double> STDEV(IEnumerable<double> sequence, int period)
		{
			IEnumerator<double> sma = SMA(sequence, period).GetEnumerator();
			IEnumerator<double> price = sequence.GetEnumerator();
			double[] buffer = new double[period];
			int i;
			for (i = 0; i < period; i++)
			{
				buffer[i] = 0.0;
			}
			i = 0;
			while (price.MoveNext() && sma.MoveNext())
			{
				buffer[i++ % period] = price.Current;
				double S = 0.0;
				if (i < period)
				{
					int num = 0;
					for (int j = 0; j < i; j++)
					{
						double num2 = sma.Current - buffer[j];
						S += num2 * num2;
						num++;
					}
					yield return Math.Sqrt(S / (double)num);
				}
				else
				{
					for (int k = 0; k < period; k++)
					{
						double num3 = sma.Current - buffer[k];
						S += num3 * num3;
					}
					yield return Math.Sqrt(S / (double)period);
				}
			}
		}
	}

		object ILegendContext.LegendLabel
		{
			get
			{
				if (LegendLabel != null)
				{
					return LegendLabel;
				}
				return ItemLabel;
			}
		}

		object ILegendContext.Series => Series;

		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		protected virtual void RaisePropertyChanged(string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "Series":
				BindActualItemBrush(ItemBrush, ItemBrush);
				BindActualItemOutline(ItemOutline, ItemOutline);
				break;
			case "ItemBrush":
				BindActualItemBrush(oldValue, newValue);
				break;
			case "ItemOutline":
				BindActualItemOutline(oldValue, newValue);
				break;
			}
			if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
			}
		}

		private void BindActualItemBrush(object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			if (ItemBrush == null)
			{
				if (Series is ILegendSeries && ((ILegendSeries)Series).HasMarkers)
				{
					BindingOperations.SetBinding(this, ActualItemBrushProperty, new Binding("ActualMarkerBrush")
					{
						Source = Series
					});
				}
			}
			else if (oldValue == null && newValue != null)
			{
				BindingOperations.SetBinding(this, ActualItemBrushProperty, new Binding("ItemBrush")
				{
					Source = this
				});
			}
		}

		private void BindActualItemOutline(object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			if (ItemOutline == null)
			{
				if (Series is ILegendSeries && ((ILegendSeries)Series).HasMarkers)
				{
					BindingOperations.SetBinding(this, ActualItemOutlineProperty, new Binding("ActualMarkerOutline")
					{
						Source = Series
					});
				}
			}
			else if (oldValue == null && newValue != null)
			{
				BindingOperations.SetBinding(this, ActualItemOutlineProperty, new Binding("ItemOutline")
				{
					Source = this
				});
			}
		}
	}

namespace Infragistics.Controls.Charts.Util

	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	public class LeastSquaresFit : Numeric
	{
		public static bool Test()
		{
			if (LinearTest() && LogarithmicTest() && ExponentialTest() && PowerLawTest() && QuadraticTest() && CubicTest() && QuarticTest())
			{
				return QuinticTest();
			}
			return false;
		}

		private LeastSquaresFit()
		{
		}

		public static double[] LinearFit(int n, Func<int, double> x, Func<int, double> y)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			double num3 = 0.0;
			double num4 = 0.0;
			int num5 = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
			{
				double num6 = x(i);
				double num7 = y(i);
				if (!double.IsNaN(num6) && !double.IsNaN(num7))
				{
					num += num7;
					num2 += num6 * num6;
					num3 += num6;
					num4 += num6 * num7;
					num5++;
				}
			}
			if (num5 < 2)
			{
				return null;
			}
			double num8 = (num * num2 - num3 * num4) / ((double)num5 * num2 - num3 * num3);
			double num9 = ((double)num5 * num4 - num3 * num) / ((double)num5 * num2 - num3 * num3);
			return new double[2] { num8, num9 };
		}

		public static double LinearEvaluate(double[] a, double x)
		{
			if (a.Length != 2)
			{
				return double.NaN;
			}
			return a[0] + a[1] * x;
		}

		public static bool LinearTest()
		{
			Random random = new Random();
			double[] array = new double[2];
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i] = 10.0 * random.NextDouble();
			}
			List<double> x = new List<double>();
			List<double> y = new List<double>();
			for (int j = -100; j < 100; j++)
			{
				double num = j;
				double num2 = LinearEvaluate(array, num);
				if (!double.IsNaN(num2))
				{
					x.Add(num);
					y.Add(num2);
				}
			}
			double[] array2 = LinearFit(x.Count, (int index) => x[index], (int index) => y[index]);
			for (int num3 = 0; num3 < array.Length; num3++)
			{
				Math.Abs(array[num3] - array2[num3]);
				_ = 0.0001;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static double[] LogarithmicFit(int n, Func<int, double> x, Func<int, double> y)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			double num3 = 0.0;
			double num4 = 0.0;
			int num5 = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
			{
				double num6 = x(i);
				double num7 = y(i);
				if (!double.IsNaN(num6) && !double.IsNaN(num7) && num6 > 0.0)
				{
					double num8 = Math.Log(num6);
					num += num7 * num8;
					num2 += num7;
					num3 += num8;
					num4 += num8 * num8;
					num5++;
				}
			}
			if (num5 < 2)
			{
				return null;
			}
			double num9 = ((double)num5 * num - num2 * num3) / ((double)num5 * num4 - num3 * num3);
			double num10 = (num2 - num9 * num3) / (double)num5;
			return new double[2] { num10, num9 };
		}

		public static double LogarithmicEvaluate(double[] a, double x)
		{
			if (a.Length != 2 || x < 0.0 || double.IsInfinity(x) || double.IsNaN(x))
			{
				return double.NaN;
			}
			return a[0] + a[1] * Math.Log(x);
		}

		public static bool LogarithmicTest()
		{
			Random random = new Random();
			double[] array = new double[2];
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i] = 10.0 * random.NextDouble();
			}
			List<double> x = new List<double>();
			List<double> y = new List<double>();
			for (int j = 1; j < 100; j++)
			{
				double num = j;
				double num2 = LogarithmicEvaluate(array, num);
				if (!double.IsNaN(num2))
				{
					x.Add(num);
					y.Add(num2);
				}
			}
			double[] array2 = LogarithmicFit(x.Count, (int index) => x[index], (int index) => y[index]);
			for (int num3 = 0; num3 < array.Length; num3++)
			{
				Math.Abs(array[num3] - array2[num3]);
				_ = 0.0001;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static double[] ExponentialFit(int n, Func<int, double> x, Func<int, double> y)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			double num3 = 0.0;
			double num4 = 0.0;
			double num5 = 0.0;
			int num6 = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
			{
				double num7 = x(i);
				double num8 = y(i);
				if (!double.IsNaN(num7) && !double.IsNaN(num8) && num8 > 0.0)
				{
					double num9 = Math.Log(num8);
					num += num7 * num7 * num8;
					num2 += num8 * num9;
					num3 += num7 * num8;
					num4 += num7 * num8 * num9;
					num5 += num8;
					num6++;
				}
			}
			if (num6 < 2)
			{
				return null;
			}
			double d = (num * num2 - num3 * num4) / (num5 * num - num3 * num3);
			double num10 = (num5 * num4 - num3 * num2) / (num5 * num - num3 * num3);
			return new double[2]
			{
				Math.Exp(d),
				num10
			};
		}

		public static double ExponentialEvaluate(double[] a, double x)
		{
			if (a.Length != 2 || x < 0.0 || double.IsInfinity(x) || double.IsNaN(x))
			{
				return double.NaN;
			}
			return a[0] * Math.Exp(a[1] * x);
		}

		public static bool ExponentialTest()
		{
			Random random = new Random();
			double[] array = new double[2];
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i] = 2.0 * random.NextDouble();

				if (!double.IsNaN(num2))
				{
					x.Add(num);
					y.Add(num2);
				}
			}
			double[] array2 = ExponentialFit(x.Count, (int index) => x[index], (int index) => y[index]);
			for (int num3 = 0; num3 < array.Length; num3++)
			{
				if (Math.Abs(array[num3] - array2[num3]) > 0.0001)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static double[] PowerLawFit(int n, Func<int, double> x, Func<int, double> y)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			double num3 = 0.0;
			double num4 = 0.0;
			int num5 = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
			{
				double num6 = x(i);
				double num7 = y(i);
				if (!double.IsNaN(num6) && !double.IsNaN(num7) && num6 > 0.0 && num7 > 0.0)
				{
					double num8 = Math.Log(x(i));
					double num9 = Math.Log(y(i));
					num += num8 * num9;
					num2 += num8;
					num3 += num9;
					num4 += num8 * num8;
					num5++;
				}
			}
			if (num5 < 2)
			{
				return null;
			}
			double num10 = ((double)num5 * num - num2 * num3) / ((double)num5 * num4 - num2 * num2);
			double num11 = Math.Exp((num3 - num10 * num2) / (double)num5);
			return new double[2] { num11, num10 };
		}

		public static double PowerLawEvaluate(double[] a, double x)
		{
			if (a.Length != 2 || x < 0.0 || double.IsInfinity(x) || double.IsNaN(x))
			{
				return double.NaN;
			}
			return a[0] * Math.Pow(x, a[1]);
		}

		public static double[] PolynomialFit(int n, int k, Func<int, double> x, Func<int, double> y)
		{
			double[] array = new double[1 + 2 * k];
			double[,] array2 = new double[k + 1, k + 1];
			double[] array3 = new double[k + 1];
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
			{
				double num2 = 1.0;
				double num3 = x(i);
				if (!double.IsNaN(num3) && !double.IsNaN(y(i)))
				{
					for (int j = 0; j < array.Length; j++)
					{
						array[j] += num2;
						num2 *= num3;
						num++;
					}
				}
			}
			if (num < k)
			{
				return null;
			}
			for (int l = 0; l <= k; l++)
			{
				for (int m = 0; m <= k; m++)
				{
					array2[l, m] = array[l + m];
				}
			}
			for (int num4 = 0; num4 < n; num4++)
			{
				double num5 = x(num4);
				double num6 = y(num4);
				if (!double.IsNaN(num5) && !double.IsNaN(num6))
				{
					for (int num7 = 0; num7 <= k; num7++)
					{
						array3[num7] += Math.Pow(num5, num7) * num6;
					}
				}
			}
			if (!Numeric.Solve(array2, array3))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return array3;
		}

		public static double PolynomialEvaluate(double[] a, double x)
		{
			if (a.Length < 1 || double.IsInfinity(x) || double.IsNaN(x))
			{
				return double.NaN;
			}
			double num = 0.0;
			for (int i = 0; i < a.Length; i++)
			{
				num += a[i] * Math.Pow(x, i);
			}
			return num;
		}

		public static bool PolynomialTest(int k)
		{
			Random random = new Random();
			double[] array = new double[k + 1];
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i] = 2.0 * random.NextDouble();
			}
			List<double> x = new List<double>();
			List<double> y = new List<double>();
			for (int j = -100; j < 100; j++)
			{
				double num = j;
				double num2 = PolynomialEvaluate(array, num);
				if (!double.IsNaN(num2))
				{
					x.Add(num);
					y.Add(num2);
				}
			}
			double[] array2 = PolynomialFit(x.Count, k, (int index) => x[index], (int index) => y[index]);
			for (int num3 = 0; num3 < k; num3++)
			{
				if (Math.Abs(array[num3] - array2[num3]) > 0.0001)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	[TSImportModule("igniteui-core/type", "IEnumerable$1")]
	public class Numeric
	{
		public delegate IComparable ComparableDelegate(int index);

		protected Numeric()
		{
		}

		internal static bool Solve(List<double> a, List<double> b, List<double> c, List<double> r, List<double> u)
		{
			int count = a.Count;
			double[] array = new double[count];
			if (b[0] == 0.0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			double num = b[0];
			u[0] = r[0] / num;
			for (int i = 1; i < count; i++)
			{
				array[i] = c[i - 1] / num;
				num = b[i] - a[i] * array[i];
				if (num == 0.0)
				{
					return false;
				}
				u[i] = (r[i] - a[i] * u[i - 1]) / num;
			}
			for (int i = count - 2; i >= 0; i--)
			{
				u[i] -= array[i + 1] * u[i + 1];
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static bool Solve(double[,] a, double[] b)
		{
			int length = a.GetLength(0);
			int[] array = new int[length];
			int[] array2 = new int[length];
			int[] array3 = new int[length];
			for (int i = 0; i < length; i++)
			{
				array3[i] = 0;
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < length; j++)
			{
				double num = 0.0;
				int num2 = 0;
				int num3 = 0;
				for (int k = 0; k < length; k++)
				{
					if (array3[k] == 1)
					{
						continue;
					}
					for (int l = 0; l < length; l++)
					{
						if (array3[l] == 0 && Math.Abs(a[k, l]) >= num)
						{
							num = Math.Abs(a[k, l]);
							num2 = k;
							num3 = l;
						}
					}
				}
				array3[num3]++;
				if (num2 != num3)
				{
					for (int m = 0; m < length; m++)
					{
						double num4 = a[num2, m];
						a[num2, m] = a[num3, m];
						a[num3, m] = num4;
					}
					double num5 = b[num2];
					b[num2] = b[num3];
					b[num3] = num5;
				}
				array2[j] = num2;
				array[j] = num3;
				if (a[num3, num3] == 0.0)
				{
					return false;
				}
				double num6 = 1.0 / a[num3, num3];
				a[num3, num3] = 1.0;
				for (int n = 0; n < length; n++)
				{
					a[num3, n] *= num6;
				}
				b[num3] *= num6;
				for (int num7 = 0; num7 < length; num7++)
				{
					if (num7 != num3)
					{
						double num8 = a[num7, num3];
						a[num7, num3] = 0.0;
						for (int num9 = 0; num9 < length; num9++)
						{
							a[num7, num9] -= a[num3, num9] * num8;
						}
						b[num7] -= b[num3] * num8;
					}
				}
			}
			for (int num10 = length - 1; num10 >= 0; num10--)
			{
				if (array2[num10] != array[num10])
				{
					for (int num11 = 0; num11 < length; num11++)
					{
						double num12 = a[num11, array2[num10]];
						a[num11, array2[num10]] = a[num11, array[num10]];
						a[num11, array[num10]] = num12;
					}
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static double[] SafeCubicSplineFit(int count, Func<int, double> x, Func<int, double> y, double yp1, double ypn)
		{
			List<double> list = new List<double>();
			int i;
			for (i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				for (; i < count && (double.IsNaN(x(i)) || double.IsNaN(y(i))); i++)
				{
					list.Add(double.NaN);
				}
				int j = i;
				for (; i < count && !double.IsNaN(x(i)) && !double.IsNaN(y(i)); i++)
				{
				}
				i--;
				if (i - j > 0)
				{
					list.AddRange(CubicSplineFit(j, i - j + 1, x, y, yp1, ypn));
				}
				else
				{
					for (; j <= i; j++)
					{
						list.Add(double.NaN);
					}
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		public static double[] CubicSplineFit(int start, int count, Func<int, double> x, Func<int, double> y, double yp1, double ypn)
		{
			return CubicSplineFit(count, (int i) => x(i + start), (int i) => y(i + start), yp1, ypn);
		}

		public static double[] CubicSplineFit(int count, Func<int, double> x, Func<int, double> y, double yp1, double ypn)
		{
			double[] array = new double[count - 1];
			double[] array2 = new double[count];
			array2[0] = (double.IsNaN(yp1) ? 0.0 : (-0.5));
			array[0] = (double.IsNaN(yp1) ? 0.0 : (3.0 / (x(1) - x(0)) * ((y(1) - y(0)) / (x(1) - x(0)) - yp1)));
			for (int i = 1; i < count - 1; i++)
			{
				double num = (x(i) - x(i - 1)) / (x(i + 1) - x(i - 1));
				double num2 = num * array2[i - 1] + 2.0;
				array2[i] = (num - 1.0) / num2;
				array[i] = (y(i + 1) - y(i)) / (x(i + 1) - x(i)) - (y(i) - y(i - 1)) / (x(i) - x(i - 1));
				array[i] = (6.0 * array[i] / (x(i + 1) - x(i - 1)) - num * array[i - 1]) / num2;
			}
			double num3 = (double.IsNaN(ypn) ? 0.0 : 0.5);
			double num4 = (double.IsNaN(ypn) ? 0.0 : (3.0 / (x(count - 1) - x(count - 2)) * (ypn - (y(count - 1) - y(count - 2)) / (x(count - 1) - x(count - 2)))));
			array2[count - 1] = (num4 - num3 * array[count - 2]) / (num3 * array2[count - 2] + 1.0);
			for (int num5 = count - 2; num5 >= 0; num5--)
			{
				array2[num5] = array2[num5] * array2[num5 + 1] + array[num5];
			}
			return array2;
		}

		public double CubicSplineEvaluate(double x, double x1, double y1, double x2, double y2, double u1, double u2)
		{
			double num = x2 - x1;
			double num2 = (x2 - x) / num;
			double num3 = (x - x1) / num;
			return num2 * y1 + num3 * y2 + ((num2 * num2 * num2 - num2) * u1 + (num3 * num3 * num3 - num3) * u2) * (num * num) / 6.0;
		}

		public static PathFigureCollection Spline2D(int count, Func<int, double> x, Func<int, double> y, double stiffness)
		{
			PathFigureCollection pathFigureCollection = new PathFigureCollection();
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = -1;
			double d = double.NaN;
			double d2 = double.NaN;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				d = x(i);
				d2 = y(i);
				if (double.IsNaN(d) || double.IsNaN(d2))
				{
					num2 = i - 1;
					if (num2 - num > 0)
					{
						pathFigureCollection.Add(Spline2D(num, num2, x, y, stiffness));
					}
					num = i + 1;
				}
			}
			if (!double.IsNaN(d) && !double.IsNaN(d2))
			{
				num2 = count - 1;
			}
			if (num2 - num > 0)
			{
				pathFigureCollection.Add(Spline2D(num, num2, x, y, stiffness));
			}
			return pathFigureCollection;
		}

		public static PathFigure Spline2D([SwiftMutableParameter] int startIndex, int endIndex, Func<int, double> x, Func<int, double> y, [SwiftMutableParameter] double stiffness)
		{
			stiffness = 0.5 * MathUtil.Clamp(double.IsNaN(stiffness) ? 0.5 : stiffness, 0.0, 1.0);
			PathFigure pathFigure = new PathFigure();
			int num = endIndex - startIndex + 1;
			if (num < 2)
			{
				return pathFigure;
			}
			if (num == 2)
			{
				pathFigure.StartPoint = new Point(x(startIndex), y(startIndex));
				LineSegment value = new LineSegment
				{
					Point = new Point(x(startIndex + 1), y(startIndex + 1))
				};
				pathFigure.Segments.Add(value);
				return pathFigure;
			}
			PolyBezierSegment polyBezierSegment = new PolyBezierSegment();
			double num2 = x(startIndex);
			double num3 = y(startIndex);
			double num4 = x(startIndex + 1);
			double num5 = y(startIndex + 1);
			while (num4 == num2 && num5 == num3 && startIndex + 1 <= endIndex)
			{
				startIndex++;
				num4 = x(startIndex + 1);
				num5 = y(startIndex + 1);
			}
			double num6 = num4 - num2;
			double num7 = num5 - num3;
			double num8 = Math.Sqrt(num6 * num6 + num7 * num7);
			for (int i = startIndex + 1; i < endIndex; i++)
			{
				double num9 = x(i);
				double num10 = y(i);
				if (num9 != num2 || num10 != num3)
				{
					double num11 = x(i + 1) - x(i - 1);
					double num12 = y(i + 1) - y(i - 1);
					double num13 = num11 * num11 + num12 * num12;
					if (num13 < 0.01)
					{
						num11 = 0.0 - (y(i + 1) - y(i));
						num12 = x(i + 1) - x(i);
						num13 = num11 * num11 + num12 * num12;
					}
					num13 = Math.Sqrt(num13);
					double num14 = stiffness * Math.Sqrt((num9 - num2) * (num9 - num2) + (num10 - num3) * (num10 - num3));
					if (num13 > 0.01)
					{
						polyBezierSegment.Points.Add(new Point(num2 + num6 * num14 / num8, num3 + num7 * num14 / num8));
						polyBezierSegment.Points.Add(new Point(num9 - num11 * num14 / num13, num10 - num12 * num14 / num13));
						polyBezierSegment.Points.Add(new Point(num9, num10));
						num2 = num9;
						num3 = num10;
						num6 = num11;
						num7 = num12;
						num8 = num13;
					}
				}
			}
			double num15 = x(endIndex);
			double num16 = y(endIndex);
			if (num15 != num2 || num16 != num3)
			{
				double num17 = x(endIndex) - x(endIndex - 1);
				double num18 = y(endIndex) - y(endIndex - 1);
				double num19 = num17 * num17 + num18 * num18;
				double num20 = stiffness * Math.Sqrt((num15 - num2) * (num15 - num2) + (num16 - num3) * (num16 - num3));
				polyBezierSegment.Points.Add(new Point(num2 + num6 * num20 / num8, num3 + num7 * num20 / num8));
				polyBezierSegment.Points.Add(new Point(num15 - num17 * num20 / num19, num16 - num18 * num20 / num19));
				polyBezierSegment.Points.Add(new Point(num15, num16));
			}
			pathFigure.StartPoint = new Point(x(startIndex), y(startIndex));
			pathFigure.Segments.Add(polyBezierSegment);
			return pathFigure;
		}
	}

		private void OnCreateDataSeriesAdapter()
		{
			Implementation.ExternalObject = this;
			SetValue(DataSeriesProperty, new DataSeriesCollection(Implementation.DataSeries));
			SetValue(RulesProperty, new DataSeriesAdapterRuleCollection(Implementation.Rules));
		}

		private void _DataSeriesAdapterImplementation_PropertyChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs args)
		{
			string propertyName = args.PropertyName;
			if (propertyName == DataSeriesAdapterCurrentlyWritingPropertyName)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!(propertyName == "ItemsSource"))
			{
				if (propertyName == "SupportedSeriesTypes")
				{
					SupportedSeriesTypes = _DataSeriesAdapterImplementation.SupportedSeriesTypes;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				ItemsSource = _DataSeriesAdapterImplementation.ItemsSource;
			}
		}

		public void Refresh()
		{
			_DataSeriesAdapterImplementation.Refresh();
		}

		IDataSourceLocalDataProvider IExternalDataSeriesAdapter.GetDataProvider(object itemsSource)
		{
			return new DataSourceLocalDataProvider
			{
				ItemsSource = (itemsSource as IEnumerable)
			};
		}
	}

	public class DataSeriesCollection : ObservableCollection<DataSeries>
	{
		private bool _ignoreExternalChanges;

		private bool _ignoreInternalChanges;

		internal Infragistics.Controls.Charts.DataAdapters.Implementation.DataSeriesCollection Inner { get; set; }

		internal DataSeriesCollection(Infragistics.Controls.Charts.DataAdapters.Implementation.DataSeriesCollection inner)
		{
			Inner = inner;
			Inner.CollectionChanged += Inner_CollectionChanged;
		}

		private void Inner_CollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (_ignoreInternalChanges)
			{
				return;
			}
			_ignoreExternalChanges = true;
			switch (e.Action)
			{
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add:
				if (e.NewItems != null)
				{
					for (int l = 0; l < e.NewItems.Count; l++)
					{
						Insert(l + e.NewStartingIndex, (DataSeries)e.NewItems[l]);
					}
				}
				break;
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove:
				if (e.OldItems != null)
				{
					for (int k = 0; k < e.OldItems.Count; k++)
					{
						RemoveAt(e.OldStartingIndex);
					}
				}
				break;
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace:
				if (e.OldItems != null)
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < e.OldItems.Count; i++)
					{
						RemoveAt(e.OldStartingIndex);
					}
				}
				if (e.NewItems != null)
				{
					for (int j = 0; j < e.NewItems.Count; j++)
					{
						Insert(j + e.NewStartingIndex, (DataSeries)e.NewItems[j]);
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			_ignoreExternalChanges = false;
		}

		protected override void ClearItems()
		{
			if (!_ignoreExternalChanges)
			{
				_ignoreInternalChanges = true;
				Inner.Clear();
				_ignoreInternalChanges = false;
			}
			base.ClearItems();
		}

		protected override void InsertItem(int index, DataSeries item)
		{
			base.InsertItem(index, item);
			if (!_ignoreExternalChanges)
			{
				_ignoreInternalChanges = true;
				if (item == null)
				{
					Inner.Insert(index, null);
				}
				else
				{
					Inner.Insert(index, item);
				}
				_ignoreInternalChanges = false;
			}
		}

		protected override void RemoveItem(int index)
		{
			base.RemoveItem(index);
			if (!_ignoreExternalChanges)
			{
				_ignoreInternalChanges = true;
				Inner.RemoveAt(index);
				_ignoreInternalChanges = false;
			}
		}

		protected override void SetItem(int index, DataSeries item)
		{
			base.SetItem(index, item);
			if (!_ignoreExternalChanges)
			{
				_ignoreInternalChanges = true;
				if (item == null)
				{
					Inner[index] = null;
				}
				else
				{
					Inner[index] = item;
				}
				_ignoreInternalChanges = false;
			}
		}

		protected override void MoveItem(int oldIndex, int newIndex)
		{
			base.MoveItem(oldIndex, newIndex);
			if (!_ignoreExternalChanges)
			{
				_ignoreInternalChanges = true;
				Inner.Move(oldIndex, newIndex);
				_ignoreInternalChanges = false;
			}
		}
	}
	public class DataSeriesAdapterRuleCollection : ObservableCollection<IDataSeriesAdapterRule>
	{
		private bool _ignoreExternalChanges;

		private bool _ignoreInternalChanges;

		internal Infragistics.Controls.Charts.DataAdapters.Implementation.DataSeriesAdapterRuleCollection Inner { get; set; }

		internal DataSeriesAdapterRuleCollection(Infragistics.Controls.Charts.DataAdapters.Implementation.DataSeriesAdapterRuleCollection inner)
		{
			Inner = inner;
			Inner.CollectionChanged += Inner_CollectionChanged;
		}

		private void Inner_CollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (_ignoreInternalChanges)
			{
				return;
			}
			_ignoreExternalChanges = true;
			switch (e.Action)
			{
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add:
				if (e.NewItems != null)
				{
					for (int l = 0; l < e.NewItems.Count; l++)
					{
						Insert(l + e.NewStartingIndex, (IDataSeriesAdapterRule)e.NewItems[l]);
					}
				}
				break;
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove:
				if (e.OldItems != null)
				{
					for (int k = 0; k < e.OldItems.Count; k++)
					{
						RemoveAt(e.OldStartingIndex);
					}
				}
				break;
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace:
				if (e.OldItems != null)
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < e.OldItems.Count; i++)
					{
						RemoveAt(e.OldStartingIndex);
					}
				}
				if (e.NewItems != null)
				{
					for (int j = 0; j < e.NewItems.Count; j++)
					{
						Insert(j + e.NewStartingIndex, (IDataSeriesAdapterRule)e.NewItems[j]);
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			_ignoreExternalChanges = false;
		}

		protected override void ClearItems()
		{
			if (!_ignoreExternalChanges)
			{
				_ignoreInternalChanges = true;
				Inner.Clear();
				_ignoreInternalChanges = false;
			}
			base.ClearItems();
		}

		protected override void InsertItem(int index, IDataSeriesAdapterRule item)
		{
			base.InsertItem(index, item);
			if (!_ignoreExternalChanges)
			{
				_ignoreInternalChanges = true;
				if (item == null)
				{
					Inner.Insert(index, null);
				}
				else
				{
					Inner.Insert(index, item);
				}
				_ignoreInternalChanges = false;
			}
		}

		protected override void RemoveItem(int index)
		{
			base.RemoveItem(index);
			if (!_ignoreExternalChanges)
			{
				_ignoreInternalChanges = true;
				Inner.RemoveAt(index);
				_ignoreInternalChanges = false;
			}
		}

		protected override void SetItem(int index, IDataSeriesAdapterRule item)
		{
			base.SetItem(index, item);
			if (!_ignoreExternalChanges)
			{
				_ignoreInternalChanges = true;
				if (item == null)
				{
					Inner[index] = null;
				}
				else
				{
					Inner[index] = item;
				}
				_ignoreInternalChanges = false;
			}
		}

		protected override void MoveItem(int oldIndex, int newIndex)
		{
			base.MoveItem(oldIndex, newIndex);
			if (!_ignoreExternalChanges)
			{
				_ignoreInternalChanges = true;
				Inner.Move(oldIndex, newIndex);
				_ignoreInternalChanges = false;
			}
		}
	}

	public interface IDataSeriesAdapterRule

	[DontHide]
	[DontObfuscate]
	public class DataSeriesAdapterRunContext
	{
		private Infragistics.Controls.Charts.DataAdapters.Implementation.DataSeriesCollection _dataSeries;

		private Stack<IDataSourceLocalDataProvider> _dataSources;

		private Stack<string> _paths;

		private Stack<string> _parentTitles;

		private string[] _includedProperties;

		private string[] _excludedProeprties;

		private HashSet<DataSeriesType> _supportedSeriesMap;

		private Infragistics.Controls.Charts.DataAdapters.Implementation.DataSeriesAdapter Owner { get; set; }

		public DataSeriesDataProviderAnalyzer Analyzer { get; set; }

		public string[] IncludedProperties => _includedProperties;

		public string[] ExcludedProperties => _excludedProeprties;

		internal DataSeriesAdapterRunContext(object owner)
		{
			Owner = (Infragistics.Controls.Charts.DataAdapters.Implementation.DataSeriesAdapter)owner;
			Analyzer = new DataSeriesDataProviderAnalyzer(this);
			Analyzer.IncludedProperties = Owner.IncludedProperties;
			Analyzer.ExcludedProperties = Owner.ExcludedProperties;
			_dataSeries = new Infragistics.Controls.Charts.DataAdapters.Implementation.DataSeriesCollection();
			_dataSources = new Stack<IDataSourceLocalDataProvider>();
			_paths = new Stack<string>();
			_parentTitles = new Stack<string>();
			_includedProperties = Owner.IncludedProperties;
			_excludedProeprties = Owner.ExcludedProperties;
			_supportedSeriesMap = null;
			if (Owner.SupportedSeriesTypes != null)
			{
				_supportedSeriesMap = new HashSet<DataSeriesType>();
				for (int i = 0; i < Owner.SupportedSeriesTypes.Length; i++)
				{
					_supportedSeriesMap.Add(Owner.SupportedSeriesTypes[i]);
				}
			}
		}

		public IDataSourceLocalDataProvider GetSubProvider(object itemsSource, string path)
		{
			IDataSourceLocalDataProvider provider = Owner.GetProvider(itemsSource);
			PushDataSource(provider);
			PushPath(path);
			return provider;
		}

		public void PopSubProvider()
		{
			PopDataSource();
			PopPath();
		}

		internal string Localize(string localizationId, string defaultString)
		{
			return Owner.Localize(localizationId, defaultString);
		}

		public void RecurseRules(object subDataSource, string subPath, bool listenForSubPathChanges)
		{
			Owner.RecurseRules(this, subDataSource, subPath, listenForSubPathChanges);
		}

		public IDataSourceLocalDataProvider GetCurrentDataSource()
		{
			return _dataSources.Peek();
		}

		public void PushDataSource(IDataSourceLocalDataProvider dataSource)
		{
			_dataSources.Push(dataSource);
		}

		public bool HasValidType(DataSeries dataSeries)
		{
			if (_supportedSeriesMap == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (_supportedSeriesMap.Contains(dataSeries.SuggestedSeries))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public object PopDataSource()
		{
			return _dataSources.Pop();
		}

		public string GetCurrentPathSegment()
		{
			return _paths.Peek();
		}

		public string GetCurrentPath()
		{
			string text = "";
			bool flag = true;
			foreach (string path in _paths)
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					flag = false;
				}
				else
				{
					text += ".";
				}
				text += path;
			}
			return text;
		}

		public string GetParentTitle()
		{
			if (_parentTitles.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return _parentTitles.Peek();
		}

		public void PushPath(string path)
		{
			_paths.Push(path);
		}

		public object PopPath()
		{
			return _paths.Pop();
		}

		public void PushParentTitle(string parentTitle)
		{
			_parentTitles.Push(parentTitle);
		}

		public object PopParentTitle()
		{
			return _parentTitles.Pop();
		}

		private void PopulateDataSeries(DataSeries dataSeries, IDataSeriesAdapterRule rule)
		{
			if (dataSeries.Priority == -1)
			{
				dataSeries.Priority = rule.Priority;
			}
			if (dataSeries.DataPath == null)
			{
				dataSeries.DataPath = GetCurrentPath();
			}
			if (dataSeries.Data == null)
			{
				dataSeries.Data = GetCurrentDataSource().ItemsSource;
			}
		}

		public void AddDataSeries(DataSeries dataSeries, IDataSeriesAdapterRule rule)
		{
			PopulateDataSeries(dataSeries, rule);
			_dataSeries.Add(dataSeries);
		}

		public void RemoveDataSeries(DataSeries dataSeries)
		{
			_dataSeries.Remove(dataSeries);
		}

		public void InsertDataSeries(int index, DataSeries dataSeries, IDataSeriesAdapterRule rule)
		{
			PopulateDataSeries(dataSeries, rule);
			_dataSeries.Insert(index, dataSeries);
		}

		public void ClearDataSeries()
		{
			_dataSeries.Clear();
		}

		public int GetDataSeriesCount()
		{
			return _dataSeries.Count;
		}

		public DataSeries GetDataSeriesAt(int index)
		{
			return _dataSeries[index];
		}
	}
	[DontHide]
	[DontObfuscate]
	public class DataSeriesDataProviderAnalyzer
	{
		private string[] _includedProperties;

		private string[] _excludedProperties;

		private bool _hasInclusions;

		private bool _hasExclusions;

		private HashSet<string> _includedPropertiesSet = new HashSet<string>();

		private List<Matcher> _includedPropertiesMatchers = new List<Matcher>();

		private HashSet<string> _excludedPropertiesSet = new HashSet<string>();

		private List<Matcher> _excludedPropertiesMatchers = new List<Matcher>();

		internal DataSeriesAdapterRunContext Owner { get; set; }

		public string[] IncludedProperties
		{
			get
			{
				return _includedProperties;
			}
			internal set
			{
				_includedProperties = value;
				_includedPropertiesSet.Clear();
				if (_includedProperties == null)
				{
					_hasInclusions = false;
					return;
				}
				_hasInclusions = true;
				string[] includedProperties = _includedProperties;
				foreach (string text in includedProperties)
				{
					if (Matcher.IsPattern(text))
					{
						_includedPropertiesMatchers.Add(new Matcher(text));
					}
					else
					{
						_includedPropertiesSet.Add(text);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public string[] ExcludedProperties
		{
			get
			{
				return _excludedProperties;
			}
			internal set
			{
				_excludedProperties = value;
				_excludedPropertiesSet.Clear();
				if (_excludedProperties == null)
				{
					_hasExclusions = false;
					return;
				}
				_hasExclusions = true;
				string[] excludedProperties = _excludedProperties;
				foreach (string text in excludedProperties)
				{
					if (Matcher.IsPattern(text))
					{
						_excludedPropertiesMatchers.Add(new Matcher(text));
					}
					else
					{
						_excludedPropertiesSet.Add(text);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal DataSeriesDataProviderAnalyzer(DataSeriesAdapterRunContext owner)
		{
			Owner = owner;
		}

		public string GetParentTitle()
		{
			return Owner.GetParentTitle();
		}

		public bool ShouldIncludeProperty(string property, string path)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(path))
			{
				property = path + "." + property;
			}
			if (_hasInclusions && !_includedPropertiesSet.Contains(property) && !InclusionMatches(property))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_hasExclusions && (_excludedPropertiesSet.Contains(property) || ExclusionMatches(property)))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool ExclusionMatches(string property)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < _excludedPropertiesMatchers.Count; i++)
			{
				if (_excludedPropertiesMatchers[i].Match(property))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool InclusionMatches(string property)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < _includedPropertiesMatchers.Count; i++)
			{
				if (_includedPropertiesMatchers[i].Match(property))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public string ExpandCamelCasedWords(string value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			value = value.Replace("[", "").Replace("]", "");
			List<char> list = new List<char>();
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < value.Length; i++)
			{
				char c = value[i];
				char c2 = char.ToUpper(c);
				char c3 = char.ToLower(c);
				if (i == 0)
				{
					c = c2;
				}
				bool flag = num == 0 && list.Count > 0;
				bool flag2 = num > 1;
				if (c2 == c)
				{
					if (flag)
					{
						list.Add(' ');
					}
					num++;
				}
				else if (c3 == c)
				{
					if (flag2)
					{
						list.Insert(list.Count - 1, ' ');
					}
					num = 0;
				}
				else
				{
					num = 0;
				}
				list.Add(c);
			}
			string text = string.Empty;
			for (int j = 0; j < list.Count; j++)
			{
				text += list[j];
			}
			return text;
		}

		public bool HasStringProperties()
		{
			return GetAllStringProperties().Length != 0;
		}

		public string[] GetAllStringProperties()
		{
			return GetMatchingProperties((DataSourceSchemaPropertyType p) => p == DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.StringValue, null);
		}

		public bool IsCollection(object item)
		{
			if (item is IEnumerable || item is Array)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public string[] GetAllPropertiesWithName(string name)
		{
			return GetMatchingProperties(null, (string n) => n == name);
		}

		public string[] GetAllNumericProperties()
		{
			return GetMatchingProperties(IsNumericType, null);
		}

		public string[] GetAllObjectProperties()
		{
			return GetMatchingProperties(IsObjectType, null);
		}

		public string[] GetAllCollectionProperties()
		{
			if (GetAllObjectProperties().Length == 0)
			{
				return new string[0];
			}
			IDataSourceLocalDataProvider currentDataSource = Owner.GetCurrentDataSource();
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			for (int i = 0; i < currentDataSource.ActualCount; i++)
			{
				if (IsCollection(currentDataSource.GetItemAtIndex(i)))
				{
					list.Add(currentDataSource.ActualSchema.PropertyNames[i]);
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		public string GetFirstNumericProperty()
		{
			string[] allNumericProperties = GetAllNumericProperties();
			if (allNumericProperties.Length == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return allNumericProperties[0];
		}

		public bool HasNumericProperties()
		{
			return GetAllNumericProperties().Length != 0;
		}

		private bool IsDateTimeType(DataSourceSchemaPropertyType type)
		{
			if (type == DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.DateTimeValue || type == DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.DateTimeOffsetValue)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private DataSourceSchemaPropertyType GetPropertyType(string name)
		{
			IDataSourceLocalDataProvider currentDataSource = Owner.GetCurrentDataSource();
			if (currentDataSource == null)
			{
				return DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.ObjectValue;
			}
			IDataSourceSchema actualSchema = currentDataSource.ActualSchema;
			if (actualSchema == null)
			{
				return DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.ObjectValue;
			}
			int num = -1;
			for (int i = 0; i < actualSchema.PropertyNames.Length; i++)
			{
				if (actualSchema.PropertyNames[i].Equals(name))
				{
					num = i;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (num == -1)
			{
				return DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.ObjectValue;
			}
			return actualSchema.PropertyTypes[num];
		}

		private string[] GetMatchingProperties(Func<DataSourceSchemaPropertyType, bool> match, Func<string, bool> nameMatch)
		{
			IDataSourceSchema actualSchema = Owner.GetCurrentDataSource().ActualSchema;
			if (actualSchema == null)
			{
				return new string[0];
			}
			string currentPath = Owner.GetCurrentPath();
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < actualSchema.PropertyTypes.Length; i++)
			{
				if ((match == null || match(actualSchema.PropertyTypes[i])) && (nameMatch == null || nameMatch(actualSchema.PropertyNames[i])) && ShouldPlot(actualSchema.PropertyDataIntents, i) && ShouldIncludeProperty(actualSchema.PropertyNames[i], currentPath))
				{
					num++;
				}
			}
			string[] array = new string[num];
			num = 0;
			for (int j = 0; j < actualSchema.PropertyTypes.Length; j++)
			{
				if ((match == null || match(actualSchema.PropertyTypes[j])) && (nameMatch == null || nameMatch(actualSchema.PropertyNames[j])) && ShouldPlot(actualSchema.PropertyDataIntents, j) && ShouldIncludeProperty(actualSchema.PropertyNames[j], currentPath))
				{
					array[num] = actualSchema.PropertyNames[j];
					num++;
				}
			}
			return array;
		}

		private bool ShouldPlot(string[][] propertyDataIntents, int index)
		{
			if (propertyDataIntents == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return !ContainsIntent(propertyDataIntents, index, "DontPlot");
		}

		private bool ContainsIntent(string[][] propertyDataIntents, int index, string intentName)
		{
			if (propertyDataIntents == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < propertyDataIntents[index].Length; i++)
			{
				if (string.Equals(propertyDataIntents[index][i].ToLower(), intentName.ToLower()))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public string[] GetAllPropertiesWithIntent(string intent)
		{
			return GetAllPropertiesWithIntentHelper(intent, excludeValued: false, excludeValueless: false);
		}

		public string[] GetAllPropertiesWithValuelessIntent(string intent)
		{
			return GetAllPropertiesWithIntentHelper(intent, excludeValued: true, excludeValueless: false);
		}

		public string GetPropertyIntentValue(string intent, string property)
		{
			IDataSourceLocalDataProvider currentDataSource = Owner.GetCurrentDataSource();
			if (currentDataSource == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			IDataSourceSchema actualSchema = currentDataSource.ActualSchema;
			if (actualSchema == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			string[][] propertyDataIntents = actualSchema.PropertyDataIntents;
			if (propertyDataIntents == null || actualSchema.PropertyNames == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < actualSchema.PropertyNames.Length; i++)
			{
				if (actualSchema.PropertyNames[i] == null || !actualSchema.PropertyNames[i].Equals(property))
				{
					continue;
				}
				for (int j = 0; j < propertyDataIntents[i].Length; j++)
				{
					string[] array = propertyDataIntents[i][j].Split('/');
					if (array.Length == 2 && array[0] != null && array[0].Equals(intent))
					{
						return array[1];
					}
				}
			}

		private string[] GetAllPropertiesWithIntentHelper(string intent, bool excludeValued, bool excludeValueless)
		{
			IDataSourceLocalDataProvider currentDataSource = Owner.GetCurrentDataSource();

			string[][] propertyDataIntents = actualSchema.PropertyDataIntents;
			if (propertyDataIntents == null || actualSchema.PropertyNames == null)

				return new string[0];
			}
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < actualSchema.PropertyNames.Length; i++)

				for (int j = 0; j < propertyDataIntents[i].Length; j++)
				{
					string[] array = propertyDataIntents[i][j].Split('/');
					if ((!excludeValued || array.Length <= 1) && (!excludeValueless || array.Length >= 2) && string.Equals(intent.ToLower(), array[0].ToLower()))
					{
						num++;
					}
				}
			}
			string[] array2 = new string[num];
			num = 0;
			for (int k = 0; k < actualSchema.PropertyNames.Length; k++)
			{
				for (int l = 0; l < propertyDataIntents[k].Length; l++)
				{
					string text = propertyDataIntents[k][l];
					string[] array3 = text.Split('/');
					if ((!excludeValued || array3.Length <= 1) && (!excludeValueless || array3.Length >= 2) && string.Equals(intent.ToLower(), text.ToLower()))
					{
						array2[num] = actualSchema.PropertyNames[k];
						num++;
					}
				}

		private bool IsNumericType(DataSourceSchemaPropertyType type)
		{
			if (type != DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.IntValue && type != DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.LongValue && type != DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.ShortValue && type != DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.SingleValue && type != DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.DoubleValue && type != DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.DecimalValue)
			{
				return type == DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.ByteValue;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool IsObjectType(DataSourceSchemaPropertyType type)
		{
			return type == DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.ObjectValue;
		}

		public bool IsMonotonic(IDataSourceLocalDataProvider provider, string property, int monotonicCheckAmount)
		{
			if (provider == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			bool flag2 = false;
			int actualCount = provider.ActualCount;
			for (int i = 0; i < Math.Min(actualCount, monotonicCheckAmount); i++)
			{
				if (i != 0)
				{
					double num = CoerceToDouble(provider.GetItemValue(provider.GetItemAtIndex(i - 1), property));
					double num2 = CoerceToDouble(provider.GetItemValue(provider.GetItemAtIndex(i), property));
					if (!flag2 && num != num2)
					{
						flag = num2 > num;
						flag2 = true;
					}
					if (num != num2 && flag2 && num2 > num != flag)
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private string GetFirstMatchingDistinctProperty(int distinctCheckThreshold, Func<DataSourceSchemaPropertyType, bool> match, Func<string, DataSourceSchemaPropertyType, bool> checkDistinct)
		{
			IDataSourceLocalDataProvider currentDataSource = Owner.GetCurrentDataSource();
			if (currentDataSource.ActualSchema == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			string[] matchingProperties = GetMatchingProperties(match, null);
			if (matchingProperties.Length == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (currentDataSource.ActualCount > distinctCheckThreshold)
			{
				return null;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < matchingProperties.Length; i++)
			{
				if (checkDistinct(matchingProperties[i], GetPropertyType(matchingProperties[i])))
				{
					return matchingProperties[i];
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		}

		public string GetTitleString(object specificItem, string[] specificProperties)
		{
			IDataSourceLocalDataProvider currentDataSource = Owner.GetCurrentDataSource();
			string text = null;
			if (text == null && specificProperties != null)
			{
				string text2 = null;
				for (int i = 0; i < specificProperties.Length; i++)
				{
					string propertyIntentValue = GetPropertyIntentValue(DataSeriesIntent.SeriesTitle.ToString(), specificProperties[i]);
					if (text == null)
					{
						text = propertyIntentValue;
						text2 = propertyIntentValue;
					}
					else if (propertyIntentValue != null)
					{
						if (propertyIntentValue.Trim().Length > 0 && propertyIntentValue != text2)
						{
							text = text + " - " + propertyIntentValue;
						}
						text2 = propertyIntentValue;
					}
				}
			}
			if (text == null)
			{
				string[] allPropertiesWithValuelessIntent = GetAllPropertiesWithValuelessIntent(DataSeriesIntent.SeriesTitle.ToString());
				if (allPropertiesWithValuelessIntent != null && allPropertiesWithValuelessIntent.Length != 0)
				{
					text = allPropertiesWithValuelessIntent[0];
					text = ExtractTitle(specificItem, currentDataSource, text);
				}
			}
			if (text == null && GetParentTitle() != null)
			{
				text = GetParentTitle();
			}
			if (text == null && specificItem != null)
			{
				string[] allStringProperties = GetAllStringProperties();
				foreach (string text3 in allStringProperties)
				{
					if (text3 != null && (text3.ToLower().Equals("label") || text3.ToLower().Equals("title")))
					{
						text = text3;
					}
				}
				if (text != null)
				{
					text = ExtractTitle(specificItem, currentDataSource, text);
				}
			}
			return text;
		}

		private string ExtractTitle(object specificItem, IDataSourceLocalDataProvider provider, string titleString)
		{
			if (specificItem != null)
			{
				object itemValue = provider.GetItemValue(specificItem, titleString);
				if (itemValue != null)
				{
					titleString = itemValue.ToString();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				titleString = GetNonNullPropertyValue(titleString).ToString();
			}
			return titleString;
		}

		public object GetNonNullPropertyValue(string propertyName)
		{
			IDataSourceLocalDataProvider currentDataSource = Owner.GetCurrentDataSource();
			for (int i = 0; i < currentDataSource.ActualCount; i++)
			{
				object itemValue = currentDataSource.GetItemValue(currentDataSource.GetItemAtIndex(i), propertyName);
				if (itemValue != null)
				{
					return itemValue;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private bool IsStringPropertyDistinct(string propertyName, DataSourceSchemaPropertyType type)
		{
			IDataSourceLocalDataProvider currentDataSource = Owner.GetCurrentDataSource();
			HashSet<string> hashSet = new HashSet<string>();
			for (int i = 0; i < currentDataSource.ActualCount; i++)
			{
				string item = (string)currentDataSource.GetItemValue(currentDataSource.GetItemAtIndex(i), propertyName);
				if (hashSet.Contains(item))
				{
					return false;
				}
				hashSet.Add(item);
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool IsDateTimePropertyDistinct(string propertyName, DataSourceSchemaPropertyType type)
		{
			IDataSourceLocalDataProvider currentDataSource = Owner.GetCurrentDataSource();
			HashSet<DateTime> hashSet = new HashSet<DateTime>();
			for (int i = 0; i < currentDataSource.ActualCount; i++)
			{
				object itemValue = currentDataSource.GetItemValue(currentDataSource.GetItemAtIndex(i), propertyName);
				DateTime item = ((itemValue != null) ? Convert.ToDateTime(itemValue) : DateTime.MinValue);
				if (hashSet.Contains(item))
				{
					return false;
				}
				hashSet.Add(item);
			}
			return true;
		}

		private double CoerceToDouble(object value_)
		{
			return Convert.ToDouble(value_);
		}

		private bool IsNumericPropertyDistinct(string propertyName, DataSourceSchemaPropertyType propertyType)
		{
			IDataSourceLocalDataProvider currentDataSource = Owner.GetCurrentDataSource();
			switch (propertyType)
			{
			case DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.IntValue:
			case DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.LongValue:
			case DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.ShortValue:
			{
				HashSet<long> hashSet3 = new HashSet<long>();
				for (int k = 0; k < currentDataSource.ActualCount; k++)
				{
					object itemValue3 = currentDataSource.GetItemValue(currentDataSource.GetItemAtIndex(k), propertyName);
					long item3 = ((itemValue3 != null) ? Convert.ToInt64(itemValue3) : long.MinValue);
					if (hashSet3.Contains(item3))
					{
						return false;
					}
					hashSet3.Add(item3);
				}
				return true;
			}
			case DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.DoubleValue:
			case DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.SingleValue:
			{
				HashSet<double> hashSet2 = new HashSet<double>();
				for (int j = 0; j < currentDataSource.ActualCount; j++)
				{
					object itemValue2 = currentDataSource.GetItemValue(currentDataSource.GetItemAtIndex(j), propertyName);
					double item2 = ((itemValue2 != null) ? CoerceToDouble(itemValue2) : double.NaN);
					if (hashSet2.Contains(item2))
					{
						return false;
					}
					hashSet2.Add(item2);
				}
				return true;
			}
			case DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.DecimalValue:
			{
				HashSet<decimal> hashSet = new HashSet<decimal>();
				for (int i = 0; i < currentDataSource.ActualCount; i++)
				{
					object itemValue = currentDataSource.GetItemValue(currentDataSource.GetItemAtIndex(i), propertyName);
					decimal item = ((itemValue != null) ? Convert.ToDecimal(itemValue) : decimal.MinValue);
					if (hashSet.Contains(item))
					{
						return false;
					}
					hashSet.Add(item);
				}
				return true;
			}
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}
	}
	internal class Matcher
	{
		protected Regex _exp;

		public Matcher(string pattern)
		{
			string pattern2 = ResolvePattern(pattern);
			_exp = new Regex(pattern2);
		}

		public bool Match(string target)
		{
			return _exp.IsMatch(target);
		}

		public static bool IsPattern(string pattern)
		{
			return ResolvePattern(pattern) != null;
		}

		public static string ResolvePattern(string pattern)
		{
			if (pattern == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (pattern.StartsWith("/") && pattern.EndsWith("/"))
			{
				return pattern.Substring(1, pattern.Length - 2);
			}
			if (pattern.StartsWith("Regex(") && pattern.EndsWith(")"))
			{
				return pattern.Substring(6, pattern.Length - 7);
			}
			if (pattern.StartsWith("RegExp(") && pattern.EndsWith(")"))
			{
				return pattern.Substring(7, pattern.Length - 8);
			}
			if (pattern.Contains("*") || pattern.Contains("#") || pattern.Contains("?"))
			{
				pattern = pattern.Replace(".", "\\.");
				pattern = pattern.Replace("*", ".*");
				pattern = pattern.Replace("#", "\\d+");
				pattern = pattern.Replace("?", ".+");
				pattern = pattern.Replace("[", "\\[");
				pattern = pattern.Replace("]", "\\]");
				return "^" + pattern + "$";
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	[DontObfuscate]
	[DontHide]
	public class DataSeries
	{
		private List<DataSeriesMemberPathHint> _memberPathHints;

		public string Name { get; set; }

		public string Title { get; set; }

		public object Data { get; set; }

		public int Priority { get; set; }

		public int Index { get; set; }

		public DataSeriesAxisType SuggestedPrimaryAxis { get; set; }

		public DataSeriesAxisType SuggestedSecondaryAxis { get; set; }

		public DataSeriesType SuggestedSeries { get; set; }

		public string DataPath { get; internal set; }

		public DataSeriesMarker SuggestedMarker { get; set; }

		public DataSeries()
		{
			_memberPathHints = new List<DataSeriesMemberPathHint>();
			SuggestedMarker = DataSeriesMarker.Smart;
			Index = -1;
			Priority = -1;
		}

		public void AddMemberPathHint(DataSeriesMemberPathHint hint)
		{
			_memberPathHints.Add(hint);
		}

		public void AddMemberPathHint(DataSeriesMemberPathHint hint, DataSeriesIntent intent)
		{
			DataSeriesMemberPathHint dataSeriesMemberPathHint = hint.Clone();
			dataSeriesMemberPathHint.Intent = intent;
			_memberPathHints.Add(dataSeriesMemberPathHint);
		}

		public void AddMemberPathHint(string path, DataSeriesIntent intent)
		{
			DataSeriesMemberPathHint dataSeriesMemberPathHint = new DataSeriesMemberPathHint();
			dataSeriesMemberPathHint.Intent = intent;
			dataSeriesMemberPathHint.Path = path;
			_memberPathHints.Add(dataSeriesMemberPathHint);
		}

		public void RemoveMemberPathHint(DataSeriesMemberPathHint hint)
		{
			_memberPathHints.Remove(hint);
		}

		public void ClearMemberPathHints()
		{
			_memberPathHints.Clear();
		}

		public int GetMemberPathHintCount()
		{
			return _memberPathHints.Count;
		}

		public DataSeriesMemberPathHint GetMemberPathHintAt(int index)
		{
			return _memberPathHints[index];
		}

		public DataSeriesMemberPathHint FindMatchingHint(DataSeriesIntent intent)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < _memberPathHints.Count; i++)
			{
				if (_memberPathHints[i].Intent == intent)
				{
					return _memberPathHints[i];
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public string GetMemberPathFor(DataSeriesIntent intent)
		{
			DataSeriesMemberPathHint dataSeriesMemberPathHint = FindMatchingHint(intent);
			if (dataSeriesMemberPathHint == null)
			{
				return "";
			}
			return dataSeriesMemberPathHint.Path;
		}

		public bool HasMatchingHint(DataSeriesIntent intent)
		{
			DataSeriesMemberPathHint dataSeriesMemberPathHint = FindMatchingHint(intent);
			if (dataSeriesMemberPathHint == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataSeriesMemberPathHint.Path))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal IList<DataSeriesMemberPathHint> GetAllPathHints()
		{
			return _memberPathHints;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is DataSeries dataSeries))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!string.Equals(Name, dataSeries.Name))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!string.Equals(Title, dataSeries.Title))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Data != dataSeries.Data)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Priority != dataSeries.Priority)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (SuggestedPrimaryAxis != dataSeries.SuggestedPrimaryAxis)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (SuggestedSecondaryAxis != dataSeries.SuggestedSecondaryAxis)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (SuggestedSeries != dataSeries.SuggestedSeries)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (SuggestedMarker != dataSeries.SuggestedMarker)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!string.Equals(DataPath, dataSeries.DataPath))
			{
				return false;
			}
			IList<DataSeriesMemberPathHint> allPathHints = GetAllPathHints();
			IList<DataSeriesMemberPathHint> allPathHints2 = dataSeries.GetAllPathHints();
			if (allPathHints.Count != allPathHints2.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < allPathHints.Count; i++)
			{
				if (!allPathHints[i].Equals(allPathHints2[i]))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public new string ToString()
		{
			string text = string.Concat(SuggestedSeries, " hints: ");
			foreach (DataSeriesMemberPathHint memberPathHint in _memberPathHints)
			{
				text = text + " {" + memberPathHint.ToString() + "}, ";
			}
			return text;
		}
	}
	[DontObfuscate]
	[DontHide]
	public class DataSeriesMemberPathHint
	{
		public string Path { get; set; }

		public DataSeriesIntent Intent { get; set; }

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is DataSeriesMemberPathHint dataSeriesMemberPathHint))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!string.Equals(Path, dataSeriesMemberPathHint.Path))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Intent != dataSeriesMemberPathHint.Intent)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public new string ToString()
		{
			return string.Concat(Intent, " Path = '", Path, "'");
		}

		public void Update(string propName, string propFormat = null)
		{
			Path = (string.IsNullOrEmpty(propFormat) ? propName : propFormat.Replace("NAME", propName));
		}

		public void Update(List<string> propNames, string propFormat = null)
		{
			if (propNames.Count != 0)
			{
				Update(propNames[0], propFormat);
			}
		}

		public bool HasPath()
		{
			return !string.IsNullOrEmpty(Path);
		}

		public DataSeriesMemberPathHint Clone()
		{
			return new DataSeriesMemberPathHint
			{
				Intent = Intent,
				Path = Path
			};
		}
	}

namespace Infragistics.Controls.Charts.DataAdapters.Rules
