	[DontHide]
	[DontObfuscate]
	public class SimpleFinancialPriceSeriesRule : IDataSeriesAdapterRule
	{
		public int Priority { get; set; }

		public int DistinctCheckThreshold { get; set; }

		public SimpleFinancialPriceSeriesRule()
		{
			Priority = 10;
			DistinctCheckThreshold = 50000;
		}

		private void Except(List<string> source, List<string> target)
		{
			foreach (string item in target)
			{
				if (source.Contains(item))
				{
					source.Remove(item);
				}
			}
		}

		internal static string GetTimeString(DataSeriesAdapterRunContext context, int distinctCheckThreshold)
		{
			string[] allPropertiesWithIntent = context.Analyzer.GetAllPropertiesWithIntent(DataSeriesIntent.AxisDateValue.ToString());
			if (allPropertiesWithIntent.Length != 0)
			{
				return allPropertiesWithIntent[0];
			}
			return context.Analyzer.GetFirstDistinctDateTimeProperty(distinctCheckThreshold) ?? context.Analyzer.GetFirstDateTimeProperty();
		}

		internal static string GetCategoryString(DataSeriesAdapterRunContext context, int distinctCheckThreshold)
		{
			string[] allPropertiesWithIntent = context.Analyzer.GetAllPropertiesWithIntent(DataSeriesIntent.AxisDateValue.ToString());
			if (allPropertiesWithIntent.Length != 0)
			{
				return allPropertiesWithIntent[0];
			}
			allPropertiesWithIntent = context.Analyzer.GetAllPropertiesWithIntent(DataSeriesIntent.AxisLabelValue.ToString());
			if (allPropertiesWithIntent.Length != 0)
			{
				return allPropertiesWithIntent[0];
			}
			return context.Analyzer.GetFirstDistinctDateTimeProperty(distinctCheckThreshold) ?? context.Analyzer.GetFirstDistinctStringProperty(distinctCheckThreshold) ?? context.Analyzer.GetFirstDistinctMonotonicNumericProperty(distinctCheckThreshold) ?? context.Analyzer.GetFirstStringProperty();
		}

		public void Evaluate(DataSeriesAdapterRunContext context)
		{
			string timeString = GetTimeString(context, DistinctCheckThreshold);
			string categoryString = GetCategoryString(context, DistinctCheckThreshold);
			List<string> list = new List<string>(context.Analyzer.GetAllPropertiesWithIntent(DataSeriesIntent.OpenSeriesValue.ToString()));
			List<string> list2 = new List<string>(context.Analyzer.GetAllPropertiesWithIntent(DataSeriesIntent.HighSeriesValue.ToString()));
			List<string> list3 = new List<string>(context.Analyzer.GetAllPropertiesWithIntent(DataSeriesIntent.LowSeriesValue.ToString()));
			List<string> list4 = new List<string>(context.Analyzer.GetAllPropertiesWithIntent(DataSeriesIntent.CloseSeriesValue.ToString()));
			List<string> list5 = new List<string>(context.Analyzer.GetAllPropertiesWithIntent(DataSeriesIntent.VolumeSeriesValue.ToString()));
			int num = Math.Min(list.Count, Math.Min(list2.Count, Math.Min(list3.Count, list4.Count)));
			if (num == 0)
			{
				List<string> list6 = new List<string>(context.Analyzer.GetAllNumericProperties());
				foreach (string item in list6)
				{
					if (string.Equals(item.ToLower(), "open"))
					{
						list.Add(item);
					}
					else if (string.Equals(item.ToLower(), "high"))
					{
						list2.Add(item);
					}
					else if (string.Equals(item.ToLower(), "low"))
					{
						list3.Add(item);
					}
					else if (string.Equals(item.ToLower(), "close"))
					{
						list4.Add(item);
					}
					else if (string.Equals(item.ToLower(), "volume"))
					{
						list5.Add(item);
					}
				}
				Except(list6, list);
				Except(list6, list2);
				Except(list6, list3);
				Except(list6, list4);
				Except(list6, list5);
				int num2 = list.Count + list2.Count + list3.Count + list4.Count + list6.Count;
				if (num2 == 0)
				{
					return;
				}
				num = ((num2 <= 4) ? 1 : ((int)Math.Floor((double)num2 / 5.0)));
				object[] array = new object[5] { list, list2, list3, list4, list5 };
				int num3 = 0;
				while (list6.Count > 0)
				{
					((List<string>)array[num3++ % array.Length]).Add(list6[0]);
					list6.RemoveAt(0);
				}
			}
			string dataSourceTitle = GetDataSourceTitle(context.GetCurrentDataSource());
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				context.PushParentTitle((num == 1) ? dataSourceTitle : (dataSourceTitle + (i + 1)));
				string text = ((list.Count > i) ? list[i] : null);
				string text2 = ((list2.Count > i) ? list2[i] : null);
				string text3 = ((list3.Count > i) ? list3[i] : null);
				string text4 = ((list4.Count > i) ? list4[i] : null);
				DataSeries dataSeries = new DataSeries();
				dataSeries.Name = string.Join("_", text, text2, text3, text4);
				dataSeries.Title = context.Analyzer.GetTitleString(null, new string[4] { text, text2, text3, text4 });
				dataSeries.SuggestedSeries = DataSeriesType.FinancialPrice;
				dataSeries.SuggestedPrimaryAxis = DataSeriesAxisType.Category;
				dataSeries.SuggestedSecondaryAxis = DataSeriesAxisType.Linear;
				DataSeries dataSeries2 = dataSeries;
				dataSeries2.AddMemberPathHint(new DataSeriesMemberPathHint
				{
					Intent = DataSeriesIntent.OpenSeriesValue,
					Path = text
				});
				dataSeries2.AddMemberPathHint(new DataSeriesMemberPathHint
				{
					Intent = DataSeriesIntent.HighSeriesValue,
					Path = text2
				});
				dataSeries2.AddMemberPathHint(new DataSeriesMemberPathHint
				{
					Intent = DataSeriesIntent.LowSeriesValue,
					Path = text3
				});
				dataSeries2.AddMemberPathHint(new DataSeriesMemberPathHint
				{
					Intent = DataSeriesIntent.CloseSeriesValue,
					Path = text4
				});
				if (list5.Count > i)
				{
					dataSeries2.AddMemberPathHint(new DataSeriesMemberPathHint
					{
						Intent = DataSeriesIntent.VolumeSeriesValue,
						Path = list5[i]
					});
				}
				if (timeString != null)
				{
					dataSeries2.AddMemberPathHint(new DataSeriesMemberPathHint
					{
						Intent = DataSeriesIntent.AxisDateValue,
						Path = timeString
					});
				}
				dataSeries2.AddMemberPathHint(new DataSeriesMemberPathHint
				{
					Intent = DataSeriesIntent.AxisLabelValue,
					Path = categoryString
				});
				context.AddDataSeries(dataSeries2, this);
				context.PopParentTitle();
			}
		}

		private string GetDataSourceTitle(IDataSourceLocalDataProvider provider)
		{
			object obj = provider?.ItemsSource;
			if (obj == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			PropertyInfo[] properties = obj.GetType().GetProperties();
			PropertyInfo propertyInfo = null;
			PropertyInfo propertyInfo2 = null;
			PropertyInfo[] array = properties;
			foreach (PropertyInfo propertyInfo3 in array)
			{
				if (propertyInfo3.Name == "Title")
				{
					propertyInfo2 = propertyInfo3;
				}
				object[] customAttributes = propertyInfo3.GetCustomAttributes(typeof(IDataIntentAttribute), inherit: true);
				IDataIntentAttribute dataIntentAttribute = ((customAttributes != null && customAttributes.Length != 0) ? (customAttributes[0] as IDataIntentAttribute) : null);
				if (dataIntentAttribute != null && dataIntentAttribute.Intent == "Title")
				{
					propertyInfo = propertyInfo3;
				}
			}
			if (propertyInfo == null)
			{
				propertyInfo = propertyInfo2;
			}
			return ((propertyInfo != null) ? propertyInfo.GetValue(obj, null) : null)?.ToString();
		}
	}
	[DontHide]
	[DontObfuscate]
	public class SimpleScatterSeriesRule : IDataSeriesAdapterRule
	{
		public int Priority { get; set; }

		public int MonotonicCheckAmount { get; set; }

		public SimpleScatterSeriesRule()
		{
			Priority = 9;
			MonotonicCheckAmount = 10000;
		}

		public void Evaluate(DataSeriesAdapterRunContext context)
		{
			string[] allNumericProperties = context.Analyzer.GetAllNumericProperties();
			if (allNumericProperties.Length == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			_ = context.GetCurrentDataSource().ActualCount;
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			for (int i = 0; i < allNumericProperties.Length; i++)
			{
				list.Add(allNumericProperties[i]);
			}
			List<string> xProps = GetXProps(list);
			List<string> yProps = GetYProps(list);
			string[] allPropertiesWithIntent = context.Analyzer.GetAllPropertiesWithIntent(DataSeriesIntent.SeriesX.ToString());
			string[] allPropertiesWithIntent2 = context.Analyzer.GetAllPropertiesWithIntent(DataSeriesIntent.SeriesY.ToString());
			if (allPropertiesWithIntent.Length != 0 && allPropertiesWithIntent2.Length != 0 && allPropertiesWithIntent.Length == allPropertiesWithIntent2.Length)
			{
				xProps.Clear();
				yProps.Clear();
				list.Clear();
				for (int j = 0; j < allPropertiesWithIntent.Length; j++)
				{
					xProps.Add(allPropertiesWithIntent[j]);
					yProps.Add(allPropertiesWithIntent2[j]);
				}
			}
			int num = 0;
			for (num = 0; num < Math.Min(xProps.Count, yProps.Count); num++)
			{
				string[] specificProperties = new string[2]
				{
					xProps[num],
					yProps[num]
				};
				string titleString = context.Analyzer.GetTitleString(null, specificProperties);
				CreateScatterSeries(context, xProps[num], yProps[num], titleString);
			}
			for (; num < xProps.Count; num++)
			{
				list.Add(xProps[num]);
			}
			for (; num < yProps.Count; num++)
			{
				list.Add(yProps[num]);
			}
			for (int k = 0; k < list.Count; k += 2)
			{
				if (k + 1 < list.Count)
				{
					string[] specificProperties2 = new string[2]
					{
						list[k],
						list[k + 1]
					};
					string titleString2 = context.Analyzer.GetTitleString(null, specificProperties2);
					CreateScatterSeries(context, list[k], list[k + 1], titleString2);
				}
			}
		}

		private List<string> GetYProps(List<string> remainingProps)
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			for (int i = 0; i < remainingProps.Count; i++)
			{
				if (IsYProp(remainingProps[i]))
				{
					list.Add(remainingProps[i]);
					remainingProps.RemoveAt(i);
					i--;
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private bool IsYProp(string v)
		{
			if (string.Equals(v.ToLower(), "y") || string.Equals(v.ToLower(), "yvalue"))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private List<string> GetXProps(List<string> remainingProps)
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			for (int i = 0; i < remainingProps.Count; i++)
			{
				if (IsXProp(remainingProps[i]))
				{
					list.Add(remainingProps[i]);
					remainingProps.RemoveAt(i);
					i--;
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private bool IsXProp(string v)
		{
			if (string.Equals(v.ToLower(), "x") || string.Equals(v.ToLower(), "xvalue"))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void CreateScatterSeries(DataSeriesAdapterRunContext context, string xValue, string yValue, string titleString)
		{
			DataSeries dataSeries = new DataSeries();
			dataSeries.Name = xValue + "_" + yValue;
			if (titleString != null)
			{
				dataSeries.Title = titleString;
			}
			else
			{
				dataSeries.Title = xValue + " - " + yValue;
				dataSeries.Title = context.Analyzer.ExpandCamelCasedWords(dataSeries.Title);
			}
			DataSeriesMemberPathHint dataSeriesMemberPathHint = new DataSeriesMemberPathHint();
			dataSeriesMemberPathHint.Intent = DataSeriesIntent.SeriesX;
			dataSeriesMemberPathHint.Path = xValue;
			DataSeriesMemberPathHint dataSeriesMemberPathHint2 = new DataSeriesMemberPathHint();
			dataSeriesMemberPathHint2.Intent = DataSeriesIntent.SeriesY;
			dataSeriesMemberPathHint2.Path = yValue;
			dataSeries.AddMemberPathHint(dataSeriesMemberPathHint);
			dataSeries.AddMemberPathHint(dataSeriesMemberPathHint2);
			IDataSourceLocalDataProvider currentDataSource = context.GetCurrentDataSource();
			if (currentDataSource.ActualCount > MonotonicCheckAmount)
			{
				dataSeries.SuggestedSeries = DataSeriesType.ScatterPoint;
			}
			else if (context.Analyzer.IsMonotonic(currentDataSource, xValue, MonotonicCheckAmount))
			{
				dataSeries.SuggestedSeries = DataSeriesType.ScatterLine;
			}
			else
			{
				dataSeries.SuggestedSeries = DataSeriesType.ScatterPoint;
			}
			dataSeries.SuggestedPrimaryAxis = DataSeriesAxisType.Linear;
			dataSeries.SuggestedSecondaryAxis = DataSeriesAxisType.Linear;
			context.AddDataSeries(dataSeries, this);
		}
	}
	[DontHide]
	[DontObfuscate]
	public class SubCollectionsRule : IDataSeriesAdapterRule
	{
		public int Priority { get; set; }

		public int CollectionTransformationThreshold { get; set; }

		public SubCollectionsRule()
		{
			Priority = 0;
			CollectionTransformationThreshold = 50;
		}

		public void Evaluate(DataSeriesAdapterRunContext context)
		{
			IDataSourceLocalDataProvider currentDataSource = context.GetCurrentDataSource();
			if (currentDataSource == null || currentDataSource.ActualCount == 0 || currentDataSource.ActualCount > CollectionTransformationThreshold)
			{
				return;
			}
			object itemAtIndex = currentDataSource.GetItemAtIndex(0);
			if (!context.Analyzer.IsCollection(itemAtIndex))
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < currentDataSource.ActualCount; i++)
			{
				if (context.Analyzer.IsCollection(currentDataSource.GetItemAtIndex(i)))
				{
					string titleString = context.Analyzer.GetTitleString(currentDataSource.GetItemAtIndex(i), null);
					if (titleString != null)
					{
						context.PushParentTitle(titleString);
					}
					context.RecurseRules(currentDataSource.GetItemAtIndex(i), "[" + i + "]", listenForSubPathChanges: false);
					if (titleString != null)
					{
						context.PopParentTitle();
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	[DontHide]
	[DontObfuscate]
	public class SimpleCategorySeriesRule : IDataSeriesAdapterRule
	{
		public int Priority { get; set; }

		public int UseColumnThreshold { get; set; }

		public int DistinctCheckThreshold { get; set; }

		public SimpleCategorySeriesRule()
		{
			Priority = 10;
			DistinctCheckThreshold = 50000;
			UseColumnThreshold = 30;
		}

		internal static string GetCategoryString(DataSeriesAdapterRunContext context, int distinctCheckThreshold)
		{
			string[] allPropertiesWithIntent = context.Analyzer.GetAllPropertiesWithIntent(DataSeriesIntent.AxisLabelValue.ToString());
			if (allPropertiesWithIntent.Length != 0)
			{
				return allPropertiesWithIntent[0];
			}
			return context.Analyzer.GetFirstDistinctStringProperty(distinctCheckThreshold) ?? context.Analyzer.GetFirstDistinctDateTimeProperty(distinctCheckThreshold) ?? context.Analyzer.GetFirstDistinctMonotonicNumericProperty(distinctCheckThreshold) ?? context.Analyzer.GetFirstStringProperty();
		}

		public void Evaluate(DataSeriesAdapterRunContext context)
		{
			string categoryString = GetCategoryString(context, DistinctCheckThreshold);
			string[] array = null;
			string[] allPropertiesWithIntent = context.Analyzer.GetAllPropertiesWithIntent(DataSeriesIntent.PrimarySeriesValue.ToString());
			if (allPropertiesWithIntent.Length != 0)
			{
				array = allPropertiesWithIntent;
			}
			if (array == null)
			{
				array = context.Analyzer.GetAllNumericProperties();
			}
			if (array == null || array.Length == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			int actualCount = context.GetCurrentDataSource().ActualCount;
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				if (!(array[i] == categoryString) || array.Length <= 1)
				{
					string[] specificProperties = new string[1] { array[i] };
					string titleString = context.Analyzer.GetTitleString(null, specificProperties);
					DataSeries dataSeries = new DataSeries();
					DataSeriesMemberPathHint dataSeriesMemberPathHint = new DataSeriesMemberPathHint();
					dataSeriesMemberPathHint.Intent = DataSeriesIntent.PrimarySeriesValue;
					dataSeriesMemberPathHint.Path = array[i];
					DataSeriesMemberPathHint dataSeriesMemberPathHint2 = new DataSeriesMemberPathHint();
					dataSeriesMemberPathHint2.Intent = DataSeriesIntent.AxisLabelValue;
					dataSeriesMemberPathHint2.Path = categoryString;
					dataSeries.AddMemberPathHint(dataSeriesMemberPathHint);
					dataSeries.AddMemberPathHint(dataSeriesMemberPathHint2);
					if (actualCount > UseColumnThreshold)
					{
						dataSeries.SuggestedSeries = DataSeriesType.Line;
					}
					else
					{
						dataSeries.SuggestedSeries = DataSeriesType.Column;
					}
					FallbackTypeIfUnsupported(dataSeries, context);
					dataSeries.SuggestedPrimaryAxis = DataSeriesAxisType.Category;
					dataSeries.SuggestedSecondaryAxis = DataSeriesAxisType.Linear;
					dataSeries.Name = array[i];
					if (titleString != null)
					{
						dataSeries.Title = titleString;
					}
					else
					{
						dataSeries.Title = array[i];
						dataSeries.Title = context.Analyzer.ExpandCamelCasedWords(dataSeries.Title);
					}
					context.AddDataSeries(dataSeries, this);
				}
			}
		}

		private void FallbackTypeIfUnsupported(DataSeries series, DataSeriesAdapterRunContext context)
		{
			if (context.HasValidType(series))
			{
				return;
			}
			series.SuggestedSeries = DataSeriesType.Line;
			if (context.HasValidType(series))
			{
				return;
			}
			series.SuggestedSeries = DataSeriesType.Column;
			if (context.HasValidType(series))
			{
				return;
			}
			series.SuggestedSeries = DataSeriesType.Area;
			if (context.HasValidType(series))
			{
				return;
			}
			series.SuggestedSeries = DataSeriesType.Spline;
			if (context.HasValidType(series))
			{
				return;
			}
			series.SuggestedSeries = DataSeriesType.SplineArea;
			if (context.HasValidType(series))
			{
				return;
			}
			series.SuggestedSeries = DataSeriesType.StepLine;
			if (context.HasValidType(series))
			{
				return;
			}
			series.SuggestedSeries = DataSeriesType.StepArea;
			if (context.HasValidType(series))
			{
				return;
			}
			series.SuggestedSeries = DataSeriesType.Point;
			if (!context.HasValidType(series))
			{
				series.SuggestedSeries = DataSeriesType.Waterfall;
				if (!context.HasValidType(series))
				{
					series.SuggestedSeries = DataSeriesType.Line;
				}
			}
		}
	}

	internal class DataSeriesAdapterUpdateNotifier : IDataSourceDataProviderUpdateNotifier, ISupportsDataChangeNotifications
	{
		private DataSeriesAdapter _adapter;

		private IDataSourceLocalDataProvider _provider;

		public DataSeriesAdapterUpdateNotifier(DataSeriesAdapter adapter, IDataSourceLocalDataProvider provider)
		{
			_adapter = adapter;
			_provider = provider;
		}

		public void NotifyClearItems()
		{
			_adapter.OnProviderCleared(_provider);
		}

		public void NotifyInsertItem(int index, object newItem)
		{
			_adapter.OnProviderItemInserted(_provider, index, newItem);
		}

		public void NotifyRemoveItem(int index, object oldItem)
		{
			_adapter.OnProviderItemRemoved(_provider, index, oldItem);
		}

		public void NotifySetItem(int index, object oldItem, object newItem)
		{
			_adapter.OnProviderItemSet(_provider, index, oldItem, newItem);
		}
	}

	[Widget]

	[Widget]
	internal delegate void DataSeriesAdapterRunEventHandler(object sender, DataSeriesAdapterRunEventArgs args);
	[Widget]

	internal class DataSeriesAdapterRunEventArgs
	{
		public DataSeriesAdapterRunContext RunContext { get; internal set; }

	[Widget]
	[TSIgnore]
	[DontObfuscate]
	[JSClientName("DataSeriesAdapterImplementation")]
	[TSClientName("DataSeriesAdapterImplementation")]
	internal class DataSeriesAdapter : INotifyPropertyChanged
	{
		private Dictionary<object, IDataSourceLocalDataProvider> _cachedProviders = new Dictionary<object, IDataSourceLocalDataProvider>();

		private IEnumerable _itemsSource;

		internal const string ItemsSourcePropertyName = "ItemsSource";

		private DataSeriesType[] _supportedSeriesTypes;

		internal const string SupportedSeriesTypesPropertyName = "SupportedSeriesTypes";

		private string[] _includedProperties;

		internal const string IncludedPropertiesPropertyName = "IncludedProperties";

		private string[] _excludedProperties;

		internal const string ExcludedPropertiesPropertyName = "ExcludedProperties";

		private bool _duringRefresh;

		internal Func<string, string> Localizer { get; set; }

		internal object ExternalObject { get; set; }

		internal IExternalDataSeriesAdapter ExternalAdapter => (IExternalDataSeriesAdapter)ExternalObject;

		[JAVASuppressWidgetMember]
		public IEnumerable ItemsSource
		{
			get
			{
				return _itemsSource;
			}
			set
			{
				IEnumerable itemsSource = _itemsSource;
				_itemsSource = value;
				if (itemsSource != _itemsSource)
				{
					OnPropertyUpdated("ItemsSource", itemsSource, _itemsSource);
				}
			}
		}

		public DataSeriesType[] SupportedSeriesTypes
		{
			get
			{
				return _supportedSeriesTypes;
			}
			set
			{
				DataSeriesType[] supportedSeriesTypes = _supportedSeriesTypes;
				_supportedSeriesTypes = value;
				if (supportedSeriesTypes != _supportedSeriesTypes)
				{
					OnPropertyUpdated("SupportedSeriesTypes", supportedSeriesTypes, _supportedSeriesTypes);
				}
			}
		}

		public string[] IncludedProperties
		{
			get
			{
				return _includedProperties;
			}
			set
			{
				string[] includedProperties = _includedProperties;
				_includedProperties = value;
				if (includedProperties != _includedProperties)
				{
					OnPropertyUpdated("IncludedProperties", includedProperties, _includedProperties);
				}
			}
		}

		public string[] ExcludedProperties
		{
			get
			{
				return _excludedProperties;
			}
			set
			{
				string[] excludedProperties = _excludedProperties;
				_excludedProperties = value;
				if (excludedProperties != _excludedProperties)
				{
					OnPropertyUpdated("ExcludedProperties", excludedProperties, _excludedProperties);
				}
			}
		}

		[SuppressWidgetMember]
		public DataSeriesAdapterRuleCollection Rules { get; private set; }

		[SuppressWidgetMember]
		public DataSeriesCollection DataSeries { get; private set; }

		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		public event DataSeriesAdapterRunEventHandler RemovingUnsupported;

		public event DataSeriesAdapterRemovingDuplicatesEventHandler RemovingDuplicates;

		public DataSeriesAdapter()
		{
			Rules = new DataSeriesAdapterRuleCollection();
			DataSeries = new DataSeriesCollection();
			PopulateDefaultRules(Rules);
			Rules.CollectionChanged += Rules_CollectionChanged;
		}

		internal string Localize(string localizationId, string defaultString)
		{
			string text = string.Empty;
			if (Localizer != null)
			{
				text = Localizer(localizationId);
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				return defaultString;
			}
			return text;
		}

		private void PopulateDefaultRules(DataSeriesAdapterRuleCollection rules)
		{
			rules.Add(new SimpleCategorySeriesRule());
			rules.Add(new SimpleScatterSeriesRule());
			rules.Add(new SubCollectionsRule());
		}

		private void Rules_CollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			Refresh();
		}

		protected void OnPropertyUpdated(string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			PropertyUpdatedOverride(propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
			if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
			}
		}

		protected virtual void PropertyUpdatedOverride(string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "ItemsSource":
				Refresh();
				break;
			case "SupportedSeriesTypes":
				Refresh();
				break;
			case "IncludedProperties":
				Refresh();
				break;
			case "ExcludedProperties":
				Refresh();
				break;
			}
		}

		public void Refresh()
		{
			_duringRefresh = true;
			ClearCachedProviders();
			DataSeriesAdapterRunContext dataSeriesAdapterRunContext = new DataSeriesAdapterRunContext(this);
			IDataSourceLocalDataProvider provider = GetProvider(ItemsSource);
			CacheProvider(provider, null, listenOnSub: false);
			dataSeriesAdapterRunContext.PushDataSource(provider);
			RunRules(dataSeriesAdapterRunContext);
			UpdateDataSeries(dataSeriesAdapterRunContext);
			_duringRefresh = false;
		}

		private void ClearCachedProviders()
		{
			foreach (object key in _cachedProviders.Keys)
			{
				IDataSourceLocalDataProvider dataSourceLocalDataProvider = _cachedProviders[key];
				dataSourceLocalDataProvider.UpdateNotifier = null;
				dataSourceLocalDataProvider.SchemaChanged -= Provider_SchemaChanged;
			}
			_cachedProviders.Clear();
		}

		private void UpdateDataSeries(DataSeriesAdapterRunContext context)
		{
			RemoveUnsupported(context);
			RemoveDuplicates(context);
			SyncDataSeries(context);
		}

		private void RemoveUnsupported(DataSeriesAdapterRunContext context)
		{
			bool flag = true;
			if (this.RemovingUnsupported != null)
			{
				DataSeriesAdapterRunEventArgs e = new DataSeriesAdapterRunEventArgs
				{
					RunContext = context
				};
				this.RemovingUnsupported(this, e);
				flag = !e.Handled;
			}
			if (!flag || SupportedSeriesTypes == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			HashSet<DataSeriesType> hashSet = new HashSet<DataSeriesType>();
			for (int i = 0; i < SupportedSeriesTypes.Length; i++)
			{
				hashSet.Add(SupportedSeriesTypes[i]);
			}
			for (int num = context.GetDataSeriesCount() - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				DataSeries dataSeriesAt = context.GetDataSeriesAt(num);
				if (!hashSet.Contains(dataSeriesAt.SuggestedSeries))
				{
					context.RemoveDataSeries(dataSeriesAt);
				}
			}
		}

		private void SyncDataSeries(DataSeriesAdapterRunContext context)
		{
			int i;
			for (i = 0; i < Math.Min(DataSeries.Count, context.GetDataSeriesCount()); i++)
			{
				if (!DataSeries[i].Equals(context.GetDataSeriesAt(i)))
				{
					DataSeries.RemoveAt(i);
					i--;
				}
			}
			for (; i < context.GetDataSeriesCount(); i++)
			{
				DataSeries.Insert(i, context.GetDataSeriesAt(i));
			}
			while (i < DataSeries.Count)
			{
				DataSeries.RemoveAt(i);
				i--;
				i++;
			}
		}

		private void RemoveDuplicates(DataSeriesAdapterRunContext context)
		{
			Dictionary<string, List<DataSeries>> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, List<DataSeries>>();
			for (int i = 0; i < context.GetDataSeriesCount(); i++)
			{
				DataSeries dataSeriesAt = context.GetDataSeriesAt(i);
				IList<DataSeriesMemberPathHint> allPathHints = dataSeriesAt.GetAllPathHints();
				for (int j = 0; j < allPathHints.Count; j++)
				{
					if (allPathHints[j].Intent != DataSeriesIntent.AxisLabelValue && allPathHints[j].Intent != DataSeriesIntent.AxisDateValue)
					{
						string key = ((dataSeriesAt.DataPath != null) ? (dataSeriesAt.DataPath + ".") : "") + allPathHints[j].Path;
						if (allPathHints[j].Intent == DataSeriesIntent.GenerationInput)
						{
							key = allPathHints[j].Path;
						}
						if (!dictionary.ContainsKey(key))
						{
							dictionary[key] = new List<DataSeries>();
						}
						dictionary[key].Add(dataSeriesAt);
					}
				}
			}
			foreach (string key2 in dictionary.Keys)
			{
				if (dictionary[key2].Count <= 1)
				{
					continue;
				}
				DataSeries[] array = new DataSeries[dictionary[key2].Count];
				List<DataSeries> list = dictionary[key2];
				int count = list.Count;
				for (int k = 0; k < count; k++)
				{
					array[k] = list[k];
				}
				bool flag = true;
				if (this.RemovingDuplicates != null)
				{
					flag = !new DataSeriesAdapterRemovingDuplicatesEventArgs
					{
						DuplicatePath = key2,
						RunContext = context,
						MatchingSeries = array
					}.Handled;
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					continue;
				}
				int num = -1;
				DataSeries dataSeries = null;
				list = dictionary[key2];
				count = list.Count;
				for (int l = 0; l < count; l++)
				{
					DataSeries dataSeries2 = list[l];
					if (dataSeries2.Priority > num)
					{
						num = dataSeries2.Priority;
						dataSeries = dataSeries2;
					}
				}
				for (int m = 0; m < count; m++)
				{
					DataSeries dataSeries3 = list[m];
					if (dataSeries3 != dataSeries)
					{
						context.RemoveDataSeries(dataSeries3);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void RunRules(DataSeriesAdapterRunContext context)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < Rules.Count; i++)
			{
				RunRule(context, Rules[i]);
			}
		}

		private void RunRule(DataSeriesAdapterRunContext context, IDataSeriesAdapterRule rule)
		{
			rule.Evaluate(context);
		}

		internal IDataSourceLocalDataProvider GetProvider(object dataSource)
		{
			if (dataSource != null && _cachedProviders.ContainsKey(dataSource))
			{
				return _cachedProviders[dataSource];
			}
			return ExternalAdapter.GetDataProvider(dataSource);
		}

		internal void RecurseRules(DataSeriesAdapterRunContext context, object subDataSource, string subPath, bool listenForSubPathChanges)
		{
			IDataSourceLocalDataProvider provider = GetProvider(subDataSource);
			CacheProvider(provider, context.GetCurrentDataSource(), listenForSubPathChanges);
			context.PushDataSource(provider);
			context.PushPath(subPath);
			RunRules(context);
			context.PopPath();
			context.PopDataSource();
		}

		private void CacheProvider(IDataSourceLocalDataProvider provider, IDataSourceLocalDataProvider parentProvider, bool listenOnSub)
		{
			if (provider.ItemsSource != null)
			{
				_cachedProviders.Add(provider.ItemsSource, provider);
			}
			provider.SchemaChanged += Provider_SchemaChanged;
			if (parentProvider != null)
			{
				DataSeriesAdapterUpdateNotifier updateNotifier = new DataSeriesAdapterUpdateNotifier(this, provider);
				parentProvider.UpdateNotifier = updateNotifier;
			}
			if (listenOnSub)
			{
				DataSeriesAdapterUpdateNotifier updateNotifier2 = new DataSeriesAdapterUpdateNotifier(this, provider);
				provider.UpdateNotifier = updateNotifier2;
			}
		}

		private void Provider_SchemaChanged(object sender, DataSourceDataProviderSchemaChangedEventArgs args)
		{
			if (!_duringRefresh)
			{
				Refresh();
			}
		}

		internal void OnProviderCleared(IDataSourceLocalDataProvider _provider)
		{
			Refresh();
		}

		internal void OnProviderItemInserted(IDataSourceLocalDataProvider _provider, int index, object newItem)
		{
			Refresh();
		}

		internal void OnProviderItemRemoved(IDataSourceLocalDataProvider _provider, int index, object oldItem)
		{
			Refresh();
		}

		internal void OnProviderItemSet(IDataSourceLocalDataProvider _provider, int index, object oldItem, object newItem)
		{
			Refresh();
		}
	}

namespace Infragistics.Controls.Maps

	internal class SpatialCache<T>
	{
		private readonly Dictionary<string, T>[] _images;

		public int Count { get; private set; }

		public SpatialCache(int maxLevel)
		{
			_images = new Dictionary<string, T>[maxLevel + 1];
		}

		public void AddItem(int level, int tileX, int tileY, T image)
		{
			if (_images[level] == null)
			{
				_images[level] = new Dictionary<string, T>();
			}
			string key = TilesIndexesToKey(tileX, tileY);
			if (_images[level].ContainsKey(key))
			{
				_images[level][key] = image;
				return;
			}
			_images[level].Add(key, image);
			Count++;
		}

		public bool ContainsItem(int level, int tileX, int tileY)
		{
			if (level >= _images.Length || _images[level] == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return _images[level].ContainsKey(TilesIndexesToKey(tileX, tileY));
		}

		public T GetItem(int level, int tileX, int tileY)
		{
			if (level < _images.Length && _images[level] != null && _images[level].TryGetValue(TilesIndexesToKey(tileX, tileY), out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return default(T);
		}

		public void RemoveItemAt(int level, int tileX, int tileY)
		{
			if (_images[level] != null)
			{
				string key = TilesIndexesToKey(tileX, tileY);
				_images[level].Remove(key);
				Count--;
			}
		}

		public void RemoveItemsAtLevel(int level)
		{
			if (_images[level] != null)
			{
				int count = _images[level].Count;
				_images[level].Clear();
				Count -= count;
			}
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			Dictionary<string, T>[] images = _images;
			for (int i = 0; i < images.Length; i++)
			{
				images[i]?.Clear();
			}
			Count = 0;
		}

		public void ClearLevel(int level, int leftTile, int rightTile, int topTile, int bottomTile)
		{
			if (level >= _images.Length || _images[level] == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, T> item3 in _images[level])
			{
				Tuple<int, int> tuple = KeyToTilesIndexes(item3.Key);
				int item = tuple.Item1;
				int item2 = tuple.Item2;
				if (item < leftTile || item > rightTile || item2 < topTile || item2 > bottomTile)
				{
					list.Add(item3.Key);
				}
			}
			foreach (string item4 in list)
			{
				_images[level].Remove(item4);
				Count--;
			}
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			for (int i = 4; i < _images.Length; i++)
			{
				if (_images[i] != null)
				{
					int count = _images[i].Count;
					_images[i].Clear();
					Count -= count;
				}
			}
		}

		private static string TilesIndexesToKey(int tileX, int tileY)
		{
			return tileX + "x" + tileY;
		}

		private static Tuple<int, int> KeyToTilesIndexes(string key)
		{
			string[] array = key.Split('x');
			return new Tuple<int, int>(Convert.ToInt32(array[0]), Convert.ToInt32(array[1]));
		}
	}
	internal class TileSubstituteSpatialCache
	{
		internal struct TileData
		{
			public Image Image { get; set; }

			public bool ReloadTile { get; set; }

			public TileData(Image image, bool reloadTile)
			{
				this = default(TileData);
				Image = image;
				ReloadTile = reloadTile;
			}
		}

		private readonly SpatialCache<BitmapImage> _cache;

		private readonly int _tileWidth;

		private readonly int _tileHeight;

		public int Count => _cache.Count;

		public TileSubstituteSpatialCache(SpatialCache<BitmapImage> cache, int tileWidth, int tileHeight)
		{
			_cache = cache;
			_tileWidth = tileWidth;
			_tileHeight = tileHeight;
		}

		public void AddTile(int level, int tileX, int tileY, BitmapImage bitmapImage)
		{
			_cache.AddItem(level, tileX, tileY, bitmapImage);
		}

		public bool ContainsTile(int level, int tileX, int tileY)
		{
			return _cache.ContainsItem(level, tileX, tileY);
		}

		public TileData GetTileOrSubstitute(int level, int tileX, int tileY)
		{
			BitmapImage bitmapImage = null;
			Image image = null;
			List<Point> list = new List<Point>(3);
			while (level > 0)
			{
				bitmapImage = _cache.GetItem(level, tileX, tileY);
				if (bitmapImage != null)
				{
					break;
				}
				list.Add(new Point(Convert.ToInt32((double)tileX % 2.0), Convert.ToInt32((double)tileY % 2.0)));
				level--;
				tileX = Convert.ToInt32(tileX / 2);
				tileY = Convert.ToInt32(tileY / 2);
			}
			if (bitmapImage != null)
			{
				if (list.Count > 0)
				{
					double num = Math.Pow(2.0, list.Count);
					double num2 = 0.0;
					double num3 = 0.0;
					int num4 = list.Count - 1;
					int num5 = 1;
					while (num4 >= 0)
					{
						num2 += list[num4].X * ((double)_tileWidth / Math.Pow(2.0, num5));
						num3 += list[num4].Y * ((double)_tileHeight / Math.Pow(2.0, num5));
						num4--;
						num5++;
					}
					new TransformGroup
					{
						Children = 
						{
							(Transform)new ScaleTransform
							{
								ScaleX = num,
								ScaleY = num
							},
							(Transform)new TranslateTransform
							{
								X = 0.0 - num2,
								Y = 0.0 - num3
							}
						}
					};
					int num6 = Convert.ToInt32((double)_tileWidth / Math.Pow(2.0, list.Count));
					int num7 = Convert.ToInt32((double)_tileWidth / Math.Pow(2.0, list.Count));
					if (num6 > 0 || num7 > 0)
					{
						TransformedBitmap source = new TransformedBitmap(new CroppedBitmap(bitmapImage, new Int32Rect(Convert.ToInt32(num2), Convert.ToInt32(num3), num6, num7)), new ScaleTransform
						{
							ScaleX = num,
							ScaleY = num
						});
						image = new Image
						{
							Source = source
						};
					}
				}
				else
				{
					image = new Image
					{
						Source = bitmapImage
					};
				}
			}
			bool reloadTile = list.Count > 0 || image == null;
			return new TileData(image, reloadTile);
		}

		public void RemoveTileAt(int level, int tileX, int tileY)
		{
			_cache.RemoveItemAt(level, tileX, tileY);
		}

		public void RemoveTilesAtLevel(int level)
		{
			_cache.RemoveItemsAtLevel(level);
		}

		public void ClearLevel(int level, int leftTile, int rightTile, int topTile, int bottomTile)
		{
			_cache.ClearLevel(level, leftTile, rightTile, topTile, bottomTile);
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			_cache.Clear();
		}

		internal void Reset()
		{
			_cache.Reset();
		}
	}

	[DontObfuscate]

	public class ShapefileConverter : DependencyObjectNotifier, IList<ShapefileRecord>, ICollection<ShapefileRecord>, IEnumerable<ShapefileRecord>, IEnumerable, INotifyCollectionChanged
	{
		private Rect _worldRect;

		private const string WorldRectPropertyName = "WorldRect";

		public static readonly DependencyProperty DeferImportCompletedProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("DeferImportCompleted", typeof(bool), typeof(ShapefileConverter), new PropertyMetadata(false, delegate(DependencyObject sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			(sender as ShapefileConverter).PropertyUpdated("DeferImportCompleted", e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
		}));

		private const string ShapefileSourcePropertyName = "ShapefileSource";

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ShapefileSourceProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ShapefileSource", typeof(Uri), typeof(ShapefileConverter), new PropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			(sender as ShapefileConverter).PropertyUpdated("ShapefileSource", e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
		}));

		private const string DatabaseSourcePropertyName = "DatabaseSource";

		public static readonly DependencyProperty DatabaseSourceProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("DatabaseSource", typeof(Uri), typeof(ShapefileConverter), new PropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			(sender as ShapefileConverter).PropertyUpdated("DatabaseSource", e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
		}));

		private bool _importFinished;

		private ObservableCollection<ShapefileRecord> _records;

		public const double MinLatitude = -85.05112878;

		public const double MaxLatitude = 85.05112878;

		public const double MinLongitude = -180.0;

		public const double MaxLongitude = 180.0;

		[DontObfuscate]
		public Rect WorldRect
		{
			get
			{
				return _worldRect;
			}
			private set
			{
				if (_worldRect != value)
				{
					Rect worldRect = _worldRect;
					_worldRect = value;
					PropertyUpdated("WorldRect", worldRect, _worldRect);
				}
			}
		}

			Records.CollectionChanged += delegate(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)

		private void PropertyUpdated(string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			if ((propertyName == "ShapefileSource" || propertyName == "DatabaseSource") && ShapefileSource != null && DatabaseSource != null)
			{
				ImportAsync();
			}
			OnPropertyChanged(propertyName);
		}

		public void SendImportCompleted()
		{
			if (DeferImportCompleted && _importFinished)
			{
				DeferImportCompleted = false;
				if (this.ImportCompleted != null)
				{
					this.ImportCompleted(this, new AsyncCompletedEventArgs(null, cancelled: false, null));
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnImportCompleted(AsyncCompletedEventArgs e)
		{
			_importFinished = true;
			if (DeferImportCompleted)
			{
				if (this.ImportPending != null)
				{
					this.ImportPending(this, e);
				}
			}
			else if (this.ImportCompleted != null)
			{
				this.ImportCompleted(this, e);
			}
		}

		private void ImportAsync()
		{
			MultiUriProcessor multiUriProcessor = new MultiUriProcessor(new Uri[2] { ShapefileSource, DatabaseSource });
			multiUriProcessor.GetBinaryReadersCompleted += delegate(object sender, MultiUriProcessor.GetBinaryReadersCompletedEventArgs e)
			{
				BinaryReader binaryReader = null;
				BinaryReader binaryReader2 = null;
				foreach (Uri key in e.Result.Keys)
				{
					if (key == ShapefileSource)
					{
						binaryReader = e.Result[key];
					}
					if (key == DatabaseSource)
					{
						binaryReader2 = e.Result[key];
					}
				}
				using (binaryReader)
				{
					if (!binaryReader.BaseStream.CanSeek)
					{
						MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
						byte[] array = new byte[512];
						int num = 1;
						while (num > 0)
						{
							num = binaryReader.Read(array, 0, array.Length);
							memoryStream.Write(array, 0, num);
						}
						memoryStream.Seek(0L, SeekOrigin.Begin);
						binaryReader = new BinaryReader(memoryStream);
					}
					ParseShapes(binaryReader, binaryReader2);
					if (!binaryReader.BaseStream.CanSeek)
					{
						binaryReader.Close();
					}
				}
				if (binaryReader2 != null)
				{
					binaryReader2.Close();
					binaryReader2.Dispose();
				}
				OnImportCompleted(new AsyncCompletedEventArgs(null, cancelled: false, null));
			};
			multiUriProcessor.GetBinaryReadersAsync();
		}

		private void ParseShapes(BinaryReader shpReader, BinaryReader dbfReader)
		{
			ShapeHeader = ShapeFileUtil.ReadHeader(shpReader, dbfReader);
			WorldRect = ShapeHeader.Bounds;
			long position = shpReader.BaseStream.Position;
			long length = shpReader.BaseStream.Length;
			Rect rect = Rect.Empty;
			while (position < length)
			{
				ShapefileRecord shapefileRecord = ShapeFileUtil.ReadShape(ShapeHeader, shpReader, dbfReader);
				bool flag = true;
				if (this.Filter != null)
				{
					ShapeFilterRecordEventArgs e = new ShapeFilterRecordEventArgs();
					e.ShouldInclude = true;
					e.Record = shapefileRecord;
					this.Filter(this, e);
					if (!e.ShouldInclude)
					{
						flag = false;
					}
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					Records.Add(shapefileRecord);
					if (rect.IsEmpty)
					{
						rect = shapefileRecord.Bounds;
					}
					else
					{
						rect.Union(shapefileRecord.Bounds);
					}
				}
				position = shpReader.BaseStream.Position;
				length = shpReader.BaseStream.Length;
			}
			ComputedWorldRect = (rect.IsEmpty ? WorldRect : rect);
		}

			return _records.Contains(item);
		}

		public void ShiftAllShapes(double offsetX, double offsetY)
		{
			if (Records != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < Records.Count; i++)
				{
					ShiftShapes(i, offsetX, offsetY);
				}
			}
		}

		public void ShiftShapes(int recordIndex, double offsetX, double offsetY)
		{
			if (Records == null || recordIndex < 0 || recordIndex > Records.Count - 1)
			{
				return;
			}
			List<List<Point>> list = new List<List<Point>>();
			foreach (List<Point> point in Records[recordIndex].Points)
			{
				foreach (List<Point> item in ShiftPoints(point, offsetX, offsetY))
				{
					list.Add(item);
				}
			}
			Records[recordIndex].Points = list;
		}

		private static double ShiftLongitude(double longitude, double offset)
		{
			return ShiftCoordinate(longitude, offset, -180.0, 180.0);
		}

		private static double ShiftLatitude(double latitude, double offset)
		{
			return ShiftCoordinate(latitude, offset, -85.05112878, 85.05112878);
		}

		private static double ShiftCoordinate(double latOrLongitude, double offset, double min, double max)
		{
			double num = latOrLongitude;
			if (double.IsNaN(offset) || offset == 0.0)
			{
				return num;
			}
			if (num + offset < min)
			{
				num += 2.0 * max;
				return num + offset;
			}
			if (num + offset > max)
			{
				num -= 2.0 * max;
				return num + offset;
			}
			return num + offset;
		}

		public static bool IsValidGeoPoint(Point coord)
		{
			if (coord.X < -180.0 || coord.X > 180.0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (coord.Y < -90.0 || coord.Y > 90.0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static bool IsValidGeoShape(List<Point> shapePoints)
		{
			if (shapePoints.Count < 3)
			{
				return false;
			}
			foreach (Point shapePoint in shapePoints)
			{
				if (!IsValidGeoPoint(shapePoint))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static List<List<Point>> ShiftPoints(List<Point> shapePoints, double offsetX, double offsetY, string code = "")
		{
			double val = double.MaxValue;
			double val2 = double.MinValue;
			List<Point> list = new List<Point>();
			foreach (Point shapePoint in shapePoints)
			{
				double num = ShiftCoordinate(shapePoint.X, offsetX, -180.0, 180.0);
				double y = ShiftCoordinate(shapePoint.Y, offsetY, -85.05112878, 85.05112878);
				val = Math.Min(val, num);
				val2 = Math.Max(val2, num);
				list.Add(new Point(num, y));
			}
			List<List<Point>> list2 = new List<List<Point>>();
			Rect bounds = GetBounds(list);
			_ = bounds.Width;
			if (bounds.Left >= -180.0 && bounds.Right <= 180.0 && bounds.Width > 180.0)
			{
				List<Point> list3 = new List<Point>();
				List<Point> list4 = new List<Point>();
				foreach (Point item in list)
				{
					if (item.X >= -180.0 && item.X < 0.0)
					{
						list3.Add(item);
					}
					else
					{
						list4.Add(item);
					}
				}
				_ = GetBounds(list3).Width;
				_ = GetBounds(list4).Width;
				if (IsValidGeoShape(list3))
				{
					list2.Add(list3);
				}
				if (IsValidGeoShape(list4))
				{
					list2.Add(list4);
				}
			}
			else if (IsValidGeoShape(list))
			{
				list2.Add(list);
			}
			return list2;
		}

		public double GetMaxLongitude(int recordIndex, bool useLargestShape, double fromLongitude, double toLongitude)
		{
			if (Records == null)
			{
				return double.NaN;
			}
			if (recordIndex < 0 || recordIndex > Records.Count - 1)
			{
				return double.NaN;
			}
			List<List<Point>> points = Records[recordIndex].Points;
			double num = fromLongitude;
			if (useLargestShape)
			{
				foreach (Point item in GetShapeWithBiggestSize(points))
				{
					if (item.X < toLongitude)
					{
						num = Math.Max(num, item.X);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				foreach (List<Point> item2 in points)
				{
					foreach (Point item3 in item2)
					{
						if (item3.X < toLongitude)
						{
							num = Math.Max(num, item3.X);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		public void SetRecordValue(int index, string fieldName, object value)
		{
			if (Records != null && index >= 0 && index <= Records.Count - 1)
			{
				ShapefileRecord shapefileRecord = Records[index];
				if (shapefileRecord != null && shapefileRecord.FieldsNames != null)
				{
					shapefileRecord.SetFieldValue(fieldName, value);
				}
			}
		}

		public object[] GetRecordValues(string fieldName)
		{
			if (Records == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			object[] array = new object[Records.Count];
			for (int i = 0; i < Records.Count; i++)
			{
				object recordValue = GetRecordValue(i, fieldName);
				array[i] = recordValue;
			}
			return array;
		}

		public void SetRecordValues(string fieldName, object[] values)
		{
			if (Records != null)
			{
				int num = Math.Min(values.Length, Records.Count);
				for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
				{
					SetRecordValue(i, fieldName, values[i]);
				}
			}
		}

		private static Rect GetBounds(List<Point> points)
		{
			double num = double.PositiveInfinity;
			double num2 = double.PositiveInfinity;
			double num3 = double.NegativeInfinity;
			double num4 = double.NegativeInfinity;
			for (int i = 0; i < points.Count; i++)
			{
				Point point = points[i];
				num = Math.Min(num, point.X);
				num2 = Math.Min(num2, point.Y);
				num3 = Math.Max(num3, point.X);
				num4 = Math.Max(num4, point.Y);
			}
			if (double.IsInfinity(num) || double.IsInfinity(num2) || double.IsInfinity(num2) || double.IsInfinity(num4))
			{
				return Rect.Empty;
			}
			return new Rect(num, num2, num3 - num, num4 - num2);
		}

		public Rect GetLargestShapeBoundsForRecord(int index)
		{
			if (Records == null)
			{
				return Rect.Empty;
			}
			if (index < 0 || index > Records.Count - 1)
			{
				return Rect.Empty;
			}
			ShapefileRecord shapefileRecord = Records[index];
			if (shapefileRecord == null || shapefileRecord.FieldsNames == null)
			{
				return Rect.Empty;
			}
			return GetBounds(GetShapeWithBiggestSize(shapefileRecord.Points));
		}

		private static List<Point> GetShapeWithBiggestSize(List<List<Point>> points)
		{
			List<Point> result = new List<Point>();
			double num = double.MinValue;
			foreach (List<Point> point in points)
			{
				double num2 = double.MaxValue;
				double num3 = double.MinValue;
				double num4 = double.MaxValue;
				double num5 = double.MinValue;
				foreach (Point item in point)
				{
					num4 = Math.Min(num4, item.Y);
					num5 = Math.Max(num5, item.Y);
					num2 = Math.Min(num2, item.X);
					num3 = Math.Max(num3, item.X);
				}
				double width = num3 - num2;
				double height = num5 - num4;
				Rect rect = new Rect(num2, num4, width, height);
				double num6 = rect.Width * rect.Height;
				if (num6 > num)
				{
					num = num6;
					result = point;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}
	}

	public class ShapefileRecordFields : INotifyCollectionChanged, IEnumerable<object>, IEnumerable
	{
		private List<object> Values { get; set; }

		private List<string> KeysInternal { get; set; }

		public IEnumerable<string> Keys => KeysInternal;

		public object this[string key]
		{
			get
			{
				int index = KeysInternal.IndexOf(key);
				return Values[index];
			}
			set
			{
				int index = KeysInternal.IndexOf(key);
				if (Values[index] != value)
				{
					object oldItem = Values[index];
					Values[index] = value;
					OnCollectionChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace, value, oldItem, index));
				}
			}
		}

		public object this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return Values[index];
			}
			set
			{
				if (Values[index] != value)
				{
					object oldItem = Values[index];
					Values[index] = value;
					OnCollectionChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace, value, oldItem, index));
				}
			}
		}

		public int Count => Values.Count;

		public event NotifyCollectionChangedEventHandler CollectionChanged;

		public bool ContainsKey(string key)
		{
			return KeysInternal.Contains(key);
		}

		public ShapefileRecordFields()
		{
			Values = new List<object>();
			KeysInternal = new List<string>();
		}

		public void Add(string key, object value)
		{
			Insert(Values.Count, key, value);
		}

		public void Insert(int index, string key, object value)
		{
			KeysInternal.Insert(index, key);
			Values.Insert(index, value);
			OnCollectionChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add, value, index));
		}

		public bool Remove(object item)
		{
			int num = Values.IndexOf(item);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			RemoveAt(num);
			return true;
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			object changedItem = Values[index];
			Values.RemoveAt(index);
			KeysInternal.RemoveAt(index);
			OnCollectionChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove, changedItem, index));
		}

		public int IndexOf(object item)
		{
			return Values.IndexOf(item);
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			KeysInternal.Clear();
			Values.Clear();
			OnCollectionChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset));
		}

		public bool Contains(object item)
		{
			return Values.Contains(item);
		}

		private void OnCollectionChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (this.CollectionChanged != null)
			{
				this.CollectionChanged(this, e);
			}
		}

		public IEnumerator<object> GetEnumerator()
		{
			return Values.GetEnumerator();
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return GetEnumerator();
		}
	}
	[DontObfuscate]
	[TSWidget]
	[HybridJavaWidget]
	[WidgetModule("GeographicMap")]
	public class ShapefileRecord : DependencyObject, INotifyPropertyChanged
	{
		private ShapefileRecordFields _Fields;

		private List<List<Point>> _Points;

		[DontObfuscate]
		[TSSuppressWidgetMember]
		public ShapeType ShapeType { get; internal set; }

		[DontObfuscate]
		[TSSuppressWidgetMember]
		public List<string> FieldsNames { get; internal set; }

		[DontObfuscate]
		[TSSuppressWidgetMember]
		public List<string> FieldsTypes { get; internal set; }

		public ShapefileRecordFields Fields
		{
			get
			{
				return _Fields;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_Fields != value)
				{
					if (Fields != null)
					{
						Fields.CollectionChanged -= Fields_CollectionChanged;
					}
					_Fields = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("Fields");
					if (Fields != null)
					{
						Fields.CollectionChanged += Fields_CollectionChanged;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		[WFSuppressWidgetMember]
		public List<List<Point>> Points
		{
			get
			{
				return _Points;
			}
			set
			{
				if (Points != value)
				{
					_Points = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("Points");
				}
			}
		}

		[DontObfuscate]
		public Rect Bounds { get; internal set; }

		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		public ShapefileRecord()
		{
			FieldsNames = new List<string>();
			FieldsTypes = new List<string>();
		}

		private void Fields_CollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			OnPropertyChanged("Fields");
		}

		private void OnPropertyChanged(string propertyName)
		{
			if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
			}
		}

		public object GetFieldValue(string fieldName)
		{
			if (Fields.ContainsKey(fieldName))
			{
				return Fields[fieldName];
			}
			return null;
		}

		public void SetFieldValue(string fieldName, object value)
		{
			if (Fields.ContainsKey(fieldName))
			{
				Fields[fieldName] = value;
				return;
			}
			FieldsNames.Add(fieldName);
			FieldsTypes.Add("string");
			Fields.Add(fieldName, value);
		}
	}
	public class Header
	{
		public List<XBaseField> dbfBaseFields = new List<XBaseField>();

		public ShapeType ShapeType { get; set; }

		public Rect Bounds { get; set; }

		public Point XYMin => new Point(Bounds.Left, Bounds.Top);

		public Point XYMax => new Point(Bounds.Right, Bounds.Bottom);
	}
	internal static class ShapeFileUtil
	{
		private static Dictionary<char, XBaseDataType> dbfBaseDataTypes;

		public static Header ReadHeader(BinaryReader shpReader, BinaryReader dbfReader)
		{
			Header header = new Header();
			if (swap(shpReader.ReadInt32()) != 9994)
			{
				throw new Exception("Corrupt Shp file - incorrect file code");
			}
			shpReader.ReadInt32();
			shpReader.ReadInt32();
			shpReader.ReadInt32();
			shpReader.ReadInt32();
			shpReader.ReadInt32();
			swap(shpReader.ReadInt32());
			shpReader.ReadInt32();
			header.ShapeType = (ShapeType)shpReader.ReadInt32();
			Point point = default(Point);
			Point point2 = default(Point);
			point.X = shpReader.ReadDouble();
			point.Y = shpReader.ReadDouble();
			point2.X = shpReader.ReadDouble();
			point2.Y = shpReader.ReadDouble();
			shpReader.ReadDouble();
			shpReader.ReadDouble();
			shpReader.ReadDouble();
			shpReader.ReadDouble();
			header.Bounds = new Rect(point.X, point.Y, point2.X - point.X, point2.Y - point.Y);
			if (dbfReader != null)
			{
				if (dbfReader.ReadByte() != 3)
				{
					throw new Exception("Corrupt Dbf file - wrong version number");
				}
				dbfReader.ReadByte();
				dbfReader.ReadByte();
				dbfReader.ReadByte();
				dbfReader.ReadUInt32();
				dbfReader.ReadUInt16();
				ushort num = dbfReader.ReadUInt16();
				dbfReader.ReadBytes(2);
				dbfReader.ReadBytes(1);
				dbfReader.ReadBytes(1);
				dbfReader.ReadBytes(4);
				dbfReader.ReadBytes(8);
				dbfReader.ReadBytes(1);
				dbfReader.ReadBytes(1);
				dbfReader.ReadBytes(2);
				XBaseField xBaseField;
				for (int i = 0; i < num - 1; i += xBaseField.Length)
				{
					xBaseField = new XBaseField();
					xBaseField.Name = Encoding.UTF8.GetString(dbfReader.ReadBytes(11), 0, 10).Replace("\0", "");
					char key = Encoding.UTF8.GetString(dbfReader.ReadBytes(1), 0, 1)[0];
					xBaseField.Type = dbfBaseDataTypes[key];
					dbfReader.ReadBytes(4);
					xBaseField.Length = dbfReader.ReadByte();
					dbfReader.ReadBytes(15);
					header.dbfBaseFields.Add(xBaseField);
				}
				if (dbfReader.ReadByte() != 13)
				{
					throw new Exception("Corrupt Dbf file - Missing field descriptor array terminator");
				}
			}
			return header;
		}

		public static ShapefileRecord ReadShape(Header shapeHeader, BinaryReader shpReader, BinaryReader dbfReader)
		{
			swap(shpReader.ReadInt32());
			swap(shpReader.ReadInt32());
			ShapeType shapeType = (ShapeType)shpReader.ReadInt32();
			ShapefileRecord shapefileRecord = null;
			switch (shapeType)
			{
			case ShapeType.Point:
				shapefileRecord = ReadSymbol(shpReader);
				break;
			case ShapeType.PolyLine:
				shapefileRecord = ReadPath(shpReader);
				break;
			case ShapeType.Polygon:
				shapefileRecord = ReadSurface(shpReader);
				break;
			case ShapeType.PolyLineZ:
				shapefileRecord = ReadPathZ(shpReader);
				break;
			case ShapeType.PolygonZ:
				shapefileRecord = ReadSurfaceZ(shpReader);
				break;
			}
			if (shapefileRecord == null)
			{
				throw new Exception("Corrupt Shp file - failed to read " + shapeType);
			}
			shapefileRecord.ShapeType = shapeType;
			if (dbfReader != null)
			{
				dbfReader.ReadBytes(1);
				shapefileRecord.Fields = new ShapefileRecordFields();
				foreach (XBaseField dbfBaseField in shapeHeader.dbfBaseFields)
				{
					shapefileRecord.FieldsNames.Add(dbfBaseField.Name);
					byte[] bytes = dbfReader.ReadBytes(dbfBaseField.Length);
					string text = Encoding.UTF8.GetString(bytes, 0, dbfBaseField.Length);
					switch (dbfBaseField.Type)
					{
					case XBaseDataType.Number:
					{
						shapefileRecord.FieldsTypes.Add("double");
						if (double.TryParse(text, NumberStyles.Number, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var result2))
						{
							shapefileRecord.Fields.Add(dbfBaseField.Name, result2);
						}
						break;
					}
					case XBaseDataType.FloatingPoint:
					{
						shapefileRecord.FieldsTypes.Add("float");
						if (float.TryParse(text, NumberStyles.Float, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var result3))
						{
							shapefileRecord.Fields.Add(dbfBaseField.Name, result3);
						}
						break;
					}
					case XBaseDataType.Character:
					{
						shapefileRecord.FieldsTypes.Add("string");
						string value = text.Trim();
						shapefileRecord.Fields.Add(dbfBaseField.Name, value);
						break;
					}
					case XBaseDataType.Date:
					{
						shapefileRecord.FieldsTypes.Add("date");
						if (DateTime.TryParse(text, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, DateTimeStyles.None, out var result))
						{
							shapefileRecord.Fields.Add(dbfBaseField.Name, result);
						}
						break;
					}
					default:
						throw new Exception("Unrecognized field type: " + dbfBaseField.Type);
					}
				}
			}
			return shapefileRecord;
		}

		private static void FlattenFieldOnRow(ShapefileRecord row_, string property_, object val_)
		{
		}

		private static int swap(int i)
		{
			return (int)(((i & 0xFF) << 24) | ((i & 0xFF00) << 8) | ((i & 0xFF0000) >> 8) | ((i & 0xFF000000u) >> 24));
		}

		private static ShapefileRecord ReadSymbol(BinaryReader shpReader)
		{
			Point point = new Point
			{
				X = shpReader.ReadDouble(),
				Y = shpReader.ReadDouble()
			};
			ShapefileRecord shapefileRecord = new ShapefileRecord();
			shapefileRecord.Bounds = new Rect(point, Size.Empty);
			shapefileRecord.Points = new List<List<Point>>(new List<Point>[1]
			{
				new List<Point>(new Point[1] { point })
			});
			return shapefileRecord;
		}

		private static ShapefileRecord ReadPathZ(BinaryReader shpReader)
		{
			int numParts;
			int numPoints;
			ShapefileRecord result = ReadPath(shpReader, out numParts, out numPoints);
			shpReader.ReadDouble();
			shpReader.ReadDouble();
			for (int i = 0; i < numPoints; i++)
			{
				shpReader.ReadDouble();
			}
			shpReader.ReadDouble();
			shpReader.ReadDouble();
			for (int j = 0; j < numPoints; j++)
			{
				shpReader.ReadDouble();
			}
			return result;
		}

		private static ShapefileRecord ReadPath(BinaryReader shpReader, out int numParts, out int numPoints)
		{
			Point item = default(Point);
			Point point = new Point
			{
				X = shpReader.ReadDouble(),
				Y = shpReader.ReadDouble()
			};
			Point point2 = new Point
			{
				X = shpReader.ReadDouble(),
				Y = shpReader.ReadDouble()
			};
			Rect bounds = new Rect(point.X, point.Y, point2.X - point.X, point2.Y - point.Y);
			numParts = shpReader.ReadInt32();
			numPoints = shpReader.ReadInt32();
			int[] array = new int[numParts];
			for (int i = 0; i < numParts; i++)
			{
				array[i] = shpReader.ReadInt32();
			}
			List<List<Point>> list = new List<List<Point>>();
			for (int j = 0; j < numParts; j++)
			{
				int num = ((j < numParts - 1) ? array[j + 1] : numPoints) - array[j];
				List<Point> list2 = new List<Point>(num - 1);
				for (int k = 0; k < num; k++)
				{
					item.X = shpReader.ReadDouble();
					item.Y = shpReader.ReadDouble();
					list2.Add(item);
				}
				if (list2.Count > 0)
				{
					list.Add(list2);
				}
			}
			return new ShapefileRecord
			{
				Bounds = bounds,
				Points = list
			};
		}

		private static ShapefileRecord ReadPath(BinaryReader shpReader)
		{
			int numParts;
			int numPoints;
			return ReadPath(shpReader, out numParts, out numPoints);
		}

		private static ShapefileRecord ReadSurfaceZ(BinaryReader shpReader)
		{
			int numParts;
			int numPoints;
			ShapefileRecord result = ReadSurface(shpReader, out numParts, out numPoints);
			shpReader.ReadDouble();
			shpReader.ReadDouble();
			for (int i = 0; i < numPoints; i++)
			{
				shpReader.ReadDouble();
			}
			shpReader.ReadDouble();
			shpReader.ReadDouble();
			for (int j = 0; j < numPoints; j++)
			{
				shpReader.ReadDouble();
			}
			return result;
		}

		private static ShapefileRecord ReadSurface(BinaryReader shpReader)
		{
			int numParts;
			int numPoints;
			return ReadSurface(shpReader, out numParts, out numPoints);
		}

		private static ShapefileRecord ReadSurface(BinaryReader shpReader, out int numParts, out int numPoints)
		{
			Point point = new Point
			{
				X = shpReader.ReadDouble(),
				Y = shpReader.ReadDouble()
			};
			Point point2 = new Point
			{
				X = shpReader.ReadDouble(),
				Y = shpReader.ReadDouble()
			};
			Rect bounds = new Rect(point.X, point.Y, point2.X - point.X, point2.Y - point.Y);
			Point item = default(Point);
			numParts = shpReader.ReadInt32();
			numPoints = shpReader.ReadInt32();
			int[] array = new int[numParts];
			for (int i = 0; i < numParts; i++)
			{
				array[i] = shpReader.ReadInt32();
			}
			List<List<Point>> list = new List<List<Point>>();
			for (int j = 0; j < numParts; j++)
			{
				int num = ((j < numParts - 1) ? array[j + 1] : numPoints) - array[j];
				List<Point> list2 = new List<Point>(num);
				item.X = shpReader.ReadDouble();
				item.Y = shpReader.ReadDouble();
				for (int k = 1; k < num; k++)
				{
					item.X = shpReader.ReadDouble();
					item.Y = shpReader.ReadDouble();
					list2.Add(item);
				}
				if (list2.Count > 1)
				{
					list.Add(list2);
				}
			}
			return new ShapefileRecord
			{
				Bounds = bounds,
				Points = list
			};
		}

			dbfBaseDataTypes = new Dictionary<char, XBaseDataType>();

	public class ArcGISOnlineTileSource : MapTileSource
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty MapServerUriProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("MapServerUri", typeof(string), typeof(ArcGISOnlineTileSource), new PropertyMetadata(null, OnPropertyChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsMapPublicProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("IsMapPublic", typeof(bool), typeof(ArcGISOnlineTileSource), new PropertyMetadata(true, OnPropertyChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty LevelOfDetailProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("LevelOfDetail", typeof(int), typeof(ArcGISOnlineTileSource), new PropertyMetadata(-1, OnPropertyChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty UserTokenProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("UserToken", typeof(string), typeof(ArcGISOnlineTileSource), new PropertyMetadata(null, OnPropertyChanged));

		public string MapServerUri
		{

				return (string)GetValue(MapServerUriProperty);

		public ArcGISOnlineTileSource()
			: base(2097152, 2097152, 256, 256, 0)
		{
		}

		protected override void GetTileLayers(int tileLevel, int tilePositionX, int tilePositionY, IList<object> tileImageLayerSources)
		{
			string text = MapServerUri + "/tile/{0}/{1}/{2}";
			string text2 = "";
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(MapServerUri) || LevelOfDetail < 1 || !Uri.IsWellFormedUriString(MapServerUri, UriKind.Absolute))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!IsMapPublic)
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(UserToken))
				{
					return;
				}
				text += "?token={3}";
				text2 = UserToken.Trim();
			}
			int num = tileLevel - 8;
			if (num > 0)
			{
				string uriString = string.Format(text, num, tilePositionY, tilePositionX, text2);
				tileImageLayerSources.Add(new Uri(uriString));
			}
		}

		private static void OnPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ArcGISOnlineTileSource arcGISOnlineTileSource = (ArcGISOnlineTileSource)d;
			if (e.Property == MapServerUriProperty)
			{
				if (arcGISOnlineTileSource.MapServerUri != e.NewValue as string)
				{
					arcGISOnlineTileSource.MapServerUri = e.NewValue as string;
				}
				arcGISOnlineTileSource.InvalidateTileLayer(0, 0, 0, 0);
			}
			if (e.Property == UserTokenProperty)
			{
				if (arcGISOnlineTileSource.UserToken != e.NewValue as string)
				{
					arcGISOnlineTileSource.UserToken = e.NewValue as string;
				}
				arcGISOnlineTileSource.InvalidateTileLayer(0, 0, 0, 0);
			}
			if (e.Property == LevelOfDetailProperty)
			{
				arcGISOnlineTileSource.ImageWidth = (long)(Math.Pow(2.0, arcGISOnlineTileSource.LevelOfDetail - 1) * 256.0);
				arcGISOnlineTileSource.ImageHeight = (long)(Math.Pow(2.0, arcGISOnlineTileSource.LevelOfDetail - 1) * 256.0);
			}
			if (e.Property == IsMapPublicProperty)
			{
				arcGISOnlineTileSource.InvalidateTileLayer(0, 0, 0, 0);
			}
		}
	}
	public sealed class BingMapsTileSource : MapTileSource
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty TilePathProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("TilePath", typeof(string), typeof(BingMapsTileSource), new PropertyMetadata(null, OnPropertyChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty SubDomainsProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("SubDomains", typeof(ObservableCollection<string>), typeof(BingMapsTileSource), new PropertyMetadata(null, OnPropertyChanged));

		private string _cultureName;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty CultureNameProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("CultureName", typeof(string), typeof(BingMapsTileSource), new PropertyMetadata(null, OnPropertyChanged));

		public string TilePath
		{
			get
			{
				return (string)GetValue(TilePathProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(TilePathProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public ObservableCollection<string> SubDomains
		{
			get
			{
				return (ObservableCollection<string>)GetValue(SubDomainsProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(SubDomainsProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public string CultureName
		{
			get
			{
				return (string)GetValue(CultureNameProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(CultureNameProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public BingMapsTileSource()
			: base(1073741824, 1073741824, 256, 256, 0)
		{
			_cultureName = Thread.CurrentThread.CurrentCulture.Name;
		}

		public BingMapsTileSource(string tilePath, ObservableCollection<string> subDomains)
			: this()
		{
			TilePath = tilePath;
			SubDomains = subDomains;
		}

		private void subdomains_CollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			InvalidateTileLayer(0, 0, 0, 0);
		}

		protected override void GetTileLayers(int tileLevel, int tilePositionX, int tilePositionY, IList<object> tileImageLayerSources)
		{
			if (!ValidateTileSourceProperties())
			{
				tileImageLayerSources.Clear();
			}
			else
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(TilePath))
				{
					return;
				}
				tileLevel -= 8;
				if (tileLevel <= 0)
				{
					return;
				}
				string quadKey = GetQuadKey(tileLevel, tilePositionX, tilePositionY);
				string tilePath = TilePath;
				tilePath = tilePath.Replace("{culture}", _cultureName);
				tilePath = tilePath.Replace("{quadkey}", quadKey);
				int num = Convert.ToInt32(quadKey.Substring(quadKey.Length - 1, 1));
				if (SubDomains != null && num < SubDomains.Count)
				{
					tilePath = tilePath.Replace("{subdomain}", SubDomains[num]);
					tilePath = tilePath.Replace("&token={token}", "");
					if (Uri.IsWellFormedUriString(tilePath, UriKind.Absolute))
					{
						tileImageLayerSources.Add(new Uri(tilePath));
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private bool ValidateTileSourceProperties()
		{
			bool result = true;
			if (ReadLocalValue(TilePathProperty) == DependencyProperty.UnsetValue || string.IsNullOrEmpty(TilePath))
			{
				result = false;
			}
			if (ReadLocalValue(SubDomainsProperty) == DependencyProperty.UnsetValue || SubDomains == null || SubDomains.Count == 0)
			{
				result = false;
			}
			return result;
		}

		private string GetQuadKey(int tileLevel, int tilePositionX, int tilePositionY)
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			for (int num = tileLevel; num > 0; num--)
			{
				char c = '0';
				int num2 = 1 << num - 1;
				if ((tilePositionX & num2) != 0)
				{
					c = (char)(c + 1);
				}
				if ((tilePositionY & num2) != 0)
				{
					c = (char)(c + 1);
					c = (char)(c + 1);
				}
				stringBuilder.Append(c);
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		private static void OnPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			BingMapsTileSource bingMapsTileSource = (BingMapsTileSource)d;
			if (e.Property != SubDomainsProperty && e.Property != TilePathProperty && e.Property != CultureNameProperty)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (e.Property == SubDomainsProperty)
			{
				ObservableCollection<string> observableCollection = e.OldValue as ObservableCollection<string>;
				ObservableCollection<string> observableCollection2 = e.NewValue as ObservableCollection<string>;
				if (observableCollection != null)
				{
					observableCollection.CollectionChanged -= bingMapsTileSource.subdomains_CollectionChanged;
				}
				if (observableCollection2 != null)
				{
					observableCollection2.CollectionChanged += bingMapsTileSource.subdomains_CollectionChanged;
				}
			}
			if (e.Property == CultureNameProperty)
			{
				bingMapsTileSource._cultureName = (string)e.NewValue;
			}
			bingMapsTileSource.InvalidateTileLayer(0, 0, 0, 0);
		}
	}

		{

				string tilePathMapnik = TilePathMapnik;
				tilePathMapnik = tilePathMapnik.Replace("{Z}", num.ToString());
				tilePathMapnik = tilePathMapnik.Replace("{X}", tilePositionX.ToString());
				tilePathMapnik = tilePathMapnik.Replace("{Y}", tilePositionY.ToString());
				tileImageLayerSources.Add(new Uri(tilePathMapnik));
			}
		}

		public void SetTilePathUrl(string url)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(url))
			{
				if (url.StartsWith("http://") || url.StartsWith("https://"))
				{
					TilePathMapnik = url;
					return;
				}
				string text = "http://";
				TilePathMapnik = text + url;
			}
		}

	[WidgetModule("GeographicMap")]
	[TSWidget("TriangulationDataSource")]
	public class ItfConverter : DependencyObject, INotifyPropertyChanged
	{
		private const string SourcePropertyName = "Source";

		public static readonly DependencyProperty SourceProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Source", typeof(Uri), typeof(ItfConverter), new PropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			(sender as ItfConverter).PropertyUpdated("Source", e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
		}));

		private const string TriangulationSourcePropertyName = "TriangulationSource";

		private TriangulationSource _TriangulationSource;

		[DontObfuscate]
		[TSSuppressWidgetMember]
		public Uri Source
		{
			get
			{
				return GetValue(SourceProperty) as Uri;
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(SourceProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[TSSuppressWidgetMember]
		public TriangulationSource TriangulationSource
		{
			get
			{
				return _TriangulationSource;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != TriangulationSource)
				{
					object triangulationSource = _TriangulationSource;
					_TriangulationSource = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("TriangulationSource", triangulationSource, TriangulationSource);
				}
			}
		}

		public event AsyncCompletedEventHandler ImportCompleted;

		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		private void ImportAsync()
		{
			UriProcessor uriProcessor = new UriProcessor(Source);
			uriProcessor.GetBinaryReaderCompleted += delegate(object sender, UriProcessor.GetBinaryReaderCompletedEventArgs e)
			{
				if (!e.Cancelled && e.Error == null && e.Result != null)
				{
					TriangulationSource = TriangulationSource.LoadItf(e.Result);
				}
				OnImportCompleted(new AsyncCompletedEventArgs(null, cancelled: false, null));
			};
			uriProcessor.GetBinaryReaderAsync();
		}

		private void OnImportCompleted(AsyncCompletedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (this.ImportCompleted != null)
			{
				this.ImportCompleted(this, e);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void PropertyUpdated(string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			if (propertyName == "Source" && Source != null)
			{
				ImportAsync();
			}
		}

		protected void OnPropertyChanged(string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
			}
			PropertyUpdated(propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
		}
	}

	internal class TilePositionComparer : IEqualityComparer<Tile>
	{
		public bool Equals(Tile x, Tile y)
		{
			if (x.X == y.X && x.Y == y.Y)
			{
				return x.Z == y.Z;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public int GetHashCode(Tile obj)
		{
			return ((23 * 31 + obj.X) * 31 + obj.Y) * 31 + obj.Z;
		}
	}

						ContentPresenter.Content = View.Canvas;
					}
					Refresh();
				}
			}
		}

					_deferralHandler.UnRegister(this);
				}
				_deferralHandler = value;
				if (_deferralHandler != null)
				{
					_deferralHandler.Register(this, RefreshInternal);
				}
			}
		}
