		public XamMultiScaleImage()
		{
			CanvasSize = Rect.Empty;
			View = new XamMultiScaleImageView(this);
			base.DefaultStyleKey = typeof(XamMultiScaleImage);
			ActualViewportOrigin = ViewportOrigin;
			ActualViewportWidth = ViewportWidth;
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			ContentPresenter = GetTemplateChild("ContentPresenter") as ContentPresenter;
		}

		internal string GetResolvedReferer()
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(Referer))
			{
				return Referer;
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal string GetResolvedUserAgent()
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(UserAgent))
			{
				return UserAgent;
			}
			Assembly entryAssembly = Assembly.GetEntryAssembly();
			if (entryAssembly != null)
			{
				return entryAssembly.GetName().Name;
			}
			return Process.GetCurrentProcess().ProcessName;
		}

		protected virtual void OnPropertyChanged(string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			PropertyChangedEventArgs e = new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName);
			if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.PropertyChanged(this, e);
			}
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "Source":
				if (Source != null)
				{
					Source.MultiScaleImage = this;
				}
				PurgeCache();
				ResetTiles();
				Refresh();
				break;
			case "ViewportOrigin":
				Spring();
				break;
			case "ViewportWidth":
				Spring();
				break;
			case "UseSprings":
				if (!UseSprings)
				{
					View.DisableSprings();
				}
				break;
			case "IsHorizontalTileWrappingEnabled":
				CachedIsHorizontalTileWrappingEnabled = IsHorizontalTileWrappingEnabled;
				Refresh();
				break;
			}
		}

		private void ResetTiles()
		{
			TrashActiveTiles();
			if (Source != null)
			{
				LevelOffset = Convert.ToInt32(Math.Log(Source.TileWidth, 2.0));
				MaxLevel = Convert.ToInt32(Math.Log(Source.ImageWidth, 2.0));
			}
		}

		public void InvalidateTileLayer(int level, int tilePositionX, int tilePositionY, int tileLayer)
		{
			PurgeCache();
			ResetTiles();
			Refresh();
		}

		private void Spring()
		{
			if (UseSprings)
			{
				SpringStart = DateTime.Now;
				anchorViewportOrigin = ActualViewportOrigin;
				anchorViewportWidth = ActualViewportWidth;
				View.StartSpringTimer();
			}
			else
			{
				ActualViewportOrigin = ViewportOrigin;
				ActualViewportWidth = ViewportWidth;
				Refresh();
			}
		}

		internal void SpringTimer_Tick()
		{
			double num = 2.0;
			double num2 = MathUtil.Clamp((DateTime.Now - SpringStart).TotalSeconds / num, 0.0, 1.0);
			double num3 = ((SpringsEasingFunction != null) ? SpringsEasingFunction.Ease(num2) : num2);
			double num4 = 1.0 - num3;
			ActualViewportWidth = anchorViewportWidth * num4 + ViewportWidth * num3;
			ActualViewportOrigin = new Point(anchorViewportOrigin.X * num4 + ViewportOrigin.X * num3, anchorViewportOrigin.Y * num4 + ViewportOrigin.Y * num3);
			if (num2 >= 1.0)
			{
				View.StopSpringTimer();
			}
			Refresh();
		}

		private int ActiveTileIndex(int positionX, int x, int y, int z)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < activeTiles.Count; i++)
			{
				if (activeTiles[i].PositionX == positionX && activeTiles[i].X == x && activeTiles[i].Y == y && activeTiles[i].Z == z)
				{
					return i;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		internal void RefreshInternal(bool animate)
		{
			refreshDeferred = false;
			_lastReady = false;
			bool cachedIsHorizontalTileWrappingEnabled = CachedIsHorizontalTileWrappingEnabled;
			if (Source == null || !View.Ready() || CanvasSize.Width == 0.0 || CanvasSize.Height == 0.0)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = (int)Math.Ceiling(CanvasSize.Width / (double)Source.TileWidth);
			int num2 = (int)Math.Max(1.0, Math.Floor(0.0 - Math.Log(ActualViewportWidth / (double)num, 2.0)));
			if (num2 >= MaxLevel - 8)
			{
				num2 = MaxLevel - 8 - 1;
			}
			int num3 = Convert.ToInt32(Math.Pow(2.0, num2));
			double actualViewportWidth = ActualViewportWidth;
			double num4 = CanvasSize.Height * actualViewportWidth / CanvasSize.Width;
			double num5 = (double)Source.ImageWidth / Math.Pow(2.0, num2);
			double num6 = (double)Source.ImageHeight / Math.Pow(2.0, num2);
			int num7 = (int)Math.Floor(ActualViewportOrigin.X * (double)Source.ImageWidth / num5);
			int num8 = (int)Math.Ceiling((ActualViewportOrigin.X + actualViewportWidth) * (double)Source.ImageWidth / num5);
			int val = (int)Math.Floor(ActualViewportOrigin.Y * (double)Source.ImageHeight / num6);
			int val2 = (int)Math.Ceiling((ActualViewportOrigin.Y + num4) * (double)Source.ImageWidth / num6);
			if (!cachedIsHorizontalTileWrappingEnabled)
			{
				num7 = Math.Max(num7, 0);
				num8 = Math.Min(num8, num3);
			}
			val = Math.Max(val, 0);
			val2 = Math.Min(val2, num3);
			double num9 = ((double)num7 * num5 - ActualViewportOrigin.X * (double)Source.ImageWidth) / num5;
			double num10 = ((double)val * num6 - ActualViewportOrigin.Y * (double)Source.ImageHeight) / num6;
			double num11 = actualViewportWidth * (double)Source.ImageWidth / num5 * ((double)Source.TileWidth / CanvasSize.Width);
			List<Tile> list = new List<Tile>();
			for (int i = num7; i < num8; i++)
			{
				int positionX = i;
				int num12;
				for (num12 = i; num12 < 0; num12 = num3 + num12)
				{
				}
				while (num12 > num3 - 1)
				{
					num12 -= num3;
				}
				for (int j = val; j < val2; j++)
				{
					int num13 = ActiveTileIndex(positionX, num12, j, num2);
					if (num13 >= 0)
					{
						list.Add(activeTiles[num13]);
						activeTiles.RemoveAt(num13);
						continue;
					}
					list.Add(new Tile
					{
						PositionX = positionX,
						X = num12,
						Y = j,
						Z = num2
					});
				}
			}
			ImagePool.DeferDisactivate = true;
			TrashActiveTiles();
			activeTiles = list;
			for (int k = 0; k < activeTiles.Count; k++)
			{
				if (activeTiles[k].Image == null)
				{
					activeTiles[k].Image = ImagePool.Pop();
					activeTiles[k].Image.Opacity = 1.0;
					View.SendToBackground(activeTiles[k].Image);
					WriteableBitmap cachedBitmap = GetCachedBitmap(activeTiles[k]);
					if (cachedBitmap != null)
					{
						activeTiles[k].Image.Source = cachedBitmap;
					}
					else
					{
						WriteableBitmap writeableBitmap = null;
						Tile tile = new Tile
						{
							X = activeTiles[k].X,
							Y = activeTiles[k].Y,
							Z = activeTiles[k].Z
						};
						while (tile.Z >= 0 && writeableBitmap == null)
						{
							tile.X >>= 1;
							tile.Y >>= 1;
							tile.Z--;
							writeableBitmap = GetCachedBitmap(tile);
						}
						if (writeableBitmap != null)
						{
							int num14 = (int)Math.Pow(2.0, activeTiles[k].Z - tile.Z);
							int num15 = 256 / num14;
							int x = num15 * (activeTiles[k].X % num14);
							int y = num15 * (activeTiles[k].Y % num14);
							activeTiles[k].GhostImage = ImagePool.Pop();
							activeTiles[k].GhostImage.Opacity = 1.0;
							View.SendToForeground(activeTiles[k].GhostImage);
							num15 = Math.Max(1, num15);
							activeTiles[k].GhostImage.Source = new CroppedBitmap(writeableBitmap, new Int32Rect(x, y, num15, num15));
						}
						View.Download(activeTiles[k]);
					}
				}
				double num16 = (double)Source.TileWidth / num11;
				double num17 = (double)Source.TileHeight / num11;
				double il = ((double)(activeTiles[k].PositionX - num7) + num9) * num16;
				double it = ((double)(activeTiles[k].Y - val) + num10) * num17;
				activeTiles[k].Image.Width = num16 + 0.5;
				activeTiles[k].Image.Height = num17 + 0.5;
				View.SetImagePosition(activeTiles[k].Image, il, it);
				if (activeTiles[k].GhostImage != null)
				{
					activeTiles[k].GhostImage.Width = num16 + 0.5;
					activeTiles[k].GhostImage.Height = num17 + 0.5;
					View.SetImagePosition(activeTiles[k].GhostImage, il, it);
				}
			}
			ImagePool.DeferDisactivate = false;
			View.RefreshCompleted();
		}

		internal void Refresh()
		{
			if (Source != null && View.Ready() && CanvasSize.Width != 0.0 && CanvasSize.Height != 0.0 && !refreshDeferred)
			{
				refreshDeferred = true;
				View.Defer(RefreshInternal);
			}
		}

		private void TrashActiveTiles()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < activeTiles.Count; i++)
			{
				View.CancelDownload(activeTiles[i]);
				CancelFade(activeTiles[i]);
				if (activeTiles[i].Image != null)
				{
					ImagePool.Push(activeTiles[i].Image);
					activeTiles[i].Image.Source = null;
					activeTiles[i].Image = null;
				}
			}
		}

		private void PurgeCache()
		{
			Cache.Clear();
		}

		private WriteableBitmap GetCachedBitmap(Tile tile)
		{
			return Cache[tile];
		}

		internal void CacheBitmap(Tile tile, WriteableBitmap bitmap)
		{
			Cache[tile] = bitmap;
		}

		internal bool IsImageStreamValid(Stream stream)
		{
			bool flag = true;
			if (this.ImageStreamValid != null)
			{
				flag = this.ImageStreamValid(this, new ImageStreamValidEventArgs(stream));
				if (flag && stream.CanSeek)
				{
					stream.Seek(0L, SeekOrigin.Begin);
				}
				else if (!flag)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			if (flag && Source != null)
			{
				if (!Source.IsImageStreamValid(stream))
				{
					flag = false;
				}
				if (flag && stream.CanSeek)
				{
					stream.Seek(0L, SeekOrigin.Begin);
				}
			}
			return flag;
		}

		internal bool IsDuringFade()
		{
			return fadingTiles.Count != 0;
		}

		protected internal void NotifyReady()
		{
			bool flag = true;
			if (IsDuringFade())
			{
				flag = false;
			}
			if (!View.ImagesReady())
			{
				flag = false;
			}
			if (flag && !_lastReady && this.ImageTilesReady != null)
			{
				this.ImageTilesReady(this, new EventArgs());
			}
			_lastReady = flag;
		}

		internal void StartFade(Tile tile)
		{
			if (tile.GhostImage != null)
			{
				tile.FadeStart = DateTime.Now;
				fadingTiles.Add(tile);
				View.StartFadeTimer();
			}
			else
			{
				NotifyReady();
			}
		}

		private void CancelFade(Tile tile)
		{
			if (tile.GhostImage == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ImagePool.Push(tile.GhostImage);
			tile.GhostImage.Source = null;
			tile.GhostImage = null;
			for (int i = 0; i < fadingTiles.Count; i++)
			{
				if (fadingTiles[i] == tile)
				{
					fadingTiles.RemoveAt(i);
					break;
				}
			}
			if (fadingTiles.Count == 0)
			{
				View.StopFadeTimer();
			}
		}

		internal void FadeTimer_Tick()
		{
			DateTime now = DateTime.Now;
			double num = 0.5;
			int num2 = 0;
			while (num2 < fadingTiles.Count)
			{
				double value = (now - fadingTiles[num2].FadeStart).TotalSeconds / num;
				value = MathUtil.Clamp(value, 0.0, 1.0);
				fadingTiles[num2].GhostImage.Opacity = 1.0 - value;
				if (value >= 1.0)
				{
					ImagePool.Push(fadingTiles[num2].GhostImage);
					fadingTiles[num2].GhostImage.Source = null;
					fadingTiles[num2].GhostImage = null;
					fadingTiles.RemoveAt(num2);
				}
				else
				{
					num2++;
				}
				View.FadingChanged();
			}
			if (fadingTiles.Count == 0)
			{
				View.StopFadeTimer();
			}
		}

		internal void OnSpringsDisabled()
		{
			ActualViewportWidth = ViewportWidth;
			ActualViewportOrigin = ViewportOrigin;
			Refresh();
		}

		internal void DeferCancelled()
		{
			refreshDeferred = false;
		}

		protected internal void OnDownloadingImage(DownloadingMultiScaleImageEventArgs args)
		{
			if (this.DownloadingImage != null)
			{
				this.DownloadingImage(this, args);
			}
		}

		protected internal void OnCancellingImage(CancellingMultiScaleImageEventArgs args)
		{
			if (this.CancellingImage != null)
			{
				this.CancellingImage(this, args);
			}
		}

		public void PixelScalingRatioChanged(double pixelRatio)
		{
			_pixelRatio = pixelRatio;
		}
	}

	public abstract class XamMultiScaleTileSource : DependencyObject
	{
		private long _imageWidth;

		private long _imageHeight;

		private double _opacity = 1.0;

		private bool _isHorizontalTileWrappingEnabled;

		private XamMultiScaleImage _multiScaleImage;

		public long ImageWidth
		{
			get
			{
				return _imageWidth;
			}
			protected internal set
			{
				_imageWidth = value;
				InvalidateTileLayer(0, 0, 0, 0);
			}
		}

		public long ImageHeight
		{
			get
			{
				return _imageHeight;
			}
			protected internal set
			{
				_imageHeight = value;
				InvalidateTileLayer(0, 0, 0, 0);
			}
		}

		public double Opacity
		{
			get
			{
				return _opacity;
			}
			set
			{
				_opacity = value;
				if (MultiScaleImage != null)
				{
					MultiScaleImage.Opacity = _opacity;
				}
			}
		}

		public bool IsHorizontalTileWrappingEnabled
		{
			get
			{
				return _isHorizontalTileWrappingEnabled;
			}
			set
			{
				_isHorizontalTileWrappingEnabled = value;
				if (MultiScaleImage != null)
				{
					MultiScaleImage.IsHorizontalTileWrappingEnabled = _isHorizontalTileWrappingEnabled;
				}
			}
		}

		public int TileWidth { get; private set; }

		public int TileHeight { get; private set; }

		public int TileOverlap { get; private set; }

		internal XamMultiScaleImage MultiScaleImage
		{
			get
			{
				return _multiScaleImage;
			}
			set
			{
				_multiScaleImage = value;
				if (_multiScaleImage != null)
				{
					_multiScaleImage.Opacity = Opacity;
				}
			}
		}

		protected XamMultiScaleTileSource(long imageWidth, long imageHeight, int tileWidth, int tileHeight, int tileOverlap)
		{
			_imageWidth = imageWidth;
			_imageHeight = imageHeight;
			TileWidth = tileWidth;
			TileHeight = tileHeight;
			TileOverlap = tileOverlap;
		}

		internal Uri GetTileUri(int tileLevel, int tilePositionX, int tilePositionY)
		{
			List<object> list = new List<object>();
			GetTileLayers(tileLevel, tilePositionX, tilePositionY, list);
			Uri result = null;
			if (list.Count > 0)
			{
				result = list[0] as Uri;
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected abstract void GetTileLayers(int tileLevel, int tilePositionX, int tilePositionY, IList<object> tileImageLayerSources);

		protected void InvalidateTileLayer(int level, int tilePositionX, int tilePositionY, int tileLayer)
		{
			if (MultiScaleImage != null)
			{
				MultiScaleImage.InvalidateTileLayer(level, tilePositionX, tilePositionY, tileLayer);
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual bool IsImageStreamValid(Stream stream)
		{
			bool result = false;
			if (stream.Length < 16)
			{
				return false;
			}
			StreamReader streamReader = new StreamReader(stream);
			char[] array = new char[16];
			streamReader.Read(array, 0, 16);
			if ((((array[1] == 'P') & (array[2] == 'N')) && array[3] == 'G') | ((array[6] == 'J') & (array[7] == 'F') & (array[8] == 'I') & (array[9] == 'F')))
			{
				result = true;
			}
			stream.Seek(0L, SeekOrigin.Begin);
			return result;
		}
	}
	public enum LineCap

	internal class MultiUriProcessor
	{
		internal class ProgressMonitor
		{
			private Dictionary<object, bool> PartsCompleted { get; set; }

			internal event EventHandler<EventArgs> Completed;

			internal ProgressMonitor(IEnumerable parts)
			{
				if (parts == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException("parts");
				}
				PartsCompleted = new Dictionary<object, bool>();
				foreach (object part in parts)
				{
					if (part != null)
					{
						PartsCompleted.Add(part, value: false);
					}
				}
			}

			internal void RegisterComplete(object part, bool complete)
			{
				if (PartsCompleted.ContainsKey(part))
				{
					PartsCompleted[part] = complete;
				}
				CheckComplete();
			}

			private void CheckComplete()
			{
				foreach (KeyValuePair<object, bool> item in PartsCompleted)
				{
					if (!item.Value)
					{
						return;
					}
				}
				OnCompleted();
			}

			private void OnCompleted()
			{
				if (this.Completed != null)
				{
					this.Completed(this, new EventArgs());
				}
			}
		}

		internal class GetBinaryReadersCompletedEventArgs : AsyncCompletedEventArgs
		{
			internal Dictionary<Uri, BinaryReader> Result { get; private set; }

			internal GetBinaryReadersCompletedEventArgs(Dictionary<Uri, BinaryReader> result, Exception error, bool cancelled, object userState)
				: base(error, cancelled, userState)
			{
				Result = result;
			}
		}

		private List<Uri> Uris { get; set; }

		internal event EventHandler<GetBinaryReadersCompletedEventArgs> GetBinaryReadersCompleted;

		internal MultiUriProcessor(Uri[] uris)
		{
			if (uris == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("uris");
			}
			Uris = new List<Uri>(uris);
		}

		internal void GetBinaryReadersAsync()
		{
			Dictionary<Uri, BinaryReader> readers = new Dictionary<Uri, BinaryReader>(Uris.Count);
			ProgressMonitor monitor = new ProgressMonitor(Uris);
			monitor.Completed += delegate
			{
				OnGetBinaryReadersCompleted(new GetBinaryReadersCompletedEventArgs(readers, null, cancelled: false, null));
			};
			foreach (Uri uri in Uris)
			{
				UriProcessor processor = new UriProcessor(uri);
				processor.GetBinaryReaderCompleted += delegate(object sender, UriProcessor.GetBinaryReaderCompletedEventArgs e)
				{
					readers.Add(processor.Uri, e.Result);
					monitor.RegisterComplete(processor.Uri, e.Error == null);
				};
				processor.GetBinaryReaderAsync();
			}
		}

		private void OnGetBinaryReadersCompleted(GetBinaryReadersCompletedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (this.GetBinaryReadersCompleted != null)
			{
				this.GetBinaryReadersCompleted(this, e);
			}
		}
	}
	internal class UriProcessor
	{
		internal class GetBinaryReaderCompletedEventArgs : AsyncCompletedEventArgs
		{
			internal BinaryReader Result { get; private set; }

			internal GetBinaryReaderCompletedEventArgs(BinaryReader result, Exception error, bool cancelled, object userState)
				: base(error, cancelled, userState)
			{
				Result = result;
			}
		}

		internal Uri Uri { get; private set; }

		internal event EventHandler<GetBinaryReaderCompletedEventArgs> GetBinaryReaderCompleted;

		internal UriProcessor(Uri uri)
		{
			if (uri == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("uri");
			}
			Uri = uri;
		}

		internal void GetBinaryReaderAsync()
		{
			try
			{
				if (!Uri.IsAbsoluteUri)
				{
					StreamResourceInfo resourceStream = Application.GetResourceStream(new Uri(Uri.OriginalString, UriKind.Relative));
					if (resourceStream != null)
					{
						Stream stream = resourceStream.Stream;
						OnGetBinaryReaderCompleted(new GetBinaryReaderCompletedEventArgs(new BinaryReader(stream), null, cancelled: false, null));
						return;
					}
				}
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
			}
			if (Uri.Host.Contains("siteoforigin:"))
			{
				try
				{
					BinaryReader result = new BinaryReader(Application.GetRemoteStream(Uri).Stream);
					OnGetBinaryReaderCompleted(new GetBinaryReaderCompletedEventArgs(result, null, cancelled: false, null));
					return;
				}
				catch (FileNotFoundException error)
				{
					OnGetBinaryReaderCompleted(new GetBinaryReaderCompletedEventArgs(null, error, cancelled: false, null));
					return;
				}
			}
			WebClient webClient = new WebClient();
			webClient.OpenReadCompleted += delegate(object sender, OpenReadCompletedEventArgs e)
			{
				BinaryReader result2 = ((e.Error != null || e.Result == null) ? null : new BinaryReader(e.Result));
				OnGetBinaryReaderCompleted(new GetBinaryReaderCompletedEventArgs(result2, e.Error, e.Cancelled, e.UserState));
			};
			webClient.OpenReadAsync(Uri);
		}

		private void OnGetBinaryReaderCompleted(GetBinaryReaderCompletedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (this.GetBinaryReaderCompleted != null)
			{
				this.GetBinaryReaderCompleted(this, e);
			}
		}
	}
	internal class XamMultiScaleImageView
	{
		internal readonly Canvas Canvas = new Canvas
		{
			UseLayoutRounding = false,
			SnapsToDevicePixels = true
		};

		private readonly List<WebClient> DownloadClient = new List<WebClient>();

		private List<Tile> pendingTiles = new List<Tile>();

		private readonly List<Tile> DownloadTile = new List<Tile>();

		private readonly DispatcherTimer FadeTimer = new DispatcherTimer
		{
			Interval = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(0.05)
		};

		private DispatcherTimer SpringTimer = new DispatcherTimer
		{
			Interval = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(0.05)
		};

		protected XamMultiScaleImage Model { get; set; }

		public XamMultiScaleImageView(XamMultiScaleImage model)
		{
			Model = model;
			FadeTimer.Tick += delegate
			{
				Model.FadeTimer_Tick();
			};
			SpringTimer.Tick += delegate
			{
				Model.SpringTimer_Tick();
			};
			Model.ImagePool = new StackPool<Image>
			{
				Create = Image_Create,
				Activate = Image_Activate,
				Deactivate = Image_Disactivate,
				Destroy = Image_Destroy
			};
			for (int num = 0; num < 4; num++)
			{
				WebClient webClient = new WebClient();
				webClient.DownloadDataCompleted += DownloadClient_DownloadDataCompleted;
				DownloadClient.Add(webClient);
				DownloadTile.Add(null);
			}
			Model.CanvasSize = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, Canvas.ActualWidth, Canvas.ActualHeight);
			Canvas.SizeChanged += delegate
			{
				Model.CanvasSize = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, Canvas.ActualWidth, Canvas.ActualHeight);
				Canvas.Clip = new RectangleGeometry
				{
					Rect = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, Canvas.ActualWidth, Canvas.ActualHeight)
				};
				Model.Refresh();
			};
		}

		private Image Image_Create()
		{
			return new Image
			{
				UseLayoutRounding = false,
				IsHitTestVisible = false
			};
		}

		private void Image_Activate(Image image)
		{
			Canvas.Children.Add(image);
		}

		private void Image_Disactivate(Image image)
		{
			Canvas.Children.Remove(image);
		}

		private void Image_Destroy(Image image)
		{
		}

		internal bool ImagesReady()
		{
			bool result = true;
			for (int i = 0; i < DownloadTile.Count; i++)
			{
				if (DownloadTile[i] != null)
				{
					result = false;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal void SetImagePosition(Image image, double il, double it)
		{
			image.Width = Math.Round(image.Width);
			image.Height = Math.Round(image.Height);
			Canvas.SetLeft(image, Math.Round(il));
			Canvas.SetTop(image, Math.Round(it));
		}

		internal void CancelDownload(Tile tile)
		{
			Uri tileUri = Model.Source.GetTileUri(tile.Z + 8, tile.X, tile.Y);
			if (tileUri != null)
			{
				CancellingMultiScaleImageEventArgs args = new CancellingMultiScaleImageEventArgs
				{
					Uri = tileUri
				};
				Model.OnCancellingImage(args);
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < DownloadTile.Count; i++)
			{
				if (tile == DownloadTile[i])
				{
					if (tile.IsAlternateDownload)
					{
						tile.IsAlternateDownload = false;
						DownloadTile[i] = null;
						BumpDownload();
					}
					else
					{
						DownloadClient[i].CancelAsync();
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < pendingTiles.Count; j++)
			{
				if (pendingTiles[j] == tile)
				{
					pendingTiles.RemoveAt(j);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void Download(Tile tile)
		{
			pendingTiles.Add(tile);
			pendingTiles.Sort(delegate(Tile a, Tile b)
			{
				int num = ((a.GhostImage != null) ? (a.GhostImage.Source as BitmapSource).PixelWidth : 0);
				int value = ((b.GhostImage != null) ? (b.GhostImage.Source as BitmapSource).PixelWidth : 0);
				return num.CompareTo(value);
			});
			BumpDownload();
		}

		private void BumpDownload()
		{
			XamMultiScaleTileSource source;
			try
			{
				source = Model.Source;
			}
			catch (UnauthorizedAccessException)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = -1;
			if (pendingTiles.Count > 0)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < DownloadTile.Count; i++)
				{
					if (DownloadTile[i] == null)
					{
						num = i;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			WebClient webClient = DownloadClient[num];
			DownloadTile[num] = pendingTiles[0];
			pendingTiles.RemoveAt(0);
			Uri uri = source.GetTileUri(DownloadTile[num].Z + 8, DownloadTile[num].X, DownloadTile[num].Y);
			if (uri == null)
			{
				DownloadTile[num] = null;
				BumpDownload();
				return;
			}
			DownloadingMultiScaleImageEventArgs e = new DownloadingMultiScaleImageEventArgs
			{
				Uri = uri
			};
			Model.OnDownloadingImage(e);
			uri = e.Uri;
			DownloadTile[num].IsAlternateDownload = false;
			if (e.AlternateDownloadHandler != null)
			{
				DownloadTile[num].IsAlternateDownload = true;
				DownloadTile[num].AlternateDownloadUri = uri;
				e.AlternateDownloadHandler(uri, num, delegate(Uri u, object state, byte[] result)
				{
					if (Model.Dispatcher.Thread != Thread.CurrentThread)
					{
						Model.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
						{
							int index = (int)state;
							if (DownloadTile[index] != null && !(DownloadTile[index].AlternateDownloadUri == null) && DownloadTile[index].AlternateDownloadUri.Equals(uri))
							{
								OnDownloadCompleted((int)state, result, null, cancelled: false);
							}
						});
					}
					else
					{
						OnDownloadCompleted((int)state, result, null, cancelled: false);
					}
				});
			}
			else
			{
				string resolvedReferer = Model.GetResolvedReferer();
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(resolvedReferer))
				{
					webClient.Headers.Add(HttpRequestHeader.Referer, resolvedReferer);
				}
				string resolvedUserAgent = Model.GetResolvedUserAgent();
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(resolvedUserAgent))
				{
					webClient.Headers.Add(HttpRequestHeader.UserAgent, resolvedUserAgent);
				}
				webClient.DownloadDataAsync(uri, num);
			}
		}

		private void DownloadClient_DownloadDataCompleted(object sender, DownloadDataCompletedEventArgs e)
		{
			int index = (int)e.UserState;
			byte[] result = null;
			if (e.Error == null && !e.Cancelled)
			{
				result = e.Result;
			}
			OnDownloadCompleted(index, result, e.Error, e.Cancelled);
		}

		private void OnDownloadCompleted(int index, byte[] result, Exception error, bool cancelled)
		{
			Tile tile = DownloadTile[index];
			DownloadTile[index] = null;
			XamMultiScaleTileSource source;
			try
			{
				source = Model.Source;
			}
			catch (UnauthorizedAccessException)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (error == null && !cancelled && source != null)
			{
				MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream(result);
				if (Model.IsImageStreamValid(memoryStream))
				{
					BitmapImage bitmapImage = new BitmapImage();
					bitmapImage.BeginInit();
					bitmapImage.StreamSource = memoryStream;
					bitmapImage.EndInit();
					WriteableBitmap writeableBitmap = new WriteableBitmap(bitmapImage);
					Model.CacheBitmap(tile, writeableBitmap);
					if (tile.Image != null)
					{
						tile.Image.Source = null;
						tile.Image.Source = writeableBitmap;
						tile.Image.InvalidateVisual();
						Model.StartFade(tile);
					}
				}
			}
			BumpDownload();
		}

		internal void SendToBackground(Image image)
		{
			Panel.SetZIndex(image, 0);
		}

		internal void SendToForeground(Image image)
		{
			Panel.SetZIndex(image, 1);
		}

		internal bool Ready()
		{
			if (Model.ContentPresenter == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal void Defer(Action<bool> work)
		{
			if (Model.DeferralHandler != null)
			{
				Model.DeferralHandler.DeferredRefresh();
				return;
			}
			Model.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
			{
				work(obj: false);
			});
		}

		internal void StartSpringTimer()
		{
			if (!SpringTimer.IsEnabled)
			{
				SpringTimer.Start();
			}
		}

		internal void StopSpringTimer()
		{
			SpringTimer.Stop();
		}

		internal void StartFadeTimer()
		{
			if (!FadeTimer.IsEnabled)
			{
				FadeTimer.Start();
			}
		}

		internal void StopFadeTimer()
		{
			if (FadeTimer.IsEnabled)
			{
				FadeTimer.Stop();
			}
			Model.NotifyReady();
		}

		internal void DisableSprings()
		{
			if (SpringTimer.IsEnabled)
			{
				SpringTimer.Stop();
				Model.OnSpringsDisabled();
			}
		}

		internal void RefreshCompleted()
		{
			Model.NotifyReady();
		}

		internal void FadingChanged()
		{
		}
	}
}

		public event DataSourceSchemaChangedHandler SchemaChanged
		{
			add
			{
				bool flag = _schemaChanged != null;
				_schemaChanged = (DataSourceSchemaChangedHandler)Delegate.Combine(_schemaChanged, value);
				if (_schemaChanged != null && !flag)
				{
					Implementation.SchemaChanged += Implementation_SchemaChanged;
				}
			}
			remove
			{
				bool flag = _schemaChanged != null;
				_schemaChanged = (DataSourceSchemaChangedHandler)Delegate.Remove(_schemaChanged, value);
				if (_schemaChanged == null && flag)
				{
					Implementation.SchemaChanged -= Implementation_SchemaChanged;
				}
			}
		}

		public event DataSourceRowExpansionChangedHandler RowExpansionChanged
		{
			add
			{
				bool flag = _rowExpansionChanged != null;
				_rowExpansionChanged = (DataSourceRowExpansionChangedHandler)Delegate.Combine(_rowExpansionChanged, value);
				if (_rowExpansionChanged != null && !flag)
				{
					Implementation.RowExpansionChanged += Implementation_RowExpansionChanged;
				}
			}
			remove
			{
				bool flag = _rowExpansionChanged != null;
				_rowExpansionChanged = (DataSourceRowExpansionChangedHandler)Delegate.Remove(_rowExpansionChanged, value);
				if (_rowExpansionChanged == null && flag)
				{
					Implementation.RowExpansionChanged -= Implementation_RowExpansionChanged;
				}
			}
		}

		public event DataSourceDataCommittedHandler DataCommitted
		{
			add
			{
				bool flag = _dataCommitted != null;
				_dataCommitted = (DataSourceDataCommittedHandler)Delegate.Combine(_dataCommitted, value);
				if (_dataCommitted != null && !flag)
				{
					Implementation.DataCommitted += Implementation_DataCommitted;
				}
			}
			remove
			{
				bool flag = _dataCommitted != null;
				_dataCommitted = (DataSourceDataCommittedHandler)Delegate.Remove(_dataCommitted, value);
				if (_dataCommitted == null && flag)
				{
					Implementation.DataCommitted -= Implementation_DataCommitted;
				}
			}
		}

		internal BaseDataSource(Infragistics.Controls.DataSource.Implementation.BaseDataSource BaseDataSourceImpl)
		{
			_BaseDataSourceImplementation = BaseDataSourceImpl;
			if (_BaseDataSourceImplementation != null)
			{
				((INotifyPropertyChanged)_BaseDataSourceImplementation).PropertyChanged += _BaseDataSourceImplementation_PropertyChanged;
			}
			OnCreateBaseDataSource();
		}

		private void OnCreateBaseDataSource()
		{
			Implementation.ExternalObject = this;
			Implementation.ExternalDataSource = this;
			if (Implementation.ExecutionContext == null)
			{
				Implementation.ExecutionContext = new XamlDispatcherDataSourceExecutionContext(base.Dispatcher);
			}
			Implementation.PropertyChanged += Implementation_PropertyChanged;
		}

		private void _BaseDataSourceImplementation_PropertyChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs args)
		{
			string propertyName = args.PropertyName;
			if (!(propertyName == BaseDataSourceCurrentlyWritingPropertyName))
			{
				switch (propertyName)
				{
				case "ActualSchema":
					ActualSchema = _BaseDataSourceImplementation.ActualSchema;
					break;
				case "ActualCount":
					ActualCount = _BaseDataSourceImplementation.ActualCount;
					break;
				case "FirstVisibleIndexRequested":
					FirstVisibleIndexRequested = _BaseDataSourceImplementation.FirstVisibleIndexRequested;
					break;
				case "LastVisibleIndexRequested":
					LastVisibleIndexRequested = _BaseDataSourceImplementation.LastVisibleIndexRequested;
					break;
				case "UpdateNotifier":
					UpdateNotifier = _BaseDataSourceImplementation.UpdateNotifier;
					break;
				case "ExecutionContext":
					ExecutionContext = _BaseDataSourceImplementation.ExecutionContext;
					break;
				case "DeferAutoRefresh":
					DeferAutoRefresh = _BaseDataSourceImplementation.DeferAutoRefresh;
					break;
				case "PrimaryKey":
					PrimaryKey = _BaseDataSourceImplementation.PrimaryKey;
					break;
				case "PropertiesRequested":
					PropertiesRequested = _BaseDataSourceImplementation.PropertiesRequested;
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private void Implementation_PropertyChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			string propertyName = e.PropertyName;
			if (!(propertyName == "NotifyUsingSourceIndexes"))
			{
				if (propertyName == "ActualPrimaryKey")
				{
					ActualPrimaryKey = Implementation.ActualPrimaryKey;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				NotifyUsingSourceIndexes = Implementation.NotifyUsingSourceIndexes;
			}
		}

		public virtual void CloneProperties(IDataSource dataSource)
		{
			if (dataSource is BaseDataSource baseDataSource)
			{
				baseDataSource.ExecutionContext = ExecutionContext;
				baseDataSource.IncludeSummaryRowsInSection = IncludeSummaryRowsInSection;
				baseDataSource.IsSectionCollapsable = IsSectionCollapsable;
				baseDataSource.IsSectionExpandedDefault = IsSectionExpandedDefault;
				baseDataSource.IsSectionHeaderNormalRow = IsSectionHeaderNormalRow;
				baseDataSource.IsSectionSummaryRowsAtBottom = IsSectionSummaryRowsAtBottom;
				baseDataSource.IsSectionContentVisible = IsSectionContentVisible;
				baseDataSource.PrimaryKey = PrimaryKey;
				baseDataSource.PropertiesRequested = PropertiesRequested;
				baseDataSource.SectionHeaderDisplayMode = SectionHeaderDisplayMode;
				baseDataSource.ShouldEmitSectionFooters = ShouldEmitSectionFooters;
				baseDataSource.ShouldEmitSectionHeaders = ShouldEmitSectionHeaders;
				baseDataSource.ShouldEmitShiftedRows = ShouldEmitShiftedRows;
				baseDataSource.SummaryScope = SummaryScope;
				for (int i = 0; i < GroupDescriptions.All.Count; i++)
				{
					baseDataSource.GroupDescriptions.Add(GroupDescriptions.All[i]);
				}
				for (int j = 0; j < SortDescriptions.All.Count; j++)
				{
					baseDataSource.SortDescriptions.Add(SortDescriptions.All[j]);
				}
				for (int k = 0; k < FilterExpressions.All.Count; k++)
				{
					baseDataSource.FilterExpressions.Add(FilterExpressions.All[k]);
				}
				for (int l = 0; l < SummaryDescriptions.All.Count; l++)
				{
					baseDataSource.SummaryDescriptions.Add(SummaryDescriptions.All[l]);
				}
			}
		}

	public class LocalDataSource : BaseDataSource, IExternalLocalDataSource, IEnumerable
	{
		private Infragistics.Controls.DataSource.Implementation.LocalDataSource _LocalDataSourceImplementation;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty DataProviderProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("DataProvider", typeof(IDataSourceLocalDataProvider), typeof(LocalDataSource), new PropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			IDataSourceLocalDataProvider dataProvider = (IDataSourceLocalDataProvider)e.NewValue;
			((LocalDataSource)sender).LocalDataSourceCurrentlyWritingPropertyName = "DataProvider";
			((LocalDataSource)sender)._LocalDataSourceImplementation.DataProvider = dataProvider;
			((LocalDataSource)sender).LocalDataSourceCurrentlyWritingPropertyName = null;
		}));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ActualDataProviderProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ActualDataProvider", typeof(IDataSourceLocalDataProvider), typeof(LocalDataSource), new PropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			IDataSourceLocalDataProvider actualDataProvider = (IDataSourceLocalDataProvider)e.NewValue;
			((LocalDataSource)sender).LocalDataSourceCurrentlyWritingPropertyName = "ActualDataProvider";
			((LocalDataSource)sender)._LocalDataSourceImplementation.ActualDataProvider = actualDataProvider;
			((LocalDataSource)sender).LocalDataSourceCurrentlyWritingPropertyName = null;
		}));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ItemsSourceProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ItemsSource", typeof(IEnumerable), typeof(LocalDataSource), new PropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			IEnumerable itemsSource = (IEnumerable)e.NewValue;
			((LocalDataSource)sender).LocalDataSourceCurrentlyWritingPropertyName = "ItemsSource";
			((LocalDataSource)sender)._LocalDataSourceImplementation.ItemsSource = itemsSource;
			((LocalDataSource)sender).LocalDataSourceCurrentlyWritingPropertyName = null;
		}));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsItemIndexLookupSupportedProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("IsItemIndexLookupSupported", typeof(bool), typeof(LocalDataSource), new PropertyMetadata(false));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsKeyIndexLookupSupportedProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("IsKeyIndexLookupSupported", typeof(bool), typeof(LocalDataSource), new PropertyMetadata(false));

		internal new Infragistics.Controls.DataSource.Implementation.LocalDataSource Implementation => _LocalDataSourceImplementation;

		internal string LocalDataSourceCurrentlyWritingPropertyName { get; set; }

		public IDataSourceLocalDataProvider DataProvider
		{
			get
			{
				return (IDataSourceLocalDataProvider)GetValue(DataProviderProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(DataProviderProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public IDataSourceLocalDataProvider ActualDataProvider
		{
			get
			{
				return (IDataSourceLocalDataProvider)GetValue(ActualDataProviderProperty);
			}
			internal set
			{
				SetValue(ActualDataProviderProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public IEnumerable ItemsSource
		{
			get
			{
				return (IEnumerable)GetValue(ItemsSourceProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ItemsSourceProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public new bool IsItemIndexLookupSupported => (bool)GetValue(IsItemIndexLookupSupportedProperty);

		public new bool IsKeyIndexLookupSupported => (bool)GetValue(IsKeyIndexLookupSupportedProperty);

		public LocalDataSource()
			: this(new Infragistics.Controls.DataSource.Implementation.LocalDataSource())
		{
		}

		internal LocalDataSource(Infragistics.Controls.DataSource.Implementation.LocalDataSource LocalDataSourceImpl)
			: base(LocalDataSourceImpl)
		{
			_LocalDataSourceImplementation = LocalDataSourceImpl;
			if (_LocalDataSourceImplementation != null)
			{
				((INotifyPropertyChanged)_LocalDataSourceImplementation).PropertyChanged += _LocalDataSourceImplementation_PropertyChanged;
			}
			OnCreateLocalDataSource();
		}

		private void OnCreateLocalDataSource()
		{
			Implementation.ExternalLocalDataSource = this;
		}

		private void _LocalDataSourceImplementation_PropertyChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs args)
		{
			string propertyName = args.PropertyName;
			if (!(propertyName == LocalDataSourceCurrentlyWritingPropertyName))
			{
				switch (propertyName)
				{
				case "DataProvider":
					DataProvider = _LocalDataSourceImplementation.DataProvider;
					break;
				case "ActualDataProvider":
					ActualDataProvider = _LocalDataSourceImplementation.ActualDataProvider;
					break;
				case "ItemsSource":
					ItemsSource = _LocalDataSourceImplementation.ItemsSource;
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public override object GetItemAtIndex(int index)
		{
			return _LocalDataSourceImplementation.GetItemAtIndex(index);
		}

		public override object GetItemPropertyAtIndex(int index, string valueName)
		{
			return _LocalDataSourceImplementation.GetItemPropertyAtIndex(index, valueName);
		}

		public override int IndexOfItem(object item)
		{
			return _LocalDataSourceImplementation.IndexOfItem(item);
		}

		public override int IndexOfKey(object[] key)
		{
			return _LocalDataSourceImplementation.IndexOfKey(key);
		}

		public IDataSourceLocalDataProvider ResolveDataProvider()
		{
			return new DataSourceLocalDataProvider();
		}

		public IEnumerator GetEnumerator()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < ActualCount; i++)
			{
				yield return GetItemAtIndex(i);
			}
		}

		public override IDataSource Clone()
		{
			return new LocalDataSource((Infragistics.Controls.DataSource.Implementation.LocalDataSource)Implementation.Clone());
		}
	}

			: this(new Infragistics.Controls.DataSource.Implementation.VirtualDataSource())

		}

		internal VirtualDataSource(Infragistics.Controls.DataSource.Implementation.VirtualDataSource VirtualDataSourceImpl)
			: base(VirtualDataSourceImpl)
		{
			_VirtualDataSourceImplementation = VirtualDataSourceImpl;
			if (_VirtualDataSourceImplementation != null)
			{
				((INotifyPropertyChanged)_VirtualDataSourceImplementation).PropertyChanged += _VirtualDataSourceImplementation_PropertyChanged;
			}
			OnCreateVirtualDataSource();
		}

		private void OnCreateVirtualDataSource()
		{
			Implementation.ExternalVirtualDataSource = this;
		}

		private void _VirtualDataSourceImplementation_PropertyChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs args)
		{
			string propertyName = args.PropertyName;
			if (!(propertyName == VirtualDataSourceCurrentlyWritingPropertyName))
			{
				switch (propertyName)
				{
				case "DataProvider":
					DataProvider = _VirtualDataSourceImplementation.DataProvider;
					break;
				case "ActualDataProvider":
					ActualDataProvider = _VirtualDataSourceImplementation.ActualDataProvider;
					break;
				case "PageSizeRequested":
					PageSizeRequested = _VirtualDataSourceImplementation.PageSizeRequested;
					break;
				case "MaxCachedPages":
					MaxCachedPages = _VirtualDataSourceImplementation.MaxCachedPages;
					break;
				case "ActualPageSize":
					ActualPageSize = _VirtualDataSourceImplementation.ActualPageSize;
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		}

		}

		{
			return _VirtualDataSourceImplementation.IndexOfKey(key);
		}

		protected virtual IDataSourceVirtualDataProvider ResolveDataProviderOverride()
		{
			return null;
		}

		IDataSourceVirtualDataProvider IExternalVirtualDataSource.ResolveDataProvider()
		{
			return ResolveDataProviderOverride();
		}

		public IEnumerator GetEnumerator()
		{
			int actualPageSize = ActualPageSize;
			int desiredFirstIndex = 0;
			int desiredLastIndex = desiredFirstIndex + actualPageSize;
			for (int i = 0; i < ActualCount; i++)
			{
				yield return GetItemAtIndex(i);
				if (i > desiredLastIndex)
				{
					desiredFirstIndex++;
					desiredLastIndex++;
					FirstVisibleIndexRequested = desiredFirstIndex;
					LastVisibleIndexRequested = desiredLastIndex;
				}
			}
		}

		void IExternalVirtualDataSource.ResetCache()
		{
			ResetCacheOverride();
		}

		protected virtual void ResetCacheOverride()
		{
		}
	}

					}
					else

						_schema = ResolveSchema();

			_groupDescriptions.CollectionChanged += GroupDescriptions_CollectionChanged;

		public object GetItemAtIndex(int index)
		{
			if (_list == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return _list[index];
		}

		public object GetItemValue(object item, string valueName)
		{
			EnsureSchema();
			_reflectionHelpers.TryGetValue(valueName, out var value);
			if (value == null)
			{
				value = new FastReflectionHelper();
				value.PropertyName = valueName;
				_reflectionHelpers.Add(valueName, value);
			}
			object propertyValue = value.GetPropertyValue(item);
			if (propertyValue == DBNull.Value)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return propertyValue;
		}

		public void SetItemValue(object item, string valueName, object value)
		{
			_reflectionHelpers.TryGetValue(valueName, out var value2);
			if (value2 == null)
			{
				value2 = new FastReflectionHelper();
				value2.PropertyName = valueName;
				_reflectionHelpers.Add(valueName, value2);
			}
			value2.SetPropertyValue(item, value);
		}

		public void RemoveItem(object item)
		{
			if (_list != null && _isListDirectReference)
			{
				int index = _list.IndexOf(item);
				_list.RemoveAt(index);
				NotifyRemoveItem(index, item);
			}
		}

		public void AddItem(object item)
		{
			if (_list != null && _isListDirectReference)
			{
				int count = _list.Count;
				_list.Insert(count, item);
				NotifyInsertItem(count, item);
			}
		}

		private void EnsureSchema()
		{
			if (_schema == null)
			{
				_schema = ActualSchema;
				if (this.SchemaChanged != null)
				{
					this.SchemaChanged(this, new DataSourceDataProviderSchemaChangedEventArgs(_schema, ActualCount));
				}
			}
		}

		private IDataSourceSchema ResolveSchema()
		{
			object obj = FindSchemaItem();
			if (obj == null)
			{
				return new DefaultDataSourceSchema(new string[0], new DataSourceSchemaPropertyType[0], null, null);
			}
			Type type = obj.GetType();
			_reflectionHelpers.Clear();
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			HashSet<string> hashSet = new HashSet<string>();
			List<DataSourceSchemaPropertyType> list2 = new List<DataSourceSchemaPropertyType>();
			List<List<string>> list3 = new List<List<string>>();
			if (obj is IDictionary)
			{
				IDictionary dictionary = (IDictionary)obj;
				foreach (object key in dictionary.Keys)
				{
					if (key != null)
					{
						string text = "[" + key.ToString() + "]";
						list.Add(text);
						hashSet.Add(text);
						object obj2 = dictionary[key];
						_reflectionHelpers.Add(text, new FastReflectionHelper(useTraditionalReflection: false, text));
						if (obj2 != null)
						{
							list2.Add(ResolveSchemaType(obj2.GetType()));
						}
						else
						{
							list2.Add(DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.ObjectValue);
						}
						list3.Add(new List<string>());
					}
				}
			}
			List<PropertyInfo> list4 = (from p in type.GetProperties()
				where p.GetGetMethod() != null && p.GetGetMethod().IsPublic && !p.GetGetMethod().IsStatic
				select p).ToList();
			if (obj is IDictionary)
			{
				FilterOutDictionaryProperties(list4);
			}
			if (obj is ICollection)
			{
				FilterOutCollectionProperties(list4);
			}
			if (obj is IList)
			{
				FilterOutListProperties(list4);
			}
			bool flag = false;
			if (type.FullName == "System.Data.DataRowView")
			{
				object value = type.GetProperty("DataView").GetValue(obj, null);
				if (value != null)
				{
					object value2 = value.GetType().GetProperty("Table").GetValue(value, null);
					if (value2 != null)
					{
						ICollection collection = (ICollection)value2.GetType().GetProperty("Columns").GetValue(value2, null);
						if (collection != null)
						{
							foreach (object item in collection)
							{
								string text2 = (string)item.GetType().GetProperty("ColumnName").GetValue(item, null);
								Type type2 = (Type)item.GetType().GetProperty("DataType").GetValue(item, null);
								string text3 = "[" + text2 + "]";
								list.Add(text3);
								hashSet.Add(text3);
								_reflectionHelpers.Add(text3, new FastReflectionHelper(useTraditionalReflection: false, text3));
								list2.Add(ResolveSchemaType(type2));
								list3.Add(new List<string>());
							}
						}
					}
				}
				flag = true;
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				IEnumerable<FieldInfo> enumerable = from f in type.GetFields()
					where f.IsPublic && !f.IsStatic
					select f;
				foreach (PropertyInfo item2 in list4)
				{
					if (!hashSet.Contains(item2.Name) && item2.GetGetMethod().GetParameters().Count() <= 0)
					{
						list.Add(item2.Name);
						hashSet.Add(item2.Name);
						_reflectionHelpers.Add(item2.Name, new FastReflectionHelper(useTraditionalReflection: false, item2.Name));
						list2.Add(ResolveSchemaType(item2.PropertyType));
						list3.Add(ResolveDataIntents(item2));
					}
				}
				foreach (FieldInfo item3 in enumerable)
				{
					if (!hashSet.Contains(item3.Name))
					{
						list.Add(item3.Name);
						hashSet.Add(item3.Name);
						_reflectionHelpers.Add(item3.Name, new FastReflectionHelper(useTraditionalReflection: false, item3.Name));
						list2.Add(ResolveSchemaType(item3.FieldType));
						list3.Add(ResolveDataIntents(item3));
					}
				}
			}
			string[][] array = new string[list3.Count][];
			for (int num = 0; num < list3.Count; num++)
			{
				array[num] = list3[num].ToArray();
			}
			return new DefaultDataSourceSchema(list.ToArray(), list2.ToArray(), null, array);
		}

		private List<string> ResolveDataIntents(PropertyInfo p)
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			object[] customAttributes = p.GetCustomAttributes(inherit: true);
			foreach (object obj in customAttributes)
			{
				if (obj is IDataIntentAttribute)
				{
					list.Add(((IDataIntentAttribute)obj).Intent);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private List<string> ResolveDataIntents(FieldInfo f)
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			object[] customAttributes = f.GetCustomAttributes(inherit: true);
			foreach (object obj in customAttributes)
			{
				if (obj is IDataIntentAttribute)
				{
					list.Add(((IDataIntentAttribute)obj).Intent);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private void FilterOutDictionaryProperties(List<PropertyInfo> properties)
		{
			for (int num = properties.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				PropertyInfo propertyInfo = properties[num];
				if (propertyInfo.Name == "Item" && propertyInfo.GetGetMethod() != null && propertyInfo.GetGetMethod().GetParameters().Length == 1)
				{
					properties.RemoveAt(num);
				}
				if (propertyInfo.Name == "Keys" && propertyInfo.GetGetMethod() != null && propertyInfo.GetGetMethod().GetParameters().Length == 0)
				{
					properties.RemoveAt(num);
				}
				if (propertyInfo.Name == "Values" && propertyInfo.GetGetMethod() != null && propertyInfo.GetGetMethod().GetParameters().Length == 0)
				{
					properties.RemoveAt(num);
				}
				if (propertyInfo.Name == "Count" && propertyInfo.GetGetMethod() != null && propertyInfo.GetGetMethod().GetParameters().Length == 0)
				{
					properties.RemoveAt(num);
				}
				if (propertyInfo.Name == "Comparer" && propertyInfo.GetGetMethod() != null && propertyInfo.GetGetMethod().GetParameters().Length == 0)
				{
					properties.RemoveAt(num);
				}
			}
		}

		private void FilterOutCollectionProperties(List<PropertyInfo> properties)
		{
			for (int num = properties.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				PropertyInfo propertyInfo = properties[num];
				if (propertyInfo.Name == "Count" && propertyInfo.GetGetMethod() != null && propertyInfo.GetGetMethod().GetParameters().Length == 0)
				{
					properties.RemoveAt(num);
				}
				if (propertyInfo.Name == "IsSynchronized" && propertyInfo.GetGetMethod() != null && propertyInfo.GetGetMethod().GetParameters().Length == 0)
				{
					properties.RemoveAt(num);
				}
				if (propertyInfo.Name == "SyncRoot" && propertyInfo.GetGetMethod() != null && propertyInfo.GetGetMethod().GetParameters().Length == 0)
				{
					properties.RemoveAt(num);
				}
				if (propertyInfo.Name == "Capacity" && propertyInfo.GetGetMethod() != null && propertyInfo.GetGetMethod().GetParameters().Length == 0)
				{
					properties.RemoveAt(num);
				}
			}
		}

		private void FilterOutListProperties(List<PropertyInfo> properties)
		{
			for (int num = properties.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				PropertyInfo propertyInfo = properties[num];
				if (propertyInfo.Name == "Item" && propertyInfo.GetGetMethod() != null && propertyInfo.GetGetMethod().GetParameters().Length == 1)
				{
					properties.RemoveAt(num);
				}
				if (propertyInfo.Name == "IsReadOnly" && propertyInfo.GetGetMethod() != null && propertyInfo.GetGetMethod().GetParameters().Length == 0)
				{
					properties.RemoveAt(num);
				}
				if (propertyInfo.Name == "IsFixedSize" && propertyInfo.GetGetMethod() != null && propertyInfo.GetGetMethod().GetParameters().Length == 0)
				{
					properties.RemoveAt(num);
				}
				if (propertyInfo.Name == "Capacity" && propertyInfo.GetGetMethod() != null && propertyInfo.GetGetMethod().GetParameters().Length == 0)
				{
					properties.RemoveAt(num);
				}
			}
		}

		private DataSourceSchemaPropertyType ResolveSchemaType(Type type)
		{
			if (type == typeof(bool))
			{
				return DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.BooleanValue;
			}
			if (type == typeof(double))
			{
				return DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.DoubleValue;
			}
			if (type == typeof(decimal))
			{
				return DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.DecimalValue;
			}
			if (type == typeof(string))
			{
				return DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.StringValue;
			}
			if (type == typeof(float))
			{
				return DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.SingleValue;
			}
			if (type == typeof(DateTime))
			{
				return DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.DateTimeValue;
			}
			if (type == typeof(DateTimeOffset))
			{
				return DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.DateTimeOffsetValue;
			}
			if (type == typeof(int))
			{
				return DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.IntValue;
			}
			if (type == typeof(short))
			{
				return DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.ShortValue;
			}
			if (type == typeof(long))
			{
				return DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.LongValue;
			}
			return DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.ObjectValue;
		}

		private object FindSchemaItem()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < _list.Count; i++)
			{
				if (_list[i] != null)
				{
					if (_list[i] is IDictionary)
					{
						return FindMapSchemaItem();
					}
					return _list[i];
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private object FindMapSchemaItem()
		{
			if (_list == null || _list.Count < 1)
			{
				return null;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < _list.Count; i++)
			{
				if (_list[i] == null || !(_list[i] is IDictionary))
				{
					continue;
				}
				bool flag = true;
				foreach (object key in ((IDictionary)_list[i]).Keys)
				{
					if (((IDictionary)_list[i])[key] == null)
					{
						flag = false;
					}
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					return _list[i];
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected void OnPropertyChanged(string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
			}
			PropertyUpdatedOverride(propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
		}

		protected virtual void PropertyUpdatedOverride(string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			if (!(propertyName == "ItemsSource"))
			{
				if (propertyName == "DeferAutoRefresh" && !(bool)newValue)
				{
					QueueAutoRefresh();
				}
				return;
			}
			_schema = null;
			if (ItemsSource != null)
			{
				_list = ItemsSource as IList;
				_isListDirectReference = true;
				if (_observableCollection != null)
				{
					_observableCollection.CollectionChanged -= ObservableCollection_CollectionChanged;
					_observableCollection = null;
				}
				if (_list == null)
				{
					_isListDirectReference = false;
					_list = ItemsSource.OfType<object>().ToList();
				}
				if (ItemsSource is INotifyCollectionChanged)
				{
					_observableCollection = ItemsSource as INotifyCollectionChanged;
					_observableCollection.CollectionChanged += ObservableCollection_CollectionChanged;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (_observableCollection != null)
				{
					_observableCollection.CollectionChanged -= ObservableCollection_CollectionChanged;
					_observableCollection = null;
				}
				_list = null;
			}
			EnsureSchema();
		}

		private void ObservableCollection_CollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			CheckForSingularChange(e);
			switch (e.Action)
			{
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add:
				if (e.NewItems != null)
				{
					NotifyInsertItem(e.NewStartingIndex, e.NewItems[0]);
				}
				break;
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Move:
				if (e.OldItems != null)
				{
					NotifyRemoveItem(e.OldStartingIndex, e.OldItems[0]);
				}
				if (e.NewItems != null)
				{
					NotifyInsertItem(e.NewStartingIndex, e.NewItems[0]);
				}
				break;
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove:
				if (e.OldItems != null)
				{
					NotifyRemoveItem(e.OldStartingIndex, e.OldItems[0]);
				}
				break;
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace:
				if (e.NewItems != null)
				{
					NotifySetItem(e.NewStartingIndex, e.OldItems[0], e.NewItems[0]);
				}
				break;
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset:
				NotifyClearItems();
				break;
			}
		}

		private void CheckForSingularChange(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			switch (e.Action)
			{
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add:
				if (e.NewItems != null && e.NewItems.Count > 1)
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException(new SRProvider().RangeModificationsNotSupported);
				}
				break;
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove:
				if (e.OldItems != null && e.OldItems.Count > 1)
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException(new SRProvider().RangeModificationsNotSupported);
				}
				break;
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace:
				if ((e.OldItems != null && e.OldItems.Count > 1) || (e.NewItems != null && e.NewItems.Count > 1))
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException(new SRProvider().RangeModificationsNotSupported);
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		public void NotifySetItem(int index, object oldItem, object newItem)
		{
			if (MustSyncListWithChanges)
			{
				_list[index] = newItem;
			}
			if (UpdateNotifier != null)
			{
				UpdateNotifier.NotifySetItem(index, oldItem, newItem);
			}
		}

		public void NotifyClearItems()
		{
			if (MustSyncListWithChanges)
			{
				_list.Clear();
			}
			if (UpdateNotifier != null)
			{
				UpdateNotifier.NotifyClearItems();
			}
		}

		public void NotifyInsertItem(int index, object newItem)
		{
			if (MustSyncListWithChanges)
			{
				_list.Insert(index, newItem);
			}
			if (_list != null && _list.Count == 1 && (ActualSchema == null || ActualSchema.PropertyNames.Length == 0))
			{
				_schema = null;
				EnsureSchema();
			}
			if (UpdateNotifier != null)
			{
				UpdateNotifier.NotifyInsertItem(index, newItem);
			}
		}

		public void NotifyRemoveItem(int index, object oldItem)
		{
			if (MustSyncListWithChanges)
			{
				_list.RemoveAt(index);
			}
			if (UpdateNotifier != null)
			{
				UpdateNotifier.NotifyRemoveItem(index, oldItem);
			}
		}

		public void QueueAutoRefresh()
		{
			if (!DeferAutoRefresh && !_autoRefreshQueued && ExecutionContext != null)
			{
				_autoRefreshQueued = true;
				ExecutionContext.EnqueueAction(DoRefreshInternal);
			}
		}

		internal void DoRefreshInternal()
		{
			if (DeferAutoRefresh)
			{
				_autoRefreshQueued = false;
			}
			else if (_autoRefreshQueued)
			{
				_autoRefreshQueued = false;
				RefreshInternal();
			}
		}

		internal void RefreshInternal()
		{
			RefreshInternalOverride();
		}

		protected virtual void RefreshInternalOverride()
		{
		}

		public void FlushAutoRefresh()
		{
			DoRefreshInternal();
		}

		public void Refresh()
		{
			RefreshInternal();
		}

		public int IndexOfItem(object item)
		{
			if (_list == null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			return _list.IndexOf(item);
		}

		public int IndexOfKey(object[] key)
		{
			return -1;
		}

		public virtual DataSourceSchemaPropertyType ResolveSchemaPropertyType(string propertyPath)
		{
			string[] array = propertyPath.Split('.');
			if (array.Length == 1)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < ActualSchema.PropertyNames.Length; i++)
				{
					if (ActualSchema.PropertyNames[i] == array[0])
					{
						return ActualSchema.PropertyTypes[i];
					}
				}
				return DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.ObjectValue;
			}
			object item = FindSchemaItem();
			object itemValue = GetItemValue(item, propertyPath);
			if (itemValue == null)
			{
				return DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.ObjectValue;
			}
			return ResolveSchemaType(itemValue.GetType());
		}
	}

	internal class XamlDispatcherDataSourceExecutionContext : IDataSourceExecutionContext
	{
		private Dispatcher _dispatcher;

		private List<DispatcherTimer> _timers = new List<DispatcherTimer>();

		private List<bool> _inUse = new List<bool>();

		private object _timersLock = new object();

		public XamlDispatcherDataSourceExecutionContext(Dispatcher dispatcher)
		{
			_dispatcher = dispatcher;
		}

		public void Execute(DataSourceExecutionContextExecuteCallback handler)
		{
			_dispatcher.BeginInvoke(handler, DispatcherPriority.Normal);
		}

		public void ExecuteDelayed(DataSourceExecutionContextExecuteCallback callback, int delayMilliseconds)
		{
			DispatcherTimer toUse = null;
			lock (_timersLock)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < _inUse.Count; i++)
				{
					if (!_inUse[i])
					{
						_inUse[i] = true;
						toUse = _timers[i];
						break;
					}
				}
				if (toUse == null)
				{
					toUse = new DispatcherTimer();
					_inUse.Add(item: true);
					_timers.Add(toUse);
				}
			}
			toUse.Interval = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(delayMilliseconds);
			toUse.Tick += delegate
			{
				toUse.Stop();
				lock (_timersLock)
				{
					for (int j = 0; j < _inUse.Count; j++)
					{
						if (_timers[j] == toUse)
						{
							_inUse[j] = false;
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				callback();
			};
			toUse.Start();
		}

		public void EnqueueAction(DataSourceExecutionContextExecuteCallback callback)
		{
			_dispatcher.BeginInvoke(callback, DispatcherPriority.Normal);
		}
	}

	[DontHide]
	[DontObfuscate]
	public class AsyncVirtualDataSourceProviderWorker
	{
		private LinkedList<AsyncDataSourcePageRequest> _requests = new LinkedList<AsyncDataSourcePageRequest>();

		private IList<AsyncDataSourcePageRequest> _tasks = new List<AsyncDataSourcePageRequest>();

		[DontObfuscate]
		protected const int MaxSimultaneousExecutingTasks = 2;

		[DontObfuscate]
		protected const int MaxRetryDelay = 20000;

		[DontObfuscate]
		protected const int InitialRetryDelay = 200;

		protected object SyncLock = new object();

		private bool _running = true;

		private int _pageSizeRequested;

		private int _actualPageSize;

		private TaskCompletionSource<bool> _waitForChanges;

		private int _timeoutMilliseconds;

		private IDataSourceSchema _actualSchema;

		private int _actualCount = -1;

		private WeakReference _pageLoaded;

		private WeakReference _batchCompleted;

		private WeakReference _executionContext;

		private bool _populatedActualPageSize;

		[DontObfuscate]
		protected IList<AsyncDataSourcePageRequest> Tasks => _tasks;

		[DontObfuscate]
		protected DataSourcePageLoadedCallback PageLoaded
		{
			get
			{
				if (_pageLoaded == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return (DataSourcePageLoadedCallback)_pageLoaded.Target;
			}
		}

		[DontObfuscate]
		protected DataSourceBatchCompletedCallback BatchCompleted
		{
			get
			{
				if (_batchCompleted == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return (DataSourceBatchCompletedCallback)_batchCompleted.Target;
			}
		}

		[DontObfuscate]
		protected IDataSourceExecutionContext ExecutionContext
		{
			get
			{
				if (_executionContext == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return (IDataSourceExecutionContext)_executionContext.Target;
			}
		}

		[DontObfuscate]
		protected int ActualPageSize
		{
			get
			{
				return _actualPageSize;
			}
			set
			{
				_actualPageSize = value;
			}
		}

		[DontObfuscate]
		protected int ActualCount
		{
			get
			{
				return _actualCount;
			}
			set
			{
				_actualCount = value;
			}
		}

		[DontObfuscate]
		protected IDataSourceSchema ActualSchema
		{
			get
			{
				return _actualSchema;
			}
			set
			{
				_actualSchema = value;
			}
		}

		[DontObfuscate]
		protected bool PopulatedActualPageSize
		{
			get
			{
				return _populatedActualPageSize;
			}
			set
			{
				_populatedActualPageSize = value;
			}
		}

		public bool IsRunning
		{
			get
			{
				return _running;
			}
			protected set
			{
				_running = value;
			}
		}

		public bool IsShutdown { get; set; }

		public AsyncVirtualDataSourceProviderWorker(AsyncVirtualDataSourceDataProviderWorkerSettings settings)
		{
			_running = true;
			_pageSizeRequested = settings.PageSizeRequested;
			_actualPageSize = _pageSizeRequested;
			_timeoutMilliseconds = settings.TimeoutMilliseconds;
			_pageLoaded = new WeakReference(settings.PageLoaded);
			_batchCompleted = new WeakReference(settings.BatchCompleted);
			_executionContext = new WeakReference(settings.ExecutionContext);
		}

		public virtual bool AddPageRequest(int pageIndex, DataSourcePageRequestPriority priority)
		{
			return AddPageRequestWithRetry(pageIndex, priority, 200);
		}

		protected virtual void SignalChangesOcurred()
		{
			_waitForChanges?.SetResult(result: true);
			_waitForChanges = null;
		}

		protected virtual void AwaitChanges()
		{
			TaskCompletionSource<bool> taskCompletionSource = new TaskCompletionSource<bool>();
			lock (SyncLock)
			{
				_waitForChanges = taskCompletionSource;
			}
			try
			{
				taskCompletionSource.Task.Wait(_timeoutMilliseconds);
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
			}
		}

		public bool AddPageRequestWithRetry(int pageIndex, DataSourcePageRequestPriority priority, int retryDelay)
		{
			lock (SyncLock)
			{
				if (IsShutdown)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (priority == DataSourcePageRequestPriority.High)
				{
					_requests.AddFirst(new AsyncDataSourcePageRequest(pageIndex, retryDelay));
				}
				else
				{
					_requests.AddLast(new AsyncDataSourcePageRequest(pageIndex, retryDelay));
				}
				SignalChangesOcurred();
				return true;
			}
		}

		public virtual void RemovePageRequest(int pageIndex)
		{
			lock (SyncLock)
			{
				LinkedListNode<AsyncDataSourcePageRequest> linkedListNode = null;
				for (LinkedListNode<AsyncDataSourcePageRequest> linkedListNode2 = _requests.First; linkedListNode2 != null; linkedListNode2 = linkedListNode2.Next)
				{
					if (linkedListNode2.Value.Index == pageIndex)
					{
						linkedListNode = linkedListNode2;
						break;
					}
				}
				if (linkedListNode != null)
				{
					_requests.Remove(linkedListNode);
				}
				SignalChangesOcurred();
			}
		}

		public void RemoveAllPageRequests()
		{
			lock (SyncLock)
			{
				_requests.Clear();
				SignalChangesOcurred();
			}
		}

		public void Shutdown()
		{
			lock (SyncLock)
			{
				_pageLoaded = null;
				_batchCompleted = null;
				_executionContext = null;
				IsShutdown = true;
				_running = false;
				SignalChangesOcurred();
			}
		}

		[DontObfuscate]
		protected virtual void Initialize()
		{
		}

		[DontObfuscate]
		protected virtual AsyncVirtualDataSourceProviderTaskDataHolder GetTaskDataHolder()
		{
			return null;
		}

		[DontObfuscate]
		protected virtual void GetTasksData(AsyncVirtualDataSourceProviderTaskDataHolder holder)
		{
		}

		[DontObfuscate]
		protected virtual void RemoveCompletedTaskData(AsyncVirtualDataSourceProviderTaskDataHolder taskDataHolder, int completed)
		{
		}

		[DontObfuscate]
		protected virtual void GetCompletedTaskData(AsyncVirtualDataSourceProviderTaskDataHolder taskDataHolder, int completed)
		{
		}

		[DontObfuscate]
		protected virtual int CheckAndPotentiallyWaitOnTasks(AsyncDataSourcePageRequest[] currentTasks)
		{
			return Task.WaitAny(currentTasks.Select((AsyncDataSourcePageRequest t) => t.TaskHolder.Task).ToArray(), _timeoutMilliseconds);
		}

		[DontObfuscate]
		protected void DoWork()
		{
			Initialize();
			do
			{
				AsyncDataSourcePageRequest[] array = null;
				AsyncVirtualDataSourceProviderTaskDataHolder asyncVirtualDataSourceProviderTaskDataHolder = null;
				lock (SyncLock)
				{
					int count = _tasks.Count;
					if (_requests.First != null && count < 2)
					{
						LinkedListNode<AsyncDataSourcePageRequest> first = _requests.First;
						_requests.RemoveFirst();
						MakeTaskForRequest(first.Value, first.Value.RetryDelay);
						count = _tasks.Count;
					}
					if (count > 0)
					{
						array = new AsyncDataSourcePageRequest[count];
						for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
						{
							array[i] = _tasks[i];
						}
						asyncVirtualDataSourceProviderTaskDataHolder = GetTaskDataHolder();
						GetTasksData(asyncVirtualDataSourceProviderTaskDataHolder);
					}
				}
				if (array != null && array.Length != 0)
				{
					int num = CheckAndPotentiallyWaitOnTasks(array);
					if (!_running)
					{
						break;
					}
					if (num >= 0)
					{
						AsyncDataSourcePageRequest asyncDataSourcePageRequest = array[num];
						GetCompletedTaskData(asyncVirtualDataSourceProviderTaskDataHolder, num);
						lock (SyncLock)
						{
							_tasks.Remove(asyncDataSourcePageRequest);
							RemoveCompletedTaskData(asyncVirtualDataSourceProviderTaskDataHolder, num);
						}
						ProcessCompletedTask(asyncDataSourcePageRequest.TaskHolder, asyncDataSourcePageRequest.RetryDelay, asyncDataSourcePageRequest.Index, asyncVirtualDataSourceProviderTaskDataHolder);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					AwaitChanges();
				}
			}
			while (_running);
		}

		[DontObfuscate]
		protected virtual void MakeTaskForRequest(AsyncDataSourcePageRequest request, int retryDelay)
		{
		}

		[DontObfuscate]
		protected virtual void ProcessCompletedTask(AsyncDataSourcePageTaskHolder task, int retryDelay, int index, AsyncVirtualDataSourceProviderTaskDataHolder taskDataHolder)
		{
		}

		[DontObfuscate]
		protected void RetryIndex(int pageIndex, int currentDelay)
		{
			int nextDelay = currentDelay * 2;
			if (currentDelay > 20000)
			{
				RemovePageRequest(pageIndex);
			}
			if (_executionContext == null)
			{
				Shutdown();
				return;
			}
			if (!(_executionContext.Target is IDataSourceExecutionContext dataSourceExecutionContext))
			{
				Shutdown();
				return;
			}
			dataSourceExecutionContext.ExecuteDelayed(delegate
			{
				AddPageRequestWithRetry(pageIndex, DataSourcePageRequestPriority.Low, nextDelay);
			}, currentDelay);
		}

		[DontObfuscate]
		protected bool IsLastPage(int pageIndex)
		{
			if (_actualCount < 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_actualCount - pageIndex * _actualPageSize < _actualPageSize)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public virtual void CreateBatchRequest(TransactionState[] changes)
		{
		}
	}

	[JsonAPIRedirect("Infragistics.Controls.DataSource.FilterExpression")]
	public interface IFilterExpression
	{
		bool IsPropertyReference { get; }

		bool IsOperation { get; }

		bool IsFunction { get; }

		bool IsLiteral { get; }

		bool IsNull { get; }

		bool IsWrapper { get; }

		int Precedence { get; }

		bool IsAutoGenerated { get; }

		object Evaluate(object item, IDataSourceDataProvider dataProvider, IDataSourceSchema schema);

		bool Match(object item, IDataSourceDataProvider dataProvider, IDataSourceSchema schema);

		void MarkAutoGenerated();
	}
	public interface IOperationFilterExpression : IFilterExpression
	{
		FilterExpressionOperatorType Operator { get; }

		IFilterExpression Left { get; }

		IFilterExpression Right { get; }
	}

		private bool _hasBooleanReturn;

		private bool _isAutoGenerated;

		public bool IsAutoGenerated => _isAutoGenerated;

		public virtual bool IsPropertyReference => false;

		public virtual bool IsOperation => false;

		public virtual bool IsFunction => false;

		public virtual bool IsLiteral => false;

		public virtual bool IsNull => false;

		public virtual bool IsWrapper => false;

		public void MarkAutoGenerated()
		{
			_isAutoGenerated = true;
		}

			return val is IFilterExpression;

		}

		[BlazorSuppressWidgetMember]
		public bool Match(object item, IDataSourceDataProvider dataProvider, IDataSourceSchema schema)
		{
			object value = Evaluate(item, dataProvider, schema);
			return ToBoolean(value, dataProvider, schema);
		}

		internal bool ToBoolean(object value, IDataSourceDataProvider dataProvider, IDataSourceSchema schema)
		{
			if (!_hasBooleanReturn)
			{
				return CoerceBoolean(value, dataProvider, schema);
			}
			return (bool)value;
		}

		private bool CoerceBoolean(object value, IDataSourceDataProvider dataProvider, IDataSourceSchema schema)
		{
			return Convert.ToBoolean(value);
		}

	[DontHide]
	[DontObfuscate]
	public class OperationFilterExpression : FilterExpression, IOperationFilterExpression, IFilterExpression
	{
		private IFilterExpression _left;

		private bool _hasLeft;

		private IFilterExpression _right;

		private bool _hasRight;

		private FilterExpressionOperatorType _operator;

		public override bool IsOperation => true;

		public bool IsComparisonOperation
		{
			get
			{
				switch (Operator)
				{
				case FilterExpressionOperatorType.None:
				case FilterExpressionOperatorType.Equal:
				case FilterExpressionOperatorType.NotEqual:
				case FilterExpressionOperatorType.GreaterThan:
				case FilterExpressionOperatorType.GreaterThanOrEqual:
				case FilterExpressionOperatorType.LessThan:
				case FilterExpressionOperatorType.LessThanOrEqual:
					return true;
				default:
					return false;
				}
			}
		}

		public string PropertyName
		{
			get
			{
				if (_left == null || !_left.IsPropertyReference)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return ((PropertyReferenceFilterExpression)_left).PropertyReference;
			}
			set
			{
				Left = FilterExpression.Property(value);
			}
		}

		public bool HasPropertyName
		{
			get
			{
				if (_left != null)
				{
					return _left.IsPropertyReference;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public object Value
		{
			get
			{
				if (_right == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (_right.IsNull)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (!_right.IsLiteral)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return ((LiteralFilterExpression)_right).LiteralValue;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == null)
				{
					Right = FilterExpression.NullLiteral();
				}
				else
				{
					Right = FilterExpression.Literal(value);
				}
			}
		}

		public bool HasValue => _right != null;

		public IFilterExpression Left
		{
			get
			{
				return _left;
			}
			set
			{
				_left = value;
				_hasLeft = true;
				UpdateBooleanReturn();
			}
		}

		public bool HasLeft => _hasLeft;

		public IFilterExpression Right
		{
			get
			{
				return _right;
			}
			set
			{
				_right = value;
				_hasRight = true;
				UpdateBooleanReturn();
			}
		}

		public bool HasRight => _hasRight;

		public FilterExpressionOperatorType Operator
		{
			get
			{
				return _operator;
			}
			set
			{
				_operator = value;
				UpdateBooleanReturn();
			}
		}

		public bool HasOperator => _operator != FilterExpressionOperatorType.None;

		protected bool IsBooleanOperation
		{
			get
			{
				switch (Operator)
				{
				case FilterExpressionOperatorType.Equal:
				case FilterExpressionOperatorType.NotEqual:
				case FilterExpressionOperatorType.GreaterThan:
				case FilterExpressionOperatorType.GreaterThanOrEqual:
				case FilterExpressionOperatorType.LessThan:
				case FilterExpressionOperatorType.LessThanOrEqual:
				case FilterExpressionOperatorType.And:
				case FilterExpressionOperatorType.Or:
				case FilterExpressionOperatorType.Not:
					return true;
				default:
					return false;
				}
			}
		}

		public override int Precedence => Operator switch
		{
			FilterExpressionOperatorType.Grouping => 0, 
			FilterExpressionOperatorType.Not => 4, 
			FilterExpressionOperatorType.Multiply => 6,

		public override object Evaluate(object item, IDataSourceDataProvider dataProvider, IDataSourceSchema schema)
		{
			switch (Operator)
			{
			case FilterExpressionOperatorType.Add:
			case FilterExpressionOperatorType.Subtract:
			case FilterExpressionOperatorType.Multiply:
			case FilterExpressionOperatorType.Divide:
			case FilterExpressionOperatorType.Modulo:
				return EvaluateArithmetic(item, dataProvider, schema);
			case FilterExpressionOperatorType.None:
			case FilterExpressionOperatorType.Equal:
			case FilterExpressionOperatorType.NotEqual:
			case FilterExpressionOperatorType.GreaterThan:
			case FilterExpressionOperatorType.GreaterThanOrEqual:
			case FilterExpressionOperatorType.LessThan:
			case FilterExpressionOperatorType.LessThanOrEqual:
				return EvaluateComparison(item, dataProvider, schema);
			case FilterExpressionOperatorType.And:
			case FilterExpressionOperatorType.Or:
			case FilterExpressionOperatorType.Not:
				return EvaluateLogical(item, dataProvider, schema);
			case FilterExpressionOperatorType.Grouping:
				if (Left != null)
				{
					return Left.Evaluate(item, dataProvider, schema);
				}
				if (Right == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return Right.Evaluate(item, dataProvider, schema);
			default:
				throw new NotImplementedException();
			}
		}

					if (num3 > 0)

		private object EvaluateLogical(object item, IDataSourceDataProvider dataProvider, IDataSourceSchema schema)
		{

					return !(bool)obj2;
				}
				return !(bool)obj;
			case FilterExpressionOperatorType.Or:
				return (bool)obj || (bool)obj2;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		private object CoerceType(object val, Type targetType)
		{
			if (targetType == typeof(string))
			{
				if (val == null)
				{
					return "";
				}
				return val.ToString();
			}
			if (targetType == typeof(int) || targetType == typeof(short) || targetType == typeof(int))
			{
				return Convert.ToInt32(val);
			}
			if (targetType == typeof(bool))
			{
				return Convert.ToBoolean(val);
			}
			if (targetType == typeof(byte))
			{
				return Convert.ToByte(val);
			}
			if (targetType == typeof(DateTime))
			{
				return Convert.ToDateTime(val);
			}
			if (targetType == typeof(DateTimeOffset))
			{
				if (val is DateTimeOffset)
				{
					return (DateTimeOffset)val;
				}
				return (DateTimeOffset)Convert.ToDateTime(val);
			}
			if (targetType == typeof(long) || targetType == typeof(long))
			{
				return Convert.ToInt64(val);
			}
			if (targetType == typeof(decimal))
			{
				return Convert.ToDecimal(val);
			}
			if (targetType == typeof(sbyte))
			{
				return Convert.ToSByte(val);
			}
			return val;
		}

		private Type GetTargetType(object propertyType, object literalValue)
		{
			if (propertyType is DataSourceSchemaPropertyType || propertyType is int)
			{
				switch ((DataSourceSchemaPropertyType)(int)propertyType)
				{
				case DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.BooleanValue:
					return typeof(bool);
				case DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.ByteValue:
					return typeof(byte);
				case DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.DateTimeOffsetValue:
					return typeof(DateTimeOffset);
				case DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.DateTimeValue:
					return typeof(DateTime);
				case DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.DecimalValue:
					return typeof(decimal);
				case DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.DoubleValue:
					return typeof(double);
				case DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.IntValue:
					return typeof(int);
				case DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.LongValue:
					return typeof(long);
				case DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.ObjectValue:
					if (literalValue != null && literalValue is string)
					{
						return GetLiteralTargetType((string)literalValue);
					}
					return typeof(object);
				case DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.ShortValue:
					return typeof(short);
				case DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.SingleValue:
					return typeof(float);
				case DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.StringValue:
					return typeof(string);
				}
			}
			if (propertyType is string)
			{
				return GetLiteralTargetType((string)literalValue);
			}
			return typeof(object);
		}

		private Type GetLiteralTargetType(string literalValue)
		{
			switch (literalValue)
			{
			case "Edm.Boolean":
			case "Boolean":
			case "bool":
			case "boolean":
				return typeof(bool);
			case "Edm.Byte":
			case "Byte":
			case "byte":
			case "Edm.SByte":
			case "SByte":
				return typeof(byte);
			case "Edm.DateTimeOffset":
			case "DateTimeOffset":
				return typeof(DateTimeOffset);
			case "Edm.DateTime":
			case "DateTime":
			case "Calendar":
			case "datetime":
			case "calendar":
			case "Edm.Time":
			case "Time":
			case "time":
				return typeof(DateTime);
			case "Edm.Decimal":
			case "Decimal":
			case "decimal":
				return typeof(decimal);
			case "Edm.Double":
			case "Double":
			case "double":
				return typeof(double);
			case "Edm.Float":
			case "Float":
			case "float":
			case "Edm.Single":
			case "Single":
			case "single":
				return typeof(float);
			case "Edm.Int16":
			case "Int16":
			case "Short":
			case "short":
				return typeof(short);
			case "Edm.Int32":
			case "Int32":
			case "int":
			case "Integer":
				return typeof(int);
			case "Edm.Int64":
			case "Int64":
			case "long":
			case "Long":
				return typeof(long);
			case "Edm.String":
			case "String":
			case "string":
				return typeof(string);
			default:
				return typeof(object);
			}
		}
	}
	[DontHide]
	[DontObfuscate]
	public class PropertyReferenceFilterExpression : FilterExpression, IPropertyReferenceFilterExpression, IFilterExpression
	{
		private string _propertyReference;

		public override bool IsPropertyReference => true;

		public override int Precedence => 99;

		public string PropertyReference
		{
			get
			{
				return _propertyReference;
			}
			set
			{
				_propertyReference = value;
			}
		}

		public PropertyReferenceFilterExpression()
		{
		}

		public PropertyReferenceFilterExpression(string propertyReference)
		{
			_propertyReference = propertyReference;
		}

		protected override bool ResolveHasBooleanReturn()
		{
			return false;
		}

		public override object Evaluate(object item, IDataSourceDataProvider dataProvider, IDataSourceSchema schema)
		{
			return dataProvider.GetItemValue(item, PropertyReference);
		}
	}
