	public abstract class WrapperExpression : FilterExpression
	{
		private FilterExpression _expression;

		private bool _expressionDirty;

		public IFilterExpression InnerExpression { get; protected set; }

		public FilterExpression Expression
		{
			get
			{
				return _expression;
			}
			set
			{
				_expression = value;
				_expressionDirty = true;
			}
		}

		public string PropertyName
		{
			get
			{
				if (_expression == null || !_expression.IsPropertyReference)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return ((PropertyReferenceFilterExpression)_expression).PropertyReference;
			}
			set
			{
				Expression = FilterExpression.Property(value);
			}
		}

		public override bool IsWrapper => true;

		public override int Precedence => 99;

		protected FilterFactory Factory => FilterFactory.Instance;

		[BlazorSuppressWidgetMember]
		public abstract FilterExpressionWrapperType GetWrapperType();

		public WrapperExpression(string propertyName)
		{
			Expression = FilterFactory.Instance.Property(propertyName);
			PropertyName = propertyName;
		}

		public WrapperExpression(FilterExpression propExpression)
		{
			Expression = propExpression;
			if (Expression.IsPropertyReference)
			{
				PropertyName = ((PropertyReferenceFilterExpression)Expression).PropertyReference;
			}
		}

		protected override bool ResolveHasBooleanReturn()
		{
			return true;
		}

		public override object Evaluate(object item, IDataSourceDataProvider dataProvider, IDataSourceSchema schema)
		{
			if (InnerExpression == null || _expressionDirty)
			{
				InnerExpression = Build();
				_expressionDirty = false;
			}
			return InnerExpression.Evaluate(item, dataProvider, schema);
		}

		protected abstract IFilterExpression Build();
	}
	public class TodayExpression : WrapperExpression
	{
		public TodayExpression(string propertyName)
			: base(propertyName)
		{
		}

		public TodayExpression(FilterExpression propExpression)
			: base(propExpression)
		{
		}

		[BlazorSuppressWidgetMember]
		public override FilterExpressionWrapperType GetWrapperType()
		{
			return FilterExpressionWrapperType.Today;
		}

		protected override IFilterExpression Build()
		{
			DateTime dateTime = ((base.Factory.TodayOverride != DateTime.MinValue) ? base.Factory.TodayOverride : DateTime.Now.Date);
			FilterExpression right = FilterFactory.Instance.Literal(dateTime.Month);
			FilterExpression right2 = FilterFactory.Instance.Literal(dateTime.Day);
			FilterExpression right3 = FilterFactory.Instance.Literal(dateTime.Year);
			return base.Expression.Month().IsEqualTo(right).And(base.Expression.Day().IsEqualTo(right2))
				.And(base.Expression.Year().IsEqualTo(right3));
		}
	}

	public abstract class OffsettableWeekExpression : WrapperExpression
	{
		protected int Offset { get; set; }

		public OffsettableWeekExpression(string propertyName)
			: base(propertyName)
		{
		}

		public OffsettableWeekExpression(FilterExpression propExpression)
			: base(propExpression)
		{
		}

		protected override IFilterExpression Build()
		{
			DateTime dateTime = ((base.Factory.TodayOverride != DateTime.MinValue) ? base.Factory.TodayOverride : DateTime.Now.Date).AddDays(Offset);
			DateTime dateTime2 = dateTime.AddDays(0 - dateTime.DayOfWeek);
			DateTime dateTime3 = dateTime.AddDays((double)(6 - dateTime.DayOfWeek));
			bool flag = false;
			DateTime dateTime4 = DateTime.MinValue;
			DateTime dateTime5 = DateTime.MinValue;
			DateTime dateTime6 = DateTime.MinValue;
			DateTime dateTime7 = DateTime.MinValue;
			for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++)
			{
				DateTime dateTime8 = dateTime3.AddDays(-i);
				if (dateTime8.Day == 1)
				{
					if (i != 6)
					{
						flag = true;
						dateTime5 = dateTime8.AddDays(-1.0);
						dateTime4 = dateTime5.AddDays(-(6 - i - 1));
						dateTime6 = dateTime8;
						dateTime7 = dateTime8.AddDays(i);
					}
					break;
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				FilterExpression filterExpression = base.Expression.Year().IsEqualTo(base.Factory.Literal(dateTime4.Year)).And(base.Expression.Month().IsEqualTo(base.Factory.Literal(dateTime4.Month)));
				IFilterExpression filterExpression2 = null;
				filterExpression2 = ((dateTime5.Day - dateTime4.Day <= 0) ? base.Expression.Day().IsEqualTo(base.Factory.Literal(dateTime4.Day)) : base.Expression.Day().IsGreaterThanOrEqualTo(base.Factory.Literal(dateTime4.Day)).And(base.Expression.Day().IsLessThanOrEqualTo(base.Factory.Literal(dateTime5.Day))));
				FilterExpression filterExpression3 = filterExpression.And(filterExpression2);
				FilterExpression filterExpression4 = base.Expression.Year().IsEqualTo(base.Factory.Literal(dateTime6.Year)).And(base.Expression.Month().IsEqualTo(base.Factory.Literal(dateTime6.Month)));
				IFilterExpression filterExpression5 = null;
				filterExpression5 = ((dateTime7.Day - dateTime6.Day <= 0) ? base.Expression.Day().IsEqualTo(base.Factory.Literal(dateTime6.Day)) : base.Expression.Day().IsGreaterThanOrEqualTo(base.Factory.Literal(dateTime6.Day)).And(base.Expression.Day().IsLessThanOrEqualTo(base.Factory.Literal(dateTime7.Day))));
				FilterExpression right = filterExpression4.And(filterExpression5);
				return filterExpression3.Or(right);
			}
			FilterExpression right2 = FilterFactory.Instance.Literal(dateTime.Month);
			FilterExpression right3 = FilterFactory.Instance.Literal(dateTime.Year);
			FilterExpression right4 = FilterFactory.Instance.Literal(dateTime2.Day);
			FilterExpression right5 = FilterFactory.Instance.Literal(dateTime3.Day);
			return base.Expression.Year().IsEqualTo(right3).And(base.Expression.Month().IsEqualTo(right2))
				.And(base.Expression.Day().IsGreaterThanOrEqualTo(right4))
				.And(base.Expression.Day().IsLessThanOrEqualTo(right5));
		}
	}

	public class ThisQuarterExpression : WrapperExpression
	{
		public ThisQuarterExpression(string propertyName)
			: base(propertyName)
		{
		}

		public ThisQuarterExpression(FilterExpression propExpression)
			: base(propExpression)
		{
		}

		[BlazorSuppressWidgetMember]
		public override FilterExpressionWrapperType GetWrapperType()
		{
			return FilterExpressionWrapperType.ThisQuarter;
		}

		protected override IFilterExpression Build()
		{
			DateTime dateTime = ((base.Factory.TodayOverride != DateTime.MinValue) ? base.Factory.TodayOverride : DateTime.Now.Date);
			FilterExpression filterExpression = base.Expression.Year().IsEqualTo(base.Factory.Literal(dateTime.Year));
			if (dateTime.Month == 1 || dateTime.Month == 2 || dateTime.Month == 3)
			{
				return filterExpression.And(base.Expression.IsQ1());
			}
			if (dateTime.Month == 4 || dateTime.Month == 5 || dateTime.Month == 6)
			{
				return filterExpression.And(base.Expression.IsQ2());
			}
			if (dateTime.Month == 7 || dateTime.Month == 8 || dateTime.Month == 9)
			{
				return filterExpression.And(base.Expression.IsQ3());
			}
			return filterExpression.And(base.Expression.IsQ4());
		}
	}

			if (dateTime.Month == 1 || dateTime.Month == 2 || dateTime.Month == 3)

			if (dateTime.Month == 4 || dateTime.Month == 5 || dateTime.Month == 6)
			{
				return filterExpression.And(base.Expression.IsQ3());

	[JsonAPIWidget]
	public enum FilterExpressionFunctionType
	{
		Contains,
		EndsWith,
		StartsWith,
		[TSClientName("Length")]
		Length,
		IndexOf,
		Replace,
		Substring,
		ToLower,
		ToUpper,
		Trim,
		Concat,
		Day,
		Hour,
		Minute,
		Month,
		Second,
		Year,
		Round,
		Floor,
		Ceiling,
		Date,
		Time,
		Now,

	[DontHide]
	[DontObfuscate]
	public class FilterExpressionVisitor
	{
		public void Visit(IFilterExpression expression)
		{
			if (expression == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Expected an expression but found none");
			}
			if (expression.IsOperation)
			{
				VisitOperationExpression((IOperationFilterExpression)expression);
			}
			else if (expression.IsFunction)
			{
				VisitFunctionExpression((IFunctionFilterExpression)expression);
			}
			else if (expression.IsLiteral)
			{
				VisitLiteralExpression((ILiteralFilterExpression)expression);
			}
			else if (expression.IsPropertyReference)
			{
				VisitPropertyReferenceExpression((IPropertyReferenceFilterExpression)expression);
			}
			else if (expression.IsWrapper)
			{
				WrapperExpression wrapperExpression = (WrapperExpression)expression;
				Visit(wrapperExpression.InnerExpression);
			}
		}

		public virtual void VisitOperationExpression(IOperationFilterExpression expression)
		{
			if (expression.Left != null)
			{
				Visit(expression.Left);
			}
			if (expression.Right != null)
			{
				Visit(expression.Right);
			}
		}

		public virtual void VisitFunctionExpression(IFunctionFilterExpression expression)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < expression.FunctionArguments.All.Count; i++)
			{
				Visit(expression.FunctionArguments.All[i]);
			}
		}

		public virtual void VisitLiteralExpression(ILiteralFilterExpression expression)
		{
		}

		public virtual void VisitPropertyReferenceExpression(IPropertyReferenceFilterExpression expression)
		{
		}
	}

	[DontHide]
	[DontObfuscate]
	[ClientName("ODataLiteralEmitter")]
	public interface IODataLiteralEmitter
	{
		string EmitLiteral(object value, bool leaveUnquoted);
	}
	[DontHide]
	[DontObfuscate]
	public class DefaultODataLiteralEmitter : IODataLiteralEmitter
	{
		public string EmitLiteral(object value, bool leaveUnquoted)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return "null";
			}
			if (value is bool)
			{
				if (!(bool)value)
				{
					return "false";
				}
				return "true";
			}
			if (value is DateTime)
			{
				return EmitDateTime((DateTime)value);
			}
			if (value is TimeSpan)
			{
				return EmitTimespan((TimeSpan)value);
			}
			if (value is DateTimeOffset)
			{
				return EmitDateTimeOffset((DateTimeOffset)value);
			}
			if (value is string)
			{
				string text = value.ToString();
				if (!leaveUnquoted)
				{
					text = "'" + text + "'";
				}
				return text;
			}
			return value.ToString();
		}

		private string EmitTimespan(TimeSpan value)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			if (value.TotalMilliseconds < 0.0)
			{
				flag = true;
				value = value.Negate();
			}
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			stringBuilder.Append("duration'");
			if (flag)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append("-");
			}
			stringBuilder.Append("P");
			if (value.Days > 0)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(value.Days.ToString());
				stringBuilder.Append("D");
			}
			stringBuilder.Append("T");
			if (value.Hours > 0)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(value.Hours);
				stringBuilder.Append("H");
			}
			if (value.Minutes > 0 || value.Hours > 0)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(value.Minutes);
				stringBuilder.Append("M");
			}
			if (value.Seconds > 0 || value.Milliseconds > 0 || value.Hours > 0 || value.Minutes > 0)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(value.Seconds);
				if (value.Milliseconds > 0)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(".");
					stringBuilder.Append(((double)value.Milliseconds / 1000.0).ToString());
				}
				stringBuilder.Append("S");
			}
			stringBuilder.Append("'");
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		private string EmitDateTimeOffset(DateTimeOffset value)
		{
			value = value.ToUniversalTime();
			return string.Format("datetime'{0}Z", value.ToString("s") + "'");
		}

		private string EmitDateTime(DateTime value)
		{
			if (value.Kind == DateTimeKind.Local)
			{
				value = value.ToUniversalTime();
			}
			string text = ((value.Second == 0 && value.Millisecond == 0) ? value.ToString("yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm") : ((value.Millisecond != 0) ? value.ToString("yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.fffffff") : value.ToString("yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss")));
			return "datetime'" + text + "'";
		}
	}
	[DontHide]
	[DontObfuscate]
	public class ODataDataSourceFilterExpressionVisitor : FilterExpressionVisitor
	{
		private StringBuilder _sb;

		private IODataLiteralEmitter _literalEmitter;

		public ODataDataSourceFilterExpressionVisitor()
		{
			_literalEmitter = new DefaultODataLiteralEmitter();
			_sb = new StringBuilder();
		}

		public ODataDataSourceFilterExpressionVisitor(IODataLiteralEmitter literalEmitter)
			: this()
		{
			_literalEmitter = literalEmitter;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return _sb.ToString();
		}

		public override void VisitOperationExpression(IOperationFilterExpression expression)
		{
			bool flag = true;
			string text = "";
			switch (expression.Operator)
			{
			case FilterExpressionOperatorType.Add:
				text = "add";
				break;
			case FilterExpressionOperatorType.And:
				text = "and";
				break;
			case FilterExpressionOperatorType.Divide:
				text = "div";
				break;
			case FilterExpressionOperatorType.None:
			case FilterExpressionOperatorType.Equal:
				text = "eq";
				break;
			case FilterExpressionOperatorType.GreaterThan:
				text = "gt";
				break;
			case FilterExpressionOperatorType.GreaterThanOrEqual:
				text = "ge";
				break;
			case FilterExpressionOperatorType.Grouping:
				flag = false;
				break;
			case FilterExpressionOperatorType.LessThan:
				text = "lt";
				break;
			case FilterExpressionOperatorType.LessThanOrEqual:
				text = "le";
				break;
			case FilterExpressionOperatorType.Modulo:
				text = "mod";
				break;
			case FilterExpressionOperatorType.Multiply:
				text = "mul";
				break;
			case FilterExpressionOperatorType.Not:
				text = "not";
				flag = false;
				break;
			case FilterExpressionOperatorType.NotEqual:
				text = "ne";
				break;
			case FilterExpressionOperatorType.Or:
				text = "or";
				break;
			case FilterExpressionOperatorType.Subtract:
				text = "sub";
				break;
			default:
				text = "eq";
				break;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				if (NeedsGrouping(expression, expression.Left))
				{
					_sb.Append("(");
				}
				Visit(expression.Left);
				if (NeedsGrouping(expression, expression.Left))
				{
					_sb.Append(")");
				}
				_sb.Append(" ");
				_sb.Append(text);
				_sb.Append(" ");
				if (NeedsGrouping(expression, expression.Right))
				{
					_sb.Append("(");
				}
				Visit(expression.Right);
				if (NeedsGrouping(expression, expression.Right))
				{
					_sb.Append(")");
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (expression.Operator == FilterExpressionOperatorType.Grouping)
				{
					_sb.Append("(");
				}
				else
				{
					_sb.AppendLine(text + " ");
				}
				if (expression.Left != null)
				{
					Visit(expression.Left);
				}
				else
				{
					Visit(expression.Right);
				}
				if (expression.Operator == FilterExpressionOperatorType.Grouping)
				{
					_sb.Append(")");
				}
			}
		}

		private bool NeedsGrouping(IFilterExpression expression, IFilterExpression child)
		{
			int precedence = expression.Precedence;
			int num = child?.Precedence ?? 0;
			if (child != null && child.IsOperation && ((IOperationFilterExpression)child).Operator == FilterExpressionOperatorType.Grouping)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return num < precedence;
		}

		public override void VisitFunctionExpression(IFunctionFilterExpression expression)
		{
			string value = "";
			switch (expression.FunctionType)
			{
			case FilterExpressionFunctionType.Ceiling:
				value = "ceiling";
				break;
			case FilterExpressionFunctionType.Concat:
				value = "concat";
				break;
			case FilterExpressionFunctionType.Contains:
				value = "contains";
				break;
			case FilterExpressionFunctionType.Day:
				value = "day";
				break;
			case FilterExpressionFunctionType.EndsWith:
				value = "endswith";
				break;
			case FilterExpressionFunctionType.Floor:
				value = "floor";
				break;
			case FilterExpressionFunctionType.Hour:
				value = "hour";
				break;
			case FilterExpressionFunctionType.IndexOf:
				value = "indexof";
				break;
			case FilterExpressionFunctionType.Length:
				value = "length";
				break;
			case FilterExpressionFunctionType.Minute:
				value = "minute";
				break;
			case FilterExpressionFunctionType.Month:
				value = "month";
				break;
			case FilterExpressionFunctionType.Replace:
				value = "replace";
				break;
			case FilterExpressionFunctionType.Round:
				value = "round";
				break;
			case FilterExpressionFunctionType.Second:
				value = "second";
				break;
			case FilterExpressionFunctionType.StartsWith:
				value = "startswith";
				break;
			case FilterExpressionFunctionType.Substring:
				value = "substring";
				break;
			case FilterExpressionFunctionType.ToLower:
				value = "tolower";
				break;
			case FilterExpressionFunctionType.ToUpper:
				value = "toupper";
				break;
			case FilterExpressionFunctionType.Trim:
				value = "trim";
				break;
			case FilterExpressionFunctionType.Year:
				value = "year";
				break;
			}
			_sb.Append(value);
			_sb.Append("(");
			bool flag = true;
			for (int i = 0; i < expression.FunctionArguments.All.Count; i++)
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					flag = false;
				}
				else
				{
					_sb.Append(", ");
				}
				Visit(expression.FunctionArguments.All[i]);
			}
			_sb.Append(")");
		}

		public override void VisitLiteralExpression(ILiteralFilterExpression expression)
		{
			RenderLiteral(expression, expression.LiteralValue);
		}

		private void RenderLiteral(ILiteralFilterExpression expression, object literalValue)
		{
			string value = _literalEmitter.EmitLiteral(literalValue, expression.LeaveUnquoted);
			_sb.Append(value);
		}

		public override void VisitPropertyReferenceExpression(IPropertyReferenceFilterExpression expression)
		{
			RenderPropertyReference(expression.PropertyReference);
		}

		private void RenderPropertyReference(string propertyReference)
		{
			_sb.Append(propertyReference);
		}
	}

	[DontHide]
	public class ODataSchemaProvider
	{
		private string _entityTypeSchemaNamespace;

		private string _entitySetSchemaNamespace;

		private Schema Schema { get; set; }

		public ODataSchemaProvider(string metadataDocument)
		{
			if (metadataDocument == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			XmlDocument xmlDocument = new XmlDocument();
			xmlDocument.LoadXml(metadataDocument);
			XmlNodeList elementsByTagName = xmlDocument.GetElementsByTagName("Schema");
			if (elementsByTagName == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			XmlNodeList xmlNodeList = null;
			XmlNodeList xmlNodeList2 = null;
			int count = elementsByTagName.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (elementsByTagName[i].NodeType != XmlNodeType.Element)
				{
					continue;
				}
				XmlElement xmlElement = (XmlElement)elementsByTagName[i];
				if (xmlNodeList == null)
				{
					XmlNodeList elementsByTagName2 = xmlElement.GetElementsByTagName("EntityContainer");
					if (elementsByTagName2 != null && elementsByTagName2.Count > 0)
					{
						xmlNodeList = (elementsByTagName2[0] as XmlElement).GetElementsByTagName("EntitySet");
						if (xmlNodeList != null)
						{
							_entitySetSchemaNamespace = xmlElement.Attributes["Namespace"].Value;
						}
					}
				}
				if (xmlNodeList2 == null)
				{
					xmlNodeList2 = xmlElement.GetElementsByTagName("EntityType");
					if (xmlNodeList2 != null)
					{
						_entityTypeSchemaNamespace = xmlElement.Attributes["Namespace"].Value;
					}
				}
			}
			if (xmlNodeList != null && xmlNodeList2 != null)
			{
				Schema = new Schema(_entityTypeSchemaNamespace, xmlNodeList2, xmlNodeList);
			}
		}

		public IDataSourceSchema GetODataDataSourceSchema(string entitySet)
		{
			if (Schema == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			List<DataSourceSchemaPropertyType> list2 = new List<DataSourceSchemaPropertyType>();
			List<string> list3 = new List<string>();
			EntitySet entitySet2 = Schema.EntitySets[entitySet];
			if (entitySet2 != null)
			{
				Entity entity = Schema.Entities[entitySet2.EntityName];
				if (entity != null)
				{
					foreach (EntityProperty value in entity.Properties.Values)
					{
						list.Add(value.Name);
						if (value.Type == typeof(string))
						{
							list2.Add(DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.StringValue);
						}
						else if (value.Type == typeof(double))
						{
							list2.Add(DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.DoubleValue);
						}
						else if (value.Type == typeof(int) || value.Type == typeof(short) || value.Type == typeof(int))
						{
							list2.Add(DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.IntValue);
						}
						else if (value.Type == typeof(bool))
						{
							list2.Add(DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.BooleanValue);
						}
						else if (value.Type == typeof(byte))
						{
							list2.Add(DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.ShortValue);
						}
						else if (value.Type == typeof(DateTime))
						{
							list2.Add(DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.DateTimeValue);
						}
						else if (value.Type == typeof(DateTimeOffset))
						{
							list2.Add(DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.DateTimeOffsetValue);
						}
						else if (value.Type == typeof(long) || value.Type == typeof(long))
						{
							list2.Add(DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.LongValue);
						}
						else if (value.Type == typeof(decimal))
						{
							list2.Add(DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.DecimalValue);
						}
						else if (value.Type == typeof(sbyte))
						{
							list2.Add(DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.ShortValue);
						}
						else
						{
							list2.Add(DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.ObjectValue);
						}
					}
					list3.AddRange(entity.PrimaryKey);
				}
			}
			return new ODataDataSourceSchema(list.ToArray(), list2.ToArray(), list3.ToArray());
		}
	}
	internal class Schema
	{
		private Dictionary<string, Entity> _entities;

		private Dictionary<string, EntitySet> _entitySets;

		internal Dictionary<string, Entity> Entities
		{
			get
			{
				if (_entities == null)
				{
					_entities = new Dictionary<string, Entity>();
				}
				return _entities;
			}
		}

		internal Dictionary<string, EntitySet> EntitySets
		{
			get
			{
				if (_entitySets == null)
				{
					_entitySets = new Dictionary<string, EntitySet>();
				}
				return _entitySets;
			}
		}

		internal string Namespace { get; private set; }

		internal Schema(string @namespace, XmlNodeList entityTypeElements, XmlNodeList entitySetElements)
		{
			Namespace = @namespace;
			LoadEntities(entityTypeElements);
			LoadEntitySets(entitySetElements);
		}

		private void LoadEntities(XmlNodeList entityTypeElements)
		{
			int count = entityTypeElements.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				XmlNode xmlNode = entityTypeElements[i];
				Entity entity = new Entity(xmlNode.Attributes["Name"].Value, xmlNode);
				Entities.Add(entity.Name, entity);
			}
		}

		private void LoadEntitySets(XmlNodeList entitySetElements)
		{
			int count = entitySetElements.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				XmlNode xmlNode = entitySetElements[i];
				EntitySet entitySet = new EntitySet(xmlNode.Attributes["Name"].Value, xmlNode.Attributes["EntityType"].Value);
				EntitySets.Add(entitySet.Name, entitySet);
			}
		}
	}
	internal class Entity
	{
		private Dictionary<string, EntityProperty> _properties;

		private List<string> _primaryKey;

		internal string Name { get; private set; }

		internal Dictionary<string, EntityProperty> Properties
		{
			get
			{
				if (_properties == null)
				{
					_properties = new Dictionary<string, EntityProperty>();
				}
				return _properties;
			}
		}

		internal List<string> PrimaryKey
		{
			get
			{
				if (_primaryKey == null)
				{
					_primaryKey = new List<string>();
				}
				return _primaryKey;
			}
		}

		internal Entity(string name, XmlNode entityNode)
		{
			Name = name;
			LoadProperties(entityNode);
			LoadPrimaryKey(entityNode);
		}

		private void LoadProperties(XmlNode entityNode)
		{
			int count = entityNode.ChildNodes.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				XmlNode xmlNode = entityNode.ChildNodes[i];
				if (xmlNode.Name == "Property")
				{
					string value = xmlNode.Attributes["Name"].Value;
					string value2 = xmlNode.Attributes["Type"].Value;
					Properties.Add(value, new EntityProperty(value, value2));
				}
			}
		}

		private void LoadPrimaryKey(XmlNode entityNode)
		{
			int count = entityNode.ChildNodes.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				XmlNode xmlNode = entityNode.ChildNodes[i];
				if (!(xmlNode.Name == "Key"))
				{
					continue;
				}
				int count2 = xmlNode.ChildNodes.Count;
				for (int j = 0; j < count2; j++)
				{
					XmlNode xmlNode2 = xmlNode.ChildNodes[j];
					if (xmlNode2.Name == "PropertyRef")
					{
						PrimaryKey.Add(xmlNode2.Attributes["Name"].Value);
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	internal class EntityProperty
	{
		internal string Name { get; private set; }

		internal bool IsNullable { get; private set; }

		internal Type Type { get; private set; }

		internal EntityProperty(string name, string schemaType)
		{
			Name = name;
			Type = GetTypeFromSchemaType(schemaType);
		}

		private Type GetTypeFromSchemaType(string schemaType)
		{
			return schemaType switch
			{
				"Edm.Binary" => typeof(object), 
				"Edm.Boolean" => typeof(bool), 
				"Edm.Byte" => typeof(byte), 
				"Edm.DateTime" => typeof(DateTime), 
				"Edm.DateTimeOffset" => typeof(DateTimeOffset), 
				"Edm.Decimal" => typeof(decimal), 
				"Edm.Double" => typeof(double), 
				"Edm.Float" => typeof(float), 
				"Edm.Guid" => typeof(Guid), 
				"Edm.Int16" => typeof(short), 
				"Edm.Int32" => typeof(int), 
				"Edm.Int64" => typeof(long), 
				"Edm.SByte" => typeof(sbyte), 
				"Edm.String" => typeof(string), 
				"Edm.Time" => typeof(DateTime), 
				_ => typeof(string), 
			};
		}
	}
	internal class EntitySet
	{
		internal string EntityName { get; private set; }

		internal string EntityNamespace { get; private set; }

		internal string EntityType { get; private set; }

		internal string Name { get; private set; }

		internal EntitySet(string name, string entityType)
		{
			Name = name;
			EntityType = entityType;
			if (entityType.Contains("."))
			{
				string[] array = entityType.Split('.');
				if (array.Length == 2)
				{
					EntityNamespace = array[0];
					EntityName = array[1];
				}
				else
				{
					int num = entityType.LastIndexOf(".");
					EntityNamespace = entityType.Substring(0, num);
					EntityName = entityType.Substring(num + 1);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				EntityNamespace = entityType;
				EntityName = entityType;
			}
		}
	}

	[DontHide]
	[DontObfuscate]
	public class SumSummaryCalculator : SummaryCalculator
	{
		private double _sum;

		public override string DisplayName
		{
			get
			{
				string text = Infragistics.Controls.DataSource.Implementation.BaseDataSource.GetString("DataSource_Summary_Sum");
				if (text == null)
				{
					return "Sum";
				}
				return text;
			}
		}

		public override SummaryOperand Operand => SummaryOperand.Sum;

		public override void BeginCalculation(IDataSource dataSource, string propertyName)
		{
			base.BeginCalculation(dataSource, propertyName);
			_sum = 0.0;
		}

		public override ISummaryResult EndCalculation()
		{
			return new DefaultSummaryResult(base.PropertyName, SummaryOperand.Sum, GetExpectedTypeFromDouble(_sum));
		}

		public override void Aggregate(object item)
		{
			double itemAsDouble = GetItemAsDouble(item);
			if (!double.IsNaN(itemAsDouble))
			{
				_sum += itemAsDouble;
			}
		}

		public override ISummaryResult ItemAdded(object item, ISummaryResult previousResult, int currentCount)
		{
			double num = GetItemAsDouble(item);
			if (double.IsNaN(num))
			{
				num = 0.0;
			}
			if (previousResult == null)
			{
				return new DefaultSummaryResult(base.PropertyName, SummaryOperand.Sum, GetExpectedTypeFromDouble(num));
			}
			double value = GetValueAsDouble(previousResult.Value) + num;
			return new DefaultSummaryResult(base.PropertyName, SummaryOperand.Sum, GetExpectedTypeFromDouble(value));
		}

		public override ISummaryResult ItemRemoved(object item, ISummaryResult previousResult, int currentCount)
		{
			double num = GetItemAsDouble(item);
			if (double.IsNaN(num))
			{
				num = 0.0;
			}
			double value = GetValueAsDouble(previousResult.Value) - num;
			return new DefaultSummaryResult(base.PropertyName, SummaryOperand.Sum, GetExpectedTypeFromDouble(value));
		}
	}

	public class AverageSummaryCalculator : SummaryCalculator
	{
		private double _sum;

		private int _count;

		public override string DisplayName
		{
			get
			{
				string text = Infragistics.Controls.DataSource.Implementation.BaseDataSource.GetString("DataSource_Summary_Avg");
				if (text == null)
				{
					return "Avg";
				}
				return text;
			}
		}

		public override SummaryOperand Operand => SummaryOperand.Average;

		public override void BeginCalculation(IDataSource dataSource, string propertyName)
		{
			base.BeginCalculation(dataSource, propertyName);
			_sum = 0.0;
			_count = 0;
		}

		public override ISummaryResult EndCalculation()
		{
			double value = ((_count > 0) ? (_sum / (double)_count) : 0.0);
			return new DefaultSummaryResult(base.PropertyName, SummaryOperand.Average, GetExpectedTypeFromDouble(value));
		}

		public override void Aggregate(object item)
		{
			double itemAsDouble = GetItemAsDouble(item);
			if (!double.IsNaN(itemAsDouble))
			{
				_sum += itemAsDouble;
				_count++;
			}
		}

		public override ISummaryResult ItemAdded(object item, ISummaryResult previousResult, int currentCount)
		{
			double num = GetItemAsDouble(item);
			if (double.IsNaN(num))
			{
				num = 0.0;
			}
			if (previousResult == null)
			{
				return new DefaultSummaryResult(base.PropertyName, SummaryOperand.Average, GetExpectedTypeFromDouble(num));
			}
			double value = (GetValueAsDouble(previousResult.Value) * (double)(currentCount - 1) + num) / (double)currentCount;
			return new DefaultSummaryResult(base.PropertyName, SummaryOperand.Average, GetExpectedTypeFromDouble(value));
		}

		public override ISummaryResult ItemRemoved(object item, ISummaryResult previousResult, int currentCount)
		{
			double num = GetItemAsDouble(item);
			if (double.IsNaN(num))
			{
				num = 0.0;
			}
			double value = (GetValueAsDouble(previousResult.Value) * (double)(currentCount + 1) - num) / (double)currentCount;
			return new DefaultSummaryResult(base.PropertyName, SummaryOperand.Average, GetExpectedTypeFromDouble(value));
		}
	}
	[DontHide]
	[DontObfuscate]
	public class MaxSummaryCalculator : SummaryCalculator
	{
		private object _currMax;

		public override string DisplayName
		{
			get
			{
				string text = Infragistics.Controls.DataSource.Implementation.BaseDataSource.GetString("DataSource_Summary_Max");
				if (text == null)
				{
					return "Max";
				}
				return text;
			}
		}

		public override SummaryOperand Operand => SummaryOperand.Max;

		public override void BeginCalculation(IDataSource dataSource, string propertyName)
		{
			base.BeginCalculation(dataSource, propertyName);
			_currMax = null;
		}

		public override ISummaryResult EndCalculation()
		{
			return new DefaultSummaryResult(base.PropertyName, SummaryOperand.Max, _currMax);
		}

		public override void Aggregate(object item)
		{
			_currMax = Maximum(item, _currMax);
		}

		public override ISummaryResult ItemAdded(object item, ISummaryResult previousResult, int currentCount)
		{
			if (previousResult == null)
			{
				return new DefaultSummaryResult(base.PropertyName, SummaryOperand.Max, Maximum(item, null));
			}
			object value = Maximum(item, previousResult.Value);
			return new DefaultSummaryResult(base.PropertyName, SummaryOperand.Max, value);
		}

		public override ISummaryResult ItemRemoved(object item, ISummaryResult previousResult, int currentCount)
		{
			if (base.DataSource.GetItemProperty(item, base.PropertyName).Equals(previousResult.Value))
			{
				base.IsSummaryDirty = true;
			}
			return previousResult;
		}

		private object Maximum(object item, object reference)
		{
			object itemProperty = base.DataSource.GetItemProperty(item, base.PropertyName);
			if (reference == null)
			{
				return itemProperty;
			}
			if (itemProperty == null)
			{
				return reference;
			}
			switch (base.PropertyType)
			{
			case DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.StringValue:
				reference = ((string.Compare((string)itemProperty, (string)reference) > 0) ? itemProperty : reference);
				break;
			case DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.DecimalValue:
				reference = (((decimal)itemProperty > (decimal)reference) ? itemProperty : reference);
				break;
			case DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.DoubleValue:
				reference = (((double)itemProperty > (double)reference) ? itemProperty : reference);
				break;
			case DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.IntValue:
				reference = (((int)itemProperty > (int)reference) ? itemProperty : reference);
				break;
			case DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.LongValue:
				reference = (((long)itemProperty > (long)reference) ? itemProperty : reference);
				break;
			case DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.ShortValue:
				reference = (((short)itemProperty > (short)reference) ? itemProperty : reference);
				break;
			case DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.SingleValue:
				reference = (((float)itemProperty > (float)reference) ? itemProperty : reference);
				break;
			case DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.BooleanValue:
				reference = (((bool)itemProperty) ? itemProperty : reference);
				break;
			case DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.ByteValue:
				reference = (((byte)itemProperty > (byte)reference) ? itemProperty : reference);
				break;
			case DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.DateTimeOffsetValue:
				reference = ((DateTimeOffset.Compare((DateTimeOffset)itemProperty, (DateTimeOffset)reference) > 0) ? itemProperty : reference);
				break;
			case DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.DateTimeValue:
				reference = ((DateTime.Compare((DateTime)itemProperty, (DateTime)reference) > 0) ? itemProperty : reference);
				break;
			}
			return reference;
		}
	}

		{
			_currMin = Minimum(item, _currMin);
		}

		public override ISummaryResult ItemAdded(object item, ISummaryResult previousResult, int currentCount)
		{
			if (previousResult == null)
			{
				return new DefaultSummaryResult(base.PropertyName, SummaryOperand.Min, Minimum(item, null));
			}
			object value = Minimum(item, previousResult.Value);
			return new DefaultSummaryResult(base.PropertyName, SummaryOperand.Min, value);
		}

		public override ISummaryResult ItemRemoved(object item, ISummaryResult previousResult, int currentCount)
		{
			if (base.DataSource.GetItemProperty(item, base.PropertyName).Equals(previousResult.Value))
			{
				base.IsSummaryDirty = true;
			}
			return previousResult;
		}

		private object Minimum(object item, object reference)
		{
			object itemProperty = base.DataSource.GetItemProperty(item, base.PropertyName);
			if (reference == null)
			{
				return itemProperty;
			}
			if (itemProperty == null)
			{
				return reference;
			}
			switch (base.PropertyType)
			{
			case DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.StringValue:
				reference = ((string.Compare((string)itemProperty, (string)reference) < 0) ? itemProperty : reference);
				break;
			case DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.DecimalValue:
				reference = (((decimal)itemProperty < (decimal)reference) ? itemProperty : reference);
				break;
			case DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.DoubleValue:
				reference = (((double)itemProperty < (double)reference) ? itemProperty : reference);
				break;
			case DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.IntValue:
				reference = (((int)itemProperty < (int)reference) ? itemProperty : reference);
				break;
			case DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.LongValue:
				reference = (((long)itemProperty < (long)reference) ? itemProperty : reference);
				break;
			case DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.ShortValue:
				reference = (((short)itemProperty < (short)reference) ? itemProperty : reference);
				break;
			case DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.SingleValue:
				reference = (((float)itemProperty < (float)reference) ? itemProperty : reference);
				break;
			case DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.BooleanValue:
				reference = ((!(bool)itemProperty) ? itemProperty : reference);
				break;
			case DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.ByteValue:
				reference = (((byte)itemProperty < (byte)reference) ? itemProperty : reference);
				break;
			case DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.DateTimeOffsetValue:
				reference = ((DateTimeOffset.Compare((DateTimeOffset)itemProperty, (DateTimeOffset)reference) < 0) ? itemProperty : reference);
				break;
			case DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.DateTimeValue:
				reference = ((DateTime.Compare((DateTime)itemProperty, (DateTime)reference) < 0) ? itemProperty : reference);
				break;
			}
			return reference;
		}
	}
	[DontHide]
	[DontObfuscate]
	public abstract class SummaryCalculator
	{
		private SummaryOperand _operand = SummaryOperand.Custom;

		public string PropertyName { get; internal set; }

		public DataSourceSchemaPropertyType PropertyType { get; internal set; }

		public IDataSource DataSource { get; internal set; }

		public abstract string DisplayName { get; }

		public bool IsSummaryDirty { get; protected set; }

		public virtual SummaryOperand Operand => _operand;

		public virtual void BeginCalculation(IDataSource dataSource, string propertyName)
		{
			DataSource = dataSource;
			PropertyName = propertyName;
			if (PropertyName != null)
			{
				PropertyType = dataSource.ResolveSchemaPropertyType(PropertyName);
			}
			IsSummaryDirty = false;
		}

		public virtual ISummaryResult EndCalculation()
		{
			return null;
		}

		public virtual void Aggregate(object item)
		{
		}

		public virtual ISummaryResult ItemAdded(object item, ISummaryResult previousResult, int currentCount)
		{
			return previousResult;
		}

		public virtual ISummaryResult ItemRemoved(object item, ISummaryResult previousResult, int currentCount)
		{
			return previousResult;
		}

		protected double GetItemAsDouble(object item)
		{
			if (DataSource == null)
			{
				return double.NaN;
			}
			object itemProperty = DataSource.GetItemProperty(item, PropertyName);
			if (itemProperty == null)
			{
				return double.NaN;
			}
			return GetValueAsDouble(itemProperty);
		}

		protected double GetValueAsDouble(object value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return double.NaN;
			}
			switch (PropertyType)
			{
			case DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.DecimalValue:
				return (double)(decimal)value;
			case DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.DoubleValue:
				return (double)value;
			case DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.IntValue:
				return (int)value;
			case DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.LongValue:
				return (long)value;
			case DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.ShortValue:
				return (short)value;
			case DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.SingleValue:
				return (float)value;
			case DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.DateTimeValue:
				return ((DateTime)value).ToOADate();
			case DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.ObjectValue:
				try
				{
					return Convert.ToDouble(value);
				}
				catch
				{
					return double.NaN;
				}
			default:
				return 0.0;
			}
		}

		protected object GetExpectedTypeFromDouble(double value)
		{
			return PropertyType switch
			{
				DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.DecimalValue => (decimal)value, 
				DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.DoubleValue => value, 
				DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.IntValue => (int)value, 
				DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.LongValue => (long)value, 
				DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.ShortValue => (short)value, 
				DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.SingleValue => (float)value, 
				DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.DateTimeValue => DateTime.FromOADate(value), 
				_ => value, 
			};
		}
	}
	[DontHide]
	[DontObfuscate]
	[XamWidget]
	[UwpWidget]
	public enum SummaryOperand
	{
		Min,
		Max,
		Sum,
		Average,
		Count,
		Custom
	}
	[DontHide]
	[DontObfuscate]
	public class SummaryDescription
	{
		private bool _sealed;

		private string _propertyName;

		private SummaryOperand _operand;

		private SummaryCalculator _calculator;

		public string PropertyName
		{
			get
			{
				return _propertyName;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_sealed)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(new SRProvider().Object_Sealed);
				}
				_propertyName = value;
			}
		}

		public SummaryOperand Operand
		{
			get
			{
				return _operand;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_sealed)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(new SRProvider().Object_Sealed);
				}
				_operand = value;
				switch (_operand)
				{
				case SummaryOperand.Min:
					Calculator = new MinSummaryCalculator();
					break;
				case SummaryOperand.Max:
					Calculator = new MaxSummaryCalculator();
					break;
				case SummaryOperand.Sum:
					Calculator = new SumSummaryCalculator();
					break;
				case SummaryOperand.Average:
					Calculator = new AverageSummaryCalculator();
					break;
				case SummaryOperand.Count:
					Calculator = new CountSummaryCalculator();
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public SummaryCalculator Calculator
		{
			get
			{
				return _calculator;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_sealed)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(new SRProvider().Object_Sealed);
				}
				_calculator = value;
			}
		}

		public event ProvideCalculatorEventHandler ProvideCalculator;

		public SummaryDescription()
		{
		}

		public SummaryDescription(string propertyName)
		{
			PropertyName = propertyName;
			Operand = SummaryOperand.Count;
		}

		public SummaryDescription(string propertyName, SummaryOperand operand)
		{
			PropertyName = propertyName;
			Operand = operand;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object other)
		{
			SummaryDescription summaryDescription = (SummaryDescription)other;
			if (summaryDescription == null)
			{
				return base.Equals(other);
			}
			if (summaryDescription.PropertyName == PropertyName)
			{
				return summaryDescription.Operand == Operand;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return (int)(PropertyName.GetHashCode() * 17 + Operand);
		}

		internal void Seal()
		{
			_sealed = true;
		}

		private SummaryCalculator NotifyProvideCalculator()
		{
			if (this.ProvideCalculator != null)
			{
				ProvideCalculatorEventArgs e = new ProvideCalculatorEventArgs();
				this.ProvideCalculator(this, e);
				return e.Calculator;
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal SummaryCalculator GetCalculator()
		{
			return _operand switch
			{
				SummaryOperand.Min => new MinSummaryCalculator(), 
				SummaryOperand.Max => new MaxSummaryCalculator(), 
				SummaryOperand.Sum => new SumSummaryCalculator(), 
				SummaryOperand.Average => new AverageSummaryCalculator(), 
				SummaryOperand.Count => new CountSummaryCalculator(), 
				SummaryOperand.Custom => NotifyProvideCalculator() ?? throw new ArgumentNullException("Calculator", "No custom calculator was provided."), 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}
	}
	[DontHide]
	[XamWidget]
	[UwpWidget]
	[TSIgnore]
	[DontObfuscate]
	public class SummaryDescriptionCollection : SyncableObservableCollection<SummaryDescription>
	{
	}

	public delegate void ProvideCalculatorEventHandler(object sender, ProvideCalculatorEventArgs args);
	[Widget]
	public class ProvideCalculatorEventArgs
	{
		[JsonAPISuppressWidgetMember]
		public SummaryCalculator Calculator { get; set; }
	}

namespace Infragistics.Controls.DataSource.Transactions

	public abstract class BaseTransactionService
	{
		private bool _isPending;

		private List<Transaction> _pendingTransactions = new List<Transaction>();

		private Dictionary<object, TransactionState> _pendingStates;

		protected const string IsEnabledPropertyName = "IsEnabled";

		protected bool IsPending
		{
			get
			{
				return _isPending;
			}
			set
			{
				_isPending = value;
			}
		}

		protected List<Transaction> PendingTransactions => _pendingTransactions;

		protected Dictionary<object, TransactionState> PendingStates => _pendingStates;

		public virtual bool IsEnabled
		{
			get
			{
				return _isPending;
			}
			set
			{
			}
		}

		public virtual bool CanUndo => false;

		public virtual bool CanRedo => false;

		public Action<object, object> Merge { get; set; }

		public Func<object, object> Clone { get; set; }

		public event TransactionServiceStateChanged StateChanged;

		protected BaseTransactionService(Action<object, object> merge, Func<object, object> clone, IEqualityComparer<object> equalityComparer)
		{
			if (merge == null || clone == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException();
			}
			Merge = merge;
			Clone = clone;
			if (equalityComparer != null)
			{
				_pendingStates = new Dictionary<object, TransactionState>(equalityComparer);
			}
			else
			{
				_pendingStates = new Dictionary<object, TransactionState>();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateState(Dictionary<object, TransactionState> states, Transaction transaction)
		{
			if (states.ContainsKey(transaction.ID))
			{
				if (Merge != null)
				{
					Merge(states[transaction.ID], transaction.Value);
				}
				else
				{
					states[transaction.ID].Value = transaction.Value;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				states.Add(transaction.ID, new TransactionState(transaction.ID, transaction.Type, Clone(transaction.Value)));
			}
		}

		protected void OnStateChanged(TransactionEvent eventType, object eventData)
		{
			if (this.StateChanged != null)
			{
				this.StateChanged(eventType, eventData);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnPropertyChanged(string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
		}

		public virtual void Add(Transaction transaction, bool isPending = false)
		{
			if (IsPending)
			{
				UpdateState(PendingStates, transaction);
				PendingTransactions.Add(transaction);
			}
		}

		public virtual void Clear(bool clearPendingTransactions, object id = null)
		{
			if (clearPendingTransactions)
			{
				_pendingStates.Clear();
				_pendingTransactions.Clear();
			}
		}

		public virtual TransactionState GetState(object id)
		{
			if (PendingStates.Count > 0 && PendingStates.ContainsKey(id))
			{
				return PendingStates[id];
			}
			return null;
		}

		public void StartPending()
		{
			_isPending = true;
		}

		public virtual void EndPending(bool save)
		{
			_isPending = false;
			ClearPending();
		}

		public virtual void ClearPending(int transactionID = -1)
		{
			if (transactionID > -1)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < PendingTransactions.Count; i++)
				{
					if (PendingTransactions[i].TransactionID == transactionID)
					{
						PendingTransactions.RemoveAt(i);
						PendingStates.Clear();
						for (int j = 0; j < PendingTransactions.Count; j++)
						{
							UpdateState(PendingStates, PendingTransactions[j]);
						}
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				_pendingStates.Clear();
				_pendingTransactions.Clear();
			}
		}

		public virtual Transaction GetPendingTransaction(int transactionID)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < PendingTransactions.Count; i++)
			{
				if (PendingTransactions[i].TransactionID == transactionID)
				{
					return PendingTransactions[i];
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public virtual TransactionCommit GetPendingCommit(int commitID)
		{
			return null;
		}

		public virtual int Commit(bool isPending, bool clearPendingTransactions)
		{
			return -1;
		}

		public virtual void AcceptCommit(int commitID)
		{
		}

		public virtual void RejectCommit(int commitID)
		{
		}

		public virtual void Undo()
		{
		}

		public virtual void Redo()
		{
		}

		public virtual TransactionState[] GetAggregatedChanges(int commitID = -1)
		{
			List<TransactionState> list = new List<TransactionState>();
			foreach (TransactionState value in PendingStates.Values)
			{
				list.Add(value);
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		public virtual Transaction[] GetPendingTransactions(object id = null)
		{
			if (id != null)
			{
				List<Transaction> list = new List<Transaction>();
				for (int i = 0; i < PendingTransactions.Count; i++)
				{
					if (PendingTransactions[i].ID == id)
					{
						list.Add(PendingTransactions[i]);
					}
				}
				return list.ToArray();
			}
			return PendingTransactions.ToArray();
		}

		public virtual Transaction[] GetPendingErrors()
		{
			List<Transaction> list = new List<Transaction>();
			for (int i = 0; i < PendingTransactions.Count; i++)
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(PendingTransactions[i].Error))
				{
					list.Add(PendingTransactions[i]);
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}
	}

	internal class TransactionKeyEqualityComparer : IEqualityComparer<object>
	{
		public new bool Equals(object x, object y)
		{
			object[] array = (object[])x;
			object[] array2 = (object[])y;
			if (array.Length != array2.Length)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				if (array[i] == null && array2[i] != null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (array[i] != null && array2[i] == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (array[i] != array2[i] && !array[i].Equals(array2[i]))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public int GetHashCode(object obj)
		{
			int num = 0;
			object[] array = (object[])obj;
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				if (array[i] != null)
				{
					num += array[i].GetHashCode();
				}
			}
			return num;
		}
	}

	public class TransactionService : BaseTransactionService
	{
		private static int _transactionIDTracker;

		private List<Transaction> _transactions = new List<Transaction>();

		private List<TransactionCommit> _pendingCommits = new List<TransactionCommit>();

		private Dictionary<object, TransactionState> _states;

		private List<TransactionHistory> _undoStack = new List<TransactionHistory>();

		private List<TransactionHistory> _redoStack = new List<TransactionHistory>();

		private IEqualityComparer<object> _equalityComparer;

		public override bool IsEnabled => true;

		public override bool CanUndo => _undoStack.Count > 0;

		public override bool CanRedo => _redoStack.Count > 0;

		public TransactionService(Action<object, object> merge, Func<object, object> clone, IEqualityComparer<object> equalityComparer)
			: base(merge, clone, equalityComparer)
		{
			_equalityComparer = equalityComparer;
			if (_equalityComparer != null)
			{
				_states = new Dictionary<object, TransactionState>(_equalityComparer);
			}
			else
			{
				_states = new Dictionary<object, TransactionState>();
			}
		}

		protected override void UpdateState(Dictionary<object, TransactionState> states, Transaction transaction)
		{
			TransactionState transactionState = null;
			if (states.ContainsKey(transaction.ID))
			{
				transactionState = states[transaction.ID];
			}
			if (transactionState != null)
			{
				switch (transaction.Type)
				{
				case TransactionType.Delete:
					if (transactionState.TransactionType == TransactionType.Add)
					{
						states.Remove(transaction.ID);
					}
					else if (transactionState.TransactionType == TransactionType.Update)
					{
						transactionState.Value = null;
						transactionState.TransactionType = TransactionType.Delete;
					}
					break;
				case TransactionType.Update:
					if (transactionState.TransactionType == TransactionType.Add || transactionState.TransactionType == TransactionType.Update)
					{
						base.Merge(transactionState.Value, transaction.Value);
					}
					break;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				states.Add(transaction.ID, new TransactionState(transaction.ID, transaction.Type, base.Clone(transaction.Value)));
			}
		}

		protected void VerifyAddedTransaction(Dictionary<object, TransactionState> states, Transaction transaction)
		{
			TransactionState transactionState = null;
			if (states.ContainsKey(transaction.ID))
			{
				transactionState = states[transaction.ID];
			}
			switch (transaction.Type)
			{
			case TransactionType.Add:
				if (transactionState != null)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException("Cannot add this transaction. A transaction with this ID already exists.");
				}
				break;
			case TransactionType.Update:
			case TransactionType.Delete:
				if (transactionState != null && transactionState.TransactionType == TransactionType.Delete)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException("Cannot add this transaction. A transaction with this ID has already been deleted.");
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnPropertyChanged(string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			base.OnPropertyChanged(propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
			if (propertyName == "IsEnabled")
			{
				Clear(clearPendingTransactions: true);
			}
		}

		public override void Add(Transaction transaction, bool isPending = false)
		{
			Dictionary<object, TransactionState> states = ((base.IsPending || isPending) ? base.PendingStates : _states);
			List<Transaction> obj = ((base.IsPending || isPending) ? base.PendingTransactions : _transactions);
			VerifyAddedTransaction(states, transaction);
			UpdateState(states, transaction);
			obj.Add(transaction);
			transaction.TransactionID = _transactionIDTracker++;
			if (!base.IsPending && !isPending)
			{
				TransactionHistory transactionHistory = new TransactionHistory();
				transactionHistory.Transactions.Add(transaction);
				_undoStack.Insert(0, transactionHistory);
				_redoStack.Clear();
				OnStateChanged(TransactionEvent.Add, transactionHistory);
			}
		}

		public override void Clear(bool clearPendingTransactions, object id = null)
		{
			if (id != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < _transactions.Count; i++)
				{
					if (_transactions[i].ID == id)
					{
						_transactions.RemoveAt(i);
						i--;
					}
				}
				_states.Remove(id);
				for (int j = 0; j < _undoStack.Count; j++)
				{
					for (int k = 0; k < _undoStack[j].Transactions.Count; k++)
					{
						if (_undoStack[j].Transactions[k].ID == id)
						{
							_undoStack[j].Transactions.RemoveAt(k);
							k--;
						}
					}
					if (_undoStack[j].Transactions.Count == 0)
					{
						_undoStack.RemoveAt(j);
						j--;
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (_equalityComparer != null)
				{
					_states = new Dictionary<object, TransactionState>(_equalityComparer);
				}
				else
				{
					_states = new Dictionary<object, TransactionState>();
				}
				_transactions.Clear();
				_undoStack.Clear();
			}
			_redoStack.Clear();
			base.Clear(clearPendingTransactions, id);
		}

		public override TransactionState GetState(object id)
		{
			Dictionary<object, TransactionState> dictionary = (base.IsPending ? base.PendingStates : _states);
			if (dictionary.Count > 0 && dictionary.ContainsKey(id))
			{
				return dictionary[id];
			}
			return null;
		}

		public TransactionState GetPendingState(object id)
		{
			return base.GetState(id);
		}

		public TransactionState GetLatestStateFromPendingCommits(object id)
		{
			for (int num = _pendingCommits.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				if (_pendingCommits[num].States.ContainsKey(id))
				{
					return _pendingCommits[num].States[id];
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override void EndPending(bool save)
		{
			base.IsPending = false;
			if (save)
			{
				TransactionHistory transactionHistory = new TransactionHistory();
				for (int i = 0; i < base.PendingTransactions.Count; i++)
				{
					Transaction transaction = base.PendingTransactions[i];
					_ = base.PendingStates[transaction.ID];
					_transactions.Add(transaction);
					UpdateState(_states, transaction);
					transactionHistory.Transactions.Add(transaction);
				}
				_undoStack.Insert(0, transactionHistory);
				_redoStack.Clear();
			}
			base.EndPending(save);
		}

		public void SavePendingTransaction(int transactionID)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < base.PendingTransactions.Count; i++)
			{
				Transaction transaction = base.PendingTransactions[i];
				if (transaction.TransactionID == transactionID)
				{
					_transactions.Add(transaction);
					UpdateState(_states, transaction);
					base.PendingTransactions.RemoveAt(i);
					base.PendingStates.Clear();
					for (int j = 0; j < base.PendingTransactions.Count; j++)
					{
						UpdateState(base.PendingStates, base.PendingTransactions[j]);
					}
					TransactionHistory transactionHistory = new TransactionHistory();
					transactionHistory.Transactions.Add(transaction);
					_undoStack.Insert(0, transactionHistory);
					_redoStack.Clear();
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public override int Commit(bool isPending, bool clearPendingTransactions)
		{
			int result = -1;
			if (_states.Count > 0)
			{
				TransactionCommit transactionCommit = new TransactionCommit();
				transactionCommit.ID = _transactionIDTracker++;
				transactionCommit.Changes = GetAggregatedChanges();
				transactionCommit.States = _states;
				transactionCommit.Index = -1;
				if (isPending)
				{
					transactionCommit.Index = _pendingCommits.Count;
					_pendingCommits.Add(transactionCommit);
				}
				else
				{
					OnStateChanged(TransactionEvent.Commit, transactionCommit);
				}
				result = transactionCommit.ID;
			}
			Clear(clearPendingTransactions);
			return result;
		}

		public override void AcceptCommit(int commitID)
		{
			TransactionCommit pendingCommit = GetPendingCommit(commitID);
			if (pendingCommit != null)
			{
				OnStateChanged(TransactionEvent.Commit, pendingCommit);
				_pendingCommits.RemoveAt(pendingCommit.Index);
			}
		}

		public override void RejectCommit(int commitID)
		{
			TransactionCommit pendingCommit = GetPendingCommit(commitID);
			if (pendingCommit != null)
			{
				_pendingCommits.RemoveAt(pendingCommit.Index);
			}
		}

		public override void Undo()
		{
			if (!CanUndo)
			{
				return;
			}
			TransactionHistory transactionHistory = _undoStack[0];
			_undoStack.RemoveAt(0);
			int index = _transactions.Count - transactionHistory.Transactions.Count;
			_transactions.RemoveRange(index, transactionHistory.Transactions.Count);
			_redoStack.Insert(0, transactionHistory);
			_states.Clear();
			for (int i = 0; i < _undoStack.Count; i++)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < _undoStack[i].Transactions.Count; j++)
				{
					UpdateState(_states, _undoStack[i].Transactions[j]);
				}
			}
			OnStateChanged(TransactionEvent.Undo, transactionHistory);
		}

		public override void Redo()
		{
			if (CanRedo)
			{
				TransactionHistory transactionHistory = _redoStack[0];
				_redoStack.RemoveAt(0);
				for (int i = 0; i < transactionHistory.Transactions.Count; i++)
				{
					UpdateState(_states, transactionHistory.Transactions[i]);
					_transactions.Add(transactionHistory.Transactions[i]);
				}
				_undoStack.Insert(0, transactionHistory);
				OnStateChanged(TransactionEvent.Redo, transactionHistory);
			}
		}

		public override TransactionState[] GetAggregatedChanges(int commitID = -1)
		{
			List<TransactionState> list = new List<TransactionState>();
			if (commitID > -1)
			{
				TransactionCommit pendingCommit = GetPendingCommit(commitID);
				if (pendingCommit != null)
				{
					foreach (TransactionState value in pendingCommit.States.Values)
					{
						list.Add(value);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				foreach (TransactionState value2 in _states.Values)
				{
					list.Add(value2);
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		public override TransactionCommit GetPendingCommit(int commitID)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < _pendingCommits.Count; i++)
			{
				if (_pendingCommits[i].ID == commitID)
				{
					return _pendingCommits[i];
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override Transaction[] GetPendingTransactions(object id = null)
		{
			if (id != null)
			{
				List<Transaction> list = new List<Transaction>();
				for (int i = 0; i < base.PendingTransactions.Count; i++)
				{
					if (base.PendingTransactions[i].ID == id || _equalityComparer.Equals(base.PendingTransactions[i].ID, id))
					{
						list.Add(base.PendingTransactions[i]);
					}
				}
				return list.ToArray();
			}
			return base.PendingTransactions.ToArray();
		}
	}
}

		public BaseDataSource()
		{
			_dataProviderUpdateNotifier = new DefaultDataSourceDataProviderUpdateNotifier(this);
			_sortDescriptions = new SortDescriptionCollection();
			_groupDescriptions = new SortDescriptionCollection();
			_summaryDescriptions = new SummaryDescriptionCollection();
			_sortDescriptions.AddListener(SortDescriptions_CollectionChanged);
			_groupDescriptions.AddListener(GroupDescriptions_CollectionChanged);
			_summaryDescriptions.AddListener(SummaryDescriptions_CollectionChanged);
			_filterExpressions = new FilterExpressionCollection();
			_filterExpressions.AddListener(FilterExpressions_CollectionChanged);
			TransactionService = new TransactionService(Merge, Clone, new TransactionKeyEqualityComparer());
			TransactionService.StateChanged += OnTransactionServiceStateChanged;
		}

		private void OnTransactionServiceStateChanged(TransactionEvent eventType, object eventData)
		{
			if ((eventType == TransactionEvent.Undo || eventType == TransactionEvent.Redo) && UpdateNotifier != null)
			{
				Transaction transaction = ((TransactionHistory)eventData).Transactions[0];
				if (transaction.Type == TransactionType.Update || transaction.Type == TransactionType.Delete)
				{
					object[] key = (object[])transaction.ID;
					int num = IndexOfKey(key);
					if (num > -1)
					{
						object itemAtIndex = GetItemAtIndex(num);
						UpdateNotifier.NotifySetItem(num, itemAtIndex, itemAtIndex);
						int[] stickyRows = GetStickyRows();
						if (stickyRows != null)
						{
							foreach (int index in stickyRows)
							{
								if (GetItemAtIndex(index) is DataSourceSpecialRow { RowType: DataSourceRowType.ShiftedRow } dataSourceSpecialRow && dataSourceSpecialRow.TargetRow == itemAtIndex)
								{
									UpdateNotifier.NotifySetItem(index, dataSourceSpecialRow, dataSourceSpecialRow);
									break;
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					_ = transaction.Type;
				}
			}
			OnTransactionEvent(eventType, eventData);
		}

		protected virtual void OnTransactionEvent(TransactionEvent eventType, object eventData)
		{
		}

		protected virtual bool IsCRUDSupported()
		{
			if (!IsReadOnly && ActualPrimaryKey != null && ActualBaseDataProvider != null)
			{
				return TransactionService != null;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void Merge(object left, object right)
		{
			if (left == null || right == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Dictionary<string, object> dictionary = (Dictionary<string, object>)left;
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, object> item in (Dictionary<string, object>)right)
			{
				if (dictionary.ContainsKey(item.Key))
				{
					dictionary[item.Key] = item.Value;
				}
				else
				{
					dictionary.Add(item.Key, item.Value);
				}
			}
		}

		private object Clone(object source)
		{
			if (source != null)
			{
				Dictionary<string, object> obj = (Dictionary<string, object>)source;
				Dictionary<string, object> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, object>();
				{
					foreach (KeyValuePair<string, object> item in obj)
					{
						dictionary.Add(item.Key, item.Value);
					}
					return dictionary;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public virtual int UpdatePropertyAtKey(object[] key, string propertyPath, object value, bool isPending = false)
		{
			if (IsCRUDSupported())
			{
				DataSourceSpecialRow dataSourceSpecialRow = null;
				if (key.Length == 1 && key[0] is DataSourceSpecialRow)
				{
					DataSourceSpecialRow dataSourceSpecialRow2 = key[0] as DataSourceSpecialRow;
					if (dataSourceSpecialRow2.RowType == DataSourceRowType.ShiftedRow)
					{
						dataSourceSpecialRow = dataSourceSpecialRow2;
						if (ActualPrimaryKey != null)
						{
							key = new object[ActualPrimaryKey.Length];
							GetPrimaryKeyValue(dataSourceSpecialRow.TargetRow, key);
						}
						else
						{
							key = new object[1] { dataSourceSpecialRow.TargetRow };
						}
					}
				}
				Dictionary<string, object> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, object>();
				dictionary.Add(propertyPath, value);
				Transaction transaction = new Transaction();
				transaction.ID = key;
				transaction.Value = dictionary;
				transaction.Type = TransactionType.Update;
				TransactionService.Add(transaction, isPending);
				if ((IsBatchingEnabled || isPending) && UpdateNotifier != null)
				{
					int num = IndexOfKey(key);
					if (num > -1)
					{
						object itemAtIndex = GetItemAtIndex(num);
						UpdateNotifier.NotifySetItem(num, itemAtIndex, itemAtIndex);
					}
					if (IsRowPinned(num))
					{
						int num2 = -1;
						if (dataSourceSpecialRow != null)
						{
							num2 = IndexOfItem(dataSourceSpecialRow);
						}
						else
						{
							int[] stickyRows = GetStickyRows();
							if (stickyRows != null)
							{
								for (int i = 0; i < stickyRows.Length; i++)
								{
									if (GetItemAtIndex(stickyRows[i]) is DataSourceSpecialRow { RowType: DataSourceRowType.ShiftedRow } dataSourceSpecialRow3)
									{
										dataSourceSpecialRow = dataSourceSpecialRow3;
										num2 = stickyRows[i];
										break;
									}
								}
							}
						}
						if (num2 > -1)
						{
							UpdateNotifier.NotifySetItem(num2, dataSourceSpecialRow, dataSourceSpecialRow);
						}
					}
				}
				return transaction.TransactionID;
			}
			return -1;
		}

		public virtual void RemoveItemByKey(object[] key)
		{
			if (!IsCRUDSupported())
			{
				return;
			}
			DataSourceSpecialRow dataSourceSpecialRow = null;
			if (key.Length == 1 && key[0] is DataSourceSpecialRow)
			{
				DataSourceSpecialRow dataSourceSpecialRow2 = key[0] as DataSourceSpecialRow;
				if (dataSourceSpecialRow2.RowType == DataSourceRowType.ShiftedRow)
				{
					dataSourceSpecialRow = dataSourceSpecialRow2;
					if (ActualPrimaryKey != null)
					{
						key = new object[ActualPrimaryKey.Length];
						GetPrimaryKeyValue(dataSourceSpecialRow.TargetRow, key);
					}
					else
					{
						key = new object[1] { dataSourceSpecialRow.TargetRow };
					}
				}
			}
			Transaction transaction = new Transaction();
			transaction.ID = key;
			transaction.Type = TransactionType.Delete;
			TransactionService.Add(transaction);
			if (!IsBatchingEnabled || UpdateNotifier == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = IndexOfKey(key);
			if (num > -1)
			{
				object itemAtIndex = GetItemAtIndex(num);
				UpdateNotifier.NotifySetItem(num, itemAtIndex, itemAtIndex);
			}
			if (!IsRowPinned(num))
			{
				return;
			}
			int num2 = -1;
			if (dataSourceSpecialRow != null)
			{
				num2 = IndexOfItem(dataSourceSpecialRow);
			}
			else
			{
				int[] stickyRows = GetStickyRows();
				if (stickyRows != null)
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < stickyRows.Length; i++)
					{
						if (GetItemAtIndex(stickyRows[i]) is DataSourceSpecialRow { RowType: DataSourceRowType.ShiftedRow } dataSourceSpecialRow3)
						{
							dataSourceSpecialRow = dataSourceSpecialRow3;
							num2 = stickyRows[i];
							break;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (num2 > -1)
			{
				UpdateNotifier.NotifySetItem(num2, dataSourceSpecialRow, dataSourceSpecialRow);
			}
		}

		public void RemoveItem(object item)
		{
			if (IsCRUDSupported())
			{
				object[] key;
				if (item is DataSourceSpecialRow)
				{
					key = new object[1] { item };
				}
				else if (ActualPrimaryKey == null || ActualPrimaryKey.Length < 1)
				{
					key = new object[1] { item };
				}
				else
				{
					key = new object[ActualPrimaryKey.Length];
					GetPrimaryKeyValue(item, key);
				}
				RemoveItemByKey(key);
			}
		}

		[BlazorSuppressWidgetMember]
		public void AddItem(object item)
		{
			if (IsCRUDSupported() && !(item is DataSourceSpecialRow))

				Transaction transaction = new Transaction();
				transaction.ID = new object[1] { item };
				transaction.Type = TransactionType.Add;
				TransactionService.Add(transaction);
			}
		}

				TransactionService.SavePendingTransaction(transactionID);
			}

		public void RejectPendingTransaction(int transactionID)
		{
			if (!IsCRUDSupported())
			{
				return;
			}
			Transaction pendingTransaction = TransactionService.GetPendingTransaction(transactionID);
			if (pendingTransaction == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			TransactionService.ClearPending(transactionID);
			if (UpdateNotifier == null || pendingTransaction.Type == TransactionType.Add)
			{
				return;
			}
			object[] key = (object[])pendingTransaction.ID;
			int num = IndexOfKey(key);
			if (num <= -1)
			{
				return;
			}
			object itemAtIndex = GetItemAtIndex(num);
			UpdateNotifier.NotifySetItem(num, itemAtIndex, itemAtIndex);
			int[] stickyRows = GetStickyRows();
			if (stickyRows == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < stickyRows.Length; i++)
			{
				if (GetItemAtIndex(stickyRows[i]) is DataSourceSpecialRow { RowType: DataSourceRowType.ShiftedRow } dataSourceSpecialRow && dataSourceSpecialRow.TargetRow == itemAtIndex)
				{
					UpdateNotifier.NotifySetItem(stickyRows[i], dataSourceSpecialRow, dataSourceSpecialRow);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public int CommitEdits(bool isPending)
		{
			if (IsCRUDSupported())
			{
				bool flag = TransactionService.GetPendingTransactions().Length != 0;
				int num = TransactionService.Commit(isPending, IsBatchingEnabled);
				if (num == -1 && flag && UpdateNotifier != null)
				{
					UpdateNotifier.NotifyClearItems();
				}
				return num;
			}
			return -1;
		}

		public void AcceptPendingCommit(int commitID)
		{
			if (!IsCRUDSupported())
			{
				return;
			}
			TransactionCommit pendingCommit = TransactionService.GetPendingCommit(commitID);
			if (pendingCommit == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			TransactionService.AcceptCommit(commitID);
			if (UpdateNotifier == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < pendingCommit.Changes.Length; i++)
			{
				if (pendingCommit.Changes[i].TransactionType != TransactionType.Add)
				{
					object[] key = (object[])pendingCommit.Changes[i].ID;
					int num = IndexOfKey(key);
					if (num > -1)
					{
						object itemAtIndex = GetItemAtIndex(num);
						UpdateNotifier.NotifySetItem(num, itemAtIndex, itemAtIndex);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public void RejectPendingCommit(int commitID)

		public bool HasEdit(object[] key, string propertyPath)
		{
			if (IsCRUDSupported())
			{
				key = ResolveKey(key);
				TransactionState state = TransactionService.GetState(key);
				if (state != null && state.Value is Dictionary<string, object> dictionary && dictionary.ContainsKey(propertyPath))
				{
					return true;
				}
				state = TransactionService.GetPendingState(key);
				if (state != null && state.Value is Dictionary<string, object> dictionary2 && dictionary2.ContainsKey(propertyPath))
				{
					return true;
				}
				state = TransactionService.GetLatestStateFromPendingCommits(key);
				if (state != null && state.Value is Dictionary<string, object> dictionary3 && dictionary3.ContainsKey(propertyPath))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool HasDelete(object[] key)
		{
			if (IsCRUDSupported())
			{
				key = ResolveKey(key);
				TransactionState state = TransactionService.GetState(key);
				if (state != null && state.TransactionType == TransactionType.Delete)
				{
					return true;
				}
				state = TransactionService.GetPendingState(key);
				if (state != null && state.TransactionType == TransactionType.Delete)
				{
					return true;
				}
				state = TransactionService.GetLatestStateFromPendingCommits(key);
				if (state != null && state.TransactionType == TransactionType.Delete)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public DataSourceAggregatedResult[] GetAggregatedChanges(int commitID)
		{
			if (IsCRUDSupported())
			{
				TransactionState[] aggregatedChanges = TransactionService.GetAggregatedChanges(commitID);
				List<DataSourceAggregatedResult> list = new List<DataSourceAggregatedResult>();
				for (int i = 0; i < aggregatedChanges.Length; i++)
				{
					object[] array = (object[])aggregatedChanges[i].ID;
					DataSourceAggregatedResult dataSourceAggregatedResult = new DataSourceAggregatedResult();
					if (aggregatedChanges[i].TransactionType == TransactionType.Add)
					{
						dataSourceAggregatedResult.TransactionType = TransactionType.Add;
						dataSourceAggregatedResult.Item = array[0];
					}
					else if (aggregatedChanges[i].TransactionType == TransactionType.Delete)
					{
						dataSourceAggregatedResult.TransactionType = TransactionType.Delete;
						int num = IndexOfKey(array);
						if (num > -1)
						{
							dataSourceAggregatedResult.Item = GetItemAtIndex(num);
						}
						else
						{
							dataSourceAggregatedResult.Item = array;
						}
					}
					else if (aggregatedChanges[i].TransactionType == TransactionType.Update)
					{
						dataSourceAggregatedResult.TransactionType = TransactionType.Update;
						Dictionary<string, object> dictionary = (Dictionary<string, object>)aggregatedChanges[i].Value;
						dataSourceAggregatedResult.Keys = new string[dictionary.Count];
						dataSourceAggregatedResult.Values = new object[dictionary.Count];
						int num2 = 0;
						foreach (KeyValuePair<string, object> item in dictionary)
						{
							dataSourceAggregatedResult.Keys[num2] = item.Key;
							dataSourceAggregatedResult.Values[num2] = item.Value;
							num2++;
						}
						object itemFromKey = GetItemFromKey(array);
						if (itemFromKey != null)
						{
							dataSourceAggregatedResult.Item = itemFromKey;
						}
						else
						{
							dataSourceAggregatedResult.Item = array;
						}
					}
					list.Add(dataSourceAggregatedResult);
				}
				return list.ToArray();
			}
			return new DataSourceAggregatedResult[0];
		}

		public void SetTransactionError(int transactionID, string message)
		{
			Transaction pendingTransaction = TransactionService.GetPendingTransaction(transactionID);
			if (pendingTransaction == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			pendingTransaction.Error = message;
			if (UpdateNotifier != null)
			{
				object[] key = (object[])pendingTransaction.ID;
				int num = IndexOfKey(key);
				if (num > -1)
				{
					object itemAtIndex = GetItemAtIndex(num);
					UpdateNotifier.NotifySetItem(num, itemAtIndex, itemAtIndex);
				}
			}
		}

		public string GetTransactionErrorByKey(object[] key, string propertyPath)
		{
			key = ResolveKey(key);
			Transaction[] pendingTransactions = TransactionService.GetPendingTransactions(key);
			for (int i = 0; i < pendingTransactions.Length; i++)
			{
				if (pendingTransactions[i].Error != null && pendingTransactions[i].Type == TransactionType.Update && ((Dictionary<string, object>)pendingTransactions[i].Value).ContainsKey(propertyPath))
				{
					return pendingTransactions[i].Error;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public string GetTransactionErrorByID(int transactionID)
		{
			return TransactionService.GetPendingTransaction(transactionID)?.Error;
		}

		public int GetTransactionID(object[] key, string propertyPath)
		{
			key = ResolveKey(key);
			Transaction[] pendingTransactions = TransactionService.GetPendingTransactions(key);
			for (int i = 0; i < pendingTransactions.Length; i++)
			{
				if (pendingTransactions[i].Type == TransactionType.Update && ((Dictionary<string, object>)pendingTransactions[i].Value).ContainsKey(propertyPath))
				{
					return pendingTransactions[i].TransactionID;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		private object[] ResolveKey(object[] key)
		{
			if (key.Length == 1 && key[0] is DataSourceSpecialRow)
			{
				DataSourceSpecialRow dataSourceSpecialRow = key[0] as DataSourceSpecialRow;
				if (dataSourceSpecialRow.RowType == DataSourceRowType.ShiftedRow)
				{
					if (ActualPrimaryKey != null)
					{
						key = new object[ActualPrimaryKey.Length];
						GetPrimaryKeyValue(dataSourceSpecialRow.TargetRow, key);
					}
					else
					{
						key = new object[1] { dataSourceSpecialRow.TargetRow };
					}
				}
			}
			return key;
		}

		public virtual object GetItemProperty(object item, string propertyName)
		{
			if (ActualBaseDataProvider != null)
			{
				if (item is DataSourceSpecialRow)
				{
					return GetSpecialRowItemValue((DataSourceSpecialRow)item, propertyName);
				}
				return ActualBaseDataProvider.GetItemValue(item, propertyName);

		[DontObfuscate]
		protected internal object GetSpecialRowItemValue(DataSourceSpecialRow item, string valueName)
		{
			if (item.RowType == DataSourceRowType.ShiftedRow)
			{
				if (IsCRUDSupported())
				{
					object itemPropertyFromTransactions = GetItemPropertyFromTransactions(item.TargetRow, valueName);
					if (itemPropertyFromTransactions != null)
					{
						return itemPropertyFromTransactions;
					}
				}
				return GetItemProperty(item.TargetRow, valueName);
			}
			return item.GetSectionValue(valueName);
		}

		protected object GetItemPropertyFromTransactions(object item, string valueName)
		{
			object[] array;
			if (ActualPrimaryKey == null || ActualPrimaryKey.Length < 1)
			{
				array = new object[1] { item };
			}
			else
			{
				array = new object[ActualPrimaryKey.Length];
				GetPrimaryKeyValue(item, array);
			}
			TransactionState state = TransactionService.GetState(array);
			if (state != null && state.TransactionType == TransactionType.Update)
			{
				Dictionary<string, object> dictionary = (Dictionary<string, object>)state.Value;
				if (dictionary.ContainsKey(valueName))
				{
					return dictionary[valueName];
				}
			}
			state = TransactionService.GetPendingState(array);
			if (state != null && state.TransactionType == TransactionType.Update)
			{
				Dictionary<string, object> dictionary2 = (Dictionary<string, object>)state.Value;
				if (dictionary2.ContainsKey(valueName))
				{
					return dictionary2[valueName];
				}
			}
			state = TransactionService.GetLatestStateFromPendingCommits(array);
			if (state != null && state.TransactionType == TransactionType.Update)
			{
				Dictionary<string, object> dictionary3 = (Dictionary<string, object>)state.Value;
				if (dictionary3.ContainsKey(valueName))
				{
					return dictionary3[valueName];
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected bool DoesItemPropertyHaveTransaction(object item, string valueName)
		{
			object[] array;
