		[DontObfuscate]
		protected void OnPropertyUpdated(string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
			}
			PropertyUpdatedOverride(propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
		}

		[DontObfuscate]
		protected virtual void PropertyUpdatedOverride(string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "PrimaryKey":
				ActualPrimaryKey = PrimaryKey;
				break;
			case "ActualPrimaryKey":
				OnActualPrimaryKeyChanged((string[])oldValue, (string[])newValue);
				break;
			case "ExecutionContext":
				if (ActualBaseDataProvider != null)
				{
					ActualBaseDataProvider.ExecutionContext = ExecutionContext;
				}
				QueueAutoRefresh();
				break;
			case "LastVisibleIndexRequested":
			case "FirstVisibleIndexRequested":
				OnRequestedVisibleRangeChanged();
				break;
			case "ActualDataProvider":
				OnActualDataProviderChanged(oldValue, newValue);
				break;
			case "DeferAutoRefresh":
				if (ActualBaseDataProvider != null)
				{
					ActualBaseDataProvider.DeferAutoRefresh = DeferAutoRefresh;
				}
				if (!(bool)newValue)
				{
					QueueAutoRefresh();
				}
				break;
			case "PropertiesRequested":
				if (ActualBaseDataProvider != null)
				{
					ActualBaseDataProvider.PropertiesRequested = PropertiesRequested;
				}
				break;
			case "ShouldEmitSectionFooters":
			case "ShouldEmitSectionHeaders":
			case "ShouldEmitShiftedRows":
			case "SectionHeaderDisplayMode":
			case "IsSectionCollapsable":
			case "IncludeSummaryRowsInSection":
			case "IsSectionSummaryRowsAtBottom":
			case "IsSectionContentVisible":
				QueueAutoRefresh();
				break;
			case "SummaryScope":
				if (ActualBaseDataProvider != null)
				{
					ActualBaseDataProvider.SummaryScope = SummaryScope;
				}
				QueueAutoRefresh();
				break;
			}
		}

		[DontObfuscate]
		protected void OnActualPrimaryKeyChanged(string[] oldValue, string[] newValue)
		{
			OnActualPrimaryKeyChangedOverrride(oldValue, newValue);
		}

		[DontObfuscate]
		protected virtual void OnActualPrimaryKeyChangedOverrride(string[] oldValue, string[] newValue)
		{
		}

		[DontObfuscate]
		protected void OnActualDataProviderChanged(object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			IDataSourceDataProvider dataSourceDataProvider = (IDataSourceDataProvider)oldValue;
			IDataSourceDataProvider dataSourceDataProvider2 = (IDataSourceDataProvider)newValue;
			if (dataSourceDataProvider != null)
			{
				dataSourceDataProvider.UpdateNotifier = null;
			}
			if (dataSourceDataProvider2 != null)
			{
				dataSourceDataProvider2.UpdateNotifier = _dataProviderUpdateNotifier;
			}
			if (dataSourceDataProvider != null)
			{
				dataSourceDataProvider.SchemaChanged -= BaseDataProvider_SchemaChanged;
			}
			if (dataSourceDataProvider2 != null)
			{
				dataSourceDataProvider2.SchemaChanged += BaseDataProvider_SchemaChanged;
				dataSourceDataProvider2.ExecutionContext = ExecutionContext;
				NotifyUsingSourceIndexes = ActualBaseDataProvider.NotifyUsingSourceIndexes;
			}
			else
			{
				NotifyUsingSourceIndexes = false;
			}
			if (dataSourceDataProvider != null)
			{
				SortDescriptions.SyncTarget = null;
				GroupDescriptions.SyncTarget = null;
				FilterExpressions.SyncTarget = null;
				SummaryDescriptions.SyncTarget = null;
			}
			if (dataSourceDataProvider2 != null)
			{
				SortDescriptions.SyncTarget = dataSourceDataProvider2.SortDescriptions;
				GroupDescriptions.SyncTarget = dataSourceDataProvider2.GroupDescriptions;
				FilterExpressions.SyncTarget = dataSourceDataProvider2.FilterExpressions;
				SummaryDescriptions.SyncTarget = dataSourceDataProvider2.SummaryDescriptions;
				if (PropertiesRequested != null)
				{
					dataSourceDataProvider2.PropertiesRequested = PropertiesRequested;
				}
				dataSourceDataProvider2.SummaryScope = SummaryScope;
			}
			QueueAutoRefresh();
		}

		[DontObfuscate]
		protected virtual void OnRequestedVisibleRangeChanged()
		{
		}

		[DontObfuscate]
		protected virtual bool CanInitialize()
		{
			if (_executionContext != null && ActualBaseDataProvider != null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		}

		protected virtual int ResolveFullCount(int count)
		{
			return count;
		}

		private void BaseDataProvider_SchemaChanged(object sender, DataSourceDataProviderSchemaChangedEventArgs args)
		{
			ExecutionContext.Execute(delegate
			{
				_schemaDirty = true;
				_comparablesDirty = true;
				QueueAutoRefresh();
				if (DeferAutoRefresh)
				{
					ActualSchema = args.Schema;
					ActualCount = ResolveFullCount(args.Count);
					NotifySchemaChanged();
				}
			});
		}

		private void NotifySchemaChanged()
		{
			if (this.SchemaChanged != null)
			{
				this.SchemaChanged(this, new DataSourceSchemaChangedEventArgs(ActualSchema, ActualCount));
			}
		}

		public void QueueAutoRefresh()
		{
			if (!DeferAutoRefresh)
			{
				if (ActualBaseDataProvider != null)
				{
					ActualBaseDataProvider.QueueAutoRefresh();
				}
				if (!_autoRefreshQueued && ExecutionContext != null)
				{
					_autoRefreshQueued = true;
					ExecutionContext.EnqueueAction(DoRefreshInternal);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void DoRefreshInternal()
		{
			if (DeferAutoRefresh)
			{
				_autoRefreshQueued = false;
				return;
			}
			if (ActualBaseDataProvider != null)
			{
				ActualBaseDataProvider.FlushAutoRefresh();
			}
			if (_autoRefreshQueued)
			{
				_autoRefreshQueued = false;
				RefreshInternal();
			}
		}

		internal void RefreshInternal()
		{
			if (ActualBaseDataProvider != null)
			{
				ActualSchema = ActualBaseDataProvider.ActualSchema;
				ActualCount = ResolveFullCount(ActualBaseDataProvider.ActualCount);
			}
			if (ActualSchema != null && PrimaryKey == null)
			{
				ActualPrimaryKey = ActualSchema.PrimaryKey;
			}
			RefreshInternalOverride();
			if (_schemaDirty)
			{
				_schemaDirty = false;
				NotifySchemaChanged();
			}
		}

		[DontObfuscate]
		protected virtual void RefreshInternalOverride()
		{
		}

		public void FlushAutoRefresh()
		{
			DoRefreshInternal();
		}

		public void Refresh()
		{
			if (ActualBaseDataProvider != null)
			{
				ActualBaseDataProvider.Refresh();
			}
			RefreshInternal();
		}

		}

		[DontObfuscate]
		protected virtual void EnsureComparables(IDataSourceSchema schema)
		{
			if (_comparablesDirty && ActualCount > 0 && ActualBaseDataProvider != null)
			{
				object obj = null;
				int num = FirstVisibleIndexRequested;
				obj = GetItemAtIndex(num);
				while (obj is DataSourceSpecialRow && num < LastVisibleIndexRequested)
				{
					num++;
					obj = GetItemAtIndex(num);
				}
				if (obj != null && !(obj is DataSourceSpecialRow))
				{
					_schemaComparables = GetComparables(schema, obj);
					_comparablesDirty = false;
				}
			}
		}

		protected bool[] GetComparables(IDataSourceSchema schema, object item)
		{
			bool[] array = new bool[schema.PropertyNames.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < schema.PropertyNames.Length; i++)
			{
				object itemValue = ActualBaseDataProvider.GetItemValue(item, schema.PropertyNames[i]);
				if (itemValue != null)
				{
					Type typeFromHandle = typeof(IComparable);
					array[i] = typeFromHandle.IsAssignableFrom(itemValue.GetType());
					if (!array[i])
					{
						array[i] = typeFromHandle.IsAssignableFrom(Nullable.GetUnderlyingType(itemValue.GetType()));
					}
				}
			}
			return array;
		}

		public virtual DataSourceSchemaPropertyType ResolveSchemaPropertyType(string propertyPath)
		{
			return ActualBaseDataProvider.ResolveSchemaPropertyType(propertyPath);
		}

		public virtual void CloneProperties(IDataSource dataSource)
		{
			if (dataSource is BaseDataSource baseDataSource)
			{
				baseDataSource.ExecutionContext = ExecutionContext;
				baseDataSource.IncludeSummaryRowsInSection = IncludeSummaryRowsInSection;
				baseDataSource.IsSectionCollapsable = IsSectionCollapsable;
				baseDataSource.IsSectionExpandedDefault = IsSectionExpandedDefault;
				baseDataSource.IsSectionHeaderNormalRow = IsSectionHeaderNormalRow;
				baseDataSource.IsSectionSummaryRowsAtBottom = IsSectionSummaryRowsAtBottom;
				baseDataSource.IsSectionContentVisible = IsSectionContentVisible;
				baseDataSource.PrimaryKey = PrimaryKey;
				baseDataSource.PropertiesRequested = PropertiesRequested;
				baseDataSource.SectionHeaderDisplayMode = SectionHeaderDisplayMode;
				baseDataSource.ShouldEmitSectionFooters = ShouldEmitSectionFooters;
				baseDataSource.ShouldEmitSectionHeaders = ShouldEmitSectionHeaders;
				baseDataSource.ShouldEmitShiftedRows = ShouldEmitShiftedRows;
				baseDataSource.SummaryScope = SummaryScope;
				for (int i = 0; i < GroupDescriptions.All.Count; i++)
				{
					baseDataSource.GroupDescriptions.Add(GroupDescriptions.All[i]);
				}
				for (int j = 0; j < SortDescriptions.All.Count; j++)
				{
					baseDataSource.SortDescriptions.Add(SortDescriptions.All[j]);
				}
				for (int k = 0; k < FilterExpressions.All.Count; k++)
				{
					baseDataSource.FilterExpressions.Add(FilterExpressions.All[k]);
				}
				for (int l = 0; l < SummaryDescriptions.All.Count; l++)
				{
					baseDataSource.SummaryDescriptions.Add(SummaryDescriptions.All[l]);
				}
			}
		}

		public virtual int GetRowCount()
		{
			return ActualCount;
		}
	}
	internal class SectionData
	{
		private int _parentSection = -1;

		private bool _isSectionVisible = true;

		public bool IsRemoved { get; set; }

		public int SectionIndex { get; set; }

		public int SectionStartIndex { get; set; }

		public int SectionEndIndex { get; set; }

		public string[] SectionKeyNames { get; set; }

		public object[] SectionKeyValues { get; set; }

		public ISummaryResult[][] SummaryResults2 { get; set; }

		public int[] SummaryLocations { get; set; }

		public SummaryGroup[] SummaryGroups { get; set; }

		public int PinnedCount { get; set; }

		public int SummaryTopCount { get; set; }

		public int SummaryBottomCount { get; set; }

		public int FirstRowDisplacement { get; set; }

		public int[] RowCount { get; set; }

		public int FooterCount { get; set; }

		public int[] HeaderOffsets { get; set; }

		public int ParentSection
		{
			get
			{
				return _parentSection;
			}
			set
			{
				_parentSection = value;
			}
		}

		public int RealSectionStartIndex => SectionStartIndex + HeaderCount + SummaryTopCount - FirstRowDisplacement;

		public int RealSectionEndIndex => RealSectionStartIndex + RowCount[RowCount.Length - 1] - 1;

		public bool[] HeaderStates { get; set; }

		public string[] HeaderExpansionKeys { get; set; }

		public int HeaderCount { get; set; }

		public bool IsSectionContentVisible
		{
			get
			{
				if (!IsSectionVisible)
				{
					return false;
				}
				for (int i = GetLevel(); i < HeaderStates.Length; i++)
				{
					if (!HeaderStates[i])
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public bool IsSectionVisible
		{
			get
			{
				return _isSectionVisible;
			}
			set
			{
				_isSectionVisible = value;
			}
		}

		public SectionData SyncSection { get; set; }

		public void InitializeExpandedStates(DataSourceSectionHeaderDisplayMode sectionHeaderDisplayMode, bool defaultState)
		{
			InitializeExpandedStates(sectionHeaderDisplayMode, defaultState, SectionKeyNames.Length);
		}

		public void InitializeExpandedStates(DataSourceSectionHeaderDisplayMode sectionHeaderDisplayMode, bool defaultState, int numHeaders)
		{
			switch (sectionHeaderDisplayMode)
			{
			case DataSourceSectionHeaderDisplayMode.Combined:
				HeaderStates = new bool[1];
				HeaderExpansionKeys = new string[1];
				break;
			case DataSourceSectionHeaderDisplayMode.Split:
				HeaderStates = new bool[numHeaders];
				HeaderExpansionKeys = new string[numHeaders];
				break;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < HeaderStates.Length; i++)
			{
				HeaderStates[i] = defaultState;
			}
		}

		public static List<Dictionary<string, ISummaryResult>> GetSummaryRowsFromResults(ISummaryResult[] summaryResults)
		{
			List<Dictionary<string, ISummaryResult>> list = new List<Dictionary<string, ISummaryResult>>();
			if (summaryResults != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < summaryResults.Length; i++)
				{
					if (summaryResults[i] == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (list.Count == 0)
					{
						list.Add(new Dictionary<string, ISummaryResult>());
					}
					for (int j = 0; j < list.Count; j++)
					{
						if (!list[j].ContainsKey(summaryResults[i].PropertyName))
						{
							list[j].Add(summaryResults[i].PropertyName, summaryResults[i]);
							break;
						}
						if (j == list.Count - 1)
						{
							list.Add(new Dictionary<string, ISummaryResult>());
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		public DataSourceRowType GetRowType(int rowIndex)
		{
			int headerCount = GetHeaderCount();
			if (rowIndex >= SectionStartIndex && rowIndex < SectionStartIndex + headerCount)
			{
				return DataSourceRowType.SectionHeader;
			}
			if (rowIndex >= SectionStartIndex + headerCount && rowIndex < SectionStartIndex + headerCount + SummaryTopCount)
			{
				return DataSourceRowType.SummaryRowSection;
			}
			if (rowIndex > SectionEndIndex - FooterCount - SummaryBottomCount && rowIndex <= SectionEndIndex - FooterCount)
			{
				return DataSourceRowType.SummaryRowSection;
			}
			if (rowIndex > SectionEndIndex - FooterCount && rowIndex <= SectionEndIndex)
			{
				return DataSourceRowType.SectionFooter;
			}
			return DataSourceRowType.Normal;
		}

		public int GetSummaryRowIndex(int rowIndex)
		{
			int headerCount = GetHeaderCount();
			int result = -1;
			if (rowIndex >= SectionStartIndex + headerCount && rowIndex < SectionStartIndex + headerCount + SummaryTopCount)
			{
				result = rowIndex - (SectionStartIndex + headerCount);
			}
			if (rowIndex > SectionEndIndex - FooterCount - SummaryBottomCount && rowIndex <= SectionEndIndex - FooterCount)
			{
				result = rowIndex - (SectionEndIndex - FooterCount - SummaryBottomCount + 1);
			}
			return result;
		}

		public int GetHeaderCount()
		{
			int num = 0;
			if (HeaderExpansionKeys != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < HeaderExpansionKeys.Length; i++)
				{
					if (HeaderExpansionKeys[i] != null)
					{
						num++;
					}
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		public int GetLevel()
		{
			if (HeaderExpansionKeys != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < HeaderExpansionKeys.Length; i++)
				{
					if (HeaderExpansionKeys[i] != null)
					{
						return i;
					}
				}
			}
			return 0;
		}

		public bool HasRows()
		{
			return RowCount[RowCount.Length - 1] > 0;
		}

		public void SyncSummaryRows(Action<DataSourceSpecialRow> notifier)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < SummaryGroups.Length; i++)
			{
				if (SummaryGroups[i] != null)
				{
					List<Dictionary<string, ISummaryResult>> summaryRowsFromResults = GetSummaryRowsFromResults(SummaryResults2[i]);
					for (int j = 0; j < summaryRowsFromResults.Count; j++)
					{
						ISummaryResult[] array = new ISummaryResult[summaryRowsFromResults[j].Count];
						summaryRowsFromResults[j].Values.CopyTo(array, 0);
						SummaryGroups[i].Summaries[j].SummaryResults = array;
						notifier?.Invoke(SummaryGroups[i].Summaries[j]);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public void SetSummaryRow(DataSourceSpecialRow row, int position)
		{
			if (row != null && row.RowType == DataSourceRowType.SummaryRowSection && (position >= 0 || position < SummaryGroups[row.Level - 1].Summaries.Length))
			{
				SummaryGroups[row.Level - 1].Summaries[position] = row;
			}
		}

		public bool HasSummaries()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < SummaryGroups.Length; i++)
			{
				if (SummaryGroups[i] == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				for (int j = 0; j < SummaryGroups[i].Summaries.Length; j++)
				{
					if (SummaryGroups[i].Summaries[j] != null)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void UpdateSummary(int level, int summaryIndex, ISummaryResult result)
		{
			result.SummaryIndex = summaryIndex;
			SummaryResults2[level][summaryIndex] = result;
			if (IsRemoved && SyncSection != null)
			{
				SyncSection.SummaryResults2[level][summaryIndex] = result;
			}
		}

		public void ShiftSummaryLocationsFromLevel(int level, int amount)
		{
			for (int num = level - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				if (SummaryLocations[num] != -1)
				{
					SummaryLocations[num] += amount;
				}
			}
		}
	}
	internal class SummaryGroup
	{
		public DataSourceSpecialRow[] Summaries { get; set; }
	}

	[DontObfuscate]
	[JsonAPIMarshalByValue]
	[JsonAPIWidget]
	public class DataSourceSpecialRow
	{
		private FastIterationDictionary<string, object> _values = new FastIterationDictionary<string, object>();

		private FastIterationDictionary<string, object> _sectionValues = new FastIterationDictionary<string, object>();

		public DataSourceRowType RowType { get; set; }

		public string[] Keys
		{
			get
			{
				List<string> list = new List<string>();
				for (int i = 0; i < _values.KeyList.Count; i++)
				{
					if (!_values.RemovedList[i])
					{
						list.Add(_values.KeyList[i]);
					}
				}
				return list.ToArray();
			}
		}

		public object[] Values
		{
			get
			{
				List<object> list = new List<object>();
				for (int i = 0; i < _values.ValueList.Count; i++)
				{
					if (!_values.RemovedList[i])
					{
						list.Add(_values.ValueList[i]);
					}
				}
				return list.ToArray();
			}
		}

		public string[] SectionKeys
		{
			get
			{
				List<string> list = new List<string>();
				for (int i = 0; i < _sectionValues.KeyList.Count; i++)
				{
					if (!_sectionValues.RemovedList[i])
					{
						list.Add(_sectionValues.KeyList[i]);
					}
				}
				return list.ToArray();
			}
		}

		public object[] SectionValues
		{
			get
			{
				List<object> list = new List<object>();
				for (int i = 0; i < _sectionValues.ValueList.Count; i++)
				{
					if (!_sectionValues.RemovedList[i])
					{
						list.Add(_sectionValues.ValueList[i]);
					}
				}
				return list.ToArray();
			}
		}

		[JsonAPIPrimitiveValue]
		public object TargetRow { get; set; }

		public int Level { get; set; }

		[BlazorByValueArray]
		public ISummaryResult[] SummaryResults { get; set; }

		[BlazorSuppressWidgetMember]
		public object GetValue(string name)
		{
			if (name == "SectionInformation")
			{
				return _sectionValues;
			}
			object value = null;
			if (_values.TryGetValue(name, out value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return GetSummaryValue(name);
		}

		[BlazorSuppressWidgetMember]
		public object GetSectionValue(string name)
		{
			if (name == "SectionInformation")
			{
				return _sectionValues;
			}
			object value = null;
			if (_sectionValues.TryGetValue(name, out value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return GetSummaryValue(name);
		}

		[BlazorSuppressWidgetMember]
		public void SetValue(string name, object value)
		{
			_values[name] = value;
		}

		[BlazorSuppressWidgetMember]
		public void SetSectionValue(string name, object value)
		{
			_sectionValues[name] = value;
		}

		[BlazorSuppressWidgetMember]
		public string[] GetSectionKeys()
		{
			string[] array = new string[_sectionValues.Count];
			int num = 0;
			foreach (string key in _sectionValues.Keys)
			{
				array[num] = key;
				num++;
			}
			return array;
		}

		[BlazorSuppressWidgetMember]
		public object GetSummaryValue(string propertyName)
		{
			if (SummaryResults != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < SummaryResults.Length; i++)
				{
					if (SummaryResults[i] != null && SummaryResults[i].PropertyName == propertyName)
					{
						return SummaryResults[i].Value;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		[BlazorSuppressWidgetMember]
		public ISummaryResult[] GetSummaryResults(string propertyName)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(propertyName))
			{
				return SummaryResults;
			}
			List<ISummaryResult> list = new List<ISummaryResult>();
			for (int i = 0; i < SummaryResults.Length; i++)
			{
				if (SummaryResults[i] != null && SummaryResults[i].PropertyName == propertyName)
				{
					list.Add(SummaryResults[i]);
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		internal bool IsHeaderSame(DataSourceSpecialRow header)
		{
			if (header.RowType != DataSourceRowType.SectionHeader)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (header._sectionValues.Count != _sectionValues.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < header._sectionValues.KeyList.Count; i++)
			{
				string key = header._sectionValues.KeyList[i];
				object obj = header._sectionValues.ValueList[i];
				if (!_sectionValues.ContainsKey(key))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (_sectionValues[key] == null)
				{
					if (_sectionValues[key] != obj)
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				else if (!_sectionValues[key].Equals(obj))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object other)
		{
			if (other is DataSourceSpecialRow dataSourceSpecialRow)
			{
				if (RowType == DataSourceRowType.SectionHeader && dataSourceSpecialRow.RowType == DataSourceRowType.SectionHeader)
				{
					return IsHeaderSame(dataSourceSpecialRow);
				}
				if (RowType == DataSourceRowType.ShiftedRow && dataSourceSpecialRow.RowType == DataSourceRowType.ShiftedRow)
				{
					return TargetRow == dataSourceSpecialRow.TargetRow;
				}
			}
			return base.Equals(other);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			if (RowType == DataSourceRowType.SectionHeader)
			{
				int num = 0;
				for (int i = 0; i < _sectionValues.ValueList.Count; i++)
				{
					num = num * 17 + GetSubHashCode(_sectionValues.KeyList[i]);
					num = num * 17 + GetSubHashCode(_sectionValues.ValueList[i]);
				}
				return num;
			}
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}

		private int GetSubHashCode(object val_)
		{
			return val_?.GetHashCode() ?? 0;
		}
	}
	internal class LocalDataSource : BaseDataSource

		public IDataSourceLocalDataProvider ActualDataProvider

					ActualDataProvider = ResolveDataProvider();
				}
				return _actualDataProvider;
			}
			internal set

				IDataSourceLocalDataProvider actualDataProvider = _actualDataProvider;
				_actualDataProvider = value;
				if (actualDataProvider != _actualDataProvider)
				{
					OnPropertyUpdated("ActualDataProvider", actualDataProvider, _actualDataProvider);
				}
			}
		}

		[JAVASuppressWidgetMember]
		[TSSuppressWidgetMember]

		public IEnumerable ItemsSource

		protected internal IExternalLocalDataSource ExternalLocalDataSource

		public override bool IsItemIndexLookupSupported => true;

		public override bool IsKeyIndexLookupSupported => true;

		public override bool IsSortingSupported
		{
			get

				if (base.ExternalDataSource != null && !_checkingExternal)
				{
					_checkingExternal = true;
					bool isSortingSupportedOverride = base.ExternalDataSource.IsSortingSupportedOverride;
					_checkingExternal = false;
					return isSortingSupportedOverride;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		[DontObfuscate]

		public LocalDataSource()
		{
			base.TransactionService.IsEnabled = false;
		}

		[DontObfuscate]
		protected IDataSourceLocalDataProvider ResolveDataProvider()
		{
			if (ExternalLocalDataSource == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return ExternalLocalDataSource.ResolveDataProvider();
		}

		[DontObfuscate]
		protected override void PropertyUpdatedOverride(string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			base.PropertyUpdatedOverride(propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "DataProvider":
				ActualDataProvider = DataProvider;
				break;
			case "ActualDataProvider":
				if (ActualDataProvider != null)
				{
					ActualDataProvider.ItemsSource = ItemsSource;
					base.ActualSchema = ActualDataProvider.ActualSchema;
					base.ActualCount = ResolveFullCount(ActualDataProvider.ActualCount);
				}
				QueueAutoRefresh();
				break;
			case "ItemsSource":
				if (ActualDataProvider != null)
				{
					ActualDataProvider.ItemsSource = ItemsSource;
					base.ActualSchema = ActualDataProvider.ActualSchema;
					base.ActualCount = ResolveFullCount(ActualDataProvider.ActualCount);
				}
				QueueAutoRefresh();
				break;
			}
		}

		public override object GetItemAtIndex(int index)
		{
			if (_view != null && _view.View != null)
			{
				return _view.View[index];
			}
			return ActualDataProvider.GetItemAtIndex(index);
		}

		public override object GetItemFromKey(object[] key)
		{
			string[] actualPrimaryKey = base.ActualPrimaryKey;
			if (actualPrimaryKey == null || actualPrimaryKey.Length < 1 || ActualBaseDataProvider == null)
			{
				return key[0];
			}
			DataSourcePropertiesComparer primaryKeyComparer = GetPrimaryKeyComparer();
			if (_view != null)
			{
				int count = _view.View.Count;
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					object obj = _view.View[i];
					if (obj is DataSourceSpecialRow)
					{
						if (((DataSourceSpecialRow)obj).RowType == DataSourceRowType.SectionHeader && !IsSectionContentVisible && IsSectionHeaderNormalRow && primaryKeyComparer.CompareToKey(obj, key) == 0)
						{
							return obj;
						}
					}
					else if (primaryKeyComparer.CompareToKey(obj, key) == 0)
					{
						return obj;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
			if (ActualDataProvider != null && ActualDataProvider.IsKeyIndexLookupSupported)
			{
				int index = ActualDataProvider.IndexOfKey(key);
				return ActualDataProvider.GetItemAtIndex(index);
			}
			if (ActualDataProvider != null)
			{
				int actualCount = ActualDataProvider.ActualCount;
				for (int j = 0; j < actualCount; j++)
				{
					object obj = ActualDataProvider.GetItemAtIndex(j);
					if (primaryKeyComparer.CompareToKey(obj, key) == 0)
					{
						return obj;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override object GetItemPropertyAtIndex(int index, string valueName)
		{
			object obj = ((_view == null) ? ActualDataProvider.GetItemAtIndex(index) : _view.View[index]);
			if (obj is DataSourceSpecialRow)
			{
				return GetSpecialRowItemValue((DataSourceSpecialRow)obj, valueName);
			}
			if (IsCRUDSupported() && DoesItemPropertyHaveTransaction(obj, valueName))
			{
				return GetItemPropertyFromTransactions(obj, valueName);
			}
			return ActualDataProvider.GetItemValue(obj, valueName);
		}

		private IDataSourceSupportsIndexedAccess GetItems()
		{
			return ActualDataProvider;
		}

		private bool HasPinnedRows()
		{
			if (_pinnedKeys != null)
			{
				return _pinnedKeys.Count > 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		[DontObfuscate]
		protected override void RefreshInternalOverride()
		{
			base.RefreshInternalOverride();
			if (ActualDataProvider != null)
			{
				if (NeedLocalFiltering() || NeedLocalGrouping() || NeedLocalSorting() || NeedLocalSummaries() || HasPinnedRows())
				{
					if (_view == null)
					{
						if (_viewUpdateNotifier == null)
						{
							_viewUpdateNotifier = new LocalDataSourceViewUpdateNotifier(this);
						}
						_view = new RearrangedListView(ActualDataProvider);
						_view.UpdateNotifier = _viewUpdateNotifier;
						_view.ExpansionNotifier = new LocalDataSourceViewExpansionNotifier(this);
					}
					EnsureComparables(ActualDataProvider.ActualSchema);
					_view.ShouldEmitSectionHeaders = base.ShouldEmitSectionHeaders && base.HasGroups;
					_view.ShouldEmitSectionFooters = base.ShouldEmitSectionFooters && base.HasGroups;
					_view.ShouldEmitShiftedRows = base.ShouldEmitShiftedRows;
					_view.SetPinnedKeys(_pinnedKeys);
					_view.SortComparer = ResolveSortComparer();
					_view.GroupComparer = ResolveGroupComparer();
					_view.PrimaryKeyComparer = GetPrimaryKeyComparer();
					_view.GroupDescriptions = base.GroupDescriptions;
					_view.SortDescriptions = base.SortDescriptions;
					_view.SummaryDescriptions = base.SummaryDescriptions;
					_view.SummaryScope = base.SummaryScope;
					_view.IncludeSummaryRowsInSection = IncludeSummaryRowsInSection;
					_view.IsSectionSummaryRowsAtBottom = IsSectionSummaryRowsAtBottom;
					_view.SectionHeaderDisplayMode = SectionHeaderDisplayMode;
					_view.DataSource = this;
					_view.IsGrouping = base.GroupDescriptions != null && base.GroupDescriptions.All.Count > 0;
					_view.Filter = ResolveFilter();
					_view.Refresh();
					base.ActualSchema = ActualDataProvider.ActualSchema;
					base.ActualCount = _view.View.Count;
				}
				else
				{
					IDataSourceSupportsIndexedAccess items = GetItems();
					base.ActualSchema = ActualDataProvider.ActualSchema;
					if (items != null)
					{
						base.ActualCount = items.ActualCount;
					}
					else
					{
						base.ActualCount = 0;
					}
					if (_view != null)
					{
						_view.UpdateNotifier = null;
						_view = null;
						OnBroadcastClearItems();
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				base.ActualCount = 0;
				base.ActualSchema = null;
			}
		}

		public override int IndexOfItem(object item)
		{
			if (_view != null)
			{
				return _view.View.IndexOf(item);
			}
			if (ActualDataProvider != null && ActualDataProvider.IsItemIndexLookupSupported)
			{
				return ActualDataProvider.IndexOfItem(item);
			}
			if (ActualDataProvider != null)
			{
				int actualCount = ActualDataProvider.ActualCount;
				for (int i = 0; i < actualCount; i++)
				{
					object itemAtIndex = ActualDataProvider.GetItemAtIndex(i);
					if (AreEqual(itemAtIndex, item))
					{
						return i;
					}
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		private bool AreEqual(object currItem, object item)
		{
			if (currItem == null && item == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (currItem == null || item == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return currItem.Equals(item);
		}

		public override int IndexOfKey(object[] key)
		{
			string[] actualPrimaryKey = base.ActualPrimaryKey;
			if (actualPrimaryKey == null || actualPrimaryKey.Length < 1 || ActualBaseDataProvider == null)
			{
				return IndexOfItem(key[0]);
			}
			DataSourcePropertiesComparer primaryKeyComparer = GetPrimaryKeyComparer();
			if (_view != null)
			{
				int count = _view.View.Count;
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					object obj = _view.View[i];
					if (obj is DataSourceSpecialRow)
					{
						if (((DataSourceSpecialRow)obj).RowType == DataSourceRowType.SectionHeader && !IsSectionContentVisible && IsSectionHeaderNormalRow && primaryKeyComparer.CompareToKey(obj, key) == 0)
						{
							return i;
						}
					}
					else if (primaryKeyComparer.CompareToKey(obj, key) == 0)
					{
						return i;
					}
				}
				return -1;
			}
			if (ActualDataProvider != null && ActualDataProvider.IsKeyIndexLookupSupported)
			{
				return ActualDataProvider.IndexOfKey(key);
			}
			if (ActualDataProvider != null)
			{
				int actualCount = ActualDataProvider.ActualCount;
				for (int j = 0; j < actualCount; j++)
				{
					object obj = ActualDataProvider.GetItemAtIndex(j);
					if (primaryKeyComparer.CompareToKey(obj, key) == 0)
					{
						return j;
					}
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		[DontObfuscate]
		protected override void OnActualPrimaryKeyChangedOverrride(string[] oldValue, string[] newValue)
		{
			base.OnActualPrimaryKeyChangedOverrride(oldValue, newValue);
			_primaryKeyComparer = null;
		}

		private DataSourcePropertiesComparer GetPrimaryKeyComparer()
		{
			if (_primaryKeyComparer != null)
			{
				return _primaryKeyComparer;
			}
			if (base.ActualPrimaryKey == null)
			{
				_primaryKeyComparer = new DataSourcePropertiesComparer(null, null, null, this);
				return _primaryKeyComparer;
			}
			ListSortDirection[] array = new ListSortDirection[base.ActualPrimaryKey.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i] = ListSortDirection.Ascending;
			}
			_primaryKeyComparer = new DataSourcePropertiesComparer(base.ActualPrimaryKey, array, _schemaComparables, this);
			return _primaryKeyComparer;
		}

		private RearrangedListViewFilter ResolveFilter()
		{
			if (base.FilterExpressions.All.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			IDataSourceLocalDataProvider provider = ActualDataProvider;
			IDataSourceSchema schema = ActualDataProvider.ActualSchema;
			IList<IFilterExpression> expressions = base.FilterExpressions.All;
			return delegate(object item)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < expressions.Count; i++)
				{
					if (!expressions[i].Match(item, provider, schema))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				return true;
			};
		}

		private IComparer<object> ResolveSortComparer()
		{
			int num = 0;
			if (base.SortDescriptions.All.Count == 0 && (base.GroupDescriptions == null || base.GroupDescriptions.All.Count == 0))
			{
				return null;
			}
			num = base.SortDescriptions.All.Count;
			if (base.GroupDescriptions != null)
			{
				num += base.GroupDescriptions.All.Count;
			}
			string[] array = new string[num];
			ListSortDirection[] array2 = new ListSortDirection[num];
			int num2 = 0;
			if (base.GroupDescriptions != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < base.GroupDescriptions.All.Count; i++)
				{
					array[i] = base.GroupDescriptions.All[i].PropertyName;
					array2[i] = base.GroupDescriptions.All[i].Direction;
					num2++;
				}
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < base.SortDescriptions.All.Count; j++)
			{
				array[j + num2] = base.SortDescriptions.All[j].PropertyName;
				array2[j + num2] = base.SortDescriptions.All[j].Direction;
			}
			return new DataSourcePropertiesComparer(array, array2, _schemaComparables, this);
		}

		private IComparer<object> ResolveGroupComparer()
		{
			if (base.GroupDescriptions == null || base.GroupDescriptions.All.Count < 1)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int count = base.GroupDescriptions.All.Count;
			string[] array = new string[count];
			ListSortDirection[] array2 = new ListSortDirection[count];
			if (base.GroupDescriptions != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < base.GroupDescriptions.All.Count; i++)
				{
					array[i] = base.GroupDescriptions.All[i].PropertyName;
					array2[i] = base.GroupDescriptions.All[i].Direction;
				}
			}
			return new DataSourcePropertiesComparer(array, array2, _schemaComparables, this);
		}

		private bool NeedLocalGrouping()
		{
			if (base.GroupDescriptions == null || base.GroupDescriptions.All.Count < 1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (ActualDataProvider == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (ActualDataProvider.IsGroupingSupported)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool NeedLocalSorting()
		{
			if (base.SortDescriptions == null || base.SortDescriptions.All.Count < 1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (ActualDataProvider == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (ActualDataProvider.IsSortingSupported)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool NeedLocalFiltering()
		{
			if (base.FilterExpressions != null)
			{
				return base.FilterExpressions.All.Count > 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool NeedLocalSummaries()
		{
			if (base.SummaryDescriptions == null || base.SummaryDescriptions.All.Count < 1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		[DontObfuscate]

				_view.NotifyClearItems();

				base.OnClearItemsOverride();

		}

			base.ActualCount = _view.View.Count;
			OnBroadcastClearItems();
		}

			base.ActualCount = _view.View.Count;
			OnBroadcastSetItem(index, oldItem, newItem);

		{
			base.ActualCount = _view.View.Count;
			OnBroadcastInsertItem(index, newItem);

		{
			base.ActualCount = _view.View.Count;
			OnBroadcastRemoveItem(index, oldItem);
		}

		public override void PinRow(object[] key)
		{
			base.PinRow(key);
			_lastStartSection = -1;
			_lastEndSection = -1;
			if (_view != null)
			{
				_pinnedKeys.Add(key);
				_view.PinRow(key);
			}
			else
			{
				_pinnedKeys.Add(key);
				QueueAutoRefresh();
			}
		}

		public override void UnpinRow(object[] key)
		{
			base.UnpinRow(key);
			DataSourcePropertiesComparer primaryKeyComparer = GetPrimaryKeyComparer();
			if (_view != null)
			{
				for (int num = _pinnedKeys.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					object[] array = _pinnedKeys[num];
					if (array.Length == key.Length && primaryKeyComparer.CompareKeys(array, key) == 0)
					{
						_pinnedKeys.RemoveAt(num);
						_view.UnpinRow(array);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				for (int num2 = _pinnedKeys.Count - 1; num2 >= 0; num2--)
				{
					object[] array2 = _pinnedKeys[num2];
					if (array2.Length == key.Length && primaryKeyComparer.CompareKeys(array2, key) == 0)
					{
						_pinnedKeys.RemoveAt(num2);
					}
				}
				QueueAutoRefresh();
			}
			_lastStartSection = -1;
			_lastEndSection = -1;
		}

		public override void ClearPinnedRows()
		{
			for (int num = _pinnedKeys.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				UnpinRow(_pinnedKeys[num]);
			}
		}

		public override bool IsRowPinned(int row)
		{
			if (_view == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			object itemAtIndex = GetItemAtIndex(row);
			if (itemAtIndex == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (itemAtIndex is DataSourceSpecialRow { RowType: DataSourceRowType.ShiftedRow })
			{
				return true;
			}
			DataSourcePropertiesComparer primaryKeyComparer = GetPrimaryKeyComparer();
			object[] array;
			if (base.ActualPrimaryKey == null)
			{
				array = new object[1] { itemAtIndex };
			}
			else
			{
				string[] actualPrimaryKey = base.ActualPrimaryKey;
				int num = actualPrimaryKey.Length;
				array = new object[num];
				for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
				{
					array[i] = GetItemProperty(itemAtIndex, actualPrimaryKey[i]);
				}
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < _pinnedKeys.Count; j++)
			{
				if (primaryKeyComparer.CompareKeys(_pinnedKeys[j], array) == 0)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetStickyRowPriority(int row)
		{
			switch (GetRowType(row))
			{
			case DataSourceRowType.SectionHeader:
				return 100 - GetRowLevel(row);
			case DataSourceRowType.SectionFooter:
				return 99 - GetRowLevel(row);
			case DataSourceRowType.ShiftedRow:
			case DataSourceRowType.SummaryRowSection:
				return 2;
			case DataSourceRowType.SummaryRowRoot:
				return 3;
			default:
				return 1;
			}
		}

		public override int[] GetStickyRowsInRange(int firstVisibleIndex, int lastVisibleIndex)
		{
			if (_view == null || ((base.GroupDescriptions == null || base.GroupDescriptions.All.Count == 0) && (base.SummaryDescriptions == null || base.SummaryDescriptions.All.Count == 0) && !HasPinnedRows()))
			{
				return null;
			}
			SectionData sectionData = null;
			SectionData sectionData2 = null;
			if (_view.Sections.Count == 1)
			{
				sectionData = _view.Sections[0];
				sectionData2 = _view.Sections[0];
			}
			else
			{
				sectionData = _view.GetSection(firstVisibleIndex);
				if (sectionData != null)
				{
					while (sectionData.ParentSection != -1)
					{
						sectionData = _view.Sections[sectionData.ParentSection];
					}
				}
				sectionData2 = _view.GetSection(lastVisibleIndex);
				if (lastVisibleIndex >= _view.View.Count - _view.RootSummaryRowCount)
				{
					sectionData2 = _view.GetLastSection();
				}
			}
			if (sectionData == null || sectionData2 == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (sectionData.SectionIndex == _lastStartSection && sectionData.PinnedCount == _lastStartSectionPinCount && sectionData.SectionStartIndex == _lastStartSectionStartIndex && sectionData.SectionEndIndex == _lastStartSectionEndIndex && sectionData.SummaryTopCount == _lastStartSummaryTopCount && sectionData.SummaryBottomCount == _lastStartSummaryBottomCount && sectionData2.SectionIndex == _lastEndSection && sectionData2.PinnedCount == _lastEndSectionPinCount && sectionData2.SectionStartIndex == _lastEndSectionStartIndex && sectionData2.SectionEndIndex == _lastEndSectionEndIndex && sectionData2.SummaryTopCount == _lastEndSummaryTopCount && sectionData2.SummaryBottomCount == _lastEndSummaryBottomCount && _view.RootSummaryRowCount == _lastRootSummaryCount)
			{
				return _pinnedRowsInOrder;
			}
			_lastStartSection = sectionData.SectionIndex;
			_lastEndSection = sectionData2.SectionIndex;
			_lastStartSectionPinCount = sectionData.PinnedCount;
			_lastEndSectionPinCount = sectionData2.PinnedCount;
			_lastStartSectionStartIndex = sectionData.SectionStartIndex;
			_lastEndSectionStartIndex = sectionData2.SectionStartIndex;
			_lastStartSectionEndIndex = sectionData.SectionEndIndex;
			_lastEndSectionEndIndex = sectionData2.SectionEndIndex;
			_lastStartSummaryTopCount = sectionData.SummaryTopCount;
			_lastStartSummaryBottomCount = sectionData.SummaryBottomCount;
			_lastEndSummaryTopCount = sectionData2.SummaryTopCount;
			_lastEndSummaryBottomCount = sectionData2.SummaryBottomCount;
			_lastRootSummaryCount = _view.RootSummaryRowCount;
			if (_view.Sections.Count == 1)
			{
				_lastEndSection = sectionData2.SectionEndIndex;
			}
			if (base.ShouldEmitSectionHeaders)
			{
				_ = base.HasGroups;
			}
			int summaryRowCount = _view.GetSummaryRowCount();
			List<int> list = new List<int>();
			for (int i = sectionData.SectionIndex; i <= sectionData2.SectionIndex; i++)
			{
				SectionData sectionData3 = _view.Sections[i];
				int num = _view.Sections[i].HeaderStates.Length;
				int headerCount = _view.Sections[i].GetHeaderCount();
				if (base.ShouldEmitSectionHeaders && base.HasGroups)
				{
					for (int j = 0; j < num; j++)
					{
						if (_view.Sections[i].HeaderExpansionKeys[j] != null)
						{
							int num2 = sectionData3.SectionStartIndex + sectionData3.HeaderOffsets[j];
							list.Add(num2);
							if ((base.SummaryScope == DataSourceSummaryScope.Both || base.SummaryScope == DataSourceSummaryScope.Groups) && sectionData3.HeaderStates[j] && IncludeSummaryRowsInSection && !IsSectionSummaryRowsAtBottom)
							{
								for (int k = 0; k < summaryRowCount; k++)
								{
									list.Add(num2 + 1 + k);
								}
							}
						}
						if (!_view.Sections[i].HeaderStates[j])
						{
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				if (_view.Sections[i].IsSectionContentVisible && base.ShouldEmitShiftedRows)
				{
					for (int l = 0; l < _view.Sections[i].PinnedCount; l++)
					{
						list.Add(_view.Sections[i].SectionStartIndex + _view.Sections[i].SummaryTopCount + l + headerCount);
					}
				}
				if ((base.SummaryScope == DataSourceSummaryScope.Both || base.SummaryScope == DataSourceSummaryScope.Groups) && IncludeSummaryRowsInSection && IsSectionSummaryRowsAtBottom)
				{
					for (int num3 = _view.Sections[i].SummaryBottomCount - 1; num3 >= 0; num3--)
					{
						if (base.ShouldEmitSectionFooters)
						{
							list.Add(_view.Sections[i].SectionEndIndex - headerCount - num3);
						}
						else
						{
							list.Add(_view.Sections[i].SectionEndIndex - num3);
						}
					}
				}
				if (base.ShouldEmitSectionFooters && base.HasGroups)
				{
					int num4 = num - 1;
					while (num4 >= 0 && _view.Sections[i].HeaderStates[num4])
					{
						list.Add(_view.Sections[i].SectionEndIndex - num4);
						num4--;
					}
				}
			}
			for (int m = _view.View.Count - _view.RootSummaryRowCount; m < _view.View.Count; m++)
			{
				list.Add(m);
			}
			_pinnedRowsInOrder = list.ToArray();
			return _pinnedRowsInOrder;
		}

		public override bool IsExclusivelySticky(int row)
		{
			DataSourceRowType rowType = GetRowType(row);
			if (rowType != DataSourceRowType.SectionHeader && rowType != DataSourceRowType.SectionFooter && rowType != DataSourceRowType.SummaryRowRoot)
			{
				if (IsSectionSummaryRowsAtBottom)
				{
					return rowType == DataSourceRowType.SummaryRowSection;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override DataSourceRowType GetRowType(int row)
		{
			if (row < 0)
			{
				return DataSourceRowType.Normal;
			}
			object itemAtIndex = GetItemAtIndex(row);
			if (itemAtIndex is DataSourceSpecialRow)
			{
				DataSourceRowType rowType = ((DataSourceSpecialRow)itemAtIndex).RowType;
				if (IsSectionHeaderNormalRow && rowType == DataSourceRowType.SectionHeader)
				{
					return DataSourceRowType.Normal;
				}
				return rowType;
			}
			return DataSourceRowType.Normal;
		}

		public override void SetIsRowExpandedAtIndex(int rowIndex, bool state)
		{
			if (IsSectionCollapsable && _view != null && _view.View.Count > 0 && _view.View.Count > rowIndex)
			{
				_view.SetIsRowExpandedAtIndex(rowIndex, state);
			}
		}

		public override bool GetIsRowExpandedAtIndex(int rowIndex)
		{
			if (_view != null && _view.View.Count > 0 && _view.View.Count > rowIndex)
			{
				return _view.GetExpansionStateForRow(rowIndex);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override int GetRowLevel(int rowIndex)
		{
			if (rowIndex < 0)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			object itemAtIndex = GetItemAtIndex(rowIndex);
			if (itemAtIndex is DataSourceSpecialRow)
			{
				return ((DataSourceSpecialRow)itemAtIndex).Level;
			}
			if (SectionHeaderDisplayMode == DataSourceSectionHeaderDisplayMode.Split)
			{
				return base.GroupDescriptions.All.Count;
			}
			if (base.GroupDescriptions.All.Count > 0)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			return 0;
		}

		public override int GetRootSummaryRowCount()
		{
			if (_view != null)
			{
				return _view.RootSummaryRowCount;
			}
			return 0;
		}

		public override ISummaryResult[] GetRootSummaryResults()
		{
			if (_view != null)
			{
				return _view.RootSummaryResults;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override ISummaryResult[][] GetSectionSummaryResults(int sectionIndex)
		{
			if (_view != null && _view.Sections.Count > 0 && sectionIndex >= 0 && sectionIndex < _view.Sections.Count)
			{
				return _view.Sections[sectionIndex].SummaryResults2;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override IDataSource Clone()
		{
			LocalDataSource localDataSource = new LocalDataSource();
			localDataSource.ItemsSource = ItemsSource;
			base.CloneProperties(localDataSource);
			return localDataSource;
		}

		protected override bool IsCRUDSupported()
		{
			if (!base.IsReadOnly && ActualBaseDataProvider != null)
			{
				return base.TransactionService != null;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override void OnTransactionEvent(TransactionEvent eventType, object eventData)
		{
			if (eventType != TransactionEvent.Commit)
			{
				return;
			}
			List<TransactionType> list = new List<TransactionType>();
			List<object> list2 = new List<object>();
			TransactionCommit transactionCommit = (TransactionCommit)eventData;
			TransactionState[] changes = transactionCommit.Changes;
			for (int i = 0; i < changes.Length; i++)
			{
				if (changes[i].TransactionType == TransactionType.Update)
				{
					object[] array = (object[])changes[i].ID;
					object itemFromKey = GetItemFromKey(array);
					if (itemFromKey == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					Dictionary<string, object> dictionary = (Dictionary<string, object>)changes[i].Value;
					int num = IndexOfItem(itemFromKey);
					SectionData sectionData = null;
					if (_view != null && num > -1)
					{
						sectionData = _view.GetSection(num);
						for (int j = 0; j < base.SummaryDescriptions.All.Count; j++)
						{
							SummaryDescription summaryDescription = base.SummaryDescriptions.All[j];
							if (summaryDescription.Operand == SummaryOperand.Custom || dictionary.ContainsKey(summaryDescription.PropertyName))
							{
								_view.UpdateSummary(j, num, itemFromKey, insert: false, sectionData);
							}
						}
					}
					foreach (KeyValuePair<string, object> item2 in dictionary)
					{
						ActualDataProvider.SetItemValue(itemFromKey, item2.Key, item2.Value);
					}
					if (sectionData != null && _view != null && num > -1)
					{
						for (int k = 0; k < base.SummaryDescriptions.All.Count; k++)
						{
							SummaryDescription summaryDescription2 = base.SummaryDescriptions.All[k];
							if (summaryDescription2.Operand == SummaryOperand.Custom || dictionary.ContainsKey(summaryDescription2.PropertyName))
							{
								_view.UpdateSummary(k, num, itemFromKey, insert: true, sectionData);
							}
						}
					}
					if (num > -1)
					{
						OnBroadcastSetItem(num, itemFromKey, itemFromKey);
					}
					list2.Add(itemFromKey);
					list.Add(TransactionType.Update);
					if (_pinnedKeys.Count <= 0)
					{
						continue;
					}
					DataSourcePropertiesComparer primaryKeyComparer = GetPrimaryKeyComparer();
					for (int l = 0; l < _pinnedKeys.Count; l++)
					{
						if (primaryKeyComparer.CompareKeys(_pinnedKeys[l], array) != 0)
						{
							continue;
						}
						int[] stickyRows = GetStickyRows();
						foreach (int index in stickyRows)
						{
							if (_view.View[index] is DataSourceSpecialRow { RowType: DataSourceRowType.ShiftedRow } dataSourceSpecialRow && dataSourceSpecialRow.TargetRow == itemFromKey)
							{
								OnBroadcastSetItem(index, dataSourceSpecialRow, dataSourceSpecialRow);
								break;
							}
						}
						break;
					}
				}
				else if (changes[i].TransactionType == TransactionType.Delete)
				{
					object[] key = (object[])changes[i].ID;
					int num2 = IndexOfKey(key);
					if (num2 > -1)
					{
						object itemAtIndex = GetItemAtIndex(num2);
						ActualDataProvider.RemoveItem(itemAtIndex);
						NotifyRemoveItem(num2, itemAtIndex);
						list2.Add(itemAtIndex);
						list.Add(TransactionType.Delete);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					if (changes[i].TransactionType != TransactionType.Add)
					{
						continue;
					}
					object item = ((object[])changes[i].ID)[0];
					if (changes[i].Value != null)
					{
						foreach (KeyValuePair<string, object> item3 in (Dictionary<string, object>)changes[i].Value)
						{
							ActualDataProvider.SetItemValue(item, item3.Key, item3.Value);
						}
					}
					ActualDataProvider.AddItem(item);
					list2.Add(item);
					list.Add(TransactionType.Add);
				}
			}
			if (changes.Length != 0)
			{
				NotifyCommitCompleted(transactionCommit.ID, GetAggregatedChanges(transactionCommit.ID));
			}
		}

		protected override void EnsureComparables(IDataSourceSchema schema)
		{
			if (_comparablesDirty && ActualDataProvider != null && ActualDataProvider.ActualCount > 0)
			{
				object itemAtIndex = ActualDataProvider.GetItemAtIndex(0);
				if (itemAtIndex != null)
				{
					_schemaComparables = GetComparables(schema, itemAtIndex);
					_comparablesDirty = false;
				}
			}
		}
	}
	internal class DataSourcePropertiesComparer : IComparer<object>
	{
		private IDataSource _dataSource;

		private string[] _properties;

		private ListSortDirection[] _directions;

		private int _propertiesCount;

		private IDataSourceSchema _schema;

		private DataSourceSchemaPropertyType[] _schemaTypes;

		private bool[] _schemaComparables;

		public DataSourcePropertiesComparer(string[] properties, ListSortDirection[] directions, bool[] comparables, IDataSource dataSource)
		{
			_properties = properties;
			if (_properties != null)
			{
				_propertiesCount = _properties.Length;
			}
			_directions = directions;
			_dataSource = dataSource;
			_schema = dataSource.ActualSchema;
			if (_properties != null)
			{
				_schemaTypes = new DataSourceSchemaPropertyType[_propertiesCount];
			}
			_schemaComparables = comparables;
			if (_schemaComparables == null)
			{
				_schemaComparables = new bool[_propertiesCount];
			}
			Dictionary<string, DataSourceSchemaPropertyType> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, DataSourceSchemaPropertyType>();
			for (int i = 0; i < _schema.PropertyNames.Length; i++)
			{
				dictionary[_schema.PropertyNames[i]] = _schema.PropertyTypes[i];
			}
			if (_properties == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < _properties.Length; j++)
			{
				if (dictionary.ContainsKey(_properties[j]))
				{
					_schemaTypes[j] = dictionary[_properties[j]];
				}
				else
				{
					_schemaTypes[j] = dataSource.ResolveSchemaPropertyType(_properties[j]);
				}
			}
		}

		public int Compare(object x, object y)
		{
			if (_properties == null)
			{
				if (x == y)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return -1;
			}
			object obj = null;
			object obj2 = null;
			DataSourceSpecialRow dataSourceSpecialRow = null;
			DataSourceSpecialRow dataSourceSpecialRow2 = null;
			if (x is DataSourceSpecialRow)
			{
				dataSourceSpecialRow = (DataSourceSpecialRow)x;
			}
			if (y is DataSourceSpecialRow)
			{
				dataSourceSpecialRow2 = (DataSourceSpecialRow)y;
			}
			string text = null;
			bool flag = false;
			int propertiesCount = _propertiesCount;
			for (int i = 0; i < propertiesCount; i++)
			{
				text = _properties[i];
				flag = _directions[i] == ListSortDirection.Descending;
				if (dataSourceSpecialRow != null && dataSourceSpecialRow.RowType == DataSourceRowType.SummaryRowRoot)
				{
					return 1;
				}
				obj = ((dataSourceSpecialRow == null) ? _dataSource.GetItemProperty(x, text) : dataSourceSpecialRow.GetValue(text));
				obj2 = ((dataSourceSpecialRow2 == null) ? _dataSource.GetItemProperty(y, text) : dataSourceSpecialRow2.GetValue(text));
				int num = CompareValues(obj, obj2, flag, _schemaTypes[i], _schemaComparables[i]);
				if (i == propertiesCount - 1 && dataSourceSpecialRow != null && dataSourceSpecialRow.RowType == DataSourceRowType.SummaryRowSection && num == 0)
				{
					num = ((!_dataSource.IsSectionSummaryRowsAtBottom) ? (flag ? 1 : (-1)) : ((!flag) ? 1 : (-1)));
				}
				if (num != 0)
				{
					return num;
				}
			}
			return 0;
		}

		public int CompareKeys(object[] key1, object[] key2)
		{
			if (_properties == null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < key1.Length; i++)
				{
					if (key1[i] != key2[i])
					{
						return -1;
					}
				}
				return 0;
			}
			object obj = null;
			object obj2 = null;
			bool flag = false;
			int propertiesCount = _propertiesCount;
			for (int j = 0; j < propertiesCount; j++)
			{
				flag = _directions[j] == ListSortDirection.Descending;
				obj = key1[j];
				obj2 = key2[j];
				int num = CompareValues(obj, obj2, flag, _schemaTypes[j], _schemaComparables[j]);
				if (num != 0)
				{
					return num;
				}
			}
			return 0;
		}

		public int CompareToKey(object x, object[] key)
		{
			if (_properties == null)
			{
				if (key.Length == 1 && x == key[0])
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return -1;
			}
			object obj = null;
			object obj2 = null;
			string text = null;
			bool flag = false;
			int propertiesCount = _propertiesCount;
			for (int i = 0; i < propertiesCount; i++)
			{
				text = _properties[i];
				flag = _directions[i] == ListSortDirection.Descending;
				obj = _dataSource.GetItemProperty(x, text);
				obj2 = key[i];
				int num = CompareValues(obj, obj2, flag, _schemaTypes[i], _schemaComparables[i]);
				if (num != 0)
				{
					return num;
				}
			}
			return 0;
		}

		private int CompareValues(object xValue, object yValue, bool currIsDescending, DataSourceSchemaPropertyType schemaType, bool isComparable)
		{
			if (currIsDescending)
			{
				object obj = xValue;
				xValue = yValue;
				yValue = obj;
			}
			int result = 0;
			switch (schemaType)
			{
			case DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.BooleanValue:
				xValue = ((xValue == null) ? ((object)false) : xValue);
				yValue = ((yValue == null) ? ((object)false) : yValue);
				result = ((bool)xValue).CompareTo((bool)yValue);
				break;
			case DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.DateTimeValue:
				xValue = ((xValue == null) ? ((object)DateTime.MinValue) : xValue);
				yValue = ((yValue == null) ? ((object)DateTime.MinValue) : yValue);
				result = DateTime.Compare((DateTime)xValue, (DateTime)yValue);
				break;
			case DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.DateTimeOffsetValue:
				xValue = ((xValue == null) ? ((object)DateTimeOffset.MinValue) : xValue);
				yValue = ((yValue == null) ? ((object)DateTimeOffset.MinValue) : yValue);
				result = DateTimeOffset.Compare((DateTimeOffset)xValue, (DateTimeOffset)yValue);
				break;
			case DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.DoubleValue:
				xValue = ((xValue == null) ? ((object)double.MinValue) : xValue);
				yValue = ((yValue == null) ? ((object)double.MinValue) : yValue);
				result = ((double)xValue).CompareTo((double)yValue);
				break;
			case DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.ByteValue:
				xValue = ((xValue == null) ? ((object)(byte)0) : xValue);
				yValue = ((yValue == null) ? ((object)(byte)0) : yValue);
				result = ((double)xValue).CompareTo((double)yValue);
				break;
			case DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.DecimalValue:
				xValue = ((xValue == null) ? ((object)decimal.MinValue) : xValue);
				yValue = ((yValue == null) ? ((object)decimal.MinValue) : yValue);
				result = ((decimal)xValue).CompareTo((decimal)yValue);
				break;
			case DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.SingleValue:
				xValue = ((xValue == null) ? ((object)float.MinValue) : xValue);
				yValue = ((yValue == null) ? ((object)float.MinValue) : yValue);
				result = ((float)yValue).CompareTo((float)yValue);
				break;
			case DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.IntValue:
				xValue = ((xValue == null) ? ((object)int.MinValue) : xValue);
				yValue = ((yValue == null) ? ((object)int.MinValue) : yValue);
				result = ((int)xValue).CompareTo((int)yValue);
				break;
			case DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.LongValue:
				xValue = ((xValue == null) ? ((object)long.MinValue) : xValue);
				yValue = ((yValue == null) ? ((object)long.MinValue) : yValue);
				result = ((long)xValue).CompareTo((long)yValue);
				break;
			case DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.ObjectValue:
				if (isComparable)
				{
					IComparable comparable = (IComparable)xValue;
					IComparable comparable2 = (IComparable)yValue;
					result = comparable?.CompareTo(comparable2) ?? ((comparable2 != null) ? (-1) : 0);
				}
				else
				{
					xValue = ((xValue == null) ? "" : xValue);
					yValue = ((yValue == null) ? "" : yValue);
					result = string.Compare(xValue.ToString(), yValue.ToString());
				}
				break;
			case DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.ShortValue:
				xValue = ((xValue == null) ? ((object)short.MinValue) : xValue);
				yValue = ((yValue == null) ? ((object)short.MinValue) : yValue);
				result = ((short)xValue).CompareTo((short)yValue);
				break;
			case DataSourceSchemaPropertyType.StringValue:
				xValue = ((xValue == null) ? "" : xValue);
				yValue = ((yValue == null) ? "" : yValue);
				result = string.Compare((string)xValue, (string)yValue);
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}
	}

	internal class PagePredictionEngine : INotifyPropertyChanged
	{
		internal const string ExecutionContextPropertyName = "ExecutionContext";

		private IDataSourceExecutionContext _executionContext;

		internal const string FirstVisibleIndexRequestedPropertyName = "FirstVisibleIndexRequested";

		private int _firstVisibleIndexRequested;

		internal const string LastVisibleIndexRequestedPropertyName = "LastVisibleIndexRequested";

		private int _lastVisibleIndexRequested;

		internal const string PageSizePropertyName = "PageSize";

		private int _pageSize = -1;

		internal const string FullCountPropertyName = "FullCount";

		private int _fullCount = -1;

		internal const string PageVisibilityDisplayThresholdMillisecondsPropertyName = "PageVisibilityDisplayThresholdMilliseconds";

		private int _pageVisibilityDisplayThresholdMilliseconds = 500;

		internal const string FetchAheadMillisecondsPropertyName = "FetchAheadMilliseconds";

		private int _fetchAheadMilliseconds = 1000;

		internal const string MaximumPageCandidatesPropertyName = "MaximumPageCandidates";

		private int _maximumPageCandidates = 8;

		internal const string PageCandidatesSinkPropertyName = "PageCandidatesSink";

		private IPageCandidatesSink _pageCandidatesSink;

		private int _maxPage;

		private bool _updateEnqueued;

		private bool _speedCheckEnqueued;

		private FastIterationDictionary<object, int> _candidates = new FastIterationDictionary<object, int>();

		private List<int> _toRemove = new List<int>();

		private List<int> _toConsider = new List<int>();

		private DataSourceVelocityTracker _velocityTracker = new DataSourceVelocityTracker();

		private double _currentVelocity;

		public IDataSourceExecutionContext ExecutionContext
		{
			get
			{
				return _executionContext;
			}
			set
			{
				IDataSourceExecutionContext executionContext = _executionContext;
				_executionContext = value;
				if (executionContext != _executionContext)
				{
					OnPropertyUpdated("ExecutionContext", executionContext, _executionContext);
				}
			}
		}

		public int FirstVisibleIndexRequested
		{
			get
			{
				return _firstVisibleIndexRequested;
			}
			set
			{
				int firstVisibleIndexRequested = _firstVisibleIndexRequested;
				_firstVisibleIndexRequested = value;
				if (firstVisibleIndexRequested != _firstVisibleIndexRequested)
				{
					OnPropertyUpdated("FirstVisibleIndexRequested", firstVisibleIndexRequested, _firstVisibleIndexRequested);
				}
			}
		}

		public int LastVisibleIndexRequested
		{
			get
			{
				return _lastVisibleIndexRequested;
			}
			set
			{
				int lastVisibleIndexRequested = _lastVisibleIndexRequested;
				_lastVisibleIndexRequested = value;
				if (lastVisibleIndexRequested != _lastVisibleIndexRequested)
				{
					OnPropertyUpdated("LastVisibleIndexRequested", lastVisibleIndexRequested, _lastVisibleIndexRequested);
				}
			}
		}

		public int PageSize
		{
			get
			{
				return _pageSize;
			}
			set
			{
				int pageSize = _pageSize;
				_pageSize = value;
				if (pageSize != _pageSize)
				{
					OnPropertyUpdated("PageSize", pageSize, _pageSize);
				}
			}
		}

		public int FullCount
		{
			get
			{
				return _fullCount;
			}
			set
			{
				int fullCount = _fullCount;
				_fullCount = value;
				if (fullCount != _fullCount)
				{
					OnPropertyUpdated("FullCount", fullCount, _fullCount);
				}
			}
		}

		public int PageVisibilityDisplayThresholdMilliseconds
		{
			get
			{
				return _pageVisibilityDisplayThresholdMilliseconds;
			}
			set
			{
				int pageVisibilityDisplayThresholdMilliseconds = _pageVisibilityDisplayThresholdMilliseconds;
				_pageVisibilityDisplayThresholdMilliseconds = value;
				if (pageVisibilityDisplayThresholdMilliseconds != _pageVisibilityDisplayThresholdMilliseconds)
				{
					OnPropertyUpdated("PageVisibilityDisplayThresholdMilliseconds", pageVisibilityDisplayThresholdMilliseconds, _pageVisibilityDisplayThresholdMilliseconds);
				}
			}
		}

		public int FetchAheadMilliseconds
		{
			get
			{
				return _fetchAheadMilliseconds;
			}
			set
			{
				int fetchAheadMilliseconds = _fetchAheadMilliseconds;
				_fetchAheadMilliseconds = value;
				if (fetchAheadMilliseconds != _fetchAheadMilliseconds)
				{
					OnPropertyUpdated("FetchAheadMilliseconds", fetchAheadMilliseconds, _fetchAheadMilliseconds);

		public int MaximumPageCandidates
		{
			get
			{
				return _maximumPageCandidates;
			}
			set

				_maximumPageCandidates = value;

				{
					OnPropertyUpdated("MaximumPageCandidates", maximumPageCandidates, _maximumPageCandidates);
				}

		}

		public IPageCandidatesSink PageCandidatesSink
		{
			get
			{
				return _pageCandidatesSink;
			}
			set

				IPageCandidatesSink pageCandidatesSink = _pageCandidatesSink;
				_pageCandidatesSink = value;
				if (pageCandidatesSink != _pageCandidatesSink)
				{
					OnPropertyUpdated("PageCandidatesSink", pageCandidatesSink, _pageCandidatesSink);
				}
			}
		}

		public SectionMap SectionMap { get; internal set; }

		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		protected void OnPropertyUpdated(string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
			}
			PropertyUpdatedOverride(propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
		}

		protected virtual void PropertyUpdatedOverride(string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "FirstVisibleIndexRequested":
			case "LastVisibleIndexRequested":
				OnDesiredVisibleRangeChanged();
				break;
			case "ExecutionContext":
				OnExecutionContextChanged();
				break;
			case "FullCount":
				ResetState();
				break;
			case "PageSize":
				ResetState();
				break;
			}
		}

		private void ResetState()
		{
			_velocityTracker.Clear();
			_currentVelocity = 0.0;
			List<int> list = new List<int>();
			for (int i = 0; i < _candidates.ValueList.Count; i++)
			{
				if (!_candidates.RemovedList[i])
				{
					list.Add(_candidates.ValueList[i]);
				}
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < list.Count; j++)
			{
				RemoveCandidate(list[j]);
			}
			if (FullCount > 0 && PageSize > 0)
			{
				_maxPage = (int)Math.Ceiling((double)FullCount / (double)PageSize);
			}
		}

		private void OnExecutionContextChanged()
		{
			EnqueueUpdate();
		}

		public void EnqueueUpdate()
		{
			if (!_updateEnqueued && ExecutionContext != null)
			{
				_updateEnqueued = true;
				ExecutionContext.EnqueueAction(NormalUpdate);
			}
		}

		private void NormalUpdate()
		{
			_updateEnqueued = false;
			Update();
		}

		private void Update()
		{
			if (_fullCount != -1 && _pageSize != -1)
			{
				EnqueueTopPosition();
				UpdateCurrentVelocity();
				UpdatePageCandidates();
				if (_currentVelocity != 0.0)
				{
					EnqueueSpeedCheck();
				}
			}
		}

		private void SpeedCheckUpdate()
		{
			_speedCheckEnqueued = false;
			Update();
		}

		private void EnqueueSpeedCheck()
		{
			if (!_speedCheckEnqueued && ExecutionContext != null)
			{
				_speedCheckEnqueued = true;
				ExecutionContext.ExecuteDelayed(SpeedCheckUpdate, 0);
			}
		}

		private void UpdatePageCandidates()
		{
			int firstVisiblePage = GetFirstVisiblePage();
			int lastVisiblePage = GetLastVisiblePage();
			bool flag = true;
			for (int i = firstVisiblePage; i <= lastVisiblePage; i++)
			{
				int currentPage = i;
				flag = EvaluatePage(currentPage, DataSourcePageRequestPriority.High);
			}
			if (_currentVelocity > 0.0)
			{
				int currentPage = lastVisiblePage;
				while (flag)
				{
					currentPage++;
					flag = EvaluatePage(currentPage, DataSourcePageRequestPriority.Normal);
				}
			}
			else if (_currentVelocity < 0.0)
			{
				int currentPage = firstVisiblePage;
				while (flag)
				{
					currentPage--;
					flag = EvaluatePage(currentPage, DataSourcePageRequestPriority.Normal);
				}
			}
			ReEvaluateCandidates();
		}

		private void ReEvaluateCandidates()
		{
			_toConsider.Clear();
			List<object> keyList = _candidates.KeyList;
			int count = _candidates.KeyList.Count;
			List<bool> removedList = _candidates.RemovedList;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (!removedList[i])
				{
					int item = (int)keyList[i];
					_toConsider.Add(item);
				}
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < _toConsider.Count; j++)
			{
				EvaluatePage(_toConsider[j], DataSourcePageRequestPriority.Normal);
			}
		}

		private bool EvaluatePage(int currentPage, DataSourcePageRequestPriority priority)
		{
			if (currentPage < 0 || currentPage > _maxPage)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (PageWillBeVisibleTooShortATime(currentPage))
			{
				RemoveCandidate(currentPage);
				return false;
			}
			if (PageWontBeVisibleWithinTimeFrame(currentPage, FetchAheadMilliseconds))
			{
				RemoveCandidate(currentPage);
				return false;
			}
			if (TooManyPageCandidates())
			{
				RemoveCandidate(currentPage);
				return false;
			}
			AddCandidate(currentPage, priority);
			return true;
		}

		private void AddCandidate(int currentPage, DataSourcePageRequestPriority priority)
		{
			if (!_candidates.ContainsKey(currentPage) && _pageCandidatesSink != null && _pageCandidatesSink.AddCandidate(currentPage, priority))
			{
				_candidates.Add(currentPage, currentPage);
			}
		}

		public void RemoveCandidate(int currentPage)
		{
			if (_candidates.ContainsKey(currentPage))
			{
				_candidates.Remove(currentPage);
				if (_pageCandidatesSink != null)
				{
					_pageCandidatesSink.RemoveCandidate(currentPage);
				}
			}
		}

		private bool TooManyPageCandidates()
		{
			return _candidates.Count >= MaximumPageCandidates;
		}

		private bool PageWontBeVisibleWithinTimeFrame(int currentPage, int fetchAheadMilliseconds)
		{
			double num = (double)fetchAheadMilliseconds / 1000.0 * _currentVelocity;
			if (PageIsVisible(currentPage))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (num > 0.0)
			{
				if (num + (double)LastVisibleIndexRequested >= (double)(currentPage * PageSize))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			else if ((double)FirstVisibleIndexRequested + num <= (double)(currentPage * PageSize + PageSize))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool PageIsVisible(int currentPage)
		{
			int num = currentPage * PageSize;
			int num2 = num + PageSize;
			if (LastVisibleIndexRequested < num || FirstVisibleIndexRequested > num2)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool PageWillBeVisibleTooShortATime(int currentPage)
		{
			double num = (double)PageVisibilityDisplayThresholdMilliseconds / 1000.0 * _currentVelocity;
			if (num > 0.0)
			{
				if (num + (double)FirstVisibleIndexRequested > (double)(currentPage * PageSize + PageSize))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			else if ((double)LastVisibleIndexRequested + num < (double)(currentPage * PageSize))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private int GetFirstVisiblePage()
		{
			return (int)Math.Floor((double)FirstVisibleIndexRequested / (double)PageSize);
		}

		private int GetLastVisiblePage()
		{
			return (int)Math.Floor((double)LastVisibleIndexRequested / (double)PageSize);
		}

		private void UpdateCurrentVelocity()
		{
			_currentVelocity = _velocityTracker.GetVelocity().Y;
		}

		private void EnqueueTopPosition()
		{
			_velocityTracker.TrackPoint(new Point(0.0, FirstVisibleIndexRequested));
		}

		protected virtual void OnDesiredVisibleRangeChanged()
		{
			if (ExecutionContext != null)
			{
				ExecutionContext.EnqueueAction(Update);
			}
		}
	}
