	{
	}
	internal class DataSourceVelocityReading
	{
		public Point Position { get; set; }

		public int Time { get; set; }

		public DataSourceVelocityReading(Point position, int time)
		{
			Position = position;
			Time = time;
		}
	}
	public class DataSourceVelocityTracker
	{
		private long _beginning;

		private int _ringBufferLength = 6;

		private int _currentPosition;

		private int _lastTimestamp;

		private DataSourceVelocityReading[] Readings { get; set; }

		public DataSourceVelocityTracker()
		{
			_beginning = GetCurrentTime();
			_lastTimestamp = 0;
			Readings = new DataSourceVelocityReading[_ringBufferLength];
		}

		public void TrackPoint(Point position)
		{
			int eventTime = GetEventTime();
			Readings[_currentPosition] = new DataSourceVelocityReading(position, eventTime);
			_currentPosition++;
			if (_currentPosition > _ringBufferLength - 1)
			{
				_currentPosition = 0;
			}
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < _ringBufferLength; i++)
			{
				Readings[i] = null;
			}
		}

		public Point GetVelocity()
		{
			int num = int.MaxValue;
			int num2 = int.MinValue;
			double num3 = 0.0;
			double num4 = 0.0;
			double num5 = 0.0;
			double num6 = 0.0;
			long num7 = GetEventTime();
			for (int i = 0; i < _ringBufferLength; i++)
			{
				if (Readings[i] != null && num7 - Readings[i].Time <= 300)
				{
					if (Readings[i].Time < num)
					{
						num = Readings[i].Time;
						num3 = Readings[i].Position.X;
						num4 = Readings[i].Position.Y;
					}
					if (Readings[i].Time > num2)
					{
						num2 = Readings[i].Time;
						num5 = Readings[i].Position.X;
						num6 = Readings[i].Position.Y;
					}
				}
			}
			double num8 = (double)Math.Max(num2 - num, 16) / 1000.0;
			if (num8 == 0.0)
			{
				return new Point(num3, num4);
			}
			return new Point((num5 - num3) / num8, (num6 - num4) / num8);
		}

		private long GetCurrentTime()
		{
			return DateTime.Now.Ticks / 10000;
		}

		private int GetEventTime()
		{
			int num = (int)(GetCurrentTime() - _beginning);
			if (num == _lastTimestamp)
			{
				num++;
			}
			_lastTimestamp = num;
			return num;
		}
	}
	internal interface IPageCandidatesSink
	{
		int[] TransformPage(int pageIndex);

		bool AddCandidate(int pageIndex, DataSourcePageRequestPriority priority);

		void RemoveCandidate(int pageIndex);
	}
	internal class SectionMap
	{
		private SectionData _searchTarget = new SectionData();

		private SectionDataStartIndexComparer _sectionComparer = new SectionDataStartIndexComparer();

		private SectionDataUndisplacedStartIndexComparer _sectionUndisplacedComparer = new SectionDataUndisplacedStartIndexComparer();

		private List<SectionData> _sectionInformation = new List<SectionData>();

		private SectionSearchData _getSectionSearchData = new SectionSearchData();

		private SectionSearchData _getSectionFromReadIndexSearchData = new SectionSearchData();

		public List<SectionData> Sections => _sectionInformation;

		public int FullCount => _sectionInformation[_sectionInformation.Count - 1].SectionEndIndex + 1;

		public bool HasSections => Sections.Count > 0;

		private bool CheckIndex(int searchIndex, int testIndex, SectionSearchData data)
		{
			if (searchIndex >= 0 && searchIndex < _sectionInformation.Count)
			{
				SectionData sectionData = _sectionInformation[searchIndex];
				if (testIndex >= sectionData.SectionStartIndex && testIndex <= sectionData.SectionEndIndex)
				{
					data.LastFoundSectionBufferIndex++;
					if (data.LastFoundSectionBufferIndex >= data.LastFoundSection.Length)
					{
						data.LastFoundSectionBufferIndex = 0;
					}
					data.LastFoundSectionIndex[data.LastFoundSectionBufferIndex] = searchIndex;
					data.LastFoundSection[data.LastFoundSectionBufferIndex] = sectionData;
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool CheckRealIndex(int searchIndex, int testIndex, SectionSearchData data)
		{
			if (searchIndex >= 0 && searchIndex < _sectionInformation.Count)
			{
				SectionData sectionData = _sectionInformation[searchIndex];
				if ((testIndex >= sectionData.RealSectionStartIndex && testIndex <= sectionData.RealSectionEndIndex) || (!sectionData.IsSectionContentVisible && testIndex >= sectionData.RealSectionStartIndex))
				{
					data.LastFoundSectionBufferIndex++;
					if (data.LastFoundSectionBufferIndex >= data.LastFoundSection.Length)
					{
						data.LastFoundSectionBufferIndex = 0;
					}
					data.LastFoundSectionIndex[data.LastFoundSectionBufferIndex] = searchIndex;
					data.LastFoundSection[data.LastFoundSectionBufferIndex] = sectionData;
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public SectionData GetSection(int index)
		{
			return GetSection(index, _sectionComparer, _getSectionSearchData);
		}

		private SectionData GetSection(int index, IComparer<SectionData> comparer, SectionSearchData data)
		{
			if (data.LastFoundSection == null)
			{
				data.LastFoundSection = new SectionData[5];
				data.LastFoundSectionIndex = new int[5];
				for (int i = 0; i < data.LastFoundSection.Length; i++)
				{
					data.LastFoundSection[i] = null;
					data.LastFoundSectionIndex[i] = -1;
				}
			}
			if (data.LastFoundSection[data.LastFoundSectionBufferIndex] != null)
			{
				if (index >= data.LastFoundSection[data.LastFoundSectionBufferIndex].SectionStartIndex && index <= data.LastFoundSection[data.LastFoundSectionBufferIndex].SectionEndIndex)
				{
					return data.LastFoundSection[data.LastFoundSectionBufferIndex];
				}
				for (int j = 0; j < data.LastFoundSection.Length; j++)
				{
					if (data.LastFoundSection[j] != null && index >= data.LastFoundSection[j].SectionStartIndex && index <= data.LastFoundSection[j].SectionEndIndex)
					{
						data.LastFoundSectionBufferIndex = j;
						return data.LastFoundSection[data.LastFoundSectionBufferIndex];
					}
				}
				int searchIndex = data.LastFoundSectionIndex[data.LastFoundSectionBufferIndex] + 1;
				if (CheckIndex(searchIndex, index, data))
				{
					return data.LastFoundSection[data.LastFoundSectionBufferIndex];
				}
				searchIndex = data.LastFoundSectionIndex[data.LastFoundSectionBufferIndex] - 1;
				if (CheckIndex(searchIndex, index, data))
				{
					return data.LastFoundSection[data.LastFoundSectionBufferIndex];
				}
			}
			_searchTarget.SectionStartIndex = index;
			int num = _sectionInformation.BinarySearch(_searchTarget, comparer);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				num = ~num;
				num--;
			}
			if (CheckIndex(num, index, data))
			{
				return data.LastFoundSection[data.LastFoundSectionBufferIndex];
			}
			if (CheckIndex(num + 1, index, data))
			{
				return data.LastFoundSection[data.LastFoundSectionBufferIndex];
			}
			if (CheckIndex(num - 1, index, data))
			{
				return data.LastFoundSection[data.LastFoundSectionBufferIndex];
			}
			return null;
		}

		private SectionData GetSectionFromRealIndex(int index, IComparer<SectionData> comparer, SectionSearchData data)
		{
			if (data.LastFoundSection == null)
			{
				data.LastFoundSection = new SectionData[5];
				data.LastFoundSectionIndex = new int[5];
				for (int i = 0; i < data.LastFoundSection.Length; i++)
				{
					data.LastFoundSection[i] = null;
					data.LastFoundSectionIndex[i] = -1;
				}
			}
			if (data.LastFoundSection[data.LastFoundSectionBufferIndex] != null)
			{
				SectionData sectionData = data.LastFoundSection[data.LastFoundSectionBufferIndex];
				if (index >= sectionData.RealSectionStartIndex && index <= sectionData.RealSectionEndIndex)
				{
					return sectionData;
				}
				for (int j = 0; j < data.LastFoundSection.Length; j++)
				{
					if (data.LastFoundSection[j] != null && index >= data.LastFoundSection[j].RealSectionStartIndex && index <= data.LastFoundSection[j].RealSectionEndIndex)
					{
						data.LastFoundSectionBufferIndex = j;
						return data.LastFoundSection[data.LastFoundSectionBufferIndex];
					}
				}
				int searchIndex = data.LastFoundSectionIndex[data.LastFoundSectionBufferIndex] + 1;
				if (CheckRealIndex(searchIndex, index, data))
				{
					return data.LastFoundSection[data.LastFoundSectionBufferIndex];
				}
				searchIndex = data.LastFoundSectionIndex[data.LastFoundSectionBufferIndex] - 1;
				if (CheckRealIndex(searchIndex, index, data))
				{
					return data.LastFoundSection[data.LastFoundSectionBufferIndex];
				}
			}
			_searchTarget.SectionStartIndex = index;
			int num = _sectionInformation.BinarySearch(_searchTarget, comparer);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				num = ~num;
				num--;
			}
			if (CheckRealIndex(num, index, data))
			{
				return data.LastFoundSection[data.LastFoundSectionBufferIndex];
			}
			if (CheckRealIndex(num + 1, index, data))
			{
				return data.LastFoundSection[data.LastFoundSectionBufferIndex];
			}
			if (CheckRealIndex(num - 1, index, data))
			{
				return data.LastFoundSection[data.LastFoundSectionBufferIndex];
			}
			return null;
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			_sectionInformation.Clear();
			_getSectionSearchData.LastFoundSection = null;
			_getSectionFromReadIndexSearchData.LastFoundSection = null;
		}

		public void OffsetSucceedingSections(SectionData section, int offset, int firstRowDisplacementOffset)
		{
			for (int i = section.SectionIndex + 1; i < _sectionInformation.Count; i++)
			{
				SectionData sectionData = _sectionInformation[i];
				sectionData.FirstRowDisplacement += firstRowDisplacementOffset;
				sectionData.SectionStartIndex += offset;
				sectionData.SectionEndIndex += offset;
				for (int j = 0; j < sectionData.SummaryLocations.Length; j++)
				{
					if (sectionData.SummaryLocations[j] != -1)
					{
						sectionData.SummaryLocations[j] += offset;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public void OffsetSucceedingFromRemovedSection(SectionData section, int offset, int firstRowDisplacementOffset)
		{
			for (int i = section.SectionIndex; i < _sectionInformation.Count; i++)
			{
				SectionData sectionData = _sectionInformation[i];
				sectionData.FirstRowDisplacement += firstRowDisplacementOffset;
				sectionData.SectionStartIndex += offset;
				sectionData.SectionEndIndex += offset;
				sectionData.SectionIndex = i;
				if (sectionData.ParentSection > section.SectionIndex)
				{
					sectionData.ParentSection--;
				}
				for (int j = 0; j < sectionData.SummaryLocations.Length; j++)
				{
					if (sectionData.SummaryLocations[j] != -1)
					{
						sectionData.SummaryLocations[j] += offset;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public void EndSection(int i)
		{
			if (_sectionInformation.Count != 0)
			{
				_sectionInformation[_sectionInformation.Count - 1].SectionEndIndex = i;
			}
		}

		internal SectionData StartSection(int i, IDataSource dataSource, object currRepresentative, string[] groupNames, DataSourceSectionHeaderDisplayMode groupingMode, bool defaultExpansionState)
		{
			SectionData sectionData = GenerateSection(dataSource, currRepresentative, groupNames, groupingMode, defaultExpansionState);
			sectionData.SectionStartIndex = i;
			sectionData.SectionIndex = _sectionInformation.Count;
			if (_sectionInformation.Count > 0)
			{
				sectionData.FirstRowDisplacement = _sectionInformation[_sectionInformation.Count - 1].FirstRowDisplacement;
			}
			_sectionInformation.Add(sectionData);
			return sectionData;
		}

		public SectionData GenerateSection(IDataSource dataSource, object currRepresentative, string[] groupNames, DataSourceSectionHeaderDisplayMode groupingMode, bool defaultExpansionState)
		{
			SectionData sectionData = new SectionData();
			sectionData.SectionKeyNames = groupNames;
			sectionData.RowCount = new int[groupNames.Length];
			object[] array = new object[groupNames.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				sectionData.RowCount[i] = 0;
				array[i] = dataSource.GetItemProperty(currRepresentative, groupNames[i]);
			}
			sectionData.SectionKeyValues = array;
			sectionData.InitializeExpandedStates(groupingMode, defaultExpansionState);
			int num = ((groupingMode != DataSourceSectionHeaderDisplayMode.Split) ? 1 : groupNames.Length);
			sectionData.HeaderOffsets = new int[num];
			sectionData.SummaryLocations = new int[num];
			sectionData.SummaryResults2 = new ISummaryResult[num][];
			for (int j = 0; j < num; j++)
			{
				sectionData.SummaryLocations[j] = -1;
				sectionData.SummaryResults2[j] = new ISummaryResult[dataSource.SummaryDescriptions.All.Count];
			}
			sectionData.SummaryGroups = new SummaryGroup[groupNames.Length];
			return sectionData;
		}

		public void OffsetSucceedingSectionsFromNewSection(SectionData sectionData, int offset, int firstRowDisplacementOffset)
		{
			for (int i = sectionData.SectionIndex + 1; i < _sectionInformation.Count; i++)
			{
				_sectionInformation[i].SectionIndex = i;
				_sectionInformation[i].FirstRowDisplacement += firstRowDisplacementOffset;
				_sectionInformation[i].SectionStartIndex += offset;
				_sectionInformation[i].SectionEndIndex += offset;
				for (int j = 0; j < _sectionInformation[i].SummaryLocations.Length; j++)
				{
					if (_sectionInformation[i].SummaryLocations[j] != -1)
					{
						_sectionInformation[i].SummaryLocations[j] += offset;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public void InsertSection(int insertIndex, SectionData sectionData)
		{
			_sectionInformation.Insert(insertIndex, sectionData);
		}

		public void RemoveSection(int sectionIndex)
		{
			if (_getSectionSearchData != null)
			{
				SectionSearchData getSectionSearchData = _getSectionSearchData;
				ClearLastFoundSection(sectionIndex, getSectionSearchData);
			}
			if (_getSectionFromReadIndexSearchData != null)
			{
				SectionSearchData getSectionFromReadIndexSearchData = _getSectionFromReadIndexSearchData;
				ClearLastFoundSection(sectionIndex, getSectionFromReadIndexSearchData);
			}
			_sectionInformation[sectionIndex].IsRemoved = true;
			_sectionInformation.RemoveAt(sectionIndex);
		}

		private static void ClearLastFoundSection(int sectionIndex, SectionSearchData searchData)
		{
			if (searchData.LastFoundSection == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < searchData.LastFoundSection.Length; i++)
			{
				if (searchData.LastFoundSection[i] != null && searchData.LastFoundSection[i].SectionIndex == sectionIndex)
				{
					searchData.LastFoundSection[i] = null;
				}
			}
		}

		public SectionData GetLastSection()
		{
			return _sectionInformation[_sectionInformation.Count - 1];
		}

		public SectionData GetFirstSection()
		{
			return _sectionInformation[0];
		}

		public void IncrementFirstRowDisplacement()
		{
			_sectionInformation[_sectionInformation.Count - 1].FirstRowDisplacement++;
		}

		public SectionData GetSectionFromRealIndex(int index)
		{
			return GetSectionFromRealIndex(index, _sectionUndisplacedComparer, _getSectionFromReadIndexSearchData);
		}

		public bool HasChildren(SectionData section)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < Sections.Count; i++)
			{
				if (i != section.SectionIndex && Sections[i].ParentSection == section.SectionIndex)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void IncrementRowCount(SectionData section, int amount)
		{
			if (section.SectionKeyNames == null)
			{
				section.RowCount[0] += amount;
				return;
			}
			if (section.ParentSection == -1)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < section.SectionKeyNames.Length; i++)
				{
					section.RowCount[i] += amount;
				}
				return;
			}
			section.GetLevel();
			for (int j = section.GetLevel(); j < section.SectionKeyNames.Length; j++)
			{
				section.RowCount[j] += amount;
			}
			int parentSection = section.ParentSection;
			while (parentSection >= 0)
			{
				SectionData sectionData = Sections[parentSection];
				int level = sectionData.GetLevel();
				sectionData.RowCount[level] += amount;
				parentSection = sectionData.ParentSection;
			}
		}

		public void UpdateHierarchyForInsertedSection(SectionData section, bool insertBefore)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < section.SectionIndex; i++)
			{
				SectionData sectionData = _sectionInformation[i];
				for (int j = 0; j < section.SectionKeyNames.Length; j++)
				{
					if (sectionData.HeaderExpansionKeys[j] != null && (sectionData.SectionKeyValues[j] == section.SectionKeyValues[j] || sectionData.SectionKeyValues[j].Equals(section.SectionKeyValues[j])))
					{
						section.ParentSection = i;
						section.HeaderExpansionKeys[j] = null;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public bool IsVisible(SectionData section)
		{
			int level = section.GetLevel();
			if (level == 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			SectionData sectionData = _sectionInformation[section.ParentSection];
			for (int num = level - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				if (!sectionData.HeaderStates[num])
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return IsVisible(sectionData);
		}
	}
	internal class SectionSearchData

		public SectionData[] LastFoundSection { get; internal set; }

		public int LastFoundSectionBufferIndex { get; internal set; }

		public int[] LastFoundSectionIndex { get; internal set; }
	}
	internal class RearrangedListView : ISupportsDataChangeNotifications

		private SummaryCalculator[] _rootSummaryCalculators;

		private IComparer<object> _sortComparer;

		private IComparer<object> _groupComparer;

		private ISupportsExpansionChangeNotifications _expansionNotifier;

		private DataSourceSummaryScope _summaryScope;

		private List<object[]> _pinnedKeys = new List<object[]>();

		private Dictionary<string, bool> _expansionStates = new Dictionary<string, bool>();

		public int RootSummaryRowCount => _rootSummaryRowCount;

		public IList View => _view;

					return false;

				if (IsSectionCollapsable)
				{
					return DataSource.IsSectionExpandedDefault;
				}
				return true;
			}

		public List<SectionData> Sections => _sectionMap.Sections;

		public bool ShouldEmitSectionFooters { get; internal set; }

		}

		}

		public void Refresh()
		{
			if (_view == _source || _view == null)
			{
				_view = new List<object>();
			}
			_view.Clear();
			if (!IsSectionCollapsable)
			{
				_expansionStates.Clear();
			}
			if (_source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int actualCount = _source.ActualCount;
			_rootSummaryRowCount = 0;
			_summaryRowCount = GetSummaryRowCount();
			BeginSummaries(null);
			bool flag = SummaryDescriptions.All.Count > 0 && SummaryScope != DataSourceSummaryScope.Groups && SummaryScope != DataSourceSummaryScope.None;
			if (_filter == null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < actualCount; i++)
				{
					object itemAtIndex = _source.GetItemAtIndex(i);
					_view.Add(itemAtIndex);
					if (flag)
					{
						AggregateItem(null, itemAtIndex);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < actualCount; j++)
				{
					object itemAtIndex2 = _source.GetItemAtIndex(j);
					if (_filter(itemAtIndex2))
					{
						_view.Add(itemAtIndex2);
						if (flag)
						{
							AggregateItem(null, itemAtIndex2);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			EndSummaries(null);
			if (_sortComparer != null)
			{
				_view.Sort(_sortComparer);
			}
			_hasSections = false;
			_sectionMap.Clear();
			if (GroupDescriptions != null && GroupDescriptions.All.Count > 0)
			{
				_hasSections = true;
				InsertVirtualRows();
			}
			else
			{
				_sectionMap.Sections.Add(new SectionData
				{
					SectionIndex = 0,
					SectionKeyNames = null,
					SectionKeyValues = null,
					SectionStartIndex = 0,
					SectionEndIndex = _view.Count,
					HeaderStates = new bool[0],
					RowCount = new int[1]
				});
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				InjectRootSummaryRows(_summaryResults);
			}
			_ = PrimaryKeyComparer;
			new List<object>();
			if (_pinnedKeys.Count > 0 && ShouldEmitShiftedRows)
			{
				if (!_hasSections)
				{
					SectionData section = _sectionMap.Sections[0];
					for (int k = 0; k < _pinnedKeys.Count; k++)
					{
						int num = DataSource.IndexOfKey(_pinnedKeys[k]);
						if (num != -1)
						{
							InjectSortedShiftedRow(section, _view[num], k);
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					for (int l = 0; l < _pinnedKeys.Count; l++)
					{
						int num2 = DataSource.IndexOfKey(_pinnedKeys[l]);
						if (num2 != -1)
						{
							SectionData section2 = _sectionMap.GetSection(num2);
							InjectSortedShiftedRow(section2, _view[num2], l);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (UpdateNotifier != null)
			{
				UpdateNotifier.NotifyClearItems();
			}
		}

		private object GetFirstOrLastItemInSection(SectionData section, bool first)
		{
			object result = null;
			if (section.IsSectionContentVisible)
			{
				if (first)
				{
					int index = section.SectionStartIndex + section.GetHeaderCount() + section.SummaryTopCount + section.PinnedCount;
					result = _view[index];
				}
				else
				{
					int index2 = section.SectionEndIndex - section.FooterCount - section.SummaryBottomCount;
					result = _view[index2];
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void InsertVirtualRows()
		{
			if (_view.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			_ = DateTime.Now;
			string[] groupNames = GetGroupNames();
			string[] sectionNames = GetSectionNames();
			int num = ((SectionHeaderDisplayMode != DataSourceSectionHeaderDisplayMode.Split) ? 1 : sectionNames.Length);
			if (_previousSectionsCache == null || _previousSectionsCache.Length != sectionNames.Length)
			{
				_previousHeaderCache = new DataSourceSpecialRow[num];
				_previousSectionsCache = new SectionData[num];
			}
			_previousSummaryCalculators = new SummaryCalculator[num][];
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				_previousSummaryCalculators[i] = new SummaryCalculator[SummaryDescriptions.All.Count];
			}
			bool flag = SummaryScope == DataSourceSummaryScope.None || SummaryScope == DataSourceSummaryScope.Root;
			List<object> list = new List<object>();
			object obj = null;
			object obj2 = null;
			if (DataSource.IsSectionContentVisible || !ShouldEmitSectionHeaders)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < _view.Count; j++)
				{
					object obj3 = _view[j];
					if (obj3 == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (obj == null)
					{
						SectionData sectionData = StartSection(j, obj3, sectionNames);
						j += InjectHeaders(sectionData, j, groupNames, sectionNames, useCache: true);
						BuildSectionHierarchy(sectionData, initial: true, flag);
						_sectionMap.IncrementRowCount(sectionData, 1);
						AggregateItem(sectionData, obj3);
						obj2 = obj3;
					}
					else if (GroupComparer.Compare(obj, obj3) != 0)
					{
						if (_sectionMap.Sections[_sectionMap.Sections.Count - 1].IsSectionVisible)
						{
							j += InjectFooters(j, obj2, groupNames, sectionNames);
						}
						EndSection(j - 1, obj2, groupNames);
						SectionData sectionData2 = StartSection(j, obj3, sectionNames);
						BuildSectionHierarchy(sectionData2, initial: false, flag);
						int num2 = InjectHeaders(sectionData2, j, groupNames, sectionNames, useCache: true);
						j += num2;
						sectionData2.IsSectionVisible = _sectionMap.IsVisible(sectionData2);
						_sectionMap.IncrementRowCount(sectionData2, 1);
						AggregateItem(sectionData2, obj3);
						obj2 = obj3;
					}
					else
					{
						SectionData section = _sectionMap.Sections[_sectionMap.Sections.Count - 1];
						_sectionMap.IncrementRowCount(section, 1);
						AggregateItem(section, obj3);
					}
					if (j == _view.Count - 1)
					{
						if (_sectionMap.Sections[_sectionMap.Sections.Count - 1].IsSectionVisible)
						{
							j += InjectFooters(j + 1, obj2, groupNames, sectionNames);
						}
						EndSection(j, obj2, groupNames);
					}
					obj = obj3;
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					if (SectionHeaderDisplayMode == DataSourceSectionHeaderDisplayMode.Split)
					{
						for (int k = 0; k < sectionNames.Length; k++)
						{
							for (int l = 0; l < SummaryDescriptions.All.Count; l++)
							{
								_previousSectionsCache[k].SummaryResults2[k][l] = _previousSummaryCalculators[k][l].EndCalculation();
								_previousSectionsCache[k].SummaryResults2[k][l].SummaryIndex = l;
							}
							for (int m = 0; m < _previousSectionsCache[k].SummaryLocations.Length; m++)
							{
								if (_previousSectionsCache[k].SummaryLocations[m] == -1)
								{
									_previousSectionsCache[k].SummaryLocations[m] = _sectionMap.Sections[_sectionMap.Sections.Count - 1].SectionEndIndex + 1;
								}
							}
						}
					}
					else
					{
						for (int n = 0; n < SummaryDescriptions.All.Count; n++)
						{
							_previousSectionsCache[0].SummaryResults2[0][n] = _previousSummaryCalculators[0][n].EndCalculation();
							_previousSectionsCache[0].SummaryResults2[0][n].SummaryIndex = n;
						}
						_previousSectionsCache[0].SummaryLocations[0] = _sectionMap.Sections[_sectionMap.Sections.Count - 1].SectionEndIndex + 1;
					}
				}
				InjectSectionSummaries();
				for (int num3 = 0; num3 < _sectionMap.Sections.Count; num3++)
				{
					SectionData sectionData3 = _sectionMap.Sections[num3];
					if (!ShouldEmitSectionHeaders)
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (!sectionData3.IsSectionVisible)
					{
						int num4 = sectionData3.SectionEndIndex - sectionData3.SectionStartIndex + 1;
						if (SectionHeaderDisplayMode == DataSourceSectionHeaderDisplayMode.Split && GroupDescriptions.All.Count > 1 && IncludeSummaryRowsInSection && IsSectionSummaryRowsAtBottom)
						{
							sectionData3.GetLevel();
							bool flag2 = false;
							if (num3 + 1 < _sectionMap.Sections.Count && _sectionMap.Sections[num3 + 1].GetLevel() == 0)
							{
								flag2 = true;
							}
							if (flag2)
							{
								num4 = sectionData3.GetHeaderCount() + sectionData3.RowCount[sectionData3.RowCount.Length - 1];
							}
						}
						_view.RemoveRange(sectionData3.SectionStartIndex, num4);
						_sectionMap.RemoveSection(sectionData3.SectionIndex);
						_sectionMap.OffsetSucceedingFromRemovedSection(sectionData3, -num4, -num4);
						num3--;
					}
					else
					{
						if (sectionData3.IsSectionContentVisible)
						{
							continue;
						}
						int num5 = 0;
						for (int num6 = sectionData3.GetLevel(); num6 < sectionData3.HeaderStates.Length; num6++)
						{
							num5 = sectionData3.HeaderOffsets[num6];
							if (!sectionData3.HeaderStates[num6])
							{
								break;
							}
						}
						int index = sectionData3.SectionStartIndex + num5 + 1;
						int num7 = sectionData3.RowCount[sectionData3.RowCount.Length - 1];
						_view.RemoveRange(index, num7);
						sectionData3.SectionEndIndex -= num7;
						_sectionMap.OffsetSucceedingSections(sectionData3, -num7, -num7);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				for (int num8 = 0; num8 < _view.Count; num8++)
				{
					object obj4 = _view[num8];
					if (obj4 != null)
					{
						if (obj == null)
						{
							SectionData sectionData4 = StartSection(num8, obj4, sectionNames);
							InjectHeaders(list, sectionData4, obj4, groupNames, sectionNames, useCache: true);
							BuildSectionHierarchy(sectionData4, initial: true, flag);
							_sectionMap.IncrementRowCount(sectionData4, 1);
							AggregateItem(sectionData4, obj4);
							obj2 = obj4;
						}
						else if (GroupComparer.Compare(obj, obj4) != 0)
						{
							_ = _sectionMap.Sections[_sectionMap.Sections.Count - 1];
							EndSection(list.Count - 1, obj2, groupNames);
							SectionData sectionData5 = StartSection(num8, obj4, sectionNames);
							BuildSectionHierarchy(sectionData5, initial: false, flag);
							InjectHeaders(list, sectionData5, obj4, groupNames, sectionNames, useCache: true);
							sectionData5.IsSectionVisible = _sectionMap.IsVisible(sectionData5);
							_sectionMap.IncrementRowCount(sectionData5, 1);
							AggregateItem(sectionData5, obj4);
							obj2 = obj4;
						}
						else
						{
							SectionData section2 = _sectionMap.Sections[_sectionMap.Sections.Count - 1];
							_sectionMap.IncrementRowCount(section2, 1);
							AggregateItem(section2, obj4);
						}
						if (num8 == _view.Count - 1)
						{
							_ = _sectionMap.Sections[_sectionMap.Sections.Count - 1];
							EndSection(num8, obj2, groupNames);
						}
						obj = obj4;
					}
				}
				_view = list;
			}
			for (int num9 = 0; num9 < _previousSectionsCache.Length; num9++)
			{
				_previousHeaderCache[num9] = null;
				_previousSectionsCache[num9] = null;
			}
			_previousSummaryCalculators = null;
			_ = DateTime.Now;
		}

		private void BuildSectionHierarchy(SectionData currentSection, bool initial, bool ignoreSummaries)
		{
			if (initial)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < _previousSectionsCache.Length; i++)
				{
					_previousSectionsCache[i] = currentSection;
					if (!ignoreSummaries)
					{
						for (int j = 0; j < SummaryDescriptions.All.Count; j++)
						{
							SummaryDescription summaryDescription = SummaryDescriptions.All[j];
							_previousSummaryCalculators[i][j] = summaryDescription.GetCalculator();
							_previousSummaryCalculators[i][j].BeginCalculation(DataSource, summaryDescription.PropertyName);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (SectionHeaderDisplayMode == DataSourceSectionHeaderDisplayMode.Split)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				int num = currentSection.SectionKeyNames.Length;
				for (int k = 0; k < num; k++)
				{
					if (flag)
					{
						if (!ignoreSummaries)
						{
							for (int l = 0; l < SummaryDescriptions.All.Count; l++)
							{
								_previousSectionsCache[k].SummaryResults2[k][l] = _previousSummaryCalculators[k][l].EndCalculation();
								_previousSectionsCache[k].SummaryResults2[k][l].SummaryIndex = l;
								_previousSummaryCalculators[k][l].BeginCalculation(DataSource, SummaryDescriptions.All[l].PropertyName);
							}
							_previousSectionsCache[k].SummaryLocations[k] = currentSection.SectionStartIndex;
						}
						_previousSectionsCache[k] = currentSection;
						continue;
					}
					bool flag2 = false;
					if (!((_previousSectionsCache[k].SectionKeyValues[k] != null) ? (!_previousSectionsCache[k].SectionKeyValues[k].Equals(currentSection.SectionKeyValues[k])) : (currentSection.SectionKeyValues[k] != null)))
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (!ignoreSummaries)
					{
						for (int m = 0; m < SummaryDescriptions.All.Count; m++)
						{
							_previousSectionsCache[k].SummaryResults2[k][m] = _previousSummaryCalculators[k][m].EndCalculation();
							_previousSectionsCache[k].SummaryResults2[k][m].SummaryIndex = m;
							_previousSummaryCalculators[k][m].BeginCalculation(DataSource, SummaryDescriptions.All[m].PropertyName);
						}
						_previousSectionsCache[k].SummaryLocations[k] = currentSection.SectionStartIndex;
					}
					_previousSectionsCache[k] = currentSection;
					if (k - 1 > -1)
					{
						int num2 = k - 1;
						while (num2 >= 0 && _previousSectionsCache[num2].IsRemoved)
						{
							num2--;
						}
						currentSection.ParentSection = _previousSectionsCache[num2].SectionIndex;
					}
					flag = true;
				}
				return;
			}
			bool flag3 = false;
			for (int n = 0; n < currentSection.SectionKeyNames.Length; n++)
			{
				if (_previousSectionsCache[0].SectionKeyValues[n] == null)
				{
					if (_previousSectionsCache[0].SectionKeyValues[n] != currentSection.SectionKeyValues[n])
					{
						flag3 = true;
						break;
					}
				}
				else if (!_previousSectionsCache[0].SectionKeyValues[n].Equals(currentSection.SectionKeyValues[n]))
				{
					flag3 = true;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (!flag3)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!ignoreSummaries)
			{
				for (int num3 = 0; num3 < SummaryDescriptions.All.Count; num3++)
				{
					_previousSectionsCache[0].SummaryResults2[0][num3] = _previousSummaryCalculators[0][num3].EndCalculation();
					_previousSectionsCache[0].SummaryResults2[0][num3].SummaryIndex = num3;
					_previousSummaryCalculators[0][num3].BeginCalculation(DataSource, SummaryDescriptions.All[num3].PropertyName);
				}
				_previousSectionsCache[0].SummaryLocations[0] = currentSection.SectionStartIndex;
			}
			_previousSectionsCache[0] = currentSection;
		}

		internal int GetSummaryRowCount()
		{
			int num = 0;
			Dictionary<string, int> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, int>();
			for (int i = 0; i < SummaryDescriptions.All.Count; i++)
			{
				string propertyName = SummaryDescriptions.All[i].PropertyName;
				if (!dictionary.ContainsKey(propertyName))
				{
					dictionary.Add(propertyName, 1);
				}
				else
				{
					dictionary[propertyName]++;
				}
				if (dictionary[propertyName] > num)
				{
					num = dictionary[propertyName];
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		private int InjectHeaders(List<object> view, SectionData section, object representative, string[] groupNames, string[] sectionNames, bool useCache)
		{
			int num = 0;
			if (ShouldEmitSectionHeaders)
			{
				if (DataSource.SectionHeaderDisplayMode == DataSourceSectionHeaderDisplayMode.Combined)
				{
					if (InjectHeader(view, 0, representative, groupNames, sectionNames, useCache))
					{
						_sectionMap.IncrementFirstRowDisplacement();
						num++;
						if (section != null)
						{
							string text = CombineSectionKeysAndValues(section);
							section.HeaderExpansionKeys[0] = text;
							section.HeaderStates[0] = GetSectionExpansionState(text);
							section.HeaderOffsets[0] = view.Count - 1 - section.SectionStartIndex;
						}
					}
				}
				else if (DataSource.SectionHeaderDisplayMode == DataSourceSectionHeaderDisplayMode.Split)
				{
					int i = 0;
					int num2 = 0;
					for (; i < sectionNames.Length; i++)
					{
						int num3 = view.Count + num2;
						if (!InjectHeader(view, i, representative, groupNames, new string[1] { sectionNames[i] }, useCache))
						{
							continue;
						}
						num++;
						_sectionMap.IncrementFirstRowDisplacement();
						if (section != null)
						{
							string text2 = CombineSectionKeysAndValues(section, i);
							section.HeaderExpansionKeys[i] = text2;
							section.HeaderStates[i] = GetSectionExpansionState(text2);
							section.HeaderOffsets[i] = num3 - section.SectionStartIndex;
							if (!section.HeaderStates[i])
							{
								break;
							}
						}
						else if (!IsSectionExpandedDefault)
						{
							break;
						}
						num2++;
					}
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		private int InjectHeaders(SectionData section, int i, string[] groupNames, string[] sectionNames, bool useCache)
		{
			int num = 0;
			if (ShouldEmitSectionHeaders)
			{
				object currRepresentative = _view[i];
				if (DataSource.SectionHeaderDisplayMode == DataSourceSectionHeaderDisplayMode.Combined)
				{
					if (InjectHeader(i, 0, currRepresentative, groupNames, sectionNames, useCache))
					{
						_sectionMap.IncrementFirstRowDisplacement();
						num++;
						if (section != null)
						{
							string text = CombineSectionKeysAndValues(section);
							section.HeaderExpansionKeys[0] = text;
							section.HeaderStates[0] = GetSectionExpansionState(text);
							section.HeaderOffsets[0] = i - section.SectionStartIndex;
						}
					}
				}
				else if (DataSource.SectionHeaderDisplayMode == DataSourceSectionHeaderDisplayMode.Split)
				{
					int j = 0;
					int num2 = 0;
					for (; j < sectionNames.Length; j++)
					{
						int num3 = i + num2;
						if (!InjectHeader(num3, j, currRepresentative, groupNames, new string[1] { sectionNames[j] }, useCache))
						{
							continue;
						}
						num++;
						_sectionMap.IncrementFirstRowDisplacement();
						if (section != null)
						{
							string text2 = CombineSectionKeysAndValues(section, j);
							section.HeaderExpansionKeys[j] = text2;
							section.HeaderStates[j] = GetSectionExpansionState(text2);
							section.HeaderOffsets[j] = num3 - section.SectionStartIndex;
							if (!section.HeaderStates[j])
							{
								break;
							}
						}
						else if (!IsSectionExpandedDefault)
						{
							break;
						}
						num2++;
					}
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		private bool InjectHeader(int i, int level, object currRepresentative, string[] groupNames, string[] sectionNames, bool useCache)
		{
			DataSourceSpecialRow dataSourceSpecialRow = new DataSourceSpecialRow();
			dataSourceSpecialRow.Level = level;
			for (int j = 0; j < groupNames.Length; j++)
			{
				dataSourceSpecialRow.SetValue(groupNames[j], DataSource.GetItemProperty(currRepresentative, groupNames[j]));
				if (j < sectionNames.Length)
				{
					dataSourceSpecialRow.SetSectionValue(sectionNames[j], DataSource.GetItemProperty(currRepresentative, sectionNames[j]));
				}
			}
			dataSourceSpecialRow.RowType = DataSourceRowType.SectionHeader;
			dataSourceSpecialRow.SummaryResults = new ISummaryResult[SummaryDescriptions.All.Count];
			if (useCache && _previousHeaderCache != null)
			{
				if (_previousHeaderCache[level] != null)
				{
					if (_previousHeaderCache[level].IsHeaderSame(dataSourceSpecialRow))
					{
						return false;
					}
					_previousHeaderCache[level] = dataSourceSpecialRow;
					for (int k = level + 1; k < _previousHeaderCache.Length; k++)
					{
						_previousHeaderCache[k] = null;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					_previousHeaderCache[level] = dataSourceSpecialRow;
				}
			}
			_view.Insert(i, dataSourceSpecialRow);
			return true;
		}

		private bool InjectHeader(List<object> view, int level, object currRepresentative, string[] groupNames, string[] sectionNames, bool useCache)
		{
			DataSourceSpecialRow dataSourceSpecialRow = new DataSourceSpecialRow();
			dataSourceSpecialRow.Level = level;
			for (int i = 0; i < groupNames.Length; i++)
			{
				dataSourceSpecialRow.SetValue(groupNames[i], DataSource.GetItemProperty(currRepresentative, groupNames[i]));
				if (i < sectionNames.Length)
				{
					dataSourceSpecialRow.SetSectionValue(sectionNames[i], DataSource.GetItemProperty(currRepresentative, sectionNames[i]));
				}
			}
			dataSourceSpecialRow.RowType = DataSourceRowType.SectionHeader;
			dataSourceSpecialRow.SummaryResults = new ISummaryResult[SummaryDescriptions.All.Count];
			if (useCache && _previousHeaderCache != null)
			{
				if (_previousHeaderCache[level] != null)
				{
					if (_previousHeaderCache[level].IsHeaderSame(dataSourceSpecialRow))
					{
						return false;
					}
					_previousHeaderCache[level] = dataSourceSpecialRow;
					for (int j = level + 1; j < _previousHeaderCache.Length; j++)
					{
						_previousHeaderCache[j] = null;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					_previousHeaderCache[level] = dataSourceSpecialRow;
				}
			}
			view.Add(dataSourceSpecialRow);
			return true;
		}

		private int InjectFooters(int i, object item, string[] groupNames, string[] sectionNames)
		{
			int num = 0;
			if (ShouldEmitSectionFooters)
			{
				if (DataSource.SectionHeaderDisplayMode == DataSourceSectionHeaderDisplayMode.Combined)
				{
					InjectFooter(i, 0, item, groupNames, sectionNames);
					num++;
				}
				else if (DataSource.SectionHeaderDisplayMode == DataSourceSectionHeaderDisplayMode.Split)
				{
					for (int num2 = sectionNames.Length - 1; num2 >= 0; num2--)
					{
						if (_sectionMap.Sections[_sectionMap.Sections.Count - 1].HeaderStates[num2])
						{
							InjectFooter(i, num2, item, groupNames, new string[1] { sectionNames[num2] });
							i++;
							num++;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		private void InjectFooter(int i, int level, object currRepresentative, string[] groupNames, string[] sectionNames)
		{
			DataSourceSpecialRow dataSourceSpecialRow = new DataSourceSpecialRow();
			dataSourceSpecialRow.Level = level;
			for (int j = 0; j < groupNames.Length; j++)
			{
				dataSourceSpecialRow.SetValue(groupNames[j], DataSource.GetItemProperty(currRepresentative, groupNames[j]));
				if (j < sectionNames.Length)
				{
					dataSourceSpecialRow.SetSectionValue(sectionNames[j], DataSource.GetItemProperty(currRepresentative, sectionNames[j]));
				}
			}
			dataSourceSpecialRow.RowType = DataSourceRowType.SectionFooter;
			_view.Insert(i, dataSourceSpecialRow);
		}

		private DataSourceSpecialRow InjectSummaryRow(SectionData section, int i, ISummaryResult[] summaryResults)
		{
			DataSourceSpecialRow result = InjectSummaryRow(i, 0, summaryResults, DataSourceRowType.SummaryRowSection);
			if (IsSectionSummaryRowsAtBottom)
			{
				section.SummaryBottomCount++;
			}
			else
			{
				section.SummaryTopCount++;
			}
			section.SectionEndIndex++;
			_sectionMap.OffsetSucceedingSections(section, 1, 1);
			return result;
		}

		private DataSourceSpecialRow InjectSummaryRow(int i, int level, ISummaryResult[] summaryResults, DataSourceRowType rowType)
		{
			DataSourceSpecialRow dataSourceSpecialRow = new DataSourceSpecialRow
			{
				Level = level,
				RowType = rowType,
				SummaryResults = summaryResults
			};
			_view.Insert(i, dataSourceSpecialRow);
			return dataSourceSpecialRow;
		}

		private int InjectShiftedRowAtEnd(SectionData section, object targetRow, bool offset)
		{
			int headerCount = section.GetHeaderCount();
			int num = section.SectionStartIndex + section.SummaryTopCount + section.PinnedCount;
			if (ShouldEmitSectionHeaders)
			{
				num += headerCount;
			}
			InjectShiftedRowAtLocation(num, section.HeaderStates.Length, targetRow);
			section.PinnedCount++;
			section.SectionEndIndex++;
			section.FirstRowDisplacement++;
			if (offset)
			{
				_sectionMap.OffsetSucceedingSections(section, 1, 1);
			}
			return num;
		}

		private int InjectShiftedRowAtLocation(SectionData section, int location, object targetRow)
		{
			int headerCount = section.GetHeaderCount();
			if (ShouldEmitSectionHeaders)
			{
				location += headerCount;
			}
			InjectShiftedRowAtLocation(location, section.HeaderStates.Length, targetRow);
			section.PinnedCount++;
			section.SectionEndIndex++;
			section.FirstRowDisplacement++;
			_sectionMap.OffsetSucceedingSections(section, 1, 1);
			return location;
		}

		private int InjectShiftedRowAtLocation(int location, int level, object targetRow)
		{
			DataSourceSpecialRow dataSourceSpecialRow = new DataSourceSpecialRow();
			dataSourceSpecialRow.RowType = DataSourceRowType.ShiftedRow;
			dataSourceSpecialRow.TargetRow = targetRow;
			dataSourceSpecialRow.Level = level;
			_view.Insert(location, dataSourceSpecialRow);
			return location + 1;
		}

		private int InjectSortedShiftedRow(SectionData section, object targetRow)
		{
			int pinnedKeyIndex = -1;
			for (int i = 0; i < _pinnedKeys.Count; i++)
			{
				if (PrimaryKeyComparer.CompareToKey(targetRow, _pinnedKeys[i]) == 0)
				{
					pinnedKeyIndex = i;
					break;
				}
			}
			return InjectSortedShiftedRow(section, targetRow, pinnedKeyIndex);
		}

		private int InjectSortedShiftedRow(SectionData section, object targetRow, int pinnedKeyIndex)
		{
			int result = -1;
			if (pinnedKeyIndex != -1)
			{
				int sectionStartIndex = section.SectionStartIndex;
				int num = sectionStartIndex + section.PinnedCount;
				bool flag = false;
				for (int i = sectionStartIndex; i < num; i++)
				{
					int index = (ShouldEmitSectionHeaders ? (i + 1) : i);
					DataSourceSpecialRow dataSourceSpecialRow = _view[index] as DataSourceSpecialRow;
					if (dataSourceSpecialRow.TargetRow == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (_sortComparer != null)
					{
						int num2 = _sortComparer.Compare(targetRow, dataSourceSpecialRow.TargetRow);
						if (num2 == 0 || num2 < 0)
						{
							result = InjectShiftedRowAtLocation(section, i, targetRow);
							flag = true;
							break;
						}
						continue;
					}
					int num3 = -1;
					for (int j = 0; j < _pinnedKeys.Count; j++)
					{
						if (PrimaryKeyComparer.CompareToKey(dataSourceSpecialRow.TargetRow, _pinnedKeys[j]) == 0)
						{
							num3 = j;
							break;
						}
					}
					if (num3 > pinnedKeyIndex)
					{
						result = InjectShiftedRowAtLocation(section, i, targetRow);
						flag = true;
						break;
					}
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					result = InjectShiftedRowAtEnd(section, targetRow, offset: true);
					flag = true;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void InjectRootSummaryRows(ISummaryResult[] summaryResults)
		{
			List<Dictionary<string, ISummaryResult>> summaryRowsFromResults = SectionData.GetSummaryRowsFromResults(summaryResults);
			_rootSummaryRowCount = summaryRowsFromResults.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < summaryRowsFromResults.Count; i++)
			{
				ISummaryResult[] array = new ISummaryResult[summaryRowsFromResults[i].Count];
				summaryRowsFromResults[i].Values.CopyTo(array, 0);
				InjectSummaryRow(_view.Count, 0, array, DataSourceRowType.SummaryRowRoot);
			}
		}

		private void InjectSectionSummaries()
		{
			if (SummaryScope != DataSourceSummaryScope.Both && SummaryScope != DataSourceSummaryScope.Groups)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < _sectionMap.Sections.Count; i++)
			{
				SectionData sectionData = _sectionMap.Sections[i];
				if (!sectionData.IsSectionVisible)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (IncludeSummaryRowsInSection)
				{
					if (IsSectionSummaryRowsAtBottom)
					{
						InjectSectionSummariesBottom(sectionData, notify: false);
					}
					else
					{
						InjectSectionSummariesTop(sectionData, notify: false);
					}
					continue;
				}
				for (int j = 0; j < sectionData.SummaryResults2.Length; j++)
				{
					DataSourceSpecialRow dataSourceSpecialRow = (DataSourceSpecialRow)_view[sectionData.SectionStartIndex + sectionData.HeaderOffsets[j]];
					if (dataSourceSpecialRow != null)
					{
						dataSourceSpecialRow.SummaryResults = sectionData.SummaryResults2[j];
					}
					if (!sectionData.HeaderStates[j])
					{
						break;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void InjectSectionSummariesTop(SectionData section, bool notify)
		{
			int num = 0;
			object firstOrLastItemInSection = GetFirstOrLastItemInSection(section, !IsSectionSummaryRowsAtBottom);
			for (int i = 0; i < section.SummaryResults2.Length; i++)
			{
				if (section.HeaderExpansionKeys[i] == null || !section.HeaderStates[i])
				{
					continue;
				}
				List<Dictionary<string, ISummaryResult>> summaryRowsFromResults = SectionData.GetSummaryRowsFromResults(section.SummaryResults2[i]);
				if (ShouldEmitSectionHeaders)
				{
					num++;
				}
				section.SummaryGroups[i] = new SummaryGroup();
				section.SummaryGroups[i].Summaries = new DataSourceSpecialRow[_summaryRowCount];
				for (int j = 0; j < summaryRowsFromResults.Count; j++)
				{
					ISummaryResult[] array = new ISummaryResult[summaryRowsFromResults[j].Count];
					summaryRowsFromResults[j].Values.CopyTo(array, 0);
					int num2 = section.SectionStartIndex + num + j;
					DataSourceSpecialRow dataSourceSpecialRow = InjectSummaryRow(num2, i + 1, array, DataSourceRowType.SummaryRowSection);
					section.SetSummaryRow(dataSourceSpecialRow, j);
					for (int k = i + 1; k < section.HeaderOffsets.Length; k++)
					{
						section.HeaderOffsets[k]++;
					}
					section.SectionEndIndex++;
					section.SummaryTopCount++;
					_sectionMap.OffsetSucceedingSectionsFromNewSection(section, 1, 1);
					if (firstOrLastItemInSection != null)
					{
						string[] groupNames = GetGroupNames();
						for (int l = 0; l < groupNames.Length; l++)
						{
							dataSourceSpecialRow.SetValue(groupNames[l], DataSource.GetItemProperty(firstOrLastItemInSection, groupNames[l]));
						}
					}
					if (notify && UpdateNotifier != null)
					{
						UpdateNotifier.NotifyInsertItem(num2, dataSourceSpecialRow);
					}
				}
				num += summaryRowsFromResults.Count;
			}
		}

		private int InjectSectionSummariesBottomAtLevel(SectionData section, int level, bool notify)
		{
			int num = section.SummaryLocations[level];
			List<Dictionary<string, ISummaryResult>> summaryRowsFromResults = SectionData.GetSummaryRowsFromResults(section.SummaryResults2[level]);
			for (int i = 0; i < summaryRowsFromResults.Count; i++)
			{
				ISummaryResult[] array = new ISummaryResult[summaryRowsFromResults[i].Count];
				summaryRowsFromResults[i].Values.CopyTo(array, 0);
				SectionData section2 = _sectionMap.GetSection(num - 1);
				DataSourceSpecialRow dataSourceSpecialRow = InjectSummaryRow(num + i, level + 1, array, DataSourceRowType.SummaryRowSection);
				section.SetSummaryRow(dataSourceSpecialRow, i);
				section2.SectionEndIndex++;
				section2.SummaryBottomCount++;
				_sectionMap.OffsetSucceedingSections(section2, 1, 1);
				object obj = null;
				DataSourceRowType dataSourceRowType = DataSourceRowType.Normal;
				for (int num2 = num + i - 1; num2 >= 0; num2--)
				{
					DataSourceRowType rowType = DataSource.GetRowType(num2);
					if (rowType == DataSourceRowType.Normal || rowType == DataSourceRowType.SectionHeader)
					{
						obj = _view[num2];
						dataSourceRowType = rowType;
						break;
					}
				}
				if (obj != null)
				{
					string[] groupNames = GetGroupNames();
					if (dataSourceRowType == DataSourceRowType.SectionHeader)
					{
						DataSourceSpecialRow dataSourceSpecialRow2 = obj as DataSourceSpecialRow;
						for (int j = 0; j < groupNames.Length; j++)
						{
							dataSourceSpecialRow.SetValue(groupNames[j], dataSourceSpecialRow2.GetValue(groupNames[j]));
						}
					}
					else
					{
						for (int k = 0; k < groupNames.Length; k++)
						{
							dataSourceSpecialRow.SetValue(groupNames[k], DataSource.GetItemProperty(obj, groupNames[k]));
						}
					}
				}
				if (notify && UpdateNotifier != null)
				{
					UpdateNotifier.NotifyInsertItem(num + i, dataSourceSpecialRow);
				}
			}
			return summaryRowsFromResults.Count;
		}

		private void InjectSectionSummariesBottom(SectionData section, bool notify)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < section.SummaryResults2.Length && section.HeaderStates[i]; i++)
			{
				if (section.SummaryLocations[i] != -1)
				{
					section.SummaryGroups[i] = new SummaryGroup();
					section.SummaryGroups[i].Summaries = new DataSourceSpecialRow[_summaryRowCount];
					InjectSectionSummariesBottomAtLevel(section, i, notify);
				}
			}
		}

		private string[] GetGroupNames()
		{
			string[] array = new string[GroupDescriptions.All.Count + SortDescriptions.All.Count];
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < GroupDescriptions.All.Count; i++)
			{
				array[num] = GroupDescriptions.All[i].PropertyName;
				num++;
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < SortDescriptions.All.Count; j++)
			{
				array[num] = SortDescriptions.All[j].PropertyName;
				num++;
			}
			return array;
		}

		private string[] GetSectionNames()
		{
			string[] array = new string[GroupDescriptions.All.Count];
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < GroupDescriptions.All.Count; i++)
			{
				array[num] = GroupDescriptions.All[i].PropertyName;
				num++;
			}
			return array;
		}

		private void EndSection(int i, object currRepresentative, string[] groupNames)
		{
			_sectionMap.EndSection(i);
		}

		private SectionData StartSection(int i, object currRepresentative, string[] groupNames)
		{
			return _sectionMap.StartSection(i, DataSource, currRepresentative, groupNames, DataSource.SectionHeaderDisplayMode, IsSectionExpandedDefault);
		}

		public void SetPinnedKeys(List<object[]> pinnedKeys)
		{
			_pinnedKeys = new List<object[]>();
			for (int i = 0; i < pinnedKeys.Count; i++)
			{
				_pinnedKeys.Add(pinnedKeys[i]);
			}
		}

		private void OnClearItems()
		{
			_view.Clear();
			if (UpdateNotifier != null)
			{
				UpdateNotifier.NotifyClearItems();
			}
		}

		public void NotifySetItem(int index, object oldItem, object newItem)
		{
			if (_sortComparer != null)
			{
				RemoveOldFromSorted(oldItem);
				AddNewToSorted(newItem);
			}
			else
			{
				RemoveOldFromUnsorted(index, oldItem);
				AddNewToUnsorted(index, newItem);
			}
		}

		private void AddNewToUnsorted(int index, object newItem)
		{
			if (ShouldShow(newItem))
			{
				int newIndex = FindUnsortedViewIndexForSourceIndex(index);
				OnInsertItem(newIndex, newItem);
			}
		}

		private void OnInsertItem(int newIndex, object newItem)
		{
			InsertAndAdjustSectionData(newIndex, newItem);
			UpdateSectionsOnInsert(newIndex, newItem);
			UpdateSummariesOnInsert(newIndex, newItem);
		}

		private void InsertAndAdjustSectionData(int newIndex, object newItem)
		{
			if (_hasSections)
			{
				SectionData sectionData = _sectionMap.GetSection(newIndex);
				if (sectionData == null)
				{
					sectionData = _sectionMap.GetLastSection();
				}
				int headerCount = sectionData.GetHeaderCount();
				bool flag = true;
				if (newIndex >= sectionData.SectionStartIndex && newIndex <= sectionData.SectionStartIndex + (headerCount - 1) + sectionData.SummaryTopCount + sectionData.PinnedCount)
				{
					if (!BelongsInSection(sectionData, newItem, _view[sectionData.SectionStartIndex]))
					{
						sectionData = _sectionMap.GetSection(sectionData.SectionStartIndex - 1);
						if (sectionData == null)
						{
							sectionData = _sectionMap.GetFirstSection();
							sectionData.SectionStartIndex++;
						}
						flag = false;
					}
					else
					{
						newIndex = sectionData.SectionStartIndex + headerCount + sectionData.SummaryTopCount + sectionData.PinnedCount;
					}
				}
				if (flag && !sectionData.IsSectionContentVisible)
				{
					return;
				}
				sectionData.SectionEndIndex++;
				_sectionMap.OffsetSucceedingSections(sectionData, 1, 0);
				if (BelongsInSection(sectionData, newItem, _view[sectionData.SectionStartIndex]))
				{
					if (!sectionData.IsSectionContentVisible)
					{
						sectionData.SectionEndIndex--;
						_sectionMap.OffsetSucceedingSections(sectionData, -1, 0);
						return;
					}
					if (newIndex >= sectionData.SectionEndIndex - sectionData.FooterCount - sectionData.SummaryBottomCount && newIndex <= sectionData.SectionEndIndex)
					{
						newIndex = sectionData.SectionEndIndex - sectionData.FooterCount - sectionData.SummaryBottomCount;
					}
				}
			}
			_view.Insert(newIndex, newItem);
			if (UpdateNotifier != null)
			{
				UpdateNotifier.NotifyInsertItem(newIndex, newItem);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateSectionsOnInsert(int newIndex, object newItem)
		{
			SectionData sectionData = null;
			sectionData = ((!_hasSections) ? _sectionMap.Sections[0] : _sectionMap.GetSection(newIndex));
			if (sectionData == null)
			{
				sectionData = ((!_hasSections || newIndex != 0) ? _sectionMap.GetLastSection() : _sectionMap.GetFirstSection());
			}
			if (BelongsInSection(sectionData, newItem, _view[sectionData.SectionStartIndex]))
			{
				_sectionMap.IncrementRowCount(sectionData, 1);
				if (ShouldEmitShiftedRows && sectionData.IsSectionContentVisible)
				{
					int num = InjectSortedShiftedRow(sectionData, newItem);
					if (num != -1 && UpdateNotifier != null)
					{
						UpdateNotifier.NotifyInsertItem(num, _view[num]);
					}
				}
				return;
			}
			SectionData section = _sectionMap.GetSection(newIndex - 1);
			if (section != null && BelongsInSection(section, newItem, _view[section.SectionStartIndex]))
			{
				_sectionMap.IncrementRowCount(section, 1);
				if (ShouldEmitShiftedRows && section.IsSectionContentVisible)
				{
					int num2 = InjectSortedShiftedRow(section, newItem);
					if (num2 != -1 && UpdateNotifier != null)
					{
						UpdateNotifier.NotifyInsertItem(num2, _view[num2]);
					}
				}
				return;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			if (newIndex <= sectionData.SectionStartIndex)
			{
				flag = true;
			}
			int num3 = 0;
			object obj = null;
			object obj2 = null;
			string[] groupNames = GetGroupNames();
			string[] sectionNames = GetSectionNames();
			SectionData sectionData2 = _sectionMap.GenerateSection(DataSource, newItem, sectionNames, SectionHeaderDisplayMode, IsSectionExpandedDefault);
			sectionData2.SectionStartIndex = newIndex;
			sectionData2.SectionEndIndex = newIndex;
			sectionData2.SectionIndex = (flag ? sectionData.SectionIndex : (sectionData.SectionIndex + 1));
			_sectionMap.UpdateHierarchyForInsertedSection(sectionData2, flag);
			for (int i = 0; i < sectionData.SectionKeyValues.Length; i++)
			{
				if (sectionData.SectionKeyValues[i].Equals(sectionData2.SectionKeyValues[i]) && !sectionData.HeaderStates[i])
				{
					_sectionMap.IncrementRowCount(sectionData, 1);
					return;
				}
			}
			_sectionMap.InsertSection(sectionData2.SectionIndex, sectionData2);
			if (ShouldEmitSectionHeaders)
			{
				int num4 = InjectHeaders(sectionData2, newIndex, groupNames, sectionNames, useCache: false);
				sectionData2.SectionEndIndex += num4;
				num3 += num4;
				obj = _view[newIndex];
				if (!flag)
				{
					sectionData.SectionEndIndex--;
				}
			}
			if (sectionData2.IsSectionContentVisible)
			{
				if (ShouldEmitShiftedRows)
				{
					for (int j = 0; j < _pinnedKeys.Count; j++)
					{
						if (PrimaryKeyComparer.CompareToKey(newItem, _pinnedKeys[j]) == 0)
						{
							InjectShiftedRowAtEnd(sectionData2, newItem, offset: false);
							num3++;
							break;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				_view.RemoveAt(newIndex + num3);
				sectionData2.SectionEndIndex--;
				num3--;
			}
			if (ShouldEmitSectionFooters)
			{
				int num5 = InjectFooters(newIndex + (num3 - 1), newItem, groupNames, sectionNames);
				if (num5 > 1)
				{
					sectionData2.SectionEndIndex += num5;
				}
				num3 += num5;
				obj2 = _view[newIndex + (num3 - 1)];
			}
			_sectionMap.OffsetSucceedingSectionsFromNewSection(sectionData2, num3, num3);
			RemoveDuplicateHeaders(sectionData2);
			if (sectionData2.IsSectionContentVisible)
			{
				_sectionMap.IncrementRowCount(sectionData2, 1);
			}
			if (UpdateNotifier != null)
			{
				if (obj != null)
				{
					UpdateNotifier.NotifyInsertItem(newIndex, obj);
				}
				if (obj2 != null)
				{
					UpdateNotifier.NotifyInsertItem(newIndex + (num3 - 1), obj2);
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateSummaryRowRepresentative(DataSourceSpecialRow summaryRow)
		{
			int num = _view.IndexOf(summaryRow);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			object obj = _view[num - 1];
			DataSourceSpecialRow dataSourceSpecialRow = obj as DataSourceSpecialRow;
			string[] groupNames = GetGroupNames();
			for (int i = 0; i < groupNames.Length; i++)
			{
				if (dataSourceSpecialRow == null)
				{
					summaryRow.SetValue(groupNames[i], DataSource.GetItemProperty(obj, groupNames[i]));
				}
				else
				{
					summaryRow.SetValue(groupNames[i], dataSourceSpecialRow.GetValue(groupNames[i]));
				}
			}
		}

		private void RemoveDuplicateHeaders(SectionData section)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			bool flag2 = false;
			if (section.SectionIndex > 0)
			{
				SectionData sectionData = _sectionMap.Sections[section.SectionIndex - 1];
				int num = 0;
				int num2 = 0;
				int num3 = 0;
				while (num2 < section.SectionKeyNames.Length)
				{
					if (!flag && sectionData.SectionKeyValues[num2].Equals(section.SectionKeyValues[num2]))
					{
						_view.RemoveAt(section.SectionStartIndex + num3);
						section.SectionEndIndex--;
						_sectionMap.OffsetSucceedingSections(section, -1, -1);
						if (IncludeSummaryRowsInSection && (SummaryScope == DataSourceSummaryScope.Groups || SummaryScope == DataSourceSummaryScope.Both))
						{
							for (int i = 0; i < _summaryRowCount; i++)
							{
								if (_view[section.SectionStartIndex - 1] is DataSourceSpecialRow { RowType: DataSourceRowType.SummaryRowSection } dataSourceSpecialRow && dataSourceSpecialRow.Level == num2 + 1)
								{
									_view.RemoveAt(section.SectionStartIndex - 1);
									sectionData.SectionEndIndex--;
									_sectionMap.OffsetSucceedingSections(sectionData, -1, -1);
									_view.Insert(section.SectionEndIndex + 1, dataSourceSpecialRow);
									num++;
									UpdateSummaryRowRepresentative(dataSourceSpecialRow);
								}
							}
						}
						section.HeaderExpansionKeys[num2] = null;
						section.HeaderOffsets[num2] = 0;
						section.HeaderStates[num2] = true;
						if (sectionData.HeaderExpansionKeys[num2] != null)
						{
							section.ParentSection = sectionData.SectionIndex;
						}
						num3--;
						flag2 = true;
					}
					else
					{
						flag = true;
						section.HeaderOffsets[num2] = num3;
						if (num > 0)
						{
							section.SectionEndIndex += num;
							_sectionMap.OffsetSucceedingSections(section, num, num);
							section.SummaryLocations[num2] = section.SectionEndIndex - (num - 1);
						}
						else
						{
							section.SummaryLocations[num2] = section.SectionEndIndex + 1;
						}
					}
					num2++;
					num3++;
				}
				if (section.ParentSection == -1 && flag2)
				{
					section.ParentSection = sectionData.ParentSection;
				}
			}
			if (section.SectionIndex >= _sectionMap.Sections.Count - 1)
			{
				return;
			}
			flag = false;
			flag2 = false;
			SectionData sectionData2 = _sectionMap.Sections[section.SectionIndex + 1];
			int num4 = 0;
			int num5 = 0;
			while (num4 < section.SectionKeyNames.Length)
			{
				if (!flag && sectionData2.SectionKeyValues[num4].Equals(section.SectionKeyValues[num4]))
				{
					if (sectionData2.HeaderExpansionKeys[num4] != null)
					{
						_view.RemoveAt(sectionData2.SectionStartIndex + num5);
						sectionData2.SectionEndIndex--;
						_sectionMap.OffsetSucceedingSections(sectionData2, -1, -1);
						section.ShiftSummaryLocationsFromLevel(num4, -1);
						section.SummaryResults2[num4] = sectionData2.SummaryResults2[num4];
						section.RowCount[num4] = sectionData2.RowCount[num4];
						if (IncludeSummaryRowsInSection && (SummaryScope == DataSourceSummaryScope.Groups || SummaryScope == DataSourceSummaryScope.Both))
						{
							DataSourceSpecialRow item = sectionData2.SummaryGroups[num4].Summaries[0];
							int num6 = _view.IndexOf(item);
							section.SummaryLocations[num4] = num6;
							SectionData section2 = _sectionMap.GetSection(num6);
							int num7 = sectionData2.SummaryGroups[num4].Summaries.Length;
							for (int j = 0; j < num7; j++)
							{
								sectionData2.SummaryGroups[num4].Summaries[j] = null;
								_view.RemoveAt(num6);
								section2.SectionEndIndex--;
								if (IsSectionSummaryRowsAtBottom)
								{
									section2.SummaryBottomCount--;
								}
								else
								{
									section2.SummaryTopCount--;
								}
							}
							_sectionMap.OffsetSucceedingSections(section2, -num7, -num7);
							section.ShiftSummaryLocationsFromLevel(num4, -num7);
						}
						sectionData2.SummaryLocations[num4] = -1;
						sectionData2.RowCount[num4] = 0;
						sectionData2.SummaryResults2[num4] = null;
						sectionData2.SummaryGroups[num4] = null;
						sectionData2.HeaderExpansionKeys[num4] = null;
						sectionData2.HeaderOffsets[num4] = 0;
						sectionData2.HeaderStates[num4] = true;
						flag2 = true;
					}
					num5--;
				}
				else
				{
					flag = true;
					sectionData2.HeaderOffsets[num4] = num5;
					if (section.HeaderExpansionKeys[num4] != null && section.SummaryLocations[num4] == -1)
					{
						section.SummaryLocations[num4] = section.SectionEndIndex + 1;
					}
				}
				num4++;
				num5++;
			}
		}

		private bool BelongsInSection(SectionData section, object newItem, object existingItem)
		{
			if (GroupDescriptions.All.Count == 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (GroupComparer.Compare(newItem, existingItem) == 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private object[] GetSectionValues(string[] sectionNames, object newItem)
		{
			object[] array = new object[sectionNames.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i] = DataSource.GetItemProperty(newItem, sectionNames[i]);
			}
			return array;
		}

		private bool ItemsAreEqual(object item1, object item2)
		{
			if (item1 == null && item2 == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (item1 == null && item2 != null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (item1 != null && item2 == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return item1.Equals(item2);
		}

		private int FindUnsortedViewIndexForSourceIndex(int index)
		{
			if (GroupDescriptions.All.Count == 0 && _pinnedKeys.Count == 0 && _filter == null && _source.ActualCount == _view.Count)
			{
				return index;
			}
			int num = 0;
			int i = 0;
			int count = _view.Count;
			while (num < index && i < count)
			{
				for (; i < count; i++)
				{
					object obj = _view[i];
					bool flag = false;
					if (obj is DataSourceSpecialRow)
					{
						flag = true;
					}
					if (!flag)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
				object itemAtIndex = _source.GetItemAtIndex(num);
				if (ItemsAreEqual(itemAtIndex, _view[i]))
				{
					i++;
					num++;
				}
				else
				{
					num++;
				}
			}
			return i;
		}

		private void RemoveOldFromUnsorted(int index, object oldItem)
		{
			int num = FindUnsortedViewIndexForSourceIndex(index);
			if (num < _view.Count && ItemsAreEqual(oldItem, _view[num]))
			{
				OnRemoveItem(num, oldItem);
			}
		}

		private void OnRemoveItem(int oldIndex, object oldItem)
		{
			_view.RemoveAt(oldIndex);
			if (UpdateNotifier != null)
			{
				UpdateNotifier.NotifyRemoveItem(oldIndex, oldItem);
			}
			SectionData section = UpdateSectionsOnRemoval(oldIndex, oldItem);
			UpdateSummariesOnRemoval(oldIndex, oldItem, section);
		}

		private SectionData UpdateSectionsOnRemoval(int oldIndex, object oldItem)
		{
			SectionData sectionData = null;
			sectionData = ((!_hasSections) ? _sectionMap.Sections[0] : _sectionMap.GetSection(oldIndex));
			if (sectionData != null)

				_sectionMap.IncrementRowCount(sectionData, -1);
				if (sectionData.IsSectionContentVisible)
				{
					sectionData.SectionEndIndex--;
					_sectionMap.OffsetSucceedingSections(sectionData, -1, 0);
					if (ShouldEmitShiftedRows)
					{
						for (int i = 0; i < sectionData.PinnedCount; i++)
						{
							int num = 0;
							if (ShouldEmitSectionHeaders)
							{
								num = 1;
							}
							num += sectionData.SummaryTopCount;
							object obj = _view[sectionData.SectionStartIndex + i + num];
							DataSourceSpecialRow dataSourceSpecialRow = null;
							if (obj is DataSourceSpecialRow)
							{
								dataSourceSpecialRow = (DataSourceSpecialRow)obj;
							}
							if (dataSourceSpecialRow != null && dataSourceSpecialRow.TargetRow == oldItem)
							{
								_view.RemoveAt(sectionData.SectionStartIndex + i + num);
								sectionData.SectionEndIndex--;
								sectionData.PinnedCount--;
								sectionData.FirstRowDisplacement--;
								_sectionMap.OffsetSucceedingSections(sectionData, -1, -1);
								if (UpdateNotifier != null)
								{
									UpdateNotifier.NotifyRemoveItem(sectionData.SectionStartIndex + i + num, dataSourceSpecialRow);
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
				if (_hasSections && !sectionData.HasRows() && ContainsOnlySpecial(sectionData))
				{
					int num2 = 0;
					if (_sectionMap.HasChildren(sectionData))

						int num3 = level;

						for (int j = 0; j < sectionData.SectionKeyValues.Length; j++)
						{
							if (!sectionData.SectionKeyValues[j].Equals(sectionData2.SectionKeyValues[j]))
							{
								num3 = j;
								break;
							}
						}
						if (ShouldEmitSectionHeaders && sectionData.HeaderStates[num3 - 1])
						{
							for (int k = num3; k < count; k++)

										if (dataSourceSpecialRow2 == null)

											continue;
										}
										int num4 = _view.IndexOf(dataSourceSpecialRow2);
										if (num4 < 0)
										{
											continue;
										}
										_view.RemoveAt(num4);
										sectionData.SectionEndIndex--;

											}
										}
									}
								}
								int index = sectionData.SectionStartIndex + sectionData.HeaderOffsets[k];
								if (_view[index] is DataSourceSpecialRow { RowType: DataSourceRowType.SectionHeader } dataSourceSpecialRow3)
