										if (dataSourceSpecialRow7 == null)
										{
											dataSourceSpecialRow8.SetValue(groupNames[num15], DataSource.GetItemProperty(obj2, groupNames[num15]));
										}
										else
										{
											dataSourceSpecialRow8.SetValue(groupNames[num15], dataSourceSpecialRow7.GetValue(groupNames[num15]));
										}
									}
								}
								_sectionMap.Sections[sectionData.SectionIndex - 1].SectionEndIndex += num13;
							}
						}
					}
					if (ShouldEmitSectionFooters)
					{
						for (int num16 = 0; num16 < sectionData.HeaderExpansionKeys.Length && sectionData.HeaderStates[num16]; num16++)
						{
							if (sectionData.HeaderExpansionKeys[num16] != null)
							{
								object oldItem2 = _view[sectionData.SectionEndIndex];
								_view.RemoveAt(sectionData.SectionEndIndex);
								if (UpdateNotifier != null)
								{
									UpdateNotifier.NotifyRemoveItem(sectionData.SectionEndIndex, oldItem2);
								}
								num2++;
								sectionData.SectionEndIndex--;
							}
						}
					}
					_sectionMap.RemoveSection(sectionData.SectionIndex);
					_sectionMap.OffsetSucceedingFromRemovedSection(sectionData, -num2, -num2);
					sectionData.IsRemoved = true;
				}
			}
			return sectionData;
		}

		private bool ContainsOnlySpecial(SectionData section)
		{
			for (int i = section.SectionStartIndex; i <= section.SectionEndIndex; i++)
			{
				if (DataSource.GetRowType(i) == DataSourceRowType.Normal)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void AddNewToSorted(object newItem)
		{
			if (ShouldShow(newItem))
			{
				int num = _view.BinarySearch(newItem, _sortComparer);
				if (num < 0)
				{
					num = ~num;
				}
				OnInsertItem(num, newItem);
			}
		}

		public void PinRow(object[] key)
		{
			_pinnedKeys.Add(key);
			int num = DataSource.IndexOfKey(key);
			DataSource.GetItemAtIndex(num);
			if (num != -1 && ShouldEmitShiftedRows)
			{
				SectionData section = _sectionMap.GetSection(num);
				int index = InjectSortedShiftedRow(section, _view[num]);
				if (UpdateNotifier != null)
				{
					UpdateNotifier.NotifyInsertItem(index, _view[index]);
				}
			}
		}

		public void UnpinRow(object[] key)
		{
			if (!_pinnedKeys.Remove(key))
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = DataSource.IndexOfKey(key);
			DataSource.GetItemAtIndex(num);
			if (num == -1)
			{
				return;
			}
			SectionData section = _sectionMap.GetSection(num);
			int num2 = section.SectionStartIndex;
			if (ShouldEmitSectionHeaders)
			{
				num2 += section.GetHeaderCount();
			}
			if (!ShouldEmitShiftedRows)
			{
				return;
			}
			RemovedShiftedRowInfo removedShiftedRowInfo = RemoveShiftedRow(num2, _view[num], section.PinnedCount, GetGroupNames());
			if (removedShiftedRowInfo != null)
			{
				section.SectionEndIndex--;
				section.PinnedCount--;
				section.FirstRowDisplacement--;
				_sectionMap.OffsetSucceedingSections(section, -1, -1);
				if (UpdateNotifier != null)
				{
					UpdateNotifier.NotifyRemoveItem(removedShiftedRowInfo.Index, removedShiftedRowInfo.Item);
				}
			}
		}

		private RemovedShiftedRowInfo RemoveShiftedRow(int pinnedStart, object actualItem, int pinnedCount, string[] groupNames)
		{
			for (int num = pinnedStart + (pinnedCount - 1); num >= pinnedStart; num--)
			{
				if (_view[num] is DataSourceSpecialRow)
				{
					DataSourceSpecialRow dataSourceSpecialRow = (DataSourceSpecialRow)_view[num];
					if (dataSourceSpecialRow.RowType == DataSourceRowType.ShiftedRow && dataSourceSpecialRow.TargetRow == actualItem)
					{
						_view.RemoveAt(num);
						return new RemovedShiftedRowInfo
						{
							Item = dataSourceSpecialRow,
							Index = num
						};
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void RemoveOldFromSorted(object oldItem)
		{
			int num = _view.BinarySearch(oldItem, _sortComparer);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				num = ~num;
			}
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				int count = _view.Count;
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					int num2 = num - i;
					int num3 = num + i;
					if (num2 < 0 && num3 > count - 1)
					{
						break;
					}
					if (num2 >= 0 && num2 < count && _view[num2] != null && _view[num2].Equals(oldItem))
					{
						num = num2;
						break;
					}
					if (num3 < count && _view[num3] != null && _view[num3].Equals(oldItem))
					{
						num = num3;
						break;
					}
				}
				if (num < 0 || num > count - 1)
				{
					return;
				}
				object obj = _view[num];
				if (obj == null && oldItem == null)
				{
					_view.RemoveAt(num);
					_updateNotifier.NotifyRemoveItem(num, oldItem);
					SectionData section = UpdateSectionsOnRemoval(num, oldItem);
					UpdateSummaries(num, oldItem, insert: false, section);
				}
				else
				{
					if (obj == null)
					{
						return;
					}
					if (obj.Equals(oldItem))
					{
						_view.RemoveAt(num);
						_updateNotifier.NotifyRemoveItem(num, oldItem);
						SectionData section2 = UpdateSectionsOnRemoval(num, oldItem);
						UpdateSummaries(num, oldItem, insert: false, section2);
						return;
					}
					if (num - 1 >= 0)
					{
						SectionData section3 = _sectionMap.GetSection(num - 1);
						if (section3 != null && !section3.IsSectionContentVisible)
						{
							num--;
						}
					}
					UpdateSectionsOnRemoval(num, oldItem);
				}
				return;
			}
			int count2 = _view.Count;
			for (int j = 0; j < count2; j++)
			{
				object obj2 = _view[j];
				if (obj2 == null && oldItem == null)
				{
					_view.RemoveAt(j);
					break;
				}
				if (obj2 != null && obj2.Equals(oldItem))
				{
					_view.RemoveAt(j);
					_updateNotifier.NotifyRemoveItem(j, oldItem);
					SectionData section4 = UpdateSectionsOnRemoval(j, oldItem);
					UpdateSummariesOnRemoval(j, oldItem, section4);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private bool ShouldShow(object item)
		{
			if (_filter == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return _filter(item);
		}

		public void NotifyClearItems()
		{
		}

		public void NotifyInsertItem(int index, object newItem)
		{
			if (_sortComparer != null)
			{
				AddNewToSorted(newItem);
			}
			else
			{
				AddNewToUnsorted(index, newItem);
			}
		}

		public void NotifyRemoveItem(int index, object oldItem)
		{
			if (_sortComparer != null)
			{
				RemoveOldFromSorted(oldItem);
			}
			else
			{
				RemoveOldFromUnsorted(index, oldItem);
			}
		}

		public void SetIsRowExpandedAtIndex(int rowIndex, bool state)
		{
			SectionData sectionData = _sectionMap.GetSection(rowIndex);
			if (sectionData == null)
			{
				sectionData = _sectionMap.GetLastSection();
			}
			int i = 0;
			int num = 0;
			for (; i < sectionData.HeaderExpansionKeys.Length; i++)
			{
				if (sectionData.HeaderExpansionKeys[i] == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (rowIndex == sectionData.SectionStartIndex + sectionData.HeaderOffsets[i])
				{
					string key = sectionData.HeaderExpansionKeys[i];
					if (_expansionStates.ContainsKey(key))
					{
						if (_expansionStates[key] != state)
						{
							bool oldState = _expansionStates[key];
							if (state == IsSectionExpandedDefault)
							{
								_expansionStates.Remove(key);
							}
							else
							{
								_expansionStates[key] = state;
							}
							DataSource.QueueAutoRefresh();
							if (ExpansionNotifier != null)
							{
								ExpansionNotifier.NotifyRowExpansionChanged(rowIndex, oldState, state);
							}
						}
					}
					else if (state != IsSectionExpandedDefault)
					{
						_expansionStates.Add(key, state);
						DataSource.QueueAutoRefresh();
						if (ExpansionNotifier != null)
						{
							ExpansionNotifier.NotifyRowExpansionChanged(rowIndex, IsSectionExpandedDefault, state);
						}
					}
				}
				num++;
			}
		}

		public bool GetExpansionStateForRow(int rowIndex)
		{
			SectionData sectionData = _sectionMap.GetSection(rowIndex);
			if (sectionData == null)
			{
				sectionData = _sectionMap.GetLastSection();
			}
			int i = 0;
			int num = 0;
			for (; i < sectionData.HeaderExpansionKeys.Length; i++)
			{
				if (sectionData.HeaderExpansionKeys[i] != null)
				{
					if (rowIndex == sectionData.SectionStartIndex + sectionData.HeaderOffsets[i])
					{
						return sectionData.HeaderStates[i];
					}
					num++;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool GetSectionExpansionState(string sectionKey)
		{
			if (!IsSectionCollapsable)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!_expansionStates.ContainsKey(sectionKey))
			{
				return IsSectionExpandedDefault;
			}
			return _expansionStates[sectionKey];
		}

		private string CombineSectionKeysAndValues(SectionData section)
		{
			string text = "";
			for (int i = 0; i < section.SectionKeyNames.Length; i++)
			{
				text = text + section.SectionKeyNames[i] + ":" + section.SectionKeyValues[i];
			}
			return text;
		}

		private string CombineSectionKeysAndValues(SectionData section, int level)
		{
			if (DataSource.SectionHeaderDisplayMode == DataSourceSectionHeaderDisplayMode.Combined)
			{
				return CombineSectionKeysAndValues(section);
			}
			string text = "";
			for (int i = 0; i < level + 1; i++)
			{
				text = string.Concat(text, section.SectionKeyNames[i], ":", section.SectionKeyValues[i], ":");
			}
			return text;
		}

		private void BeginSummaries(SectionData section)
		{
			if (SummaryScope == DataSourceSummaryScope.None || (section != null && SummaryScope == DataSourceSummaryScope.Root) || (section == null && SummaryScope == DataSourceSummaryScope.Groups))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (section == null && (_summaryResults == null || _summaryResults.Length != SummaryDescriptions.All.Count))
			{
				_summaryResults = new ISummaryResult[SummaryDescriptions.All.Count];
			}
			if (section != null)
			{
				for (int num = section.GetHeaderCount() - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < SummaryDescriptions.All.Count; i++)
					{
						SummaryDescription summaryDescription = SummaryDescriptions.All[i];
						_previousSummaryCalculators[num][i].BeginCalculation(DataSource, summaryDescription.PropertyName);
					}
				}
				return;
			}
			if (_rootSummaryCalculators == null || _rootSummaryCalculators.Length != SummaryDescriptions.All.Count)
			{
				_rootSummaryCalculators = new SummaryCalculator[SummaryDescriptions.All.Count];
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < SummaryDescriptions.All.Count; j++)
			{
				SummaryDescription summaryDescription2 = SummaryDescriptions.All[j];
				if (_rootSummaryCalculators[j] == null || _rootSummaryCalculators[j].Operand != summaryDescription2.Operand)
				{
					_rootSummaryCalculators[j] = summaryDescription2.GetCalculator();
				}
				_rootSummaryCalculators[j].BeginCalculation(DataSource, summaryDescription2.PropertyName);
			}
		}

		private void EndSummaries(SectionData section)
		{
			if (SummaryScope == DataSourceSummaryScope.None || (section != null && SummaryScope == DataSourceSummaryScope.Root) || (section == null && SummaryScope == DataSourceSummaryScope.Groups))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (section != null)
			{
				for (int num = section.GetHeaderCount() - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					DataSourceSpecialRow dataSourceSpecialRow = (DataSourceSpecialRow)_view[section.SectionStartIndex + num];
					for (int i = 0; i < SummaryDescriptions.All.Count; i++)
					{
						_ = SummaryDescriptions.All[i];
						ISummaryResult summaryResult = _previousSummaryCalculators[num][i].EndCalculation();
						summaryResult.SummaryIndex = i;
						if (dataSourceSpecialRow != null)
						{
							dataSourceSpecialRow.SummaryResults[num] = summaryResult;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < SummaryDescriptions.All.Count; j++)
				{
					ISummaryResult summaryResult2 = _rootSummaryCalculators[j].EndCalculation();
					summaryResult2.SummaryIndex = j;
					_summaryResults[j] = summaryResult2;
				}
			}
		}

		private void AggregateItem(SectionData section, object item)
		{
			if (SummaryScope == DataSourceSummaryScope.None || (section != null && SummaryScope == DataSourceSummaryScope.Root) || (section == null && SummaryScope == DataSourceSummaryScope.Groups) || item == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (section != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < _previousSummaryCalculators.Length; i++)
				{
					if (_previousSummaryCalculators[i] == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					for (int j = 0; j < _previousSummaryCalculators[i].Length; j++)
					{
						if (_previousSummaryCalculators[i][j] != null)
						{
							_previousSummaryCalculators[i][j].Aggregate(item);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				for (int k = 0; k < SummaryDescriptions.All.Count; k++)
				{
					_rootSummaryCalculators[k].Aggregate(item);
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateSectionSummaryOnInsert(SectionData section, SummaryCalculator calculator, object newItem, int level, int summaryIndex)
		{
			ISummaryResult previousResult = section.SummaryResults2[level][summaryIndex];
			ISummaryResult result = calculator.ItemAdded(newItem, previousResult, section.RowCount[level]);
			section.UpdateSummary(level, summaryIndex, result);
			if (ShouldEmitSectionHeaders && section.HeaderExpansionKeys[level] != null && _view[section.SectionStartIndex + section.HeaderOffsets[level]] is DataSourceSpecialRow dataSourceSpecialRow)
			{
				dataSourceSpecialRow.SummaryResults[summaryIndex] = section.SummaryResults2[level][summaryIndex];
			}
		}

		private void UpdateSectionSummary(SectionData section, SummaryCalculator calculator, object item, int level, int summaryIndex, bool insert)
		{
			ISummaryResult previousResult = section.SummaryResults2[level][summaryIndex];
			int currentCount = section.RowCount[level];
			ISummaryResult result = (insert ? calculator.ItemAdded(item, previousResult, currentCount) : calculator.ItemRemoved(item, previousResult, currentCount));
			section.UpdateSummary(level, summaryIndex, result);
			if (ShouldEmitSectionHeaders && !section.IsRemoved && section.HeaderExpansionKeys[level] != null && _view[section.SectionStartIndex + section.HeaderOffsets[level]] is DataSourceSpecialRow dataSourceSpecialRow)
			{
				dataSourceSpecialRow.SummaryResults[summaryIndex] = section.SummaryResults2[level][summaryIndex];
			}
		}

		public void UpdateSummaries(int index, object item, bool insert, SectionData section)
		{
			if (SummaryDescriptions.All.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (section == null)
			{
				section = GetSection(index);
				if (section == null)
				{
					section = _sectionMap.GetLastSection();
				}
			}
			bool flag = false;
			bool flag2 = false;
			bool flag3 = false;
			for (int i = 0; i < SummaryDescriptions.All.Count; i++)
			{
				SummaryDescription summaryDescription = SummaryDescriptions.All[i];
				if (SummaryScope == DataSourceSummaryScope.Both || SummaryScope == DataSourceSummaryScope.Root)
				{
					ISummaryResult summaryResult = null;
					summaryResult = ((!insert) ? _rootSummaryCalculators[i].ItemRemoved(item, _summaryResults[i], _source.ActualCount) : _rootSummaryCalculators[i].ItemAdded(item, _summaryResults[i], _source.ActualCount));
					summaryResult.SummaryIndex = i;
					_summaryResults[i] = summaryResult;
					if (_rootSummaryCalculators[i].IsSummaryDirty)
					{
						flag = true;
					}
					else
					{
						flag2 = true;
					}
				}
				if ((SummaryScope != DataSourceSummaryScope.Both && SummaryScope != DataSourceSummaryScope.Groups) || section == null || section.SummaryResults2 == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				SummaryCalculator calculator = summaryDescription.GetCalculator();
				calculator.DataSource = DataSource;
				calculator.PropertyName = summaryDescription.PropertyName;
				calculator.PropertyType = DataSource.ResolveSchemaPropertyType(summaryDescription.PropertyName);
				string[] sectionNames = GetSectionNames();
				int num = section.GetLevel();
				for (int j = num; j < sectionNames.Length; j++)
				{
					UpdateSectionSummary(section, calculator, item, j, i, insert);
					if (calculator.IsSummaryDirty)
					{
						flag = true;
					}
					flag3 = true;
				}
				int parentSection = section.ParentSection;
				while (parentSection != -1)
				{
					SectionData sectionData = _sectionMap.Sections[parentSection];
					for (int k = sectionData.GetLevel(); k < num; k++)
					{
						UpdateSectionSummary(sectionData, calculator, item, k, i, insert);
						if (calculator.IsSummaryDirty)
						{
							flag = true;
						}
					}
					parentSection = sectionData.ParentSection;
					num--;
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				DataSource.QueueAutoRefresh();
				return;
			}
			if (flag2)
			{
				List<Dictionary<string, ISummaryResult>> summaryRowsFromResults = SectionData.GetSummaryRowsFromResults(_summaryResults);
				UpdateRootSummaryResult(summaryRowsFromResults);
			}
			if (flag3)
			{
				UpdateSectionSummaryResult(section, null);
				int parentSection2 = section.ParentSection;
				while (parentSection2 != -1)
				{
					SectionData sectionData2 = _sectionMap.Sections[parentSection2];
					UpdateSectionSummaryResult(sectionData2, null);
					parentSection2 = sectionData2.ParentSection;
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateSummariesOnInsert(int newIndex, object newItem)

						{
							flag = true;
						}
					}
					parentSection = sectionData2.ParentSection;
					num--;
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				DataSource.QueueAutoRefresh();
				return;
			}
			if (flag2)
			{
				List<Dictionary<string, ISummaryResult>> summaryRowsFromResults = SectionData.GetSummaryRowsFromResults(_summaryResults);
				UpdateRootSummaryResult(summaryRowsFromResults);
			}
			if (flag3)
			{
				UpdateSectionSummaryResult(sectionData, null);
				int parentSection2 = sectionData.ParentSection;
				while (parentSection2 != -1)
				{
					SectionData sectionData3 = _sectionMap.Sections[parentSection2];
					UpdateSectionSummaryResult(sectionData3, null);
					parentSection2 = sectionData3.ParentSection;
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateSummariesOnRemoval(int oldIndex, object oldItem, SectionData section)
		{
			if (SummaryDescriptions.All.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (section != null)
			{
				_ = _view[section.SectionStartIndex];
			}
			bool flag = false;
			bool flag2 = false;
			bool flag3 = false;
			for (int i = 0; i < SummaryDescriptions.All.Count; i++)
			{
				SummaryDescription summaryDescription = SummaryDescriptions.All[i];
				if (SummaryScope == DataSourceSummaryScope.Both || SummaryScope == DataSourceSummaryScope.Root)
				{
					ISummaryResult summaryResult = _rootSummaryCalculators[i].ItemRemoved(oldItem, _summaryResults[i], DataSource.ActualCount);
					summaryResult.SummaryIndex = i;
					_summaryResults[i] = summaryResult;
					if (_rootSummaryCalculators[i].IsSummaryDirty)
					{
						flag = true;
					}
					else
					{
						flag2 = true;
					}
				}
				if ((SummaryScope != DataSourceSummaryScope.Both && SummaryScope != DataSourceSummaryScope.Groups) || section == null || section.SummaryResults2 == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				SummaryCalculator calculator = summaryDescription.GetCalculator();
				calculator.DataSource = DataSource;
				calculator.PropertyName = summaryDescription.PropertyName;
				calculator.PropertyType = DataSource.ResolveSchemaPropertyType(summaryDescription.PropertyName);
				string[] sectionNames = GetSectionNames();
				int num = section.GetLevel();
				for (int j = num; j < sectionNames.Length; j++)
				{
					UpdateSectionSummary(section, calculator, oldItem, j, i, insert: false);
					if (calculator.IsSummaryDirty)
					{
						flag = true;
					}
					flag3 = true;
				}
				int parentSection = section.ParentSection;
				while (parentSection != -1)
				{
					SectionData sectionData = _sectionMap.Sections[parentSection];
					for (int k = sectionData.GetLevel(); k < num; k++)
					{
						UpdateSectionSummary(sectionData, calculator, oldItem, k, i, insert: false);
						if (calculator.IsSummaryDirty)
						{
							flag = true;
						}
					}
					parentSection = sectionData.ParentSection;
					num--;
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				DataSource.QueueAutoRefresh();
				return;
			}
			if (flag2)
			{
				List<Dictionary<string, ISummaryResult>> summaryRowsFromResults = SectionData.GetSummaryRowsFromResults(_summaryResults);
				UpdateRootSummaryResult(summaryRowsFromResults);
			}
			if (flag3)
			{
				UpdateSectionSummaryResult(section, null);
				int parentSection2 = section.ParentSection;
				while (parentSection2 != -1)
				{
					SectionData sectionData2 = _sectionMap.Sections[parentSection2];
					UpdateSectionSummaryResult(sectionData2, null);
					parentSection2 = sectionData2.ParentSection;
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateSectionSummaryResult(SectionData section, List<Dictionary<string, ISummaryResult>> sectionSummaryRows)
		{
			if (SummaryScope != DataSourceSummaryScope.Groups && SummaryScope != DataSourceSummaryScope.Both)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (IncludeSummaryRowsInSection)
			{
				if (!section.IsRemoved && !section.HasSummaries())
				{
					if (IsSectionSummaryRowsAtBottom)
					{
						InjectSectionSummariesBottom(section, notify: true);
					}
					else
					{
						InjectSectionSummariesTop(section, notify: true);
					}
					return;
				}
				section.SyncSummaryRows(delegate(DataSourceSpecialRow row)
				{
					if (UpdateNotifier != null)
					{
						int index2 = _view.IndexOf(row);
						UpdateNotifier.NotifySetItem(index2, row, row);
					}
				});
				return;
			}
			for (int num = 0; num < section.SummaryResults2.Length; num++)
			{
				int index = section.SectionStartIndex + section.HeaderOffsets[num];
				DataSourceSpecialRow dataSourceSpecialRow = (DataSourceSpecialRow)_view[index];
				if (dataSourceSpecialRow != null)
				{
					dataSourceSpecialRow.SummaryResults = section.SummaryResults2[num];
					if (UpdateNotifier != null)
					{
						UpdateNotifier.NotifySetItem(index, dataSourceSpecialRow, dataSourceSpecialRow);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateRootSummaryResult(List<Dictionary<string, ISummaryResult>> summaryRows)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < summaryRows.Count; i++)
			{
				ISummaryResult[] array = new ISummaryResult[summaryRows[i].Count];
				summaryRows[i].Values.CopyTo(array, 0);
				int index = _view.Count - summaryRows.Count + i;
				DataSourceSpecialRow dataSourceSpecialRow = _view[index] as DataSourceSpecialRow;
				dataSourceSpecialRow.SummaryResults = array;
				if (UpdateNotifier != null)
				{
					UpdateNotifier.NotifySetItem(index, dataSourceSpecialRow, dataSourceSpecialRow);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void PropertyUpdatedOverride(string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			base.PropertyUpdatedOverride(propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "DataProvider":
				ActualDataProvider = DataProvider;
				QueueAutoRefresh();
				break;
			case "ExecutionContext":
				PredictionEngine.ExecutionContext = base.ExecutionContext;
				break;
			case "ActualDataProvider":
				ActualDataProvider.PageSizeRequested = PageSizeRequested;
				ActualDataProvider.PageLoaded = DataProvider_PageLoaded;
				ActualDataProvider.BatchCompleted = DataProvider_BatchCompleted;
				QueueAutoRefresh();
				break;
			case "PageSizeRequested":
				ActualPageSize = PageSizeRequested;
				if (ActualDataProvider != null)
				{
					ActualDataProvider.PageSizeRequested = PageSizeRequested;
				}
				QueueAutoRefresh();
				break;
			case "ActualPageSize":
				PredictionEngine.PageSize = ActualPageSize;
				QueueAutoRefresh();
				break;
			case "FirstVisibleIndexRequested":
				PredictionEngine.FirstVisibleIndexRequested = base.FirstVisibleIndexRequested;
				break;
			case "LastVisibleIndexRequested":
				PredictionEngine.LastVisibleIndexRequested = base.LastVisibleIndexRequested;
				break;
			case "ActualCount":
				if (ActualDataProvider != null && !_sectionMap.HasSections)
				{
					PredictionEngine.FullCount = ActualDataProvider.ActualCount;
				}
				else
				{
					PredictionEngine.FullCount = base.ActualCount;
				}
				QueueAutoRefresh();
				break;
			case "MaxCachedPages":
				_actualPages.MaxItems = MaxCachedPages;
				break;
			}
		}

		private int GetRealIndex(int index)
		{
			if (base.HasGroups && _sectionMap.HasSections)
			{
				SectionData sectionData = GetSection(index);
				if (sectionData == null)
				{
					sectionData = _sectionMap.GetLastSection();
				}
				return index - sectionData.FirstRowDisplacement;
			}
			return index;
		}

		private void DataProvider_PageLoaded(IDataSourcePage page, int currentFullCount, int actualPageSize)
		{
			IDataSourceExecutionContext executionContext = base.ExecutionContext;
			if (executionContext != null)
			{
				executionContext.Execute(delegate
				{
					ReceivePage(page, currentFullCount, actualPageSize);
				});
			}
			else
			{
				ReceivePage(page, currentFullCount, actualPageSize);
			}
		}

		private void ReceivePage(IDataSourcePage page, int currentFullCount, int actualPageSize)
		{
			if (page == null)
			{
				currentFullCount = ResolveFullCount(currentFullCount);
				if (base.ActualCount != currentFullCount)
				{
					base.ActualCount = currentFullCount;
				}
				return;
			}
			if (actualPageSize != ActualPageSize && !ActualPageSizePopulated)
			{
				ActualPageSize = actualPageSize;
			}
			ActualPageSizePopulated = true;
			int num = page.PageIndex();
			DecrementPageCount(num);
			_actualPages[num] = page;
			IDataSourceSchema dataSourceSchema = page.Schema();
			if (dataSourceSchema != null)
			{
				base.ActualSchema = dataSourceSchema;
			}
			ISummaryResult[] summaryInformation = page.GetSummaryInformation();
			if (base.SummaryDescriptions.All.Count > 0 && _summaryResults == null && summaryInformation != null)
			{
				_summaryResults = summaryInformation;
				for (int i = 0; i < base.SummaryDescriptions.All.Count; i++)
				{
					_summaryResults[i].SummaryIndex = i;
				}
				List<Dictionary<string, ISummaryResult>> summaryRowsFromResults = SectionData.GetSummaryRowsFromResults(_summaryResults);
				_rootSummaryRowCount = summaryRowsFromResults.Count;
			}
			ISectionInformation[] groupInformation = page.GetGroupInformation();
			if (base.GroupDescriptions.All.Count > 0 && _groupInformation == null && groupInformation != null)
			{
				_groupInformation = groupInformation;
				PopulateSections();
				_expansionStateChanged = false;
			}
			currentFullCount = ResolveFullCount(currentFullCount);
			if (base.ActualCount != currentFullCount)
			{
				base.ActualCount = currentFullCount;
			}
			NotifyPageContentChanged(page);
		}

		protected override int ResolveFullCount(int currentFullCount)
		{
			if (_groupInformation != null)
			{
				return _sectionMap.FullCount + _rootSummaryRowCount;
			}
			return currentFullCount + _rootSummaryRowCount;
		}

		private void PopulateSections()
		{
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			_ = base.ShouldEmitSectionHeaders;
			bool shouldEmitSectionFooters = base.ShouldEmitSectionFooters;
			for (int i = 0; i < _groupInformation.Length; i++)
			{
				SectionData sectionData = new SectionData();
				int num3 = num2;
				int num4 = _groupInformation[i].EndIndex - _groupInformation[i].StartIndex;
				sectionData.SectionStartIndex = num;
				sectionData.SectionIndex = i;
				sectionData.RowCount = new int[base.GroupDescriptions.All.Count];
				for (int j = 0; j < base.GroupDescriptions.All.Count; j++)
				{
					sectionData.RowCount[j] = 0;
				}
				sectionData.SectionEndIndex = num + num4;
				sectionData.FirstRowDisplacement = 0;
				sectionData.SectionKeyNames = _groupInformation[i].GroupKeyProperties;
				sectionData.SectionKeyValues = _groupInformation[i].GroupKeyValues;
				sectionData.SummaryLocations = new int[0];
				sectionData.InitializeExpandedStates(SectionHeaderDisplayMode, IsSectionExpandedDefault);
				BuildSectionHierarchy(sectionData, i == 0);
				if (shouldEmitSectionFooters)
				{
					sectionData.FooterCount = sectionData.HeaderStates.Length;
				}
				int num5 = 0;
				sectionData.SummaryResults2 = new ISummaryResult[base.GroupDescriptions.All.Count][];
				if ((base.SummaryScope == DataSourceSummaryScope.Both || base.SummaryScope == DataSourceSummaryScope.Groups) && _groupInformation[i].SummaryResults != null)
				{
					sectionData.SummaryResults2[base.GroupDescriptions.All.Count - 1] = _groupInformation[i].SummaryResults;
					if (sectionData.SummaryResults2 != null)
					{
						for (int k = 0; k < sectionData.SummaryResults2[base.GroupDescriptions.All.Count - 1].Length; k++)
						{
							sectionData.SummaryResults2[base.GroupDescriptions.All.Count - 1][k].SummaryIndex = k;
						}
						num5 = SectionData.GetSummaryRowsFromResults(sectionData.SummaryResults2[base.GroupDescriptions.All.Count - 1]).Count;
					}
				}
				if (IncludeSummaryRowsInSection)
				{
					if (IsSectionSummaryRowsAtBottom)
					{
						sectionData.SummaryBottomCount = num5;
					}
					else
					{
						sectionData.SummaryTopCount = num5;
						num3 += num5;
					}
					num2 += num5;
					sectionData.SectionEndIndex += num5;
				}
				if (shouldEmitSectionFooters)
				{
					num2++;
				}
				int num6 = 0;
				sectionData.HeaderOffsets = new int[sectionData.HeaderStates.Length];
				if (sectionData.ParentSection > -1)
				{
					SectionData sectionData2 = _sectionMap.Sections[sectionData.ParentSection];
					for (int l = 0; l < sectionData2.SectionKeyValues.Length; l++)
					{
						num6 = l;
						if (!sectionData2.SectionKeyValues[l].Equals(sectionData.SectionKeyValues[l]))
						{
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				for (int m = num6; m < sectionData.HeaderStates.Length; m++)
				{
					num2++;
					num3++;
					sectionData.SectionEndIndex++;
					string text = CombineSectionKeysAndValues(sectionData, m);
					sectionData.HeaderExpansionKeys[m] = text;
					sectionData.HeaderOffsets[m] = m - num6;
					if (_expansionStates.ContainsKey(text))
					{
						sectionData.HeaderStates[m] = _expansionStates[text];
					}
					else
					{
						sectionData.HeaderStates[m] = IsSectionExpandedDefault;
					}
					if (!sectionData.HeaderStates[m])
					{
						int num7 = 0;
						int num8 = sectionData.HeaderStates.Length - 1 - m;
						sectionData.SectionEndIndex -= num7;
						num2 -= num7;
						if (shouldEmitSectionFooters)
						{
							num2--;
							sectionData.FooterCount--;
						}
						m += num8;
					}
				}
				sectionData.HeaderCount = sectionData.GetHeaderCount();
				sectionData.FirstRowDisplacement = num3;
				_sectionMap.IncrementRowCount(sectionData, num4 + 1);
				if (!sectionData.IsSectionContentVisible)
				{
					int level = sectionData.GetLevel();
					sectionData.SectionEndIndex -= sectionData.RowCount[level] + num5;
					num2 -= sectionData.RowCount[level] + num5;
				}
				num = sectionData.SectionEndIndex + 1;
				_sectionMap.Sections.Add(sectionData);
				sectionData.IsSectionVisible = _sectionMap.IsVisible(sectionData);
			}
			int num9 = 0;
			for (int n = 0; n < _sectionMap.Sections.Count; n++)
			{
				SectionData sectionData3 = _sectionMap.Sections[n];
				if (base.ShouldEmitSectionHeaders && !sectionData3.IsSectionVisible)
				{
					int num10 = sectionData3.SectionEndIndex - sectionData3.SectionStartIndex + 1;
					_sectionMap.RemoveSection(sectionData3.SectionIndex);
					_sectionMap.OffsetSucceedingFromRemovedSection(sectionData3, -num10, -num10);
					n--;
					num9++;
				}
				else if (sectionData3.ParentSection > -1)
				{
					sectionData3.ParentSection -= num9;
				}
			}
		}

		private void BuildSectionHierarchy(SectionData currentSection, bool initial)
		{
			if (initial)
			{
				_previousSectionsCache = new SectionData[base.GroupDescriptions.All.Count];
				for (int i = 0; i < _previousSectionsCache.Length; i++)
				{
					_previousSectionsCache[i] = currentSection;
				}
			}
			if (SectionHeaderDisplayMode == DataSourceSectionHeaderDisplayMode.Split)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				int num = currentSection.SectionKeyNames.Length;
				for (int j = 0; j < num; j++)
				{
					if (flag)
					{
						_previousSectionsCache[j] = currentSection;
						continue;
					}
					bool flag2 = false;
					if (!((_previousSectionsCache[j].SectionKeyValues[j] != null) ? (!_previousSectionsCache[j].SectionKeyValues[j].Equals(currentSection.SectionKeyValues[j])) : (currentSection.SectionKeyValues[j] != null)))
					{
						continue;
					}
					_previousSectionsCache[j] = currentSection;
					if (j - 1 > -1)
					{
						int num2 = j - 1;
						while (num2 >= 0 && _previousSectionsCache[num2].IsRemoved)
						{
							num2--;
						}
						currentSection.ParentSection = _previousSectionsCache[num2].SectionIndex;
					}
					flag = true;
				}
				return;
			}
			bool flag3 = false;
			for (int k = 0; k < currentSection.SectionKeyNames.Length; k++)
			{
				if (_previousSectionsCache[0].SectionKeyValues[k] == null)
				{
					if (_previousSectionsCache[0].SectionKeyValues[k] != currentSection.SectionKeyValues[k])
					{
						flag3 = true;
						break;
					}
				}
				else if (!_previousSectionsCache[0].SectionKeyValues[k].Equals(currentSection.SectionKeyValues[k]))
				{
					flag3 = true;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (flag3)
			{
				_previousSectionsCache[0] = currentSection;
			}
		}

		private void NotifyPageContentChanged(IDataSourcePage page)
		{
			if (base.UpdateNotifier == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = page.PageIndex() * ActualPageSize;
			if (ActualDataProvider == null || num <= ActualDataProvider.ActualCount)
			{
				int num2 = GetDisplacedIndex(num);
				int displacedIndex = GetDisplacedIndex(num + page.Count() - 1);
				if (num2 > 0 && GetRowType(num2 - 1) == DataSourceRowType.SectionHeader)
				{
					num2--;
				}
				if (base.ActualCount == 0 && page.Count() == 0)
				{
					OnClearItems();
				}
				else
				{
					base.UpdateNotifier.RangeActualized(num2, displacedIndex);
				}
			}
		}

				return startIndex + sectionData.FirstRowDisplacement;
			}
			return startIndex;
		}

		private object GetVirtualItem(int index)
		{
			if (index >= base.ActualCount - _rootSummaryRowCount)
			{
				DataSourceSpecialRow obj = new DataSourceSpecialRow
				{
					RowType = DataSourceRowType.SummaryRowRoot,
					Level = 0
				};
				int index2 = index - (base.ActualCount - _rootSummaryRowCount);
				List<Dictionary<string, ISummaryResult>> summaryRowsFromResults = SectionData.GetSummaryRowsFromResults(_summaryResults);
				ISummaryResult[] array = new ISummaryResult[summaryRowsFromResults[index2].Count];
				summaryRowsFromResults[index2].Values.CopyTo(array, 0);
				obj.SummaryResults = array;
				return obj;
			}
			SectionData section = GetSection(index);
			if (section != null)
			{
				DataSourceRowType rowType = section.GetRowType(index);
				switch (rowType)
				{
				case DataSourceRowType.SectionHeader:
				case DataSourceRowType.SectionFooter:
				{
					DataSourceSpecialRow dataSourceSpecialRow = new DataSourceSpecialRow();
					dataSourceSpecialRow.RowType = rowType;
					dataSourceSpecialRow.SummaryResults = section.SummaryResults2[section.SummaryResults2.Length - 1];
					dataSourceSpecialRow.Level = ((rowType == DataSourceRowType.SectionHeader) ? (section.GetLevel() + (index - section.SectionStartIndex)) : (section.FooterCount - 1 - (section.GetLevel() + (index - (section.SectionEndIndex - section.FooterCount + 1)))));
					if (SectionHeaderDisplayMode == DataSourceSectionHeaderDisplayMode.Combined)
					{
						for (int i = 0; i < base.GroupDescriptions.All.Count; i++)
						{
							dataSourceSpecialRow.SetSectionValue(base.GroupDescriptions.All[i].PropertyName, section.SectionKeyValues[i]);
							dataSourceSpecialRow.SetValue(base.GroupDescriptions.All[i].PropertyName, section.SectionKeyValues[i]);
						}
					}
					else if (dataSourceSpecialRow.Level >= 0 && dataSourceSpecialRow.Level < base.GroupDescriptions.All.Count)
					{
						dataSourceSpecialRow.SetSectionValue(base.GroupDescriptions.All[dataSourceSpecialRow.Level].PropertyName, section.SectionKeyValues[dataSourceSpecialRow.Level]);
						dataSourceSpecialRow.SetValue(base.GroupDescriptions.All[dataSourceSpecialRow.Level].PropertyName, section.SectionKeyValues[dataSourceSpecialRow.Level]);
					}
					return dataSourceSpecialRow;
				}
				case DataSourceRowType.SummaryRowSection:
				{
					DataSourceSpecialRow obj2 = new DataSourceSpecialRow
					{
						RowType = DataSourceRowType.SummaryRowSection,
						Level = section.HeaderStates.Length
					};
					int summaryRowIndex = section.GetSummaryRowIndex(index);
					List<Dictionary<string, ISummaryResult>> summaryRowsFromResults2 = SectionData.GetSummaryRowsFromResults(section.SummaryResults2[section.SummaryResults2.Length - 1]);
					ISummaryResult[] array2 = new ISummaryResult[summaryRowsFromResults2[summaryRowIndex].Count];
					summaryRowsFromResults2[summaryRowIndex].Values.CopyTo(array2, 0);
					obj2.SummaryResults = array2;
					return obj2;
				}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private int[] GetPageOffset(int index)
		{
			if (base.HasGroups && _sectionMap.HasSections)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				SectionData sectionData = GetSection(index);
				if (sectionData == null)
				{
					sectionData = _sectionMap.GetLastSection();
					if (_summaryResults.Length != 0 && index > sectionData.SectionEndIndex)
					{
						flag = true;
					}
				}
				int sectionStartIndex = sectionData.SectionStartIndex;
				if (base.ShouldEmitSectionHeaders && index >= sectionStartIndex && index < sectionStartIndex + sectionData.GetHeaderCount())
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				if (index - (sectionStartIndex + sectionData.GetHeaderCount() - 1) <= sectionData.PinnedCount + sectionData.SummaryTopCount)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				if (base.ShouldEmitSectionFooters)
				{
					if (index <= sectionData.SectionEndIndex && index >= sectionData.SectionEndIndex - sectionData.HeaderStates.Length - sectionData.SummaryBottomCount)
					{
						flag = true;
					}
				}
				else if (sectionData.SummaryBottomCount > 0 && index > sectionData.SectionEndIndex - sectionData.SummaryBottomCount && index <= sectionData.SectionEndIndex)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				int num = index - sectionData.FirstRowDisplacement;
				int num2 = (int)Math.Floor((double)num / (double)ActualPageSize);
				int num3 = num % ActualPageSize;
				if (flag)
				{
					num3 = -1;
				}
				return new int[2] { num2, num3 };
			}
			int num4 = (int)Math.Floor((double)index / (double)ActualPageSize);
			int num5 = index % ActualPageSize;
			return new int[2] { num4, num5 };
		}

		}

		private void IncrementPageCount(int page)
		{
			if (!_pageRequestCounts.ContainsKey(page))
			{
				_pageRequestCounts.Add(page, 1);
			}
			else
			{
				_pageRequestCounts[page] += 1;
			}
		}

		private void DecrementPageCount(int page)
		{
			if (!_pageRequestCounts.ContainsKey(page))
			{
				return;
			}
			_pageRequestCounts[page] -= 1;
			if (_pageRequestCounts[page] <= 0)
			{
				_pageRequestCounts.Remove(page);
				if (ActualDataProvider != null)
				{
					ActualDataProvider.RemovePageRequest(page);
				}
			}
		}

		[SuppressWidgetMember]
		public bool AddCandidate(int pageIndex, DataSourcePageRequestPriority priority)
		{
			bool result = false;
			if (!_pageCandidates.ContainsKey(pageIndex))
			{
				List<int> list = new List<int>();
				int[] array = TransformPage(pageIndex);
				foreach (int num in array)
				{
					if (!_actualPages.ContainsKey(num))
					{
						list.Add(num);
						IncrementPageCount(num);
						if (_pageRequestCounts[num] == 1 && ActualDataProvider != null)
						{
							ActualDataProvider.AddPageRequest(num, priority);
						}
						result = true;
					}
				}
				if (list.Count > 0)
				{
					_pageCandidates.Add(pageIndex, list.ToArray());
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		[SuppressWidgetMember]
		public void RemoveCandidate(int pageIndex)
		{
			if (_pageCandidates.ContainsKey(pageIndex))
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < _pageCandidates[pageIndex].Length; i++)
				{
					int page = _pageCandidates[pageIndex][i];
					DecrementPageCount(page);
				}
				_pageCandidates.Remove(pageIndex);
			}
		}

		public int[] TransformPage(int viewPageIndex)
		{
			int[] result = new int[1] { viewPageIndex };
			if (base.HasGroups && _sectionMap.HasSections)
			{
				int num = viewPageIndex * ActualPageSize;
				int num2 = num + ActualPageSize - 1;
				SectionData sectionData = GetSection(num);
				List<int> list = new List<int>();
				for (int i = num; i <= num2; i++)
				{
					if (sectionData == null)
					{
						break;
					}
					if (i > sectionData.SectionEndIndex)
					{
						if (sectionData.SectionIndex >= _sectionMap.Sections.Count - 1)
						{
							break;
						}
						sectionData = _sectionMap.Sections[sectionData.SectionIndex + 1];
					}
					if (sectionData.IsSectionContentVisible && (i < sectionData.SectionStartIndex || i > sectionData.SectionStartIndex + (sectionData.GetHeaderCount() - 1) + sectionData.PinnedCount))
					{
						int item = (i - sectionData.FirstRowDisplacement) / ActualPageSize;
						if (!list.Contains(item))
						{
							list.Add(item);
						}
					}
				}
				result = list.ToArray();
			}
			return result;
		}

		public virtual int GetUnrealizedCount()
		{
			int num = _actualPages.Count * ActualPageSize;
			return base.ActualCount - num;
		}

		protected internal override void OnSetItemOverride(int index, object oldItem, object newItem)

			base.OnSetItemOverride(index, oldItem, newItem);

				_actualPages.Remove(num);
			}
		}

		[DontObfuscate]
		protected override void RefreshInternalOverride()
		{
			base.RefreshInternalOverride();
			ActualPageSizePopulated = false;
			bool flag = base.ActualCount != 0;
			_dontQueueOnClear = true;
			if (!_expansionStateChanged)
			{
				ResetCache();
				if (flag)
				{
					OnClearItems();
				}
				_groupInformation = null;
				_summaryResults = null;
				_rootSummaryRowCount = 0;
				_sectionMap.Clear();
			}
			else
			{
				_expansionStateChanged = false;
				if (flag)
				{
					OnClearItems();
				}
			}
			ReRequestCandidates();
			PredictionEngine.EnqueueUpdate();
			_dontQueueOnClear = false;
		}

		private void ReRequestCandidates()
		{
			if (ActualDataProvider == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (int[] value in _pageCandidates.Values)
			{
				foreach (int pageIndex in value)
				{
					ActualDataProvider.AddPageRequest(pageIndex, DataSourcePageRequestPriority.Normal);
				}
			}
		}

		[DontObfuscate]
		protected internal override void OnClearItemsOverride()
		{
			base.OnClearItemsOverride();
			if (!_dontQueueOnClear)
			{
				QueueAutoRefresh();
			}
		}

		public override int IndexOfItem(object item)
		{
			FastIterationDictionary<object, LRUCacheItem<object, IDataSourcePage>> innerCache = _actualPages.InnerCache;
			List<object> keyList = innerCache.KeyList;
			List<LRUCacheItem<object, IDataSourcePage>> valueList = innerCache.ValueList;
			int count = valueList.Count;
			List<bool> removedList = innerCache.RemovedList;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (removedList[i])
				{
					continue;
				}
				IDataSourcePage value = valueList[i].Value;
				int num = value.Count();
				for (int j = 0; j < num; j++)
				{
					if (AreEqual(value.GetItemAtIndex(j), item))
					{
						return (int)keyList[i] * ActualPageSize + j;
					}
				}
			}
			if (ActualDataProvider != null && ActualDataProvider.IsItemIndexLookupSupported)
			{
				return ActualDataProvider.IndexOfItem(item);
			}
			return -1;
		}

		private bool AreEqual(object currItem, object item)
		{
			if (currItem == null && item == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (currItem == null || item == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return currItem.Equals(item);
		}

		public override int IndexOfKey(object[] key)
		{
			string[] actualPrimaryKey = base.ActualPrimaryKey;
			if (actualPrimaryKey == null || actualPrimaryKey.Length < 1 || ActualBaseDataProvider == null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			EnsureComparables(base.ActualSchema);
			DataSourcePropertiesComparer primaryKeyComparer = GetPrimaryKeyComparer();
			if (base.HasGroups && base.ShouldEmitSectionHeaders && !IsSectionContentVisible && IsSectionHeaderNormalRow && _sectionMap.Sections.Count > 0)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < _sectionMap.Sections.Count; i++)
				{
					SectionData sectionData = _sectionMap.Sections[i];
					DataSourceSpecialRow dataSourceSpecialRow = new DataSourceSpecialRow();
					for (int j = 0; j < sectionData.SectionKeyNames.Length; j++)
					{
						string name = sectionData.SectionKeyNames[j];
						object value = sectionData.SectionKeyValues[j];
						dataSourceSpecialRow.SetSectionValue(name, value);
					}
					if (primaryKeyComparer.CompareToKey(dataSourceSpecialRow, key) == 0)
					{
						return i;
					}
				}
			}
			FastIterationDictionary<object, LRUCacheItem<object, IDataSourcePage>> innerCache = _actualPages.InnerCache;
			List<object> keyList = innerCache.KeyList;
			List<LRUCacheItem<object, IDataSourcePage>> valueList = innerCache.ValueList;
			int count = valueList.Count;
			List<bool> removedList = innerCache.RemovedList;
			for (int k = 0; k < count; k++)
			{
				if (removedList[k])
				{
					continue;
				}
				IDataSourcePage value2 = valueList[k].Value;
				int num = value2.Count();
				for (int l = 0; l < num; l++)
				{
					if (primaryKeyComparer.CompareToKey(value2.GetItemAtIndex(l), key) == 0)
					{
						return (int)keyList[k] * ActualPageSize + l;
					}
				}
			}
			if (ActualDataProvider != null && ActualDataProvider.IsKeyIndexLookupSupported)
			{
				return ActualDataProvider.IndexOfKey(key);
			}
			return -1;
		}

		private DataSourcePropertiesComparer GetPrimaryKeyComparer()
		{
			ListSortDirection[] array = new ListSortDirection[base.ActualPrimaryKey.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i] = ListSortDirection.Ascending;
			}
			return new DataSourcePropertiesComparer(base.ActualPrimaryKey, array, _schemaComparables, this);
		}

		public override int GetStickyRowPriority(int row)
		{
			switch (GetRowType(row))
			{
			case DataSourceRowType.SectionHeader:
				return 100 - GetRowLevel(row);
			case DataSourceRowType.SectionFooter:
				return 99 - GetRowLevel(row);
			case DataSourceRowType.ShiftedRow:
			case DataSourceRowType.SummaryRowSection:
				return 2;
			case DataSourceRowType.SummaryRowRoot:
				return 3;
			default:
				return 1;
			}
		}

		public override int[] GetStickyRowsInRange(int firstVisibleIndex, int lastVisibleIndex)
		{
			if ((base.GroupDescriptions == null || base.GroupDescriptions.All.Count == 0) && (base.SummaryDescriptions == null || base.SummaryDescriptions.All.Count == 0))
			{
				return null;
			}
			SectionData sectionData = GetSection(firstVisibleIndex);
			SectionData sectionData2 = GetSection(lastVisibleIndex);
			if (_sectionMap.Sections.Count > 0)
			{
				if (_sectionMap.Sections.Count == 1)
				{
					sectionData = _sectionMap.Sections[0];
					sectionData2 = _sectionMap.Sections[0];
				}
				else
				{
					sectionData = _sectionMap.GetSection(firstVisibleIndex);
					if (sectionData != null)
					{
						while (sectionData.ParentSection != -1)
						{
							sectionData = _sectionMap.Sections[sectionData.ParentSection];
						}
					}
					sectionData2 = _sectionMap.GetSection(lastVisibleIndex);
					if (lastVisibleIndex >= base.ActualCount - _rootSummaryRowCount)
					{
						sectionData2 = _sectionMap.GetLastSection();
					}
				}
			}
			else if (_rootSummaryRowCount > 0)
			{
				List<int> list = new List<int>();
				for (int i = base.ActualCount - _rootSummaryRowCount; i < base.ActualCount; i++)
				{
					list.Add(i);
				}
				return list.ToArray();
			}
			if (sectionData == null || sectionData2 == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (sectionData.SectionIndex == _lastStartSection && sectionData.PinnedCount == _lastStartSectionPinCount && sectionData.SectionStartIndex == _lastStartSectionStartIndex && sectionData.SectionEndIndex == _lastStartSectionEndIndex && sectionData.SummaryTopCount == _lastStartSummaryTopCount && sectionData.SummaryBottomCount == _lastStartSummaryBottomCount && sectionData2.SectionIndex == _lastEndSection && sectionData2.PinnedCount == _lastEndSectionPinCount && sectionData2.SectionStartIndex == _lastEndSectionStartIndex && sectionData2.SectionEndIndex == _lastEndSectionEndIndex && sectionData2.SummaryTopCount == _lastEndSummaryTopCount && sectionData2.SummaryBottomCount == _lastEndSummaryBottomCount && _rootSummaryRowCount == _lastRootSummaryCount)
			{
				return _pinnedRowsInOrder;
			}
			_lastStartSection = sectionData.SectionIndex;
			_lastEndSection = sectionData2.SectionIndex;
			_lastStartSectionPinCount = sectionData.PinnedCount;
			_lastEndSectionPinCount = sectionData2.PinnedCount;
			_lastStartSectionStartIndex = sectionData.SectionStartIndex;
			_lastEndSectionStartIndex = sectionData2.SectionStartIndex;
			_lastStartSectionEndIndex = sectionData.SectionEndIndex;
			_lastEndSectionEndIndex = sectionData2.SectionEndIndex;
			_lastEndSummaryTopCount = sectionData2.SummaryTopCount;
			_lastEndSummaryBottomCount = sectionData2.SummaryBottomCount;
			_lastStartSummaryTopCount = sectionData.SummaryTopCount;
			_lastStartSummaryBottomCount = sectionData.SummaryBottomCount;
			_lastRootSummaryCount = _rootSummaryRowCount;
			List<int> list2 = new List<int>();
			for (int j = sectionData.SectionIndex; j <= sectionData2.SectionIndex; j++)
			{
				SectionData sectionData3 = _sectionMap.Sections[j];
				int num = sectionData3.HeaderStates.Length;
				int headerCount = sectionData3.GetHeaderCount();
				if (base.ShouldEmitSectionHeaders && base.HasGroups)
				{
					for (int k = 0; k < sectionData3.HeaderStates.Length; k++)
					{
						if (sectionData3.HeaderExpansionKeys[k] != null)
						{
							int item = sectionData3.SectionStartIndex + sectionData3.HeaderOffsets[k];
							list2.Add(item);
						}
						if (!sectionData3.HeaderStates[k])
						{
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				if (sectionData3.IsSectionContentVisible)
				{
					for (int l = 0; l < sectionData3.SummaryTopCount; l++)
					{
						list2.Add(sectionData3.SectionStartIndex + l + headerCount);
					}
					if (base.ShouldEmitShiftedRows)
					{
						for (int m = 0; m < sectionData3.PinnedCount; m++)
						{
							list2.Add(sectionData3.SectionStartIndex + m + num);
						}
					}
					if ((base.SummaryScope == DataSourceSummaryScope.Both || base.SummaryScope == DataSourceSummaryScope.Groups) && IncludeSummaryRowsInSection && IsSectionSummaryRowsAtBottom)
					{
						for (int num2 = sectionData3.SummaryBottomCount - 1; num2 >= 0; num2--)
						{
							if (base.ShouldEmitSectionFooters)
							{
								list2.Add(sectionData3.SectionEndIndex - headerCount - num2);
							}
							else
							{
								list2.Add(sectionData3.SectionEndIndex - num2);
							}
						}
					}
				}
				if (base.ShouldEmitSectionFooters && base.HasGroups)
				{
					int num3 = sectionData3.HeaderStates.Length - 1;
					while (num3 >= 0 && sectionData3.HeaderStates[num3])
					{
						list2.Add(sectionData3.SectionEndIndex - num3);
						num3--;
					}
				}
			}
			for (int n = base.ActualCount - _rootSummaryRowCount; n < base.ActualCount; n++)
			{
				list2.Add(n);
			}
			_pinnedRowsInOrder = list2.ToArray();
			return _pinnedRowsInOrder;
		}

		public override bool IsExclusivelySticky(int row)
		{
			DataSourceRowType rowType = GetRowType(row);
			if (rowType != DataSourceRowType.SectionHeader && rowType != DataSourceRowType.SectionFooter && rowType != DataSourceRowType.SummaryRowRoot)
			{
				if (IsSectionSummaryRowsAtBottom)
				{
					return rowType == DataSourceRowType.SummaryRowSection;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override DataSourceRowType GetRowType(int row)
		{
			if (row < 0)
			{
				return DataSourceRowType.Normal;
			}
			object itemAtIndex = GetItemAtIndex(row);
			if (itemAtIndex is DataSourceSpecialRow)
			{
				DataSourceRowType rowType = ((DataSourceSpecialRow)itemAtIndex).RowType;
				if (IsSectionHeaderNormalRow && rowType == DataSourceRowType.SectionHeader)
				{
					return DataSourceRowType.Normal;
				}
				return rowType;
			}
			return DataSourceRowType.Normal;
		}

		public override bool GetIsRowExpandedAtIndex(int rowIndex)
		{
			SectionData sectionData = _sectionMap.GetSection(rowIndex);
			if (sectionData == null)
			{
				sectionData = _sectionMap.GetLastSection();
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < sectionData.HeaderExpansionKeys.Length; i++)
			{
				if (sectionData.HeaderExpansionKeys[i] != null && rowIndex == sectionData.SectionStartIndex + sectionData.HeaderOffsets[i])
				{
					return sectionData.HeaderStates[i];
				}
			}
			return base.GetIsRowExpandedAtIndex(rowIndex);
		}

		public override void SetIsRowExpandedAtIndex(int rowIndex, bool state)
		{
			SectionData sectionData = _sectionMap.GetSection(rowIndex);
			if (sectionData == null)
			{
				sectionData = _sectionMap.GetLastSection();
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < sectionData.HeaderExpansionKeys.Length; i++)
			{
				if (sectionData.HeaderExpansionKeys[i] == null || rowIndex != sectionData.SectionStartIndex + sectionData.HeaderOffsets[i])
				{
					continue;
				}
				bool flag = false;
				string key = sectionData.HeaderExpansionKeys[i];
				if (_expansionStates.ContainsKey(key) && _expansionStates[key] != state)
				{
					bool oldState = _expansionStates[key];
					if (state == IsSectionExpandedDefault)
					{
						_expansionStates.Remove(key);
					}
					else
					{
						_expansionStates[key] = state;
					}
					flag = true;
					OnRowExpansionChanged(rowIndex, oldState, state);
				}
				else if (state != IsSectionExpandedDefault)
				{
					_expansionStates.Add(key, state);
					flag = true;
					OnRowExpansionChanged(rowIndex, IsSectionExpandedDefault, state);
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					_sectionMap.Clear();
					PopulateSections();
					_expansionStateChanged = true;
					if (base.ActualCount != _sectionMap.FullCount)
					{
						base.ActualCount = _sectionMap.FullCount + _rootSummaryRowCount;
					}
					else
					{
						QueueAutoRefresh();
					}
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		public override int GetRowLevel(int rowIndex)
		{
			if (rowIndex < 0)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			object itemAtIndex = GetItemAtIndex(rowIndex);
			if (itemAtIndex is DataSourceSpecialRow)
			{
				return ((DataSourceSpecialRow)itemAtIndex).Level;
			}
			if (IsGroupingSupported)
			{
				if (SectionHeaderDisplayMode == DataSourceSectionHeaderDisplayMode.Split)
				{
					return base.GroupDescriptions.All.Count;
				}
				if (base.GroupDescriptions.All.Count > 0)
				{
					return 1;
				}
			}
			return 0;
		}

		public override int GetRootSummaryRowCount()
		{
			return _rootSummaryRowCount;
		}

		private string CombineSectionKeysAndValues(SectionData section)
		{
			string text = "";
			for (int i = 0; i < section.SectionKeyNames.Length; i++)
			{
				text = text + section.SectionKeyNames[i] + ":" + section.SectionKeyValues[i];
			}
			return text;
		}

		private string CombineSectionKeysAndValues(SectionData section, int level)
		{
			if (SectionHeaderDisplayMode == DataSourceSectionHeaderDisplayMode.Combined)
			{
				return CombineSectionKeysAndValues(section);
			}
			string text = "";
			for (int i = 0; i < section.SectionKeyNames.Length; i++)
			{
				text = string.Concat(text, section.SectionKeyNames[i], ":", section.SectionKeyValues[i], ":");
			}
			return text + level;
		}

		public override ISummaryResult[] GetRootSummaryResults()
		{
			return _summaryResults;
		}

		public override ISummaryResult[][] GetSectionSummaryResults(int sectionIndex)
		{
			if (_sectionMap.Sections.Count > 0 && sectionIndex >= 0 && sectionIndex < _sectionMap.Sections.Count)
			{
				return _sectionMap.Sections[sectionIndex].SummaryResults2;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override IDataSource Clone()
		{
			return null;
		}

		public override void CloneProperties(IDataSource dataSource)
		{
			base.CloneProperties(dataSource);
			if (dataSource is VirtualDataSource virtualDataSource)
			{
				virtualDataSource.PageSizeRequested = PageSizeRequested;
				virtualDataSource.MaxCachedPages = MaxCachedPages;
			}
		}

		public override int UpdatePropertyAtKey(object[] key, string propertyPath, object value, bool isPending = false)
		{
			int result = base.UpdatePropertyAtKey(key, propertyPath, value, isPending);
			if (ConcurrencyTag != null && IsCRUDSupported())
			{
				int num = IndexOfKey(key);
				if (num > -1)
				{
					object itemAtIndex = GetItemAtIndex(num);
					object itemValue = ActualDataProvider.GetItemValue(itemAtIndex, ConcurrencyTag);
					if (itemValue != null)
					{
						base.TransactionService.GetState(key).Version = itemValue;
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public override void RemoveItemByKey(object[] key)
		{
			base.RemoveItemByKey(key);
			if (ConcurrencyTag == null || !IsCRUDSupported())
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = IndexOfKey(key);
			if (num > -1)
			{
				object itemAtIndex = GetItemAtIndex(num);
				object itemValue = ActualDataProvider.GetItemValue(itemAtIndex, ConcurrencyTag);
				if (itemValue != null)
				{
					base.TransactionService.GetState(key).Version = itemValue;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnTransactionEvent(TransactionEvent eventType, object eventData)
		{
			if (eventType != TransactionEvent.Commit)
			{
				return;
			}
			TransactionState[] changes = ((TransactionCommit)eventData).Changes;
			List<TransactionState> list = new List<TransactionState>();
			for (int i = 0; i < changes.Length; i++)
			{
				TransactionType transactionType = changes[i].TransactionType;
				object id = null;
				object value = null;
				if (transactionType == TransactionType.Delete || transactionType == TransactionType.Update)
				{
					Dictionary<string, object> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, object>();
					object[] array = (object[])changes[i].ID;
					for (int j = 0; j < base.ActualPrimaryKey.Length; j++)
					{
						dictionary.Add(base.ActualPrimaryKey[j], array[j]);
					}
					id = dictionary;
				}
				switch (transactionType)
				{
				case TransactionType.Add:
				{
					Dictionary<string, object> dictionary2 = new Dictionary<string, object>();
					object item = ((object[])changes[i].ID)[0];
					for (int k = 0; k < base.ActualSchema.PropertyNames.Length; k++)
					{
						string text = base.ActualSchema.PropertyNames[k];
						dictionary2.Add(text, ActualDataProvider.GetItemValue(item, text));
					}
					value = dictionary2;
					break;
				}
				case TransactionType.Update:
					value = (Dictionary<string, object>)changes[i].Value;
					break;
				}
				list.Add(new TransactionState(id, transactionType, value)
				{
					Version = changes[i].Version
				});
			}
			TransactionState[] changes2 = list.ToArray();
			if (this.BatchStarted != null)
			{
				this.BatchStarted(this, new DataSourceBatchStartedEventArgs(changes2));
			}
			ActualDataProvider.CreateBatchRequest(changes2);
		}

		private void DataProvider_BatchCompleted(bool success, bool requiresRefresh, string[] messages)
		{
			if (requiresRefresh)
			{
				QueueAutoRefresh();
			}
			if (this.BatchCompleted != null)
			{
				this.BatchCompleted(this, new DataSourceBatchCompletedEventArgs(success, messages));
			}
		}

		protected override void EnsureComparables(IDataSourceSchema schema)
		{
			if (_comparablesDirty && _actualPages.Count > 0)
			{
				object itemAtIndex = _actualPages.InnerCache.ValueList[0].Value.GetItemAtIndex(0);
				if (itemAtIndex != null)
				{
					_schemaComparables = GetComparables(schema, itemAtIndex);
					_comparablesDirty = false;
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class DataSourceBatchStartedEventArgs
	{
		public TransactionState[] Changes { get; private set; }

		public DataSourceBatchStartedEventArgs(TransactionState[] changes)
		{
			Changes = changes;
		}
	}
	public delegate void DataSourceBatchStartedEventHandler(object sender, DataSourceBatchStartedEventArgs e);
	public class DataSourceBatchCompletedEventArgs
	{
		public bool Success { get; private set; }

		public string[] Messages { get; private set; }

		public DataSourceBatchCompletedEventArgs(bool success, string[] messages)
		{
			Success = success;
			Messages = messages;
		}
	}
	public delegate void DataSourceBatchCompletedEventHandler(object sender, DataSourceBatchCompletedEventArgs e);
}
